Ha juntzanh ley tik ix yak' Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a tzinan lu'um, haton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix alchaji, to ol yak' silab' heb' israel t'a Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ik'kot winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, tzik'anpaxkot spichul heb' syak'och t'a yopisio t'a sacerdoteal. Tzik'paxkot aceite sk'anchaji a sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Tzik'paxkot junok nok' kelem wakax ol ak'chaj silab'il yuj mul yet' chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' junok yune' mo'och ixim pan malaj yich.
Tza molb'an heb' etchonhab' smasanil t'a sti' mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Moisés chi' icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, ix molchaj anima smasanil t'a sti' mantiado chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová to ol ko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal t'a stz'ey. Ix b'ikjiel heb' yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch skamix winhaj Aarón chi' yet' stzek'ul yuj winh yet' pax k'apak pichul jukan, k'apak chaleka yet' k'apak stzek'ul tz'isb'iloch yelwanub'.
Haxo t'a spatik k'apak chi', ix yak'paxoch jun k'apak smakul snhisk'ol winh, ha t'a yol k'apak chi' ix yak'och k'e'en Urim winh yet' k'e'en Tumim.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jik'e sk'ox winh, haton jun k'apak ix b'ak'jioch t'a sjolom winh. Haxo t'a snanhal sat winh, ix ak'jioch jun k'e'en yelwanub' nab'a oro, haton sch'oxani to sik'b'iloch winh t'a sacerdoteal, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh aceite winhaj Moisés chi', haton sk'anchaji a sik'chajoch junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová. Ix stzikanem winh t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tastak ayoch t'a yo'ol chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yochkan masanil tastak chi' yikok Jehová.
Hanheja' jun aceite chi', ix tzikjiem ukel t'a yib'anh altar yet' t'a yib'anh masanil syamk'ab'il, t'a yib'anh jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anpaxk'e aceite winhaj Moisés t'a sjolom winhaj Aarón yuj yochkan winh yikok Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' winh t'a stz'ey. Ix ak'jioch spichul heb' jukan, stzek'ul heb' yet' sk'ox heb' yuj winh, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' kelem wakax winh, nok' ol och t'a silab'il yuj mul. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winh. Ix yik'anb'at schik'il nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sch'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak schanhil, yik wach' chab'il yuj Dios. Haxo jantakto chik' ixto kan chi', ix stob'kanem winh t'a yichtak altar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan yikok Jehová, yik wach' slajwikanel chukal ta'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta masanil xepu'al nok' winh ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu'al ayoch t'ay. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix snhustz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo jantakto nok' wakax chi' ix kani, haton stz'umal nok' yet' sb'ak'chil nok' yet' sch'anhtza' nok', ix ak'chajkanoch sk'ak'al t'a spatikelta campamento, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix yak'anpax ik'jokkot nok' kalnel winh snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' winhaj Moisés chi', ix stzikanoch schik'il nok' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ix skotak xikej nok' winh, ix snhusantz'a sjolom nok' winh yet' nok' chok' yaj chi' yet' sxepual nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smaxan nok' yol sk'o'ol winh yet' nok' yok. Ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun ofrenda chi' te suk'uk'i sjab' ix yab' Jehová, icha wal ix aj yalani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot junxo nok' ch'ak kalnel winh yik sk'anchaji yik tz'ochkan heb' t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal chi', ix yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yik'anb'at jab'ok schik'il nok' winh, ix sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin winhaj Aarón t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' winh t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok winh t'a swach'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' t'a stz'ey, ix yak'anpaxoch schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a sjayil schikin heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a smam sk'ab' heb' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok heb' t'a swach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanoch winh jantakto chik' ixto kan t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta xepu' winh ayoch t'a nok' snhe yet' ayoch t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol, xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok' yet' nok' stut schab'il yet' xepu' ayoch t'ay yet' nok' xub' t'a swach'.

Ix yik'ankot jun yune' mo'och ixim pan winh malaj yich, ix yak'och winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yik'ank'eta jun ixim pan chi' winh t'a yol mo'och chi' yet' junxo ixim kalab'il yet' aceite yet' jun ixim k'oxox b'ob'il t'a ixim harina, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' xepu' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh nok' xub' t'a swach'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an masanil juntzanh tik winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, yik sb'akhanek' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxek' masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ix snhusantz'a winh smasanil t'a yib'anh altar yet' nok' silab' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj sik'chajoch heb' t'a yopisio. Te suk'uk'i sjab' ix yab' Jehová.
Ix yik'anpaxkot snhisk'ol nok' kalnel winh ix ak'ji yuj sik'chajkanoch heb' t'a yopisio. Ix sb'akhanoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix yik'kan winhaj Moisés chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot aceite winh yet' chik' ayek' t'a yib'anh altar. Ix stzikank'e winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Aarón yet' t'a spichul. Ix tzikanpaxk'e winh t'a yib'anh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a spichul heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' yikok Jehová yet' spichul smasanil.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal chi': Tz'anhjokab' nok' chib'ej t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Hata' tze chi nok' yet' ixim pan ayem t'a yol jun yune' mo'och, haton ixim ix ak'ji yik tzex ochkan t'a eyopisio. Icha ix aj walani: Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ol swa jun wa'el tik heb', xin chi, ix walani.
Ha jantakto manh ol lajwok nok' chib'ej chi' yet' ixim pan chi' eyu'uj, ol he nhuskantz'aok.
Ha t'a yichanh k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová, anhej ta' tzex aj ukeok k'uhal masanto sk'och sk'uhal eyochkan t'a eyopisio.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix b'o icha wal ix aj schekan Jehová ko k'ulej yik slajwikanel he mul.

Yuj chi' ha t'a yichanh mantiado, hata' tzex kan ukeok k'uhal yet' ukeok ak'wal. Tze k'anab'ajan masanil juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová yik wach' max ex chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal masanil tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
T'a yewial slajwi uke' k'uhal yochkan winhaj Aarón t'a yopisio chi', ix awtaj winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yuj winhaj Moisés.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Ik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yik tz'och nok' silab'il yuj a mul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, haton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Tza nhustz'a smasanil silab'il u'uj, tzak'och nok' t'a yichanh Jehová.

Alpax t'a heb' ketisraelal to syik'kot junok nok' mam chiwa heb' silab'il yuj smul. Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' kelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' kalnel, yuj snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Syik'anpaxkot junok nok' wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel smiljicham t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet'ok. Syik'anpaxkot junok ofrenda heb' t'a tas swaji, kalab'il yet' aceite, yujto ol sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'ayex tiknaik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' t'a yichanh mantiado masanil tastak ix chekji yik'kot yuj winhaj Moisés chi'. Masanil chonhab' ix jawi molan, ix och linhjab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' icha tik: Haton wal juntzanh tik schek Jehová he k'ulej yik wach' ol sch'ox wal stzikikial t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj Aarón chi': Nitzkot a b'a t'a slak'anil altar tik, tzak'an nok' nok' silab'ok yuj a mul yet' nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Icha chi' ol aj yak'ji lajwok a mul. Tzak'anpax nok' silab' yuj yak'ji lajwok ko mul a onh israel onh tik, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Aarón t'a slak'anil altar chi', ix smilancham nok' kelem wakax ix yak' winh silab'il yuj smul chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix japax heb' yuninal winh yet' schik'il nok' silab' chi', ix yak'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', ix sukanoch winh t'a sch'ak altar chi'. Haxo jab'okxo chik' ixto kan chi', ix sekkanem winh t'a yich altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusantz'a smasanil xepu'al nok' winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' pax stut nok' yet' xepu'al ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok', haton nok' silab' yuj mul, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haxo pax sb'ak'chil nok' yet' stz'umal, ix nhusjitz'a t'a spatikel campamento.
Ix smilanpaxcham nok' silab' winhaj Aarón chi', nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil, haxo heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', ix stzikanoch winh t'a schanhil pak'anh altar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anpaxkot sjolom nok' heb' yet' nok' ix xikchajb'at chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ix maxchaj nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' nok' yok, ix snhusanpaxtz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', t'a yib'anh nok' wanxo stz'a chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yuj heb' yetchonhab'. Ix yik'ankot nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj smul heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ix smilancham nok' winh, ix yak'an nok' winh silab'il icha ix yutej yak'an nok' b'ab'el chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an junxo nok' silab' winh to stz'a smasanil icha sleyal.
Ix yak'anpax ofrenda winh t'a tas swaji. Ix yik'b'at jun b'echanh ixim harina winh, ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yet' silab' snhusjitz'a t'a junjun k'inhib'alil.

Ix yak'anpax nok' wakax winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel ix yik'kot heb' yetchonhab' chi' silab'il yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Dios. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix ik'ankot schik'il nok', haxo winh ix tzikanoch t'a schanhil pak'anh altar chi'.
Ix yak'anpax xepu'al nok' wakax heb' yet' xepu'al nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', haton xepu' ayoch t'a snhe nok', t'a nok' yol sk'o'ol yet' t'a nok' stut yet' xepu' ayoch t'a yib'anh seyub' nok'.
Junnhej ix aj nok' xepu' chi' yet' nok' snhi' sk'o'ol. Haxo winhaj Aarón ix nhusantz'a nok' xepu'al chi' t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo pax nok' snhisk'ol chi' yet' nok' xub' t'a swach', tonhej ix b'akhjiek' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi snhusantz'a silab' winh yuj mul yet' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios, ix emixta winh b'aj ay altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winhaj Moisés yet' winh t'a mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová. Haxo ix elta heb' winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxan stzikikial Jehová t'a masanil heb' israel chi'.

Ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' silab' yet' xepu'al nok' ayk'e t'a yib'anh altar, ix tz'ab'at smasanil. Ha ix yilan masanil jun chi' heb' chonhab' chi', ix el yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix em nhojjab' heb', ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' t'a sat lu'um.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik'kot junjun chaynub' yik incienso heb' winh, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxem incienso heb' winh t'a yib'anh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to manhoklaj ix halani.
Yuj chi' ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh, ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Haton jun tik syalelk'och slolonel Jehová ix yala': Ha yuj heb' tzin ak'an serwil, ol in ch'ox in b'a, to Ha inxonhej ochi. Ha t'a masanil in chonhab' ol in ch'ox in tzikikial, xchi Jehová, xchi winh. Ix em numnaj winhaj Aarón chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix awtan winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Elzafán, heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel yicham winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Nitzekkot he b'a a ex tik t'a sti' mantiado b'aj ayek' sniwanil heb' he k'ab' eyok chi', ik'ekel heb' t'a spatikel campamento, xchi winh.

Ix jawi heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh t'a spatikel campamento icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayto'och spichul heb' chamnak chi' t'ay, haton k'apak sk'antaxon heb' t'a yopisio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a chawanhxo heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Manh eyik'el he k'ox ayk'e t'a he jolom, manh he nhik'chitejb'at he pichul yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Haxo talaj tz'aji, tzex champaxi, haxo skot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh ko masanil a onh israel onh tik. Palta a masanil heb' ketchonhab' tik syal yok' sk'ol heb' yuj mach ix satel Jehová yet' k'ak'.

Manh ex elpax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yik wach' manh ol ex chamok, a ex tik sik'b'il ex eli, ak'b'iloch aceite to yik Jehová t'ayex, xchi winh. Icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:

--Ayik ol ach och a ach tik, ma heb' uninal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, manh eyuk' wino, ma tastak pajb'inakxo, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex chami. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Manh he k'ulej juntzanh chi' yujto yowalil snachajel eyu'uj, tastak wach' icha yalan ley yet' tastak manh wach'ok.
Yowalil tze k'ayb'ejpax heb' eyetchonhab' t'a juntzanh ley ix in chek yal winhaj Moisés t'ayex tik, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Ik'ekkot ixim harina ixto kan t'a ofrenda ix tz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, tze b'oan ixim pan malaj yich t'a yichanh altar, yujto a jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Tze wa'an t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto a ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová ik yaj yet' heb' uninal. Haton juntzanh tik ix alji t'ayin.

Haxo pax nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub', tz'ik'chajel nok', a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaji. Tza chi yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' isil t'a junok lugar to wach' yaji icha syal ley, yujto a juntzanh chi' eyiktaxon yaj t'a silab' sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' ketchonhab' yet' Dios.

Yujto a nok' xub' tz'ik'jiel chi' yet' nok' snhisk'ol sb'akhjiek' t'a yichanh Jehová, junnhej tz'aj yak'ji yet' nok' xepu' snhusjitz'aok. Ha cha makan nok' chi', ik yet' heb' uninal t'a masanil tiempo icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anpax winhaj Moisés chi' yuj nok' chiwa ix ak'ji silab'il yuj mul. Haxo ix yalan heb' winh to toxo ix snhustz'a nok' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Itamar, ix yalan winh icha tik:

--¿Tas yuj maj he chi nok' silab' t'a yamak'il skajnub' Jehová? Ha jun makan silab' chi', yik Jehová yaji, yuj chi' ix ak'ji t'ayex, yuj he chi'an nok', yik tz'ik'jiel smul heb' molanek' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yujto a schik'il nok' silab' chi', maj ik'jib'at t'a yol skajnub' Jehová, yuj chi' yowalil to ix he chi nok' t'a yamak'il chi', icha ix aj walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Aarón icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ix yak' silab' heb' yuj smul yet' silab' to stz'a smasanil, wach'chom icha chi', palta ina wal tas ix jawi t'a wib'anh. Tato ix in chi nok' silab' ix ak'ji yuj mul chi', ¿tom chab'il in yuj Jehová tza na'? xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Moisés icha chi', ix scha'an sk'ol winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:
Alek t'a masanil heb' eyetchonhab' to ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, haton juntzanh nok' tik syal he chi'ani:
Nok' sjax yanh cha xechanh yech.

Palta a juntzanhxo nok' ol wal tik, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an nok', wach'chom sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok': Nok' camello sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' tejón, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', a nok' chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' niwak chich, sjax yanh nok', palta tzijtum yech nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, wach'chom cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxpax swa'el nok', yuj chi' max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Max yal he chi'an juntzanh nok' nok' chi', max yalpax eyaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', yowalil tze na'a to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley.
Haxo pax nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, ma t'a yoltak a niwak ha', syal he chi'an nok' ay sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik.
Haxo pax nok' malaj sk'axil, malaj pax stuminal spatik, max yal-laj he chi'an nok'. Ha nok' chi' yajb'entak nok', wach'chom ha t'a yol ha' mar ma t'a yoltak ha' ay nok'.
Yujto yajb'entak nok', manh he chi nok', manh eyampax nok' chamnakxo.
Masanil nok' malaj sk'axil yet' stuminal spatik ay t'a yoltak ha', yajb'entakokab' yaj nok' t'a yol he sat.
Hanheja' pax t'a skal nok' much, manh ol yal-laj he chi'an juntzanh nok' ol wal tik, yujto manh wach'ok nok': Icha nok' t'iw, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano yet' masanil makanhil nok' xulem chi',
yet' masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' avestruz, nok' niwak tonton, nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' kujub', nok' kormorán, nok' ibis,
nok' pech, nok' julum chay, nok' ostok,
nok' cigüeña yet' masanil makanhil nok' garza yet' nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Hanhejtona' pax masanil nok' kotak nok' tzek' jenhenhok t'a jun petanhil sb'ey t'a sat lu'um, yajb'entakokab' nok' t'a yol he sat.
Haxo pax tato a nok' ay yip yok sk'e tz'itnajok, wach'chom sjenhwi nok', sb'eypax nok' t'a sat lu'um, syal schiji nok'.
Ha t'a skal nok' chi' syal he chi'an smasanil makanhil nok' k'ulub', nok' niwak k'ulub' yet' nok' chil.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo nok' kotakil nok' tzek' jenhenhok, ma tzek' t'a sat lu'um tik, yowalil tzeyaj nok'.

Tato tze yam juntzanh nok' nok' swal tik ayik chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tzex ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto sk'ik'b'iemi. Masanil nok' nok' ay yech palta manh chaxechanhoklaj, max sjaxpax yanh, a juntzanh nok' chi' nachajokab' el eyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok'. Yalnhej tas nok'al to chanhe' yok palta tzijtum yech mokab' wach'ok nok' t'a yol he sat. Yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman junok nok' nok' chi' tato chamnakxo nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley. Icha pax chi' junok mach tz'ik'ancha'anh nok' chamnak nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi. Manh wach'ok juntzanh nok' chi' icha yalan ley.

Haxo masanil nok' nok' tzek' t'a sat lu'um, nachajokab' el eyu'uj to max yal schiji juntzanh nok' tik: Icha nok' k'uxum boton, nok' ch'o'ow, nok' k'ok'on yet' masanil makanhil nok' pajtza' yet' masanil makanhil nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjonok: Haton nok' ayin, nok' lagarto, nok' patix yet' nok' tzalajk'ab'.

Ha t'a skal masanil nok' nok', a juntzanh nok' tik, nachajokab' el eyu'uj to manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yalnhej mach syaman nok' ayik toxo ix cham nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.

K'inalok ay junok tas b'aj tz'em nok' chamnak nok' chi', a jun chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley: Wach'chom a junok te te', junok pichul, junok tz'u'um, junok koxtal, ma junok yamk'ab' yik munlajel, tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, yowalil slab'chajem t'a skal ha ha'. Palta manto wach'ok tz'ajkani, masanto sk'ik'b'iemi, ichato chi' wach' tz'ajkani.
Tato tz'em junok nok' nok' chi' t'a yol junok lum chen ayik toxo ix cham nok', a tas ayem t'a yol lum chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, haxo jun chen chi', yowalil smak'jipoj lu'um.
Yalnhej tas chib'il wailal yet' yal ayem t'a yol jun chen chi', ma uk'em, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yuj chi' tato tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok tasi, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, wach'chom a junok horno, ma junok yet'tal b'aj tz'och k'ak', yowalil spojjieli. Ha jun yamk'ab' chi' manhxo wach'ok icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manhxo wach'ok pax t'a yol he sat.
Palta a sjaj ha ha', ma ha' uk'b'ila' wach'chom tz'em nok' chamnak nok' t'a yol ha', wach'nhej yaj ha', anhej jun mach tz'ik'ank'eta nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yol ha' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok tz'em junok nok' chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh junok makan inhat tz'awchaji, a jun makan inhat chi' max ixtaxel-laj.
Palta tato a jun makan inhat lab'anxo, tz'em junok chamnak nok' chi' t'a yib'anh, a juntzanh inhat chi' manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkani.
K'inalok scham junok nok' nok' to schiji, a mach syaman nok', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi.

Ha mach schi'an sb'ak'chil nok' chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'ikanemi. Ha mach tz'ik'anelta junok chamnak nok' chi' yowalil sjuk'el spichul, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Manh he chi juntzanh nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, yujto manh wach'ok nok'.

Masanil nok' nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi t'a sat lu'um, wach'chom nok' sb'ey yet' schanhil yok, ma nok' tzijtum yok, masanil juntzanh nok' chi' manh wach'ok nok' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' manh he chi nok'.
Manh he juel he b'a a ex tik yuj nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', yujto manh wach'ok tzex ajkan yuj nok'.
Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in, yuj chi' b'esekel he b'a t'a juntzanh manh wach'ok chi', yujto wach' innhej, yuj chi' te max yal eyixtanb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh nok' chi'.
Ha in Jehová in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, he Diosal in, yuj chi' te wach'okab'nhej tzeyutej he b'a yujto wach' innhej.
Haton wal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil nok' nok', nok' much yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha' yet' masanil nok' tzek' jachachok t'a sat lu'um tik, swal t'ayex
yik wach' snachajel eyu'uj b'ajtil ay nok' wach' syal schiji yet' nok' manh wach'ok max yal schiji, xchi Jehová, xe chi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato a junok ix ix tz'aj junok swinak unin, yowalil uke' k'uhal manh sakok yaj ix icha sleyal, ichataxon yik syilan sb'islab' uj ix t'a juntak el.
T'a wal yukub'ixial yaj jun winak unin chi', tz'ak'ji circuncidar.

Haxo pax ix nunab'il chi', 33 k'uhalto manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix, ichato wanto sakb'itan sb'a ix, max yal-laj syaman junok tas ix to wik yaji, max yalpax sb'at ix b'aj ay in kajnub' ayik manto tz'akwok juntzanh k'uhal chi'.
Palta tato ix unin tz'aj jun, 14 k'uhal tz'ek'i ayik manto sakok yaj ix, ichataxon tz'aj t'a sb'islab' uj t'a juntak el, slajwi chi' 66 k'uhal skan ix yik sakb'itan sb'a.

Ayik stz'akwi juntzanh k'uhal yik sakb'itan sb'a ix yuj yune' ix alji chi', wach'chom winak unin ma ix unin, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix silab'il yet' junok nok' yalnhej makanhil paramuch, syak' ix silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul. Ha juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sacerdote t'a yichanh mantiado.
Haxo jun winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'an t'ayin silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix. Haton juntzanh sleyal tik ayik tz'alji winak unin, ma ix unin.

Palta tato a ix nunab'il chi' malaj junok nok' skalnel chi' syal yak'ani, syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, jun nok' stz'a silab'il, jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul. Haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'an silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:

Tato ay junok anima smalk'e sniwanil, ma sk'e wochjab', ma chak sulinak tz'aj yilji sniwanil, talaj lepra jun yab'il chi', yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winhaj Aarón, ma t'a juntzanhokxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal winh.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilan jun yab'il chi'. Tato a xi'il b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', sakxo, ma niwan chekel to manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ay jun yab'il chi', palta julxo yich, a jun yab'il chi' lepraxo. Ayik toxo ix ilji jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote, a winh tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal yetanimail.
Tato sakxo yilji stz'umal b'aj ay jun yab'il chi', palta to anhej t'a stz'umal ayochi, manh sakok pax xi'il chi' ta', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi' ukeok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' hanheja' max b'eyb'ati, smakchajxi ukeokxo k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi ukexo k'uhal chi', sayjixi iljok jun anima chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wanxo sateli, maxtzak b'eyb'at t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', ichato chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manh lepraok tz'ik'ani, komon yab'ilnhej. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul jun pena'ay chi', wach'xo tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato a jun yab'il t'a sniwanil junok anima chi' sb'at lheb'eb'ok, wach'chom toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to manh lepraok, yowalil skotxi t'a winh sacerdote chi' yik sayanxi yil winh.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' to wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syal winh to a jun yab'il chi' lepra toni.
Tato ay junok anima ay lepra t'ay, yowalil tz'ik'jikot t'a winh sacerdote.
Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato wan smalk'ei, sakxo yilji sat chi', wanxo pax sakb'i xi'il t'a sat chi', chekelxo sb'ak'chil.

Tato icha chi', haton jun chi' skuchan lepra, kotak skal sch'oxank'e sb'a t'a stz'umal chi', yuj chi' syalan winh sacerdote chi' to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail. Manhxo yowalilok smakchaj t'a ukeokxo k'uhal.
Tato elanhchamel sb'at lheb'naj jun yab'il chi', smajel sniwanil chi' yuj, hato ha' tz'aj yilanoch winh sacerdote chi',
ayik slajwi yilan winh, tato toxo ix majel sniwanil chi', sakxonhej yilji jun anima chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay.
Tato ay junok k'uhal scheklajk'e sb'ak'chil t'a skal jun yab'il chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Haxo winh sacerdote tz'ilan jun yab'il chi', tato ay b'aj tz'el tochnaj stz'umal ichnhej ta', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato sakb'ixiel b'aj ix el tochnaj chi', yowalil skot jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote,
yik wach' say yil winh. Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani tato sakxo yilji jun yab'il chi', syalan winh to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.
Tato ay mach ayk'e junok yab'il mal t'ay, stakjixiemi,
haxo t'a sat chi' smali, sak yilji, ma chak sulinak yilji, a jun chi' yowalil skot t'a yichanh winh sacerdote.

Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'ilani, tato manhoknhej t'a stz'umal ayoch jun yab'il chi', tato sakxo xi'il t'a sat jun yab'il chi', a winh tz'alani to lepra jun yab'il chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Tato syil winh sacerdote chi', to max sakb'ilaj xi'il b'aj ay sat chi' to t'a satnhej stz'umal ayochi, wanxo stakji, a jun anima chi' yowalil smakchaj ukeok k'uhal.

Ayik slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tato yelk'olalnhej sb'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi' t'a stz'umal jun anima chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', syalelk'ochi to anhej sjech'al aykani, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to manhxalaj smay jun yab'il chi'.

K'inalok ay junok mach ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil, tato scheklaj sb'ak'chil jun anima b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo t'a sb'ak'chil chi' scheklajpaxk'e junok setanh saksak, ma chak sulinak to sb'at lheb'eb'ok.

Ha winh sacerdote tz'ilani, tato a xi'il wanxo sakb'i, wanxo sb'at yich jun setanh b'aj ay sat chi', tato icha chi', lepra ix cheklajk'e b'aj ay yaxk'a chi', haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to maxtzak yal-laj yajek' jun anima chi' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote to malaj junok xil wan sakb'ieli, to manh wanok sb'at yich jun yab'il chi', palta to wan stakjiemi, yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' t'a ukeok k'uhal.
Slajwi chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a sniwanil jun anima chi', syalan winh to lepra tz'ik'ani, maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Palta tato a b'aj setkixtak chi', wa'anochi, wanxo sb'oxi, tonhej smal yuj b'aj stz'ai, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun yab'il chi' malaj smay, anhej sjech'al b'aj stz'a chi' skani.
Tato ha t'a junok winak ma t'a junok ix ix sk'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom, ma t'a yuk'ti',
a winh sacerdote yowalil sayan yil jun chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at yich, mato wan sk'anb'iel xi'il yuj, syalan winh sacerdote chi' to lepra jun ayoch chi' t'a jun anima chi'.
Palta tato max b'atlaj yich jun yab'il chi', manh k'ik'ok wal xi'il b'aj ay yab'il chi', yowalil smakchaj jun anima chi' ukeok k'uhal.
Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi', maxtzak b'atlaj lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi', malaj yich, max k'anb'iel-laj xi'il,
syalan winh to sjoxjiel stitak yab'il, palta max joxjiel-laj t'a sat yab'il, smakchaj ukeokxo k'uhal jun anima chi'.

Haxo yik toxo ix ek'b'at ukexo k'uhal chi', sayanxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max b'at lheb'eb'ok, max b'at yich yuj, syalan winh to malaj smay jun yab'il chi', anhej to sjuk'el spichul jun anima chi', wach' tz'ajxikani.
Palta tato ayik toxo ix alchaji to wach' sk'ol jun anima chi', sb'atxi lheb'eb'ok jun yab'il chi',
yowalil sayxi yil winh sacerdote chi'. Tato a jun yab'il chi' wan sb'at lheb'eb'ok t'a stz'umal, manh yowalilok k'an yilji xi'il, lepra tz'ik'ani.
Palta tato wanxo stakji, k'ik' skotxi xi'il, a winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to wach'xo sk'ol jun anima chi'.
Tato a junok winak ma junok ix ix setkixtak saksak t'a stz'umal,
a winh sacerdote tz'ilan stz'umal chi', tato saktak wal yilji, palta manh kopopioklaj, komon yab'il tz'ik'an jun anima chi' syal chi', malaj smay.
Tato ay junok winak sk'ajb'anel xil sjolom ma anhej t'a snanhal sat sk'ajb'anel xi'il, manhxalaj xi'il skani, a jun chi' malaj smay.

Palta tato sk'e junok yab'il yaxk'a b'aj manhxalaj xi'il chi', yowalil syil winh sacerdote. Tato chak sulinak yilji jun yaxk'a chi' icha yab'il lepra, haton lepra ayoch t'ay. Syalan winh sacerdote chi' to a jun anima chi', maxtzak yal-laj yajek' t'a skal yetanimail yuj jun yab'il chi'.

Ha mach pena'ay yuj lepra, yowalil a pichul nhik'chimtak syak'ochi, malaj smusil sjolom syak'k'ei, smusan nanhalok sat. Tato sb'at t'a skal anima, tz'el yaw, syalan icha tik: Elanhek, chuk waji, chuk waji, xchi.
Ayik ayoch jun yab'il chi' t'ay, yowalil sch'okoj tz'aj t'a spatikel campamento.
Ayik k'ustumtak yilji junok pichul lana, ma lino,
yalnhej tas makanhil, pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, ma junok tz'u'um to yamk'ab' yaji,

tato ya'ax yilji, ma chakchak yilji juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi', haton jun makan to tz'el lheb'eb'ok. Ha jun chi' yowalil sch'oxji t'a winh sacerdote yik syilan jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi' winh, smakchaj jun chi' ukeok k'uhal.

Haxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', tz'iljixi. Tato toxo ix b'at lheb'eb'ok t'a jun pichul chi', ma t'a junok tz'um sk'anji chi', a jun chi' haton juntzanh k'ustumtak tz'el lheb'eb'ok, a juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' ay smay.
Yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il to ayxo jun chi' t'ay, yowalil snhusjitz'a smasanil, yujto a jun chi' tzijtum tas syixtejb'ati.
Palta tato ayik syilan winh sacerdote chi' to max b'eylaj juntzanh sk'ustumtakil chi',
syalan winh to sjuk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', smakchajkan ukeokxo k'uhal.

Ayik toxo ix juk'chajel jun yamk'ab' chi', ichato chi' syilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato max k'exmaj yilji jun setanh sk'ustumtakil chi', wach'chom max el lheb'eb'ok, yowalil snhusjitz'aok, wach'chom a jun sk'ustumtakil chi' ayoch t'a spatik ma t'a yo'ol, yujto yelxo ay smay jun chi'.
Tato a syilan winh sacerdote chi' ayik toxo ix juk'chajel chi', wanxo satel jun sk'ustumtakil chi', slot'chajel b'aj ayoch chi'.
Palta tato scheklajxik'e sk'ustumtakil jun chi', yowalil snhusjitz'aok.
Ha juntzanh tastak b'aj satel juntzanh k'ustumtak chi' ayik sjuk'chajeli, yowalil sjuk'chajel junelxo, icha chi' syal sk'anchajxi.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a k'ustum tz'och t'a junok pichul pach'uch'ab'il, ma jalb'il, lana, ma lino, ma junok tz'u'um. Icha chi' tz'aj scheklajkaneli tato wach' yaji, mato manh wach'ok yaji, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ix schek Jehová yal juntzanh ley tik winhaj Moisés, ix yalani:

Haton wal jun ley tik sk'anab'ajej junok anima ek'nak lepra t'ay: Ayik sna'ani to ix b'oxi sk'o'ol, yowalil syawtej winh sacerdote t'a spatikel campamento chi' yik syilan winh tato manhxa lepra chi' t'ay. Tato syil winh sacerdote chi' to toxo ix el jun yab'il chi', schekan winh ik'chajkot chawanhok nok' much t'a spitzanil, haton nok' wach' icha yalan ley. Skotpax jab'ok te' k'ute', lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Schekan miljokcham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol junok lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jikot junxo nok' much chi' t'a spitzanil, te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo, slab'chajem t'a skal schik'il nok' chamnakxo chi' kalan yet' ha ha'.
Ukel stzikjioch t'a jun mach b'aj ek'nak jun yab'il chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to wach'xo jun anima chi'. Haxo nok' much pitzan chi' tz'aktajkanel nok'.

Ha jun mach tz'ilji to wach'xo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, sjoxanel xil sjolom smasanil, yik wach'xonhej tz'ajkani. Ichato chi' syalxo yoch t'a yol campamento, palta uketo k'uhal skan ichnhej ta', maxto yal-laj yoch t'a yol b'aj kajantaxoni.

Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi', wach' tz'aj sjoxjiel sjolom. Wach' tz'aj sjoxanel xil sti' yet' sk'u sat yet' pax masanil xil ay t'a sniwanil, sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' kob'es kalnel, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Skotpax nanhal yukil libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet' pax oxeok octavo aceite.
Haxo winh sacerdote chi' schekanoch linhan jun anima yet' yofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ik'jikot jun nok' kelem kalnel chi' yet' aceite, sb'akhchajb'at t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'.

Ha b'aj schamtaxon nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul yet' nok' silab' stz'a smasanil, hata' smiljicham nok' kelem kalnel chi', yujto a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj mul, yik winh sacerdote tz'ajkan nok', icha nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupkanel mul, a juntzanh tik yik Jehová yaji.

Slajwi chi' a winh sacerdote chi' tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' silab' yuj mul, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach' jun mach sb'oxi sk'ol chi', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Syik'anpaxkot jab'ok aceite winh sacerdote chi', sekanem winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh,
slab'anem jun sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach' t'a skal aceite, stzikem ukelok aceite chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha aceite tzato kan t'a sk'ab' winh sacerdote chi', sukoch winh t'a jun anima ix b'oxi sk'o'ol chi', hanheja' t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' pax t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj ayxo och schik'il nok' silab' yuj smul.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite tz'ak'jikank'e t'a sjolom jun anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul t'a yichanh Jehová.

Slajwi chi' syak'anpax nok' silab' winh sacerdote chi', haton nok' silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi'. Slajwi chi', smiljicham nok' kalnel stz'a smasanil silab'il.
Junnhej tz'aj yak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh altar yet' ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Icha wal chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, sb'oxikani.

Tato meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix ek' jun yab'il chi', malaj stumin yik syak' nok' silab' sk'anchaj chi', anhej junok nok' kelem kalnel syik'koti yik sb'akhchajoch silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul, chab'nhej libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite syak'a' yet' oxeok octavo aceite.
Syik'paxkot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, hato ha' jantak stzak'wan smanani. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul, jun nok' snhusjitz'aok.
Ha t'a swajxakil k'uhal syik'ankot masanil juntzanh tik jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote yik sakb'ikaneli. Ha juntzanh tik tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi' syik'ankot jun nok' kalnel winh sacerdote yet' aceite chi', sb'akhanek' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

Smilancham nok' kelem kalnel chi' winh, syik'ank'e jab'ok schik'il nok' winh, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Slajwi chi' syak'ank'e jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh.
Yet' sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach', stzikanem ukelok aceite ayem t'a yol sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syak'paxoch jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj toxo ix och schik'il nok' silab' chi'.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite chi' skani, syak'k'e winh sacerdote chi' t'a sjolom jun anima chi', yik stupkanel smul t'a yichanh Jehová.
Slajwi chi', smilancham nok' paramuch chi' winh sacerdote chi' schawanhil.

Ha junok nok' paramuch chi' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'aok yet' pax ixim harina tz'ak'jipax t'a ofrendail. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul jun anima ix b'oxi chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haton sleyalil tik t'a junok mach ix ek' lepra t'ay, yik tz'alchaji to ix sakb'ixikani tato max tzak'wan yak'an juntzanh silab' icha wal sleyalil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a lum Canaán, haton lum ol wak' eyikok, talaj swak'b'at junok tas k'ustak yilji tz'el lheb'eb'ok t'a yol he pat ta',
a mach ay yik te' pat chi' yowalil skot t'a junok winh sacerdote syalani: Ay juntzanh k'ustumtak yilji wan yel lheb'eb'ok t'a yol in pat, xchama.

Ayik manto och winh sacerdote t'a yol pat chi', yowalil syal winh to tz'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol te', yik wach' max kan juntzanh k'a'el chi' t'a yol pat tato syal winh sacerdote chi' to manh wach'ok yaj jun pat chi'. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh yil tas yilji jun k'ustum tz'el lheb'eb'ok chi'.
Tato ayik syilanoch winh to ha t'a sattak pat chi' ay juntzanh niwak k'ustum lheb'kiltak, ya'ax yilji, ma chak yilji, yelk'olal to sb'at t'a yol sattak pat chi',
haxo tz'elxita winh t'a yol te' pat chi', syalan winh to smakchajkan te' ukeok k'uhal.
Ayik slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', sb'atxi winh sacerdote chi' yila'. Tato toxo ix te b'at lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi' t'a sattak pat chi',
yowalil syal winh sacerdote chi' to slipjielta masanil k'e'en k'e'en b'aj toxo ix och juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi', b'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Syalanpax winh to sjoschajel masanil sattak yol te' pat chi', haxo masanil spokokal tz'el t'a yo'ol chi', sb'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Ch'okxo k'e'en k'e'en tz'ochpaxkan sk'exulok k'e'en tz'ik'chajelta chi', ch'okxo lum lum tz'ochpax t'a sattak yol pat chi'.
Tato scheklajxik'e juntzanh k'ustum lheb'kiltak chi' ayik toxo ix ik'jiel k'e'en k'e'en chi' yet' toxo ix joschajel sattak pat chi', toxo ix ochpaxkan sk'exul,
sb'at yilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato toxo ix el lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan jun pat chi'.
Yuj chi', a jun pat chi' yowalil spojchajemi. Masanil te te', k'e'en k'e'en yet' lum lum ayoch t'a jun pat chi', b'at ak'jikan t'a junok lugar to manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a yol jun pat chi' t'a uke' k'uhal ayik toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to smakchajkani, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto t'a sk'ik'b'ikanemi.
Yalnhej mach swa'i, ma sway t'a jun pat chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul.
Palta tato ayik tz'och winh sacerdote yil jun pat chi', syilan winh to a juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi' max b'eyb'ati yiktax ix b'ojikan yol te' pat chi', syal winh to wach'xo jun pat chi'.
Yik sakb'ixikan te' pat chi', tz'ik'jikot chawanhok nok' much yet' jab'ok te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Smilancham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol jun lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.

Slajwi chi' syik'anb'at te' k'ute' chi' winh yet' te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' junxo nok' much pitzanto, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' kalanxo yaj yet' schik'il nok' much ix miljicham chi' t'a yol lum chen chi'. Ukel stzikoch winh t'a te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan jun te' pat chi' yuj schik'il nok' much chi' yet' ha ha' sk'eul sjaj, yuj nok' much pitzanto, yuj te' k'ute', yuj te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil.
Slajwi chi', tz'aktajkanb'at jun nok' much pitzan chi' t'a stiel chonhab'. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajaj sleyalil t'a junok pat, wach' tz'ajkani, xchi Jehová.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a yib'anh lepra smalk'ei, mato t'a yaxk'ail, mato t'a lheb'kiltak saksak yilji, mato t'a juntzanh k'ustumtak t'a pichul yet' t'a spatiktak te' pat. Icha chi' tz'aj snachajel tastak to manh wach'ok yet' tastak to wach'. Haton t'a tik slajwikan cheknab'il t'a juntzanh tik.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón

to syal masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik heb' winh t'a heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tato ay junok winak ay junok yab'il t'a sniwanil, yuj chi' ay tas tz'el t'a swinakil, a jun chi' manh wach'ok yaji icha yalan ley.
Wach'chom tz'elnhej juntzanh chi', ma ay b'aj tz'och wa'an jaye'ok k'uhal tz'elxi, manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway winh winak chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Yalnhej mach syaman swaynub' jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej mach tz'em k'ojan b'aj ix em k'ojan jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej mach syaman junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok yaji masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.

Tato a junok winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', stzub'anoch t'a junokxo anima, a jun anima b'aj ix och stzub' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, a stz'um nok' chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan jun winak to ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi. Yalnhej mach tz'ik'anb'at junok juntzanh tastak chi', yowalil sjuk' spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.

Tato a jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', max sb'iklaj sk'ab' syaman junokxo mach, a jun ix yamji yuj chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Tato ay junok chen syam jun winak ay tas tz'el t'ay chi', yowalil smak'jipoj jun chen chi'. Tato a junok te te' yamk'ab' yaj syam jun winak chi', tonhej sb'ikchajel te'.

Tato sb'oxi sk'ol jun winak chi, manhxa tas tz'el t'ay, yowalil stanhwej ukeok k'uhal, ichato chi' skanxi wach'il t'a yichanh ley. Slajwi chi' sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a t'a ha ha' sk'eul sjaj. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani, icha yalan ley.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, yowalil syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, skot t'a yichanh Jehová sk'och t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a, syak'an nok' t'a junok winh sacerdote.

Jun nok' syak' winh sacerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi', haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'aok. Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yik sakb'ixikan jun winak ek'nak jun ya'elal chi' t'ay.
Tato a junok winak tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yowalil sb'ikel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley, masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej tas k'apakil ma tz'u'um b'aj ix och yinhatil jun winak chi', yowalil sjuk'jieli, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Tato a junok winh winak yet' junok ix ix ay tas sk'ulej, yowalil sb'ikel sb'a heb', palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkan heb', icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Tato a junok ix ix ayoch t'a stiempoal sb'islab' uj, manh wach'oklaj yaj ix t'a ukeok k'uhal. Yalnhej mach syaman ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani, icha yalan ley masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj tzek' jichan ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempoal chi', ma yalnhej tas k'ojnub'al b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani.

Yalnhej mach syaman b'aj ix ek' jichan ix chi', ma syaman junok tas b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani. Yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Tato ay junok winh winak sway yet' ix, sb'onhchaj winh yuj tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkan winh t'a uke' k'uhal, hanhejtona' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan waynub' b'aj sway winh winak chi'.

Tato ay junok ix ix tz'ilan uj t'a manh stiempoalok, mato te niwan tiempo syak' ix yilani, a jun ix chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, icha wal to ayto'och ix t'a yilan uj.
Yalnhej tas waynub'al b'aj sway ix, ma k'ojnub' b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix ayik ayto tas tz'el chi' t'a ix, manh wach'ok tz'ajkan juntzanh chi', ichato ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj chi'.
Yalnhej mach syaman juntzanh tastak chi', manh wach'oklaj tz'ajkani, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Ayik swanaj yilan uj ix chi', uke' k'uhal stanhwej ix, slajwi chi' sb'oxikan ix, icha yalan ley.
Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, syik'ankot ix t'a junok winh sacerdote, t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.

Jun nok' syak' winh sacerdote chi' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul ix, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'anoch jun silab' chi' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix, yuj tas ix el t'ay.
Icha chi' tz'aj ko sakb'itan ko b'a a onh israel onh tik t'a tas tzonh ik'ani, yik max kixtejel skajnub' Jehová ayek' t'a ko kal tik, tato ma'ay tzonh chami, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' winak ay tas tz'el t'ay, ma tonhej tz'el yinhatil, yuj chi' manh wach'ok tz'ajkan yuj

yet' t'a heb' ix ix ayoch t'a sb'islab' uj. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajaj yuj heb' ay sya'elal icha chi', winak, ma ix. Tz'ochpax jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh junok winak sway yet' ix ix to manh wach'ok yaji, icha yalan ley.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés ayik ix lajwi scham chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, yujto ix skomon nitzejb'at sb'a heb' t'a slak'anil Jehová,

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón to max komon och winh t'a yol in kajnub' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, haton jun lugar ay t'a spatikoch k'apak cortina. Max yal-laj skomon k'och winh b'aj ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul te' skaxail in trato, yik max cham winh, yujto a in ol in ch'ox in b'a t'a skal asun t'a yib'anh smakul skaxail in trato chi'.
Ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yol jun lugar chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax winh yik tz'och silab'ok yuj smul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel snhusjitz'a smasanil.

Syak'och spichul winh nab'a lino, haton spichul winh jukan, yol swex winh, k'apak stzek'ul snanhal winh yet' sb'ak'ul sjolom winh. Ha juntzanh pichul chi' te niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' b'ab'el sb'ikel sb'a winh ichato chi' syak'anoch winh.
Haxo heb' eyetisraelal syik'kot chawanhok nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'ak'ji nok' silab'il yuj smul heb', syik'paxkot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' yik snhusjitz'aok.
Syik'ankot nok' kelem wakax chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'och nok' silab'ok yuj smul. Ha jun nok' chi' yik nok' winh, yuj yak'ji tup smul winh yet' masanil heb' ayek' t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi' syik'anpaxkot chawanh nok' mam chiwa chi' winh t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Syak'anoch suerte winh t'a yib'anh nok' chiwa chi' schawanhil: Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'ayin, haxo junxo nok', tz'ak'chajkanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', spechchajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha nok' tz'em suerte t'a yib'anh to wiko', syik'kot nok' winhaj Aarón chi' silab'ok yik stupkanel smul heb' israel.
Haxo junxo nok' chiwa chi', t'a spitzanil nok' tz'och t'a wichanh, tz'ak'jikanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', tz'aktajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um syik'ankanb'at smul heb' israel chi' nok'.
Ayik listaxo yaj juntzanh tik smasanil, smilancham nok' kelem wakax winhaj Aarón chi', syak'an nok' winh silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat.

Slajwi chi', syik'ankot jun chaynub' yik incienso winh, b'ut'an yet' stzak'ak'il altar ay t'a wichanh yet' cha b'echanhok incienso suk'uk'i sjab', syik'anoch winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina ayoch t'a snanhal in kajnub'.

Syak'anem incienso chi' winh t'a yib'anh tzak'ak' t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxail in trato, tz'och moyan stab'il incienso chi' yik wach' max cham winh.

Syik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' kelem wakax chi' winh, slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' b'aj tz'ochk'och winh chi', ukel stzikoch chik' chi' winh t'a yichanh smakul chi'.

Slajwi chi', tz'elxita winh, smilancham nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' tz'och silab'il yuj smul heb' israel, syik'anoch schik'il nok' winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina chi', stzikanpaxem schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' yet' t'a yichanh, icha syutej schik'il nok' kelem wakax winh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Icha wal chi' syutej winhaj Aarón chi' sakb'itan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yuj yalxonhej tas chukal yet' spitalil heb' israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj sakb'ikan masanil in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, haton jun ayek' heyet'ok t'a skal chukal tze k'ulej.

Malaj junok mach ayek' t'a yol in kajnub' yakb'an ayoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yik syak'an silab' winh yik stup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat yet' smul heb' chonhab' masanil.

Slajwi yelxita winh, sakb'itan altar winh ayek' t'a wichanh, haton b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', syik'anelta jab'ok schik'il nok' wakax chi' winh yet' jab'ok yik nok' mam chiwa, syak'anoch winh t'a sch'ak altar ay t'a schikin schanhil.
Stzikanoch ukel schik'il nok' nok' chi' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan altar chi' winh yuj he mul a ex israel ex tik.
Slajwi sakb'ikan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, in kajnub' yet' pax altar yuj winh, schekan winh ik'jokkot nok' mam chiwa pitzan chi'.

Slajwi chi', syak'anb'at sk'ab' winh schab'il t'a sjolom nok', tz'och ijan winh yalanem smul yet' spitalil heb' yetchonhab' t'a yib'anh nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj skan smul heb' t'a yib'anh nok'. Haxo jun winh sik'b'ilxoel b'at ak'ankan nok' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj te najat.
Stijankanb'at nok' winh ta', satkanb'at nok' t'a takinh lum chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jikanb'at smul chonhab' Israel yuj nok', haton b'aj manhxalaj anima tz'ek'i.

Slajwi chi' tz'ochixta winhaj Aarón t'a yol in kajnub' yik sk'exanel spichul winh ayochi, k'apak nab'a lino, k'apak ayoch yuj winh a tz'ochta t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, syak'ankan k'apak winh ta'.

Hanheja' t'a yol in kajnub' chi' sb'ikel sb'a winh, syak'anoch spichul winh syak'taxonoch t'a yopisio. Slajwi chi', snhusantz'a silab' winh, haton yik winh yet' silab' yik heb' israel chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul winh yet' yik heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ha jantak xepu'al nok' silab' yuj mul, snhusjipaxtz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo winh b'at ak'ankan nok' mam chiwa t'a takinh lum chi', ayik sjax winh, sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh. Ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha nok' kelem wakax yet' nok' mam chiwa smiljicham silab'il yuj stupkanel mul, haton nok' tz'ik'jikot schik'il t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, tz'ik'jikanb'at sniwanil nok' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' snhusjitz'a nok' yet' stz'umal yet' masanil sniwanil.
Ha winh snhusantz'a nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo ex israel ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal t'a yukil uj, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, malaj mach smunlaj t'a jun k'uhal chi',
yujto a jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal yak'ji silab' yuj he mul yik wach' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh.
Ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal ik'oj ip tz'ajkani yet' tzek'ojk'olal, ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha yuj chi' a ol cham winh sat sacerdote, haxo junok heb' yuninal winh tz'ochkan sk'exulok. Tz'ak'chajk'e aceite t'a sjolom, tz'ak'jipax silab' yuj yochkan yopisio, syak'anoch spichul te niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha tz'ak'an silab' yik sakb'itan jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yet' altar. Syak'anpax silab' yik stup smul heb' sacerdote yet' ex israel ex tik.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Junel tz'ak'ji silab' tik t'a yol junjun ab'il yik slajwiel he mul a ex chonhab' israel ex tik, xchi Jehová. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' yalani.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' etchonhab' to in cheknab'il juntzanhxo tik:
Yalnhej mach smilancham junok nok' wakax, junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa silab'ok t'a spatikel campamento, ma t'a yo'ol,
palta max yik'kotlaj nok' t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, yowalil manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal. Ha jun chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh, yujto tonhej stob'kanem schik'il nok' ta'.

Icha chi' tz'aj walani yik mantzak he komon milej nok' nok' silab'il t'a spatikel campamento, palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a stiel in kajnub', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' silab'il yik junk'olal t'a wichanh.
Ha winh sacerdote chi' stzikanoch schik'il nok' t'a spatiktak altar t'a wichanh, haton t'a stielxo in kajnub', snhustz'a xepu'al nok' winh t'a wichanh, suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i.
Manhxa b'ak'inh tzeyak' junokxo silab' t'a heb' enemigo, haton juntzanh b'aj ochnak ex ejmelal. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' ex juwiel t'a wichanh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yalnhej mach heb' eyetisraelal, ma ch'ok chonhab'il kajanek' t'a he kal, tato syak' junok silab' stz'ai, ma yalnhej tas silab'il,
palta to max yik'kotlaj t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik tz'ak'ji t'ayin, a jun anima chi', manhxa yalan yik t'a he kal.
Te ay wal yowal in k'ol t'a yalnhej mach eyetisraelal ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal schi'an schik'il nok' nok'. Ha in wal ol in och ajk'olal t'ay, ol in satanel t'a he kal.

Yujto masanil nok' nok' yet' anima, a yuj schik'il pitzan, yuj chi' ix wala' to stob'jioch schik'il nok' t'a spatiktak altar yik slajwikanel mul. Yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal yuj chi' syal yak'an tup mul chi'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex israel ex tik to malaj junok ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syal chi'an schik'il nok' nok'.
Yalnhej mach ex ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal syamchaj junok nok' nok' yuj, ma junok nok' much, haton nok' toxonton schiji, yowalil syik'kanel schik'il nok', smukankan yet' lum lum.
Yujto a chik' chi' ik'an pitzan nok', yuj chi' swal t'ayex to max yal-laj schiji nok' chib'ej ayto'och schik'il. Yalnhej mach schi'ani, satjiel t'a he kal.

Yalnhej mach ex, ma ch'ok chonhab'il schi'an nok' chib'ej to tonhej schami, mato smiljicham yuj junok nok' chium nok', yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanel sb'a, palta manh wach'ok tz'ajkani masanto sk'ik'b'iemi.
Palta tato max sjuk'el spichul, mato max sb'ikel sb'a, skannhej smul chi' t'a yib'anh, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik smasanil t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' aj Egipto, haton jun chonhab' b'aj ek'nak ex kajan. Manh he b'eyb'alejpax sb'eyb'al heb' aj Canaán, haton b'aj wan ex wik'anb'ati.
k'anab'ajejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajan he b'eyb'alan in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha mach ol k'anab'ajanok, ol schanhej sk'inal yuj. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha inton Jehová in swala'.
Malajokab' junok mach syak' k'ixwelal smam, smulan yet' snun, yelxo wal te chuk yujto snun ton wal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam yik max yak' k'ixwelal smam chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab': Yanab' yuj smam, ma yuj snun, wach'chom t'a yol spat aljinak ix, mato ch'ok b'aj aljinak, manh smojok smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal sb'a smulan yet' ix yixchikin, yixchikin yuj yuninal, ma yuj yisil. Max yal-laj smulan yet'ok.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yune' ix yisil smam, yisil wal smam chi', schab'il yanab' yaj ix, max yal-laj smulan yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yanab' smam, yujto ha' och smam chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix snulej ix snun, yujto ha' och ix snun winh chi' yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal yuk'tak smam smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh, yujto ichato ayto yuj sb'a yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yujto yetb'eyum ix winh yuninal winh, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syak' k'ixwelal yuk'tak yuj smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, max yal-laj smulan winh yet' ix yune' ix, to schab'il yisil yaj ix. Max yalpaxlaj smulan winh yet' ix yixchikin ix, yixchikin yuj junok winh yune' ix, ma yuj junok ix yune' ix. Yelxo wal te chuk icha chi', yujto yiknhej ix yaj heb' chi'.
Malajokab' junok winh winak syik'k'e snulej yetb'eyum, max yal-laj yik'ani yakb'an pitzanto ix yetb'eyum chi', yik wach' max och ajk'olal t'a skal heb' ix.
Malajokab' junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix t'a stiempoal yik sb'isan uj.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak, manh wach'ok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley.
Malajokab' junok winh winak snhusantz'a junok yuninal silab'ok t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc. Tato sk'ulej icha chi', malaj welk'och t'a yol sat. Ha in Jehová in swal tik.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' junok yetwinakil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, a jun chi' te yajb'entak.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' nok' nok', malajokab' junok mach syixtejb'at sb'a t'a icha chi'. Malajokab' pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', yujto yelxo wal manhxo smojok.
Malajokab' mach syixtejb'at sb'a yet' juntzanh tik, yujto ha t'a smasanil juntzanh tik, syixtejb'at sb'a juntzanh anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh tik.
Yuj juntzanh chi', manhxo pax wach'ok yaj slu'um heb', wan wak'an yowalil t'a heb', wan wak'an satjokpaxel heb' t'a slu'um chi'.

Masanil juntzanh chi', sb'eyb'alej juntzanh anima kajan t'a jun lu'um chi', ayik manto ex k'och kajan a ex tik. Yuj chi' yelxo wal manh wach'ok yaj jun lu'um chi' yuj heb'. Palta a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajanpax in cheknab'il tik. Manh he k'ulej masanil juntzanh tastak manh wach'ok sk'ulej heb' chi', yik wach' max ex satjipax el a ex tik t'a jun lu'um chi'.
Ha mach sb'eyb'alan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak chi', yowalil satjiel t'a he kal.

Yuj wal chi' b'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, manh he b'eyb'alej juntzanh b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi', haton juntzanh sb'eyb'alaji ayik manto ex k'ochlaj ta', manh eyixtejb'at he b'a t'a icha chi'. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik wach' innhej.
k'anab'ajejek he mam he nun. Tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh yechel komon Dios, manh he b'opaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en he diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Ayik tzeyak'an silab' yik he junk'olal wet'ok, tze k'anab'ajej wal icha sleyal, yuj chi' ol in cha t'ayex.
Ha nok' schib'ejal nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok' t'a sk'uhal chi' yet' t'a junxo k'u. Tato ayto nok' skan t'a schab'jial, snhuschajtz'a nok'.
Tato tzato he chi nok' t'a schab'jial chi', chukxo t'a yol in sat, maxtzak in chalaj silab' chi' t'ayex.
Ha mach schi'an nok' t'a schab'jial chi', max tuplaj smul chi' t'a yib'anh, yujto komon ix yutej tastak to wik yaji. Ha jun mach chi', manhxalaj yalan yik t'a he kal.
Ayik tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej t'a he lu'um, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molank'e t'a stitak, manh ex ek' t'anhanh he sik'ank'e ixim jolom trigo skan eyu'uj.

Ayik tze molan sat te' uwa, manh ex meltzaj he say eyil t'a schaelal, manh he sik'k'e sat sk'ajb'anemi. Ha juntzanh chi' kanokab'i, yikxo heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yaji. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh ex elk'anok, manh eyal esal lolonel, manh eyak' musansatil heb' eyetanimail.
Manh he lok in b'i t'a es. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej ichato malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh komonok tzeyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh he tok'ek' tastak ay t'a heb'. Manh eyala' to hato k'ik'an tze tup sk'u heb' winh he munlajwum smunlaj tiknaik.
Manh he b'aj heb' chakanh, manh eyak'em tas t'a yol sb'e heb' max uji yilani, palta ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh he b'o tas manh tojolok ayik tze b'oan yaj junok lolonel. Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' meb'a', manh eyak'paxoch he b'a yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Te tojolnhej tzeyutej he b'oanel tas yaj heb'.
Manh ex alwok pekal t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab'. Manh he nacha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh junok eyetanimail yik smiljichamok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chichonoch he k'ol t'a junok eyetanimail, palta wach' to tze kacha' tzeyak'an srazón yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yet'ok.
Manh he pak he b'a, mokab' chichonnhejoch he k'ol t'a heb' eyetchonhab'. Tze xajanej heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat icha tzeyutej he ya ilan he b'a. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

k'anab'ajejek juntzanh in cheknab'il tik. Manh he cha tajnok nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' junokxo nok' nok' ch'ok yinhtilal. Manh he som eyinhat tzeyawej t'a he lu'um. Manh eyak'och k'apak pichul soman sch'alil yet' junokxo makan anh ch'al.

Tato ay junok ix schekab' junok mach ayxo strato yet' junokxo winh winak, palta tato ay junokxo winh smulan yet' ix, tz'ak'ji yowalil t'a heb' schawanhil. Max miljichamlaj heb', yujto mantzak tupji yik tz'el ix t'a libre.
Ha winh smulan yet' ix chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel winh silab'il yuj smul chi' t'a stielxo in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Smiljicham nok', haxo junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch nok' t'a wichanh, yuj stupchaj smul winh chi'.
Ayik ol ex k'och t'a lum Canaán, ol eyawan masanil makanhil te awb'en te' syak' sat. Oxe' ab'il max eyamlaj junok sat te' chi' yik tze loani, yujto ay yowalil t'a yol in sat.
Haxo t'a schanhil ab'il, masanil sat te' syak' chi', tzeyak' masanil t'ayin ofrendail yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, yujto wik yaj te' sat chi'.
Haxo t'a yo'il ab'il, eyikxo yaj sat te' chi' yik tze lo'o. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej sleyal tik, yelxo wal ol yak' sat te'. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh he chi nok' chib'ej to max el schik'il. Manh eyak'och he b'a he na'anel tas tzuji, manh eyak'paxoch he b'a t'a ajchumal.
Manh setansetanok tz'aj sjoxjiel xil he jolom, manh he joxpaxel xil he sat.
Manh eyak' echnaj he b'a yuj kusk'olal yuj junok chamnak, manh eyak'och yechel junok tas t'a he niwanil. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyak' k'ixwelal ix eyisil, tzeyak'anoch ix ajmul ixal t'a stemplo juntzanh komon Dios, yik wach' max ixtaxel sb'eyb'al heb' anima, yik max ixtaxpaxel he chonhab' yuj ajmulal.
Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh sk'uhal ik'oj ip to wik yaji. Ayokab' yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Manh ex b'at he k'anb'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajchum, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yik wach' max eyixtejb'at he b'a. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
K'eanhek linhan t'a yichanh heb' ichamtak anima, niwanokab' yelk'och heb' t'a yol he sat. Ayokab'pax welk'och t'a yol he sat. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.
Manh eyixtej junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Xajan tzeyutej heb', ichato eyetchonhab' heb'. Ya'ilejek heb', icha tz'aj eya'ilan he b'a. Tze nakoti to a ex tik najtil ek'nak ex t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala'.
Manh eyixtej heb' anima t'a tas tze chonho', tz'akanokab' eyechlab' tzeyak'lab'ej, icha he ch'anh ayik tzeyechtan he lu'um ma juntzanhxo echlab' tze k'ana'.
Ha he libra yet' eyalmul tze k'ana', tz'akanokab'i. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, a in swala'.
Yuj wal chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej in b'eyb'al yet' masanil in cheknab'il tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Yalnhej mach ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal tz'ak'an junok yuninal silab'il t'a komon Dios skuchan Moloc, a jun chi' yowalil sjulk'enajcham yuj heb' yetchonhab'.
Skotpax wowal t'a jun anima chi', tzin satel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto ix yixtejb'at in kajnub', ix in spatikaneli, yujto syak' yuninal silab'il t'a jun komon Dios chi'.
Tato a heb' yetchonhab' tonhej syilochi, max sjulk'enejcham jun anima chi' heb',

a in wal ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', t'a yetb'eyum, t'a yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan yet' t'a yol spat. Ol in satel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' yet' heb' syak'em sb'a t'a komon Dios Moloc chi' yet'ok.

Tato ay mach sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a t'a heb' ajb'a'al, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, sk'anab'ajan tas syal heb' chi', ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', ol in satel t'a skal yetchonhab'.
Junelnhej tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab', wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in.
Ha wal in b'eyb'al tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajani, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wak'och wikok.
Yalnhej mach sb'aj smam snun yowalil schami, a wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail, yowalil scham jun winak chi' yet' jun ix ix chi'.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, syak' k'ixwelal smam chi'. Ha jun winak chi' yowalil schami, schampax ix ix chi', a wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yowalil scham heb' schawanhil, yujto yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, yowalil scham heb' schawanhil. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh, yujto yajb'entak tas sk'ulej heb' chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, syik'anpaxk'e snun ix ix chi' winh, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a jun winh winak chi' yet' chawanh heb' ix ix chi', snhusjitz'a heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj jun b'eyb'al chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a winh chi' yowalil scham winh, schampax nok' nok' chi'.
Tato ay pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a jun ix chi' yowalil scham ix, schampax jun nok' nok' chi'. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik' yanab' yetb'eyumok, yanab' yuj smam ma yanab' yuj snun, a chawanh heb' chi', t'a wal yichanh heb' yetchonhab' heb' satjieli, yujto a mach smulan yet' yanab', yelxo wal k'ixwelal tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a mach icha chi' sk'ulej, a smul chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix sb'isan uj, malaj yelk'och t'a yol sat winh tas tz'ik'an ix chi', b'ekanpax sk'ol ix sch'oxanel sya'elal chi', yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik heb' schawanhil t'a he kal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab' smam, ma yet' snulej snun, yujto syak' sk'ixwelal winh mach ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil.

Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak smam ma winh snulej snun, syak' wal k'ixwelal jun yicham chi', a yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak, syak' k'ixwelal winh yuk'tak winh chi', a jun chi' yajb'entak, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
B'eyb'alejek in b'eyb'al, tze k'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il tik yik wach' manh ol ex in satel t'a lum lum b'aj ol ex k'och kajan chi'.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh chi'. Ha heb' chi', sb'eyb'alej masanil juntzanh chukal tik heb', yuj chi' tzin chakel heb'.
Ha in wal ix wak' in ti' to ol wak' eyikejkan slum heb' chi' he makb'enok, lum te yax sat. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex in sik'nakelta t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Yuj chi' yowalil ay sk'exanhil nok' nok' wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yol he sat yet' t'a skal nok' much wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok. Yuj chi' manh he juel he b'a t'a wichanh yuj he chi'an nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', nok' much, nok' snherwi, ma nok' sjachwi t'a sat lum tik, haton nok' ix wala' to manh wach'ok.
Palta yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a wichanh, yujto wach' innhej a in tik. Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'eli, to ch'ok eyel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', yik wach' in chonhab' tzex aji.

Tato ay junok winh winak ma junok ix ix t'a he kal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yowalil sjulk'enajchamok. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a heb' sacerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, mokab' k'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak yik manh chukok skan heb' t'a yichanh ley, wach'chom ayto yuj sb'a heb' yet' jun chamnak chi'.
Anhej tato a snun, ma smam, ma junok yuninal, ma junok yisil, ma junok yuk'tak,
ma junok yanab' heb' kob'es ayek' kajan yet'ok, a schami, syal sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey jun chamnak chi'.
Palta max yal-laj sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey junok chamnak sk'ab' yok ix yetb'eyum heb'.
Mokab' sjoxel xil sjolom heb', mokab' sjoxpaxel xil sti' heb', mokab' yak'pax echnaj sniwanil heb' yuj schamel junok anima.

Palta wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb' yujto wiknhej yaj heb'. Mokab' chukok in b'inaj yuj heb', yujto a heb' snhusantz'a silab', syak'an ixim pan heb' ofrendail t'ayin, yuj chi' yowalil wach'nhejokab' syutej sb'a heb'.
Max yalpaxlaj yik'an junok ix ajmul ix heb', ma junok ix ix ayxo winak ix ek' t'ay, ma junok ix ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Ch'okokab' yel heb' t'a yol he sat, yujto a heb' tz'ak'anoch ixim pan ofrendail t'a wichanh, yujto a in Jehová in wach' innhej, a in ix in sik'kanel heb' yik wach' tz'ajkan heb'.
Tato ay junok heb' ix yisil junok heb' sacerdote chi' tz'och t'a ajmul ixal, syak' k'ixwelal smam ix chi', yowalil snhusjitz'a ix.

Ha winh sat sacerdote ix ik'jik'echa'anh t'a skal heb' yuk'tak ayik ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom, ayik ix ak'chajoch spichul winh te niwan yelk'ochi, max yal-laj toxonhej sb'at tzikan xil sjolom winh, max yalpaxlaj snhik'anb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.
Max yalpaxlaj sk'och winh b'aj ayek' junok chamnak, wach'chom smam, ma snun yik max yixtejb'at sb'a winh.

Ha yuj schamel heb' chi' max yal-laj yel winh t'a in kajnub', max yalpaxlaj to syixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' winh, yujto ix ak'jioch aceite t'a winh yik sik'chajkaneli, yik tz'ochkan wikok. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Ha winh sat sacerdote, a junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak tzek' t'ay, a ix syik' winh.

Max yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh yet' junok ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix spuknak sb'a yet' yetb'eyum, ma yet' junok ix ayxo winak tzek' t'ay, ma yet' junok ix ajmul ix. Palta yowalil a junok ix kob'es ix syik' winh, junok ix yetchonhab' winh,
yik manh malajok tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuninal winh t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel winh, xchi Jehová, t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón: Tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winh ay palta t'a sniwanil ol yal yak'an yofrenda heb' yetchonhab' t'ayin.

Yuj chi' yel wal malaj junok ay spaltail sniwanil chi' ol yal yoch t'a jun opisio chi': Haton heb' max yal yilani, heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' palta snhi' ma schikin, heb' k'ichajnak xub' ma sk'ab', heb' nhojanemi sb'eyi, heb' tzapan ste'el yujto nenetak yok heb' yet' sk'ab', heb' ayoch ya'ax t'a yol sat, heb' aykan sjech'al junok yab'il t'ay, heb' ay yaxk'a t'a sniwanil yet' heb' mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en.
Malaj junok heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ay palta t'a sniwanil syal yoch t'a wichanh yet' silab' to snhusjitz'aok. Tato ay palta t'a sniwanil chi', max yal-laj yak'an ofrenda t'ayin.
Syal swa'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' heb' yet' masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaji,

palta max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a in kajnub', ma sk'och heb' t'a stz'ey altar, yik max yixtejb'at in kajnub' chi' heb', yujto a in Jehová in, wik yaj juntzanh tastak chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil juntzanh tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yet' t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal to sya'ilej wal sb'a heb' yet' ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaj yuj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to a tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach junok yinhtilal heb' tz'ik'ankot juntzanh silab' t'a wichanh, haton juntzanh syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, tato manh wach'ok yaj jun tz'ik'ankot jun silab' chi' icha yalan ley, yowalil tz'ik'jiel t'a yopisio t'a wichanh. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Malaj pax junok yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' syal swa'an tastak to wik yaji tato ay lepra t'ay, ma ay tas tz'el t'a swinakil, palta hato yik wach'xo yaji icha yalan ley, ichato chi' syal swa'ani. Tato syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, junok chamnak, ma junok winak tz'el yinhatil, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Manh wach'ok tz'ajkani tato syam junok nok' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, ma syam junok anima manh wach'ok pax yaj yuj yalnhej tasi.
Tato manh wach'ok yaji, max yal-laj swa'an junok tas to wik yaji, masanto sb'ikel sb'a.
Hato yik tz'em k'u, wach'xo yaji. Ichato chi' tzaxo yal swa'an masanil tas to wik yaji yujto yiktaxon yaji.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' max yal-laj schi'an schib'ejal junok nok' nok' heb', haton nok' tonhej schami, ma nok' scham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok', yik manh chukok skan heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il heb', yik max och smul heb', yik max champax heb'. Tato malaj yelk'och in cheknab'il chi' t'a yol sat heb', skot juntzanh tik t'a yib'anh heb', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel heb'.
Malaj mach syal swa'an tastak to wik yaji tato malaj yuj sb'a yet' heb' winh sacerdote. Eb' tonhej ayek' posado t'a heb', ma heb' tonhej smunlaj t'a heb', max yal-laj swa'an heb'.
Tato ay junok schekab' junok winh sacerdote manb'il yuj, mato ay pax heb' tz'alji t'a yol scuenta winh, a heb' chi' syal swa'an heb' masanil tas to wik yaji.
Tato a ix yisil junok winh sacerdote syik' junok winak ch'ok yel t'a skal heb' sacerdote, maxtzak yal-laj swa'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix, haton juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Palta tato chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum ix, mato spuknak sb'a ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', malaj pax junok yune' ix, meltzajnak ix yik skajnajxi ix yet' winh smam chi', ichataxon ayik kob'esto ix, syal swa'an swa'el winh smam ix chi'. Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' manh yinhtilok heb' sacerdote, max yal-laj swa'an heb'.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej to wik yaji, tato manh yojtakok to wik yaji, yowalil syak' sk'exul t'a jun winh sacerdote chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh jun ix yak' sk'exul chi'.
Palta a heb' winh sacerdote yowalil manh komonok scha' heb' winh chijok tastak syak' heb' eyetchonhab' t'ayin.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej wik yaj chi', manh tonhejok syiloch winh sacerdote chi', palta yowalil a jun ix chi'an nok' chi', syak' nok' silab' yik spakok jun smul chi', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel juntzanh nok' chib'ej chi' wikok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' eyetisraelal masanil juntzanh tik: Tato ay ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, tzeyak' junok nok' nok' yik snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, mato tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani,
yowalil a junok nok' smam malaj jab'ok spaltail tzeyak'a' yik wach' tzin cha jun silab' chi'. Ha junok nok' toro, ma junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma junok nok' mam chiwa tzeyak'a',
palta manhok junok nok' ayoch syab'il. Tato ya'ay nok', max in chalaj nok'.

Yalnhej mach ex tzeyak' junok silab' yik junk'olal t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, yowalil a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa, malaj spaltail tzeyak'a', yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.

Manh eyak' junok nok' nok' pena'ay t'ayin, icha nok' malaj yol sat, nok' lajwinak, nok' k'i'ich, nok' elnak junok makan sniwanil, ma ay syaxk'ail, ma junok yab'il t'ay. Ha juntzanh nok' icha chi', max yal-laj snhusjitz'a nok' t'a waltar.

Ha mach ex tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel syal eyak'ani, wach'chom manh lajanok ste'el yok nok'. Palta tato a junok silab' ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, max in chalaj nok' icha chi' yaji.
Ha junok nok' lajwinak sk'e'en, ma pojnak, ma ik'b'ilel sk'e'en nok' chi', max yal-laj eyak'an nok' silab'il t'ayin. Manh he b'eyb'alej eyak'an juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il t'ayin.
Manh he cha juntzanh nok' nok' icha chi' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'och silab'il t'ayin, yujto manh tz'akanok yaj nok', max in chapaxlaj nok', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh:

Ayik tz'alji junok nok' yune' wakax, ma junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa, uke' k'uhal yowalil skan nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, tzaxo yal snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a wichanh.
Max yal-laj junnhej k'uhal tz'aj smiljicham junok nok' snun yet' nok' yune'.
Tato tz'ak'ji junok silab' t'ayin yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ujokab' icha t'a sleyal yik wach' tzin cha'a.
Hanhejtona', tze chib'at nok' t'a jun k'uhal chi', max yal-laj skan nok' t'a junokxo k'u. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajanpaxi. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chukok tz'aj in b'inaj eyu'uj, palta to tzin eyik'cha'anh, yujto a in wal ix ex in sik'kaneli,
ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosalok. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in swal icha tik: Ha juntzanh k'inh tik, walnakkani to wiknhej yaji, haton yik tze molb'an he b'a yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh.

Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal manhxa junok tas tze k'ulej. Tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i. Haton jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi' wiknhej yaji.
Haton juntzanh k'inh tik niwan yelk'ochi yuj in eyik'ancha'anh ayik tze molb'an he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'a sk'uhal walnakkani.
