Ha k'inh yik tze na'ankoti ayik ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto, tz'el yich t'a yemk'uhalil t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj. Haton jun k'inh chi' tzeyak'ochi yik tzin eyik'ancha'anh.
Haxo t'a 15 yoch jun uj chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Uke' k'uhal anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa''a.
Ha wal t'a sb'ab'el k'uhal chi', tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a wichanh. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o t'a jun chi'.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', tze nhusnhejtz'a silab' t'ayin. Ha t'a yukil k'uhal tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Malaj junok makan munlajel tze b'o'o, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etisraelal icha tik: Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex, ayik ol he cha'anel yich he jochan ixim he trigo, a jun b'ab'el manoja tze joch chi', tzeyik'kot t'a heb' winh sacerdote.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik slajwikanek' sk'uhal ik'oj ip, syak'an heb' sacerdote chi' ofrendail tas tzeyak' chi', sb'akhanochta heb' t'a wichanh, yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.
Ha t'a sk'uhal tzeyak' ixim he trigo chi' ofrendail t'ayin, hata' tze nhuspaxtz'a junok nok' kalnel silab'il t'a wichanh, nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, mokab'a jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot lajunheok libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, yik stz'a ofrendail to suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i. Tzeyak'anpax junok litro wino ofrendail, sekjiem t'a yib'anh juntzanh ofrenda chi'.

Ha ixim ak' trigo sjochchaj chi', max yal-laj he wa'an ixim t'a panil. Max yalpaxlaj he b'olan ixim he k'uxu', ma eyax k'uxani, masanto t'a jun sk'uhal a tzeyak'an ixim b'ab'el manoja ofrendail t'ayin he Diosal in. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik toxo ix lajwikanek' sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ayik tzeyik'ankot jun manoja ixim trigo ofrendail, haton t'a jun k'u chi' tze b'is uke' semana.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ma t'a 50 k'uhal yik toxo ix tz'akwi uke' k'uhal ik'oj ip chi', hata' tzeyak'pax junokxo ofrenda t'a ixim trigo chi' t'ayin.

Tzeyik'kot chab'ok ixim pan ofrendail ichataxon ixim heyik tze wa''a. Wajxake' libra ixim harina te wach' tz'och t'a junjun ixim, ayokab' b'at yich t'a skal ixim. Ha ixim pan chi' sb'akhjioch ixim t'a wichanh ofrendail t'a ixim b'ab'el tz'eluli yalnhej b'aj kajan ex ek'i.

Yet' ixim pan chi', syak' ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel heb' eyetchonhab', jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok' yet' jun nok' kelem wakax yet' pax chawanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Malajokab' jab'ok spaltail juntzanh nok' nok' chi'. Ha nok' chi' snhusjitz'a smasanil t'ayin Jehová in tik, junnhej tz'aj stz'a yet' ixim eyofrenda trigo yet' pax ofrenda t'a wino. Ha jun ofrenda stz'a chi' suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj stupkanel he mul. Tzeyak'anpax chawanhok nok' kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal ofrendail yuj he ch'oxanel he junk'olal wet'ok.
Ha winh sacerdote sb'akhanoch chawanh nok' kalnel t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yet' ixim pan ix b'o t'a ixim trigo ix b'ab'laj jochchaji, a jun ofrenda chi' wik yaji, skan t'a winh sacerdote chi'.

Ha t'a sk'uhal jun k'inh chi' malaj junok makan munlajel syal he b'o'ani. Tze molb'anoch he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'ayin. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i.

Ayik sk'och stiempoal he jochan ixim he trigo, manh he sik'k'e ixim skan t'a skal yok yet' ixim ay t'a stitak, yujto a juntzanh chi' yik heb' meb'a' yaji yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Ha t'a sb'ab'el k'uhal yik yukil uj, tzeyik' eyip, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin, spuji k'e'en trompeta yik tze na'ankot in wach'k'olal.
Yowalil tze nhustz'a junok nok' silab' t'ayin. Malaj junok ex tzex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal yoch yukil uj, haton t'a sk'uhal yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok he mul, tze molb'ejoch he b'a ejmelal t'ayin. Tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tze nhusantz'a ofrenda silab'il t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.
Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yujto a wal t'a jun k'u chi' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
Tato ay junok mach max k'anab'ajan yoch t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil satjiel t'a he kal.
Hanhejtona', yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tzin sateli.
Malaj junok mach smunlaj t'a junok yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a jun k'u chi'. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo yalnhej b'ajtil ayex ek'i.
Ha jun k'u chi', haton wal yik tzeyik'an eyip, yik tzex ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal, tz'el yich t'a wal sb'alunhil k'uhal yoch uj t'a k'ik'b'alil, masanto t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a junxo k'u, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab': Ayik 15 yoch yukil uj, tze cha'an uke' k'uhal sk'inhal chinama yuj in eyik'ancha'anh.
Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal t'a b'ab'el k'u. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', malaj junok mach smunlaji.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', junjun k'u tze nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin, haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal, tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab', yujto in k'inh yaji, malaj junok mach smunlaji.

(Haton t'a juntzanh k'inh tik tzin eyik'cha'anh a in Jehová in tik. Tze molb'anoch he b'a ejmelal, tze nhusantz'a silab'. Ay silab' snhusjitz'aok yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji. Tz'ak'jipax wino silab'il yet' ofrendail. Junjun makan juntzanh silab' tik tz'ak'ji, hato ha' sk'uhal alb'ilkani.

Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip walnak. Ch'ok yel juntzanh silab' chi' t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxoni. Ch'ok yel pax t'a yichanh he silab' tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' t'a eyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.)

Haxo t'a 15-xo yoch yukil uj, ayik toxo ix molchaj sat awb'en tz'el t'a sat lum lum, tzeyak'anoch sk'inhal t'a wichanh t'a uke' k'uhal. Ha b'ab'el k'u, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, hanhejtona' pax t'a yukub'ixial.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u chi', tzeyik'kot sattak te te' te wach', xiltak apak', sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a titak ha' yet' sk'ab' juntzanhxo te' k'ayum xi'il yik tzeyak'anoch k'inh yik chinama. Icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a uke' k'uhal chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová he Diosal in tik.
T'a yukil uj t'a junjun ab'il, tzeyak'anoch jun k'inh chi' t'a uke' k'uhal yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal yet' t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', he masanil a ex israel ex tik, yowalil tzex kajnaj t'a yoltak chinama,
yik wach' syojtakejnhejel heb' eyinhtilal b'ak'inh to ha t'a yoltak chinama ix ex kajnaji ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'an winhaj Moisés yojtakanel heb' chonhab' israel juntzanh niwak k'inh tz'ochi yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot aceite heb' t'ayach, haton aceite te wach' yik sat te' olivo yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al candil.

Haxo winhaj Aarón sb'oanoch sk'ak'al, yik wach' aynhejoch sk'ak'al tzek' ak'wal t'a wichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, t'a yichanhelta k'apak cortina b'aj ay skaxail in trato. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.
Wach' tz'aj sb'ojioch juntzanh candil chi' t'a wichanh t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al nab'a oro.
Tzeyik'kot ixim harina te wach', sb'o lajchaweok ixim pan, chanhe' libra ixim harina tz'och t'a junjun ixim.
Slajwi chi' tz'ak'chajk'e ixim t'a sat jun mexa nab'a oro t'a wichanh, cha tzol tz'ajk'e latz'an ixim, waktak ixim t'a junjun latz'an.
Tzak'anpaxem incienso te wach' t'a yib'anh junjun latz'an ixim pan chi'. Ha incienso chi' snhusjitz'a t'a wichanh, yik sch'oxani to wik yaj ixim pan chi'.
T'a junjun k'uhal ik'oj ip tz'ak'jiem ixim pan chi' t'a wichanh, yuj sk'anab'ajan heb' etchonhab' israel in trato heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo. Yowalil a ixim k'ixin tz'ak'jiemi.

Haxo juntzanh ixim pan tz'ik'jiel chi', yik winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal yaj ixim t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' chi' swa'an ixim pan chi' t'a junok lugar to wik yaji, yujto te niwan yelk'och ixim t'a skal juntzanhxo silab' yiktaxon heb' sacerdote tz'ik'jiel t'a juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a wichanh, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ay jun winh aljinak t'a skal heb' israel chi', israel snun winh, haxo smam winh aj Egipto. Selomit sb'i ix snun winh chi', yisil winhaj Dibri, yinhtilal Dan. Ha jun winh chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' jun winh mero wal israel t'a campamento. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winh yune' ix israel chi' ix och smul winh yujto ix yal chuk winh t'a sb'i Jehová, yuj chi' ix ik'jikot winh t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés.
Ix tanhwaj winh masanto ix yal Jehová tas yowalil tz'utaj winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'ekelta winh chuk ix halan chi' t'a yol campamento, haxo masanil heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winh chi', yak'okab'k'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom winh, haxo masanil heb' chonhab' sjulk'enancham winh.

Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ha mach tz'alan chuk t'a in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tz'och smul, yowalil scham yuj smul chi'. Masanil heb' yetchonhab' sjulanchamok. Wach'chom ch'ok chonhab'il, ma eyetchonhab', tato syal chuk t'a in b'i, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, yowalil tz'ochpax chamel t'a yib'anh.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo mach, yowalil hanheja' nok' nok' chi' tz'ak'jipax sk'exulok.
Ha mach smak'an junok yetanimail, tato tz'echnaj yuj, icha tas syutej chi', icha chi' tz'utajpaxi.

Tato sk'ichaj yuj, yowalil smak'jipax k'ichajok. Tato tz'elta yol sat yuj, yowalil tz'elpaxkot yiko', tato tz'el ye junok mach chi' yuj, yowalil tz'elpax yiko'. Icha wal tas syutej junok anima chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajxi.
Ha mach smak'ancham nok' smolb'etzal nok' junokxo anima, yowalil syak' sk'exul nok'. Palta a mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, a jun chi' yowalil schami.
Hanheja' jun ley tik tz'och yopisio t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal, yuj chi' ix ik'jielta winh ix halan chuk t'a sb'i Jehová chi' yuj heb' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' ix julk'enajcham winh. Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a lum switzal Sinaí icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' t'ayex chi', yowalil ol yik' yip lu'um, yik tzin eyik'cha'anh a in Jehová in tik.
Anhej wake' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat he lu'um, haxo t'a wake' ab'il chi' syal he mesan te' eyuwa, tze molan sat.
Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, yowalil skan lum yik' yip sat yuj in eyik'ancha'anh. Malaj jab'ok tas tzeyawej t'a jun ab'il chi', max yal-laj he mesan te' eyuwa.
Max yal-laj he jochank'e wa'an ixim trigo munil sk'ib'i, ayik toxo ix ek' stiempoal jochoj trigo. Max yalpaxlaj he molan sat te' eyuwa chi' to maj he mesa', yujto syik' yip lum t'a jun ab'il chi'.

Masanil tastak sk'ib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il yik syik' yip lum chi', syal he wa'ani, syalpax swa'an heb' anima heyet'ok, haton heb' winh he chekab', heb' ix he chekab' yet' heb' smunlaj heyet'ok yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal,
yet' pax nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ay t'a jun lugar chi'. Yuj chi', masanil tas sk'ib' t'a sat lum t'a jun ab'il chi', ha' ol he wa yet' nok' nok' chi'.
Ukel sb'ischaj t'a uktak ab'il. Ha uke' ab'il chi' sb'ischaj t'a ukel, tz'elk'och t'a 49 ab'il.
Haxo t'a slajunhilxo k'uhal yoch yukil uj, haton jun k'u ayik tz'ak'ji tup mul, hata' spuji k'e'en trompeta t'a masanil yol he chonhab'.

Haxo ab'il 50, a yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el masanil tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi' tz'alchajel yuj yel anima masanil t'a libre t'a yol he chonhab', haton heb' schonhnak sb'a chekab'wumal, yik wach' spaxta heb' smasanil t'a skal sk'ab' yok. Hanhejtona' heb' schonhnakel slu'um skanxi lum yikok heb'.

Haxo jun ab'il 50 chi' heyik yaj a ex tik, yuj eyel t'a libre. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', malaj tas tzeyawej, max he jochk'elaj wa'an ixim trigo tonhej sk'ib'cha'anh t'a ichnhej ta'. Manh he mes te' eyuwa, manh he molpax sat te'.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun ab'il chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha tastak munil syak' t'a lum lum chi' tze wa''a.
Ayik sk'och jun ab'il chi', junjun ex tze chaxi he lum he chonhnakel chi'.
Yuj chi', tato ayex tze chonho', ma tze man he lum t'a junok eyetanimail, manh he na' eyak' ganar t'a spatik jun lum chi' junjun ex.

Ha mach smanan chi', yowalil stupu', hato syala' jantak tiempoal ix ek'b'at yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'. Haxo mach schonhwaj chi', yowalil scha stojol lu'um, hato syala' jayeto ab'il ol molchaj sat tas awab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre chi'.

Hato syala', tato niwanto yab'ilal ol molchaj sat awb'en chi', icha chi' ol aj stupchaj t'ay. Tato kenxonhej yab'ilal jun, kenxonhej pax stojol lum ol ak'chaj t'ay, yujto a sat awb'en chi' schonhchaji, hato syala' jayeto ab'il smolchaji.
Manh he komon sayej chajtil tz'aj eyak'an ganar t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail. Palta tze ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Scham wal he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il yet' he b'eyb'alan in b'eyb'al tik. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej, junk'olal ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum chi'.
Te wach' ol aj sat tas ol eyawej t'a lu'um. Tzalajk'olal ol ex kajnaj t'a sat lu'um, ol eyab'lej sat tas ol eyawej chi' masanto ol ex b'ut'jok.
Talaj ol eyala': ¿Tasto ol kab'lej t'a yukil ab'il chi', tato manh ol onh awalwok, tato manh ol yalpax ko molan sat tas awab'il chi'? ta xe chi.
Manh eyak' pensar, yujto ol wak'em in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej t'a swakil ab'il chi'. Ol ste ak'ej sat, yuj chi' a jun chi' k'okb'il syab' eyab'lan t'a oxeok ab'il,
yuj chi' ol eyab'lej sat tas tzeyawej ol he molkan chi', yakb'an tzex awwi t'a swajxakil ab'il. Olto eyab'lej tas molb'ab'il chi' eyuj yakb'an tz'elul sat tas tzeyawej t'a sb'alunhil ab'il.
Ha lum lum chi', max yal-laj he chonhanel lum t'a junelnhej, yujto wik lu'um. Ha ex tik tonhej paxyalwum heyaj t'a sat lu'um, majan lum heyaj t'ayin.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel slu'um, syal smananxiel slum chi' tato syal yuj.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' slajwiel masanil tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonhb'at slum t'a junokxo, a junok te ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun schonhan slum chi' syal smananxiel jun lum chi' b'aj schonhnak chi'.
Palta tato ay junok mach manhxalaj junok sk'ab' yok syal smananel slu'um chi', tato smolchaj stumin sch'okoj, syal smananxiel slu'um chi'.

Anhej to snaji, jantakxo stiempoal schonhanel lu'um, syak'anxi meltzaj jantak k'e'en tumin t'a winh manjinak lu'um chi', hato syala' jantakto tiempo ayik ol ja jun ab'il yik tz'och k'inh yel tastak t'a libre, syik'anxi slum chi'.

Palta tato max aj k'e'en tumin chi' yuj yik smananxiel smakb'en chi', a lum slu'um chi' skannhej lum t'a yol sk'ab' jun mach ix manan el chi', masanto sk'och junxo yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Hato ta' librexo lu'um, syik'anxikan lum winh ix chonhan chi'.
Tato ay mach schonhan junok spat t'a yol niwak chonhab' ayoch smuroal, syal smananxieli ayik manto el-laj yab'ilal schonhaneli.

Palta tato maxto yal-laj smananel jun pat chi' ayik manto k'och jun ab'il chi', a jun pat chi', skanxonhej t'a winh ix manan chi' t'a junelnhej yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal. Maxtzak yal-laj yaktajel t'a yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Ha pax te' pat b'aj manh ayokoch smuroal chonhab', lajannhej ichok komon lu'um. Syal smanjixieli, ma yaktajel t'a yab'ilal k'inh chi'.
Haxo heb' levita, syal smananxiel spat heb' t'a yalnhej tas tiempoal wach'chom ay t'a yol smuroal schonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok levita max yal-laj smananxiel spat t'a yol smakb'en schonhab', haxo yik sjax yab'ilal yoch k'inh chi', syal yik'anxikan spat chi', yujto a heb' levita chi' anhej spat heb' ayoch smakb'enok t'a yoltak he chonhab'.
Ha lum lum b'aj swa skalnel heb' levita t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', max yal-laj schonhanel heb', yujto swalab' skalnel heb' yajkan yuj schonhab'.

Tato ay junok heb' eyetchonhab' kajan t'a he lak'anil manhxalaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yowalil tzex kolwaj t'ay yik wach' aynhejek' t'a he kal, icha tz'aj he kolwaj t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il sb'eyek' t'a he kal.
Manh he k'an yune' he tumin, ma stupil tastak ix eyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi'. Anhej to tze ch'oxo' to ay welk'och t'a yol he sat, yik wach' aynhejek' jun eyetchonhab' chi' heyet'ok.
Manh he k'an yune' k'e'en tumin tzeyak' majanil t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi', manh he mak'paxk'e stojol wa'el uk'el tzeyak' sk'exa'.
Yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in swala', a in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto yik swak' lum Canaán t'ayex yik tzin och he Diosalok.
Tato ay junok eyetchonhab' ayek' heyet'ok, manhxa jab'ok tas ay t'ay, yuj chi' schonh sb'a t'ayex, manh eyutok icha junok he chekab' ch'ok chonhab'il,
palta ichaokab' junok munlajwum tzeyutej, ma icha junok tonhej sb'eyek'i. Syal smunlaj heyet'ok masanto sjax yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre.
Slajwi chi, tzaxo yal yel yet' yuninal t'a yol he pat, spax t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok b'aj aytaxon slu'um.
Yujto a ex tik, in chekab' eyaji. Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yuj chi' manh smojok to tzex chonhchajel t'a chekab'wumal.
Manh te yajalok tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' eyetisraelal schonh sb'a t'ayex. Anhej to ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat a in he Diosal in tik.
Tato he gana tze man he chekab', winak ma ix, syal he manan t'a skal juntzanhxo nación t'a he lak'anil.
Syalpax he manan heb' ch'ok nacional ayek' t'a he kal, ma yuninal heb' ix alji t'a he kal, syal he manan heb' eyikok t'a junelnhej.
Haxo yik tzex chami skan heb' yikok heb' eyuninal. Syal yoch heb' chi' schekab'ok heb', palta malaj junok eyetisraelal tik syal eyak'anoch he b'a yajalil t'a yib'anh, yujto eyetchonhab' heb'.

Tato ay junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma junok anima ayek' t'a he kal tik tz'och b'eyumal, haxo junok eyetchonhab' junnhej kajan yet'ok tz'och mheb'ail, schonhan sb'a t'a jun ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a slak'anil chi', ma t'a junokxo ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi',
syal smananxiel sb'a, mato smanjiel yuj junok sk'ab' yok,
ma yuj junok to ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Tato tzaxo techaj yuj jun, syal smananel sb'a sch'okojil.

Syik' scuenta heb' t'a yab'ilal ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi', masanto sjax yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha stojol tz'ak'ji, hato syala' jantakxo yab'ilal chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'anpax scuenta jantak tumin tz'och t'a spatik smunlajel, icha stojol sk'u heb' munlajwum.
Tato ayto sk'ochxi yab'ilal chi' jun, smananxiel sb'a, syak'an meltzaj jab'okxo k'e'en tumin, hato syala' jantak ix scha'a ayik ix schonhanel sb'a chi'.
Palta tato kenxonhej tiempo sk'och yab'ilal yik k'inh chi', haxonhej jab'xo chi' stupu'.
Lajanokab' tz'utaj icha junok heb' smunlaj t'a yab'ilal t'a junok patrón, icha pax chi' tz'utaj yuj jun ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Manh he cha ixtaj jun eyetchonhab' chi' t'a eyichanh.
Tato max yal smananel sb'a jun, haxo yik sk'och yab'ilal k'inh chi', hata' tz'aktajel yet' heb' yuninal.
Yujto in chekab' heyaj a ex israel ex tik, a in wal ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yik syal winh t'a heb' yetchonhab' icha tik: Manh he b'o yechel juntzanh komon Dios he diosalok. Manh he molb'ejk'e k'e'en k'e'en tz'alji maksejal, ma k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il ayoch juntzanh icha yechel t'ay. Manh ex em nhojan ejmelal t'ay, yujto a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix wal t'ayex, niwanokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat. Niwanokab' pax yelk'och in kajnub' t'a yol he sat, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al, tze k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il,
ol wak'b'at nhab' t'a stiempoal, haxo yak'an sat te' eyawb'en te' yet' tas awab'il t'a lum lum chi'.

Wanto he tek'an ixim he trigo, toxo pax ix k'inhb'i sat eyuwa. Wanto he molan sat te' eyuwa chi', toxo ix japax stiempo yawchaj trigo junelxo, yuj chi' ol ex waok, masanto ol ex b'ut'jok. Ol eyak' wal tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yol he makb'en.
Te wach'xonhej ol ex ajek' ta'. Ol ex way t'a junk'olal, malaj mach ol ex xib'tanok. Ol ex in kol t'a nok' chium nok' yet' t'a owal.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, yuj eyespada ol cham heb', ol kan teljab' heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha t'a owanhok ex, ol el lemnaj 100-ok heb' ajk'ol chi'. Haxo t'a junok 100 ex, ol el lemnaj 10 milok heb'. Ha heb' ajk'ol chi' ol cham heb' t'a eyichanh yuj eyespada.
Te wach'k'olal ol aj ex wilanochi. Ol wik' wal cha'anh he b'isul, ol wak'elk'och in trato heyet'ok.
Wanto he wa'an ixim trigo molb'ilkan eyuj yiktax junab'i, ol he b'esankanel ixim yik ol he latz'anpaxoch ixim ak'to chi'.
Ol in kajnajnhej heyet'ok, manh ol ex in chakel-laj.
Ol in ajnhejek' t'a he kal. Ha in he Diosal in, a exxo tik in chonhab' eyaji.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, yik wach' max ex kannhej chekab'ok ta'. Ha in ix wik'el jun munlajel manhxo jantakok sya'il ayoch t'a eyib'anh. Yuj wal chi' manhxo nhojanok ex emi tzex b'eyek'i.
Palta tato a ex tik manh ol he k'anab'ajej, manh ol he b'eyb'alej in cheknab'il,
tato ol he patikejel in b'eyb'al tik, tato malaj yelk'och juntzanh in cheknab'il tik t'ayex, tzeyixtanb'at in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok,

a in pax tik, haton juntzanh tik ol in k'ulej heyet'ok: Ol wak'b'at xiwk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Ol wak'b'at juntzanh yab'il manhxa yanhal yet' k'ak'al yab'il ol kot t'ayex syixtan yol he sat, ol pax yip he niwanil. Nab'axonhej ol eyawej tastak, yujto a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ol wa'anb'at sat tas tzeyawej chi'.
Ol in och ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ex satel yuj heb' eyajk'ol chi'. Ol ex kan t'a yalanh yuj heb'. Toxonhej ol ex el lemnajok, wach'chom malaj mach tzex pechani.
Tato hanheja' max in he k'anab'ajej, wach'chom toxo ix jawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, masnhej ol k'echa'anh eyaelal wuj yuj he mul.
Ol wak' lajwokem eyak'umtakil. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', yuj chi' manhxa tas ol yal sk'ib' t'a sat lum he lum chi'.
Nab'axonhej ol eyixtej he b'a he munlaji, manhxalaj tas ol k'ib' t'a sat lum lum chi'. Manhxo ol yak'pax sat te' eyawb'en te'.
Tato te pit ol eyutej he b'a t'ayin, manh ol in he k'anab'ajejnhej, ol te k'echa'anh ya'elal t'a eyib'anh wu'uj, hato syala' jantak he mul.
Ol wak'b'at nok' chium nok' t'a he kal, ol schianb'at eyuninal nok' yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok', haxo yemta he b'isul chi' yuj nok', yuj chi' manhxa mach ol b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e.
Tato hanheja' max he na he b'a yuj juntzanh chi', pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin,
a in xo, te niwan ya'elal ol wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.

Ol wak'b'at owal t'ayex eyaelalok, yuj in pakan t'ayex yujto max he k'anab'ajej in trato. Toxonhej ol ex b'at lemnaj he kol he b'a t'a he chonhab', palta hata' ol wak'b'at k'ak'al yab'il, icha chi' ol aj he kan t'a yalanh yuj heb' winh eyajk'ol chi'.

Ayik ol wik'anemta yel he wa'el, lajunhwanh wal heb' ix ix, junnhej ol sb'o swa'el t'a junok k'ak'. Haxonhej t'a echlab'il ol aj yek' he wa'el chi' t'a he patik. Ol ex waok, palta manh ol ex b'ut'joklaj.
Wach'chom ix eyil juntzanh ya'elal chi', palta tato hanheja' max he na he b'a, hanheja' tze pitejnhej he b'a,
a in pax tik ol wak' yowalil t'ayex yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol. Masnhej ol k'echa'anh eyaelal wu'uj yuj he mul.
Ichato wal chi' ol he chianb'at heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyisil.

Ol in pojem juntzanh lugar b'aj tzex och ejmelal t'a he diosal, ol in mak'poj eyaltar yik incienso. Ol in molb'ejk'e b'ulan he niwanil t'a yib'anh juntzanh he diosal manh pitzanok chi', yujto ol ex in chakeli.
Ol laj in jukanb'at he chonhab' yet' spatil he diosal chi'. Manhxo ol in tzalaj yuj suk'uk'ial sjab' he silab'.
Ol wak' lajwokem he chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ajk'ol ol jakan kajan t'ay, ol sat sk'ol heb' yilan jun chi'.
Ol ex wak'an saklem t'a skal masanil nación. Tzak'an wespada t'a he patik ol ex b'atok. Ha he chonhab' chi', kuseltak ol ajkanok, xiwk'olaltak ol aj sjuwikanb'ati.

Ichato wal chi' wach' ol aj skan lum sch'okojil t'a masanil tiempo ayik ayextoek' t'a juntzanhxo nación ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex chi'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yik'ankan yip lu'um, icha stiempoal to maj yik' yip lum eyuj t'a yalanhtaxo ayik ayex ek' kajan ta'.

Ha heb' eyinhtilal pitzanto b'aj ay slugar heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol wak' wal och xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol el lemnaj heb' ayik ol yab'an heb' yem k'otnaj junok te' xil te'. Ol el heb' ichato ay junok mach tzak'anoch yet' espada t'a spatik heb'. Toxonhej ol komon telwok heb', wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'.
Ol komon telwokb'at junjun heb', ichato wan yel heb' t'a owal, wach'chom malaj mach spechan heb'. Manhxalaj junok heb' ol to stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh heb' ajk'o'ol.
Ol lajwokem heb' t'a skaltak juntzanh nación chi', ichato a slugar heb' ajk'ol chi' ol satanel heb'.
Ha mach t'a skal heb' eyinhtilal pitzantokanek' t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'ol chi', hata' ol cham heb' yujnhej schukal, yuj pax smul heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ayik toxo ix in och ajk'olal t'ayex chi', ayik toxo pax ex wak'kanb'at t'a schonhab' heb' eyajk'o'ol, yujto ix he pitej he b'a t'ayin, tato hata' sna sb'a sk'ol heb' eyinhtilal b'aj ix spitej sb'a heb' chi' t'ayin, tato syak'em sb'a heb' t'a wichanh yik syalank'eta smul heb' yet' he mul a ex tik,
tato icha chi', ol in na'ankot in trato wak'nak to ol wak' lum lum t'a winhaj Jacob, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Abraham.

Palta ha t'a yalanhto chi', ol ex el t'a sat he lu'um chi'. Ol kan tzinan lu'um, ol yik'an yip lu'um ayik manh ex ayok ek' ta'. Tz'akan ol aj he tupan el he mul, yujto ix he patikejel in b'eyb'al yet' in cheknab'il.

Wach'chom icha chi' tzex wutej, ayik ayek' heb' eyinhtilal t'a schonhab' heb' yajk'ol heb' chi', manh ol in patikejel-laj heb'. Manh ol in satel-laj heb' yik manh ol lajwokek' in trato ix wak' yet' heb' yujto a in Jehová in, sDiosal in heb'.

Haxo ol ajok to yuj swach'ilok heb', ol in nakot in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok ayik ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto. T'a wal yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' ix ex wik'elta, yik wach' tzin och he Diosalok. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Haton juntzanh b'eyb'al tik, cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová t'a jolom witz Sinaí t'a winhaj Moisés yik sk'anab'ajan heb' chonhab' israel.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach tz'ak'an sti' yak'an junok anima t'ayin Jehová in tik, palta snib'ej smananel jun anima chi', yowalil syak' stojol, stupu' icha yalan jun lista tik,
icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub': Ha heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, yowalil tz'ak'ji 50 siclo k'e'en plata stojolok. Tato ix, 30 siclo plata syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' oye' ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 20, tato winak, 20 siclo k'e'en plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, 10 siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' unin jun ujal sk'inal masanto t'a oye' ab'il, tato winak, oye' siclo k'e'en plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, oxe' siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' icham anima ek'xo t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, 15 siclo k'e'en plata syak'a', tato ix jun, 10 siclo k'e'en syak'a'.
Tato ay junok anima yelxo wal meb'a' jun, max yal-laj yak'an icha sb'isul k'e'en to chekel yaj chi', tz'ik'chajkot t'a yichanh junok winh sacerdote, snaji jantak wal syal yak'ani.
Haxo pax yuj nok' nok' to tz'ak'jitaxon silab'il t'ayin, masanil nok' tz'ak'ji t'ayin chi', chekel tz'ajkan nok'.
Max yal-laj sk'exji nok' yet' junokxo nok', wach'chom wach' nok', ma chuktak wal nok'. Palta tato sk'exji nok', a nok' sk'exul chi', skanxonhej nok' yet' nok' chekeltaxon yaj chi'.
Haxo pax yuj junok nok' nok' manh wach'oktaxon yoch silab'il t'ayin jun, a nok' chi' tz'ik'jikot t'a junok winh sacerdote,

yik wach' snaji jantak stojol nok', hato syala' chajtil yilji nok'. Icha stojol nok' ix naji yuj winh sacerdote chi', ichanhej chi' tz'ajkan stojol nok' yik schonhchaj yuj yochkan stojol nok' yikok in kajnub'.
Tato hanheja' mach ay yik nok' chi' snib'ej smananpaxel nok' jun, yowalil syak' stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syak'an jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh stojol nok' chi'.
Tato ay mach syak' spat t'ayin, tato wach' yaji, mato chuktak wal yaji, a junok winh sacerdote sna'ani jantak wal stojol. Icha chi' tz'ajkan stojol chi' t'a junelnhej.
Palta tato a mach ay yik jun pat chi' snib'ej smananeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol ix najikan chi', ichato chi' syik'anxi spat chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak' junok makan slu'um t'ayin, a stojol lum lum chi' snaji, hato ha' jantak sat tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um. Tato b'alunhe' arroba ixim cebada tz'elta t'a lu'um, 50 siclo plata stojol lu'um.
Tato tz'ak'ji lum lum chi' t'a yol yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, skanxonhej stojol lum icha ix aj snajikan chi'.

Palta tato ayik toxo ix lajwiek' jun ab'il chi' tz'ak'ji lu'um, a winh sacerdote syal sna'ani jantak k'e'en plata syal yak'ji. Tz'ik'jiemta jab'ok stojol lu'um, hato syala' jayeto ab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il k'inh chi'.
Tato a junok mach ix yak' slum chi' t'ayin, snib'ej smananpaxeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol nab'ilkani. Ichato chi' syal yik'anxikan slu'um chi'.
Tato max smanel lum mach ix ak'an chi', palta to schonhb'at lum t'a junokxo anima, tato icha chi', maxtzak yal smananxiel lu'um.
Ayik skan lum lum chi' t'a libre t'a yab'ilal he cha'an k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, a jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um, haxo heb' sacerdote smakb'enankan lu'um.
Tato ay mach syak' sti' yak'an junok lum lum t'ayin to manb'il yuj, manh smakb'enoktaxon yaji,

a junok winh sacerdote sna'an stojol yet' jun anima chi' masanto sjax yab'ilal k'inh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' syak' stojol lum jun anima chi', hato ha' jantak ix aj snaji, tz'ochkan k'e'en tumin chi' wikok.
Haxo yik sjax jun ab'il chi', smeltzajxi lum t'a mach ix chonhan chi', syalelk'ochi haton jun mach aytaxon yik lu'um.
Ha stojol junok tas sna heb' sacerdote stupchaj icha k'e'en tumin sk'anchaj b'aj ay in kajnub'. 20 geras yalil junjun siclo k'e'en plata.
Ha sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, wiktaxon yaj a in Jehová in tik. Malaj mach syal yak'an juntzanh nok' chi' yofrendaok t'ayin yujto a sb'ab'el yune' nok' wiktaxon yaji.

Tato a sb'ab'el yune' junok nok' to manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, syal smanjixiel nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an chi', hato syal jantak stojol nok' ix naji, syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'. Tato manhok mach ay yik nok' chi' smananeli, hanheja' icha stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syal schonhjiel yuj heb' sacerdote.

Yalnhej tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin t'a junelnhej, junok anima, ma junok nok' molb'etzal nok', ma junok lum lum to smakb'entaxon yaj jun mach tz'ak'an chi', ma junokxo tasi, max yal-laj schonhchaji, max yalpax smanjiel yuj mach ix ak'ani. Wikxo yaj t'a junelnhej.
Haxo pax junok anima toxonton ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh, max yal-laj smanjieli. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil tz'ochxonhej chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha sdiezmoal sat masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lum lum tik, wach'chom sat ixim, ma sat te te', wiktaxon yaji.
Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smananel jun diezmo chi', yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'.
Jun t'a lajlajunhwanh nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, haton nok' chi' skan t'a diezmoal t'ayin tato wach' nok', ma ay spaltail nok'.

Max yal-laj sik'laj nok', ma sk'exchaj nok' yet' junokxo nok' ch'ok yeli. Tato ay mach snib'ej sk'exan nok', a nok' b'ab'el chi' yet' pax nok' tz'ak'ji sk'exulok nok' chi', skanxonhej nok' schawanhil. Max yalpaxlaj smanjiel nok', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha t'a jolom witz Sinaí ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', yik chonhab' Israel yaji.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal, t'a schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, haton b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová Dios b'aj sch'ox sb'a. Ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' winak t'a skal heb' etchonhab' israel, hato syal junjun makan yaj heb' haton heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik wach' tz'ilji jantak heb' yet' tastak sb'i heb'.
Sb'ischaj heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, haton heb' smoj wal sb'at t'a owal, tz'ak'chajoch heb' t'a makkiltakil. Kolwajokab' winhaj Aarón het'ok,
yet' pax junjun yajalil junjun inhtilal.

Haton sb'i juntzanh heb' yajal yowalil skolwaj het'ok tik: Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Rubén, haton winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Simeón, haton winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Judá, haton winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Isacar, haton winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Zabulón, haton winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón. Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj José, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Efraín, haton winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, ha t'a heb' yik winhaj Manasés, haton winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Benjamín, haton winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Dan, haton winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Aser, haton winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gad, haton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel. Ha t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Neftalí, haton winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, xchi Dios.
Haton juntzanh heb' yajal tik ix sik'chajel t'a skal masanil yinhtilal Israel.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal t'a schab'il ujal yik jun ab'il chi', ix smolb'ej juntzanh heb' winh tik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, to satil tz'ajkan heb' winh yuj Dios. Hanheja' ix molb'ajpax masanil heb' chonhab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' israel. T'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chaj sb'i heb', haton heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal, sb'eynhejb'ati, hato ha' smakanhil t'a junjun inhtilal,
icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a Sinaí ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' chi'.

Ha t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makkiltakil, ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' chi'. Ix tz'ib'chaj sb'i heb' yet' sb'isul heb' winak tz'akanxo yab'ilal t'a 20 ab'il, yuj chi' haton wal ix aj yelk'och tik: Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Rubén, haton sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel, 46 mil 500 heb' winak smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Simeón, ay 59 mil 300.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gad, ay 45 mil 650.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Judá, ay 74 mil 600.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Isacar, ay 54 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zabulón, ay 57 mil 400.
Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj José: Ay 40 mil 500 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Efraín, ay pax 32 mil 200 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Manasés.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Benjamín, ay 35 mil 400.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Dan, ay 62 mil 700.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aser, ay 41 mil 500.
Ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj Neftalí, ay 53 mil 400.
Haton ix aj yelk'och juntzanh sb'isul ix yik'cha'anh winhaj Moisés tik, winhaj Aarón yet' lajchawanhxo heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel t'a junjun inhtilal.
Ix k'e wa'an juntzanh sb'isul chi' t'a junjun inhtilal, t'a junjun makkiltakil. Ha heb' israel, 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, haton heb' chi' smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a smasanil ay 603 mil 550 heb'.
Ha yinhtilal winhaj Leví, maj ak'jiochlaj heb' sb'isulok,
yujto a Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Moisés:
Ayik ol ik'ank'e wa'an sb'isul chonhab' Israel tik, manh ol ak'ochlaj yinhtilal winhaj Leví sb'isulok.

Yujto a ex yinhtilalexkan winhaj Leví chi', ol ex och yak'umalok serwil in kajnub' b'aj ayek' skaxail in trato yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Hanheja' ex ol eyik'nhej b'ey in kajnub' chi' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Yowalil ol ex ajnhej kajan t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' chi'.
Ayik tz'ik'jib'at t'a juntak el, a ex tze xuyemi, tze b'oanpaxk'e b'aj sk'och chi'. Yalnhej mach junok anima manh levitaok sjawi t'a slak'anil jun in kajnub' chi', tojolnhej schami.
Haxo masanil juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel ol kajnaj icha t'a stzolal, junjun heb' ol aj t'a scampamento, t'a yalanh sbandera.
Ha exxo pax yinhtilal ex kan winhaj Leví chi' jun, ha t'a spatik yichanh in kajnub' ol ex ajok. Ha ex ol he tanhwej, yik wach' max kot wowal t'a in chonhab' Israel, xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel sk'ulan icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón icha tik:

Ayik sb'oank'e scampamento heb' israel t'a junok lugar, junjun tz'aj t'a yalanh sbandera yet' junjun makkiltakil, yowalil najattak wal tz'ajel heb' t'a spatik yichanh mantiado, haton b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, hata' tz'aj scampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Judá chi', a winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 74 mil 600 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj scampamento yinhtilal Isacar yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 54 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax scampamento yinhtilal Zabulón. Ha winhaj Eliab, yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 57 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay scampamento yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 186 mil 400 heb' soldado, haton heb' b'ab'el sb'at t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel.
Haxo t'a stojolal sur, hata' tz'aj scampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Rubén chi', a winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 46 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj scampamento yinhtilal Simeón yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 59 mil 300 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax scampamento yinhtilal Gad yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Reuel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 45 mil 650 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay scampamento yinhtilal Rubén chi', ay 151 mil 450 heb' soldado, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yik schab'il makan.

Sb'atpax heb' levita t'a skal chanhe' campamento. Ha heb' et'jinak smantiadoal b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Ha chanhe' campamento chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj sb'eyi icha tas yajek' heb' t'a scampamento, junjun heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera.

Haxo t'a stojolal b'aj sb'at k'u, hata' tz'aj scampamento oxe' inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Efraín chi', a winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 40 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 32 mil 200 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax scampamento yinhtilal Benjamín. Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 35 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay scampamento yinhtilal Efraín chi', ay 108 mil 100 soldado, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yoxil makan.
Haxo t'a stojolal norte, hata' tz'aj scampamento oxexo inhtilal et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Ha heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Dan chi', a winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 62 mil 700 heb' soldado.
Junnhej tz'aj scampamento yinhtilal Aser yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 41 mil 500 heb' soldado.
Hata' tz'ajpax scampamento yinhtilal Neftalí yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Hato ha' yalan sb'isul, ay 53 mil 400 heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' a b'aj ay scampamento yinhtilal Dan chi', ay 157 mil 600 heb' soldado. Haton heb' sb'eyb'at t'a spatik sbandera yinhtilal Dan chi', haton heb' tzak'anto sb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha sb'isul heb' israel, ay 603 mil 550 heb' soldado t'a smasanil.
Palta maj och heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví sb'isulok, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix sk'ulej heb' israel icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová. Junnhej ix aj heb' t'a yalanhtak sbandera, ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a stzolal, hato syal junjun makkiltakil.
Haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Moisés tik, ayik ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi': Winhaj Nadab b'ab'el winak, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha heb' chanhwanh tik, ix sik'jiel heb', ix ochkan yopisio heb' sacerdoteal.

Palta a winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová to manh smojok. Mantalaj yuninal heb' ta', yuj chi' haxonhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix munlaj sacerdoteal t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Aarón haton smam heb'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Awtej masanil heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Leví, yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj sacerdote Aarón icha ol yal winh.

Ha heb' chi' ayoch yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a yichanh chonhab' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Stanhwanpax masanil yamk'ab' yik mantiado chi' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji serwil masanil chonhab' Israel yuj heb' t'a masanil munlajel b'aj ay in kajnub'.
Ik'chajokab'el heb' levita t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' smasanil yik wach' syak' serwil winhaj Aarón heb' yet' t'a masanil yinhtilal winh.
Anhej t'a yib'anh winh yet' yinhtilal tz'ochkan yopisio yak'an sacerdoteal. Tato ay junok mach manh yinhtilok winh chi' syekoch sb'a t'a jun opisio chi', yowalil schami, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Toxo ix ex in sik'kanel a ex levita ex tik sk'exulok junjun heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik eyaji.

Ayik ix wak'ancham masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a Egipto, ix wak'kan sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yik tz'ochkan wikok, icha pax chi' nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' wik yaji. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí, ix yalani:
Ik'k'e wa'an sb'isul heb' etlevitail, icha junjun makkiltakil, masanil heb' winak t'a he kal. Tza chael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Coat: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal. Ha heb' winh tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Libni yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Simei.
Ha sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ix chajiel yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 7 mil 500.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová tz'aj scampamento heb'.
Ha pax mach yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, haton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Lael.
Haton heb' tz'ilan juntzanh smakul yib'anh skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' k'apak cortina ayoch t'a sti' skajnub' chi',
k'apak scortinail amak' oyanoch t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová yet' b'aj ay altar, k'apak cortina ayoch t'a sti' amak' chi' yet' sch'anhal ayoch t'a spatik syamk'ab'il.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, chanh makan yaj heb': Haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Amram, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Izhar, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Hebrón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Uziel.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak ix schael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 8 mil 600 heb', haton heb' tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal sur tz'aj scampamento heb'.
Ha yajalil juntzanh heb', haton winhaj Elizafán yuninal winhaj Uziel.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' skaxail trato, te' mexa, sb'akhnub' candil, chab' altar yet' masanil jantak syamk'ab'il sk'anchaj t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yet' pax k'apak cortina ayoch t'a yo'ol.
Ha jun sat yajal yajoch t'a skal heb' levita chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan masanil heb' smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Mahli yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Musi.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 6 mil 200 heb'.
Ha yajalil heb', haton winhaj Zuriel yuninal winhaj Abihail. Tz'aj scampamento heb' t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal norte.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' smarcoal, sreglail, yoyal, sb'akhnub'al, masanil syamk'ab'il,
yet' pax yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak amak', sb'akhnub'al, yestacail yet' masanil sch'anhal.

Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at skajnub' Jehová tz'aj scampamento winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', haton heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a yol skajnub' Jehová chi' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel. Tato ay junok mach sk'och t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi' to manh yopisio'ok yaji, tojolnhej schami.

Ayik ix yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' levita winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a stzolal icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ay 22 mil, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'cha'anh sb'isul yet' sb'i heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etchonhab', tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.

Ha heb' levita tik, wik yaj heb' sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi'. Hanheja' wikpax tz'ajkan masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' sk'exulok nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' israel tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Masanil heb' winak unin jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 22 mil 273 heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak'kanoch heb' levita tik sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel. Hanheja' pax nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' tz'ochkan sk'exulok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yetisraelal, yujto wik yaj heb' levita tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

Palta ek'al sb'isul heb' b'ab'el unin t'a chonhab' Israel t'a yichanh heb' levita chi', yuj chi' ha t'a junjun heb' 273 b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', tza k'an oyeok siclo k'e'en plata, icha jantak yalil k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', haton 20 geras yalil.
Tzak'an juntzanh k'e'en tumin chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, haton tz'och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj smolank'e k'e'en tumin winhaj Moisés ix och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel syak' sobre chi'.
Ix molchaj mil 365 siclo k'e'en plata, icha jantak yalil k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'e'en winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'k'e wa'an sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat t'a stzolal t'a skal heb' levita,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Haton heb' tik smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat chi', to a juntzanh tastak wiknhej yaji, a stanhwej heb', haton juntzanh tik:
Ayik sb'atxi heb' chonhab', a ach ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, tzeyik'el k'apak cortina ayoch smakulok jun Lugar Wiknhej Yaji, tze musan te' skaxail in trato t'a k'apak.
Haxo t'a yib'anh tzeyak'b'at jun tz'u'um te lab'ab'i smusilok. Haxo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'b'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak, tzeyak'anoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyak'anpaxb'at jun k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a sat mexa ay t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh jun chi' tzeyak'em k'e'en plato, juntzanh k'e'en niwak cuchara, uk'ab' yet' juntzanh xalual wino tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail yet' ixim pan tz'ak'jitaxoni.
Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at jun chakchak k'apak, tze musan t'a jun tz'u'um te lab'ab'i chi', tzeyak'anpaxoch te' b'akhlab' yik tz'ik'jib'ati.

Tzeyik'anpaxkot junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tze musan jun sb'akhnub' candil yet' juntzanh candil chi', k'e'en k'e'en tz'ik'anel sta'anhil k'apak k'apak b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil yet' platillo yet' masanil yet'tal sk'anchaj yet' aceite.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tze musej t'a jun nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Tzeyak'anpaxb'at junxo k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak t'a yib'anh altar nab'a oro. Tze pichan t'a juntzanh nok' tz'u'um lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch ste'al yik sb'akhchaji.

Tze molanpax k'e wa'an masanil yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a yol in kajnub', tze pichanoch t'a yol jun k'ik'mutz'inak k'apak, tzeyak'anoch juntzanhxo nok' tz'u'um lab'ab'i t'ay, tzeyak'ank'e t'a yib'anh te b'akhlab'.
Yowalil tzeyik'el jantak k'e'en ta'anh kalan yet' xepu' stz'a t'a altar, slajwi chi' tze musan altar chi' t'a jun k'apak k'apak yaxmakinak.

Haxo t'a yib'anh tz'ak'jib'at masanil tastak sk'anchaj t'a altar chi': Haton yet'tal tzak'ak' yet' juntzanh k'e'en tenedor, k'e'en pala, k'e'en niwak uk'ab' yet' juntzanhxo yalnhej tas yamk'ab'il. Ha t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'jib'at nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i, tzeyak'anpaxoch te te' yik sb'akhchaji.

Ayik slajwi he pichan masanil juntzanh tastak niwan yelk'och chi', wach'xo yaji yik tz'ik'jib'ati, skot heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat yik syik'anb'at heb'. Masanil juntzanh tastak to wik yaj chi', max yal-laj syaman heb' yik max cham heb' yuj. Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il yik in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat yowalil tz'ik'anb'ati.

Ha winhaj Eleazar, winh uninal a ach sacerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan tas yaj aceite yik candil, incienso wach' sjab', ofrenda yik ixim trigo to yowalil tz'ak'ji t'ayin yet' aceite sk'anchaji a sik'chajel junok mach, ma junok tas tz'ochkan wikok. Ha winh stanhwan in kajnub' yet' masanil syamk'ab'il, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:
Mokab' satel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat t'a skal heb' eyetlevitail.

Yik max jawi chamel t'a yib'anh heb', yuj syaman heb' tastak to wiknhej yaji, yowalil tze b'eyb'alej juntzanh tik: Ach Aarón yet' heb' uninal, yowalil tzex och yet' heb' t'a yol in kajnub'. Ha ex tzeyal t'a heb' tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Yuj chi', max och heb' junok rato yil tastak to wik yaji, yik max cham heb' yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, haton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Haton smunlajel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik t'a mantiado chi':
Ha heb' yowalil tz'ik'anb'at k'apak smakul yib'anh in kajnub' yet' chab'xo jenhan smakul yib'anh, nok' tz'um lab'ab'i ayoch smakulok yib'anh, k'apak cortina ayoch t'a smakulok sti',

k'apak cortina ayoch t'a spatiktak yamak'il in kajnub' b'aj ay altar, k'apak cortina ayoch b'aj ay sti' yamak'il chi' yet' syamk'ab'il yet' jantak sch'anhal ayochi yik tz'och t'a yopisio. Ha heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan juntzanh ix b'inaj tik.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal, a heb' skuchb'an masanil heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón chi' t'a munlajel sk'ulej yet' yik'anb'at tastak heb' to tz'ik'jib'ati. Ha heb' tik sch'oxan tastak syik'b'at junjun heb'.

Haton wal yopisio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón tik ayik smunlaj heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Sk'anab'ajejokab' masanil tas syal winhaj Itamar heb', haton winh yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón.
Ik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari t'a stzolal,
haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50, haton heb' smoj wal smunlaj t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Ha smunlajel heb', haton yik'anb'at masanil ste'al mantiado chi' heb', haton smarcoal, sreglail, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al,
masanil yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak yamak'il in kajnub', sb'akhnub'al yich, yestacail, sch'anhal yet' masanil syamk'ab'il sk'anchaji. Ha ex tzeyala' tastak yowalil syik'b'at junjun heb'.
Ha jun munlajel tik skan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón, a winh tz'alani tas sk'ulej heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', a heb' ix ik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' levita smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50. Haton heb' tik: Eb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Merari. T'a stzolal ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 750 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, icha stzolal, ay 2 mil 630 heb' t'a smasanil. Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, icha stzolal, ay 3 mil 200 heb' t'a smasanil. Haxo sb'isul heb' levita chi' ix yik'chanh winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yajal yaji, icha syal stzolal, haton heb' 30 ab'il sk'inal sk'och t'a 50 to smoj wal smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a, ay 8 mil 580 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ha jun sb'isul tik, ix ik'chajk'e wa'an, ix alchaj t'a junjun heb' tastak sk'ulej yet' tastak syik'b'ati, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a masanil heb' etisraelal to a heb' anima pena'ay yuj lepra, heb' tz'el yinhatil yuj junok ilya ayoch t'ay, ma heb' syaman junok chamnak, yowalil tz'ik'jiel heb' t'a spatikel campamento.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', tz'ik'jiel heb', heb' winh winak ma heb' ix ix, yik malaj tas manh wach'ok t'a yol campamento b'aj ayinek' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' israel yik'anelta juntzanh heb' anima chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max in k'anab'ajani, syixtan yetanimail, wan yoch smul.
Yowalil syojtakejel spaltail chi'. Hanhejtona', yowalil syak'xi sk'exul tastak ix yixtejb'at chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh stojol juntzanh chi'.

Tato toxo ix cham jun mach ix ixtajb'at tastak ay t'ay chi', manhxa pax junok ayto yuj sb'a smoj scha'an sk'exul junok tas chi', a jun chi', tz'ochkan wikok, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote skani. Hanhejtona' syak'anpax junok nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul ix och chi'.
Masanil ofrenda syak' heb' etisraelal t'ayin, tz'ik'jib'at t'a heb' sacerdote. Ha juntzanh chi', yik heb' sacerdote chi' yaji.
Masanil tastak syak' junok etisraelal t'ayin, tato tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sacerdote, yik winh tz'ajkani, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés
to syal juntzanh tik winh t'a heb' yetisraelal: Talaj ay junok winak sna t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum to ay smul ix say t'a yol sk'ab',

to smulan ix yet' junok winak, palta max nachajel-laj yuj winh tato toxo ix mulan ix, yujto max yal ix, malaj pax junok mach ix ilan smulan ix. Mato ay pax junok winak tonhej sna'ank'e icha chi' t'a spatik ix yetb'eyum chi', wach'chom malaj smul ix syak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

Ha t'a cha makan lolonel icha chi', a winh winak chi', syal yik'anb'at ix yetb'eyum winh t'a yichanh junok winh sacerdote. Syak'an chanheok libra ixim harina cebada winh ofrendail yuj ix, palta max sekjiemlaj aceite t'a yib'anh ixim, max ak'jipaxlaj incienso yet' ixim, yujto a jun ofrenda chi', ofrenda yik k'ak'alk'olal, yopisio yik scheklajelta mul.
Haxo winh sacerdote chi' tz'alani to snitzkot sb'a ix ix chi', tz'ik'jioch ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Elanhchamel syik'kot jab'ok ha ha' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol junok lum uk'ab', haton ha ha' wiknhej yaji. Syik'anpaxk'e jab'ok pokok winh, haton lum ay t'a in kajnub', syak'anb'at winh t'a skal ha ha' chi'.

Tz'och linhan ix ix chi' yuj winh sacerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, syik'anel sk'ox ix, tz'ak'jipaxoch jun ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Haxo winh sacerdote chi' et'jinakk'e ha ha' k'a' tz'ik'ankot ya'elal,

schekan winh yak' sti' ix. Syalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Tato yel maj ach mulan yet' junokxo winak t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum tik, malaj tas ol ach ik'anok a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' k'a' et'jinak ya'elal tik.
Palta tato ix ach mulan yet' junokxo winh winak jun, ix och a mul t'a yol sk'ab' winh etb'eyum,
a Jehová ol ach ak'ankanoch ch'oxnab'ilok t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'. Ol ach b'inaj yuj heb' t'a chukal, ol malk'e a k'o'ol, ol takjok yib' a xub'.
Haton wal jun ya'elal chi' ol jawok t'a ib'anh a ol uk'anem jun ha ha' tik, yujto ha ha' et'jinak ya'elal, xcham winh sacerdote chi' t'a ix. Haxo stak'wi ix ix chi': Ujokab' icha chi', xcham ix.
Ha juntzanh katab' chi', tz'ib'chajokab'kan yuj winh sacerdote. Slajwi chi' sb'ikanel winh yet' ha ha' k'a' tz'em t'a yol uk'ab' chi'.
Slajwi chi' syuk'anem ha' ix ix chi', haxo yik slajwi yuk'an ha' ix, skotkan ya'elal t'a yib'anh ix.
Scha'anek' ixim harina cebada ofrenda yuj k'ak'alk'olal winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol sk'ab' ix. Ha jun ofrenda chi' sb'akhoch winh sacerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.
Syik'ank'e jun wotzok jun ofrenda winh sacerdote chi', snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yuj sch'oxankot masanil jun ofrenda chi'. Ayik toxo ix yuk'ej ha ha' k'a' chi' ix,

tato ay smul ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum chi', skot ya'elal t'a yib'anh ix yuj ha ha' syuk'em chi'. Smalk'e sk'o'ol ix, stakji yib' xub' ix, tz'ochkan ix ch'oxnab'ilok yet' sb'inaj t'a chukal t'a skal chonhab' chi'.
Palta tato yel malaj jab'ok smul ix, malaj jab'ok tas tz'ik'an ix, yuj chi' scheklajeli to malaj smul ix, syalnhej yalji yune' ix.
Haton jun ley tik tz'och t'a yib'anh ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' winh yetb'eyum, yuj chi' tz'och winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a k'ak'alk'olal.

Tato ay junok winak tonhej tzek' t'a yib'anh yak'an k'ak'alk'olal t'a ix yetb'eyum, a jun winak chi' yowalil syik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik, yik sb'o'an winh sacerdote chi' masanil tas syal jun ley tik.
Tato yel ay smul ix ix chi', ha t'a yib'anh ix skan smul chi'. Haxo t'a yib'anh winh winak chi' malaj tas skani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etchonhab': Tato ay junok winak ma junok ix ix syak' sti' yak'anoch sb'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a nazareoal,

maxtzak yal-laj yuk'an wino, ma yuk'an junokxo tas to pajb'inak. Maxtzak yalpax yuk'an wino ochnak vinagreal, ma vinagre pajb'inak. Max yalpax yuk'an yal sat uwa, ma sloan sat, ma sloan sat t'a takinhal.
Ha t'a jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi', manh wal jab'ok syal yab'lan masanil tastak tz'el t'a te' uwa, wach'chom sk'enal ma stz'umal.
Max yalpax sjoxanel xil sjolom masanto slajwi jantak tiempo ix yak' sti' chi' t'ayin, schanhej k'ib' xil sjolom yujto wik yaj a in Jehová in tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey junok chamnak,
wach'chom a smam, ma snun schami, ma junok yuk'tak, ma junok yanab', palta max yal-laj sk'och t'a stz'ey yik wach' max kan t'a chukal icha yalan ley. Yowalil wach'nhej yaji yujto wik yaji.
Ha t'a masanil tiempo b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', junelnhej wiknhej yaji.

Talaj ay junok mach junnhej ayek' yet'ok schami, a xil sjolom to wik yaj chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan icha yalan ley. Yuj chi' ayik slajwi yek'b'at ukeok k'uhal ayik sb'oxikan icha yalan ley, ichato chi' sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi'.
Haxo t'a yukub'ixial, syik'anb'at chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil t'a junok winh sacerdote t'a yichanh in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Ha winh sacerdote chi' tz'ak'an junok nok' chi' silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'. Haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a nok' smasanil silab'il. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji tup smul yuj b'aj ix cham jun anima chi' t'a stz'ey. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a xil sjolom sk'ib'xi, wik tz'ajxikani.

Tz'elxi yich jun pekti' b'aj ix yak' sti' t'ayin. Ha jantak tiempo ix ek'b'at t'a yalanhtax chi', maxtzak ochlaj sb'isulok, yujto a xil sjolom wik yaji, ix ixtaxeli. Hanhejtona' yowalil syik'paxb'at junok nok' kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal silab'il t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yuj stupan tas ix sk'ulej chi'.
Ayik slajwi jantak tiempoal ix yak' sti' jun anima chi', yowalil sb'at t'a sti' in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.

Hata' syak'och jun silab' t'a wichanh, snhusjitz'a smasanil, haton junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Hanheja' syak'pax junok nok' nun kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Ha jun chi' silab' yaj yuj yak'ji tup mul. Tz'ak'ji junok nok' ch'ak kalnel malaj jab'ok spaltail silab'il yik junk'olal.

Hanhejtona', yowalil syak' junok yune' mo'och ixim pan malaj yich, a ixim harina te wach' ayoch t'ay kalab'il yet' aceite. Syak'pax ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, ayoch aceite t'ay. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' yofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' wino t'inhantaxon yak'ani.
Ha junok winh sacerdote tz'ak'anoch jun silab' yuj mul chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in yet' silab' to snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Syak'anpax nok' kalnel silab'il yik junk'olal. Junnhej tz'aj yak'an yet' ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Syak'anpax ofrenda t'a ixim trigo yet' pax wino.

Ha jun ix yak' sti' t'a nazareoal chi', sjoxchajel xil sjolom. Ha t'a yichanh in kajnub' sjoxchajeli. Smolk'e xil sjolom ayoch ch'oxnab'ilok to wik yaji, snhusjitz'a t'a kal k'ak', haton k'ak' b'aj stz'a silab' yik junk'olal.

Ayik slajwi sjoxjiel xil sjolom chi', a winh sacerdote tz'ik'ank'e sjenhjab' nok' kalnel tajinakxo chi' yet' jun ixim pan malaj yich ayem t'a yol jun yune' mo'och chi' yet' pax jun ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, syak'anoch winh masanil t'a yol sk'ab' jun ix yak'och sb'a nazareoal chi'.

Slajwi chi', sb'akhanoch juntzanh chi' winh sacerdote chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik. Ha juntzanh chi' sik'b'ilel wikok, yik heb' sacerdote chi' yaji yet' pax snhisk'ol nok' sb'akhchajoch t'a wichanh, xub' nok' to sik'chajkaneli, yik winh sacerdote chi' yaji. Ayik toxo ix lajwi masanil juntzanh chi', a jun yak'nakoch sb'a nazareoal chi', tzaxo yal yuk'an wino.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' nazareo: Tato ay junok nazareo chi' syak' sti' yak'an junok ofrenda ek'to t'a yichanhtaxon sleyal, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha b'aj ix yak' sti' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, ayik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' eyetisraelal, syal heb' icha tik:
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, tzex stanhwani.
Ex yilokab'och Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, sch'oxokab' swach'k'olal t'ayex.
Xajanokab' tzex yiloch Jehová, yak'okab' junk'olal t'ayex, xchiokab' heb'.
Icha chi' ol yutej heb' in yak'an b'inaj t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal. Ha inxo ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'oank'e skajnub' Jehová winhaj Moisés, ix yak'anoch aceite winh t'ay yet' t'a masanil syamk'ab'il yet' t'a yib'anh altar yet' syamk'ab'il.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, haton heb' kolwajnak yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' winak,

ix yak' yofrenda heb' t'a Jehová: Wake' carreta ayk'e yenhul yib'anh yet' lajchawanh nok' mam wakax smunlaj ix yak' heb'. Syalelk'ochi, junjun carreta t'a chatakwanh heb' yajal chi', junjun pax nok' wakax chi' t'a junjun heb'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yichanh skajnub' Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Cha juntzanh carreta yet' juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj chi', tzak'an t'a heb' levita yik sk'an heb' t'a munlajel t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, icha tastak munlajelal sk'ulej junjun heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix scha'an juntzanh carreta chi' winh, ix scha'anpax nok' wakax smunlaj chi' winh, ix spojanek' winh t'a skal heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, chab' carreta yet' chanhwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb'.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, chanhe' carreta yet' wajxakwanh nok' wakax chi' ix yak' winh, icha syal smunlajel heb' b'aj skuchb'aj yuj winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón.
Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, malaj carreta, malaj pax nok' wakax ix ak'ji, yujto a heb' sb'akhanb'at masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová t'a sjolom sjenhjab'.
Ayik ix ak'jikanoch yopisio altar, ix yik'b'at yofrenda heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal t'a yichanh altar chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha t'a junjun k'u ch'okch'ok heb' yajal t'a junjun inhtilal ol yik'kot yofrenda yuj yochkan yopisio altar, xchi.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, ix yik'ankot yofrenda winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab, yajal t'a yinhtilal Judá. T'a schab'il k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar, yajal t'a yinhtilal Isacar. T'a yoxil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón, yajal t'a yinhtilal Zabulón. T'a schanhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Rubén. T'a yo'il k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Simeón. T'a swakil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel, yajal t'a yinhtilal Gad. T'a yukil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud, yajal t'a yinhtilal Efraín. T'a swajxakil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur, yajal t'a yinhtilal Manasés. T'a sb'alunhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni, yajal t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. T'a slajunhil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai, yajal t'a yinhtilal Dan. T'a yuxluchil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Aser. Haxo t'a slajchawil k'uhal, ix yik'ankot yik winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán, yajal t'a yinhtilal Neftalí. Lajannhej yofrenda junjun heb' winh ix yik'koti. Haton junjun plato nab'a plata, 130 siclo yalil junjun yet' pax junjun k'e'en niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 70 siclo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha juntzanh yet'tal chi' te b'ut'an yuj ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, haton syak' heb' t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax junjun k'e'en niwak cuchara nab'a oro heb', 10 siclo yalil junjun, b'ut'an yet' incienso. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' kelem wakax heb', junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel, junjun nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal yik snhusjitz'a t'a silab'il. Ix yak'anpax junjun nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'och silab'il yuj mul. Stzak'anilxo ix yak' silab' yik junk'olal heb', chawanh nok' toro, owanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, owanh nok' mam chiwa yet' pax owanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix yak' junjun heb'.

Masanil ofrenda ix yak' heb' yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan Israel, ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar, haton juntzanh tik: Lajchawe' k'e'en plato nab'a plata, lajchawe' uk'ab' nab'a plata yet' lajchawe' niwak cuchara nab'a oro.
Junjun plato chi' 130 siclo yalil, junjun uk'ab' 70 siclo yalil, yuj chi' a k'e'en plata chi' t'a smasanil, ay 2 mil 400 siclo yalil, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ay pax lajchawe' k'e'en niwak cuchara nab'a oro b'ut'an yuj incienso, 10 siclo yalil junjun, icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ha k'e'en oro t'a smasanil, ay 120 siclo k'e'en.

Ha sb'isul masanil nok' nok' ix nhusjitz'a silab'il chi', haton tik: Lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, lajchawanh nok' ch'ak kalnel, lajchawanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, aynhej ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet'ok yet' pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul.

Haxo pax nok' nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj junk'olal, 24 nok' toro t'a smasanil, 60 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 60 nok' mam chiwa yet' 60 nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Haton masanil juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix ak'chaji ayik ix ochkan yopisio altar ayik toxo ix ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ayik tz'och winhaj Moisés chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik slolon winh yet' Jehová chi', syab' wal winh slolon Jehová yet'ok t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín ayoch t'a yib'anh b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxail trato.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón to ayik ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al uke' candil winh, ha t'a yichanh sb'akhnub' candil chi' syak' yok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Aarón chi' sb'oanoch sk'ak'al juntzanh candil chi' yik syak'an yok t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha jun b'akhnub' candil chi' nab'a oro, tenb'il t'a k'e'en martillo, sb'at t'a yich masanto t'a sfloral t'a schon. Ix b'oji jun b'akhnub' candil chi' icha wal yechel ix sch'ox Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ik'kanel heb' levita t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal tik, tza sakb'itan heb' icha yalan ley.
Icha tik ol aj a sakb'itan heb': Tza tzikoch ha ha' t'a heb' yik sakb'ikan heb', sjoxjiel masanil xil sniwanil heb'. Slajwi chi', sjuk'an spichul heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikan heb'.
Elanhchamel tzik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax yet' junok echlab' ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' aceite tz'ak'ji ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax junokxo nok' kelem wakax silab'il yuj mul.
Tzalan t'a heb' levita to sja heb' smasanil t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, tza molb'anpax masanil heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha heb' levita chi' tz'och heb' t'a wichanh. Haxo ta' ol yak'k'e sk'ab' heb' eyetchonhab' t'a sjolom heb'.
Ha winhaj Aarón ol ak'anoch heb' levita chi' t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik yofrendaok heb' eyetisraelal chi'. Icha chi' ol aj skan heb' in yak'an serwil.

Slajwi chi', syak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' levita chi' t'a sjolom chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax chi'. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'a smasanil silab'il t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul heb'.
Slajwi chi' tzak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal yuj yak'jikan heb' t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol utok ik'ankanel heb' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Ayik toxo ix lajwi sakb'ikan heb' icha yalan ley yet' yak'jikanoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab', tzaxo yal sja heb' t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik smunlaji.
Haton heb' tik wik tz'ajkan t'a junelnhej t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin.

Yujto wik yaj masanil sb'ab'el winak yune' heb' ix eyetchonhab' tz'alji yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' tato winak nok'. Ayik ix in milancham masanil heb' b'ab'el unin t'a Egipto, hata' ix wak'kan masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok.
Yuj chi' a heb' levita tik tzin cha sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi' tiknaik.

Ha in ix in sik'kanel heb' levita tik t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik. Ix wak' heb' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh yik a heb' tzin ak'an serwil he k'exulok t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yuj wak'an tup he mul t'a eyib'anh. Ha heb' sja t'a wichanh he k'exulok yik max ex chami tato tzex ja t'a stz'ey in kajnub', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés, winhaj Aarón yet' masanil heb' israel masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' yuj heb' levita.
Ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' levita chi', ix sjuk'anel spichul heb', haxo winhaj Aarón ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a ofrendail. Ix yak'anpax silab' winh yik stupkanel smul heb'.

Ayik ix lajwi juntzanh chi' smasanil, ix och heb' levita chi' b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yik smunlaj heb' ta'. Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal skuchb'an heb'. Icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix aj sk'anab'ajan heb' sk'ulan yet' heb' levita chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ol och heb' levita t'a yopisio t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, ayik 25 ab'ilxo sk'inal heb'.
Haxo yik slajwi 50 ab'il sk'inal heb', tz'el heb' t'a yopisio t'a junelnhej.

Ayik sk'och sk'inal heb' t'a icha chi', syal skolwaj heb' yet' heb' smunlaj t'a mantiado chi', palta maxtzak munlaj heb' t'a smunlajel ichataxon ix sk'ulej. Icha chi' tzutej ak'anoch heb' levita t'a smunlajel, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yab'ilal yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, yik b'ab'el uj t'a yol schab'il ab'il, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí icha tik:
Al t'a heb' etchonhab' israel to syak'och k'inh heb' yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' t'a libre ichataxon sk'uhal to chekel yajkani.
Tzeyak'och jun k'inh chi' t'a jun k'u chi' ayik wanxo yem k'u, haton yik 14 yoch jun uj tik, tze k'anab'ajan masanil icha yajkan t'a sleyal, xchi t'a winh.
Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal to tz'och jun k'inh chi'.
Ix yak'och jun k'inh chi' heb' t'a yemk'uhalil t'a 14 yoch jun uj chi' t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak heb' winh, maj yal-laj yak'anoch k'inh heb' winh t'a jun k'uhal chi'. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón t'a jun k'u chi' yik sk'anb'an heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik ix ko yam jun chamnak, yuj chi' manh wach'ok kaj icha yalan ley. ¿Tokwal manh ol chajok kak' kofrenda t'a Jehová t'a jun k'u tik yet' masanil heb' ketchonhab'? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tanhwejek, ol wab' tas xchi Jehová eyu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal.

E masanil a ex tik yet' heb' eyinhtilal, yowalil tzeyak'och jun k'inh tik yik tze na'ankoti ayik wik'annak ex el t'a libre a in Jehová in tik. Ha mach manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley, yujto ix syam junok chamnak, ma heb' najat ayb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a,
ol xo yak'och k'inh heb' t'a 14 yoch schab'il uj t'a yemk'uhalil. Yowalil schi nok' silab' heb' yet' anh itaj k'a' yet' ixim pan malaj yich.
Malaj jab'okxo nok' skan yuj heb' t'a junxo k'uhal, max smak'poj sb'akil nok' heb'. Icha ix aj walani, icha wal chi' tz'aj eyak'anoch k'inh chi'.

Palta tato ay mach max ak'anoch jun k'inh chi', wach'chom wach' yaj icha yalan ley, mato manh ayokb'at t'a junok b'aj schek sb'a, manhxaokab' yalan yik t'a he kal, yujto maj yak' yofrenda t'ayin t'a jun k'u to chekel yajkan chi', skan smul chi' t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, snib'ej heb' syak'och jun k'inh chi' heyet'ok yik tzin yik'ancha'anh, yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' icha sleyal ix wala'. Ha ley ix wak' he k'anab'ajej chi', ha' sk'anab'ajej pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan chi' t'a he kal, xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a sk'uhal ayik ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová, syalelk'ochi haton Mantiado yik trato, ix och jun asun t'a yib'anh. Ayik ix emkan k'u, lajan ix aj yilji icha k'ak', masanto ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Ichanhej chi' ix aji. Aynhejoch jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi' a tzek' k'u, haxo t'ak'walil ichato ayoch sk'ak'al jun asun chi'.
Ayik sk'e wa'an jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh kajnub' chi', sb'eyb'at heb' israel chi'. Haxo b'aj tz'ochxi wa'an, hata' sb'oxik'e scampamento heb'.
Ha Jehová sch'oxan t'a heb' tato sb'eyb'at heb', mato tz'och wa'an heb'. Ha b'aj tz'och wa'an jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová, hata' skannhej heb'.
Tato niwan tiempo tz'och wa'an jun asun chi', sk'anab'ajej heb' t'a Jehová skan ta'.
Tato jun chab'nhej k'uhal tzek' jun asun chi' jun, icha chi' sk'ulejpax heb', slajwi chi' sb'eypaxb'at heb', icha tz'aj sch'oxan Jehová t'a heb'.
Ay b'aj junnhej ak'wal tzek' jun asun chi', haxo t'a k'inhib'alil sb'atxi, icha chi' tz'aj sb'eyxib'at heb'. Tato t'a k'uhalil ma t'ak'walil sb'at jun asun chi', sb'atpax heb'.
Tato skannhej wa'an jun asun chi' t'a yib'anh skajnub' Jehová chab'ok k'uhal, ma junok ujal, ma junok ab'il, hata' skannhej heb', max b'atlaj heb'. Tato sb'atxi jun asun chi', sb'atxi heb'.
Masanto ha' Jehová tz'alani, tz'och wa'an heb'. Hanheja' tz'alanpaxi, sb'atxi heb'. Ix sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' t'a Jehová, icha ix aj yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
B'ochajokab' chab'ok k'e'en trompeta nab'a plata, stenchaj t'a k'e'en martillo. Ha juntzanh k'e'en trompeta chi' spukhaji a tze molb'an heb' anima, ayik tzex b'eypaxb'ati.
Ha spuji chab' k'e'en trompeta chi', masanil chonhab' sja molan t'a ichanh b'aj ay in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a.
Palta tato junnhej k'e'en spuji, anhej heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makanhil inhtilal smolb'ej sb'a.
Tato junip syak' spuji k'e'en trompeta chi', sk'e wa'an campamento ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u b'aj ay in kajnub' syal chi'.
Haxo yik spukhaj k'e'en t'a schaelal sb'at heb' ayek' t'a stojolal sur. Yuj chi' a spukhaj k'e'en trompeta t'a icha chi', ch'oxnab'il yaji ayik sb'eyb'at heb' chonhab'.
Tato manh junipok syak' spukhaj k'e'en, syalelk'ochi to tonhej smolb'aj anima.
Ha mach spu'an k'e'en trompeta chi', haton heb' sacerdote yinhtil winhaj Aarón. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'ayex t'a masanil tiempo.

Tato ay heb' ajk'ol sjawi yak' owal t'ayex t'a yol he makb'en, tzex el eyak' owal chi' yet' heb', elanhchamel spukhaj k'e'en trompeta, yik tzex in nakot a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, tzex in kolanel t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Haxo t'a sk'uhal ay he tzalajk'olal, icha t'a sk'uhal k'inh, ma t'a yik tz'alji k'e'en uj, tze pu'an k'e'en trompeta chi' yik tzeyak'an silab' stz'ai, ma silab' yik junk'olal. Icha chi' tzex in nakoti. Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in tik swala', xchi t'a winh.
Ayik 20 yoch schab'il uj yik schab'il ab'il yelta chonhab' Israel t'a Egipto, ix k'e wa'an jun asun t'a yib'anh kajnub' yik trato.
Ichato chi' ix el heb' israel t'a tzinan lum yik Sinaí, k'ojank'olal ix b'eykot heb' masanto ix jawi heb' t'a tzinan lum yik Parán, yujto hata' ix och wa'an jun asun chi'.
Sb'ab'elalto sb'ey heb' tik t'a stzolal icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.
B'ab'el heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Judá. Ha winhaj Naasón yuninal winhaj Aminadab ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Haxo t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Isacar, hata' ayoch winhaj Natanael yuninal winhaj Zuar.
Ha winhaj Eliab yuninal winhaj Helón ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado yik yinhtilal Zabulón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xuyank'e wa'an skajnub' Jehová heb', haxo heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari ix ik'anb'ati, yujto a heb' ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'anb'eyok.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Rubén. Ha winhaj Elisur yuninal winhaj Sedeur ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Selumiel yuninal winhaj Zurisadai ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Simeón.
Ha winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Deuel ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Gad.
Tzak'anto skotpax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat. Ha heb' et'jinak masanil syamk'ab'il skajnub' Jehová. Haxo ix k'och heb', toxo ix b'ojik'e skajnub' Jehová chi'.
Ichato chi' ix kot heb' soldado et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Efraín. Ha winhaj Elisama yuninal winhaj Amiud ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Gamaliel yuninal winhaj Pedasur ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Manasés.
Ha winhaj Abidán yuninal winhaj Gedeoni ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Benjamín.

Slajwub'alxo masanil juntzanh soldado chi', ix kot heb' et'jinak sbandera yinhtilal Dan. Haton heb' stanhwan heb' chonhab' t'a spatik chi'. Ha winhaj Ahiezer yuninal winhaj Amisadai ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha winhaj Pagiel yuninal winhaj Ocrán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Aser.
Haxo winhaj Ahira yuninal winhaj Enán ayoch t'a yichanh heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Neftalí.
Icha chi' tz'aj stzolan sb'a heb' israel ayik sb'eyb'at heb'.

Ay jun k'uhal, ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a winh sb'aluch, haton winhaj Hobab yuninal winhaj Ragüel aj Madián, winh snhi' winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha onh tik wan ko b'at t'a jun lu'um ix yak' sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh. Konh ket'ok, wach' ol ach kila', yujto ix yak' sti' Jehová onh syailani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Hobab chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, a in tik ol in paxkan t'a in chonhab', b'aj ay masanil heb' in k'ab' wok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Manh onh aktejkani, yujto a ach tik ojtak yek' masanil juntzanh lugar b'aj wach' koch wa'an t'a tzinan lu'um tik, a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej.
Tato tzach b'at ket'ok, a tastak wach' ol yak' Jehová t'ayonh, ol kak'pax iko', xchi winh.
