Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', ma heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', nok' he wakax, nok' he chej, ma junokxo nok' he molb'etzal nok', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, palta masanil heb' syik' yip heyet'ok.
Naekkoti to ek'nakex chekab'wumal t'a Egipto. Ha inxo Jehová he Diosal in tik wik'nakexelta yet' in poder. Yuj chi' swala' to tze k'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, icha wal ix aj walan t'ayex, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, yik wach' ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanimail.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail.

Manh he nib'ejoch ix yetb'eyum junokxo mach, spat, slu'um, heb' winh schekab', heb' ix schekab', nok' swakax, nok' sb'uru, ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanimail chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová t'ayonh.

Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik te cha'anh ajnak yalanelta Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun ayoch sk'ak'al, ayik molan onh ek' ko masanil t'a yich lum witz chi'. Anhej wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik yalnak, ichato chi' stz'ib'anoch t'a chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en, yak'an t'ayin.

Palta a exxo tik, ayik eyab'an yoch jun jaj chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi', eyilan sk'e nhilnhon k'ak' t'a lum witz chi', masanil ex yajal heyaj t'a junjun eyinhtilal tik yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ex jawi eyal t'ayin icha tik:

Wal yel, a Jehová ko Diosal ix sch'ox wal stzikikial yet' yipalil t'ayonh, ix kab' wal slolon t'a skal k'ak'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix nachaj wal el ku'uj tob'an syal slolon Dios t'ayonh anima onh tik, palta ina maj onh chamlaj.
¿Tas yuj sko b'ek ko b'a ko cham yuj jun k'ak' to ayxo smay chi'? Tato ol kab' wal yoch sjaj Jehová ko Diosal junelxo, ol onh chamok.
Malaj wal junok anima syal yab'an yoch sjaj jun Dios pitzan t'a skal k'ak' icha ix kab' a onh tik, yujto ay schamelal.
Wach' a ach tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal chi' yik tzab'an masanil tas syala', slawi chi' tzalan t'ayonh masanil tas syal chi', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi t'ayin.
Ayik wan eyalan chi' t'ayin, wan pax yab'an Jehová tas tzeyal chi', yuj chi' yal t'ayin: Toxo ix wab' tas syal jun chonhab' tik, ix scha in k'ol tas ix yal heb'.
Komonok ichanhej tik spensar heb', aynhej welk'och t'a yol sat heb', sk'anab'ajannhej in cheknab'il heb' yik wach' ol aj sb'eynhejb'at heb' yet' heb' yuninal t'a smasanil tiempo.
Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to smeltzaj heb' t'a scampamento.

Ha hachxo tik, kananh wet' t'a tik, yujto ol wal masanil in cheknab'il t'ayach yet' in k'ayb'ub'al, ol a k'ayb'an heb' t'ay, yik wach' ol sb'eyb'alej heb' b'aj ay lum lum ol wak' chi' t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyik'el t'a he pensar.
B'eyb'alejek b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan Jehová ko Diosal, yik te wach'xonhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Haton wal juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al, cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tik ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex, yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej ayik ol eyik'an lum lum t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán.

k'anab'ajejek cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex yet' heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyi he chikin, yik wach' aynhej yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat ayik ayex ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tato icha chi', ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.

Yuj chi', ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek, ak'ek wal och t'a he k'ol he k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yik te wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, te niwan chonhab' ol aj he b'isul t'a sat lum lum yax sat chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, haton pax sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham.
Ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek wal: Anhej Jehová ko Diosal, malaj wal junokxo.
Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, t'a smasanil he pensar yet' t'a smasanil eyip.
Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex tiknaik, sik'ekkan t'a he pensar.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak'nhej sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Tzeyalan t'a heb' ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik wan he b'eyi, ayik tzex wayi yet' yik tzex k'e wa'an.
Tze tzek'anoch juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat ichok junok yechel yik tze na'ankoti.
Tze tz'ib'anpax och t'a yoyal sti' he pat yet' t'a spuertail smuroal he chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol ex ik'anb'at t'a jun lu'um yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ay wal niwak chonhab' manh jantakok swach'il t'a jun lu'um chi', manhok ex he b'onak.

Ay wal te' pat b'ut'an yuj tastak te wach', manhok ex he b'ut'nak. Ay ha' uk'b'ila' joyb'il, manhok ex eyab'nak sya'il he joyani. Ay te' uwa yet' te' olivo awab'il, manhok ex eyawejnak. Ha juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol eyab'lej masanto syal he b'ut'ji.
Ayik ol ujok juntzanh chi', b'at ta wal Jehová satk'olal eyu'uj. Naekkoti to a Jehová chi' ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ayex och chekab'ok.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat. Anhejokab' Jehová chi' tzeyak' serwil, anhejokab' sb'i tze loko' ayik tzeyak'an he ti' he k'ulan junok tas.
Manh ex och tzak'an t'a spatik sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil chi',
yujto skot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ayek' Jehová t'a ko kal, haxo talaj tz'aji, skot yowal sk'o'ol tzex sataneli, yujto max yal sk'ol skak'och ko pensar t'a junokxo ch'ok diosal.
Manh eyak' prowal Jehová ko Diosal, icha he k'ulejnak t'a Masah.
k'anab'ajejek wal sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, haton wal jantak scheknab'il ix yala'.
Wach'nhej tzeyutej he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová, yik wach'nhej tzex elk'ochi. Ol eyikej lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ajk'ol t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová, icha ix yutej yalani.
Tato sk'anb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'inh: ¿Tas yuj sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il yalnak Jehová ko Diosal? tato xchi heb'.
Tzeyalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik chekab' kaj t'a winh sreyal Egipto t'a peka', haxo Jehová ik'annak onh elta yet' jantak yipalil.
Ha onh tik kilnak wal juntzanh tastak satub'tak yilji yet'nak ya'elal yak'nakkot Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Egipto chi' yet' t'a masanil schonhab' chi'.
Onh yik'annakelta ta', onh yik'annakkot t'a tik t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Yuj chi' scheknak Jehová ko Diosal to yowalil sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik yuj ko na'ankoti, yik wach'nhej ko k'o'ol, wach'nhej ol aj yek' tiempo ku'uj icha kaj tiknaik.
Yuj chi', tato sko k'anab'ajej icha ajnak yalan Jehová chi', wach' onh t'a yol sat, xe cham t'a heb'.

Ayik ol ex yik'anb'at Jehová t'a sat lum lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'ayex, ha' ol ik'anel uke' nación te niwak, te ay yip t'a eyichanh, haton heb' hitita, heb' gergeseo, heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo.
Ayik ol yak'anoch juntzanh nación chi' Jehová t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satel heb' smasanil, manh he b'o he trato yet' heb', mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb'.
Manh eyak' yik'laj sb'a heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' winh yuninal heb'. Manh eyak'pax yik'laj sb'a heb' winh eyuninal yet' heb' ix yisil heb',
haxo talaj tz'aji, tz'ik'jib'at heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb' ix t'a spatik sdiosal, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, yuj chi' skot yowal sk'ol Jehová, tzex satjiel yuj t'a elanhchamel.
Tze satpaxel masanil sdiosal heb' b'aj slesalwi, yaltaril yet' k'e'en k'e'en yet' te te' yechel Asera b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal. Tze nhustz'a smasanil.
Ha onh tik schonhab' onh Jehová Dios, sik'b'il onh elta yuj t'a skal masanil juntzanh niwak nación t'a sat lum lum tik, yik wach' yiknhej Jehová chi' tzonh ajkani.
Ha wal Jehová ix el t'a sk'ol ix onh sik'aneli, manh yujok to niwan nación onh, ina to jaywanh onnhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación chi'.

Palta yujto xajan onh yuj yik wach' syak'elk'och sti' icha yutejnak yalan t'a heb' ko mam kicham, yuj chi' onh yik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok, onh yik'anelta yet' yipalil t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Egipto chi'.

Ojtakejekeli to a Jehová ko Diosal anhej wal Dios. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syal t'a heb' xajanani, haton heb' sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il. Aynhej och yet' heb' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal heb' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Syak'an spak t'a heb' schakaneli, elanhchamel satel heb' yuj.
Yuj chi', scham wal he k'anab'ajan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al swalkanel tik t'ayex.
Tato tze maklej wal eyab' masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak'elk'och strato Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak heyet'ok, ol ochnhej heyet'ok icha ajnak yalan t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ol ex sxajanej Jehová, ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh, ol yak'anpax k'ib' he b'isul. Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'ayex: T'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, he trigo, he wino, eyaceite, nok' he wakax yet' t'a yib'anh nok' he kalnel t'a sat lum lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a yichanh masanil juntzanhxo chonhab'. Malaj junok ix ix to malaj yune', ma junok winak to malaj yuninal t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Malaj pax junok nok' he molb'etzal nok' to manh ol unewok.
Ha Jehová ol ex kolanel t'a jantak ilya icha wal owal ilya heyilnak yek' t'a heb' aj Egipto. Anhej t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ol em ilya chi' yuj Jehová.

Yuj chi' yowalil tze satel masanil juntzanh nación chi'. Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb'. Manh eyak'em he b'a t'a sdiosal heb' yik manh ol ex yak' juwokel heb'.
Wach'chom tze na' icha tik: Ha juntzanh nación tik te ay yip t'a kichanh, ¿tas wal ol aj kik'anel t'a sat lum lum tik? wach'chom xe chi.
Palta manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima chi'. Naekkoti tas yutejnak heb' anima Jehová t'a Egipto yet' sreyal.

Ha onh tik kilnak wal juntzanh tastak satub'tak yilji yet'nak ya'elal yak'nakkot Jehová yet' wal yipalil t'a yib'anh Egipto chi' ayik yik'annak onh elta ta'. Icha chi' ol yutok juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tzex xiw chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anb'at jun niwan ya'elal t'a skal heb', masanto ol satel masanil heb' olto kanok yet' heb' olto sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ayex.
Yuj chi', manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayek' t'a ko kal, te niwan spoder.
Ha ol ik'anel juntzanh nación chi' t'a eyichanh t'a k'ojank'olal. Manh junnhejoklaj tiempo ol satel heb', yik wach' max te k'ib'cha'anh nok' chium nok' tzex chi'ani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' anima chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol och heb' t'a xiwk'olal masanto ol satel heb' eyu'uj.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch sreyal heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb', manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Malaj mach ol yal skolan sb'a t'ayex, masanil mach ol he sateli.

Tze nhustz'a sdiosal heb'. Manh eyik'el k'e'en plata ma k'e'en oro ayoch t'ay. Manh he nib'ejochi yik wach' max ex telwiel yuj. Manh eyixtejb'at he b'a, yujto a juntzanh chi' schakji yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi', malaj junok tas to yajb'ilel yuj Jehová tzeyik'b'at t'a he pat, yik wach' max ex sateli. Masanil juntzanh chi', aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' yowalil tze yajkaneli.
Scham wal he k'anab'ajan masanil cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, yik wach' ol ex elk'ochok, ol te k'ib' he b'isul, ol eyikejkan lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Naekkot sik'lab'il, 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a takinh lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ix yak'an ko ya'elal, onh yak'an prowal yik syila' tato sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, mato ma'ay.

Ix kil sya'elal yet' wejel yuj Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an maná ko waelok, juntzanh wa'el to manh kojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' ko mam kicham. Icha chi' ix onh yutej yik wach' skojtakejeli to manh yujoknhej tas waji ay ko k 'inal, palta to yuj masanil tas syal Jehová.
Ha ko pichul ix ko k'an t'a 40 ab'il chi', maj lajwiel-laj, maj malk'elaj kok ko b'eyi.
Naek wal to icha junok uninab'il skachji yuj smam, icha chi' ix onh yutejpax Jehová.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová, ochanhek tzak'an yuj, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal wan ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum lum manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay ha ha' ay sjaj yet' ha ha' skot t'a lum niwak witz.
Ha t'a lum lum chi', te wach' tz'aj ixim trigo, ixim cebada, te' uwa, te' higo, te' granado yet' te' olivo. Te ay pax nok' yal chab'.
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lu'um chi', manhxalaj tas tze na' yuj he wa'el yet' junokxo tasi. Ha t'a skal k'e'en k'e'en ay ta', ay k'e'en hierro, haxo t'a lum witz ay k'e'en cobre.
Wach' ol ex wa ta', yowalil ol eyak' yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach' lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tze yil wal he b'a, mokab' b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyu'uj. Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex.
Ayik wach' ol ex waok, ol eyuk'an ha', kajanexxopax t'a he pat te wach', haxo talaj tz'aji sb'at Jehová satk'olal eyu'uj.
Hanhejtona' ayik ol te k'ib' sb'isul nok' he wakax, nok' he kalnel, ayik te ayxo k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro t'ayex yet' jantakxo tastak,
haxo talaj tz'aji tzeyik'ancha'anh he b'a, sb'atkan Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyu'uj, haton jun ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok.
Ha Jehová chi' ix onh kuchb'an t'a jun niwan tzinan lum te ay smay, b'aj ay nok' chan te ow yet' nok' sina'an, b'aj malaj ha ha', palta a ix ik'anelta ha ha' t'a sat k'e'en k'e'en yik skuk'ani.
Ix yak'an maná ko wa t'a tzinan lu'um chi', jun wa'el to manh yojtakok heb' ko mam kicham. Ix yak'och ya'elal t'a kib'anh, ix onh yak'an prowal, yik wach' wach'xonhej tzonh elk'och yuj.
Ek'talaj t'a he pensar he na'an icha tik: Ha jantak ko b'eyumal tik, a yet' wal ko munlajel yet' kip ix kik'a', xe chi talaj.
Palta naek wal to a Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an he na' yet' eyip yik syal eyoch b'eyumal, yik wach' tz'elk'och strato yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam kicham ichaton wan kilan tiknaik.

Palta tato ol b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuj jun, tato ol ex och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios, ol eyak'anem he b'a t'ay yet' eyem nhojan ejmelal t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol he k'ulej, a in swalkan t'ayex tiknaik, ol ex satjokel yuj Jehová chi'.
Icha wal ol aj satel juntzanh chonhab' b'aj wan eyik'jib'at chi' yuj, icha wal chi' ol aj he satel yuj tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas syala'.
Ab'ek wal ex wetchonhab' Israel. Toxo ix k'och stiempoal yik tze k'axpitan ha' Jordán, yik tze satanel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te tek'an t'a eyichanh, te cha'anh yajk'e smuroal.
Ha heb' anima kajan ta', cha'anh ste'el heb', a winhaj Anac ay yinhtilal heb'. Ix eyab' yalji: ¿Mach wal junok syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac? xchi heb'.

Ojtakejekel tiknaik to a Jehová ko Diosal, a b'ab'el sb'at t'a eyichanh icha junok k'ak' satanel masanil tastak. Ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', yuj chi' ol he satnhejel heb', ol he pechanel heb' t'a elanhchamel, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ayik toxo ix yik'el masanil heb' anima chi' Jehová t'a eyichanh, manh he na' to yuj he wach'il, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aji. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ol ik'jokel heb' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová.

Manh yujok he wach'il, manh yujok pax swach'il he b'eyb'al yuj chi' ol ex k'och kajan t'a sat lu'um. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi', ol satjokkanel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' tz'elkank'och tas yalnak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob.
Ojtakejekel an to manh yujok he wach'il syak' jun lum manh jantakok swach'il chi' Jehová t'ayex yik tzeyikej, palta a ex tik junelnhej te pit ex.
Naekkoti, b'at talaj satk'olal eyu'uj to he tzuntzejnakkot yowal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a tzinan lu'um. Atax kelnakkot t'a Egipto masanto onh jawi t'a tik, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ay.
Ha t'a lum witz Horeb he tzuntzejnak wal kot yowal, yuj chi' snib'ejnak ex sateli.

Ayik in k'e t'a sjolom jun witz chi' yuj in cha'an chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il, haton strato Dios ket'ok, 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal ek'in ta', malaj jab'ok tas in wa''a, ma wuk'ej.

Slajwi chi', yak'an chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en chi' Jehová t'ayin. Ha wal Jehová chi' tz'ib'anoch scheknab'il chi' t'a k'e'en, juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak t'a jolom witz t'a kal k'ak' t'a jun k'u ayik molan onh ek' ta'.
Ayik slajwi yek'kanb'at 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal chi', yak'an chab' k'e'en yik trato chi' t'ayin.
Yalan icha tik: Emanhxi t'a elanhchamel, yujto a jun chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto toxo ix sjuel sb'a. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj tas ix wala', toxo ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' nab'a oro.
Toxo ix wila'' to te pit jun chonhab' tik.

Nitzel a b'a t'a wichanh, ol in satel juntzanh anima tik, manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb' t'a sat lu'um tik. Anhej t'a inhtilal ol in b'o junok niwan nación, te tek'an ol ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul t'a yichanh juntzanh anima tik, xchi Jehová.
Wemxita t'a jolom witz b'aj nhilnhon sk'e k'ak' chi', wet'nak chab' k'e'en yik trato chi'.
Haxo wemxuli, wilani to toxo ix och he mul t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal, yujto he b'o jun yechel wakax he diosalok. Jun wal rato eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik cheknab'il yal ko Diosal chi' t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', in pok'anem chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en chi' t'a eyichanh, spojb'at k'e'en.

Slajwi chi' wemxi nhojan t'a yichanh Jehová t'a 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal. Maj in wa jab'ok, maj wuk'ej jab'ok ha' eyu'uj, yuj chi' icha chi' in k'ulej, yujto te chuk he k'ulej, he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Te xiw in yujto kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sataneli. Palta jun, yab'to Jehová tas wal t'ay junelxo chi'.
Kotpax yowal t'a winh wuk'tak aj Aarón, jab'xonhej maj satjokel winh yuj. Palta tewi in yuj winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh.
Elanhchamel in mak'em weknaj jun yechel wakax b'aj och he mul chi'. Elanhchamel in yumb'at t'a kal k'ak'. Slajwi chi' in tenan pojok, in tzipankanb'at t'a yol ha ha' tz'emta t'a lum witz chi'.
Icha chi' he k'ulejpax t'a Tabera, t'a Masah yet' t'a Quibrot-hataava. Ha wal ta' he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Haton yik yalan Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a Cades-barnea to tzonh b'at kik' lum ix yak' t'ayonh. Hanhejtona' ta' he tenek' tas yal ko Diosal chi'. Maj eyak'ochlaj t'a he k'o'ol, maj he k'anab'ajej pax tas yala'.
Atax yik ex wojtakaneli woch ijan wilani to te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová.
Yujto maj he k'anab'ajej, yuj chi' yala' to ol ex satelok, yuj chi' em in nhojan t'a yichanh t'a 40 k'uhal yet' 40 ak'wal chi'.
Walan t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová, manh a satel jun a chonhab' tik. Ha ach ix a kolel yet' ipal, ix ik'anelta t'a Egipto yet' a poder.
Nakot tas alnakkan t'a heb' a chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ha spital juntzanh anima tik yet' smul heb' yet' schuk pensaril heb', manh a nakoti,

yik wach' max yal heb' anima b'aj ix onh ik'elta chi': Maj yal-laj yuj Jehová yik'ank'och jun chonhab' chi' t'a lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb', anhej to ix yik'b'at heb' yik b'at yak'ancham heb' t'a takinh lu'um yujto chakb'ilel heb' yuj, xcham heb'.
Ak' niwank'olal t'a jun chonhab'il anima tik, yujto a chonhab' yaji. Ha ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' a poder, xin chi t'ay.

Yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Tzak' b'ojok chab'ok pachanh k'e'en k'e'en, icha k'e'en ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal. Tzak' b'ojokpax junok te' kaxa, slajwi chi' tzach k'eta t'a jolom witz tik.
Ol in tz'ib'anxioch lolonel ayoch t'a k'e'en ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal, haton k'e'en ix a mak'pojok. Haxo k'e'en yik schaelal tik, ol em k'e'en t'a yol te' kaxa chi', xchi t'ayin.
Wak'an b'ojok jun te' kaxa chi', a te' acacia och t'a te'. Wak'an tzeychaj chab' k'e'en k'e'en chi', wik'ank'e k'e'en t'a jolom witz chi'.

Stz'ib'anxioch lajunhe' scheknab'il Jehová chi' t'a k'e'en. Icha aj stz'ib'an k'e'en t'a sb'ab'elal, haton juntzanh cheknab'il yal t'ayonh t'a skal k'ak' t'a jolom witz ayik molanonhek' t'a yich witz chi'. Yak'anxi k'e'en t'ayin.
Wemxita t'a jolom witz chi' b'i'an, wak'anem k'e'en t'a yol te' kaxa chi', icha aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin. Hata' kanxonhej k'e'en.
(Ix el heb' israel t'a ha' Beerot-bene-jaacán, ix jawi heb' t'a Mosera. Hata' ix cham winhaj Aarón, ix mukji winh ta'. Haxo winhaj Eleazar, winh yuninal winh ix ochkan sk'exulok sat sacerdoteal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix helxi heb', ix jawi heb' t'a Gudgoda. Ix helxi heb' ta', ix jawi heb' t'a Jotbata. Ha t'a jun lugar chi' te aynhej ha ha'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix ak'jioch yopisio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví yuj Jehová, yik syik'anb'at te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb', yik smunlajpax heb' t'a yichanh, yik syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová chi'. Ichaton chi' sk'ulejnhej heb'.
Yuj chi', a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví chi', maj schalaj smakb'en lu'um heb', yujto a Jehová icha smakb'en heb' yajkani, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.)
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', 40 k'uhal 40 ak'wal ayinek' t'a jolom witz chi', icha in k'ulej t'a sb'ab'elal. Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi' scha sk'ol Jehová yab'an tas swala', yuj chi' maj ex satjiel-laj yuj.
Yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, kuchb'ejb'at jun chonhab' chi', yik b'at scha'an lum lum heb' to ol yikej, haton lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, xchi t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, ex wetchonhab' Israel, ¿tas snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh? Haton tik snib'ej t'ayonh: Ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol ko sat, sko k'anab'ajani, sko xajanani yet' koch ejmelal t'ay t'a smasanil ko k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil ko pensar.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, wach'nhej ol onh elk'och t'a smasanil.
Scham wal he na'ani to a Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ay yik satcha'anh yet' t'a yichanhb'at satchanh chi'. A' ay pax yik lum lum tik yet' masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um.
Yujto xajan heb' ko mam kicham yuj, yuj chi' ix sik'jikanel yinhtilal heb' yuj, a onh toni, ix onh sik'jiel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' yuj icha kajkan tik.
Naeknhejkot jun trato sb'o Jehová heyet'ok, manhxo he pitej he b'a t'ay.

Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, ek'to t'a yib'anh juntzanh komon Dios, Yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' yajal, ayek' t'a yib'anh masanil tas, te ay spoder, sat ko k'o'ol yuj. Malaj sk'exanhil heb' anima t'ay. Max schalaj tumin yuj sch'olb'itani, max schapax silab' yik smontaji.
Tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' meb'a' yet' t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Xajanpax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a ko kal yuj, yuj chi' tz'ak'ji swa'el heb' yet' spichul heb' yuj.
Ichokab' ta' skutejpax ko b'a, yujto ch'ok chonhab'il ajnak onh ek' kajan t'a yol yik Egipto.
Anhejokab' Jehová ko Diosal niwan yelk'och t'a yol ko sat. Anhej t'ay tzonh och ejmelal, sko k'anab'ajannhej. Tato ay b'aj skak' ko ti' t'a junok tasi, anhejokab' t'a sb'i Jehová chi' skala'.
Kik'ekcha'anh Jehová ko Diosal. Ku'uj manh jantakok tas te satub'tak yilji ix sk'ulej icha wal ix aj kilani.
Ayik sk'ochnak heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, 70-nhej sb'isul heb', haxo tiknaik jun, a Jehová ix ak'an k'ib' ko b'isul icha sb'isul k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh.
Yowalil sko xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, sko k'anab'ajan tas schek ko k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, haton sk'ayb'ub'al, scheknab'il yet' skachnab'il.

Sko naek tiknaik tas ix yutej Jehová onh skachani. Ha onh tik ix kila', manhok heb' kuninal ix ilan tas ix sk'ulej Jehová chi'. Ha onh wal tik ix kila' jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' spoder yet' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej.
Kilnak tas sk'ulejnak Jehová t'a winh sreyal Egipto yet' t'a masanil heb' anima kajan ta'.

Kilnakpax tas sk'ulejnak yet' heb' soldado winh rey chi' yet' jantak carruaje yet'nak nok' chej. Masanil juntzanh chi' mukchajnakkanb'at yuj Jehová t'a yol ha' Chakchak Mar ayik onh spechan heb', yuj chi' a ko Diosal chi' satannakel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Sko naekpaxkoti jantak wach'il sk'ulejnak Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a tzinan lum masanto onh jawi t'a tik.

Sko na'anpaxkoti tas sk'ulejnak yet' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén. Spojnak sb'a lum lum t'a snanhal ko campamento, mukchajnakkanem heb' yet' masanil yuninal, masanil tas ay t'a heb', smantiado heb', schekab' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Icha chi' ajnak satel heb' yuj Jehová t'a kichanh.
Ha onh tik testigo onh t'a masanil tas sk'ulej Jehová to satub'tak yilji.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová swak'kan tik t'ayex, yik wach' tz'och wal eyip tzex b'at kajan t'a sat lum lum wan yoch eyikok chi',
yik wach' pax najtil ol ex kajnaj t'a lum lum te yax sat chi', haton lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'ayonh a onh yinhtilal onh heb' tik.
Ha lum wan yak'ji chi' t'ayex, manh lajanok lum icha lum Egipto b'aj onh koti. Ha t'a Egipto chi' slajwi eyawan tas tzeyawej, tzeyak'anoch yalil icha b'aj tz'awchaj anh itaj.
Ha pax lum b'aj wan he k'och chi' jun, ay switzal lu'um. Ay pax spanhanil lu'um, aynhejoch yal lu'um yuj nhab' syak' Jehová.
Ha jun lum chi' tanhwab'il lum yuj Jehová, aynhejoch sat t'a lu'um tzek' ab'il.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex. Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyak'em he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' smasanil he pensar.
Tato icha chi', ol yak'nhej b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub'xo, yuj chi' te wach' ol aj sat eyawb'en, he trigo, te' eyuwa yet' te' eyolivo.
Ay pax yax ank'ultak ol swa nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol ste ak'ej sat tas ol eyawej yik wach' ay he wa'el.
Palta tzeyil wal he b'a, yik malaj junok mach tzex montanb'ati yik tzeyik'anel he b'a t'a spatik Jehová, haxo talaj t'a juntzanhokxo komon Dios tzex och ejmelal, tzex och tzak'an yuj.

Tato icha chi', ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'ayex. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', manhxo ol yak'laj sat masanil eyawb'en, haxo he cham yuj wejel t'a sat lum lum te yax sat wan yak'an Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Scham wal eyab'ankan juntzanh lolonel tik, tze sik'ankan t'a he pensar. Tzek'ekoch t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak' sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Ayexnhejoch eyalan t'a heb', ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik tzex b'ey t'a yoltak b'e, ayik tzex wayi, ayik pax tzex k'e wa'an.
Tze tz'ib'anoch t'a smarcoal spuertail he pat yet' t'a spuertailtak he chonhab',

yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal yet' heb' eyuninal t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová ko Diosal yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ol ex kajnajnhej ta' yakb'an ayek' satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, tze xajananpax Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'ulan masanil tas syala',
ichato chi' b'i'an, a Jehová chi' ol ik'anel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te ay pax yip t'a eyichanh, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'ay.
Masanil lum b'aj ol ex ek'ok, heyik ol ajkan lu'um, sb'atnhej lum t'a takinh lu'um masanto sk'och t'a Líbano. Sb'atnhej lum t'a ha' niwan Éufrates masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.

Malaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'a t'a eyichanh. Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch niwak xiwk'olal t'a skal anima b'aj ol ex ek'nhej, manhxo ol yal sna'an heb' tas ol yutok skolan sb'a heb' t'ayex icha ix aj yak'an sti' Jehová chi' t'ayonh.
Ab'ek jun, ha t'a jun k'u tik swak' he sik'lej, tom a swach'k'olal Jehová tze nib'ej mato a skatab'.
Ol he cha swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal tato tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il wan walan tik t'ayex.

Ha yowal sk'ol ol kot t'a eyib'anh tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik, tato tzeyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, tzeyak'anoch he pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios to manh eyojtakok, tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, haton jun lum wan yak'an t'ayex, ol eyalanel wach' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Gerizim yet' katab' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Ebal.

Ha juntzanh lum witz chi', ha t'a yichanhek' niwan b'e ay lu'um, tzek' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, b'aj ay slu'um heb' cananeo, heb' anima ay t'a yak'likal sti' ha' niwan Jordán t'a yichanhb'at Gilgal. Jun b'aj ay te' ji t'a yol yik More.
Wanxo sk'och stiempoal yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tz'ochkan lum lum chi' eyikok yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ayik toxo ix eyik' lu'um, haxo he kajnaj t'a sat lum chi',
tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol he b'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex tiknaik.
Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tik yowalil ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ayexxoek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham eyikej.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a lum lum chi', ch'ok sdiosal heb' b'aj syal sb'a. Ayik toxo ix eyikejel lum slu'um heb' chi', yowalil tze satel juntzanh yik lesal b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal, wach'chom t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Tze mak'poj juntzanh yaltar heb', k'e'en k'e'en yet' te te' b'ob'il sdiosalok heb' skuchan Asera, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb'. Tze nhusantz'aok, tze mak'anpoj sdiosal heb' chi', yik wach' manhxa b'ak'inh snachajkot t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Manh ichok tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', manh ichokta tz'aj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová t'a skal eyinhtilal to yik yaji, hata' ol b'at eyak'em he b'a t'ay.

Ol eyak'an he silab' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ol eyak'anpax he diezmo, he kolwal yet' tas ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' eyofrenda to tz'el wal t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Hanheja' ol eyak'anpax nok' sb'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel.
Hata' ol ex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol he pat. Icha chi' ol aj he wa'an tas tzeyik' t'a he munlajel a to syal swach'k'olal Jehová ol yak' t'ayex.
Hata' manh ol he k'ulej icha tas sko k'ulej tiknaik, yujto ha t'a tik yalnhej tas snib'ej junjun anima, a sk'ulej.
Wal yel manto ex k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová t'ayex, hata' manhxalaj tas ol he na'a.

Wanxo sk'och sk'uhal yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tzex k'ochkan t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová eyikej. Ayik toxo ix ex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, manhxa xiwk'olal t'ayex ta'.

Haxo jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och yikok, hata' ol eyak' masanil tas ix wal t'ayex to ol he k'ulej. Hata' ol eyak' nok' silab' stz'ai yet' juntzanh silab' yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová chi', he diezmo, he kolwal yet' eyofrenda sik'b'ilel eyuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani.
Tzex te tzalaj t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' eyuninal, heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ol kajnaj t'a he kal. Yujto a heb' levita chi' malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha heyet'ok t'a lum lum chi'.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he komon nhusejtz'a nok' he silab' t'a yalnhej tas lugaril he gana.
Anhej t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a skal he chonhab' smasanil, hata' tzeyik'b'at he silab' yik tze nhusantz'aok yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik tze na'ank'e he chi'an nok' chib'ej, syal he milancham junok nok' eyiko' tze chi'an b'aj ayex ek' chi', hato syal tas syak' Jehová t'ayex. Wach'chom ayex wach' eyaji, icha yalan ley, mato ma'ay, syal he chi'ani, ichok tz'aj he chi'an junok nok' ch'ukul ma junok nok' k'ultakil chej.
Anhej wal schik'il nok' b'i'an, manh jab'ok syal he chi'ani, ma eyuk'ani, anhej to tze tob'kanem t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.

Max yal he wa''an sdiezmoal he trigo t'a yol he chonhab', ma sdiezmoal he wino, eyaceite, ma he chi'an nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel, ma eyofrenda tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma he kolwal, ma eyofrenda tz'och b'akhan t'a yichanh Jehová.

Anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal, hata' ol he chi' juntzanh silab' chi', ajun heb' eyal eyuninal heyet'ok yet' heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ayek' t'a he kal. Hata' tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tas syak' t'a he munlajel chi'.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a jun lu'um chi', mokab' b'at heb' levita satk'olal eyu'uj.
Ha wal yik ol lewanb'ok he lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a jantak yak'nak sti' yak'ani, tato syal he k'ol ol he chi nok' chib'ej, ol yal he chi'an nok' t'a yalnhej tas k'uhal.

Tato najat kajan ex t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi', syal he milancham nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel syak' Jehová chi' t'ayex b'aj kajan ex chi', tze chi'an nok' icha syal jantak snib'ej he k'o'ol, icha ix aj walan t'ayex.
Ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an yalnhej tas makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej, icha chi' tz'ajpax he chi'ani, tato wach' heyaj icha yalan ley, mato ma'ay, syalnhej he chi'an nok'.
Palta max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej max el-laj schik'il, yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej chi' yet' sk'inal.
Anhej to tze tob'kanel schik'il nok' chi' t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.
Manh he chi'a, manh eyuk'ej schik'il nok' nok' chi' yik wach'nhej ol ex ajelk'och yet' eyinhtilal yuj he k'anab'ajan Jehová.
Ha pax masanil tas to yikxo Dios yaj eyu'uj jun yet' tastak toxo ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, yowalil tzeyik'b'at t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová.

Ha t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová ko Diosal, hata' tzeyak' nok' he silab' to stz'a smasanil schib'ejal yet' schik'il nok'. Haxo pax junxo makan nok' he silab' jun, syal he chi'an schib'ejal nok', anhej wal schik'il nok' stob'chajkanoch t'a yich altar t'a yichanh Jehová.

Scham eyab'ani yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swal tik, yik wach' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'at yet' heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, tojol exnhej t'a yol sat.
Ayik ol satjokel masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová ko Diosal, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a sat slum heb' chi'.

Scham wal heyilani, manh ex b'at tzak'an t'a sb'eyb'al heb' icha tz'aj yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal. Manh he k'anb'ej tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', yik wach' manh ichokta tzeyutejpax he b'a.

Manh ichok syutej sb'a heb' chi', manh ichok chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi' chakb'ilel yuj. Ha juntzanh chi' haton sb'eyb'alej heb' anima chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ay pax b'aj snhustz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a sdiosal chi'.
k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Manh eyik'el jab'ok, manh eyak'paxoch stz'akub' juntzanh cheknab'il tik.

Tzeyil wal he b'a, talaj ay junok mach sk'e wa'an t'a he kal schekab' Dios yalani, tz'och ijan yalani to ay tas ma wayich syila', ma sch'oxanel t'a he kal tastak to satub'tak yilji, ma ayokto syalan yuj junok tas ol ujok,
tato k'okb'il tz'elk'och tas syal chi' tz'och ijan yalan t'ayex icha tik: Kotanhek, ay wal juntzanhxo Dios manh eyojtakok, b'at onh emek kuman t'a yichanh, tzonh ochek ejmelal t'ay, tato xchi t'ayex,
manh he cha eyab' juntzanh chi' t'ay. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, snib'ej syila' tato yel tze xajanej yet' smasanil he k'o'ol yet' smasanil he pensar.
Ochanhek tzak'an t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat, k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il, ab'ek tas syala', ochanhek ejmelal t'ay, junnhejokab' heyaj yet'ok.

Ha jun anima syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', mato syala' to ay tas syila', yowalil schami, yujto snib'ej tzex elkan t'a spatik Jehová. Snib'ej jun anima chi' tzex skuchb'ej yik tze pitej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Yuj chi' tze mak'cham jun anima chi', yik wach' satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay mach tzex kuchb'anb'at t'a elk'altak eyoch ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil, ma t'a najat, haton juntzanh b'aj max kal ko b'a, manh yalnakokpax sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, manh he cha eyab' t'ay. Hak'ekoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal yik schami. Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'ay, wach'chom eyuk'tak, ma eyuninal, ma eyisil, ma eyetb'eyum to xajanab'il eyu'uj, ma a junok te wach' eyak'an yet'ok, manh he k'ub'ejeli. Ha ex tze b'ab'laj ik'ejk'e k'e'en k'e'en tze julanchamok. Icha pax chi' syutej masanil heb' anima heyet'ok. Julk'enajokab' chamok, yujto snib'ej tzex yik'el t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Ol yab' jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol say mulan sb'a heb' icha juntzanh ix uji chi'.
Tato ha t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay, tzeyab' spekal to
ay heb' max k'anab'ajan Dios, haxo heb' skuchb'an sk'ulok heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi' yoch ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max kal ko b'a,
scham wal he k'anb'anek' eyab'i. Tato yel ay mach wan sk'ulan jun chukal chi' t'a he kal,
a masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xikjicham heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok', tze satanel masanil tastak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ha b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, hata' tze molb'ejoch masanil stastak heb', tzeyak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' chi' yet' masanil stastak heb' chi' silab'ok yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal. Ha jun chonhab' chi', skanxonhej icha chi'. Manhxa b'ak'inh sb'ojixik'ei.

Ha juntzanh tastak toxo ix alchaji to sateli, manh eyama', yik wach' max kot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan t'ayex tik, wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'ayex, ol yak'an k'ib' he b'isul icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha onh tik yuninal onhxo Jehová ko Diosal. Manh kak' echnaj ko niwanil, manh ko joxpaxel xil ko jolom t'a snanhal ko sat ayik scham junok anima,
yujto schonhab' Jehová ko Diosal kaji. Ha ix onh sik'anel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a sat lu'um tik, yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Manh he chi nok' nok' max chijilaj, nok' ay yowalil yuj Dios.
Haton nok' tik syal he chi'ani: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' chiwa,
nok' ch'ukul, masanil makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej yet' nok' kaltakte'al chiwa.
Syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' sjax yanh, cha xechanh yech.

Haxo pax nok' max yal-laj he chi'an jun, wach'chom sjax yanh nok' palta tato manh cha xechanhok yech nok', haton nok' tik: Nok' camello, nok' niwak chich yet' nok' tojolal chich. Ha juntzanh nok' tik manh wach'ok nok', sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxlaj yanh nok'. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'. Manh he chi nok', manh eyam nok' ayik chamnakxo nok'.
Haxo pax masanil nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', syal he chi'an nok' tato ay sk'axil nok' yet' stuminal spatik nok'.
Ha pax nok' malaj yik jun, manh he chi nok'. Yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'.
Ay pax nok' much syal he chi'ani, nok' wach' icha yalan ley.
Palta ay juntzanh nok' max yal-laj he chi'ani: Nok' ch'akb'a, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano,
yet' pax masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' avestruz, nok' niwak kujub', nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' tonton, nok' ibis yet' nok' pech,
nok' julum chay, nok' ostok, nok' kormorán,
nok' cigüeña, nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Masanil nok' kotak nok' ay sk'axil tzek' t'a juntak petanhil, manh wach'ok nok'. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Haxo pax nok' kotak nok' to ay sk'axil alb'ilxo to wach', syal he chi'an nok'.

Manh he chi' junok nok' tonhej scham t'a ichnhejta', yujto a onh tik sik'b'il onh el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Palta syal eyak'an nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal. Ha heb' chi' syal schi'an nok' heb'. Mato syalpax he chonhan nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal. Manh he tz'anh nok' yune' chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Junjun ab'il yowalil tzeyik'kanel sdiezmoal sat eyawb'en yet' tastak tze mol sat.

Tzeyik'anb'at sdiezmoal ixim he trigo, he wino yet' eyaceite. Tzeyik'anpaxb'at sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal b'aj ol aj skajnub'. Hata' ol he wa juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj eyik'ancha'anh.
Tato a jun lugar b'aj ay skajnub' chi', najat skan t'ayex, tato niwan swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'ayex, max yal eyik'anb'at masanil he diezmo chi',
syal he chonhaneli, haxo stojol tzeyik'b'at t'a skajnub' Jehová chi'.

Haxo yet' stojol chi' syal he manan tas syal he k'o'ol: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, wino, ma tas tz'uk'ji to pajxo, ma juntzanhxo tas tze nib'ej, tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal yet' eyal eyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha heb' levita kajan t'a he kal, tzeyawtej heb' wa'el heyet'ok, yujto manh ol yik'laj slu'um heb' smakb'enok icha heyik a ex tik.
Ha slajwi junjun yoxil ab'il tzeyik'ankanel sdiezmoal sat eyawb'en yet' tas tze mol t'a jun ab'il chi'. Tze molb'ej t'a junok lugar t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.

Ha heb' levita to maj schalaj slu'um smakb'enok heyet'ok, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, ma heb' meb'a' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, syal swa'an heb' tastak tze mol t'a he diezmo chi', tz'akan slaj yik' yik heb'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak tze k'ulej.
T'a yuktakil ab'il tzeyaktan he k'anan meltzaj he tastak ayb'at majanil.

Ha jun tik, icha tik yaji: Masanil mach to ay tas ix yak' majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manhxo'okab' sk'anb'ej, yujto a jun ab'il chi' ix yal Jehová to maxtzak yal-laj sk'anb'ajxi tas ayb'at majanil.
Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il syal he k'anb'anxi tas ix eyak' majanil chi'. Haxo pax t'a junok ketchonhab' jun, manhxo he k'anb'ej.
Tato ol he k'ulej icha chi', malaj mach ol b'at mheb'ail t'a yib'anh t'a he kal, yujto ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tato ol he k'anab'ajej he b'eyb'alan juntzanh cheknab'il wan walankan tik t'ayex,

ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti', tzijtum tas ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a juntzanhxo nación. Palta a ex tik, manhok exlaj ol he k'an tastak he majnej t'a heb'. Tzijtum juntzanh nación ol eyak' yajalil t'a yib'anh, palta manhoklaj heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh.
Tato ay junok heb' ketchonhab' tik meb'a' t'a he kal t'a junok chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová t'ayex, manh chukok tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb', palta tze kol heb' t'a tas tz'och yuj,
tze sian tastak t'a heb', tzeyak'an smajnej heb' tastak tz'och yuj.

Tzeya ilej he pensar, xe natalaj icha tik: Manhxo ol wak'laj tas majanil, ina to lak'anxo sjawi yukil ab'il, haton jun ab'il b'aj maxtzak k'anb'aj tastak ayb'at majanil, xe chitalaj. Max yal to chuk tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb' meb'a' ay t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', k'etalaj yaw heb' t'a Jehová yuj he chukk'olal chi', yuj chi' tz'och he mul t'a Jehová.
Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i tzex kolwaj t'a heb', b'ekanokab' yel eyu'uj, yujto a yuj tas wach' tze k'ulej chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Aynhej heb' meb'a' t'a he kal, yuj chi' a in swal t'ayex to elb'enokab' eyu'uj t'a heb' ketchonhab' wan yab'an sya'il mheb'ail t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.
Tato ay junok heb' ketisraelal, junok winak, ma junok ix ix schonhji t'ayex tz'och chekab'ok, wakenhej ab'il tz'och he chekab'ok, haxo t'a yukil ab'il jun, tzeyak'anel t'a libre.
Ayik tz'el t'a libre chi', max el-laj t'a ichnhej ta'.
Palta niwanokab' tas tzeyak' t'ay: Nok' kalnel yet' ixim trigo yet' wino. Syalelk'ochi to syik'pax yik t'a masanil tas ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyu'uj to onh ek'pax chekab'wumal t'a Egipto, palta a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta. Yuj chi' syak' jun cheknab'il tik t'ayex tiknaik.
Palta tato a junok heb' he chekab' chi' max yal-laj sk'ol tz'el t'a libre, yujto xajan ex yuj heb' yet' eyaleyuninal, yujto wach' yajek' heb' heyet'ok,

tato icha chi', tzeyik'kot junok k'e'en ol-lab' tzeyak'anoch chek'an heb' t'a spuertail he pat, tzeyolan schikin heb' yet' k'e'en. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan heb' he chekab'ok t'a junelnhej. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj heb' ix ix tz'ochkan chekab'ok t'a junelnhej.

Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i ayik tzeyak'anel heb' he chekab' chi' t'a libre, yujto wake' ab'il ix ex yak' serwil heb', nanhalnhej tze tup heb' t'a stojol junok mach tz'akan scha stojol t'a junok k'u. Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Masanil sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, ma nok' he kalnel, tato winak tze sik'kaneli yik tz'ochkan yikok Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyak' munlaj nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax chi', manh he joxpaxel xil nok' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel chi'.
Junjunnhej ab'il tze chi'an nok' yet' eyal eyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, t'a jun lugar ol sik'el skajnub'ok.
Palta tato ay jab'ok spaltail nok' jun, tato koxo yok nok', mato chuklaj yol sat nok', ma manh wal wach'ok nok', manh eyak' nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ha nok' chi', syal he chi'an nok' b'aj kajan ex chi'. Yalnhej mach syal schi'an nok', taxonhej wach' yaj heb', icha yalan ley, mato ma'ay, ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an nok' k'ultakil chej, ma nok' ch'ukul.
Palta manh he chi' schik'il nok', anhej to tze tob'el t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj stob'kanb'at ha ha'.

Ayik ayoch jun uj skuch Abib, hata' tzeyak'och k'inh yik tze wa'an ixim pan malaj yich yuj eyik'ancha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, yujto ha t'a jun ak'wal t'a jun uj chi' yik'nak onh elta Jehová t'a Egipto.
Ha t'a sk'uhal k'inh chi', hata' tzeyak' nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok.

Ha nok' nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok', tze wa'anpax ixim pan malaj yich, haton ixim tz'ak'an nachajkot ya'elal, yujto elanhchamelxonhej ajnak kelta t'a Egipto chi'. Yuj chi', masanil tiempo tze nanhejkot jun k'u yik kelnakkot t'a Egipto chi'.

Ha t'a uke' k'uhal chi', malajokab' jab'ok yich pan ayek' b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'. Yet' pax nok' chib'ej tzeyak' silab'il t'a yemk'uhalil t'a b'ab'el k'u, malaj jab'ok nok' skan t'a yik k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u.
Ha nok' he silab' yik k'inh chi', max yal-laj he milancham nok' t'a yalnhej tas chonhab'il ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Palta anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok, hata' tze milcham nok' t'a yemk'uhalil ayik wanxo sb'at k'u, haton t'a jun hora chi' elnak onh kot t'a Egipto.
Ha nok' chib'ej chi', tze b'ol nok', tze chi'an nok' t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal yik tz'och skajnub'ok. Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, tzex meltzaj b'ajtak kajan ex.

Ha t'a wake' k'uhal chi', anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa''a. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, tze molb'an he b'a yet' niwan tzalajk'olal yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok mach smunlaji.
Ayik tz'el yich sjochchaj ixim trigo, hata' schajiel yich sb'ischaj uke' semana.

Haxo slajwi uke' semana chi', tz'ochpax k'inh yik slajwi jochoj trigo, yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová. Tzeyak'an eyofrenda to tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, hato syal jantak swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal syak' t'ayex.

Tzeyak'och k'inh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok. Hata' tze molb'ej he b'a yet' heb' eyal eyuninal yet' pax heb' tik: Eb' he chekab', heb' levita kajan t'a he kal, heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum ayek' kajan t'a he kal.
Naekpaxkot a ex tik to chekab' ajnak ex ek' t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' tzeyil wal tas tz'aj he b'eyb'alan masanil tas syal jun cheknab'il tik.
Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' jochoj trigo chi' jun yet' yik toxo ix lajwi he pitz'anel yal sat eyuwa, tzeyak'anoch uke' k'uhal k'inh yik chinama.

Tzex tzalaj t'a jun k'inh chi' yet' heb' eyal eyuninal yet' pax heb' tik: Eb' he chekab', heb' levita, heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxalaj smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum ayek' kajan t'a he kal.

Ha jun k'inh chi', uke' k'uhal tzeyak'ochi yuj eyik'ancha'anh Jehová ko Diosal, t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok, yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh eyawb'en yet' t'a yib'anh he munlajel. Icha chi' ol aj eyek' t'a tzalajk'olal.

Masanil heb' winh winak, yowalil tz'och heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli, oxel tz'och heb' winh t'a yol ab'il, haton t'a oxe' k'inh tik: K'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich, k'inh yik slajwi jochoj trigo yet' k'inh chinama. Malaj junok mach sk'och t'a yichanh Jehová tato malaj yofrenda yet'nak,
palta junjun anima syik'b'at yofrenda, icha syal jantak swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal syak' t'ay.
Ol eyak'och heb' juez yet' heb' yajal t'a junjun chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'a junjun eyinhtilal, yik wach' a heb' ol b'oan yaj t'a stojolal tastak sk'e wa'an t'a he kal.

Mokab' sk'ex tojolal heb' t'a manh stojolalok. Mokab' ch'okch'okok heb' anima t'a yol sat heb', mokab' scha tumin heb' yik smontaj heb', yujto a k'e'en tumin yik montub'al chi' tz'ixtanel spensar heb' aj pensar. Hanhejtona' yuj k'e'en tumin chi' sk'ex slolonel heb' tojol.
Anhejokab' tojolal tze k'ulej, ayik ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Ayik tze b'oan altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal, manh eyak'em junok te te' yechel ix Dios skuchan Asera t'a stz'ey chi'.
Manh he b'opaxk'e chek'an junok k'e'en k'e'en yechel komon Dios Baal ta', yujto yajb'ilel juntzanh chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Manh eyak' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal tato ay spaltail sniwanil nok', yujto chuklaj t'a Jehová tato icha chi' sko k'ulej.

Tato ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, ol el spekal to ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max k'anab'ajan strato Jehová chi', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tz'och ejmelal, t'a k'u, t'a k'e'en uj, ma t'a k'e'en k'anal, haton juntzanh ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj koch ejmelal t'ay,
ayik tz'ab'chaj spekal chi', scham wal sb'eyk'olaji. Tato yel ix sk'ulej jun yajb'entak chi' jun anima chi',
yowalil tzeyik'el t'a stiel he chonhab' yik tze julk'enanchamok.
Palta max yal-laj yoch chamel t'a yib'anh jun anima chi' tato junnhej testigo. Yowalil ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha heb' testigo chi' sb'ab'laj julanoch k'e'en t'a jun anima chi'. Ichato chi' sjulanoch k'e'en masanil heb' anima t'ay. Icha chi' tz'aj yel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay junok tas tz'ak'ji he ch'olb'itej yaji, palta tato max nachajel eyu'uj tas tzeyutej he b'oan yaji, icha junok owal yik chamel, ma yuj junok mach slajwi, ma junokxo komon owal sk'e wa'an t'a he kal, tzex b'at t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal skajnub'ok,
tze mol alej yet' heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio. Ha heb' chi' tz'alani tas tz'aj sb'o'i.
Ha exxo tik tze k'anab'ajej tas tz'aj yalan heb' chi'.
Icha wal tz'aj yalchaj chi', icha chi' tze k'ulej. Malaj wal jab'ok tas tze k'exa'.

Palta tato ay mach tzek' t'a yib'anh, skomon b'oan t'a yol yiko', manh ichok ix aj yalan heb' sacerdote ay yopisio yuj Dios, mato max sk'anab'ajej pax tas ix yal winh juez, a jun chi' tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun pital tz'och t'a tas syal heb' yajal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' chonhab', ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Ayik ayexxo och t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ayik toxo ix eyak' ganar eyik'an lu'um, kajan exxo ta', talaj tze komon alej icha tik: Kak'ekoch junok ko reyal ol ak'an yajalil t'ayonh, icha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a ko lak'anil tik. Tato ol eyal icha chi',
a junok ketchonhab' ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol eyak'och he reyalok. Manhok junok ch'ok chonhab'il ol eyak'och he reyalok, yujto manh ketchonhab'ok.

Palta a jun rey chi', mokab' tzijtumok nok' schej smolb'ej, mokab' schekb'at heb' winak t'a Egipto yik sb'at heb' yik'kot jantakok nok' chej ta', yujto a Jehová alannakkani to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex b'atxi t'a Egipto chi'.
Mokab' tzijtumok tz'aj heb' ix yetb'eyum, yik max juwiel t'a yichanh Jehová yuj heb' ix. Mokab' ste molb'ej k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata.
Ayik tz'och jun rey chi' t'a yopisio, schek tz'ib'chajelta scopiail juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, haton juntzanh ayek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote yinhtilalkan Leví.

Yowalil yet'naknhej scopiail jun sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, sk'ayb'an t'a junjun k'u, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol sat, ay pax yelk'och jun k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a yol sat, sb'eyb'alan tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il tik.
Yik wach' max sna'paxi to niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab', max yik'el sb'a t'a juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová tik. Icha chi' ol aj snajtilax yopisio yet' yinhtilal t'a he kal.

Ha heb' sacerdote yinhtilalkan Leví yet' masanil heb' yetlevitail heb', malaj smakb'en lum heb' ol yik'a', icha juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal. Ha juntzanh silab' snhusjitz'a t'a Jehová ol schi heb', ma ol swa heb' yik ol ek' tiempo yuj heb'. Ha tas yik Jehová, a chi' yik heb'.
Manh ol scha slum heb' icha yik juntzanh heb' ketchonhab', yujto a tas yik Jehová, a ayoch smakb'enok heb', icha ajnak yalan Jehová.
Ha tas yiktaxon heb' sacerdote t'a nok' wakax yet' t'a nok' kalnel syak' heb' anima silab'il, haton juntzanh tik: Sjenhjab' nok', sb'ak'chil sti' nok' yet' spimal stzukutz nok'.
Yik pax heb' yaj ixim b'ab'el trigo, b'ab'el wino, b'ab'el aceite yet' nok' b'ab'el lana tz'el t'a nok' kalnel ayik sjoxchaj nok'.
Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix sik'anel heb' yinhtilal Leví t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo kinhtilal, yik syak' serwil Jehová heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tato ay junok levita t'a he kal, te ay snib'ej sb'at t'a jun lugar ix sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok yik b'at munlaj ta',
syal smunlaji. Lajan tz'aj icha heb' yetlevitail smunlaj ta',
scha'an swa'el icha yik heb' chi', wach'chom ay tas ay t'ay.
Ayik ayexxoek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' anima kajan ta'.
Malajokab' junok ex tze nhustz'a eyuninal silab'il. Malajokab' junok ex tzeyak' chum, ma tze na'anel tastak ol ujok, ma ajb'a'alil,
ma tze k'uman spixan heb' chamnak eyalani.

Yujto a masanil heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chukal chi', te aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh heb'. Yujto yuj juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' ol satjokel heb' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová chi'.
Yowalil te wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' ol eyikej chi', syak'och sk'o'ol heb' tas syal heb' ajchum yet' t'a heb' ajb'a'al. Ha exxo jun, max schalaj sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal tato icha chi' tze k'ulej.
Ha ko Diosal chi' ol sik'anel junok ketchonhab' tik schekab'ok, icha ix yutej in sik'anel a in tik. Yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej tas ol yala'.

Haton tik he k'annak t'a Jehová ko Diosal ayik ayonh ek' t'a lum witz Horeb, t'a jun k'u a molan onh ek' ta', eyalan icha tik: Manhxalaj ko gana skab' sjaj Jehová ko Diosal chi', ma kilan jun niwan k'ak' chi', yik wach' max onh chami, xe chi.
Yuj chi' yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach' tas ix yal heb' anima chi'.
Ol wik'cha'anh junok in chekab' t'a he kal icha ach tik, junok eyetchonhab'. A' in ol wak' yojtakejel tas ol yala', ol yalan t'ayex masanil tas ol wal chi'.
Ha mach max cha'an yab' tas ol in chek yal jun in chekab' chi', yowalil ol wak' yowalil t'ay, yujto a jun in chekab' chi' ol lolon in k'exulok.
Haxo pax mach syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, palta malaj tas swal t'ay, ma jun, schekab' junokxo komon Dios, a jun chi' yowalil schami, xchikan Jehová chi'.
Palta tato a ex tik ol he na'a: ¿Tas wal ol aj kojtakaneli tato manhok Jehová schekan yal jun chekab' chi'? tato xe chi.
Tato max elk'och tas syal jun syesejoch sb'a schekab'ok Jehová chi', snachajel eyu'uj to manhok Jehová tz'ak'an yala', anhej t'a yol yik snak'ei. Yuj chi' manh ex xiw t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix satel masanil juntzanh anima yuj Jehová ko Diosal, toxo ix eyikej schonhab' heb', slum heb' yet' spat heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chi' ol he sik'el oxeok chonhab' haton juntzanh ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikok.

Oxe' makan ol aj he pojan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhaltak yol junjun makan lu'um chi', hata' skan junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ol he b'oan sb'e'al juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik wach' yalnhej mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, syal sb'at skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Anhej mach smak'ancham junok anima, tato manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', hata' b'at skol sb'a, yik wach' max chami.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh sb'at k'atzitz, tato ay junok heb' winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab', swa k'e'en t'a junxo winh chi', scham winh, a winh tz'elta k'e'en sch'akab' chi' syal sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

K'inalok junnhej chonhab', najat sb'at sb'e'al, ay smay syamchaj winh yuj junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', smak'ancham winh chi' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, palta manh smojok scham winh, yujto toxonton manh yajk'olok sb'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze sik'kanel oxeok chonhab' b'aj syal skolan sb'a anima.

Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej juntzanh cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex, yujto tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak' lum lum chi' Jehová smasanil t'ayex, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik ol lewanb'ok lum he lu'um chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ol he sik'anel oxeokxo chonhab' stz'akub'ok oxe' chekelxo yaj chi', haton b'aj syal he kolan he b'a.
Icha chi' ol he k'ulej, yik wach' manh komonok ol cham junok anima malaj smul t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yuj heb' anima scham chi'.

K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' winh toxon yajk'ol sb'a, a junok winh smaklan yek' junxo winh chi' yik smak'ancham winh, ayik smak'ancham winh chi' winh, sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Tato icha chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil schonhab' winh ix cham chi', a heb' winh schekanb'at yamchaj winh ix sb'at skol sb'a chi' ta', tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a schonhab' yik tz'ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', yik smak'jipaxcham winh.
Manh eyak' niwank'olal jun anima chi', yik wach' max kan schamel junok anima malaj smul t'a eyib'anh, yik wach' ol aj eyelk'ochi.
Ha t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, manh he k'ex stz'akanhil he lum aykanem yuj he mam eyicham yik tze tok'an ek' yik junokxo mach ay yik t'a stitak eyiko'.
Tato junnhej testigo t'a spatik junok anima tz'och smul, max yal-laj yoch t'a yib'anh. Masanto ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och t'a yib'anh jun ay smul chi'.
K'inalok ay junok chuk spensar syik'cha'anh junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok mach yik syik'ankot t'a yib'anh.
Tato icha chi', yowalil tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová, haton t'a yichanh heb' sacerdote yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio.
Ha heb' ayoch yajalil chi', a heb' sch'olb'itani tato yel jun lolonel chi', mato es syik'cha'anh jun anima t'a spatik junxo chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun tz'esan chi', hata' tz'ochkan jantak tas ix snib'ej yak'och t'a yib'anh junxo anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwi jun esalwumal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' anima, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a junok esalwum chi'. Icha wal tas snib'ej t'a spatik yetanimail chi', icha chi' tz'utaji. Tato snib'ej to smak'jicham jun yetanimail chi', ma tz'ik'jielta yol sat, ma smak'jiel ye, ma xikjiel sk'ab', ma yok, icha wal snib'ej tz'utaj jun anima chi', icha chi' tz'utaji.

Ayik tzex b'at owal, manh ex xiw t'a heb' eyajk'o'ol chi. Wach'chom tzeyila' to ek'to sb'isul heb' t'ayex, niwanpax sb'isul nok' schej heb' yet' scarruaje heb' yik owal yet' soldado heb', manh ex xiwok yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ik'jinak onh elta t'a Egipto, ha' ol och heyet'ok.
Ayik manto k'och yorail yoch owal chi', a winh sacerdote tz'alan t'a heb' soldado icha tik:
Ab'ek ex wetchonhab', a tiknaik toxo ol eyak' owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol, manh ex xiwok. Manh ex ib'xokk'e yuj xiwelal,
yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok. Ha ol ak'an owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol chi', yuj chi' ol kak' ganar heb', xcham winh.

Slajwi chi', syalan heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: Tato ay junok ex toto ix he b'ok'e he pat, manto ex ochlaj t'a yo'ol, meltzajanhek, k'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach skajnajkan t'a yol he pat chi'.
Tato ay pax junok mach t'a ko kal tik ix yawej yuwa, manta jab'ok sat smolo', meltzajokab' t'a spat. K'inalok scham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach smolan sat yuwa chi'.
Tato ay junok ex ayxo he trato he nupnaji, palta manto ex nupnajok, meltzajanhek yik tzex nupnaji. K'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxopax mach snupnaj yet' ix ix chi', xcham heb'.
Slajwi chi' syalanpax heb' yajalil soldado chi': Tato ayex tzex xiwi, meltzajanhek t'a he pat, yik wach' malaj heb' schab'axk'e sk'o'ol eyu'uj, xcham heb'.
Ayik slajwi slolon masanil heb' yajal chi', tz'ak'jioch yopisio junjun kuchb'um t'a junjun makan heb' soldado.
Tato tzex k'och t'a spatiktak junok chonhab' yik tzeyak'an owal yet'ok, b'ab'el tzeyala': ¿E gana am junk'olal, mato owal? xe chi.
Tato a heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' snib'ej junk'olal, tzex scha'anoch heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi', yowalil tzeyak' pural heb' yochkan he chekab'ok.
Palta tato malaj snib'ej heb' yoch junk'olal heyet'ok jun, tato syal heb': Kak'ek owal, tato xchi heb', tzex oymaj t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi', tzeyak'an owal.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he xikancham masanil heb' winh winak.

Haxonhej heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', heyik tz'ajkani. Tzex tzalaj yet' masanil tastak ol scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal yik skan t'a yol he k'ab', haton masanil tas ol eyik' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ichanhej chi' ol he k'ulej yet' juntzanh nación najat ay b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.
Palta a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej, manhxa junok anima tzeyaktejkani.
Ol he satel juntzanh heb' tik: Eb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová.

Icha chi' tzeyutej heb', yik wach' max ex sk'ayb'ej heb' he b'eyb'alan juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej ayik syak'anem sb'a heb' t'a diosal. Tato tze k'ulej tas sk'ulej heb' chi', tz'och he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato niwan tiempo tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak junok chonhab', manh he ch'akel te te' sloji sat, yujto ol he lo sat te'. Ha te' awb'en te' chi', manh animaok te', max yal-laj skot te' t'ayex yak' owal heyet'ok.
Ha pax te' komon te' max loji sat jun, tze ch'akel te' yik tz'och te' he tek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', masanto satel jun chonhab' chi' eyu'uj.
Tato tz'ilchaj sniwanil junok anima t'a spatiktakel he chonhab' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej chi', manh chekelok mach ix mak'anchamok,
a heb' winh juez yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil jun chamnak chi', a heb' tz'echtani mach junok juntzanh chonhab' chi' lak'an ay b'aj ix cham jun anima chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi', a heb' winh tz'ik'anb'at junok nok' kob'es wakax manta b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'ay,
syik'anem nok' heb' winh t'a sch'olanil sti' junok ha' melem b'aj mantalaj mach smunlaji. Hata' smak'ji kanhchaj sjaj nok' wakax chi'.

Haxo heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'och testigoal t'ay, yujto anhej heb' sb'o'an yaj owal yet' tastak chukal tzuji t'a skal he chonhab', haton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayoch heb' yak'an serwil yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'.
Slajwi chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' sb'ikel sk'ab' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' kob'es wakax chamnakxo chi',
syalan juntzanh lolonel heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik, manhok onh ix ko mak'cham jun anima tik, manh kojtakok mach ix mak'anchamok.
Mamin Jehová, ak' niwank'olal t'a kib'anh, mokab' ak'kanoch schamel jun anima tik ko mulok a onh a chonhab' onh kolb'il onh tik u'uj, xcham heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj schamel jun chamnak chi'.
Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' t'a jun chamnak chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová.
Ayik tzeyak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'o'ol, tato tzeyak' ganar heb' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyik'ankot heb' he chekab'ok.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal tz'ilanoch junok ix ix te wach' yilji t'a skal heb', skan snib'ej t'a ix, syik'anb'at ix t'a spat,
hata' sjoxel xil sjolom ix, syik'anel yech ix,
sk'exchajel spichul ix ayochi ayik ix ik'jikot ix chi', skannhej ix t'a spat winh winak chi'. Jun ujal tz'ok' ix yuj smam snun. Slajwi chi', syik'an ix winh yetb'eyumok.
Tato slajwi chi', manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal yak'anel ix winh t'a libre. Palta max yal-laj schonhjiel ix, ma yoch ix schekab'ok winh, yujto toxo ix ixtaj ix yuj winh.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak chawanh yetb'eyum, jun ix te xajan yuj winh, haxo junxo ix chakb'ilel yuj winh. Tato tz'alji yune' heb' ix schawanhil, tato a jun ix chakb'ilel chi' sb'ab'laj alji yune',

ayik sk'och sk'uhal spojanek' stastak winh, syak'an winh t'a heb' yuninal, max yal-laj yoch yune' ix xajanab'il chi' b'ab'el uninal. K'inalok icha b'ab'el unin syutej winh, chuk sk'ulej winh t'a winh sb'ab'el unin yik ix chakb'ilel chi', yujto a winh chi' yel b'ab'el unin yaj winh.
Yowalil a winh chi' b'ab'el unin yaji. Ha winh scha'an cha makan smakb'en yik sb'ab'el uninab'il.
Tato ay mach ay junok yuninal te chuk, ma te pit, max sk'anab'ajej tas syal smam snun, wach'chom smak'ji, palta hanheja' max sk'anab'ajej.
Tato icha chi', a heb' mamab'il nunab'il chi', yowalil syik'b'at jun yune' heb' chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab',
syalan heb' icha tik: Ha wal jun kune' tik, te pit, te chuk. Max onh sk'anab'ajej, haxonhej chukal sk'ulej, te b'uk'tzin, anhej uk'el anh syak'a', xcham heb'.

Tato icha chi', haxo masanil heb' winh winak t'a jun chonhab' chi' sjulk'enancham jun yune' heb' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jiel jantak chukal ay t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, sxiwk'e heb'.
Tato ay junok winak smak'jicham yuj schukal, sk'e lokan t'a junok te te',

a sniwanil chi', max kanlaj ta' tzek' ak'wal, yowalil smukchaj t'a jun k'u chi', yik wach' max eyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, yujto aykot skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh mach sk'e lokan t'a junok te te' chi'.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyil satkan nok' swakax, ma skalnel junok heb' eyetchonhab', manh tonhejok tzeyilkan nok', palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi'.

Tato manhok t'a he lak'anil kajan jun ay yik nok' chi', mato manh eyojtakok mach ay yik nok', tzeyik'kot nok', wach'okab' tz'aj nok' t'a he pat chi' masanto sayjiek' nok' yuj winh yajal nok' chi', ichato chi' tzeyak'an meltzaj nok' t'a winh.
Icha pax chi' tze k'ulej yet' junok nok' b'uru, ma junok k'apak k'apak, ma junok yalnhej tas satb'ati. Tato ay junok ex tzeyila', mokab' tonhejok tzeyilkani.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyil stelwi nok' sb'uru, ma nok' swakax junok eyetchonhab' t'a yoltak b'e, mokab' tonhejok tzeyiloch heb', palta to tzex och yet' heb' eyik'ank'e wa'an nok'.

Ha heb' ix ix, max yal-laj sk'anan tastak sk'an heb' winh winak heb' ix, hanheja' heb' winh winak max yalpaxlaj yak'anoch spichul heb' ix ix heb' winh, yujto syajji mach icha chi' sk'ulej yuj Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato ay junok mach ex tzeyil junok so' nok' much t'a yol b'e t'a sk'ab' junok te te', mato sat lu'um ayemi, ayoch nok' snun chi' t'a yib'anh yune', ma t'a yib'anh snholob', manh eyik'b'at nok' snun chi' yet' yune' chi'.
Syal eyik'anb'at nok' yune' chi', haxo nok' snun chi' tzeyaktejkanb'at nok' yik wach' ol ex elk'ochok, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.
Tato ay junok ex tze b'ok'e junok he pat, panhan tz'aj yib'anh, tzeyak'ek' hoyan stitak t'a yib'anh chi' yik wach' malaj mach skot sutnajok, schami, yik max kot t'a eyib'anh.
Manh eyawej juntzanhokxo tas t'a skal b'aj awab'il eyuwa, talaj tz'ak'ji yowalil t'ayex, haxo tz'aji malaj junok makan schaji he lo sat.
Ayik tzex munlaj yet' arado, manh eyak'och te' yugo t'a junok nok' wakax yet' t'a junok nok' b'uru yik junnhej smunlaj nok' schawanhil.
Manh eyak'och pichul jalb'il t'a nok' lana yet' lino.
Tze b'o'och chanheok schional yelwanub'ok schikintak he xotil.
Tato ay junok winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix yetb'eyumok, haxo tz'aji maxtzak xajanej ix winh,
syalan winh to ay smul ix, sna'ank'e lolonel winh t'a spatik ix, syalan winh: Ix wik' jun ix ix tik, haxo ix in way yet' ix, ix wilani to manhxo kob'esoklaj ix, xchi winh.
Tato icha chi', haxo smam snun ix kob'es chi' tz'ik'anb'at yechel yik skob'esal ix t'a yichanh sdespacho heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab'.
Syalan winh smam ix chi' icha tik t'a heb' winh: Ix wak' ix wisil yetb'eyumok jun winh tik. Haxo tiknaik manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix,

tzijtum tas syal winh. Tob' ay smul ix. Syalan winh to manhxo kob'esok ix, palta ina wal sch'oxnab'il skob'esal ix tik, xchi winh smam ix chi'. Ayik wan yalan winh icha chi', sch'oxan jun sábana winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi'.
Haxo heb' winh syaman winh winak chi', smak'an winh heb' winh t'a nok' tz'u'um.

Slajwi chi' syak'an cien siclo k'e'en plata winh smultaok, yujto syesejk'e winh t'a spatik jun ix kob'es israel, syalan winh to ayxo smul ix. Ha jun tumin chi' tz'ak'ji t'a winh smam ix kob'es chi'. Manh yujok chi' maxtzak yik' ix winh, palta yowalil syik'nhej ix winh masanto chamel.
Palta tato yel a junok ix ix chi' manhxo kob'esok ix ayik ix nupnaj ix, malaj yechel t'a ix,

tz'ik'jiel ix t'a sti' spat smam, sjulk'enajcham ix yuj masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yak'och jun niwan mul ix t'a he kal, syak'anpax k'ixwelal smam ix. Icha chi' tz'aj satel juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum, tz'ilchajelta heb', scham heb' schawanhil, icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok ix kob'es ayxo strato snupnaji, haxo tz'aji ay junokxo winak tz'ixtan ix t'a yol junok chonhab',

tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh despacho t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' sjulk'enajcham heb' schawanhil. Scham ix yujto maj el yaw ix yik ay mach skolani. Schampax winh winak chi' yujto ix yixtej jun ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyumok jun winh yetwinakil winh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay junok ix ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyum, schalan sb'a ix yet' junok winh winak b'aj malaj anima, tz'ixtaj ix yuj winh, tato icha chi', anhej winh winak chi' schami yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh.
Haxo ix kob'es chi', malaj tas tz'alchaj t'a ix, yujto malaj smul ix, max yal-laj scham ix. Ha jun tas sk'ulej winh winak chi' lajan icha junok winh smak'cham junok yetanimail,
yujto sch'okoj ix ayek' b'aj malaj anima. Wach'chom tz'el yaw ix, palta malaj mach skolan ix.
Tato ay junok winh winak schalaj sb'a yet' junok ix kob'es mantalaj mach ay strato yet'ok, syak'an pural winh yixtan ix, tz'ilchajelta heb',
a winh winak chi' yowalil syak' 50 siclo k'e'en plata winh t'a winh smam ix, yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh. Yowalil syik'xonhej ix winh yetb'eyumok, masanto chamel.
Malajokab' junok mach tz'em ajmulal yet' ix yetb'eyum smam. Tato ay mach sk'ulan icha chi', malaj yelk'och smam t'a yol sat syal chi'.
Tato ay mach mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en, ma ik'b'ilel swinakil chi', max yal-laj yoch t'a skal heb' yetisraelal ayik molanek' heb' yik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Hanheja' junok mitz' unin, malaj pax yalan yik yoch t'a skal heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová. Hanhejtona' pax yinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh max yalpaxlaj yochi.
Ha heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita, junelnhej malaj yalan yik heb' yoch t'a skal b'aj molanek' heb' schonhab' Jehová, ma yinhtilal heb' t'a b'ak'inh.

Yujto ayik ix onh ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en heb', ayik ix onh elta t'a Egipto, maj yak'laj jab'ok ha' heb' kuk'ej, maj yak'paxlaj jab'ok ko wa'el heb'. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb' to ix stup winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor heb', ix kot winh t'a Petor t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, yik tzul onh skatab'ankan winh.

Haxo Jehová ko Diosal, maj schalaj yab' tas ix yal winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' a katab' ijan ix yalkan winh chi' t'a kib'anh, wach' lolonel ix aj yalankan winh, yujto te xajan onh yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' junelnhej malajokab' b'ak'inh tzex och t'a junk'olal yet' heb'. Manh he b'opax tas yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Palta haxo pax heb' edomita, manh he patikejkanel heb', yujto ayto kuj ko b'a yet' heb'. Manh he patikejpaxel heb' aj Egipto, yujto ek'nak onh kajan jun pekti' t'a yol smakb'en heb'.
Hato heb' yixchikin heb' ayxo yalan yik yoch t'a ko kal b'aj sko molb'ej ko b'a yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Ayik tzex b'at t'a owal yet' heb' eyajk'o'ol, ayik ayex ek' ta', manh he k'ulej tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Tato ay junok winh winak tz'el yinhatil ayik waynak, yowalil tz'elkan winh t'a spatiktak campamento tzek' k'u.
Haxo t'a yemk'uhalil, wach' syutej winh sb'ikanel sb'a, haxo yik sk'ik'b'i, tz'ochxikan winh t'a yol campamento chi'.
Yowalil junnhej junok b'aj t'a spatikel campamento b'aj tzex tzaji.
Ayik tzex b'at tzajel, tzeyik'b'at junok te te' t'a yol he pa, pach yaj snhi' te', tze joy junok olan, tzex tzajiem t'a yo'ol. Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ankank'e lum lum t'a yib'anh.

Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ajun heyet'ok, yiknhej yaj jun campamento chi'. Ha tzex tanhwani, skolwajpax heyet'ok yik tzeyak'an ganar heb' eyajk'ol chi'. Max yal-laj to ay tas chuklaj ay t'a he kal chi', talaj tz'el Jehová chi' t'a he kal yuj jun chi'.
Tato ay junok chekab' tz'el elelal t'a spatrón, snib'ej tz'aj heyet'ok, manh eyak' meltzaj t'a spatrón chi'.
Kanokab' heyet'ok. Libre sik'lan junok chonhab' b'aj snib'ej tz'aji. Malajokab' mach stzuntzani.
Malajokab' junok winh winak, ma junok ix ix t'a ko kal syak'och sb'a ajmulal yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha k'e'en tumin syak' ganar junok ix ix, ma junok winh winak t'a spatik yajmulal, manh he cha yak' k'e'en heb' b'aj syak' sti' yak'an t'a Jehová, yujto a jun b'eyb'al chi' te chakb'ilel yuj.
Ayik tzeyak'an k'e'en tumin majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'an yune' k'e'en, ma yalnhej tastak, manh he k'an smajananub'al.

Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal syal he k'anan smajananub'al junok tas tzeyak' smajnej. Haxo t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'ana', yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej chi'.
Ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, elanhchamel tze k'anab'ajej, yujto ol sk'anb'ej Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tato max eyak'a' tz'och he mul.
Tato malaj b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová chi' jun, malaj b'aj syal yoch he mul.
Tato ay b'aj tzeyak' he ti' eyak'an jun, yowalil tzeyak'elk'ochi, icha wal tas tz'el t'a he k'o'ol.
Ayik tzex och t'a skal smunlajel junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he loan sat yuwa icha jantak snib'ej he k'ol he loani, palta max yal-laj eyik'anb'at jab'ok t'a yol he pa.
Tato tzex och t'a skal strigo junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he k'utzanelta ixim sjolom he k'uxu', palta max yal-laj tze jochelta ixim yet' k'e'en jochlab' trigo yik tzeyik'anb'ati.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik'laj sb'a yet' junok ix ix, haxo tzek' jab'ok tiempo, ay tas syab' winh t'a spatik ix, manhxalaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal spukan sb'a heb', palta yowalil syak' yumal yik puklajb'ail winh t'a ix, slajwi chi' tz'elta ix t'a yol spat winh chi'.
Ayik toxo ix spuk sb'a ix yet' winh, syal yik'an junokxo winak ix.
Palta tato a junxo winh syik' ix chi' schami, mato tonhej manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syak'anpax yumal yik puklajb'ail winh t'a ix, spechanelta ix winh t'a yol spat,
maxtzak yal-laj yik'an ix winh b'ab'el yetb'eyum chi', yujto manh wach'ok tato syik'xi ix winh. Chukxo t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal. Yuj chi' manh eyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' eyikej.

Tato ay junok winh winak toto ix och yetb'eyum, max yal-laj sb'at winh t'a owal. Max yalpaxlaj yoch winh t'a junok opisio. Jun ab'il libre tz'ajkan winh t'a spat yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smajnan tumin t'ayex, manh he k'anek' smolino, ma scha' yuj smajananub'alok. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ichato tzeyamoch wa'an swa'i.
Tato tz'ab'chaji to ay junok winh israel tz'elk'anb'at junok yetchonhab' yik tz'och schekab'ok, ma yik schonhaneli, yowalil scham jun winh elk'um anima chi', tz'el jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay mach b'aj spitzwicha'anh jun yab'il skuchan lepra, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sleyal jun yab'il chi', icha tz'aj yalan heb' sacerdote, haton juntzanh ix walkan t'ayex.
Naekkoti tas sk'ulejnak ix María t'a yol b'e yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayik kelnakkot t'a Egipto.
Tato ay k'e'en tumin tzeyak' smajnej junok eyetanimail, manh ex och t'a yol spat tzeyik'anelta junok tas yik skan smajananub'alok k'e'en.
Palta to tzex kan t'a sti' spat, tze tanhwan yik'kanelta tas ol yak' smajananub'alok k'e'en chi' t'ayex.
Tato te meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix eyak' k'e'en tumin chi' majanil, tato a sk'apak aykan smajananub'alok k'e'en, manh eyamkan wanaj t'ay yik tzek' ak'wal.

Ayik sk'ik'b'i tzeyak'an meltzajok, k'inalok malaj tas sk'uej tzek' ak'wal. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej, a jun anima chi' ol yal wach' lolonel t'a eyib'anh, wach' pax tzex kan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal.
Manh eyixtej heb' meb'a' smunlaj t'ayex, heb' eyetchonhab', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze tup heb' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Tze tup heb' he majan t'a junjun yemk'uhalil, yujto yowalil sman heb' tas swa t'a jun k'u chi'. Tato ma'ay, syal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo yoch he mul t'a Jehová chi'.
Max yal-laj scham heb' mamab'il nunab'il yuj smul yuninal. Hanheja' heb' uninab'il chi', max yalpaxlaj scham heb' yuj smul smam snun chi'.
Manh he k'ulej tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ma t'a heb' manhxa smam. Manh he k'anek' sk'apak heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum yuj smajananub'alok junok tas smajnej.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyu'uj to ek'nak onh chekab'ok t'a Egipto, haxo Jehová ko Diosal onh ik'anelta ta'. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik.

Tato ayik wan he jochan ixim he trigo, sat he k'o'ol skan junok manoja ixim t'a he patik, manhxo ex meltzaj eyik'kot ixim. Kanokab' ixim ta', yik a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' heb' manhxa smam, ma heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, a heb' ol ek' sik'an ixim, yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh yet' masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Ayik tze b'ixan sat te' eyolivo yet' te eyuwa, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molanel sat te' t'a sk'ab'. Ha te' skan chi', manhxo ex meltzaj he molel te'. Yikxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yaji.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyu'uj to a ex tik ek'nak ex chekab'ok t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.
Tato ay chawanhok anima syak' owal, yowalil sb'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, yik sb'o yaj yowal heb' chi'.
Tato a winh ay smul chi' smoj smak'ji, syalan winh juez to tzek' jichan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh. Smak'ji winh ay smul chi' icha jantak smul chi'.
Ayik smak'ji winh chi', max yal-laj yek' t'a yib'anh 40 tz'u'um tz'och t'a winh. Tato tzek' t'a yib'anh, manhxalaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat anima syab'i.
Manh eyak'och spail sti' nok' nok' stek'wi trigo.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak yuk'tak sb'a, junnhej patil b'aj ay heb' winh, haxo tz'aji scham junok winh, mantalaj yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum. Ha ix yetb'eyum winh chi', max yal-laj yik'an junokxo ch'ok winakil ix. Palta a winh yuk'tak winh yetb'eyum ix ix cham chi', a winh tz'ik'anxikan ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajan sleyal winh yuj ix smu' chi'.
Ha sb'ab'el unin heb' sjawi, a sb'i winh yetb'eyum ix chamnak chi' tz'och t'ay, yik wach' max satel sb'i winh t'a skal ko chonhab'.

Palta tato malaj snib'ej winh syik' ix smu' chi' jun, syal sb'at ix t'a yichanh heb' juez yet' t'a yichanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', syalan ix icha tik: Ha winh in mu' malaj snib'ej winh sb'inajkan winh yuk'tak t'a skal ko chonhab'. Max stak'laj winh wik'an in b'a yet'ok icha t'a sleyal, tato xchi ix.
Slajwi chi' tz'awtaj winh yuj heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh. Tato max yal sk'ol winh syik' ix smu' chi',

sk'och ix t'a stz'ey winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', syik'anel junok xanhab' winh ix, stzub'anpax och ix t'a sat winh, syalan ix: Icha tik tz'utaj heb' winh malaj snib'ej syak'kan b'inaj yuk'tak, xcham ix.
Yuj chi', a tz'aj sb'inaj yinhtilal winh smu' ix chi' t'a skal ko chonhab', “yinhtil winh ik'b'ilel xanhab'”, xcham heb' anima.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak wan yak'an owal, sjawi ix yetb'eyum junok winh yik skolan winh yetb'eyum ix chi' sna'ani, tato a swinakil winh wan smak'lan sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum ix chi' syamchaj yuj ix, stok'ankot winh ix,
tato icha chi', manhxalaj niwank'olal, xikjiel sk'ab' ix.
Manh he k'an echlab' manh tz'akanok ayik tzex chonhwaji, ma ayik tzex manwaji,
palta to a wal echlab' tz'akan, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
yujto malaj snib'ej ko Diosal chi' t'a heb' max b'eyb'alan tojolal.
Naekkoti, tas onh yutej heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Amalec ayik ayonhek' t'a yoltak b'e ayik toxo onh elta t'a Egipto.
