Tze na'anpaxkoti to malaj jab'ok xiwk'olal heb' t'a Dios. Ha heb' ketisraelal najat tzak'anto skot ku'uj yuj k'unb'elal, ix laj miljikancham heb' yuj heb' aj Amalec chi'.

Yuj chi' ayik ol ex koljokel yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a heb' ajk'ol oyanoch t'a spatiktak lum lum ol ak'jok eyikej chi', yowalil tze satel heb' yinhtil Amalec chi', manhxo ol b'inaj heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a junelnhej. Mokab' b'at satk'olal jun cheknab'il tik eyu'uj.
Ayik kajan exxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
ayik tze molan b'ab'el sat eyawb'en t'a lu'um, tzeyik'anb'at t'a yol junok mo'och t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok.

Hata' tzex k'och t'a yichanh heb' winh ayoch sacerdoteal t'a jun pekti' chi', tzeyalan icha tik: Ha tiknaik, skal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal to kajan onhxo t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Haxo junok winh sacerdote scha'anek' jun mo'och tzeyik'b'at chi', syak'anoch winh t'a yichanh altar.

Slajwi chi' tzeyalan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Ha heb' ko mam kicham, arameo heb', jaywannhej sb'ey heb' yek'nak heb'. Ha yek'nak heb' chi', tonhej sb'eyek' heb' t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' snok'. Ijan chamnak heb' yuj wejel, yuj chi' b'atnak heb' t'a Egipto yet' jaywanh yuninal. Hata' ochnak heb' chonhab'il, manhxo jantakok ajnak sb'isul heb', te ay smay heb'.
Palta te ilb'ajk'ol utajnak heb' yuj heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yilnak wal sya'elal heb' ayik yak'jinakoch heb' t'a munlajel te ya.

Yuj chi', yalnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham to skolwaj yet' heb'. Yab'nak Jehová chi' tas yalnak heb', yilannakpax munlajel te ya b'aj ayoch heb' chi'. Ilb'ajk'ol utajnak heb' b'aj ayoch chekab'wumal.
Sch'oxannak spoder Dios to ayxo smay yilji, ayik yik'annak elta heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Satub'tak yilji tas sch'oxnak, laj xiwnak heb' aj Egipto chi' yuj.
Onh yik'ankot t'a sat jun lum lum te yax sat tik.

Yuj chi' jun, tik skik'kot b'ab'el sat kawb'en t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, xe chi. Slajwi eyalan juntzanh lolonel chi', tzeyak'anoch te' mo'och chi' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, tzex em kuman t'a yichanh.
Slajwi chi' tzex tzalaj wal yet' eyal eyuninal yuj masanil tas ix yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tzeyawtan kot heb' levita yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Ha t'a junjun yoxil ab'il, tzeyak'an sdiezmoal masanil tas tzeyik' t'a tastak tzeyawej. Tzeyak'an t'a heb' levita, t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' t'a heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' t'a he kal.

Junjunex tzeyal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Toxo ix wik'kanel t'a in pat masanil tas to ik yaji, haton t'a tas ix wik' t'a in munlajel t'a sat lum lum tik. Toxo ix wik'paxel yik heb' levita yet' yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a ko kal, heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Toxo ix in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala', malaj junok a cheknab'il tik sb'at satk'olal wu'uj. Malaj junok to max in k'anab'ajej.

Malaj wal jab'ok juntzanh chi' ix in wa t'a sk'uhal ayik ayin och t'a kusk'olal yuj chamel yet' t'a sk'uhal manh wach'ok waj icha yalan ley. Maj waltejoch t'a heb' chamnak. Ix in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala'.

Ilonhemta t'a satcha'anh, t'a lugar to ik yaji, ak' a wach'k'olal t'a kib'anh a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik yet' t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ix ak' t'ayonh b'aj kajan onh tik, icha ajnak ak'an a ti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix halan masanil juntzanh cheknab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej yet' he b'eyb'alani. Tze k'anab'ajej t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar.
Toxo ix eyal tiknaik to a Jehová he Diosal yaji. Ix eyak'an he ti' he k'anab'ajani, he b'eyb'alan scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il.
Haxo pax Jehová tz'alani to a onh israel onh tik, schonhab'onhxo icha ajnak yalankani, yuj chi' yowalil sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a niwak chonhab'il, ol ex b'inaj t'a wach'il, niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación sb'onak. Schonhab' ex paxi, sik'b'ilexpaxel yuj, icha ix aj yalani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix halan juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil heb' chonhab': Ha tiknaik, ol he k'anab'ajej masanil tas skalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán yik ol ex och t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, tze b'okank'e juntzanh k'e'en niwak k'e'en t'a yich lum witz Ebal, tzeyak'anoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a k'e'en. Tze tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swalkan tik t'ayex t'a k'e'en. Tze k'ulej jun tik ayik ayexxoek' ta'.

Tze b'oanpaxk'e junok altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ha k'e'en k'e'en tzeyak'och chi' t'ay, manh he mak'poj k'e'en, manh he tzeypax tojolb'ok k'e'en. Ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' tze nhustz'a silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Tzeyak'anpax silab' sch'oxan he junk'olal yet' ko Diosal chi'. Hata' tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

B'at ta satk'olal eyuj he tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex t'a juntzanh k'e'en b'aj ol eyak'och k'e'en ta'anh chi'. Te wach' tzeyutej he tz'ib'ankanochi yik chekel, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Moisés, ajun heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví yet'nak winh, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, numan tzex aji, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha tiknaik toxo onh och wal schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová swalkanel tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'u chi' ix yalpax jun cheknab'il tik winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi':
Ayik toxo ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, a heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, Leví, Judá, Isacar, José yet' Benjamín, tz'aj heb' t'a yich witz Gerizim, yik syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Gad, Aser, Zabulón, Dan yet' Neftalí, tz'aj heb' t'a yich lum witz Ebal yik syalan katab' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Leví, te cha'anh syal juntzanh lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal icha tik:

katab'il mach sb'o'an junok yechel komon Dios t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, syak'anoch t'a junok lugar k'ub'eltak yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay. Ha juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach malaj yelk'och smam snun t'a yol sat, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach sk'exan stz'akanhil slu'um yik stok'ek' slu'um junokxo mach, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach tz'ak'an musansatil junok anima max ujilaj yilani, haxo t'a ch'ok b'eal schekkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.

katab'il mach sk'ulan tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, t'a heb' unin manhxa smam, ma t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, yujto a mach sk'ulan icha chi', syak' k'ixwelal smam chi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' nok' nok', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' schab'il yanab', yanab' yuj smam ma yuj snun, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix snhi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail t'a elk'altak, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach scha'an tumin yik smak'ancham junok anima malaj smul, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach max k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
Tato yel tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal swalkan tik t'ayex, te niwan ol aj eyelk'och yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hanhejtona' tato tze k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal, ol he chapax masanil juntzanh yaxilal ol wal tik:
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, t'a yib'anh yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas ol eyak'em t'a yol he mo'och yet' t'a yib'anh tas tze wa''a.
Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh b'ajtak tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch heb' eyajk'ol t'a yol he k'ab' ayik ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok. T'a stzolal ol aj skot heb' t'ayex, palta sakleminak ol aj yel heb' elelal t'ayex.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' te tzalajk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová chi', tze b'eyb'alani, ol ex yalnhejoch schonhab'ok to sik'b'ilex el yuj, icha ajnak yalani.
Haxo heb' anima t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to sik'b'il ex el yuj Jehová, ol xiw heb' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol ex xajananok: Tzijtum ol aj eyuninal yet' yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', jantak ol aj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayex.

Ol yak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik t'a stiempoal, icha jantak tz'och yopisio. Te wach'xonhej ol aj he munlajel. Masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ol te k'ib'cha'anh, masanto ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a tzijtumok nación. Ha exxo pax tik, malaj tas ol he k'an he majnej t'a junokxo mach.

Tato ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, haton masanil juntzanh swalkan t'ayex tiknaik, sat ol ex aj t'a heb' ch'ok nacional chi', haxo heb' spatiktak ol ajkan heb'. Niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj b'aj ol ex ak'jok ganar yuj heb'.
Icha chi' ol ex ajok, tato max eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik scheknab'il Jehová, tato max ex och tzak'an t'a spatik komon Dios, yik tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex, ol ja wal juntzanh katab' tik t'a eyib'anh:
Te chuk heyik t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Syalelk'ochi to malaj tas ol eyik' t'a he munlajel chi', malaj pax tas ol he wa''a.
Ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, malaj swach'il ol aj sat eyawb'en. Manh ol k'ib' yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel, yune' nok' he chiwa yet' masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Chuk heyik b'ajtaknhej tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ol yak'kot ya'elal Jehová yet' ilk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Toxonhej ol ex somchajel t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej. Elanhchamel ol ex satel yuj chukal tze k'ulej yuj eyaktankan Jehová chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot juntzanh ilya te ow t'a eyib'anh, masanto ol ex satel t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.

Ol yak'paxkot yab'il yab'il Jehová chi' to ol ex cham yuj, k'ak'al ilya te chuk yet' he malk'ei. Haxo eyawb'en ol takjokelok. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', takinh ol aj smasanil. Ol och tz'aub' t'a he munlajel masanto ol yal he sateli.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol kot t'a satcha'anh. Manhxo ol yak'laj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum chi'.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol yak'a'. Haxonhej lum pokok yet' k'e'en arena ol em yuj Jehová ko Diosal, masanto ol ex satelok.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'o'ol. T'a stzolal ol aj he b'at t'a owal, haxo ol ajok, sakleminak ol aj eyel t'a heb'. Ol sat sk'o'ol masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol ex ik'anok.
Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol chianb'at he niwanil. Manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan nok' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová ol ak'an k'ab'at he niwanil yuj mal yab'il, icha wal ajnak heb' aj Egipto. Ol k'epax kisk'oy t'ayex yet' yaxk'a yet' k'ilaj yab'il, manhxalaj yanhal juntzanh ilya chi'.
Ol ex kistalaxok, ol somchajel he k'o'ol, manhxo ol yal-laj heyilani.

Toxonhej ol ex ek' machmon t'a chimk'uhalil, icha tz'aj yek' machmon heb' max ujitaxon yilani. Haxo t'a masanil tas ol he k'ulej, manhxalaj tas ol elk'och t'a wach'il. Ol ex te ixtaxelok. Ilb'ajk'olxonhej ol ex ajok. Manhxalaj mach ol ex kolanok.
Ha mach ol sb'o strato snupnaj yet' junok ix ix, ch'okxo mach ol way yet' ix. Ol he b'ok'e junok he pat, palta manhxo ol ex kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Ol eyawej junok eyuwa, palta manhxo ol he lo sat.

T'a wal eyichanh ol smilcham nok' he wakax heb' ajk'o'ol, palta manh ol he chi' jab'ok schib'ejal nok'. T'a eyichanh ol yik'b'at nok' he b'uru heb', manhxo ol yak' meltzaj nok' heb' t'ayex. Ol yik'b'at nok' he kalnel heb', manhxalaj mach ol yal skolankan nok' t'a heb'.
Eyichanh wal ol b'atkan heb' eyuninal yet' heb' ix eyisil t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex k'unb'ok he maklan sjax heb', palta manhxa jab'ok tas syal eyu'uj.
Ha heb' anima manh eyojtakok, a heb' ol satanel masanil sat eyawb'en yet' jantak he munlajel. Ol ex ixtaj wal, ob'iltakxonhej ol ex ajok.
Ayik ol eyilan masanil juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol ex kistalaxkanok.
Ol yak' wal kot ya'elal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom he penek, t'a he xub' yet' t'a masanil he niwanil. Manhxo ol anhtaj jun ilya chi' eyu'uj.

Ol ex ik'jokb'at yuj Jehová chi' yet' he reyal sik'b'iloch eyu'uj t'a junok nación to manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' he mam eyicham. Hata' ol eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Ol sat sk'ol juntzanhxo nación yab'an tas ol ex utajok. Ol aljok he pekal, ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ol ex yik'b'at Jehová chi'.
Te niwan inhat ol eyawej, palta jab'nhej sat ol he molo', anhej nok' k'ulub' ol k'uxanb'atok.
Ol eyawej eyuwa, ol he mesani, palta manh ol he b'ixlaj sat, malaj wino ol eyuk'ej, anhej nok' yaxtaj ol lajanelok.
Ay te' olivo t'a sat he lu'um, palta malaj yaceiteal te' ol he k'ana' yujto tonhej ol k'ajb'anel sat te'.
Ay eyuninal, ay eyisil, palta manh ol ajlaj heb' heyet'ok, yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación.
Masanil te te' syak' sat t'a he chonhab', pilan ol lajwokel te' yuj nok' k'ulub'.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, niwanxo ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a eyichanh, a exxo tik, manhxalaj ol aj eyelk'ochi yujto ol ex lajwokemok.
Ha heb' chi', ay tas ol yal yak'an heb' majanil, palta a exxo tik, manhxalaj tas t'ayex. Ha heb' sat ol aj t'ayex, a exxo tik spatiktakil ol ex ajkanok.
Masanil juntzanh ya'elal tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh. Ol eyab'xonhej sya'il masanto ol yal he sateli, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal ix yak' t'ayex.
Ha juntzanh ya'elal tik sch'oxkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'ayex yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto maj eyak'em he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol ayik ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh,

yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ajk'o'ol ol yak'kot t'ayex, ol eyab' sya'il wejel, takinhtial, manh pichulal yet' masanil ya'elal. Ol eyab' wal sya'il yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol chi' masanto ol yal he sateli.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nación te najat b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a heb' ol yik'kot Jehová t'ayex, yelk'olal ol aj skot heb' icha sjenhwi nok' ch'akb'a. Ch'ok ti'al syal heb', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Te owal anima heb'. Malaj yelk'och heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin t'a heb'.

Ol schib'at yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' heb', ol sloanb'at sat eyawb'en te' heb', masanto ol ex ixtajwal. Manhxalaj he trigo, he wino, eyaceite, ma yune' nok' he wakax yet' yune' nok' he kalnel ol to kan yuj heb', anhej to ol ex cham yuj wejel.

Ol och hoyan heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatiktak he chonhab'. Ol jawok heb' t'ayex masanto ol yal yem lanhnaj smuroal he chonhab' cha'anh yajk'ei yet' b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado ayoch yipok he k'o'ol. Masanil juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ol laj yoymitej heb'.

Ayik ol laj oymaj heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a he chonhab' chi', haxo yuj wejel ol he chianb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal. Wach'chom ay junok winak t'a he kal te wach' syutej sb'a, palta yuj wejel chi' ol schib'at yuninal. Manh ol yak' jab'ok t'a yuk'tak, t'a ix yetb'eyum to xajan yuj yet' t'a juntzanhxo yuninal olto kanok.

Wach'chom ay junok ix ix manh komonok syutej sb'a t'a he kal, te b'eyum ix, malaj b'aj tz'em yok ix t'a sat lu'um, aynhejoch xanhab' ix, palta yujto manhxa tas swa ix yuj b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'ol t'a spatiktak he chonhab' chi', ol schib'at yune' ix toto tz'alji yet' smoj yune' chi'. Manh ol yak' jab'ok ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, ma t'a juntzanhxo yune'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal te wach', te ay smay, palta tato malaj yelk'och t'ayex, manh ol he b'eyb'alejpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik,
ol yak' wal kot niwak ya'elal ko Diosal chi' t'a eyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh eyinhtilal. Ha wal ilya te chuk ol yak' t'a eyib'anh to manhxalaj yanhal.
Ol kot wal juntzanh ilya t'a eyib'anh, icha wal juntzanh ilya ik'annak heb' aj Egipto, haton juntzanh b'aj te xiwnak ex. Manhxo ol el-laj juntzanh ya'elal chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ayto juntzanhxo ya'elal max b'inajlaj t'a juntzanh slolonel Dios tik ol jawok t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sateli.
Ha ex wal tik ex wetisraelal, te niwanxo he b'isul, lajan exxo icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh, palta ol ex satelok. Manhxo niwanok ol ajkan he b'isul, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal.

Icha ix aj stzalaj sk'ol sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ix yak'an k'ib' ko b'isul, icha pax chi' ol aj stzalaj sk'ol yuj he sateli. Elanhchamel ol aj ex yik'anxiel t'a lum lum b'aj toxo ol ex kajnaj tik.

Ha ex olto ex kanok, a Jehová ol ex saklemankanb'at b'ajtak slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hata' ol ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton komon Dios b'aj max eyak'em he b'a, manh yak'nakokpaxem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'ay.

Ayik ayex ek' t'a juntzanh nación chi', manh ol eyik' jab'ok eyip, malaj jab'ok tas b'aj ay eyalan eyiko'. Yujto t'a xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' yuj Jehová ta', kuseltakxonhej ol aj yilji he sat yuj ilk'olal.
Xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a masanil tiempo yuj he chamel. Ol ex te xiw t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil.
Ol ex te xiw wal sik'lab'il yuj juntzanh te ay smay ol heyila'. Ha t'a k'inhib'alil ol eyala': Tzok wal k'ik'b'i, xe chama. Haxo t'ak'walil ol eyalanxi: Tzok sakb'i, xe chama.

Wach'chom ix yal Jehová to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex meltzaj t'a Egipto, palta a ol ex ak'anxib'at ta' t'a yol barco. Hata' ol he chonhoch he b'a schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi', palta manhxalaj mach ol ex mananok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.

Ha juntzanh lolonel yik trato ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol smakb'en Moab. Stz'akub' sb'a juntzanh tik yet' trato ix sb'o Jehová yet' heb' t'a lum witz Horeb.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik, heyilnak wal tas utajnak winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' masanil smakb'en Egipto chi' yuj Jehová.
Testigo heyaj t'a juntzanh ya'elal yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová chi'.
Palta masanto tiknaik maxto yak'laj eyojtakejeli tas syalelk'och juntzanh chi'.
40 ab'il ix ex in kuchb'ej t'a takinh lu'um. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', maj lajwokel-laj he pichul, maj lajwokel-laj he xanhab'.
Maj he walaj ixim pan, maj eyuk'laj wino, ma yal sat te' awb'en te' pajb'inak, yik wach' snachajel eyu'uj to a Jehová haton ko Diosal.
Ayik ix onh jawi t'a jun lugar tik, ix elta winhaj Sehón sreyal Hesbón yak' owal ket'ok yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán, palta ix kak' ganar heb'.
Ix kik'ankan slu'um heb', ix kak'an t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan jun trato tik, yik wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'och t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej.
Ha tiknaik, tik wal molan onh ek' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal. Masanil heb' yajal t'a eyinhtilal, heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', heb' ay yopisio yet' masanil heb' ketisraelal:
Eb' winh winak, heb' unin, heb' ix ix yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a ko kal, haton heb' k'atzitzwum yet' heb' kuchum ha',
molan onh ek'i yik wach' sko chakan strato Jehová ko Diosal b'aj syak'kan sti' t'ayonh.

Ha wal tiknaik scheklajkaneli to tzonh ochkan schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal, haxo tz'ochkan ko Diosalok, icha yutejnak yak'an sti' t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, haton heb' ko mam kicham.
Manhoknhej ket' a onh molan onh ek' tik sb'o jun trato tik Jehová chi',
palta yet' pax heb' kinhtilal toto ol aljok.
Ha ex tik eyojtak wal sik'lab'il tas wal aj kek'nak t'a Egipto yet' tas ajnak ko k'axpajek'ta t'a yol smakb'en juntzanh nación t'a yoltak b'e.
Hata' kilnak juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh yechel nab'a te', nab'a k'e'en, nab'a plata yet' nab'a oro, te chuklaj sk'ulej juntzanh anima chi', ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Komonok malaj junok anima t'a ko kal tik, winak, ma ix, ma junok yinhtilal heb' ketchonhab' tz'aktankan Jehová ko Diosal, haxo t'a sdiosal juntzanh nación chi' tz'och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' sk'ulej, lajan icha junok yib' te' swolani, a swol chi' te k'a', scham anima yuj.

Tato ay junok mach t'a ko kal tik te nhikan syutej sb'a sna'ani, slajwi yab'an tas tz'ajkan jun trato tik, syalan icha tik: Wach'chom tzin pitej in b'a tzin k'ulan masanil tas snib'ej in k'o'ol, palta malaj tas ol in ik'anok, tato xchi, ol kot ya'elal t'a kib'anh ko masanil wach'chom wach' onh, ma chuk onh.

Yuj chi' manhxo ol ak'joklaj niwank'olal jun anima chi' yuj Jehová, a yowal sk'ol ol jawok t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'. Ha masanil juntzanh ya'elal tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, ha' ol kot t'a yib'anh, ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal t'a sat lum lum tik yuj Jehová.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ik'anel jun anima chi' t'a skal masanil yinhtilal heb' ketisraelal, ol yak'anoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' masanil ya'elal sb'inaj t'a trato b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan masanil ley, ol kot t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'.
Ha heb' eyinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh yet' juntzanhxo anima ch'ok chonhab'il ol kot t'a najat, ol yil wal ya'elal heb' yet' ilya ol yak'kot Jehová t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ol yil heb' to a lum lum chi' tz'anak lu'um smasanil, anhej k'e'en azufre yet' atz'am atz'am ay t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol yal yawchaj t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol k'ib' t'a lu'um, wach'chom anh ank'ultak manhxo ol k'ib'laj anh. Icha wal ajnak satel juntzanh chonhab' yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová, haton Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma yet' Zeboim, icha wal chi' ol aj lum he lu'um tik.
Yuj chi', masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol sk'anb'ej heb': ¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix yutej jun chonhab' chi' Jehová? ¿Tas yuj ix te kot wal yowal sk'ol t'a heb'? xcham heb' anima chi'.

Haxo ol laj spakan juntzanhxo heb': Icha chi' ix aj jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yaktejkan strato Jehová heb', haton trato sb'onak Jehová chi' yet' heb' smam yicham heb', ayik yik'jinakelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max yak'taxonem sb'a heb', manhok Jehová ix halan t'a heb' to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', ix kot masanil juntzanh katab' tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a strato t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix yik'el jun chonhab' chi' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, ix yak'ankanb'at heb' t'a skaltak juntzanhxo nación, ichaton wan yuji tiknaik, xcham heb' ol pakan jun lolonel chi'.

Ay wal tas manh kojtakok, a juntzanh chi', yik Jehová ko Diosal yaji. Palta ay tas ak'b'il kojtakejel yet' heb' kuninal, haton masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik yet' kachnab'il yik sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo.

Ayik ol ujok masanil juntzanh tas ix wal tik t'ayex, haton swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax skatab' yuj he patikaneli, palta tato ol sna sb'a he k'ol ayik ayexxo ek' t'a masanil nación b'aj ol ex yak'kanb'ati,
tato yet' smasanil he k'o'ol yet' pax smasanil he pensar tze k'anab'ajan yet' heb' eyuninal icha wal tz'aj walankan tik t'ayex,
ol sk'ex spensar ko Diosal chi', ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal t'ayex. Ol ok'pax sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex smolb'anxikot b'aj ix ex saklemkanb'at chi'.
Wach'chom ex saklemkanb'ati, ix laj ex k'ochkan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hato ta' ol ex yik'xikot Jehová ko Diosal chi'.
Ol ex smolb'anpax b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' ko mam kicham. Hata' ol ex ajxok. Ek'b'al niwan ol aj he b'eyumal yet' he b'isul yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh heb' ko mam kicham chi'.
Ol yak'och yechel strato Jehová t'a he pensar yet' t'a spensar heb' eyinhtilal yik ol he xajanej t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar yik wach' ol ex ajok.
Haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'anb'at masanil katab' tik t'a yib'anh heb' ajk'ol ix chichonoch sk'ol t'ayex, heb' ex ixtani.
Ha exxo tik, ol ex meltzajxok t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.

Yuj chi', te b'eyum ol ex ajxok yuj Jehová chi', ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tastak tze k'ulej, t'a yib'anh eyuninal yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' t'a he munlajel. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas syal Jehová, masanil scheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, tato t'a smasanil he k'o'ol yet' t'a smasanil he pensar tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab', ol tzalaj sk'ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha juntzanh cheknab'il swak' eyojtakejel tik, manh ajaltakok ko k'anab'ajani, manh najatok ayel t'a ko tz'ey.

Manhok t'a satchanh ay, yik wach' max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach wal syal sk'ek'och t'a satcha'anh yik sb'at yik'anemta jun cheknab'il tik, syak'an kojtakejeli, yik wach' sko b'eyb'alej? max yal eyalan icha chi'.

Hanhejtona', manhokpax t'a sk'axepal ha' mar ay, yik max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach syal sk'axpajek' t'a ha' mar chi', yik sb'at yik'ankot t'ayonh, syak'an kojtakaneli sko b'eyb'alani? max yal eyalan icha chi'.
Okxo jun, a jun cheknab'il tik ayek' t'a ko kal, skalub'tanhej, aypaxoch t'a ko pensar, yik wach' sko k'anab'ajej.
Ha tiknaik, tik wal swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej: ¿Am k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato ha' katab' yet' chamel?

Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex, tze xajanan Jehová ko Diosal, tzex ochnhej tzak'an yuj, tze k'anab'ajan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, wach' ol ex ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul eyuninal. Ichato chi' ol yak'an syaxil Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a sat lum lum b'aj wan eyoch tik yik tze makb'enej.
Tato max he cha eyab' juntzanh tik jun, palta to tze b'ek he b'a he montajb'at t'a spatik komon Dios, tzex em kuman t'ay,
tato icha chi', wal t'a jun rato tik swalkan t'ayex to ol ex chamok. Manhxo ol najtilax he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej chi' ayik ol ex k'axpajkanek' t'a ha' Jordán.

Wal t'a jun k'u tik swak'kanoch satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik testigoal to swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej, am he k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato a katab' yet' chamel. Palta sik'lejek he k 'inal, yik wach'nhej tzex aj yet' heb' eyinhtilal.

Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajej, manh eyaktejkani, yuj chi' ol he cha he k 'inal, najtil ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel icha tik:
Ayxo 120 ab'il in k 'inal, manhxa wal wip in b'eyek' ex in kuchb'ej, hanhejtona' toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to manhxo ol in k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán tik.

Palta a Jehová ol b'ab'lajnhej t'a eyichanh, ol satanel masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' b'aj ol ex k'och chi'. Ha exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a slum heb'. Haxo winhaj Josué ol ex kuchb'anok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol satanel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', icha ix aj satanel heb' winh sreyal amorreo, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og yet' heb' yetchonhab' heb'.
Ha ol ak'anoch juntzanh nación chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb' icha ix aj walan t'ayex.

Tek'b'ejek he b'a, manh ex xiwok ayik ol he chalan he b'a yet' heb' ajk'ol chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. Manh he na' to ol ex aktajkan yuj, manh ol ex yak'kanlaj he ch'okoj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Josué chi' winh. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto a ach ol ik'b'at jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ha ach ol ak'kan junjun makan heb' t'a smakb'en.
Ha Jehová ol b'ab'laj u'uj. Aynhejek' het'ok, manh ol ach yaktejkanlaj, yuj chi' manh ach xiwok, manh ach meltzaj t'a a patik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh.

Ix stz'ib'an juntzanh tik winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'ik'anb'at skaxail strato Jehová yet' t'a masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ayik slajwi yuktakil ab'il, t'a yol ab'il yik slajwikan b'ok, ayik molanek' masanil anima t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj t'a juntzanh sk'uhal k'inh chinama, hata' tz'awtaj ley tik yab' masanil anima.

Smolb'ej sb'a masanil anima, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze molb'ej he b'a yuj eyab'ani yet' eyojtakanel masanil tas syal jun ley tik, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat, yik tze k'anab'ajan tas syala'.

Icha pax chi' heb' eyinhtilal manto ojtannakok jun ley tik, ol yab'kan heb' yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová chi' t'a yol sat heb' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Wanxo sk'och stiempoal yik ol ach chamok. Yuj chi' awtejkot winhaj Josué, tzex b'at t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik wach' ol wak'kanoch yopisio winh, xchi t'a winh. Ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Josué chi'.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh t'a skal jun niwan asun ix och moyan t'a sti' kajnub' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha ach tik toxo ol ach chamok. Slajwi chi', a jun chonhab' tik ol ochkan tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh yechel skomon diosal juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatik yichanh b'aj ol k'och heb'. Ol in yaktejkan heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' ix in b'o yet'ok.

Yuj chi', ol kot wowal t'a heb', ol waktankan heb' sch'okoj. Manhxo ol wab' tas ol yal heb'. Manhxo jantakok ya'elal ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb', masanto ol yal heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj skab' sya'il? Yuj am to manhxo ayok ek' ko Diosal t'a ko kal, xcham heb'.
Ayik ol yab'an juntzanh ya'elal chi' heb', ol wik'el in b'a t'a skal heb' yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej, yuj pax to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, tz'ib'ejek jun b'it ol wal t'ayex, ol he k'ayb'an heb' eyetchonhab' Israel tik t'ay, ol sb'itan heb' yik swak'och testigoal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ol lajwok wik'anoch heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum te yax sat chi', lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wa heb' sik'lab'il, ol b'ak'echb'ok heb'. Ol lajwok chi', ol b'at heb' t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ol in spatikanel heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' in b'onak yet'ok.

Ayik ol jawok jantak ya'elal yet' ilk'olal t'a yib'anh heb', a jun b'it tik ol ak'an testigoal t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal heb' ol na'ankot jun b'it tik, ol sb'itan heb'. Yujto ayik manto ochlaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb', wojtakxo tas ayek' t'a spensar heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix stz'ib'ejkan jun b'it tik winhaj Moisés, ix yak'an winh sk'ayb'ej heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué, yuninal winhaj Nun icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto ayinnhej och het'ok. Ha ach ol ik' och heb' etisraelal tik t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'ayex, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi stz'ib'ankan masanil juntzanh ley chi' winhaj Moisés chi',
ix yalan winh t'a heb' yinhtil Leví et'jinak skaxail strato Jehová icha tik:
Ik'ekb'at jun tz'ib'ab'il tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a stz'ey skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik syak' testigoal t'a eyib'anh.
Yujto wojtak to te pit ex, malaj he gana sk'exwi he pensar. Ayik ayinto ek' heyet'ok, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a, okxom wal ol in chamok.
Awtejek heb' yichamtak winakil junjun eyinhtilal yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', yik swalankanel jun b'it tik t'a heb'. Swak'anoch satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigoal.

Wojtakxo to ayik ol in chamok ol eyixtankanb'at he b'a, ol eyaktankan jun b'e b'aj tzex wak'kanoch tik. Hanhejtona' wojtakxopaxi to ha t'a b'ak'inh, ol jawok ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj chukal ol he k'ulej t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' icha tik:
Yab'okab' satcha'anh in loloni. Yab'okab'pax lum lum tas ol wala'.
Ha k'ayb'ub'al swal tik lajan wal icha yem nhab'. Ha lolonel swal tik lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'emi, hanheja' icha yem nhab' t'a yib'anh te te' yet' t'a yib'anh anh ank'ultak, icha chi' yaji.
Swalkaneli to niwan yelk'och Jehová. Ik'ekcha'anh sb'i ko Diosal.
Ha Jehová b'aj sko kol ko b'a lajan icha junok k'e'en niwan tenam. Te wach'nhej tas sb'o'o, te tojolnhej sb'eyb'al. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
Ha ex wetchonhab' ex tik, te manh he mojok tzex och yuninalok Jehová, te malaj he wach'il, te pit ex t'ay.

¿Tom yet' he pital chi' tzeyak' spak t'a Jehová? Ha ex tik malaj he pensar, malaj jab'ok he jelanil. ¿Tom manhok Jehová ko Mam yaj jun? ¿Tom manhok onh b'o'ani? Ha onh b'o'ani, onh yak'anoch t'a chonhab'il.
Naekkot tas sk'ulejnak Jehová, tze na'an t'a juntzanh tiempo ix ek'b'ati. k'anb'ejek eyab' t'a he mam he nun. Ab'ekpax tas syal heb' winh ichamtak winak.
Ayik ix pukaxkanb'at anima t'a junjun nación yuj Jehová Haxonhej Ochi, yuj yak'ankanem stz'akanhil slu'um junjun chonhab', t'a sb'ab'elal ix sna t'a jantak ko b'isul a onh israel onh tik.
Ha onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob ix onh sik'kanel Jehová yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Onh ilchajelta yuj t'a jun tzinan lu'um, b'aj te ow yek' ik'. Ix onh stanhwej wal, ix onh sya hilani, icha wal ko ya ilan snenal yol ko sat.
Icha tz'aj sjuanb'at so' nok' niwak ch'akb'a, sk'ayb'an yune' nok' yik sjenhwi, icha pax tz'aj yik'anb'at yune' nok' chi' t'a yib'anh sk'axil, icha wal chi' ix onh yutej Jehová.
Ha ix onh ik'ankoti, malaj junok komon Dios ix kolwaj yet'ok.

Ix laj yak'kan lum tzalkixtak kikej. Ha tas sk'ib'k'e t'a sat lu'um ix yak' kab'lej, ix yak'anpax nok' yalchab' tz'elta t'a yoltak k'e'en k'e'en t'ayonh yet' aceite tz'el t'a te' olivo sk'ib' t'a skaltak k'e'en k'e'en.

Te niwan yal yim nok' ko wakax yet' nok' chiwa ix elta, ix ko b'oan queso t'ay. Ay nok' kelemtak kalnel ix ko chi'a. Ix ko chipax nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' nok' chiwa te b'ak'ech stanhwaj t'a Basán. Ha wal ixim trigo te wach' ix ko wa''a, ix kuk'an wino, haton yal sat te' uwa.
Ex wetchonhab', haxo yik ix ex b'ak'echb'i a ex chonhab' Jesurún ex tik, ix eyik'anel he b'a t'a Jehová ix onh b'o'ani, ix he patikejkanel ko Kolumal chi'.
Ix he tzuntzej wal kot yowal sk'ol Jehová, yujto ix ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh ch'ok diosal chakb'ilel yuj.

Ix eyak'an he silab' t'a juntzanh enemigo, juntzanh manh diosok, t'a juntzanh komon Dios manta b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a, juntzanh komon Dios toto sb'ojik'ei, b'aj manh yak'nakok em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha ex wetisraelal ex tik, ix b'at satk'olal eyu'uj mach ix onh b'o'ani yet' ko Kolumal. Majxo he nakot ko Diosal ix onh ak'an pitzwok.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi', ix ex spatikejkanel a ex yuninal ex tik.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'a heb', ol wila'' tas ol yutok sb'a heb'. Wal yel a juntzanh anima tik te malaj swach'il heb', max yal-laj wak'anoch heb' yipok in k'o'ol.

Ix stzuntzejkot wowal heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh diosok. Ix chichon in k'ol t'a heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj yelk'och chi'. Wu'uj, ol tz'a sk'o'ol heb' yuj juntzanhxo chonhab' malaj yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', ol in tzuntzejkot yowal heb' yuj tas ol wak' t'a juntzanhxo anima manto nachajel yuj.
Ix te kot wal yowal in k'o'ol, icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'. Masanil tas ay t'a yich lum lum stz'akanb'at yuj, scha sk'ak'al lu'um masanto sk'och t'a yich niwak witz.
Ichato ol in julb'at juntzanh jul-lab' t'a yib'anh heb', syalelk'ochi to ol wak'b'at masanil makanhil ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'. Haton juntzanh tik:
Wejel, k'ak'al ilya te ow, jun ya'elal te ow satanel anima. Ol wak'anb'at nok' chium nok' t'a skal heb' yet' nok' chan te ow svenenoal.
Ol laj cham yuninal heb' t'a yoltak calle yuj k'e'en espada. Xiwk'olalxonhej ol ajek' heb' t'a spat. Ol cham heb' kelemtak, heb' ix kob'estak, heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin tzato chuni.
Ix in na' to ol in saklemkanb'at heb' israel tik, ol in satanel heb' t'a sat lum lum tik yik wach' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb'.
Palta malaj in gana tzin sb'uch heb' ajk'o'ol, malaj in gana syik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Talaj syal heb' icha tik: Ha onh wal ix ko satel heb' israel tik, manhok Jehová ix satanel heb', talaj xchi heb'.
Malaj jab'ok spensar heb' anima chi', max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Tato ay spensar heb', tzam nachajel yuj heb' tas ol elk'ochok.

¿Tas yuj ix el lemnaj mil heb' israel t'a junok heb' yajk'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj lajunhe' mil heb' ix el lemnaj t'a chawanhok heb'? Ha heb' ajk'ol chi' malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj heb', palta a in Jehová in Skolumal in heb' israel chi', ix wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' kajk'ol chi' yojtak heb' to a sdiosal heb' skolani, max yal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Kolumal a onh tik.
Ha heb' kajk'ol chi' stzalaj heb' yet' chukal icha schukal heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra. Haxo stzalajk'olal heb' chi' lajan icha veneno.
Ha swino heb' lajan icha svenenoal sti' nok' chan, scham anima yuj, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil chukal ix sk'ulej heb' ajk'ol chi', na'annhej wu'uj, ichato tonhej sik'an wu'uj.
Ha innhej ay walan wik wak'anoch sya'elal heb'. Ha in ol wak' spak t'a heb' icha smoj scha'an heb'. Ay jun k'uhal ol satel heb', yujto lak'anxo sja sk'uhal. Jab'xonhej sk'och yorail satel heb', xchi.

Ha Jehová ol och yet' heb' schonhab' ayik ol yilani to manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol ok' sk'o'ol Jehová chi' t'a heb' schekab', ayik ol yilani to manhxa junok mach syal skolwaji, manhxalaj heb' chekab', ma heb' yik sb'a.
Ichato chi' ol sk'anb'an Jehová t'a heb' ajk'ol chi': ¿B'ajtil ay he diosal tiknaik, juntzanh tzex kolani, haton juntzanh tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol,
juntzanh schianb'at xepu'al he silab' yet' yuk'an he wino tzeyak' t'ay silab'il? K'eokab' wan he diosal chi' yik skolwaj heyet'ok. Kotokab'i yik tzex stanhwej.

Naekkoti to a innhej Dios in. Malaj junokxo Dios t'a wichanh. Ha in swak'cham anima, a in pax swak'xi pitzwok heb'. Ha in swak' echnaj heb' anima, swanhtanpax heb'. Malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ha in Jehová in tik, ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo, swik'cha'anh in k'ab' swak'an in ti'

to ol in b'o yaj jun owal tik. Icha junok snhikk'e ye k'e'en yespada toxonhej skopopi yik sb'at t'a owal, icha chi' ol in k'ulej, yik ol in b'at wak' spak t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol wak' sya'elal heb' icha t'a smojal scha'an heb'.

Chik'takxonhej ol aj in jul-lab' yuj schik'il heb'. Haxo wespada ol xikankanb'at schib'ejal heb' chamnak yet' pax heb' yamb'ilkot t'a owal. Haxo sjolom heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin chi', chik'takxonhej ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ex anima t'a junjun nación, tzalajanhek yet' schonhab' Jehová, yujto ol spaktzitej schamel heb' schekab'. Ol satel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ol yak'an tup smul heb' schonhab' chi' t'a yib'anh. Ol sakb'itajxi slum heb' yuj Jehová, haton b'aj ix laj emkan schik'il heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix k'och winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh masanil chonhab' Israel, tzak'anoch winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winh, ix yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha tas ix wal tik t'ayex, na'annhejokab' eyuj t'a masanil tiempo. Hak'ekoch t'a he k'o'ol. k'ayb'ejek heb' eyuninal yik ol sk'anab'ajej jun ley tik heb' sik'lab'il.
Manh komon lolonelok juntzanh tik, palta to ay he k 'inal yuj. Tato tze k'anab'ajej smasanil, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
K'e'anh t'a lum switzal Abarim, tzach k'ek'och t'a sjolom lum switzal Nebo t'a yol lum yik heb' moabita, t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ol ilkanb'at lum Canaán ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Ha t'a sjolom jun lum witz b'aj ol ach k'e chi', hata' ol ach chamok, icha ix aj scham winh uk'tak aj Aarón t'a lum jolom witz Hor.
Yujto ix he tenek' tas ix wal t'ayex he chawanhil, maj in eyik'cha'anh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel t'a ha ha' skuchan Meriba-cades, t'a takinh lum Zin.
Yuj chi' manhxo ol ach k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an t'a heb' etchonhab' Israel, najatxonhej ol ilkanb'at lu'um, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik wan sk'och stiempoal scham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová, ix och ijan winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Skot Jehová t'a lum witz Sinaí. Hato t'a Edom syak'kot sakil k'inal t'ayonh. Hato pax t'a lum witz Parán syak'kot kopan stzikikial. Skot yet' heb' yángel manhxo b'ischajb'enok. Ha t'a swach' k'ab' yet'nak ley, sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al.
Ha Jehová sxajanan heb' schonhab', stanhwej heb' yikxo. Ha heb' chi' tz'och ejmelal t'a yichanh, sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il heb'.
Ha jun ley swak'kan tik, ichato smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Jacob yaji.
Ha Jehová ayoch reyal t'a Jesurún, ayik smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab', ayik smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, xchi winh.

Ix syamanoch winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junjun inhtilal. Ix yalan winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Rubén icha tik: Aynhejokab' ek' heb' yinhtilal Rubén. Mokab' satel heb', mokab' kennhejok ol aj sb'isul heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Judá icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ab' tas syal heb' yinhtilal Judá. Ik' meltzaj heb' t'a schonhab', kolwajanh yet' a poder yik syal stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajk'o'ol, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Leví icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ik k'e'en Tumim yet' k'e'en Urim, ix ak' k'e'en t'a winh sik'b'ilel u'uj, haton winh ix ak' prowal t'a Masah, winh ix a telaj a b'a yet'ok t'a ha' Meriba.
Yelxo wal ix ach snib'ej heb' yinhtilal Leví chi' t'a yichanh smam snun, t'a yichanh yuk'tak, ma yuninal. Ha heb' chi' ix sk'anab'ajej a cheknab'il heb', maj yixtejb'at a trato heb' alb'ilkani.
Syak'nhej a ley heb' sk'ayb'ej heb' yinhtilal Jacob. Syalannhej a k'ayb'ub'al heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal. Snhusannhej incienso heb' t'a ichanh, snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a altar.

Mamin Jehová, ak' wal a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', schaokab' a k'ol yik syak'an yopisio heb' t'ayach. Tza satkanel heb' yajk'ol heb' yik wach' maxtzak k'e wan heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Benjamín icha tik: Te xajan heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yuj Jehová, t'a junk'olal ayek' heb'. Ha skolwaj yet' heb'. Ha ayoch stanhwumalok heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal José icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh slu'um heb' yinhtilal José. Aokab' yal ak'wal wach' tz'em t'a lu'um, ayokab' ha ha' sk'eul t'a sat lu'um.
Wach'okab' tz'aj sk'ib' sat tas tz'el t'a sat slu'um heb' t'a junjun ab'il, wach'okab'pax tz'aj sat te te' t'a junjun ujal.
Niwanokab' sat te' awb'en te' wach' tz'el t'a spak'ultak lum witz aytaxonek' t'a peka' smol heb'.

Wach'okab' tz'aj sat te' awb'en te' tz'el t'a sat slu'um heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, haton sch'oxnak sb'a t'a skal te' k'i'ix ayoch sk'ak'al. Kotokab'kan masanil juntzanh wach'k'olal tik t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal José, haton winh sik'b'ilel t'a skal heb' yuk'tak.

Te ay smay heb' yinhtilal José, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín manhxo b'ischajb'enok yet' heb' yinhtilal Manasés, smilalxo heb'. Te ay smay heb' icha junok nok' mam wakax, ma icha yip junok nok' kaltakte'al wakax niwak sch'a'ak. Ol spech masanil chonhab' heb' masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Isacar icha tik: Tzalajanhek ex yinhtilal Zabulón b'ajtak tzex ek'i. Hanhejtona' ex pax tik ex yinhtilal Isacar, tzalajanhek b'ajtak kajan ex.

Tzeyawtejkot masanil heb' eyetisraelal t'a tzalkixtak, tzeyak'an silab' to scha sk'ol Jehová. Tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol yet' b'eyumal ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' juntzanh tas te wach' ay t'a stitak ha' chi', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Gad icha tik: Ik'jokab' cha'anh Jehová ix ak'an lewanb'ok slu'um heb' yinhtil Gad. Lajan heb' icha nok' nun choj tz'em kutzan, sjekchitanel sk'ab' yet' sjolom schib'ej. Icha chi' ol yutej heb' yajk'o'ol heb' yinhtil Gad chi'.

Ix sik'kanel lum lum te wach' heb' yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha jun lu'um chi' smoj wal to ha t'a heb' yajal tz'ak'ji lu'um. Ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab' Israel, a heb' yinhtilal Gad ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yalan scheknab'il Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Dan icha tik: Ha wal heb' yinhtilal Dan tik lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' kelem choj ay t'a Basán sk'e tz'itnajok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Neftalí icha tik: Ha heb' yinhtilal Neftalí tik, wach' yajkan heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, yik heb' yaj lum tz'emk'och t'a sur t'a ha' nhajab', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Aser icha tik: Tzijtumokab' swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, xajanokab' heb' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ochokab' heb' b'eyumal yuj yaceiteal te' olivo ay t'a slu'um.
Aokab' k'e'en hierro yet' k'e'en bronce tzek' k'atan syamnub'alok spuertail schonhab' heb'. Tek'anokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ex Jesurún, malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Diosal. Te ay smay sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh asun ayik sjawi onh skolo'.
Ha Dios aynhejek' ket'ok. T'a masanil tiempo tzonh stanhwej. Ha jantak spoder malaj slajwub', tzonh skol sik'lab'il. Ha Jehová ol ik'anel heb' kajk'ol t'a kichanh, ol yalani to ol ko satel heb'.

Ha onh israel yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik, junk'olal ol onh ajnhejek' yet' kinhtilal t'a ko lu'um. Te wach' ol aj ixim ko trigo yet' sat te' ko uwa, yujto manh ol och wa'an yak'an nhab' t'a ko lu'um tik.

Ex wetisraelal, te wach' kiko', ¿mach wal junok syal slajb'an sb'a ket'ok? Ha Jehová tzonh kolani, a tzonh tanhwani, skolwajpax ket'ok. Icha kespada yaj Jehová yik skak'an ganar heb' kajk'o'ol. Ol yak'em sb'a heb' kajk'ol chi' t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha t'a spanhanil yol yik Moab ayek' winhaj Moisés chi' ayik ix k'e winh t'a jolom witz Nebo ay t'a sjolom lum niwan witz Pisga, haton lum ay t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ix sch'oxkanb'at masanil lum lum Jehová yil winh: Haton masanil lum Galaad masanto b'aj ay smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan,
lum smakb'en heb' yik Neftalí, heb' yik Efraín, heb' yik Manasés yet' masanil lum yik heb' yik Judá, masanto sk'och lum t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Skot lum t'a Neguev masanto sk'och lum t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán yet' t'a masanil spatiktak Jericó schonhab'il te' palma, masanto sk'och lum t'a Zoar.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Haton jun lu'um tik wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob. Walannak t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' eyinhtilal, xin chi, yuj chi' tzin ch'oxkanb'at lum t'ayach, wach'chom manhxo ol ach k'och t'a lu'um, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', hata' ix cham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová chi', t'a yol yik Moab, icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun ch'olan t'a yol yik Moab t'a yichanh Bet-peor ix mukji winh yuj Jehová chi', palta malaj mach ojtannak jun b'aj mukankan sniwanil winh chi'.
120 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh. Wach'to yilan winh, tek'antopax winh ayik ix cham winh chi'.
Jun wal ujal ix och heb' chonhab' israel t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winh chi' t'a tzinan lu'um yik Moab, icha sb'eyb'al heb'.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'kanb'at sk'ab' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yik scha'ankan sjelanil winh yet' yopisio icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Yuj chi' a heb' chonhab' israel, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winhaj Josué chi'.
Atax t'a jun pekti' chi', manhxa junokxo schekab' Jehová t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel k'elk'umb'a ix aj Jehová ix lolon yet'ok, icha ix aj slolon yet' winhaj Moisés.

Manhxa junokxo mach ix k'ulan tas satub'tak yilji yet' milagro icha sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yol yik Egipto t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' t'a masanil heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och sk'ulan tastak ay smay icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh heb' yetisraelal.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová, ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Moisés chi', haton winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun:
Toxo ix cham winh in chekab' aj Moisés, yuj chi' a hachxo ol a kuchb'ej jun chonhab' tik. Ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán tik, ol ex k'och t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Ha t'a masanil lum lum b'aj ol ex ek'ok, ol eyikejkan lu'um, icha ajnak walan t'a winhaj Moisés.

Masanil lum sb'atnhej t'a takinh lu'um masanto t'a lum Líbano, sb'atnhej lum t'a ha' niwan Éufrates, masanil lum yik heb' hitita masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ol wak'nhej lum t'ayex.
Malaj junok mach ol stek'b'ej sb'a yak'an owal het'ok yujto ayinnhejoch het'ok t'a masanil tiempo, icha ix aj wochnhej yet' winhaj Moisés chi'. Malaj b'ak'inh ol ach waktejkani.
Tek'annhej tzutej a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto a ach ol a pukek' lum lum chi' yik tz'ochkan lum smakb'enej juntzanh anima tik, haton lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham.

Anhej swal t'ayach, to tza tek'b'ej a b'a, manh ach xiwok, tza k'anab'ajan masanil k'ayb'ub'al ix yalkan winh in chekab' aj Moisés t'ayach. Manh a patikejel jab'ok jun k'ayb'ub'al tik yik wach'nhej ol ach ajelk'ochok.

Manh aktejkan awtan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan k'ayb'ub'al tik, t'a k'uhal t'ak'wal tza naub'tanhej tas syala', yik wach' ol a k'anab'ajej masanil tas syal chi'. Tato icha chi', masanil tas ol a k'ulej, wach'nhej ol aj yelk'ochi.
Ha in swal t'ayach to tek'annhej tzutej a b'a, manh ach xiwok, mokab' chab'ax a k'o'ol, yujto a in Jehová a Diosal in, ayinnhejoch het'ok yalnhej b'aj tzach ek'i, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Josué t'a heb' yajalil chonhab' Israel icha tik:
Ixikek t'a masanil campamento, tzeyalani to syak' lista swa'el heb' anima smasanil, yujto a chab'ej tzonh k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik syak'ankan lum lum chi' Jehová ko Diosal kikok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés icha tik:
--Naekkot masanil tas ix yalkan winhaj Moisés t'ayex, winh schekab' Jehová, ayik ix yalan winh to a Jehová ol ak'an jun lu'um tik t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'a junk'olal.

Ol eyaktejkan heb' ix eyetb'eyum, eyuninal yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok' t'a lum tik, haton lum ix yak'kan winhaj Moisés t'ayex t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán tik. Ha exxo he masanil stiempoal wal he b'at t'a owal, ak'ek lista he b'a yet' eyamk'ab', tzex b'ab'laj t'a yichanh masanil heb' ketchonhab' tik, yik ol ex k'axpaj t'a ha' Jordán tik yik tzex kolwaj yet' heb'.

Masanto ol yak' Jehová lum b'aj ol aj heb' t'a junk'olal, haton lum ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u icha ix aj yak'an lum heyik tik Jehová chi'. Ayik toxo ix yikejkan lum heb', ol ex meltzajxikot t'a lum heyik tik, haxo he kajnajkan t'a sat lu'um, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik. --Ha masanil tas tzal tik, ol ko k'anab'ajej, yalnhej b'aj tzonh a chekb'ati, ol onh b'atok.
Ol ach ko k'anab'ajej icha ix aj ko k'anab'ajan winhaj Moisés t'a masanil tas ix yal t'ayonh. Anhej to tz'ochnhej Jehová ko Diosal het'ok icha ix aj yoch yet' winhaj Moisés chi'.
Yalnhej mach heb' max k'anab'ajan tas tzala', mato spitej sb'a t'ayach, a heb' chi' smiljicham heb'. Anhej to tza tek'b'ej a b'a, manh ach xiwok, xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi'.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Josué t'a lum Sitim, ix schekanb'at chawanh heb' winh winak winh, yik sb'at yil lum heb' winh t'a elk'altak, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixikek b'at eyil lum lum chi', tzeyilan wal tas yaj chonhab' Jericó, xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh b'i'an, haxo t'a jun ix ajmul ix skuchan Rahab t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix k'och heb' winh sk'an sposado. Ix kan heb' winh t'a spat ix.
Palta ay heb' ix ilan sk'och heb' winh, yuj chi' ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winh sreyal Jericó chi': --Ay juntzanh heb' winh israel ix jawi ul yil ko chonhab' tik, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalb'at winh rey chi' t'a ix Rahab chi' icha tik: --Hak'elta juntzanh heb' winh israel ayek' posado chi' t'ayach, ak'och heb' winh t'a yol ko k'ab' yujto tonhej tzul yilb'at ko chonhab' tik heb' winh, xchib'at winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Yeltoni, ay juntzanh heb' winh ix ek' t'a tik, palta manh wojtakok b'ajtil ix kot heb' winh. Haxo yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i ix b'at heb' winh, yujto yorailxo smakchaj spuertail chonhab'. Manh wojtakok tas b'eal b'aj ix b'at heb' winh. Tato elanhchamel tzex b'at t'a spatik heb' winh, tekan tzato yamchaj heb' winh eyu'uj, xchi ix. Icha chi' ix aj yalan ix, palta toxo ix sk'ub'ejel heb' winh ix t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat, t'a yalanh juntzanh anh lino manojail yaji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at tzak'an heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a spatik heb' winh yalani, masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán b'aj jay ha', ixnhej wal elkan heb' winh soldado chi', ix makchaj spuertail chonhab'.
Haxo yik manto waylaj heb' winh chawanh chi', ix k'ek'och ix Rahab t'a yib'anh spat chi' t'a heb' winh, ix yalan ix icha tik:
--Wojtak to a Jehová ix ak'an jun lum tik t'ayex, yuj chi' ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'a kib'anh, manhxo onh animaok skab'i ayik skab'an he pekal.

Kab'nak spekal ayik eyelnakkot t'a Egipto to a Jehová pojannak snanhal ha' Chakchak Mar, eyek'nakkot t'a stak'inhal. Kab'annakpax spekal to he satnakkanel chawanh heb' winh sreyal amorreo t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og.
Te xiwnak onh ayik kab'annak spekal jun chi'. Malaj mach syal stzak'wan t'ayex, yujto a Jehová he Diosal, anhejton Dios t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lum lum tik.

Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayex to tze lok sb'i Jehová he Diosal yik tzeyak'ankan he ti' t'ayin to tze nakot masanil heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, icha wal tzex wutej tik. Yuj chi' ak'ek junok seña, tato yel tzeyala'
to tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh in mam in nun yet' masanil heb' in nulej yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', mokab' satelok, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh chawanh chi' icha tik: --Skak' ko ti' to ol ex ko nakoti, anhej tato malaj b'aj tzal jun tik. Ayik ol yak'anoch jun lum tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab', ol ach ko kolkaneli, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ha ix Rahab chi', ha t'a yib'anh smuroal jun chonhab' chi', hata' b'ob'ilk'e spat ix, yuj chi' haxo t'a swentenail spat ix chi', hata' ix yak'el heb' winh ix. k'ojank'olal ix em t'unhunhok heb' winh t'a spatikel jun chonhab' chi' yuj ix t'a jun ch'anh lasu.

Ayik mantzak em heb' winh, ix yalan ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikek t'a kaltak te' t'a lum jolom witz chi', yik manh ol ex ilchaj yuj heb' winh tzex sayanek' chi', tze k'ub'ejel he b'a ta' oxeok k'uhal, masanto sjaxkan heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' tik, ichato chi' tzex pax b'aj ex kot chi', xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix icha tik: --Ol kak'elk'och ko ti' ix kak'kan tik t'ayach,

palta ayik ol onh jawok kak' owal yet' a chonhab' tik, yowalil lokanokab'em jun chakchak lasu t'a wentena b'aj ol onh ak'em t'unhunhok tik. Tza molb'ankot a mam a nun, heb' a nulej yet' heb' ayto uj a b'a yet'ok t'a yol a pat tik.

Tato ay junok tz'el t'a yol a pat tik ayik wan kak'an owal chi', tato schami, max kanlaj schamel chi' t'a kib'anh, palta tato ha t'a yol a pat tik ayek' junok scham ku'uj, a schamel chi' skan t'a kib'anh.
Hanhejtona' tato tzalelta tas tzul ko k'ulej tik, a onhxo tik manhxo ol kak'elk'och ko ti' ix kak' tik t'ayach, xchi heb' winh.
--Ichokab' ta', xchi ix. Ixlajwi yalan kil ko b'a heb' winh t'a ix, ix stzek'ankanoch jun ch'anh lasu chi' ix t'a swentenail spat chi'.

Ix k'ekan heb' winh chawanh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a oxe' k'uhal t'a kaltak te' t'a jolom witz chi'. Ix ek' heb' winh soldado chi' say heb' winh, palta maj ilchajlaj heb' winh, yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh soldado chi' t'a Jericó chi'.

Haxo heb' winh chawanh ilum lu'um chi', ix emixta heb' winh, ix k'axpajxiek' heb' winh t'a ha' Jordán chi', ix k'ochxi heb' winh b'aj aykan winhaj Josué chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh tastak ix b'at yil heb' winh ta'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha Jehová wan yak'anoch juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a yol ko k'ab', yujto a heb' anima ta' ichato chamnakxo heb' yuj xiwelal t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u te ak'walto, ix b'at winhaj Josué yet' heb' yetisraelal, ix el heb' t'a Sitim, ix k'och heb' t'a sti' ha' Jordán, ix och wa'an heb' t'a sti' ha' chi', majto ek'laj heb'.
Haxo t'a schab'jial ix ek' heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a masanil campamento,
ix yalan heb' t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal chi' icha tik: Ha wal ol eyilan yek' te' skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal yuj heb' sacerdote, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví, tzex och tzak'an yuj te'.

Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli, b'ajtil ol ex b'atok, yujto mantalaj junok ex eyojtak jun b'e chi', manh ex te k'och t'a slak'anil te', najat tzak'anto he b'at yuj te', icha am junok kilómetro tzak'an ex t'a spatik te', xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Josué t'a heb' anima chi': Ha tiknaik, sakb'itejek he b'a yujto a k'ik'an sch'ox Jehová tas satub'tak yilji t'a ko kal, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' sacerdote: Ik'ekb'at te' skaxail trato, tzex b'ab'laj yuj masanil heb' anima tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'akhanb'at te' heb', ix b'ab'laj heb' yuj heb' anima chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi': Ha tiknaik ol in chael yich ach wik'ancha'anh yet' opisio, yik wach' syil heb' to ayinnhejoch het'ok, icha ix in ochnhej yet' winhaj Moisés.
Tzalan t'a heb' sacerdote tz'ik'anb'at te' skaxail trato tik: Ayik ol ex k'och t'a ha' Jordán chi', ol ex b'at jab'ok t'a yol ha', ol ex kan tek'tek' t'a yol ha' chi', xa chi t'a heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj Josué t'a heb' israel chi': Nitzekkot he b'a tzeyab'an tas syal Jehová ko Diosal.

Ha yuj tas ol eyil tiknaik, hata' ol nachajel eyu'uj to ayek' Dios pitzan t'a ko kal. Ha Jehová chi' ol ik'anel heb' cananeo, heb' hitita, heb' heveo, heb' ferezeo, heb' gergeseo, heb' amorreo yet' heb' jebuseo t'a kichanh.
Haxo tiknaik jun, a te' skaxail strato Jehová, haton Dios ay yik masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol b'ab'laj b'akhchajb'at te' t'a yol ha' Jordán t'a kichanh.
Yuj chi' tze sik'el jaywanhok heb' yajalil chonhab' ol och yopisio, junjun heb' t'a junjun inhtilal.

Ayik ol yak'anem yok heb' sacerdote t'a yol ha' chi', haton heb' et'jinak te' skaxail strato Jehová, haton Dios ay yik masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol spojan sb'a ha', ha ha' tz'emul t'a yib'anh, ol wanaj ha', icha nhajab' ol yutokkan sb'a ha', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'ank'e wan sk'a'el heb', yik sk'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán chi', b'ab'el heb' sacerdote et'jinak te' skaxail trato chi' yuj heb'.
Te ayk'e ha', tz'el ha' t'a stitak smelemal, haton wal t'a stiempoal sjochchaj ixim trigo. Anhej yik ix yak'anem yok heb' sacerdote chi' t'a yol ha',

elanhchamelnhej ix och wa'an ha' yemuli. Najatto ix smolb'ejkan sb'a ha' t'a stojolal chonhab' Adán masanto ix k'och ha' t'a chonhab' Saretán. Haxo pax ha' ix kan t'a yalanh chi' jun, ix b'atnhej ha' masanto ix lajwib'at ha' t'a yol ha' mar Muerto. Ichaton chi' ix aj spojan sb'a ha' Jordán chi. Ix ek' heb' israel t'a stak'inhal t'a yol ha' chi', t'a yichanhkot chonhab' Jericó.

Haxo heb' sacerdote et'jinak te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix ochkan wa'an heb' t'a snanhal yol sb'e ha' chi', takinh lum b'aj ix kan tek'tek' heb' chi', haxo masanil heb' israel wan sk'axpajek' heb'.
Ixlajwi yek'kan heb' anima chi' smasanil t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik:
Sik'el lajchawanhok heb' winh winak t'a skal heb' anima tik, junjun heb' winh t'a junjun inhtilal, tzalani to
syik'k'eta junjunok k'e'en k'e'en heb' winh t'a yol ha' b'aj linhanek' heb' sacerdote tik, syik'anb'at k'e'en heb' winh b'aj ol ex kan t'a jun ak'wal tik, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix yawtankot heb' winh lajchawanh chi' winhaj Josué chi', haton heb' winh ix sik'el winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Emanhek t'a snanhal yol sb'e ha' chi', tzex k'och t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, junjun ex tzeyik'k'eta junjunok k'e'en k'e'en, junjun t'a junjun inhtilal, lajchawe' syil sb'a k'e'en.
Ha k'e'en k'e'en chi' yik ol nachajkot b'ak'inh ayik ol sk'anb'an heb' eyuninal t'ayex: ¿Tas syalelk'och juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik? ta xchi heb',

ol eyalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha syalelk'och juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik to ayik sk'axpajnak ek'ta heb' sacerdote yet' te' skaxail strato Jehová, ix spojan sb'a ha' Jordán t'a yichanh te' kaxa chi'. Yuj chi' a k'e'en k'e'en tik nanab'ilkot yajkan k'e'en t'a tas ujinak t'a tik t'ayonh israel onh tik, xe cham t'a heb', xchi winhaj Josué chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh sk'ulan tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix em heb' winh, ix yik'ank'eta junjun k'e'en k'e'en chi' heb' winh t'a yol ha', junjun k'e'en t'a junjun heb' yinhtilal Israel, ix yik'anb'at k'e'en heb' winh t'a campamento, ix smolb'ankan k'e'en heb' winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi'.

Ix schekan winhaj Josué chi' molb'ajpax lajchawexo k'e'en t'a yol sb'e ha' Jordán chi', b'aj ix och wa'an heb' sacerdote t'a yol sb'e ha' yet' te' skaxail trato chi', a juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en chi' ix kannhej k'e'en ta'.

Ayik linhanoch heb' sacerdote t'a snanhal yol sb'e ha' Jordán chi', ix sk'anab'ajan heb' israel tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Josué chi'. Masanil ix elk'och icha ix yutej yalankan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Josué chi'. Ix ek' heb' winh soldado yik yinhtilal Rubén, heb' winh yik Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' winh yik Manasés. Yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' winh yik owal, ix b'ab'laj heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi', icha ix aj yalankan winhaj Moisés chi'. Ay am junok 40 mil heb' winh ix b'ab'laj t'a yichanh heb' schonhab' Jehová chi', ix k'och heb' winh smasanil t'a yichanhkot Jericó. Elanhchamel ix laj ek' heb' israel chi'. Ayik ix ek'kan masanil heb' anima chi', ichato chi' ix ek' heb' sacerdote yet' te' skaxail strato Jehová chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'ab'lajxi heb' t'a yichanh masanil anima chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', a Jehová ix ik'ancha'anh winhaj Josué chi' t'a yopisio t'a yichanh heb' anima chi', yik niwan tz'aj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat heb' t'a masanil tiempo, icha ix yutej sb'a heb' t'a winhaj Moisés.
Ayik ix lajwi yek'kan heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik:
Al t'a heb' sacerdote et'jinak te' skaxail trato chi' to tzek'ta heb' t'a yol ha' chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh: K'eanhekkot t'a yol ha', xchi winh.
Ixnhej k'eul heb' t'a sti' ha', ix kotxi usnaj ha' molankan t'a yib'anh chi', ix laj b'atxikan ha' t'a yol sb'e icha yik manto wanaj ha'.
Ayik ix ek' heb' israel t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', t'a wal slajunhil k'uhal yoch b'ab'el uj, ix k'och heb' t'a Gilgal, t'a yichanhkot Jericó t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Hata' ix schek molb'ajkan k'e'en k'e'en chi' winhaj Josué, k'e'en ix yik'k'eta heb' t'a yol ha' Jordán chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Tato ol sk'anb'ej heb' eyuninal t'ayex t'a b'ak'inh tas syalelk'och juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik,
tzeyalan t'a heb' yuj tas ix aj kek'ta t'a yol ha' Jordán tik,
yet' tas ix aj spojan sb'a ha', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix halani to t'a takinhal ix aj kek'ta, icha ix yutej spojan sb'a ha' Chakchak Mar yuj ayik kek'nakkoti ayik kelnak t'a Egipto.

Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová yik wach' syojtakejel masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to niwan yelk'och spoder, yik ay yelk'ochpax Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol ko sat t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.

Masanil heb' winh sreyal heb' amorreo ay t'a sk'axepal ek'ta ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' heb' winh sreyal heb' cananeo t'a sti' ha' mar Mediterráneo, ix yab' spekal heb' tas ix aj stakji ha' Jordán yuj Jehová ayik ix ek'ta heb' israel t'a yol ha'. Yuj chi' ix xiwb'at heb', manhxalaj junok heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sb'at yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: B'o'ek jaye'ok k'e'en kuchilub' t'a k'e'en pachab', tzalani to tz'ak'ji circuncidar heb' etchonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' to sb'o k'e'en kuchilub' chi', yik tz'ak'ji circuncidar masanil heb' winh israel ayik ayek' heb' winh t'a tzalan Aralot.
Ix ak'ji circuncidar heb' winh smasanil, yujto a masanil heb' winh stiempo yoch soldadoal ayik yelnak heb' t'a Egipto, chamnakkan heb' winh t'a tzinan lu'um.
Yujto a heb' winh elnakkot t'a Egipto chi', ak'b'il circuncidar heb' winh smasanil, haxo heb' winh ix alji t'a tzinan lu'um chi', manto ak'b'iloklaj circuncidar heb' winh.

Ay 40 ab'il ix ek' heb' israel chi' t'a tzinan lu'um chi', yuj chi' a heb' winh stiempoal yoch soldadoal ayik yelnak heb' t'a Egipto, toxo ix laj cham heb' winh, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi' yalnak to malaj junok heb' ol ilan lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' smam yicham heb', haton lum te yax sat.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Josué chi' ak'chaj circuncidar heb' winh yuninal heb' winh ix alji, haton heb' winh ix kan sk'exulok smam, manto ak'jilaj circuncidar heb' winh yujto t'a yol b'e ix laj alji heb' winh.
Haxo ix lajwi yak'ji circuncidar heb' winh, ix kan heb' winh t'a yol scampamento, masanto ix laj b'oxi heb' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Ha t'a jun k'u tik swik'kanel sb'uchwal lolonel heb' aj Egipto t'ayex, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' Gilgal ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ayik aytoek' heb' israel t'a yol scampamento t'a Gilgal t'a ak'lik t'a yichanhkot Jericó, t'a 14 yoch uj t'a yemk'uhalil, ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' libre t'a Egipto.
Haxo t'a yewial slajwi k'inh chi', a tastak tz'el t'a sat lu'um chi', a ix swa heb', haton ixim pan malaj yich yet' ixim trigo mayb'il t'a kal k'ak'.
Atax ta' ochnakkan wa'an sjawi maná, yuj chi' majxo swalaj maná chi' heb' israel chi'. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi' haxonhej tas tz'el t'a sat lum Canaán chi' ix swa heb'.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Josué t'a slak'anil Jericó, ix yil jun icha soldado winh yet'nakk'e yespada t'a yol sk'ab', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Josué chi' t'a stz'ey, ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay icha tik: --¿Tom ketb'eyum ach, mato etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh? xchi winh t'ay.

--Ma'ay, wal yel a in tik Yajal waj t'a heb' soldado Jehová, xchi. Ayik ix yalan jun chi', ix emk'och nhojnaj winhaj Josué chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ha chekab' in Mamin. ¿Tas a gana tzin k'ulej tiknaik? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi icha tik: --Ik'el a xanhab', yujto a jun lugar b'aj ayach ek' tik yik Jehová yaji, xchi. Yuj chi' ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Josué chi' t'ay.
Ha spuertail Jericó te wach' yaj smakchaji yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel. Yuj chi' malaj junok mach syal yelta, ma tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Ha in ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol a k'ab' yet' winh sreyal yet' heb' winh soldado.
E masanil ex soldado israel ex tik, junjun k'u ol ex ek' oyoyok junelok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' tik, wake' k'uhal ol he k'ulej icha chi'.

Ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote sb'ab'laj t'a yichanh te' skaxail trato, junjun heb' yet'nak junjun sch'a'ak, b'ob'il t'a sch'ak nok' kalnel. Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal jun, ukel ol ex ek' oyoyok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', ol spu'annhej nok' ch'a'ak chi' heb' winh.

Haxo yik tzeyab'ani to sb'atkan numan sjaj nok' sch'ak heb' winh chi' spu'ani, te cha'anh tzex awaji, haxo yem lanhnaj smuroal chi'. Slajwi chi', junjun ex tzex b'at t'a eyichanh yik tzex och t'a yol chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix yawtankot heb' winh sacerdote winhaj Josué chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ol eyik'b'at te' skaxail strato Jehová. Tzex b'ab'laj ukwanhok ex t'a yichanh te', tzeyik'anb'at junjunok nok' he ch'a'ak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ol b'at ex ek' oyoyok junelok t'a spatik jun chonhab' tik. B'ab'elokab' sb'at heb' winh soldado t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' masanil tas ix yal winhaj Josué chi': B'ab'el sb'at jun makan heb' winh soldado yet' syamk'ab'. Slajwi chi' tzak'an ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote wan spu'annhej sch'a'ak. Tzak'anpax heb' winh sacerdote b'akhjinak te' skaxail strato Jehová. Haxo t'a spatik heb' winh tzak'an junxo makan heb' winh soldado.
Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi' to malaj junok heb' winh tz'el yaw, ma sloloni, masanto a winh ol alanok, ichato chi' te cha'anh ol el yaw heb' smasanil.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' to tzek' oyoyok heb' yet' te' kaxa chi' junelok t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh yet' masanil heb' anima t'a campamento. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, te ak'walto ix k'e wa'an winhaj Josué chi', ix b'at ek'xi oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi'. B'ab'el sb'at jun makan heb' winh soldado yet' syamk'ab'. Tzak'anpax ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote spu'an nok' ch'a'ak, max och wa'an heb' winh spu'an nok'. Tzak'anpax heb' winh sacerdote b'akhjinak te' skaxail strato Jehová. Haxo t'a spatik heb' winh tzak'an junxo makan heb' winh soldado.

Ha t'a schab'il k'uhal chi' hanheja' junel ix ek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajpax heb' winh t'a scampamento, ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh t'a wake' k'uhal.
Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, te ak'walto ix k'e wa'an heb' winh, ix b'atxi heb' winh junelxo. Ukel ix ek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a jun k'u chi'.

Haxo t'a yukelal, ayik toxo ol spu sch'ak heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' t'a masanil heb' winh soldado: Ayik ol eyab'an sb'atkan numan sjaj nok' sch'ak heb' winh sacerdote tik, cha'anh tzex awaji, yujto toxo ix yak'och jun chonhab' tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Masanil jun chonhab' tik yet' masanil heb' anima ayek' t'a yol chi', toxo ix yal Jehová to masanil heb' ol satelok, anhej ix Rahab, ix ajmul ix, manh ol satel-laj ix yet' masanil mach ayek' yet' ix t'a yol spat, yujto a ix, ix k'ub'anel heb' winh ix ulek' yil jun chonhab' tik ku'uj.

Scham eyab'ani, ayta wal junok tas ay t'a jun chonhab' tik tzeyama', ma tzeyik'b'ati, yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to masanil satjieli. Tato ay tas ol eyama', ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a kib'anh ko masanil, ol onh lajwokel yuj.
Anhej k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata, k'e'en bronce yet' k'e'en hierro, a juntzanh chi' tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, skan b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'ay, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix spu'an nok' sch'a'ak heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix b'atkan numan sjaj nok'. Ayik ix yab'an heb' winh soldado chi', te cha'anh ix el yaw heb' winh smasanil, yuj chi' ix em lanhnaj smuroal jun chonhab' chi'. Elanhchamel, junjun soldado ix b'at t'a yichanh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix och heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix laj smilancham masanil anima heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Eb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, wach'chom ichamtak anima, ma unin, nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' b'uru, masanil ix satel heb'.

Yalnakxo winhaj Josué t'a heb' winh chawanh xit'nakek' yil jun chonhab' chi' t'a sb'ab'elal to sb'at yik'elta ix ajmul ix chi' heb' winh yet' heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat, icha aj yalannakkan heb' winh t'a ix.

Yuj chi' elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh. Ix b'at yik'anelta ix heb' winh t'a yol spat chi' yet' smam snun, heb' snulej ix yet' masanil heb' ayto yuj sb'a ix yet'ok yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a jun lugar t'a spatikel campamento.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' chi' heb', ix tz'ab'at masanil tastak. Anhej tastak b'ob'il t'a k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, k'e'en bronce, ma k'e'en hierro ix yik'b'at heb', ix sik'anb'at heb' b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'chaj t'a Jehová.

Anhej ix Rahab yet' smam snun yet' heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok maj satel-laj yuj winhaj Josué chi', yujto kolwajnak ix t'a heb' winh xit'nakek' yil jun chonhab' chi' t'a sb'ab'elal. Atax ta' ix kan ix yet' yinhtilal t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun lolonel tik winhaj Josué: katab'ajokab' yuj Jehová mach sb'oanxik'e jun chonhab' tik t'a schaelal, chamokab' sb'ab'el unin ayik tz'em yich, chamokab'pax stzak'an unin ayik tz'och spuertail, xchi winh.
Ix kolwaj wal Jehová yet' winhaj Josué chi', te niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a masanil juntzanh lugar chi'.

Ay jun winh skuch Acán t'a yinhtilal Judá, yuninal winhaj Carmi, yixchikin winhaj Zabdi, yinhtilal winhaj Zera, ix yik'b'at juntzanh tas winh ay yowalil yik'jib'ati. Masanil heb' israel ix och lokan yuj smul winh chi', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Josué yet' heb' israel t'a Jericó, ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh winak winh yik sb'at yilan heb' winh chajtil yaj chonhab' Hai. Haton jun ay t'a yichanhkot Betel t'a slak'anil Bet-awén. Ix b'at heb' winh yila' tas yaj jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo ix jax heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Manh yowalilok sb'at heb' winh chonhab' tik smasanil, palta anhej chab'ok, ma oxeok mil heb' winh sb'at yak' owal yet' heb', yik manh tonhejok syixtej sb'a heb' winh smasanil, yujto kennhej heb' stanhwan jun chonhab' chi', xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' anhejam oxeok mil heb' winh soldado ix b'at yak' owal yet' heb' aj Hai chi'. Palta haxo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' winh soldado israel chi' yuj heb'.

Ix pechji heb' winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi' masanto t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'ik'jielta k'e'en k'e'en stzeyji. Ix miljicham 36 heb' winh soldado israel chi' yuj heb' t'a sat witz t'a yalanh jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' israel chi' smasanil, ix chab'axk'e sk'ol heb'.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Josué yet' heb' winh yajalil chonhab', ix snhik'b'at spichul heb' winh yuj kusk'olal, ix yak'anpaxk'e pokok heb' winh t'a sjolom, ix lajwi chi', ix em kumnaj heb' winh t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová, ix emk'och snanhal sat heb' winh t'a sat lu'um masanto ix em k'u.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --Ay Mamin Jehová, ¿tas yuj ix ik'ek'ta a chonhab' tik t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán tik? ¿Tom yuj onh satanel heb' amorreo, yuj chi' onh ik'ek'ta t'a jun lugar tik? Te wach' hama, ta ix onh kan t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi'.
Ay Mamin, ¿tasto wal ol wala'? Ha heb' a chonhab' tik toxonhej ix el heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol.

Haxo heb' cananeo yet' masanil chonhab' kajan t'a juntzanh lugar tik, ol yab' spekal heb' tas ix sk'ulej heb' a chonhab' tik, ol smolb'an sb'a heb', haxo onh satanel heb' chi', manhxo ol onh b'inaj t'a sat lum tik. Haxo heb' anima, chuk ol yal heb' t'a a patik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an, ¿tas tza k'ulej?

Ha heb' eyetisraelal tik ix och smul, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix wal t'ayex. Ix yelk'ejkot tastak heb' ix wala' to satel smasanil. Ix elk'an heb', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a elk'altak, ix sk'ub'anel heb' b'aj kajan.

Yuj wal chi' maxtzak yal-laj he tek'b'an he b'a t'a heb' eyajk'ol chi', tzex el t'a heb'. Yuj chi' a tiknaik smoj wal tzex sateli. Tato manh ol he satel masanil tas ix wala' to tze sateli, wal yel manhxo ol in och heyet'ok.

Ha tiknaik jun, k'e'anh wa'an, al t'a heb' anima tik to sakb'itej sb'a heb', syak'an lista sb'a heb', yujto a k'ik'an sjawi heb' t'a wichanh smasanil. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala': T'a he kal a ex israel ex tik, ay tas ix wala' to satjieli, yuj chi' tato hanheja' he k'ub'aneli, wal yel manhxo ol yal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a heb' eyajk'ol chi'.

Ha k'ik'an, t'a junjun inhtilal tz'aj he ja t'a wichanh. Ha jun inhtilal tzin ch'oxo', ha t'a skal jun chi' ay jun inhtilal tz'och t'a wichanh t'a junjun makan. Ha jun makan tzin ch'ox chi', sjawi t'a wichanh t'a junjun familiail, haxo jun familia tzin ch'ox chi', sjawi masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a skal, t'a junjunal sja heb' winh t'a wichanh.

Ha t'a winh tz'ilchajelta tas ix wala' to satjieli, a jun winh chi' snhusjitz'a winh yet' yetb'eyum, yuninal yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay, yujto ix sk'ulej winh tas manh smojok, maj sk'anab'ajej in trato winh, xchi Jehová.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wa'an winhaj Josué chi', ix yalan winh to smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima t'a junjun inhtilal. Elanhchamel ix ch'oxji yinhtilal winhaj Judá yuj Jehová.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' to makkiltak tz'aj sch'oxan sb'a heb' yinhtilal Judá chi'. Haxo t'a skal heb', hata' ix sch'ox heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zera Jehová, haxo pax t'a skal heb' chi' ix elta heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabdi.

Junjunal ix aj snitzankot sb'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zabdi chi'. Haxo t'a skal heb' ix ch'oxji winhaj Acán yuninal winhaj Carmi, yixchikin winhaj Zabdi schab'il yixchikin winhaj Zera, t'a yinhtilal Judá yuj Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josué t'a winhaj Acán chi' icha tik: --Ach wetchonhab', t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, jichan wal tzala' tas chukal ix a k'ulej, manh a k'ub'ejeli, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Acán chi' icha tik: --Wal yel ix och in mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ay ton juntzanh tas ix welk'ejkoti.

Ha t'a skal masanil tastak ay t'a Jericó, ix wik'kot jun k'apak k'apak kotnak t'a Babilonia, yujto te wach' yilji k'apak yet' k'e'en plata oye' am libra yalil yet' jun telanh k'e'en oro ay am junok libra yalil. Ix wiloch in k'ol t'a juntzanh chi', yuj chi' ix wik'koti. Ha t'a snanhal yol in mantiado mukan wu'uj. Ha k'e'en plata chi' ha t'a yalanh aykanem k'e'en, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh heb' winh winak winhaj Josué chi' yil t'a yol smantiado winhaj Acán chi'. Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh, ix b'at sjoyank'eta juntzanh chi' heb' winh. Ha t'a yalanh, hata' ayem k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata chi'.
Ix yik'ankot heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' israel. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová.

Haxo winhaj Josué chi' yet' masanil heb' israel chi' ix yaman winhaj Acán chi' yet' juntzanh chi': Haton k'e'en plata, jun k'apak k'apak, jun telanh k'e'en oro, heb' yuninal winh, heb' ix yisil winh, nok' wakax, nok' b'uru, nok' kalnel, smantiado winh yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb' israel chi' t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Acor.

Haxo yik ix k'och heb' ta' ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix ik'kot jun ya'elal chi' t'a kib'anh? Ha tiknaik jun, yak'okab'kot ya'elal Jehová t'a ib'anh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix syamanoch heb' israel chi' sjulk'enancham winhaj Acán chi' yet' masanil heb' yuninal. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusankantz'a heb' masanil tastak ay t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ekan juyanh k'e'en k'e'en t'a yib'anh heb', ix kannhej jun juyanh k'e'en k'e'en chi' ta', yuj chi' Acor ix sb'iejkan jun ak'lik chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch wa'an yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué icha tik: Manh ach xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e a k'o'ol. Ik'b'at masanil heb' winh soldado, tzach b'at owal t'a chonhab' Hai. Ha in ol wak'och jun chonhab' chi' yet' winh sreyal yet' masanil smakb'en t'a yol he k'ab'.

Icha wal ix eyutej chonhab' Jericó yet' winh sreyal, icha pax chi' ol eyutej jun chonhab' chi' yet' winh sreyal. Haxo pax masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' nok' nok', tzeyikejkani ayik toxo ix eyak' ganar. Ak'b'at junok makan heb' winh soldado yik sb'at sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' winh t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', haxo junokxo makan heb' winh b'at tzuntzanelta heb' kajan chi' ta', xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a winhaj Josué chi' yet' heb' winh soldado yik sb'at heb' yak' owal t'a chonhab' Hai chi', ix sik'anel 30 mil heb' winh soldado winh te jelan t'a owal, ix schekanb'at heb' winh t'ak'walil.
