Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Timnat chi', ix lolon winh yet' ix kob'es chi', ix kannhej snib'ej winh t'a ix.

Haxo yik ix ek'b'at jaye' k'uhal, ayik wan sb'at winhaj Sansón yik ol nupnaj yet' ix filistea chi', ix ek' winh b'aj ix smilcham nok' choj chi'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, ayxo och jun nok' chab' t'a yol sjoyumteal sb'akil nok', te b'ut'an yo'ol chi' yuj yal nok' chab' chi'.

Ix yik'anelta nok' winh, ix sloan winh, ix b'at winh. Haxo ix k'och winh t'a spatik smam snun chi', ix yak'an nok' yalchab' chi' winh slo heb'. Maj yal-laj winh t'a heb' tato ha t'a yol sjoyumteal sb'akil nok' choj ix yik'elta nok' yalchab' chi' winh.
Ix emk'och smam snun winh chi' t'a spat ix kob'es chi', ix yak'anoch jun k'inh yik nupnajel winhaj Sansón chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh kelemtak t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Sansón heb' winh filisteo chi', ix yawtankot 30 heb' winh kelemtak heb' winh yik syil k'inh nupnajel chi' heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Sansón t'a heb' winh kelemtak chi' icha tik: --Ay jun lolonel ol wal t'ayex, a exxo ol he na'a tas syalelk'ochi: Tato ha t'a uke' k'uhal k'inh tik ol eyal tas syalelk'ochi, ol wak' junjunok he pichul nab'a lino yet' junjunok he pichul yik k'inh.

Tato manh ol nachajel eyuj jun, a ex ol eyak' junjunok k'apak nab'a lino chi' t'ayin yet' junjunok mojanh in pichul yik k'inh, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Al naik kab' an, ol kab'i tas jun lolonel chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha t'a junok chiwajum, hata' ix elta tas tz'uk'chaji. Ha t'a jun te ay yip, hata' ix elta tas te chi', xchi winh. Haxo t'a yoxil k'uhal k'inh chi', maj yal-laj spakan jun lolonel chi' heb' winh kelemtak chi'.

Yuj chi' haxo t'a schanhil k'uhal, ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix yetb'eyum winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Montej ab' t'a winh etb'eyum chi' tas syalelk'och jun lolonel ix yal winh t'ayonh, slajwi chi' tzalan t'ayonh. Tato ma'ay, ol ach ko nhustz'a yet' a mam a nun yet' masanil mach ayek' t'a yol a pat tik. Ichato tonhej tzonh eyawtejkot t'a tik, yik tze k'ananek' tas ay t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', wan yok' ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi': --Tzin a chak a ach tik. Max in a xajanejlaj. Ix al jun a lolonel yik snael heb' winh wetchonhab', palta manh wal jab'ok tzal t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, xchi ix t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Max waltax t'a in mam in nun, atob' wal t'ayach ol wala', xchi winh.
Ix och wal ijan ix yok' t'a winh t'a uke' k'uhal chi', yuj chi' haxo t'a yukil k'uhal chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix tas syalelk'ochi. Ixnhej lajwi yab'an ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi'.

Haxo t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a yukil k'uhal chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: Malaj junokxo tas te chi' t'a yichanh nok' yalchab'. Malaj pax junokxo te ay yip t'a yichanh nok' choj, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: Yujnhej to ix he montej eyab' t'a ix wetb'eyum tik, yuj chi' ix nachaj eyalan tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh, ix te och yip winh. Ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Ascalón, ix b'at smak'ancham 30 heb' winh filisteo winh ta'. Ha spichul heb' winh ayochi, a ix yik'elta winh, ix yak'an winh stojolok tas ix yal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', wan ste chichon sk'ol winh ix meltzaj winh t'a spat winh smam.
Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh chi', ha t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a jun k'inh chi', ha t'a winh ix ak'ji ix.

Ix ek' jab'xo tiempo, ix b'atxi winhaj Sansón chi' yil ix yetb'eyum chi' yalani, yet'nak jun nok' yune' chiwa winh. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' wanxo syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim trigo. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh snhi' icha tik: --Tzin nib'ej tzin och wil ix wetb'eyum t'a yol scuarto, xchi winh. Majxo chajiochlaj winh yuj winh snhi' chi'.

Anhej to ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in na'ani to manhxalaj a gana t'a ix, yuj chi' ix wak' ix t'a jun winh ajun het'ok t'a k'inh chi'. Palta ay wal junxo ix snulej ix tzak'anto t'ay, te ek'b'alto swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh ix etb'eyum chi', syal a ix tzik'b'ati, xchi winh snhi' winh chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a winh snhi' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik jun, max yal-laj skotkan t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wutok heb' etchonhab' tik yuj in pakan in b'a, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winh b'i'an, ix b'at syamankot 300 nok' wa'ax winh, ix stzek'anoch junjun tob'an te taj winh t'a snhe chatakwanh nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al te' winh, ix yaktanb'at nok' winh t'a skal ixim strigo heb' winh filisteo chi'. Masanil ixim kunhkunhb'axo yaj sjochchaji yet' ixim ayto'och t'a yok ix tz'ab'ati. Ix tz'apaxb'at te' uwa yet' te' olivo.

Ix och ijan heb' filisteo sk'anb'anek'i mach ix k'ulan jun chi'. Ix alchaj t'a heb' to a winhaj Sansón, yujto ix chichon sk'ol winh yuj tas ix utaj yuj winh snhi', winh aj Timnat, to ix ik'jiek' ix yetb'eyum winh, ix ak'ji ix t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a k'inh yik snupnajel. Yuj chi' ix jawi heb' filisteo snhusantz'a ix ix chi' yet' smam.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Yujto icha tik ix he k'ulej, yuj chi' manh ol in och wa'an ex wixtani, masanto ol wak'kanek' in pak t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix smak'cham winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a Etam.
Ix jawi heb' winh filisteo sb'ok'e scampamento t'a yol yik Judá t'a slak'anil Lehi.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh aj Judá chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj tzex jawi eyak' owal ket'ok? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh filisteo chi': --Ha winhaj Sansón tzul ko yama', ol kak'anoch sya'elal winh, yujto niwan chukal ix yak' winh t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh aj Judá chi', oxe' mil heb' winh ix b'at ilan winhaj Sansón t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a Etam chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tom manh ojtakok to ayonh och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh filisteo tik? ¿Tas yuj tzak'och chukal t'a ko kal yet' heb' winh? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Icha in yutej heb' winh, icha pax ix wutej heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Yuj chi' to tzul ach ko tzek'b'at tiknaik yik b'at ach kak'an t'a heb' winh chi', xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Hak'ek he ti' t'ayin an, tato yel manh ol in he milchamlaj, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, manh ol ach ko milchamlaj, anhej to ol ach ko tzek'b'ati, b'at ach kak'an t'a heb' winh filisteo chi', xchi heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzek'an winh heb' winh t'a chab' ch'anh lasu te ak'to, ix yik'anelta winh heb' winh t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a Lehi chi', ix kot heb' winh filisteo scha heb' winh, toxonhej tz'awaj heb' winh yuj tzalajk'olal. Elanhchamel ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Sansón chi', ix te och yip winh, ix st'inhchitanb'at chab' lasu chi' winh, icha tz'aj snhik'chajb'at junok k'apak k'apak tz'anak, ix em lanhnaj ch'anh t'a sk'ab' winh.
Elanhchamel ix yik'k'e jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru winh, yaxtakto wal jun b'ak chi'. Ha yet' jun b'ak chi', mil heb' winh filisteo chi' ix smak'cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: Anhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru ix wak'lab'ej, kunhkunhb'a ix ajkan heb' chamnak wu'uj. Yujnhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru, mil wal winak ix in mak'chamok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix sjulankanel jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru chi' winh. Yuj chi' a jun lugar chi', Ramat-lehi ix sb'iejkani, syalelk'ochi, “tzalan b'akil yalanh sti' nok' nok'”.

Ix te takji sti' winhaj Sansón chi', yuj chi' ix yawtej Jehová winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha ach ix ak' wip, yuj chi' ix wak' ganar heb' winh filisteo tik, palta ¿tom ol in a cha cham a in a chekab' in tik yuj takinhtial t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pak'k'eta jun ha ha' t'a Lehi chi' yuj Jehová. Ix yuk'an ha' winh, ix jax stzalajk'olal winh, ix te ochxi yip winh ix yab'i. Yuj chi', a jun a yune' ha' chi', En-hakore ix sb'iejkan ha', syalelk'ochi “yuk'b'ila' mach tz'awajk'ei”. Ha jun ha' chi', ix kannhej ha' t'a Lehi chi'.
Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix och winh yajalilok heb' israel chi', yakb'an ayoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
Ay jun k'uhal, ix xit'ek' winhaj Sansón t'a Gaza. Hata' ix yil jun ix ajmul ix winh, ix och winh t'a yol spat ix, ix waykan winh yet' ix t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Gaza chi' to hata' ayek' winh, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak pat chi', ix stanhwan spuertail chonhab' heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Numan yaj heb', ix smaklan heb' yek' ak'wal chi'. Ix sna'an heb' to ha t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u ol smilcham winh heb'.

Palta haxo winhaj Sansón chi', ix stanhwej winh yoch chimilak'wal, ix k'e wa'an winh. Ix b'at winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', ix schokanelta jun niwan puerta chi' winh yet' smarcoal. Ix sjolom jenhjab'an winh, ix b'at yak'ankan winh t'a jolom witz t'a yichanh Hebrón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochpax spensar winh t'a jun ix skuchan Dalila kajan t'a jun ch'olan skuch Sorec.

Yuj chi', ix b'at lolon heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo yet' ix Dalila chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tza montej wal winhaj Sansón chi', tza k'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot jantak yip winh chi', tas wal skutej kak'an ganar winh ko tzek'ani, yik wach' maxtzak yal-laj skolan sb'a winh. Junjun onh ol kak' mil 100 siclo k'e'en plata t'ayach a tojolok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, to tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, ¿ay am wal tas tz'aj a tzek'ji yik maxtzak yal-laj a kolan a b'a? xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tato tzin tzek'chaj t'a ukeok ch'anh ch'anh manto junelok sk'anchaji, tz'el wip tik, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi', a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo chi' ix ik'anb'at uke' ch'anh ch'anh chi' t'a ix Dalila chi', ix stzek'an winhaj Sansón chi' ix.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh toxo ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol spat ix chi', yuj chi' te cha'anh ix el yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. T'a wal jun rato chi', ix st'inhchitanb'at juntzanh ch'anh ch'anh chi' winh. Icha sk'unal st'inhchaj junok anh ch'al tz'a'eltak, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh winh. Haxo heb' filisteo chi' maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' b'ajtil skot yip winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Te chuk ach, ix a musej wal in sat. Ix esej t'ayin. Ha tiknaik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj a tzek'chaji, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Tato tzatz tzin utej a tzek'an yet' ch'anh lasu manta b'aj sk'anchaji, tz'el wip, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.

Yuj chi', ix say juntzanh ch'anh lasu chi' ix, ix stzek'an winh ix t'a ch'anh. Ix helxi yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi' ayxo heb' winh ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol scuarto ix. Icha wal tz'aj st'inhchaj anh ch'al, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh lasu chi' winh.

Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ichanhej tik in ixtani. Tzesejnhej t'ayin. Al wal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj ach ko tzek'ani, xchi ix. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix: --Tato uke' tzutej a pach'uch'an xil in jolom jukan tik yet' anh ch'al, tzatz tzutejkanoch t'a te' jal-lab', tato icha chi', tz'elkan wip, icha wal yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix b'oji way winh yuj ix. Ayik toxo ix way winh chi', ix sjalankanoch xil sjolom winh chi' ix yet' anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab' chi'.
Ix stzatzb'itanem te' jal-lab' chi' ix, ix awaj ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix k'e juknaj winh, ix stok'ank'eta te jal-lab' chi' winh yet' anh ch'al chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha ach tik, te esalwum ach. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to tzin a xajanej? Yoxelalxo in ixtan tik. Manh jab'ok tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, xchi ix.
Junjun k'u aynhejoch ijan ix sk'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', yuj chi' ix tzaktzajk'e winh yet' ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalelta winh, b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Manto junelok sjoxjiel xil in jolom yiktax in alji, yujto ayik manto in alji chi', ix in sik'jikanel yuj Dios yik tzin och nazareoal, syalelk'ochi to yiktaxon Dios waji. Yuj chi' tato ay mach sjoxanel xil in jolom tik, tz'elkan wip chi', icha junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh.

Ix nachajel yuj ix to a tiknaik yel syal winh. Ix yalanb'at ix t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, kotanhek t'a wal junelxo tik, toxo ix yalelta winh tas yuj te ay yip winh chi', xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh yil ix, yet'nak k'e'en tumin heb' winh.

Ix yak'an way winhaj Sansón chi' ix t'a sat xub', ix yawtan jun winh joxwajum ix. Haxo jun winh chi' ix joxanel uke' makan xil sjolom winh pach'uch'ab'il chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel yip winh yuj ix, majxo yal skolan sb'a winh.

Ix awaj ix icha tik: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix el swayanh winh, am sna'an winh to olto yal skolan sb'a winh ichataxon t'a juntak el. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxo ix aktajkan winh yuj Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ja heb' winh filisteo, ix stzek'an winh heb' winh, ix yik'ank'eta yol sat winh heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a chonhab' Gaza. Hata' ix yak'och k'e'en cadena nab'a bronce heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh munlajel t'a k'e'en jaxum trigo t'a yol preso chi'.
Palta haxo xil sjolom winh, ix syamxioch sk'ib'i.

Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto ix yamchaj winhaj Sansón yuj heb', ix yak'an silab' heb' t'a skomon diosal skuch Dagón, ix och ijan heb' sb'itan icha tik: Ha ko diosal tik ix ak'anoch winhaj Sansón t'a yol ko k'ab'. Haton jun winh kajk'o'ol, xchi heb'.

Hanheja' pax heb' anima, ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Sansón chi' heb', ix sb'itan sdiosal heb' icha tik: Ha ko diosal ix ak'anoch jun winh kajk'ol t'a yol ko k'ab', a winh nhusannaktz'a kawb'en. Tzijtum heb' ketchonhab' smak'nakcham winh, xchi heb'.

Ix te tzalaj heb' anima chi', ix sk'anankot winhaj Sansón chi' heb' yik smatz'an winh heb'. Ix yik'anelta winh heb' t'a yol preso, ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a skal snanhal yoyal stemplo heb', yik syixtan winh heb'.
Ix yalan winh t'a jun winh kelem unin et'jinak: --Ik'inb'at t'a yoyal snanhal yol templo tik, t'a juntzanh yipumal yaji yik tzin och ijan jab'ok t'ay, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' yajalil chonhab', molanek' heb' t'a yol templo chi', te b'ut'an yuj anima, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix. Ay am oxe' milok anima ayk'e t'a schab'il piso, wan smatz'an heb' tas tz'utaj winhaj Sansón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Ach in Dios Wajalil, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a nakot t'a junelxo tik, tzak'an wip yik tzin pakan in b'a t'a heb' winh filisteo tik, yujto ix yik'k'eta yol in sat heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix och wetz'wetz' winh t'a chab' niwak yoyal templo chi' t'a snanhal yo'ol, haton juntzanh kuchjinak yalil jun templo chi'.

Ix el yaw winh ix yalan winh: Junnhejokab' tz'aj in cham yet' heb' winh filisteo tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an yip winh yekan lanhchaj chab' niwak yoyal templo chi'. Ix kot lanhnaj templo chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima ayek' ta'. Ek'alto sb'isul anima ix cham yuj winh ayik ix cham winh chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix smak'cham winh ayik pitzanto.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yuk'tak winh yet' sk'ab' yok winh, ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix smukan heb' t'a snanhal Zora yet' Estaol b'aj mukan winh smam winh, haton winhaj Manoa. Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a Israel.
Ha t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Efraín, hata' ek'nak kajan jun winh skuchan Micaía.

Ha jun winh chi', ix yal winh t'a ix snun icha tik: --Ayik ix elk'ajel k'e'en mil cien siclo plata t'ayach, ix a katab'ej jun elk'um chi'. Ix wab' halan juntzanh chi'. Palta a t'ayin ayek' k'e'en, a in ix welk'ej k'e'en t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix snun chi'. Ix yalan ix snun winh chi' t'ay: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh ach wune', xchi ix.

Ayik ix yak'anxi k'e'en winh t'a ix snun chi', ix yalan ix: --Ach wune', a tiknaik a k'e'en tumin tik, swak' k'e'en t'a Jehová, yik sb'oji junok komon Dios tzeyb'il yet' junok sb'oji t'a yol molde, yuj chi' a in swak'xi k'e'en t'ayach, xchi ix.

Palta ix yak'anxi k'e'en plata chi' winh t'a ix snun chi'. Ix yak'an 200 siclo k'e'en ix t'a jun winh b'o'um plata chi', yik sb'oji juntzanh ix yal ix chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch ix t'a yol spat winhaj Micaía chi'.
Ha spat winhaj Micaía chi', spatiltaxon komon Dios. B'ob'ilxo jun chaleka yik sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo yechel yuj winh. Haxo jun winh yuninal winh yak'nakxo'och sacerdoteal.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj sreyal heb' israel, yuj chi' junjun heb' sb'o'an icha tas snib'ej.
Ha t'a chonhab' Belén t'a yol yik Judá, kajan jun winh kelem levita.
Ix el winh t'a yol yik Belén chi', ix b'at winh say b'aj b'at kajnajok. Ix ek'nhej winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix k'och winh t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'.
--¿B'ajtil kajan ach? xchi winhaj Micaía chi' t'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Ha t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá ix in koti. Ha in tik levita in, wan in sayanek' b'aj ol in kajnajok, xchi winh.

--Tato icha chi', kananh wet' t'a in pat tik, yik wach' tzach och in sacerdoteok, icha wal in mam ol ach ajok. Ol wak' lajunheok siclo plata a tojolok t'a junjun ab'il. Ol wak'anpax a pichul yet' a wa'el, xchi winhaj Micaía chi' t'a winh.
Ix scha'an sk'ol winh skan kajan yet' winhaj Micaía chi', icha wal yuninal winh ix yutej winh.
Ix yak'anoch jun winh levita chi' winh sacerdoteok, icha chi' ix aj skajnajkan winh yet' winh.
Ix sna'an winhaj Micaía chi' to ol scha' swach'k'olal Jehová winh, yujto a jun winh levita ayoch sacerdoteok winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj sreyal heb' israel ayochi. Ha heb' yinhtilal Dan, mantalaj smakb'en heb' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, yujto maj yik'ek'laj slum heb' ak'b'il t'ay, yuj chi' wan yek' heb' say b'aj skajnaji.

Yuj chi' ix schekb'at owanh heb' soldado heb' te tek'an, yik sb'at heb' sayoj lum b'aj skajnaji. Ix el heb' owanh chi' t'a chonhab' Zora yet' t'a Estaol, ix ek' heb' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix k'och heb' t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'. Hata' ix kan heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ayik wanxo sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil spat winhaj Micaía chi', ix yab'an heb' slolon winh kelem chi', ix yojtakejel heb' to ch'ok chonhab'il winh, ix b'at sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Mach ach ik'ankot t'a tik? ¿Tas yuj ayachek' t'a tik? ¿Tas tzul a k'ulej? xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuj strato ix sb'o yet' winhaj Micaía chi', yik tz'och winh sacerdoteok winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --k'anb'ej t'a Dios ku'uj, tato wach' ol aj yelk'och jun b'aj wan ko b'at tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Junk'olal tzex b'ati, yujto scha sk'ol Jehová tas wan he k'ulan tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' owanh ilum lu'um chi', ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Lais. Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi' te malaj tas sna heb', icha sb'eyb'al heb' sidonio. Ha heb' chi', ayek' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a junk'olal, malaj jab'ok tas syak' palta t'a heb', te najat skan chonhab' Sidón t'a heb', malaj mach ay yalan yik t'a heb', yik sb'a heb' sch'okoj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj heb' ilum lum chi' t'a Zora yet' t'a Estaol, b'aj aykan juntzanhxo yetb'eyum heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' aykan chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas ix aj b'aj ix ex ko chekb'at chi'? xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' ilum lum chi':

--Ix ek' kil jun makan lum lum chi' smasanil, ix kila' to te wach' lu'um. Koyek, b'at kak'ek owal yet' heb' kajan ta'. Malaj mach tonhej skan k'ojan t'a tik tato malaj jab'ok tas sk'ulej. Koyek kik'ek' jun lu'um chi'.
Ha heb' anima kajan ta', junk'olal yaj heb', te lewan lu'um, malaj tas syak' palta ta'. Ha Dios ol ak'an lum t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay 600 heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Dan ix el t'a Zora yet' t'a Estaol chi', yet'nak yalyuninal junjun heb'. Te ay syamk'ab' heb' yik owal smasanil.
Ix k'och heb' t'a Quiriat-jearim t'a yol yik Judá. Ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a Quiriat-jearim chi', haton jun lugar chi' scampamento winhaj Dan ix sb'iejkani.
Ix helxi heb' ta', ix ek' heb' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil spat winhaj Micaía.

Ha heb' owanh xit'nakek' iloj lum t'a Lais chi', ix yal heb' t'a heb' yetb'eyum chi': --Ab'ek, ha t'a yol juntzanh pat tik ay jun chaleka yet' jun yechel tzeyb'il ayoch plata t'ay yet' jun komon Dios b'ob'il t'a yol molde. Ay pax juntzanhxo komon Dios. ¿Tas wal ol ko k'ulok yet'ok tze na'a? xchi heb'.
Ix b'at heb' owanh xit'nakek' iloj lum chi' b'aj kajan jun winh kelem levita chi' t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'. Ix k'och heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' janik' sk'o'ol winh.
Haxo heb' 600 soldado yinhtilal Dan chi', wan stanhwankan heb' t'a sti' puerta, yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Haxo heb' owanh chi', ix k'e heb' t'a yol pat yik syik'anelta juntzanh tik heb': Jun yechel tzeyb'il, jun yechel b'ob'il t'a yol molde, jun chaleka yet' juntzanhxo kotak komon Dios. Ix yik'anelta juntzanh chi' heb' yakb'an ayek' winh sacerdote chi' yet' heb' 600 soldado chi' t'a ti' pat chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh sacerdote chi' to ix och heb' chi' t'a yol spat winhaj Micaía chi' yik syik'anelta juntzanh tastak chi' heb', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas tze k'ulej chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Tz'in xa chi, anhej to tzach b'at ket'ok. Sko nib'ej tzach och ko sacerdoteok, icha ko mam ol ach ajok. ¿Tom manh wach'ok tzab'i to tzach och sacerdoteal t'a junok makan yinhtilal Israel, t'a yichanh to anhej t'a junok patil anima? xchi heb'.
Ix scha sk'ol winh sacerdote tas ix yal heb' chi'. Ix yik'anek' juntzanh chi' winh t'a heb'. Ix och winh t'a skal heb', ix b'at winh yet' heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb', b'ab'el heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yet' sk'a'el heb'. Tzak'anxo ix b'at heb' soldado.
Najattakxo ix b'at heb', ichato chi' ix smolb'an sb'a winhaj Micaía yet' heb' yetchonhab', ix b'at heb' syam heb' yalani.

Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a spatik heb' ix awaj heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal Dan chi', ix meltzajkot k'elan heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winhaj Micaía chi': --¿Tas tzach ik'ani yuj chi' het'nak juntzanh anima tik? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb': --Ha ex tik ix eyik'kot in diosal ix in b'o'o, ix eyik'anpaxkot winh in sacerdote, manhxo jab'ok tas ix eyaktejkan t'ayin, tze tek'b'an he b'a he k'anb'an t'ayin tas tzin ik'ani, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Malaj ko gana to sk'e a jaj awaj t'ayonh, yujto ha t'a ko kal tik ay heb' winh utzin sk'o'ol, haxo ta tz'aji tzach satel heb' winh yet' heb' ajun tik het'ok, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Micaía chi' to te niwan heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix meltzaj winh t'a spat. Haxo heb' yinhtilal Dan chi' ix b'atnhejkan heb' b'aj wan sb'at chi'.

Ix yik'anb'at juntzanh tastak sb'onak winhaj Micaía chi' heb' yet' winh sacerdote masanto ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Lais. Ha masanil heb' anima kajan t'a Lais chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas sna' heb', yuj chi' te sekojtak ix aj satel heb', ix nhusjipaxtz'a schonhab' heb' chi' yuj heb' yinhtilal Dan chi'.

Ha chonhab' Lais chi', ha t'a yol yik Bet-rehob skani, te najatto ay t'a Sidón, malaj junok mach ay yalan yik t'a heb', yuj chi' malaj mach ix kolan heb'. Ha heb' yinhtilal Dan chi', ix sb'oxik'e jun chonhab' chi' heb', ix kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, Lais sb'i jun chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an sb'iej Dan, yik syak' b'inaj sb'i winh smam yicham heb', haton winhaj Dan yuninal winhaj Israel.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun yechel yet'nak heb' chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay. Haxo sacerdote heb', haton winhaj Jonatán yinhtilal Gersón yuninal winhaj Moisés. Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix ochnhej heb' sacerdoteal t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan chi' masanto ayik ix ik'jib'at heb' israel t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha jun yechel ix sb'o winhaj Micaía chi', a ix och sdiosalok heb' yinhtilal Dan t'a masanil tiempo yakb'an ayek' skajnub' Dios t'a Silo.
Ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel, ay jun winh levita najattak yajkanb'at t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Tonhej skomon b'eyek' winh. Ay jun ix aj Belén t'a yol yik Judá ix yik' winh.
Palta ix mulan ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh, yuj chi' ix pax ix t'a spat winh smam t'a Belén chi'. Ayik toxo ix el schanhil ujal yajek' ix ta',
ix k'ochxi winh levita chi' smontejxi ix, talaj skotxi ix yet' winh. Yet'nak jun winh schekab' winh yet' chawanh nok' b'uru. Ix chaji winh yuj ix t'a spat winh smam chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix chajipax winh t'a tzalajk'olal yuj winh smam ix chi'. Ix yalan winh smam ix chi' to skan winh yet' heb'. Yuj chi' oxe' k'uhal ix kan winh yet' winh schekab' chi' t'a spat winh smam ix chi'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', ix waypax heb' ta'.

Haxo t'a schanhil k'uhal jun, ix k'e wa'an winh t'a k'inhib'alil yik smeltzaj heb' winh yalani. Ayik wanxo smeltzaj heb' chi', ix yalan winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay: --Waek junok eyo'och ichato chi' tzex b'ati yik wach' ay eyip ol ex b'eyok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix em k'ojan heb' swa'i, ix yuk'an ha' heb', ix och tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay to skan junokxo ak'wal winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Wach'chom ix k'e linhan winh yik smeltzaj winh sna'ani, palta ix ochxi tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay, yuj chi' ix kanxi winh.

Haxo t'a yo'il k'uhal jun, ix k'e wa'an winh t'a k'inhib'alil yik smeltzaji, palta ix ochxi tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay yik swa'i, ichato chi' smeltzaj winh yik wach' ay yip winh sb'at t'a yoltak b'e. Ix wa heb' yakb'an wan sk'e k'u.

Haxo ix k'e wa'an winh yik smeltzaj heb' yalani. Ix yalanxi winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay to toxo ix k'e k'u, ix ochxi tean winh t'a winh yik skanxi winh t'a junxo ak'wal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal, haxo t'a junxo k'u, sakb'i sb'at heb'.

Palta haxo pax winh levita chi', majxo yal-laj sk'ol winh ix kan t'a junxo ak'wal chi', palta ix meltzajxonhej winh yet' ix ix chi' yet' winh schekab' winh chi' yet' chawanh nok' sb'uru winh ayoch stz'u'um. Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh Jebús, haton chonhab' Jerusalén, wanxo yem k'u.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi' t'a winh levita chi': --¿Tas am xa chi, tato tzonh kan t'a chonhab' Jebús tik t'a jun ak'wal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh levita chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, max onh kanlaj wayanh t'a junok chonhab' to manhok heb' ketisraelal kajan t'ay. Ol onh b'atnhej masanto ol onh k'och t'a chonhab' Gabaa.
Ha t'a Gabaa chi' ol onh wayok, ma t'a Ramá, xchi winh.
Ix b'atnhej heb'. Wanxo sk'ik'b'i ix k'och heb' t'a Gabaa chi', t'a yol yik Benjamín.
Ix elkan heb' t'a yol b'e, ix b'atkan heb' t'a Gabaa. Hata' ol way heb' sna'ani. Ix b'at em k'ojan heb' t'a mercado t'a jun chonhab' chi', yujto malaj mach ix ak'an sposado heb'.

Haxo yik wanxo sk'e ak'wal ix ek' jun winh icham winak spetoj t'a smunlajel. Ha t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín ay schonhab' winh, palta kajan winh t'a Gabaa t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín t'a jun pekti' chi'.
Ayik ix yilanoch jun winh levita chi' winh icham winak chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ex koti, b'ajpax tzex b'ati? xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh levita chi' icha tik: --Tonhej tzonh ek' t'a tik. Ko petoj t'a Belén. Wan ko pax t'a ko chonhab' najat t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix onh ek' jaye' k'uhal t'a Belén chi', haxo tiknaik jun, wan ko b'at t'a skajnub' Jehová, palta malaj junok mach tz'ak'an ko posado t'a tik.
Ay yanh nok' in b'uru tik, ay pax ko wa'el yet' ix wetb'eyum tik yet' winh in chekab' tik. Malaj tas syak' palta t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh: --Malaj tas tza na', a in ol wak' masanil tas ol och eyuj, max yal in k'ol tzex kan t'a mercado tik t'a t'ak'walil tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at heb' winh icham chi' t'a spat, ix yak'an swa'el nok' sb'uru winh chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'ikan yok heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an a heb'.

Yakb'an wan stzalaj heb', ix ja nhilnaj juntzanh heb' winh puch winak aj chonhab' chi' t'a spatiktak te' pat chi'. Ix och ijan heb' sponhub'tanhan och te' puerta chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icham winak chi': --Hak'elta jun winh ix waykan chi' t'ayach. Ko gana skixtej winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ix elta winh aj pat chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ma'ay ex wetanimail. Manh he na eyak' chukal chi' t'a jun winh anima ayek' posado tik t'ayin.

Ina jun ix wisil kob'esto yet' pax jun ix ix yet'nak jun winh winak tik. Ha heb' ix tik, syal wak'anel heb' ix t'ayex yik tze k'ulan tas he gana chi' t'a heb' ix, palta manh he k'ulej chukal chi' t'a jun winh tik, xchi winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' winh tas ix yal winh icham winak chi'. Ix spechanelta ix yetb'eyum winh levita chi' t'a yol calle. Ix yixtan ix heb' winh ix ek' ak'wal, masanto ix sakb'i, ichato chi' ix yaktankan ix heb' winh.
Wanxo sakb'i, ix b'at ix t'a spat winh icham winak b'aj ayek' winh yetb'eyum chi', haxo yik k'och ix t'a ti' pat chi', ix telwi ix, ix cham ix.

Ayik ix k'e wa'an winh levita chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix sjakan spuertail te' pat chi' winh yik smeltzaji. Ix yilan winh, pak'jab'ek' ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a ti' pat chi', jichankanb'at sk'ab' ix t'a yib'anh smarcoal sti' te' pat chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --K'e'anh wa'an, konh, xchi winh t'a ix. Palta majxo tak'woklaj ix. Ix yik'ank'e wan sniwanil ix chi' winh, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix yik'anb'at winh t'a spat.
Ayik ix k'och winh t'a spat chi', ix xikanb'at sniwanil ix yetb'eyum winh chi'. Lajchawe' ix yutej winh xikanb'ati. Ix laj yak'anb'at winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' yetisraelal.
Ha masanil heb' ix ilan jun chi', ix yalan heb': --Yiktax kelnakkot t'a Egipto, mantalaj b'aj ix kil junok icha jun tik. Yowalil scham wal ko na'anek tas ol ko k'ulejek yet'ok, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa, junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb'. Ix kot heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan t'a norte, heb' ay t'a Beerseba t'a sur yet' heb' ay t'a Galaad t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel schonhab' Dios, ayek' molan heb' ta'. Ay am 400 mil heb' soldado yet'nakxo syamk'ab' yik owal.

(Ix yab' spekal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín to ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yetisraelal heb' t'a Mizpa.) Haxo heb' yajalil heb' israel chi' ix halani, tato ay heb' ojtannak tas ix aj yuji jun chukal chi', syal yalan heb'.
Haxo winh yetb'eyum ix chamnak chi' ix halani: --Ix in jawi yet' ix wetb'eyum chi' t'a chonhab' Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín yik tzin waykan ta'.

Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh winak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a spatiktak te' pat b'aj ay in ek' chi', yik tzin smilancham heb' winh yalani. Ix och ijan heb' winh yixtan ix wetb'eyum chi', masanto ix cham ix yuj heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix wik'kot sniwanil ix chi', ix in xikanb'ati. Ix wak'anb'at t'a masanil yol ko makb'en, yik wach' tzeyil he masanil tas ix aj yoch jun niwan mul te chukxo pax tik.
Haxo tiknaik yujto wetisraelal ex, a ex ol he na'a, ol eyala' tas ol aj jun tik, xchi winh.
Junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Malaj junok onh tzonh pax t'a ko pat masanto ol yal sb'a tas ol aj jun tik.
Ha tiknaik a tas sko k'ulej to tz'och suerte t'a ko kal yik wach' ol kila' mach onh ol onh b'at kak' owal t'a chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Junjun winak t'a skal lajlajunhwanh winak t'a junjun inhtilal skan t'a yib'anh sayan ko wa'el a onh soldado onh tik. Ha onhxo ko masanil, ol onh b'at kak'ek' spak t'a heb' aj Gabaa yuj jun chukal ix sk'ulej heb' chi', xchi heb'.
Junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' israel chi' yik ix b'at heb' yak' owal t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a masanil yol yik Benjamín. Ix ek' yalan heb' icha tik: Yelxo wal te chuk tas ix sk'ulej jaywanh heb' winak aj Gabaa.

Yuj chi' a tiknaik, a juntzanh winak ix k'ulan chukal t'a he kal chi', ik'ekelta heb', tzeyak'anoch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab' yik sko milancham heb', icha chi' ol aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'. Maj schalaj yab' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'.
Palta to ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado heb' t'a Gabaa chi' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal chi'.
Ay am 26 mil heb' soldado ix kot t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal. Ch'ok pax yaj 700 heb' soldado te jelan, aj Gabaa chi' heb'.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' soldado chi', 700 heb' to ha t'a sk'exanh sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejme'ech. Te tojol sjulwaj heb', wach'chom a junok tas te xi' sjul heb', palta syamchaj yuj heb'.
Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' israel chi', ay am 400 mil heb' soldado te k'ajan t'a owal, malaj heb' aj Benjamín chi' t'a skal heb'.

Ix b'at heb' israel chi' b'aj ayek' skajnub' Dios yik sk'anb'an heb' mach inhtilal heb' sb'ab'laj och yak' owal yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Ix yalan Jehová to a heb' yinhtilal Judá sb'ab'laj ochi.
Ix k'e wa'an heb' israel chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix b'at sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a yichanh chonhab' Gabaa chi'.
Ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' t'a yichanh chonhab' chi' yik syak'an owal heb'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', ix elta heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 22 mil heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' ix smilchamok.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' israel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, kusk'olal yaj heb' ix ek' k'u, masanto ix k'ik'b'iemi. Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a Jehová: ¿Tzam onh b'atxi kak' owal yet' heb' ketisraelal yinhtilal Benjamín? xchi heb'. Ix yalan Jehová: Ixikek, xchi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix yik'anxi yip heb', haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'at heb' yak'xi owal yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Hanheja' b'aj ix och heb' t'a sb'ab'elal, hata' ix ochxi heb'.
Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi', ix elixta heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi' yak' owal yet' heb'. 18 mil soldado yetisraelal heb' chi' ix smilchamok.

Yuj chi', ix b'atxi heb' soldado smasanil yet' masanil heb' chonhab' t'a skajnub' Dios. Ix ochxi heb' t'a kusk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Pilan k'u maj wa jab'ok heb'. Ix snhusan silab' heb', ix yak'anpax silab' heb' yik junk'olal.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a te' skaxail strato Jehová, ayek' te' t'a skajnub' Dios chi'. Ha winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar, yixchikin winhaj Aarón ayoch sacerdoteal. Ix sk'anb'an heb' israel chi' t'a Jehová tato syal yak'anxi owal chi' heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', mato manhxo. Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb': Hak'ek owal yet' heb', a k'ik'an swak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab', xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at juntzanh heb' soldado yik Israel sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb', ix b'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' soldado yik Benjamín chi'. Ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' aj Gabaa chi', icha ix yutej sb'a heb' t'a sb'ab'elal yet' t'a schaelal.

Ix elixta heb' yik Benjamín chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yak' owal yet' heb'. Najat ix kot heb' yak' owal yet' heb' yetisraelal chi'. Ix to wal yak' ganar heb' smilancham 30-xo heb' israel t'a yol sb'e'al Betel yet' t'a yol sb'e'al Gabaa yet' b'aj manhxa mach kajan.

Ha wal sna'an heb' to wan yel heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'ay, wan yak'an ganar heb' sna'ani, icha ix yak' heb' t'a sb'ab'elal yet' t'a schaelal, palta tonhej ix stz'akel sb'a heb' soldado israel chi', yakb'an wan skot heb' t'a yoltak b'e najat t'a stiel chonhab'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' israel chi' t'a slak'anil Baal-tamar, elanhchamel ix sb'oxioch sb'a heb' yak' owal chi'. Ix elpaxkot heb' ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Lajunhe' mil heb' sik'b'ilel t'a skal masanil soldado yik Israel ix och t'a chonhab' chi' yak' owal, yelk'olal ix te och yip owal chi'. Ha heb' yik Benjamín najat ix b'at chi', max snalaj heb' tato wan satel heb'.

Yuj Jehová ix yak' ganar heb' israel chi' t'a heb' yik Benjamín chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 25 mil yet' 100-xo heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi' ix chami. Ichato chi' ix yilanelta sb'a heb' to wan yak'ji ganar heb'.

Icha tik ix aj yoch owal chi'. Ha t'a sb'ab'elal, a heb' soldado israel chi' najat ix el heb' t'a yichanh heb' yik Benjamín chi', yujto yipk'olal yaj heb' winh ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi', yik satel jun chonhab' chi' heb'.
Haxo heb' soldado ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a chi', elanhchamel ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' anima chi' heb'.

Ha heb' ix sk'ub'ejkanel sb'a chi', lajti' yaj heb' yet' heb' soldado yetb'eyum heb' to ayik ol och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ol yak' cheklaj k'e stab'il heb', yik wach' snachajel yuj heb' chi' to toxo ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ha wal yik wan yel heb' israel t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', ix yilan jun niwan tab' chi' heb', yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb', ix stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Toxo ix cham 30 heb' yuj heb' yik Benjamín chi', yuj chi' ix sna' heb' yik Benjamín chi' to wan yak'an ganar heb', icha ix yak' heb' t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix k'e juyuyok tab' t'a chonhab' chi'. Ayik ix yilanb'at heb' yik Benjamín chi' t'a spatik, juyuyi sk'e stab'il schonhab' heb' chi' t'a cha'anh.
Icha wal chi' ix aj stek'b'an sb'a heb' israel t'a yichanh heb' yik Benjamín chi', ix te xiwk'e heb' yik Benjamín chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to wan yak'ji ganar heb'.

Yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', ix b'atkan heb' b'aj sb'atkan sb'e'al tzinan lu'um, palta maxtzak yal-laj yel heb' yujto ix yamji heb'. Ix miljicham heb' yuj heb' israel tz'elta t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi'.
Ix oymaj heb' israel chi' t'a spatiktak heb'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' smasanil, ix pechji heb' yuj heb' b'aj syik' yip heb' anima masanto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Gabaa chi'
Hata' ix cham 18 mil heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal k'e'en tenam skuch Rimón, palta oye' mil heb' chi' ix cham t'a yoltak b'e. Ix ochnhej heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb' ixto kan chi', masanto t'a Gidom. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel chi'. Chab'to mil heb' soldado chi' ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi', 25 mil heb' soldado yik Benjamín chi' ix chami, haton heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Palta 600 to heb' winh ix b'atkan elelal t'a tzinan lu'um. Chanhe' ujal ix aj heb' winh t'a k'e'en tenam skuchan Rimón chi'.

Haxo heb' israel ix b'at heb' t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', ix xikancham masanil anima heb' yet' masanil nok' molb'etzal nok'. Ix snhusanpaxtz'a junjun chonhab' heb' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
Ha masanil heb' israel chi', ix yak' sti' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa to malaj junok heb' ol yak' yisil yetb'eyumok heb' yinhtilal Benjamín.
Ayik ix lajwi owal chi', ix smolan sb'a heb' israel chi' t'a yichanh Dios t'a skajnub', masanto ix k'ik'b'i, ix ok' wal heb' sik'lab'il, ix yalan heb':
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal ach, ¿tas wal yuj ix jawi jun tik t'a kib'anh? ¿Tas wal yuj wan satel jun kinhtilal a onh israel onh tik? xchi heb'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wa'an heb', ix sb'oank'e jun altar heb', ix snhusantz'a silab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'anpax silab' heb' yik junk'olal.

Ix och ijan heb' sk'anb'an yab'i: ¿Mach heb' ketchonhab' maj xit'ek' ket'ok t'a molchajel t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa? xchi heb'. Yujto yak'nak sti' heb', tato ay mach max b'at t'a jun molchajel chi', smiljichamok.
Te kusk'olal yaj heb' yuj tas ix sk'ulej heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Ix och ijan heb' yalani: Ha wal t'a jun k'u tik ix satel jun inhtilal t'a ko kal.
¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej yik tz'ochxi yetb'eyum heb' winh ixto kan chi'? Ha onh tik ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj junok onh ol kak' heb' ix kisil yetb'eyumok heb' winh.

¿Ay am heb' ketisraelal maj xit'ek' ket'ok t'a Mizpa molchajel t'a yichanh Jehová? xchi heb'. Haxo ix sna'ankot heb' to a heb' kajan t'a Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad, malaj junok heb' ix xit'ek' t'a molchajel chi'.
Ayik ix awtaj lista, malaj junok heb' aj Jabes chi' ix tak'wi.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix schekanb'at 12 mil soldado heb', yik b'at miljicham masanil heb' aj Jabes chi', masanil heb' winak, heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ix ix ayxo winak sk'umej.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' aj Jabes chi', ix ilchaj 400 heb' ix kob'estak mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik, ix ik'jikot heb' ix t'a campamento t'a Silo t'a yol yik Canaán.

Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' chonhab' chi', ix schekb'at yalumal heb' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín aykanb'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a k'e'en tenam skuchan Rimón, ix b'at ik'chajkot heb' winh t'a junk'olal.
Yuj chi' ix meltzajkot heb' winh aj Benjamín chi'. Haxo heb' israel ix ak'an heb' ix kob'estak ix yik'kot heb' t'a Jabes chi' yetb'eyumok heb'. Palta ayto maj tz'akwok yik'an yetb'eyum heb' smasanil.
Ha masanil heb' israel chi' ix ok' sk'ol heb' yuj heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', yujto ix satjiel jun inhtilal chi' yuj Jehová.

Haxo heb' yajal yaj t'a kal chonhab' chi' ix sk'anb'ej heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal ol aj yilchajpax heb' ix yetb'eyum juntzanhxo heb' winh ix kan tik, yujto masanil heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh, ix cham heb' ix smasanil?
Ha yuj juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan chi', yuj chi' olto pitzwokcha'anh jun inhtilal tik, yik max satel t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik.

Palta a onh tik, max yal-laj kak'an heb' ix kisil yik tz'och yetb'eyumok heb' winh, yujto ko masanil ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Dios to max kak'laj heb' ix kisil t'a heb' winh, yuj chi' a mach syak' yisil, skotkan katab' t'a yib'anh.

Palta junjun ab'il ay jun niwan k'inh tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Silo, haton jun ay t'a snorteal Betel, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a b'e sb'at t'a Betel chi' sk'och t'a Siquem, t'a stojolal sur yik Lebona, xchi heb'.
Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel chi', ix yalb'at jun lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi': Tzex b'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a skaltak te' uwa t'a slak'anil Silo.

Wach' tzeyutej he k'ub'anel he b'a ta', lista eyaji. Ayik ol eyilan yelta nhililok heb' ix kob'estak aj Silo chanhal ta', tzex elta b'aj k'ub'an ex chi', tzeyik'ankot junjunok heb' ix eyetb'eyumok. Slajwi chi' tzex paxkan t'a he chonhab'.

Tato ol jawok heb' winh smam, ma heb' winh snulej heb' ix kob'estak chi' yal t'ayonh, ol kalan t'a heb': Sko k'an niwank'olal t'ayex t'a spatik heb' winh, yujto maj ilchaj yetb'eyum heb' winh smasanil ku'uj, ayik ix och owal t'a Jabes. Hanhejtona', tik wal manhok ex ix eyak' heb' ix t'a heb' winh, yuj chi' max ochlaj he mul b'aj ix eyak' he ti', xko cham t'a heb', xchi heb' yajalil Israel chi'.

Ix scha'an sk'ol heb' winh yik Benjamín chi' sk'ulan icha ix alchaj chi'. Yuj chi' junjun heb' winh ix yik'b'at junjun heb' ix kob'estak chi' ayik wan schanhalwi heb' ix. Ix yik'anb'at heb' ix heb' winh t'a elanhchamel t'a schonhab', ix sb'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' winh chi' yik skajnajxi heb' winh ta'.
Hanheja' juntzanhxo heb' winh yetisraelal heb' winh chi', ix meltzajpax junjun heb' winh t'a slu'um yet' t'a spat.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' mantalaj sreyal heb' israel, junjun heb' sk'ulej icha tas snib'ej.

Ayik ayoch heb' juez yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, ix jawi jun niwan wejel t'a chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh aj chonhab' Belén t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at kajnaj winh yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' chawanh yuninal t'a yol yik Moab yuj jun wejel chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', Elimelec sb'i winh, haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, Noemí sb'i ix. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh chi', haton winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión. Aj Efrata heb', Belén pax sb'i. Ix b'atkan kajan heb' t'a yol yik Moab chi'. Lajunhe' ab'il ix ek' heb' ta'. Yakb'an ayek' heb' chi' ta', ix cham winhaj Elimelec yetb'eyum ix Noemí chi', ix kan ix yet' chawanh heb' winh yune' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix och yetb'eyum heb' winh schawanhil. Ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab chi', jun ix skuch Orfa, haxo junxo ix skuch Rut.
Haxo ix aji, ix champax winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión chi', yuj chi' ix kan ix Noemí sch'okoj, yujto ix cham heb' winh yune' ix chi', ix champax winh yetb'eyum ix.
Haxo ix yab'an ix Noemí chi' to ix ok'xi sk'o'ol Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel, manhxalaj wejel ta'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj ix t'a Judá yet' chawanh heb' ix yalib' chi'.

Ayik wan skot heb' ix t'a yoltak b'e, ix yalan ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, paxanhek t'a spat he mam he nun. Ha Jehová ol och heyet'ok yujto wach'nhej ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin yet' t'a heb' winh wune'.
Aokab' Jehová ol och heyet'ok yik ol ochxok eyetb'eyum, wach'nhej ol aj eyajxiek' t'a he pat, xchi ix. Ix tz'ub'anelta sti' heb' ix yalib' ix chi', ix syamanoch heb' ix yok'i.
Ix yalan heb' ix icha tik: --Max onh kanlaj. Ol onh b'at het'ok t'a a chonhab' chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a heb' ix: --Ex walib', paxanhek t'a he pat. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzex och tzak'an wu'uj? Malaj wune' toxo tz'aji yik tzeyik'lan he b'a yet'ok.
Yuj chi' ixikek, paxanhek t'a he pat. Yujto a in tik, chichim inxo, manhxo ol ochlaj wetb'eyum. Wach'chom swal tiknaik to ha t'a jun ak'wal tik ol och wetb'eyum, olto aljok wune', ta xin chi,

¿palta tom olto he tanhwej sk'ib' heb' winh, yik ol eyik'an he b'a yet' heb' winh? ¿Tom yujnhej he tanhwani, manhxo ol och eyetb'eyum? Ma'ay ex walib', manh ol yal-laj icha chi'. Ha in tik, wiktaxon yaj ya'elal ix yak'kot Jehová t'a wib'anh. Ol am in te kus eyu'uj tato ol wila'' to ol eyab' sya'il, xchi ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi'.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' ix yok'i. Ixlajwi chi', haxo ix Orfa ix tz'ub'ankanelta sti' ix, ix meltzaj ix. Haxo pax ix Rut jun, ix kannhej ix yet' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix Noemí chi' t'a ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Tzam ila' to a ix a mu' toxo ix pax ix t'a schonhab' yet' t'a sdiosal, ixik pax a ach tik, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Manh ach och ijan halan t'ayin yik tzach waktejkani. Yalnhej b'aj ol ach b'atok, ol in b'atnhej het'ok. Ha b'aj ol ach ajok, hata' ol in aj pax het'ok. Ha a chonhab', a ol och in chonhab'ok, a a Diosal, a ol ochpax in Diosalok.
Ha b'aj ol ach chamok, hata' ol in champaxok, hata' ol in muknajok. Yak'okab' in ya'elal Jehová tato tzach waktejkani, masanto a chamel ol ik'an ko pojan ko b'a, xchi ix Rut chi'.
Haxo ix yilan ix Noemí chi' to ay wal och t'a sk'ol ix Rut chi' sb'at yet'ok, manhxalaj tas ix yal ix t'a ix.

Ix b'eyxikot heb' ix schawanhil, masanto ix jawi heb' ix t'a Belén. Ayik ix jawi heb' ix ta', masanil heb' anima ay ta' ix te sat sk'ol heb'. Ix yalan heb' ix ix icha tik: --¿Mantok a ix Noemí tik? xchi heb' ix.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' ix icha tik: --Manhxo eyal Noemí t'ayin, palta Mara tzeyak' in b'iej, yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix ak'an in ya'elal.

Ayik ix in b'at t'a tik, manh jantakok tas ay t'ayin, haxo yik tzin meltzaj tik, manhxalaj jab'ok. Icha chi' ix el t'a sk'o'ol Jehová sjawi t'a wib'anh, ¿tasto wal yuj tzeyal Noemí chi' t'ayin yujto toxo ix ja t'a wib'anh wab'an sya'il yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil? xchi ix.
Ichaton chi' ix aj sjawi ix Noemí yet' ix Rut t'a Belén chi', spetoj heb' ix t'a yol yik Moab. Ha ix jawi heb' ix chi', wan wal syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim cebada.
Ay jun winh skuchan Booz, ayto yuj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Elimelec yetb'eyumkan ix Noemí chi'. Te b'eyum winh, niwan yelk'och winh t'a schonhab' chi'.

Ix yal ix Rut chi' t'a ix Noemí icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, komonok tzin a chab'ati, b'at wila'' talaj ay b'aj wan sjochchaj ixim cebada, talaj scha sk'ol heb' winh aj munlajel chi' tzin sik' jaye'ok sjolom kik t'a spatiktak heb' winh, xchi ix. --Ixik, xchi ix.

Ix b'at ix Rut chi' b'aj wan sjochchaj ixim cebada chi', ix och ijan ix sik'an ixim skan yuj heb' winh sjochan ixim chi'. k'okb'il wal a jun munlajel b'aj ix k'och ix chi' yik winhaj Booz, haton jun winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh xilb'a Elimelec chi'.

Ayik wan sik'an ixim ix, ix k'och winhaj Booz chi', spetoj winh t'a Belén. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' smunlajwum chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová ayoch heyet'ok, xchi winh. --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach, xchi heb' munlajwum chi' t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh ayoch yil heb' smunlajwum chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun ix kob'es chi'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Haton jun ix aj Moab ix jawi yet' ix Noemí.

Ix sk'an spermiso ix t'ayin yik tzek' ix t'a skal ixim jochb'ilxo, yik sik'ancha'anh ixim skan yuj heb' munlajwum tik ix. Atax t'a k'inhib'alil ix jawi ix, max och wa'an ix sik'ancha'anh ixim, hato wal yik'an yip ix tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ach ix, ab' tas ol wala': Manhxo ach b'at a sik'cha'anh ixim cebada tik t'a yik junokxo mach, palta kananh yet' heb' ix in chekab' tik.

Ha yet' heb' ix ol ach b'at b'aj sjochwi cebada heb' winh in munlajwum tik. Toxo ix wal t'a heb' winh to malaj tas syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ayik stakji a ti', syal ik'anelta ha' uk' t'a yol ch'ub' b'aj syik'elta yik heb' winh in munlajwum chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
Ayik ix yab'an ix icha chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj te wach' tzutej a k'o'ol t'ayin, ina to a in tik ch'ok chonhab'il in? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Yujto ix wab' masanil tas ix a k'ulej t'a ix alib' atax yik ix cham winh etb'eyum, ix aktejkan a mam a nun yet' a chonhab' b'aj aljinak ach, ix ach ja t'a ko chonhab' to manh ojtakoktaxon tik.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik tz'ak'an spak t'ayach yuj tas ix a k'ulej chi', syak'an swach'k'olal t'ayach, haton ko Diosal b'aj ix ach jawi a kol a b'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi ix icha tik: --Mamin, ste tzalaj in k'o'ol yuj tas tzal tik t'ayin, te wach' tzutej a k'o'ol t'ayin wach'chom manh in lajanok yet' junok heb' ix a chekab' tik, xchi ix.

Ayik ix k'och yorail swa heb', ix yawtejkot ix Rut chi' winh wa'el, ix yalanh winh icha tik: --Kotanh, wa''anh ket'ok. Lab'ejem ixim a pan chi' t'a skal vinagre tik, xchi winh. Ix em k'ojan ix t'a stz'ey heb' munlajwum chi', ix yak'an ixim mayb'il cebada winh t'a ix, yik sk'ux ix yet' swa'el chi'. Ix wa ix masanto ix b'ut'ji ix, ayto maj lajwilaj yuj ix.

Ayik ix b'atxi ix sik'oj cebada chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a heb' winh smunlajwum chi' icha tik: --Ha ixim somchajb'at t'a skal ixim manojaxo yaj chi', syal sik'an ixim ix. Manh eyak' k'ixwelal ix.
Syal eyaktankan junjunok ixim manojaxo yaj chi' yik sik'cha'anh ixim ix. Manh he tumej ix, xchi winh.
Haxo yik wanxo yem k'u, ix yaktan ix sik'an ixim, ix smak'anel ixim ix, ay am oxeok almul ixim ix yik' ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj ix t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix sch'oxan ix t'a ix yalib' chi' jantak ixim ix yik' ix. Yet'nak pax ixim mayb'il cebada chi' ix t'a ix yalib' chi', haton ixim maj lajwoklaj sk'uxan ix chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an ix yalib' ix chi' t'ay: ¿Mach ay yik b'aj ach xit'ek' chi'? ¿B'ajtil ix a sik' ixim cebada tik? Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun mach wach' ix yutej sb'a chi' t'ayach, xchi ix. Ix yalan ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ha jun winh ay yik b'aj in xit'ek' chi', Booz sb'i winh, xchi ix.

Ix yalanxi ix yalib' ix chi' icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Booz chi', yujto wach' syutej spensar winh t'ayonh a onh pitzan onh tik, icha yutejnak spensar winh t'a heb' winh ko chamnak. Ix yalanxi ix: --Ha winh chi' te ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winh, yuj chi' smoj ton skolwaj winh t'ayonh, xchi ix.
Ix yalan ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ix yalpax winh t'ayin icha tik: Syal a kotnhej a sik' ixim, anhej yet' heb' ix in chekab' tik tzach b'ati, masanto ol lajwok munlajel tik, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi ix yalib' ix chi': Wach' jun ach walib', wach' tato tzach b'atnhej yet' heb' ix schekab' winh chi', max ach b'atlaj t'a junokxo ch'ok, yik wach' malaj mach tzach tzuntzani, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej ix Rut yet' heb' ix schekab' winhaj Booz chi', masanto ix lajwi sjochchaj ixim cebada yet' ixim trigo. Aynhejek' ix Rut yet' ix yalib' chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal ix Noemí t'a ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ach Rut, smoj tzin say junok etb'eyum nu yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach aji.
Ha winhaj Booz, winh ay schekab' heb' ix junnhej ix ach munlaj chi' yet'ok, te ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winh. Ha t'a jun ak'wal tik ol b'at winh ak'ojel matz'il cebada.
Ha tiknaik, icha tik ol a k'ulej: B'ikel a b'a, tzak'anek' perfume t'ayach, a a pichul wach' tzak'ochi, tzach b'at b'aj ayek' winh chi', palta manh a komon ch'oxej a b'a ayik manto lajwi swa winh.

Tonhej tzila' b'ajtil tzek' jichan winh swayi, slajwi chi' tzach ek' jichan t'a yoktak winh, tzak'ank'e sti' sk'u' winh t'a yoktak chi' t'a ib'anh. Haxo winh ol alanok tas ol a k'ulej, xchi ix Noemí chi'.
Ix tak'wi ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ol in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix al tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix b'aj smunlaj winhaj Booz chi', ix sk'anab'ajej ix icha ix aj yalan ix yalib' chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi swa winhaj Booz chi' yet' yuk'an ha', te tzalajk'olal ix aj winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ek' jichan winh sway t'a slak'anil b'aj kunhanek' ixim sat cebada chi'. Haxo yik ix k'e ak'wal, te k'ojank'olal ix aj sk'och ix Rut chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sk'u' winh ix t'a yoktak, ix ek' jichan ix sway ta'.
Haxo t'a chimilak'wal ix k'e juknaj winh, ix sutmaj winh b'aj waynak chi', haxo ix yab'an winh to ay jun ix ix jichanek' t'a yoktak chi'.
--¿Mach ach? xchi winh. --Ha in Rut in a chekab' in. Ha ach tik, smoj tzach kolwaj t'ayin, yujto te ayto uj a b'a yet' winh wetb'eyum chamnak, xchi ix.

--Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach. Ha tiknaik, ix nachajel wu'uj chajtil to wach' a pensar, yujto tza nib'ej sb'inajkan winh etb'eyum chamnak. K'inalok ta manh ichokta, syal ik'an a b'a yet' junokxo winh to kelemto, wach'chom meb'a', ma b'eyum, anhej tato syal a k'o'ol, palta maj a k'ulej icha chi'.
Manh ak' pensar, yujto ha t'a yol ko chonhab' tik, ojtakab'ilxo to wach' a b'inaji, yuj chi' ol in k'anab'ajej masanil tas tzal tik.
Yeltoni ayto wuj in b'a het'ok, palta ayto wal junxo winh te ayto uj a b'a yet'ok t'a wichanh.

Kananh t'a tik t'a jun ak'wal tik. Hato k'ik'an swala', tato scha sk'ol winh chi' ach yik'an icha sleyal. Tato icha chi', wach' toni. Tato manh ol yal sk'ol winh jun, swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová ach wik'ani. Wayanh tiknaik, haxo yik ol sakb'ok, ol ach paxok, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix waykan ix t'a yoktak winhaj Booz chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ayto sakb'i ix k'e wa'an ix, yujto ix yal winh t'a ix to malajokab' mach tz'ilani to ay junok ix ix, ix ulek' b'aj smunlaj winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --Ik'el a xotil chi', tza pixan snhi' k'apak, xchi winh t'a ix. Ayik yamb'il snhi' k'apak xotil ix chi' yuj, ix sekanem ixim cebada winh t'a yo'ol, ay am wakeok almul ixim ix yak'em winh. Ix schelank'e winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' ix, ix yik'anb'at ixim ix t'a chonhab' chi'.
Haxo ix k'och ix t'a ix yalib' chi', ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas ix a k'ulej nu? xchi ix. Ix yalan ix Rut chi' tas ix yal winhaj Booz chi' icha tik:
--Ha masanil ixim cebada tik ix yak' winh t'ayin. Ix yalanpax winh to max yal in jawi t'ayach tato malaj jab'ok tas wet'nak, xchi ix.
Ix yalan ix yalib' ix chi': --Ha tiknaik jun nu, tanhwej tas ol ajelk'och jun tik. Manh ol ek' tiempo yuj winh. Ol sb'o yaj winh tiknaik, xchi ix t'a ix Rut chi'.

Haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix b'at em k'ojan winhaj Booz chi' t'a sti' spuertail chonhab' b'aj smolb'ejtaxon sb'a heb' anima. Junanto wal rato chi', ix elul winh te ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh xilb'a Elimelec chi', haton jun winh ix yal winhaj Booz chi' t'a ix Rut. Ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a winh: --Ochanh wa'an to ol onh lolon jab'ok, xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajej winh chi' yoch wa'an, ix em k'ojan winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot lajunhwanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Booz chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to tz'em k'ojan junok rato heb' winh yet' winh. Ix em k'ojan heb' winh b'i'an.
Ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' heb' chi' icha tik: --Ha ix Noemí ix meltzajxikot t'a Moab, snib'ej ix schonhel jab'ok slum winh kuk'tak xilb'a Elimelec.

Yuj chi' swal t'ayach talaj tza manel lu'um. Tato tzik' lu'um, t'a wal yichanh heb' testigo tik yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' tik, tzalankani to tzik' lu'um. Yujto a ach tik smoj ik'an lu'um. Tato max a mankan lum jun, al t'ayin tiknaik, yujto a in tik schab'ilxo makan waji, malaj junokxo syal smanan lu'um, xchi winhaj Booz chi'. Ix tak'wi winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Elimelec chi' icha tik: --Ol in man lu'um, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' tas yaji: --Ha tiknaik jun, tato tza mankanel lum t'a ix Noemí chi', yowalil tzik' ix Rut aj Moab, ix yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Mahlón, yik wach' ol b'inajkan winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a lu'um, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Tato icha chi' yaji, max yal-laj in manan lu'um. Ay talaj tz'ik'an in makb'en yuj. Tato tza nib'ej tza mankanel lum a ach tik, syal a manan lu'um, swak' in derecho tik t'ayach, xchi winh.

(Ha sb'eyb'al heb' israel t'a jun pekti' chi', tato ay junok mach ay yalan yik smanankan smakb'en junok te ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok, tato max yal sk'o'ol smanani syal yak'ankan b'aj ay yalan yik chi' t'a junokxo mach. Ayik sb'o jun lolonel chi', a sb'eyb'al heb' to a jun mach max manankan chi', syik'el junok xanhab' ayochi, syak'an t'a winh smanankan chi', ch'oxnab'il tz'ajkani.)
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sk'ab' yok winhaj Elimelec chi' t'a winhaj Booz chi': --Mankanel lu'um, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun xanhab' winh, ix yak'ankanb'at winh t'a winhaj Booz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' jantak heb' ayek' chi': --E masanil, testigo tzex ajkan tiknaik to a in tzin mankanel lum t'a ix Noemí, haton slum winhaj Elimelec, lum yik winhaj Quelión, lum yik winhaj Mahlón.

Hanhejtona' testigo tzex ajpaxkani to ol wik'kan ix Rut aj Moab wetb'eyumok, haton ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Mahlón, yik ol b'inajnhejkan winh t'a slu'um chi' yet' t'a ko kal a onh ayto kuj ko b'a yet' winh yet' t'a yol ko chonhab' tik. Yuj chi' testigo tzex ajkan t'a jun lolonel tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' masanil heb' ayek' chi' icha tik: --Testigo tzonh ajkani. Ha ix ix tz'ochkan t'a yol a pat chi', aokab' Jehová ol ak'an elk'och ix icha ix Raquel yet' ix Lea b'aj kotnak kinhtilal a onh israel onh tik. Hanhejtona' a ach pax tik, niwanokab' tz'aj a b'inajkan t'a yol yik Efrata, haton chonhab' Belén tik.
Tzijtumokab' uninal ol yak' Jehová yet' ix, k'ib'okab'nhej sb'isul inhtilal yet' ix, icha ix aj sk'ib'cha'anh yinhtilal winhaj Fares, haton winh yuninal winhaj Judá yet' ix Tamar, xchi heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'an ix Rut chi' winhaj Booz chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix way winh yet' ix, haxo Jehová ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'a ix, ix skuchanoch yune' ix, ix alji jun swinak unin ix.
Ix yalan heb' ix ix t'a ix Noemí chi' icha tik: --Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto toxo ix yak' jun iachikin ilumalok. Niwanokab' ol aj sb'inaj t'a skal chonhab' Israel.

Aokab' winh ol och yipok a k'o'ol yet' ach yilani ayik ol ach chichimaxok, yujto yune' winh ix alib' tik. Haton ix tzach xajanani, ek'b'al yelk'och ix t'a yichanh ichato ay ukwanhok une' ix il sat, xchi heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schelank'e winh unin chi' ix Noemí chi', haxo ix ix ilan k'ib' winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ix kajan t'a slak'anil ix chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ichato ix alji yune' ix Noemí, xchi heb' ix. Obed ix yak' heb' ix sb'iej, haton winh smam winhaj Isaí, smam winhaj rey David.

Haton heb' smam yicham winhaj rey David t'a stzolal tik, tz'el yich t'a winhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Ram, winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Naasón, winhaj Salmón, winhaj Booz, winhaj Obed, winhaj Isaí, haton winh smam winhaj David chi'.

Ha t'a chonhab' Ramataim, t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, hata' kajan jun winh skuch Elcana, yuninal winhaj Jeroham, yixchikin winhaj Eliú. Ha winhaj Eliú chi' yuninal winhaj Tohu, yixchikin winhaj Zuf.
Ha winhaj Elcana chi', chawanh yetb'eyum winh, jun ix skuch Ana, haxo junxo ix skuchan Penina. Ha ix Penina chi', tzijtum yune' ix, haxo ix Ana chi', malaj junok yik ix.

Junjun ab'il sb'at winhaj Elcana chi' t'a Silo yik syak'an silab' winh, yik tz'ochpax winh ejmelal t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Hata' ayoch chawanh yuninal winhaj sacerdote Elí sacerdoteal yet' smam chi', haton winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees.
Ayik sjawi sk'uhal yik b'at yak'an silab' winhaj Elcana chi', syak' nok' silab' chi' winh t'a ix Penina chi' yet' t'a heb' yuninal, haton jantak smoj yak'jitaxon t'a heb'.
Haxo pax ix Ana chi', te xajan ix yuj winh, yuj chi' te wach' nok' chib'ej tz'ak'ji t'a ix, wach'chom malaj yune' ix syak' Jehová.
Te chuk syal ix Penina chi' t'a ix Ana chi', yik syak'an kus sk'o'ol ix ix yujto malaj yune' ix syak' Jehová.
Ichanhej chi' syutej sb'a ix t'a ix Ana chi' ayik xit'ek' heb' t'a junjun ab'il t'a skajnub' Jehová, ste b'uchwaj ix Penina chi' t'a ix Ana chi'. Ste ok' ix Ana chi', manhxalaj snib'ej ix swa'i.
Yuj chi', sk'anb'an winhaj Elcana chi' t'a ix icha tik: Ana, ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i, maxtzak ach wapax yuj kusk'olal? ¿Tom manh wach'ok waj het'ok t'a yichanh lajunhwanhok une'? xchi winh t'a ix.

Ha junel ayik ayek' heb' t'a Silo chi', ayik ix lajwi swa heb', ix k'e wa'an ix Ana chi', ix b'at ix t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha t'a yol sti' skajnub' Dios chi', hata' k'ojanem winhaj sacerdote Elí t'a jun sk'ojnub'.
Ayik ix k'och ix ta', ix te ok' ix sik'lab'il, ix syamanoch ix slesalwi t'a Jehová.

Ix yak'an sti' ix t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová, Yajal Ach t'a Smasanil, tato smoj wal ilanoch in kusk'olal a in a chekab' in tik, tato tzin a nakoti, komonok tz'el wal t'a a k'ol ak'an junok wune' winak unin. Swak'kan t'ayach t'a junelnhej, max joxjiel-laj xil sjolom, yik scheklajeli to ik yaji, xchi ix.
Te junip ix lesalwi ix t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix och k'elan winhaj Elí chi' t'a sti' ix.
Manh cha'anhoklaj slesalwi ix, anhej t'a spensar ix slesalwi t'a Jehová, tonhej tz'ib'xi sti' ix, a sna'an winhaj Elí chi' to uk'um anh ix.
Ix yalan winh: --¿Tom manhxo ol el jab'ok anh anh t'a a sat? Aktejxo uk'an anh, xchi winh.
--Ma'ay mamin, manh in uk'umok anh, malaj tas ix wuk'u', to ay wal in kusk'olal tzul wal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Manh a na' to chuklaj tas tzin k'ulej t'a tik, ayxo tiempo in kajwi in lesalwi yuj jun wilk'olal tik, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a ix: --Paxanh t'a junk'olal, aokab' Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ol ak'an t'ayach tas ix a k'an chi' t'ay, xchi winh.
--Yuj wal Dios t'ayach, komonok wach' tzin kan t'a a sat, xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj ix, ix jax ix b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix wa ix t'a tzalajk'olal, manhxalaj yilk'olal ix.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik ix sakb'i, ayik ix lajwi yochkan heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat t'a Ramá. Ayik ix way winhaj Elcana chi' yet' ix Ana chi', ix nachajkot slesal ix yuj Jehová.
Ix skuchkanoch yune' ix. Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal yalji yune' ix chi', winak unin ix alji, ix yak'an ix skuch Samuel, yujto ix yab' Dios tas ix in k'an t'ay, xchi ix.

Ix k'ochpax sk'uhal sb'atxi winhaj Elcana yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal t'a chonhab' Silo, ichataxon sk'ulej winh t'a junjun ab'il, yik b'at yak'an silab' winh tak'wab'il yuj yak'an t'a Jehová icha sleyal.

Maj b'atlaj ix Ana chi' yet' heb', ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Manh ol in b'atlaj, masanto ol el winh unin tik t'a yim, ichato chi' ol in b'atok. Swik'ankanb'at winh, swak'ankan winh junelnhej t'a Jehová, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elcana chi' icha tik: --Wach' toni tato wach' tza na'. Kananh yet' winh masanto ol el winh t'a yim chi'. Aokab' Jehová tz'och het'ok yik tz'elk'och b'aj ix ak' a ti' t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix kan ix yet' winh unin chi', ix sk'ib'tzitan winh ix, masanto ix el winh t'a yim.

Ayik maxtzak chunilaj winh unin chi', yuneto winh ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a skajnub' Jehová t'a Silo chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jun nok' kelem wakax heb' oxe' ab'il sk'inal yet' jun arroba ixim trigo yet' jun tz'u'um ayem wino t'a yo'ol.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' wakax chi' heb' silab'il, ix yak'ankan winh unin chi' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj sacerdote Elí.
Ix yalan ix Ana chi' icha tik: --Ak' niwank'olal t'ayin mamin, a in ton tik ulnak in ek' t'a a tz'ey t'a junel, ayik in lesalwinak t'a Jehová.
Haton winh unin tik in k'annak t'a Jehová, haxo ix ak'an t'ayin.
Haxo tiknaik tz'el t'a in k'o'ol, swak'ankan winh t'a Jehová. Yakb'an pitzan winh, yik Jehová yaj winh, xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix em kumnaj heb' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix lesalwi ix Ana, ix yalan ix icha tik: Ste tzalaj wal in k'ol t'a Jehová. A' ix ak'an wip. Ayxo tas syal walan t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto a Jehová ix och wet'ok. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaj wal tiknaik.
Malaj junok mach lajan swach'il yet' Jehová ko Diosal. Malaj junokxo mach syal onh skolan icha ko Diosal chi'.
Manhxa mach syal yik'ancha'anh sb'a, malaj mach syal ak'umtak syutej sb'a syalani, yujto a Jehová yojtak smasanil. Ha tzonh ch'olb'itan junjun onh t'a tastak sko k'ulej.
Ha Jehová sk'okchitanb'at sjul-lab' heb' te jelan. A' tz'ik'ancha'anh heb' emnakil syutej sb'a.

Ha mach syak' sobre swa'el t'a yalanhtaxo, haxo tiknaik smunlaj yuj jab'ok swa'el. Ha mach ix ab'an sya'il wejel, haxo tiknaik b'ut'an sk'o'ol. Ha ix ix max unewitaxonlaj, haxo tiknaik, ayxo ukwanh yune' ix. Haxo pax ix tzijtum unin ix yune'ej, haxo tiknaik manhxalaj yune' ix.
Ha t'a Jehová skot chamel yet' pax k 'inal. Ha Jehová tzonh ak'ankanem b'aj tz'emkan junok chamnak, hanheja' tzonh ik'anpaxk'eta.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an mheb'ail, syak'anpax b'eyumal, tzonh yik'emi, tzonh yik'anpaxcha'anh.

Ha Jehová tz'ik'ancha'anh heb' meb'a' t'a sat lu'um, sik'ank'e wa'an heb' k'anum tumin t'a skal k'alem, yik tz'em k'ojan heb' t'a skal heb' niwak yajal, tz'och heb' t'a niwak opisio. Ha Jehová ix b'oanem yich jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haxo t'a yib'anh ix sb'oem lum lum tik.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' yiko' b'ajtak tzek' heb', haxo heb' anima te chuk, skan heb' t'a kal k'ik' k'inal. Malaj mach syal yak'an ganar t'a yol yiko'.

Ha satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, hato t'a satcha'anh smak'wajkot k'u t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha Jehová sch'olb'itan masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tz'ak'an spoder winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj, tz'ik'jicha'anh winh yuj, xchi ix.
Ix pax winhaj Elcana t'a spat t'a Ramá, ix kan winh unin chi' yak' serwil Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj sacerdote Elí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elí chi', te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' winh, malaj yelk'och Jehová t'a heb' winh,

malaj pax yelk'och sleyal yik sacerdoteal t'a heb' winh. Ayik syak'an silab' heb' anima, sk'och heb' winh schekab' heb' winh sacerdote chi' yet' k'e'en niwak tenedor ayik wan staji nok' chib'ej t'a yol chen.

Syak'anem k'e'en heb' winh t'a yol chen chi'. Ha jantak nok' chib'ej sk'eta yuj heb' winh t'a k'e'en, syik'b'at nok' heb' winh t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi'. Ichanhej chi' syutej masanil silab' heb' yetchonhab' heb' winh sk'och yak' silab' t'a Silo chi'.

Hanheja' ayik manto nhusjitz'a xepu'al nok' silab', sk'och jun schekab' heb' sacerdote chi'. Syalan t'a mach wan yak'an jun silab' chi': Ak' jab'ok nok' chib'ej tik t'ayin, to ol in b'ol nok' schi winh sacerdote, yujto manh ol schalaj nok' tz'anhb'ilxo winh t'ayach, palta a nok' yaxto, xchi jun chekab' chi'.

Tato stak'wi heb' anima chi', syalan heb': Tanhwej hato ol tz'ab'at xepu'al nok', ichato chi' ol yal ik'anb'at jantak tza nib'ej, tato xchi heb', stak'wi jun chekab' chi': Ma'ay, yowalil tzak' nok' t'ayin wal tiknaik, tato ma'ay, ol in tok'ek' nok' t'ayach, xchi jun chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi', te niwan smul chawanh heb' winh sacerdote chi' tz'och t'a Jehová, yujto malaj yelk'och ofrenda tz'ak'ji chi' t'ay t'a sat heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj yune' Samuel, ayoch schaleka winh nab'a lino, yik syak'an serwil Jehová winh.

Ha ix snun winh unin chi', ha t'a junjun ab'il sb'o'an jun spichul winh ix, jukan syutej ix. Haxo yik sb'at ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi' t'a Silo chi' yik b'at yak'an silab' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, syik'anb'at jun spichul winh chi' ix.

Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winhaj Elí t'a yib'anh winhaj Elcana yet' ix Ana chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Yak'okab' uninal Jehová yet' ix etb'eyum tik sk'exulok winh unin ix yak' ix t'a Jehová, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat.
Haxo Jehová, ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'a ix Ana chi'. Ix alji oxwanh swinak unin ix yet' chawanh ix unin. Haxo pax winhaj Samuel, wan sk'ib' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Elí chi', ix yab' winh tas wan sk'ulan heb' winh yuninal winh chi' t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ix way heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix stanhwan sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Yuj chi, ix yal winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi' icha tik: Masanil heb' anima tik syal heb' t'ayin tastak chukal tze k'ulej. ¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a?
Ma'ay ex wuninal, te chuk tas syal heb' schonhab' Jehová tik t'a eyib'anh yuj tas tze k'ulej chi'.

Tato ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a junok yetanimail, tzato yal skolwaj Dios yet'ok. Palta tato ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a Jehová, ¿mach ol kolanok? xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och tas ix yal winh smam heb' winh chi' t'ay, yujto toxo ix sna' Jehová to ol cham heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj yune' Samuel chi', wan sk'ib' winh, wach' tas sk'ulej winh t'a sat Jehová yet' pax t'a heb' anima.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix k'och jun schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Elí chi', ix yalani: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ayik ayek' heb' a mam icham t'a Egipto, ayik wan yak'an serwil winh sreyal Egipto chi' heb', in ch'oxnak in b'a t'a heb' chajtil waji.

Ha t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, hata' ix ex in sik'elta, yik tzex och sacerdoteal t'ayin, tze nhusantz'a incienso t'a yib'anh waltar, tzeyak'anoch he chaleka yik he sacerdoteal yik tzex jawi t'a wichanh. Ix wak'anpax juntzanh ofrenda swa heb' he mam eyicham chi', haton juntzanh snhustz'a heb' yik tzin yik'ancha'anh.

¿Tas yuj malaj yelk'och juntzanh silab', ma ofrenda tik t'a yol a sat to a in tzin chek yak' heb' t'a in kajnub'? ¿Tas yuj haxonhej heb' winh uninal chi' tzik'cha'anh t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an b'ak'echb'ok he b'a yuj swach'il yofrenda heb' in chonhab' syak' t'ayin?

Wach'chom a in Jehová sDiosal in Israel ix wala' to a ex yet' heb' inhtilal t'a b'ak'inh tzin eyak'nhej serwil t'a in kajnub', haxo tiknaik a in swala' to manhxo ichokta ol ajok, yujto a mach ay welk'och t'a sat, a heb' chi' ay yelk'och t'a in sat. Haxo heb' tzin patikaneli, malaj yelk'och heb' t'a in sat, a in Jehová in swal jun tik.
Wan sjawi sk'uhal to ol wak' tzapanb'ok a k 'inal yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' a mam icham, manhxa junok heb' inhtilal chi' ol och icham animail.
Ol ach kusok, ol chichon a k'o'ol ayik ol ilan tas wach' ol in k'ulej t'a heb' etisraelal, palta manhxa b'ak'inh ay junok inhtilal ol och icham animail.
Ayto junok inhtilal olto kan yil waltar, yik ol kus sk'ol yilani, haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' toto ol aljok, kelemtak heb' ol miljokcham heb'.
Ha jun tik ch'oxnab'il ol aj t'ayach to ol elk'och tas wan walan tik, a heb' winh uninal, haton winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees, junnhej k'uhal ol cham heb' winh schawanhil.
Ol wak'och junxo sacerdote, to tz'akan ol sk'anab'ajej tas tzin nib'ej, ol wak'an najtilax yopisio yet' heb' yinhtilal, ol wak'anoch yopisio yet' jun rey ol in sik'eli.

Yuj chi', a masanil heb' inhtilal olto kanok, ol jawok heb', ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh jun sacerdote chi', yik sk'anan jab'ok stumin heb', ma jab'ok span heb'. Ol sk'anan jab'ok smunlajel heb' t'a winh sacerdote chi', yik syak' ganar jab'ok swa'el heb', xchi Jehová, xchi jun chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Elí chi'.

Ha winhaj Samuel kelemxo winh, hanheja' smunlaj winh t'a skajnub' Jehová t'a yalanh smandar winhaj sacerdote Elí. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' nib'ab'il slolonel Jehová, yujto manh komonok sch'ox sb'a t'a junok mach t'a wayichal.
Haxo winhaj Elí chi' wan yixtax yol sat winh, maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Ay jun ak'wal ayik waynak winh t'a yol scuarto,
haxo winhaj Samuel chi' sway t'a junxo scuarto t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj ayek' te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios. Ayik ayto sakb'i, ayto och sk'ak'al candil,
ix awaj Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, xchi. --Oy, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalan winh: --Ina in tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Malaj in tzach wawtej, ixik b'at ek'anxi jichan, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh: --Samuel, xchi. Ix k'ex wan winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalanxi winh: --Ina in tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Ach wuninal, malaj ach tzach wawtej. B'at wayanhxi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'.
Ha winhaj Samuel chi' manto yojtakok Jehová winh, yujto manta b'aj slolon junelok t'a winh.

Haxo t'a yoxelal ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh, ix k'ex wa'an winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi': --Ina in tik, yujto a ach tik tzin awtej, xchi winh. Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj Elí to a Jehová tz'awtan winh kelem chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik, b'at ek'anhxi jichan. Tato ay mach tzach awtan junelxo, tzach tak'wi icha tik: Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' a in a chekab' in tik, xa chi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Yuj chi', ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix k'och Jehová t'a slak'anil winh, ix awaj t'a winh icha ix aj yawtan winh t'a juntak el chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, Samuel, xchi. --Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ay jun tas ol in k'ulej t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol te somchajcha'anh heb' anima yab'ani.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ol elk'och masanil ix walkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Elí yet' masanil yinhtilal.

Toxo ix wal yab' winh to ol wak' sya'elal heb' yinhtilal winh t'a junelnhej, yujto yojtakxo winh tas chukal sk'ulej heb' winh yuninal winh chi', ix in spatikejel heb' winh a in Dios in tik, palta maj skach jab'ok heb' winh yuninal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix wak' in ti' to a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elí chi', malaj junok silab', ma junok ofrenda syal stupanel smul heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix ek'xi jichan winhaj Samuel chi', haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix sjakan skajnub' Jehová winh. Ix xiw winh yalan juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj Elí chi'.
Palta ix awtaj winh yuj winhaj Elí chi', icha tik: --Samuel, xchi winh. --Ina in tik, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach? Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol to malaj junok tas ol a k'ub'ejel t'ayin. Aokab' Jehová chi' ol ak'an a ya'elal tato ay junok ol a k'ub'ejel t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel smasanil t'a winh, malaj wal jab'ok tas to maj yal winh. Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' icha tik: --Ha wal Jehová ix halani, elokab'k'och tas wach' t'a sat, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan sk'ib' winhaj Samuel chi', a Jehová aynhejoch yet' winh. Masanil lolonel syal winh tz'elnhejk'ochi.
Yuj chi', masanil heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en Israel, syalelk'ochi skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba, ix nachajel yuj heb' to a winhaj Samuel chi' yel schekab' ton wal Jehová yaj winh.
Ix sch'oxnhej sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a Silo, ix lolon t'a winh.

Ayik slolon winhaj Samuel chi', haxo masanil heb' chonhab' smaklej wal heb' yab'i. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel, ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a Afec. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' israel chi', ix och heb' smak sat heb', ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a slak'anil Eben-ezer.
Ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' filisteo chi' t'a yichanh heb' israel chi' yuj yak'an owal heb'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel yuj heb', ay am 4 milok heb' ix chami.

Ayik ix jax heb' israel t'a scampamento, ix yalan heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab': ¿Tas wal yuj ix onh yak'och Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo tik? B'at kik'ek te' skaxail strato Jehová ayek' t'a Silo, yik wach' sb'at Jehová ket'ok t'a owal, tzonh kolji yuj t'a heb' ajk'ol chi', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at juntzanh chekab' heb' t'a Silo yik b'at yik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil heb', haton jun sch'ox stzikikial t'a snanhal chawanh querubín t'a yib'anh te' kaxa chi'. Ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', tzak'anoch winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Elí t'a spatik te'.
Ayik ix k'och te' t'a scampamento heb', ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil, ix ib'xi wal lum lum yuj yel yaw heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo yel yaw heb' chi' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix yalan heb': ¿Tas yuj ste awaj heb' hebreo t'a scampamento? xchi heb'. Haxo ix yab'an heb' to a te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' ix k'ochi.
Ix te xiwk'e heb', ix yalan heb' t'ay junjun: Ix k'och sDiosal heb' t'a yol scampamento, ¿tas ol aj tiknaik? Ob'iltak onh. Mantalaj b'aj tzuji jun tik t'ayonh.
Ob'iltak onh, ¿mach ol onh kolan t'a juntzanh Dios te ay smay chi'? Haton heb' ix satanel heb' aj Egipto t'a tzinan lu'um yet' juntzanh ya'elal.
Ha tiknaik jun, ko tek'b'ejek ko b'a, kak'ek wal kip kak'an owal, yik wach' max onh kan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' hebreo tik icha ix aj heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', haxo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a spat. Te tzijtum heb' ix chami, ay am 30 milok heb'.
Ix yik'ankanek' te' skaxail strato Dios heb' filisteo chi', ix smilancham winhaj Ofni heb' yet' winhaj Finees chi', haton heb' yuninal winhaj Elí.

Ay jun winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Benjamín ix yak' ganar yel t'a skal owal chi', ix jawi winh t'a chonhab' Silo t'a jun k'u chi', nhik'chimtak spichul winh, ayk'e pokok t'a sjolom winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.

Haxo ix jawi winh, k'ojanem winhaj Elí t'a sk'ojnub' t'a ti' b'e smaklan junok ab'ix, yujto ayoch winh t'a ilk'olal yuj te' skaxail strato Dios. Haxo ix jawi jun winh soldado chi', ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' chonhab' tas wan yuji. Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yel yaw.

Ayxo 98 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Elí chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Ayik ix yab'an winh yel yaw heb' anima chi', ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tas yaj juntzanh anima tz'el yaw chi'? xchi winh. Haxo jun winh soldado chi' yelk'olal sk'och b'aj ayek' winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh: --In petoj t'a skal owal, elelal ix aj in koti, xchi winh soldado chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas wal ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh soldado chi': --Ix onh el t'a heb' filisteo, manh jantakok anima ix cham t'a ko kal. Ix champax heb' winh uninal schawanhil, haxo te' skaxail strato Dios, ix yik'kanb'at te' heb' winh filisteo chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Elí tas ix aj te' skaxail strato Dios chi', ix b'at pak'naj winh t'a spatik sk'ojnub' t'a sti' spuertail chonhab' chi', ix k'okchaj sb'akil sjaj winh, yujto al sniwanil winh, te icham winakxo pax winh, yuj chi' ix cham winh. 40 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a Israel.

Haxo ix yalib' winh, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Finees, toxo tz'alji yune' ix, yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an ix to ix ik'jib'at te' skaxail strato Dios, ix champax winh yalib' ix yet' winh yetb'eyum ix, ix kot sya'il sk'ol ix, ix alji yune' ix chi'.
Ayik ix yilan heb' ix tz'ilan b'o sk'ol ix chi' to wan scham ix, ix yalan heb' t'a ix: Manh ach xiwok, yujto winak unin une' tik, xchi heb' ix, palta majxo tak'woklaj ix, ichato maxtzak yab' ix.

Ha jun unin chi' Icabod, ix yak' ix sb'iej, ix yalan ix: Ha tiknaik ix ik'jiek' sb'inajnakil Israel, xchi ix. Yujto ix ik'jib'at te' skaxail strato Dios, ix champax winh yalib' ix yet' winh yetb'eyum ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix: Ix ik'jiek' sb'inajnakil Israel, xchi ix, yujto ix ik'jikanb'at te' skaxail strato Jehová.
Ha t'a Eben-ezer ix yik'ek' te' skaxail strato Dios heb' filisteo chi', ix k'och te' yuj heb' t'a Asdod.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch te' heb' t'a yol stemplo sdiosal. Ix yak'anem te' heb' t'a stz'ey sdiosal skuchan Dagón.

Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'och heb' aj lugar chi' t'a stemplo sdiosal chi', ix yilan heb' to ix telwi sdiosal heb' chi', nhojan yajkan t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová. Ix yik'ancha'anh heb', ix yak'anxik'e heb' t'a yet'tal.

Haxo yik ix k'ochxi heb' t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, ix yilan heb' pok'anxiem sdiosal heb' chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix el sk'ab' yet' sjolom, hato t'a yol ti puerta ayek'i. Haxonhej sniwanil ix kani.
Yuj chi' atax ta', ayik tz'och heb' sacerdote yik Dagón yet' masanil mach t'a yol templo chi', max stek'laj smarcoal puerta chi' heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch sya'elal heb' aj Asdod chi' yuj Jehová yet' masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix pitzwik'e ilya t'a heb' anima chi', ix laj k'e kisk'oy t'a heb'.
