Ayik ix yilanoch jun ya'elal ix yak'kot Jehová chi' heb', ix yalan heb': Ha te' skaxail strato sDiosal heb' israel, max yal-laj skan te' t'a tik, yujto sjawi niwak ya'elal t'a kib'anh yuj te', tz'ixtaxpax ko diosal yuj te', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix laj yalb'at heb' t'a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' sloloni. Ix yalan heb': --¿Tas skutej te' skaxail strato sDiosal heb' israel tik? xchi heb'. --Ik'ekb'at te', b'at eyak'ankan te' t'a chonhab' Gat, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at te' heb'.
Ayik ix b'at yak'ankan te' heb' ta', ix jawi jun niwan somk'olal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yuj Jehová. Ix pitzwipax kisk'oy chi' t'a heb' unin yet' t'a icham anima.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at te' kaxa chi' heb', ix b'at yak'ankan te' heb' t'a Ecrón. Ayik ix k'och te' ta', ix k'ex yaw heb' anima ta', ix yalan heb': Ix eyik'kot te' skaxail strato sDiosal heb' israel t'a tik yik tzonh cham yuj ko masanil, xchi heb'.

Ix cham heb' anima t'a chonhab' Ecrón chi' yuj xiwelal yet' yuj niwan ya'elal ix yak' Jehová t'a yib'anh heb', yuj chi' ix awtajkot masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' filisteo yuj heb', ix yalan heb' t'a heb': Ik'ekb'at te' skaxail strato sDiosal heb' israel tik. Hak'ek meltzaj te' t'a heb', haxo ta tz'aji tzonh cham ko masanil yuj, xchi heb'.
Te najat chekelto yel yaw heb', sk'och masanto t'a satcha'anh yuj ya'elal ayoch t'a yib'anh heb', haxo heb' manto chamlaj, te ya yaj heb' yuj kisk'oy chi'.
Uke' ujal ix ek' te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a skal heb' filisteo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj heb' sacerdote sdiosal heb' chi' yet' heb' naumel lolonel yuj heb' filisteo chi'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a heb': --¿Tas skutej te' skaxail strato Jehová chi'? ¿Tas wal tz'aj kak'an meltzaj te'? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' sacerdote chi': --Tato tzeyak' meltzaj te', manh eyak' meltzaj te' sch'okoj, palta yowalil ay tas tzeyak'b'at stojolok he mul chi', yik tz'och wa'an yowal sk'ol Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ol och wa'an jun ya'elal ayoch t'ayex tik, ol nachajel eyu'uj tas wal yuj ayoch ya'elal t'ayex yuj Jehová, xchi heb'.

--¿Tas wach' skak' stojol ko mul chi' jun? xchi heb'. --Hak'ek oyeok oro icha yilji yab'il kisk'oy chi', junjun yik junjun heb' eyajalil. Tzeyak'anpax oyeok oro icha yilji nok' ch'o'ow, yujto te ya heyaj yuj nok' yet' heb' eyajalil tik.

Yuj chi', tze b'o yechel kisk'oy chi' yet' yechel nok' ch'o'ow to toxo ix ixtaxb'at ko lugar tik yuj, tzeyik'ancha'anh sDiosal heb' israel. Tope syak' niwank'olal yik tz'och wa'an jun ya'elal tik t'ayonh yet' t'a ko diosal yet' pax t'a yol ko makb'en tik.
Mokab' pitok skutej ko b'a icha yutejnak sb'a heb' winh sreyal Egipto yet' masanil heb' anima ay ta'. Masanto ix och niwak ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', ichato chi' ix yaktanel chonhab' Israel heb'.

Ha tiknaik tzeyak' b'ojok junok te' ak' carreta, tzeyik'ankot chawanhok nok' wakax ay yune', mantalaj b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'a sjaj nok', tze tzek'anoch te' yugo chi' t'a nok' schawanhil, tzeyak'anoch te' carreta chi' t'a te' yugo chi'. Manh he chab'at yune' nok' chi' yet'ok, tze makkan nok' t'a yol smakte'.

Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ank'e te' kaxa chi' t'a yol carreta chi', tzeyak'anem juntzanh oro chi' t'a yol junok kajón, tzeyak'ank'e t'a stz'ey te' kaxa chi', haton juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at stojolok he mul chi'. Slajwi chi', tzeyaktanb'at nok' wakax chi' yet' te' carreta chi' sch'okoj.

Tzeyilani tato ha t'a sb'e'al Bet-semes ol b'at nok', tato icha chi' a Jehová sDiosal heb' israel tzonh ixtani. Tato ch'ok b'eal b'aj ol b'at nok' jun, manhok Jehová tz'ak'ankot jun ya'elal tik t'ayonh, komon yaelalnhej am tzonh ik'ani, xchi heb' sacerdote chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb' filisteo chi', a chawanh nok' wakax ay yune' ix yik'kot heb', ix smakankan nok' yune' chi' heb' t'a yol makte', ix stzek'anoch te' carreta chi' heb' t'a nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb' yet' jun te' kajón b'aj ayem oro icha yechel nok' ch'o'ow yet' yechel kisk'oy chi'.

Ix yaktanel nok' wakax chi' heb', ix b'at nok' t'a sb'e'al Bet-semes, tz'ok' nok' sb'at nok'. Manh wal jab'ok tz'elkan nok' t'a titak b'e chi'. Najat tzak'anto sb'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik nok' yik syilan heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a smojonal Bet-semes chi'.
Ay heb' aj Bet-semes wan sjochwi trigo ayek' t'a jun ch'olan. Ayik ix yilan heb' to wan sjawi te' skaxail strato Jehová. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ak'lik yik winhaj Josué, t'a yol yik Bet-semes chi' ix jawi te' carreta chi'. Hata' ix wanaj nok' wakax chi'. Ay jun k'e'en niwan k'e'en ta', haxo heb' levita ix ik'anemta te' kaxa yik Jehová yet' te kajón b'aj ayem tastak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en niwan k'e'en chi'. Ix och ijan heb' xikanb'at te' carreta chi' k'atzitzal, ix snhusantz'a nok' wakax chi' heb' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ix yil owanh heb' yajalil heb' filisteo, tas ix yutej heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a chonhab' Ecrón t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha oye' oro yechel jun ya'elal ix yak'kot heb' filisteo chi' yuj stojolok smul t'a yichanh Jehová, junjun yik juntzanh chonhab' tik, haton Asdod, Gaza, Ascalón, Gat yet' Ecrón.

Haxo sb'isul oro yechel nok' ch'o'ow, lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb' yajalil filisteo chi', haton chonhab' ayoch smuroal yet' yaldeail. Ha k'e'en niwan k'e'en t'a sat slum winhaj Josué b'aj ix ak'jik'e te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a Bet-semes chi', aynhejek' k'e'en.
Ix cham 70 winak aj Bet-semes chi' yuj Jehová, yujto ix say yil yol te' kaxa chi' heb'. Haxo masanil heb' anima, ix ok' heb', yujto ix och chamel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' anima ay ta': Malaj mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ay smay. ¿B'aj wal skak'b'at skaxail strato yik tz'elkan t'a ko tz'ey tik? xchi heb'.
Ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a Quiriat-jearim, ix yalan heb': Ix yak' meltzaj te' skaxail strato Jehová heb' filisteo, yuj chi' ik'ekk'e te', xchi heb'.

Ix k'och heb' aj Quiriat-jearim yik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix yak'anoch te' heb' t'a yol spat winhaj Abinadab ay t'a jun tzalan. Ix sik'jiel winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Abinadab chi' yuj heb', yik stanhwan te' winh.
Ay am junok 20 ab'il ix kan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a Quiriat-jearim chi'. Masanil heb' israel skus sk'o'ol, snib'ej heb' skolwaj Jehová yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a heb': Tato t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tzex meltzaj t'a Jehová, yowalil tzeyik'elta juntzanh sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a he kal yet' yechel Astarot, tzeyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yik anhej tzeyak' serwil. Tato icha chi', ha' ol ex kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
Yuj chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh komon Dios chi' heb', haton yechel Baal yet' Astarot, haxonhej t'a Jehová ix och heb' ejmelal.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' to smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel t'a Mizpa, yik stewi winh t'a Jehová yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ta'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yik'k'eta ha ha' heb', ix sekanem ha' heb' t'a sat lum t'a yichanh Jehová, ix och heb' smasanil t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a yichanh Jehová. (Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix sch'olb'itej heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Samuel chi'.)

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to ayek' molan heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix smolb'anpax sb'a heb', yik skot heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' israel icha chi', ix xiwk'e heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Samuel chi': Manh aktej a tewi t'a Jehová to tzonh skol t'a heb' filisteo tik, xchi heb'.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' yune' kalnel tzato chuni winhaj Samuel chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ix och ijan winh sk'anan skolwal. Elanhchamel ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh.

Ayik wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, a heb' filisteo wan sjawi heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', haxo Jehová te cha'anh ix ak'an mak'waj k'u t'a yichanh heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ix elta heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Tzijtum heb' filisteo chi' ix cham yuj heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a yichanhb'at Bet-car.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sayan jun k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anem k'e'en winh t'a skal Mizpa yet' Sen. Eben-ezer ix yak' winh sb'iej, ix yalan winh: Masanto tiknaik ix kolwajnhej Jehová ket'ok, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' manhxa junelokxo ix och heb' t'a yol slugar heb' israel yak' owal. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', aynhejoch Jehová xib'tan heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' yet' smakb'en heb' yik'nakek' heb' filisteo chi', schab'at t'a Ecrón, masanto sk'och t'a Gat, ix yik'xikanek' heb' israel chi'. Haxo heb' amorreo, malaj owal t'a skal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.
Ix yak' yajalil winhaj Samuel t'a chonhab' Israel chi' masanto ix cham winh.
Junjun ab'il xit'ek' winh t'a Betel, t'a Gilgal yet' t'a Mizpa, yuj sch'olb'itan winh tas yaj heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Slajwi chi', smeltzaj winh t'a Ramá, b'aj kajantaxoni. Hata' sch'olb'itejpax heb' yetchonhab' winh. Ix sb'oank'e jun altar yik Jehová winh ta'.
Ayik ix ichamax winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anoch chawanh heb' winh yuninal winh yajalilok heb' chonhab' chi'.
Joel sb'i jun winh b'ab'el, haxo junxo winh, Abías sb'i winh. Ix yak' yajalil heb' winh t'a Beerseba.

Palta manhok sb'eyb'al winh smam heb' winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej. Ha wal t'a k'e'en tumin ix yak'och spensar heb' winh. Scha k'e'en heb' winh t'a elk'altak, malaj swach'il syutej heb' winh sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.

Ix yalan heb' winh: Ha ach tik, te icham winak hachxo, haxo heb' winh uninal, manh ichaok ix utej a b'a syutej sb'a heb' winh, te chuk syutej sb'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' to tza sayoch junok ko reyal yik tzonh skuchb'an icha yaj juntzanhxo nación, xchi heb' winh.
Maj schalaj sk'ol winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix yab'an winh to snib'ej junok sreyal heb' yik skuchb'aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: k'anab'ajej masanil tas sk'an heb' chonhab' chi', yujto manhok ach tzach spatikejel heb', palta a in, yujto manhxa snib'ej heb' swak' yajalil t'a yib'anh.
Atax yik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto, tz'ochnhej heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios, malaj welk'och t'a heb'. Icha wal ix in yutej heb', icha wal chi' tzach yutej heb' tiknaik.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajej tas syal heb'. Palta yowalil tzak' yojtakejel heb' tastak ol utaj heb' yuj jun sreyal ol och chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix k'anan sreyal chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha wal tik ol ex yutok jun winh he reyal ol yak' yajalil t'a he kal chi': Ol smolb'ej masanil heb' eyuninal winh, ay heb' ol yak'och winh t'a yol carruaje yik owal, ay heb' ol k'e t'a yib'anh chej yik sb'at t'a owal, ay pax heb' ol ochkan stanhwumalok winh.

Ay heb' ol yak'och winh yajalil t'a junjun nhilanh soldado. Ay pax heb' ol och munlajel t'a slu'um winh, ol ochpax heb' jochoj trigo. Ay pax heb' ol och b'o'oj yamk'ab' yik owal yet' t'a b'o'oj tastak tz'och t'a carruaje yik owal.
Ol yik'anb'at heb' ix eyisil winh t'a spat. Ay heb' ix ol och b'o'oj perfume, ma b'o'oj wa'el yet' t'a b'o'oj pan.
Ol stok'ek' swach'il lum he lu'um winh yet' tas awab'il eyu'uj, te' uwa yet' te' olivo, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok.
Ha tas tzeyawej, ol yik'el sdiezmoal winh yet' he wino, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' t'a heb' schekab' chi'.
Ol yik'anpaxek' heb' he chekab' winh yet' heb' ix he chekab'. Ol yik'anpaxek' nok' he wakax winh yet' nok' he b'uru te wach', ol yak'anoch winh t'a smunlajel.
Hanheja' ol yik'paxek' sdiezmoal nok' he kalnel winh, ol eyak'an serwil winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', olto eyal he b'a t'a Jehová yuj tas ol ex utaj yuj winh he reyal ol he sik'och chi', palta manhxo ol kolwaj heyet'ok, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' chonhab' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Malaj yelk'och juntzanh chi', anhej to tz'och junok ko reyal.
Ko gana lajan tzonh aj icha juntzanhxo nación, ko gana to ay junok ko reyal tz'ak'an yajalil t'a ko kal, tzonh skuchb'anpax t'a owal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' anima chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a Jehová.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi', ak'och junok sreyal heb', xchi t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': Meltzajanhek t'a he chonhab' b'ela, xchi winh.

Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ay jun winh winak skuchan Cis, yuninal winhaj Abiel, yixchikin winhaj Zeror. Ha winhaj Zeror chi' yuninal winhaj Becorat, yixchikin winhaj Afía. Niwan yelk'och winhaj Cis chi' t'a heb' anima.

Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Saúl, te wach' sniwanil. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok wach' yilji t'a yichanh winhaj Saúl chi', te cha'anh ste'el winh. Ha masanil heb' winak t'a Israel, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix satb'at juntzanh nok' sb'uru winhaj Cis chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yuninal chi': --Ak' lista a b'a, sb'at a sayan nok' b'uru chi', ik'b'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' het'ok, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'axpajb'at winh t'a skal lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix ek' winh t'a yol yik Salisa. Maj chaxlaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj winh. Ix ek'pax winh t'a yol smakb'en Saalim yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín, palta malaj nok'.

Haxo ix k'och winh t'a yol smakb'en Zuf, ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': --Konh meltzaj t'a tik, haxo ta tz'aji, swach' och winh in mam t'a ilk'olal ku'uj t'a yichanh nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ha t'a yol jun chonhab' tik ay jun winh schekab' Dios, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a heb' anima, masanil tas syal winh, tz'elnhejk'ochi. B'at kila', ol yal winh tas b'eal ol kik'a', xchi winh.
--Konh an, anhej to malaj jab'ok tas skik'b'at t'a winh, malaj junok ixim pan ay t'a yol ko pa. Malaj jab'ok tas ol kak' t'a winh, ¿tas wal ol kik'b'ati? xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ay jab' tumin plata wet'nak, ol kak' k'e'en t'a winh schekab' Jehová chi', yik ol yal winh tas ol onh ajok, xchi winh.

(Ha t'a peka' chi', tato ay junok israel snib'ej sk'anb'ej yab' srazón t'a Dios syalan icha tik: B'at kil jun winh syal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Ha winh tz'alji schekab'ok Dios chi' tiknaik, ha t'a peka', a winh syal yilan junok tas ol ujok, sb'i winh yuj heb'.)
--Wach' jun, b'at kila', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil b'aj ayek' winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayik wan sk'e heb' winh t'a switzal chonhab' chi', ix schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak wan sb'at ik'oj ha', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' ix icha tik: --¿Ay am ek' winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok? xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' ix: --Ayek' winh t'a eyichanhb'at chi', palta tato tze pil wal jab'okxo eyip olto ilchaj winh eyu'uj. Toto wal sjawi winh t'a yol chonhab' tik yujto ay k'inh ol och t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Anhej tzex k'ochi tze sayanek' winh t'a kal chonhab' chi', yakb'an manto b'at winh b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi' b'aj tanhwab'il yuj heb' anima. Masanto ol k'och winh, ichato chi' ol yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh silab', haxo swa winh yet' heb' anima awtab'il chi'. Yuj chi' ixikek wal tiknaik, k'okb'ilto ol eyil winh, xchi heb' ix.
Ix b'at heb' winh b'i'an, haxo yik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', k'okb'il wal ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Samuel chi', wan sb'at winh t'a jun tzalan b'aj ol och ejmelal chi'.
K'ik'anokto sk'och winhaj Saúl, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi':

Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, swak'kot jun winh winak t'ayach, ha t'a yol yik Benjamín skot winh. Tzak'k'e aceite t'a sjolom winh, a winh ol och yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha winh ol kolan in chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, yujto toxo ix kus in k'ol yuj b'aj ix tewi heb' t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Haton winh tik wal t'ayach ewi, a winh ol och yajalilok in chonhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', hata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Al t'ayin mamin, b'ajtil ay spat winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok, xchi winh.
--Ha in toni. Konh wet'ok, b'ab'lajanh. Ol ach wa wet' b'aj wan in b'at chi'. Hato k'ik'an swal t'ayach tas a gana tza k'anb'ej chi', slajwi chi' tzach paxi.

Ha yuj nok' b'uru ix satb'at t'ayach yiktax oxji, manh ak' pensar yuj nok', toxo ix chax nok'. Palta ay jun mach te nib'ab'il yuj heb' ketchonhab' israel tik, a ach toni yet' heb' a k'ab' ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha in tik, yinhtilal in Benjamín, yelxo wal jaywannhej ko b'isul t'a kinhtilal chi' t'a skal masanil heb' ketisraelal. Hanheja' heb' sk'ab' yok in mam chi', malaj kelk'och t'a skal heb' kinhtilal chi'. ¿Tas wal yuj tzal juntzanh tik t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yet' winh schekab' yuj winhaj Samuel chi' t'a yol jun cuarto, ix ak'ji jun k'ojnub' te niwan yelk'och t'a heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh awtab'il wa'el chi', ay am junok 30 heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun winh ilum wa'el t'a cocina icha tik: --Ik'kot nok' chib'ej ix wal t'ayach to ch'ok tzik'kaneli, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' xub' winh, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha jun chib'ej tik ik'b'ilxokaneli, chi'a. Ha jun tik to na'anxotax wu'uj, ix in chek ik'jikaneli, ayik ix in chekan b'ojok jun k'inh tik, xchi winh. Junnhej ix wa winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ayik ix emixta heb' winh ta', ix emul heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lolon winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat.

Haxo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix awtaj winhaj Saúl yuj winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an tzach b'ati, xchi winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh b'i'an. Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' winh t'a yol calle.

Haxo ix emk'och heb' winh t'a titak chonhab', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Al t'a winh a chekab' tik to sb'ab'lajb'at winh, tzach kan jab'okxo, yujto ol wal tas ix schek Jehová wal t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix schekan b'ab'laj winh schekab' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun yet'tal aceite winhaj Samuel chi', ix stob'ank'e aceite chi' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saúl chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tzach sik'anel tiknaik yik tzach och yajalil t'a yib'anh schonhab'.

Ayik ol ko pukan ko b'a tik, ol a chalan a b'a yet' chawanh heb' winh winak t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan ix Raquel t'a chonhab' Selsa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Ha heb' winh chi' ol halan t'ayach to toxo ix chax nok' a b'uru tza saya', manhxo ayok och winh a mam t'a kusk'olal yuj nok', haxo pax u'uj a ach tik syak' pensar winh yuj tas ol aj a chaxi.

Ayto wal jab'xo a k'och t'a te' ji t'a Tabor, ay oxwanh heb' winh winak ol a cha ta', wan sb'at heb' winh t'a Betel yik tz'och heb' winh ejmelal t'a Jehová ta'. Ay jun winh, oxwanh chiwa yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh oxe' ixim pan yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh, yet'nak jun tz'u'um winh b'ut'an t'a wino.
Ol yak'an stzatzil a k'ol heb' winh, ol yak'an chab'ok ixim pan chi' heb' winh t'ayach, ol a cha ixim t'a heb' winh.

Slajwi chi', ol ach k'ek'och t'a chonhab' Gabaa, b'aj tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Jehová, hata' ay jun yet'tal jun makan heb' filisteo. Ayik ol ach och t'a yol chonhab' chi', ol ilan jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Jehová wan yemuli, syalan slolonel Dios heb' winh, b'ab'el heb' winh wan yak'anoch salterio, pandereta, flauta yet' arpa.
Haxo t'a jun rato chi', ol och Yespíritu Jehová t'ayach, icha heb' winh chi' ol ach ajok, ol k'exmaj a pensar.
Ayik ol hilani to icha chi' aji, a tas wach' ol ab'i, a ol a k'ulej, yujto ha Dios ol och het'ok.

Slajwi chi', tzach b'ab'lajk'och t'a Gilgal. Hata' ol ko chalaj ko b'a, ol in nhusantz'a silab' yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová. Uke' k'uhal ol in a tanhwej ta', hato yik ol in k'ochok. Ichato chi' ol walan t'ayach tas ol a k'ulej, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixnhej wal lajwi yalankan kil ko b'a winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix k'exji spensar winh yuj Dios, yuj chi' a wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix elk'och juntzanh tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa yet' winh schekab' chi', ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jehová icha ix aj yalan winhaj Samuel chi', ix chaji winh yuj heb' winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Saúl, ix och ijan winh yalan slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' winh.

Ha mach ojtannak winhaj Saúl chi' t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix yilan heb' yoch winh ejmelal, ix yilanpax heb' to ix k'exmaj winh icha juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ix yalan heb': ¿Tas tz'ik'an winh yuninal winhaj Cis tik? ¿Tom ipan winh schekab' Jehová yaji? xchi heb'.
Ay jun winh aj Gabaa chi' ix halani: ¿Mach smam juntzanhxo heb' winh chekab' tik jun? xchi winh. Hata' ix elkankot jun slolonel heb' anima: ¿Tom ipan winhaj Saúl tik schekab' Dios? xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at juntzanh chi', ix k'ek'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Ix sk'anb'an jun winh yuk'tak smam winh t'ay yet' t'a winh schekab' winh yet'nak chi': --¿B'ajtil ix ex xit'ek'i? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix onh xit'ek' ko say nok' b'uru, palta maj chaxlaj nok' ku'uj, yuj chi' onh b'atkan ko k'anb'ej t'a winhaj Samuel, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh yuk'tak winh smam winh chi': --Tzok wal el t'a he k'o'ol, tzeyal t'ayin, tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Wach' ix yutej winh yalani. Ix yal winh to toxo ix chax nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix yal winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel t'ay to ol och reyal.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at jaye' k'uhal, ix smolb'an heb' israel winhaj Samuel t'a Mizpa t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ix yal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik: Ha in ix ex wik'elta t'a Egipto, ix ex in kolelta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto chi' yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo chonhab' ix ex ixtani, xchi Dios chi'.

Palta haxo tiknaik tze patikejel ko Diosal ix onh ik'anelta b'aj ix onh ek' t'a sya'elal yet' t'a kusk'olal chi'. Ix he patikejkaneli, ix ex och ijan he k'anan junok ko reyal yuj yak'an yajalil t'a kib'anh. Yuj chi' jun, tzex och t'a yichanh Jehová, t'a junjun inhtilal yet' t'a junjun makanhil tz'aj eyochi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajalil junjun inhtilal heb' israel, haxo t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Benjamín ix em sorteo.

Ix yalanpax winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Benjamín chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Matri ix emi. Ix yalanxi winh to snitzkot sb'a yinhtilal winhaj Matri chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis ix emi. Ix sayjiek' winh yuj heb', palta maj ilchajlaj winh.
Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a Jehová tato ayek' winh ta'. Ix yalani to ayek' winh, to ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a skal juntzanh spa heb'.
Ix b'at sayjielta winh yuj heb' b'aj k'ub'anel chi'. Haxo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix ilji to a heb' te cha'anh ste'el, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel t'a heb' anima chi': --Ileknab' wal winh ko reyal ix sik'och Jehová tik, malaj junok winak t'a ko kal tik syal slajb'an sb'a yet' winh, xchi winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yalani: --Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' sleyal yik rey t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ix stz'ib'ejkan winh, ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix stak'lankan sb'a heb', ix pax heb' t'a spat.
Ichapax chi' winhaj Saúl, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a Gabaa. Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh winak te jelan t'a owal ix b'at yet' winh, yujto ix lolon Dios t'a spensar heb' yik sb'at heb' yet' winh.

Palta ay juntzanh winak b'uchumtak ix halan icha tik: ¿Tas ol yutok jun winh tik onh skolani? xchi heb' winh. Emnakil ix yutej winhaj Saúl chi' heb' winh, malaj tas ix siej heb' winh t'a winh. Palta malaj tas ix yal winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix kot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' Amón yet' soldado yak' owal t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik. Ix yalanb'at heb' aj Jabes chi' t'a winhaj Nahas chi': --Tato tzak' junok a trato ket'ok, ol kak'och ko b'a t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita chi', ix yalan winh: --Tzin b'o in trato chi' heyet'ok, tato syal he k'ol swik'elta junok yol he sat junjun ex t'a he wach', yik tz'el sk'ixwelal heb' eyetisraelal, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yajalil chonhab', ix yalan heb': --Tato icha chi', tzak' ukeokxo k'uhal ko permiso, ol kak'b'at ko chekab' t'a masanil heb' ketisraelal, tato malaj mach ol jawok onh skolo', ol kak'anoch ko b'a t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' chi' t'a Gabaa schonhab' winhaj Saúl, ix yalan scheknab'il heb' t'a heb' anima ta'. Haxo masanil heb' anima, ix laj ok'k'e heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'och winhaj Saúl, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, makb'il juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj yuj winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tas tz'ik'an heb' anima tik yuj chi' tz'ok' heb'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' anima chi' masanil tas ix ul yal heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', elanhchamel ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, ha' ix ak'an yip winh, ix kot yowal winh sik'lab'il.

Ix schok' xikanb'at chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jib'at nok' chib'ej chi' yik sch'oxji nok' t'a masanil yol smakb'en israel. Ha heb' tz'ik'anb'at nok' chi' syal heb' icha tik: Icha tik ol utaj nok' swakax mach max yal sk'o'ol sb'at t'a owal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' pax winhaj Samuel, xchi heb'. Ix jawi jun niwan xiwelal t'a heb' anima yuj Jehová, junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil, ix jawi heb' yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ayik ix sb'isan jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Bezec, ay 30 mil heb' ix kot t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 300 mil heb' ix kot t'a juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.

Hata' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi': --Alek t'a heb' eyetchonhab' to a k'ik'an t'a k'ek'uhalil, toxo ix ko kol heb', xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' chekab' chi' yal t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' to a k'ik'an skolchaj heb'. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.
Ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winhaj Nahas icha tik: --Hato k'ik'an b'at kak'och ko b'a t'a yol he k'ab', tze na'ani tas tzonh eyutej, xchib'at heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, k'ik'to wal, ix spojanek' heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ox poj ix yutej heb' winh. Ayto wal sakb'i, ix k'och lemnaj heb' t'a yol scampamento heb' amonita chi', ix och ijan heb' smilancham heb' masanto t'a k'ek'uhalil. Haxo heb' maj chamok, ix saklemkanb'at heb', malaj b'aj junnhej ix kan chawanhok heb'.
Ix yalan heb' anima chi' t'a winhaj Samuel: --¿Machtak heb' ix halani to manh smojok yoch winhaj Saúl ko reyalok? Ik'ekkot heb' t'a tik, ol ko milcham heb', xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ma'ay, ha t'a jun k'u tik, malaj junok ketchonhab' syal schami, yujto a Jehová ix onh kolani, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Samuel chi' t'a heb' anima smasanil: --Koyek t'a Gilgal, yik b'at ko wach' ak'ejkanoch winhaj Saúl tik ko reyalok, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová ta'. Ix swach' ak'ankanoch winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a reyal. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' yik junk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Haxo heb' chonhab' yet' winhaj Saúl ix te tzalaj heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix yalankan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel: --Tik wal tzeyilkani to ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix he k'an t'ayin, yuj chi' ix wak'kanoch jun winh ko reyal tik.

Haton jun winh tik ko reyal, a winh ol ex kuchb'anok. Ileknab'i, icham winak inxo, sakxo xil in jolom, haxo heb' winh wuninal ayoch heb' winh heyet'ok. Ha in ix ex in kuchb'ej yiktax kelem in, masanto tiknaik.

Ayinek' t'a eyichanh tiknaik. Tato ay mach ix wik'ek' junok nok' swakax, ma junok nok' sb'uru, mato ay mach b'aj ix wak' chukal, mato ay junok tas ix in cha t'ayex in montub'alok t'a elk'altak, alek t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ko reyal ix sik'el tik. Tato icha chi', syal in tupan tiknaik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Malaj junelok ix ak' chukal t'ayonh, malaj b'aj ix a cha junok tas a montub'alok, xchi heb'.
--Ha Jehová yet' winh ix sik'och ko reyalok tik, testigo tz'ajkan heb' to malaj in mul ix och t'ayex, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Ma'ay, malaj tasi, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal chi': --Ha Jehová sik'annakel winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik yik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', scham wal eyab'an tas ol wal tiknaik t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj tas wach' sk'ulejnak ku'uj yet' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'.

Ayik sk'ochnak winhaj Jacob yet' masanil yal yuninal t'a Egipto, te ya utajnak heb' yuj heb' anima ay ta'. Yalannak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová yik skolji heb' yuj. Haxo Jehová chi' ak'anb'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik sb'at yik'anelta heb' ko mam kicham chi' heb' winh ta'. Ak'jinakkan kajan heb' t'a tik yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal yuj heb', yuj chi' kotak skal ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yuj. Ay jun pekti' ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sísara, yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yik chonhab' Hazor. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Moab. Junjun makan heb' chi', ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ko mam kicham.

Yuj chi', juntak el tz'ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi', syalanxi sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, syalan heb': Mamin, ix och wal ko mul t'ayach, yujto ix ach kaktejkani, haxo Baal yet' Astarot skak' serwil. Ha tiknaik jun, kolonh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'o'ol, a achxonhej ol ach kak' serwil, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix ak'jikot winhaj Jerobaal, winhaj Barac, winhaj Jefté yet' in tik yuj Jehová, yik tzex kolji t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'o'ol, yuj chi' syal heyaj t'a junk'olal.
Ayik ix heyilani to skot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita yak' owal ket'ok, ix he k'anan junok he reyal t'ayin, yik tz'och yajalil t'a ko kal, wach'chom a Jehová ko Diosal ko reyal yaji.
Ha tiknaik ina winh he reyal ix he k'an tik. Toxo ix ak'jioch winh rey t'a ko kal yuj Jehová.

Ha tiknaik, tze na' sik'lab'il to tze k'anab'ajej Jehová tzeyak'an serwil, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej icha snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal, tato tze k'anab'ajej winh he reyal tik, wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati.
Tato pit ol eyutej he b'a t'a tas syal Jehová jun, tato max he k'anab'ajej, ol yak'och ya'elal t'a eyib'anh icha ix utaj heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha tiknaik, maklejek heyila', yujto ol sch'ox Jehová junok tas satub'tak yilji t'a eyichanh.

Ha tiknaik stiempoal sjochchaj ixim trigo, manh stiempoalok yak'an nhab'. Palta ol in k'an t'a Jehová to ol mak'waj k'u, ol yak'ankot nhab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to chuk ix he k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ayik ix he k'anan jun winh rey tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Jehová to skot nhab'. Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix mak'waj k'u ix kot nhab' chi', yuj chi' masanil anima ix xiw t'a Jehová yet' t'a winhaj Samuel chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' ix halan t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal yik max onh chami, yujto ix te wach' och ko mul yuj b'aj ix ko k'an ko reyal tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Wach'chom chuk tas ix he k'ulej chi', palta manh ex xiwok. Ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tik, manhxo eyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, haxonhej tzeyak' serwil t'a smasanil he k'o'ol.
Manh eyaktejkan Jehová yik tzex och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok tas syak' t'ayonh, max yalpax onh skolani.
Ha Jehová manh ol ex yaktejkan he ch'okoj, yik manh ol alchaj chukal t'ay, yujto snib'ej tzex och schonhab'ok.
Kolwajnhejokab' Jehová wet'ok yik tzin lesalwinhej eyu'uj yik max och in mul t'ay. Palta to ol ex in k'ayb'ej t'a stojolal.
Anhej to tze k'anab'ajej, tzeyak'an serwil Jehová t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tze na'ankot jantak tas wach' ix sk'ulej ku'uj.
Palta tato ol he k'ulejnhej chukal, ol ex satjokel yet' he reyal tik yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Te tek'an wal winhaj Saúl ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ayik ix lajwi schab'il ab'il yoch winh reyal chi',

ix sik'anel oxe' mil soldado winh t'a skal heb' israel. Chab' mil ix kan yet' winh t'a Micmas t'a tzalkixtak t'a slak'anil Betel. Haxo junxo mil heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal winh t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Benjamín. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ix kani, ix chekji pax heb' yuj winh t'a spat.

Haxo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix satanel jun makan heb' soldado filisteo t'a Geba. Ix yab' jun chi' heb' filisteo, yuj chi' elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Saúl to spuji k'e'en trompeta t'a yol smakb'en Israel yik smolb'an sb'a heb' winh soldado.

Masanil heb' israel ix ab'ani to toxo ix satel jun scampamento heb' filisteo yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yab'anpax heb' to aykot yowal heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi', t'a elanhchamel ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado israel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gilgal.

Hanheja' heb' filisteo chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'. Ay oxe' mil scarruaje heb' yik owal, wake' mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, tzijtum pax heb' sb'eyi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb'. Ix b'at heb' t'a Micmas, ix sb'o'an scampamento heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Bet-awén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel to max techaj yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix xiwk'e heb'. Ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en, t'a skaltak wayumtak, t'a sattak k'e'en tenam, t'a yoltak juntzanh jul yik ha ha' yet' t'a yoltak k'e'en xab'.

Ay pax heb' ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, ix b'at heb' t'a yol yik Gad yet' t'a Galaad. Haxo winhaj Saúl chi' jun, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gilgal. Masanil heb' soldado winh yet'nak, toxonhej sluklon heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', uke' k'uhal ix kan winh t'a Gilgal yik stanhwan winh sk'och winhaj Samuel, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan winh. Palta haxo ix aji, maj k'ochlaj winh t'a Gilgal chi', yuj chi' wanxo yaktajkan winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi': --Ik'ekkot nok' silab' ol nhusjoktz'aok yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová, xchi winh. Haxo winh ix komon nhusantz'a nok' silab' chi'.
Ayik wan slajwi snhusan silab' chi' winh, ix k'och winhaj Samuel chi'. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to sk'och winh, ix elta winh scha winh yik syak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --¿Tas ix a k'ulej tik? xchi winh. --Ix wila'' to wan in yaktankan heb' anima tik, a hachxo max ach jalaj icha yaj sk'uhal alankani, haxo heb' winh filisteo toxonhej lekanek' heb' winh t'a Micmas.
Yuj chi' ix in na'a, k'inalok sja heb' winh yak' owal t'ayin t'a Gilgal tik, manto in k'anpax skolwal Jehová, yuj chi' ix wak' pural in b'a wak'an jun silab' tik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi': --Yuj a manh pensaril ix a k'ulan jun tik. Oktom to ix a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach, tato icha chi', ix am yala' to tzach kan reyal t'a skal heb' israel t'a junelnhej.
Okxo jun, manhxo ol najtilax opisio. Ol say Jehová mach junok sk'anab'ajan tas snib'ej, a ol och yajalil t'a schonhab', yujto ix a tenek' tas ix yala'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Samuel t'a Gilgal chi', ix pax winh. Ha jantakto heb' anima tzak'an t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' t'a owal. Ix el heb' t'a Gilgal chi', ix b'atkan heb' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Hata' ix sb'is winhaj Saúl chi' jantakto heb' soldado tzak'an yuj, 600 to syil sb'a heb'.
Ajun pax winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winh yet'nak yet' heb' soldado. Ha t'a Gabaa chi' ix kan heb', haxo pax heb' filisteo, ha t'a Micmas ay scampamento heb'.
Ox makan ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at yik'anelta sk'a'el heb' israel heb'. Jun makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a sb'e'al Ofra t'a yol yik Sual.
Haxo junxo makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a Bet-horón, haxo heb' yoxil makan, ix b'atkan heb' t'a pak'an t'a sch'olanil Zeboim b'aj schab'at tzinan lu'um.
Masanil t'a yol smakb'en Israel, malaj junok heb' b'o'um k'e'en ix chaji sb'o k'e'en yuj heb' filisteo, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sb'o k'e'en espada yet' lanza heb' israel chi'.
Ayik tz'el ye k'e'en syamk'ab' heb' israel chi', ha t'a heb' filisteo xit'ek' heb' snhik ye k'e'en sk'e'en chi', icha k'e'en arado, k'e'en asaron, k'e'en ch'akab' yet' k'e'en jochlab' trigo.
Chab' plata sk'an heb' filisteo chi' yuj snhikjik'e ye k'e'en arado yet' k'e'en asaron. Jun sk'an heb' yik sk'e ye junok k'e'en ch'akab' yet' junok k'e'en teklab' wakax.
Yuj chi', malaj junok heb' soldado israel et'jinak yespada, ma slanza, anhej winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán et'jinak yiko' ayik ix och owal chi'.
Haxo jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo, makb'il b'aj lot'an yuj heb', haton b'aj tzek' sb'e'al Micmas.

Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' yik owal: --Konh ek' t'a junxo k'axep chi', ol onh k'och b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh. Maj yal-laj winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh smam chi'.
Haxo winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a slak'anil Gabaa ay scampamento winh, t'a yich jun te' granado b'aj stek'ji ixim trigo, 600 heb' soldado ajun yet' winh.

Ajun winhaj Ahías yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet'nak winh. Ayoch schaleka winh yik sacerdoteal. Ha winhaj Ahitob chi' yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Icabod. Ha winhaj Finees smam heb' winh, yixchikin heb' winh winhaj Elí, haton winh ak'annak sacerdoteal t'a Silo. Manh yojtakok winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado tato ix b'at winhaj Jonatán chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán chi', ayoch t'a spensar winh sk'axpajek' t'a scampamento heb' filisteo chi'. Ay jun k'e'en tenam skuch Boses t'a yichanh Micmas t'a stojolal norte, haxo junxo k'e'en skuch Sene ay t'a yichanh Gabaa t'a stojolal sur. Ay jun niwan ch'olan t'a skal k'e'en schab'il.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' chi': --Ha tiknaik konh em t'a sat k'e'en tik yik tzonh k'ek'och t'a scampamento heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Tope wal ol kolwaj Jehová ket'ok. Manh ajaltakoklaj skolwaj ket'ok tato syal sk'o'ol, wach'chom manh niwanok ko b'eyi, xchi winh.
--Ichokab' ta' tato wach' tz'aj tza na', anhej to tzak'an in och uj b'aj tzach b'ati, xchi winh schekab' winh chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Konh an, ayik ol onh emk'och t'a yol ch'olan chi', ol ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a heb'.
Tato ol yal heb' t'ayonh, tanhwejek ta', tato xchi heb', manh ol onh k'elaj t'a b'aj ayek' heb' chi'.
Tato ol yal heb' jun, k'eanhekkot t'a tik, tato xchi heb', ol onh k'e'ok. Icha chi' ol aj sch'oxan Jehová t'ayonh to ol yak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a heb', ix yalan heb' filisteo chi': Ileknab' wal yelta heb' hebreo t'a yoltak olan b'ajtak k'ub'an, xchi heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix awajemta heb' t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winh yet'nak winh chi': --Lemek, k'eanhekkot t'a tik, ay jun tas ol kal eyab'i, xchi heb' filisteo chi'. Haxo ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh ajun yet' chi': --Ol ach k'enhej tzak'an wu'uj, yujto a tiknaik ol yak'och heb' filisteo tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh.

Ix k'e machaljok heb' winh. Haxo yik ix k'ek'och heb' winh, ix syamanoch winhaj Jonatán chi' smilancham heb' filisteo chi', haxo winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' ix wach' milancham heb' maj cham sik'lab'il.
Ha t'a jun b'ab'el owal chi', ay am junok 20 heb' ix smilcham heb' winh, ay am junok chanhe' ch'anhil b'aj ix cham heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' filisteo ayek' t'a yol scampamento yet' heb' tonhej sakleminak yajeli yet' heb' najat ayel stanhwej yet' pax heb' ayb'at yik'elta sk'a'el heb' israel chi', ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix ek'pax jun niwan kixkab', yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'.
Haxo pax heb' ayoch smaklej yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín, ix yilan heb' to ix k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi' smasanil, wan saklempax heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Sayek eyil heb' soldado, ol cheklajok machtak malaj, xchi winh. Haxo ix cheklaji to a winhaj Jonatán malaj yet' winh tz'ik'an syamk'ab' winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ayek' te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Ahías: --Ik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová yik sko k'anb'ej t'ay, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan slolon winh yet' winh sacerdote chi', ix te wach' somchajk'e heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh sacerdote chi': --Aktej, manhxo ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' b'aj ayoch owal chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix te k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi', wan smil-lancham sb'a heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' israel ayxo tiempo yajek' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi', ix och heb' yet' winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán chi'.
Ayik ix yab'anpax heb' israel ix b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, to wan yel heb' filisteo chi', ix kot heb', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb'.
Ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto t'a yichanhb'at Bet-awén, icha chi' ix aj skolan chonhab' Israel Jehová t'a jun k'u chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix te el yip heb' israel chi', yujto malaj junok heb' ix wa yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl icha tik: katab'ajokab' mach swa t'a jun k'ik'b'alil tik, ayik mantzak wik'el yowal in k'ol t'a heb' ajk'ol tik, xchi winh.
Ayik ix k'och heb' soldado t'a jun kaltak te', te ay nok' yal chab' ay t'a sat lu'um,
icha yel yok ha ha', icha wal chi' sb'ey nok' yal chab' chi', palta malaj wal junok heb' ix yal yuk'an jab'ok nok', yujto ix xiw heb' t'a tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Jonatán maj yab'laj jun lolonel chi' winh, yuj chi' ix slab'ejem jun te te' winh yet'nak t'a skal nok' yalchab' chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a sti', ix te och yip winh yuj jab' chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh soldado t'a winh: --Ha winh a mam ix yal winh t'ayonh icha tik: Tato ay junok mach ay jab'ok tas syab'lej, katab'ajokab'kani, yuj chi' lajanxonhej yel kip ko masanil, xchi jun winh soldado chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winh in mam chi', te chuk tas syik'kot winh t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha in tik, ix wab' wal yoch wip yuj jab' nok' yalchab' ix wab'lej tik.
Okxom masanil heb' soldado tik, tato ix swa jab'ok tas ix kik'kanek' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi' heb', ek'tom wal te niwan heb' filisteo chi' ix cham ku'uj, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix och heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Ix syamoch heb' smilancham heb' t'a Micmas, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Ajalón. Ix te el yip heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', a jantak tas ix yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi', haton nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' yunetak wakax, ix smilcham nok' heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix schi'an nok' heb' yet' schik'il.

Ay heb' ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Wan yoch smul heb' soldado t'a yichanh Jehová, wan schi'an nok' chib'ej heb' yet' schik'il, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ix och he mul t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' b'alekkot junok k'e'en niwan k'e'en chi' t'a tik tiknaik.

Pukokab' ab'ix t'a skal heb' anima, syik'kot junjunok nok' swakax heb', ma junok skalnel heb', smilancham nok' heb' schi'a, mokab' schilaj nok' heb' yet' schik'il yik max och smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh. Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', junjun heb' ix ik'ankot junjun swakax, ma skalnel, ix smilancham nok' heb' schi'a.
Ix sb'o'an jun altar winhaj Saúl chi' ta'. Ha jun tik b'ab'el altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Koyek kak'ekxi owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a jun ak'wal tik, ol kik'anek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb', masanto yik ol sakb'ok, ol ko milcham heb' smasanil, manhxa junok pitzan ol kanok, xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' smasanil icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tas tzal chi', xchi heb'. Palta ix yalan winh sacerdote icha tik: --Ayik manto onh b'atek, wach' ta sko k'anb'ej t'a Dios, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Dios: --¿Tom tzonh b'atxi kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'? xchi winh. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Masanil ex yajal ex, nitzekkot he b'a t'a tik, ol ko k'anb'ani, mach ix och smul tiknaik.

Yujto swak' in ti' t'a Jehová ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik, wach'chom a winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, syal scham winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Malaj junok heb' t'a skal heb' soldado ix tak'wi.
Yuj chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' smasanil icha tik: --Kananhek he masanil t'a tik, ch'ok ol in kan a in tik yet' winh wuninal aj Jonatán, xchi winh. --Ha achnhej tzala, xchi heb' soldado chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová ach ko Diosal, ¿tas yuj max ach tak'wi t'a winh a chekab' tik? Ha tiknaik ayik ol och sorteo, tato a k'e'en Urim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to a in, ma a winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, palta tato a k'e'en Tumim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to a heb' a chonhab' Israel tik ix och smul, xchi winh. Haxo ix aji, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winhaj Saúl ix emi, haxo heb' chonhab', ix kolchajkanel heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Haxo tiknaik jun, haxonhej t'a wib'anh yet' winh wuninal tik tz'och sorteo, xchi winh. Haxo ix aj jun, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán chi' ix emi.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas ix a k'ulej, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Wal yel ix wab'lej jab' nok' yalchab', tonhej ix in lab'ejem jun te te' t'a skal nok', ix in lek'ani, yuj chi' ina in tik chamok in okab'i, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Yak'okab' och junok niwan ya'elal Dios t'a wib'anh tato max ach chami, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' anima smasanil: --Tokwal ol ko cha cham winhaj Jonatán tik, yujto a yuj winh, onh kolchaj a onh israel onh tik. Manh smojok icha chi'. Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal. Wal yel malaj junok xil sjolom winhaj Jonatán tik ol em t'a sat lu'um. Yujto a tas toxo ix elk'och tiknaik, ha Dios ix kolwaj ket'ok, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel winhaj Jonatán chi' yuj heb' yetchonhab', yuj chi' majxo chamlaj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', majxo b'atlaj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado spech heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix laj meltzaj heb' filisteo chi' t'a schonhab'.

Atax yik ix ochkan winhaj Saúl sreyalok chonhab' Israel, ix syamanoch winh yak'an owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' ajk'o'ol oyanoch t'a spatiktak winh, haton heb' aj Moab, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Edom, heb' winh sreyal Soba yet' heb' filisteo. Ix yak'nhej ganar winh b'ajtak ix yak' owal.
Ha t'a junel ix smolb'ej masanil soldado winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' amalec. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel heb' israel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol tz'elk'an tastak ay t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Isúi yet' pax winhaj Malquisúa. Ay pax chawanh yisil winh, jun ix skuch Merab, haton ix b'ab'el, haxo ix schab'il, skuch Mical.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Saúl chi' Ahinoam sb'i ix, yisil ix winhaj Ahimaas. Haxo winh sat yajalil heb' soldado winh, Abner sb'i winh, yuninal winhaj Ner yicham winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi' yet' winhaj Ner smam winhaj Abner, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Abiel.

Yakb'an ayoch winhaj Saúl chi' reyal t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' heb' filisteo. Yuj chi' a heb' kelemtak jelan, te ay pax yip, ix och heb' t'a soldadoal yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Ha Jehová ix in chekani ayik ix ach in sik'ankanoch reyal t'a Israel haton schonhab'. Yuj chi' cha ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' amalecita yujto yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' israel ayik skotnak heb' t'a Egipto.

Yuj chi' ol ach b'at ak' owal yet' heb', tza satel heb' yet' tastak ay t'a heb', malaj junok makan b'aj tz'ok' a k'o'ol. Tza milcham masanil heb' winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' hato yalji yet' pax nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' camello yet' nok' b'uru, tza satel smasanil, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix smolb'ej heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix sayan yil heb' winh t'a Telaim. Ay 10 mil heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 200 mil heb' yik juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a chonhab' Amalec, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado t'a yol jun takinh melem.

Ix yalanb'at winh t'a heb' quenita: --Elanhek t'a skal heb' amalecita, yik manh ol ex in satel yet' heb', yujto ok'nak he k'o'ol t'a heb' ketisraelal ayik sjawinak heb' t'a tik, ayik spetoj heb' t'a Egipto, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' quenita chi' t'a skal heb' amalecita chi'.

Ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' amalecita chi', ix scha'anel yich winh t'a Havila, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Shur t'a smojonalxo Egipto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalecita chi' yuj heb'.
Ix syamankot winhaj Agag heb', haton winh sreyal heb' amalecita chi'. Pitzan winh ix syaman winh heb'. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' amalecita, ix miljicham heb'.

Palta a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado, maj smilchamlaj winhaj Agag chi' heb'. Maj smilpaxchamlaj nok' wakax heb' te wach', nok' kalnel, nok' yunetak wakax te b'ak'ech, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhokxo tastak te ay stojol. Haxo masanil tas malaj wal yelk'ochi, ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel icha tik:

Skus in k'o'ol yujto ix wak'och winhaj Saúl tik reyal, yujto tzin spatikejkanel winh, maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh. Ix kus sk'o'ol winhaj Samuel, yuj chi' pilan ak'wal ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, te ak'walto ix b'at winh yil winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Carmel. Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun monumento winh yuj yik'ancha'anh sb'a. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a Gilgal.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' ta'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh. Toxo ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', xchi winh.
--¿Tas yaj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax swab' yok' chi'? xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

--Ha t'a chonhab' Amalec ix kot nok', yujto a wal nok' kalnel te wach' ix yik'kot heb' soldado yet' nok' wakax yik ol och silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo, ix ko sateli, xchi winh.
--Numan tzach aji. Ol wal t'ayach tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin t'a k'ik'i t'ak'wal, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Al an, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha t'a yalanhtaxo malaj elk'och a na'ani, palta ach och yajalil t'a masanil yinhtilal Israel. Ha Jehová ix ach ak'anoch sreyalok ko chonhab' tik.
Ach schekanpaxb'at a satel juntzanh heb' amalecita malaj swach'il tas sk'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
¿Tas yuj maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach, ina to ix ik'kot tastak t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'? Te chuk tas ix a k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ma'ay, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', ix in xit'ek'i, ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix schek in k'ulej. Ix wik'kot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' amalecita chi', ix in satanel masanil heb' anima ta'.

Haxo heb' soldado ix ik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' wakax wach' t'a skal nok' to yowalil satjieli. Ix yik'ankot nok' heb', yik tz'ak'chaj nok' silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a Gilgal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Samuel chi': Ste stzalaj Jehová tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', t'a yichanh juntzanh silab' sko nhustz'a t'ay. Yel xo te wach' tato sko cha kab' tas syala', t'a yichanh pax sko nhustz'a xepu'al nok' kalnel t'ay.

Tato sko pitej ko b'a t'a Jehová, lajan ko mul icha smul heb' naumel lolonel. Tato skik'cha'anh ko b'a, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala', lajan wal ko mul icha smul heb' tz'em kuman t'a komon Dios. Yujto ix a patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach spatikejpaxel yet' a reyal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Yel toni, ix och in mul, maj in k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová yet' tas ix al t'ayin, yujto ix in xiw t'a heb' soldado ajun wet'ok, ix in cha wab' tas ix yal heb'.
Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol to tzin ak' niwank'olal yuj in mul ix ochi, meltzajanh wet'ok tzonh och ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
--Manh ol in meltzajlaj het'ok, yujto ix a patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol ach yik'el t'a reyal t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Haxo yik ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yalani, ix och yub'naj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a sti' spichul winh, ix nhik'chaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Icha wal ix utej a nhik'chitan in pichul tik, icha chi' ol yutej Jehová yik'anel opisio t'a reyal t'a yol a k'ab', ol yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' junxo ketchonhab' ek'to wach' t'a ichanh.
Yowalil ol elk'och jun tik, yujto a Jehová skik'cha'anh a onh israel onh tik, malaj b'aj syesej, malaj b'aj sk'ex spensar ichok anima, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' --Yeltoni ix och in mul, palta elokab' t'a a k'ol tzach meltzaj wet'ok yik ay welk'och t'a yichanh heb' yajalil ko chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab' smasanil. Meltzajanh wet'ok, tzonh och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh, ix och winhaj Saúl chi' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --Ik'ekkot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' Amalec chi' t'a wichanh, xchi winh. Ix te tzalaj winhaj Agag chi' ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi', manhxo ol chamlaj winh sna'ani.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --Yuj k'e'en espada tik tzijtum heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a manh uneal. Icha wal ix ajkan heb' ix chi', icha chi' ol aj skan ix a nun, xchi winh. Maj yak' niwank'olal winh, ix skotakxikanb'at winhaj Agag chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gilgal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh t'a Ramá, ix meltzajpax winhaj Saúl t'a spat t'a Gabaa.
Ayik pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', majxo b'atlaj winh yil winhaj Saúl chi', palta skus winh yuj winh. Ix kuspax Jehová yujto ix yak'och winhaj Saúl sreyalok Israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --¿B'ak'inh ol aktej a kus yuj winhaj Saúl chi'? Maxtzak yal in k'o'ol to ol yak'nhej yajalil winh t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha tiknaik, ak' b'ut'jok nok' a ch'a'ak yet' aceite, tzach b'at t'a spat winhaj Isaí t'a Belén, yujto toxo ix in sik'el jun winh yuninal winh yik tz'och reyal sk'exulok winhaj Saúl chi', xchi t'a winh.

--¿Tas wal tz'aj in b'ati? Ta syab' jun tik winhaj Saúl chi', tzam in smilcham winh, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ik'b'at junok nok' kob'es wakax tzach b'ati, tzalani to ak'oj silab' t'a Jehová tzach k'ochi.
Slajwi chi' tzawtan winhaj Isaí chi' yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' winh. Hata' ol wal t'ayach tas ol a k'ulej. Ha mach ol in ch'ox t'ayach, tza sik'kaneli, tzak'ank'e aceite t'a sjolom, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal Jehová chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Belén, ix ul chaji winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', elanhchamel ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas tzul a k'ulej mamin? ¿Wach' am tas tzul a k'ulej? xchi heb' t'a winh.

--I', tzin jawi wak' jun silab' t'a Jehová. B'o'ek he b'a icha yalan ley, ol ex b'at wet'ok yik sko chi'an jun silab' tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Isaí yet' t'a heb' winh yuninal to sb'o sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' heb' yet' winh.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Isaí yet' heb' winh yuninal chi', elanhchamel ix yiloch winhaj Eliab winhaj Samuel chi', ix sna'an winh: Tekan a jun winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Manh ach och k'elan chajtil yilji jun winh tik, manh iloch ste'el winh, yujto manhoklaj winh tik. Ha heb' anima, a chajtil yilji heb' anima, a syiloch heb', palta a in xo tik, a spensar heb' swilochi, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Abinadab t'a yichanh winh, palta ix yalanxi winh: Manhoklaj junxo winh tik sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Sama t'a yichanh winh, ix yalanxi winh: --Manhoklaj junxo winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix ek'chaj heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' yukwanhil t'a yichanh winh. Malaj junok heb' winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Isaí chi': --¿Tom anhej heb' winh uninal tik? xchi winh. --Ayto junxo winh tzak'an unin, aykanb'at winh tanhwoj kalnel, xchi winhaj Isaí chi'. --Ak'b'at yik'umal winh an, tato max ja winh, manh ol onh walaj, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

Ix schekanb'at yik'umal junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Haxo ix jawi winh, ix yilanoch winhaj Samuel chi', chakpulinak yilji winh, te wiwo yilji yol sat winh, te wach' sniwanil winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Haton winh tik, ak'k'e aceite t'a sjolom winh, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' sch'a'ak winhaj Samuel chi', haton b'aj ayem aceite. T'a yichanh heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' smasanil ix yak'k'e aceite winhaj Samuel chi' t'a sjolom winh. Ha winh chi' David sb'i winh. Atax t'a jun k'u chi' ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh. Haxo yik ix lajwi swa heb', ix meltzajxi winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.
Ix yik'el Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl, haxo jun espíritu chuk ix ak'jikanoch t'a winh, ste ixtaj wal winh yuj.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh: --Mamin rey, a tas tzach ik'ani tekan a junok espíritu chuk ix ak'jioch t'ayach yuj Dios yik tzach yixtani.

Yuj chi' schaokab' a k'o'ol, tzonh b'at a onh a chekab' onh tik ko say junok winh syal schalan te' arpa, yik wach' a tzach yixtan jun espíritu chi', schalan te' arpa chi' winh, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxi a k'o'ol, xchi heb' winh.
--Ixikek an, a junok winh te jelan schalan te' tzeyik'koti, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh ayek' chi' icha tik: --Ay wal jun winh wojtak a in tik, yuninal winh winhaj Isaí aj Belén, te wach' schalan te' arpa chi' winh, hanhejtona' te wach' winh t'a owal. Te ay spensar winh sloloni, wach' yiljipax sniwanil winh. Ayoch Jehová yet' winh skila', xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yak'b'at schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Isaí chi', ix yalanb'at winh: Ak'kot winh uninal aj David t'ayin, winh stanhwan nok' a kalnel, xchib'at winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Isaí chi', ix yak'ankot winhaj David chi' winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yak'ankot jun nok' b'uru winh yet' winh, kuchb'il jun ikatzil pan yuj nok' yet' jun tz'u'um ayem wino t'a yo'ol yet' pax jun nok' yune' chiwa.
Ayik ix jawi winhaj David t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochkan winh schekab'ok winh. Te xajan ix aj winh, ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Saúl chi' yik'umalok syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ix yak'anb'at jun schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Isaí, smam winhaj David chi', ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol to skan winhaj David tik wet'ok, yujto te wach' winh t'ayin swila', xchib'at winh.

Ayik tz'ixtaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj jun espíritu chuk ayoch chi' t'ay, tz'och ijan winhaj David chi' schalan te' arpa chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', tz'el jun espíritu chuk chi' t'a winh, wach' tz'ajxi sk'ol winh syab'i.
Ay jun k'u, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Soco, t'a yol yik Judá, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix sb'o scampamento heb' t'a Efes-damim, t'a snanhal Soco chi' yet' Azeca.
Hanhejtona' pax winhaj Saúl, ix smolb'ejpax sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal t'a sch'olanil Ela, yik smakan sat heb' filisteo chi' heb'.
Ayek' heb' filisteo chi' t'a jun tzalan, haxo t'a junxo tzalan ayek' heb' israel chi'. Ay jun ch'olan aykan t'a snanhal heb'.
Ix elta jun winh soldado t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb', te cha'anh ste'el winh, ay am oxeok metro ste'el winh, Goliat sb'i winh, aj chonhab' Gat winh.
Ha t'a sjolom winh ayk'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce, haxo pax t'a snhi' sk'ol winh ayoch jun k'e'en coraza nab'a bronce paxi. Ay am oyeok arroba yalil jun k'e'en coraza chi'.
Aypaxoch k'e'en bronce t'a sat spenek winh, yet'nak k'e'en kotak lanza winh t'a yich spatik.
Haxo ste'al yok k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak chi', te niwan spatik, haxo k'e'en hierro ayoch t'a snhi', ek'to 13 libra yalil. Haxo t'a yichanh winh b'ab'el sb'at winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab'.

Sjawi tek'tek' winh t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel, te cha'anh tz'awajk'eta winh, syalan winh: --¿Tas yuj t'a stzolal tzex komon ajelta eyak'an owal? Ha in tik filisteo in, a exxo soldado ex winhaj Saúl. Ha tiknaik, sik'ekelta junok winak t'a he kal chi', yik tz'emta winh yak' owal wet'ok.
Tato stechaj yak'an owal wet'ok, tato tzin smilchamok, a onh tik ol onh ochkan he chekab'ok, palta tato a in tzin milcham jun winh chi' jun, a exxo tzex ochkan ko chekab'ok.
Tato ay junok winak t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik skot yak' owal wet' tiknaik, kotokab'i, ol kak'an owal, xchi winh filisteo chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl yet' masanil heb' soldado tas ix yal winh chi', ix te tak sk'ol heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj Saúl chi', ay jun winh t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá skuchan Isaí, te icham winakxo winh, wajxakwanh yuninal winh. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay jun winh skuchan David.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayoch soldadoal yuj winhaj Saúl chi', a winhaj Eliab b'ab'el, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Sama. Slajwub' uninxo winhaj David chi'.
Ha winhaj David chi', ay b'aj xit'ek' winh b'aj ay winhaj Saúl chi', smeltzajxi winh t'a Belén yik sb'at stanhwan nok' skalnel winh smam winh chi'.
Ha winh filisteo chi', junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil ayul winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi'. 40 k'uhal ix sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Isaí chi' t'a winhaj David chi': --Ik'b'at ox almulok ixim trigo tik yet' lajunheok ixim pan, b'at ilan heb' winh uk'tak chi'.
Tzik'anb'at lajunheok nok' queso t'a winh yajalil heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tzilani tato wach' sk'ol heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tzik'ankot junok tas sch'oxnab'ilok tato yel wach' sk'ol heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ha t'a sch'olanil Ela ayek' winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuk'tak winhaj David chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado israel yik syak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'.

Ayik ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'ankan nok' skalnel winhaj David chi' t'a junxo stanhwumal, ix b'at winh, ix yik'anb'at tastak ix schek winh smam winh chi' yik'b'ati. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a scampamento heb' soldado israel chi', wanxo sb'at heb' yak' owal chi', wan yel yaw heb' sb'at heb'.
Ix sb'oanoch tzolan sb'a heb', hanheja' ichapax chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi'.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'kan tastak yet'nak winhaj David chi' ab'enal t'a junok heb' stanhwan scampamento heb', ix b'at winh b'aj tzolanoch heb' chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tas yaj heb' winh yuk'tak chi'.

Ayik wan slolon winh yet' heb', ix elixta winh filisteo aj chonhab' Gat chi', winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yetfilisteoal chi', ix syamanxioch winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi' icha t'a junjun k'u. Ix yab' winhaj David chi' masanil tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh filisteo chi' heb' israel chi', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Ay heb' ix halani: Ina winh ix elta t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', sb'uchwaj winh t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Ix yal winh rey, tato ay mach syak' ganar smilancham jun winak tik, te niwan b'eyumal ol yak' winh t'ay, syak'anpax ix yisil winh yetb'eyumok, haxo heb' sk'ab' yok maxtzak stuplaj heb' t'a winh rey chi', xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey: --¿Tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach tz'ak'an ganar smilancham winh filisteo chi', yik syaktej winh onh sb'uchani? ¿Tas yaj jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', yuj chi' sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi heb' icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach smilancham jun winh ajk'ol chi'.

Ayik wan sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a heb' ix halan chi', ix yab'an winhaj Eliab winh yuk'tak winh, ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas tzul a k'ulej t'a tik? ¿Mach ix ak'kan yil jaywanh nok' a kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um chi'? Wojtak to niwan elk'och a na'ani, palta chuk a pensar, tonhej tzul il tas tz'aj yoch owal tik, xchi winh.
--¿Tom ay tas wan ex wutan jun? ¿Tom ay yowalil in k'anb'ani? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutej junxo winh chi' yalan t'a winh.
Haxo heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winhaj David chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Mamin, mokab' chab'ax a k'o'ol yuj jun winh filisteo chi'. Ol in b'at a in a chekab' in tik, ol wak' owal yet' winh, xchi winh.
--Max yal-laj a b'at ak' owal yet' jun winh filisteo chi', yujto kelem unin ach, palta a jun winh chi', toxonton ak'um owal winh yiktax ix kotoch winh kelemal, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha in a chekab' in tik, ayik tzin tanhwan nok' skalnel winh in mam, ay b'aj sjawi nok' choj, ma nok' oso yik tzul yik'anb'at nok' kalnel chi' nok',
tzin b'at t'a spatik nok', tzin tok'anek' nok' kalnel chi' t'a nok'. Tato skot nok' t'ayin, tzin och yub'naj t'a yalanh sti' nok', tzin milancham nok'.
Yuj chi', taxonhej a junok nok' choj, ma junok nok' oso, schamnhej nok' wu'uj. Icha chi' ol wutej jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. ¿Tas yuj sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan?

Ha Jehová tzin kolan t'a nok' choj yet' t'a nok' oso chi', hanheja' ol in kolan t'a jun winh filisteo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ixik an, aokab' Jehová ol och het'ok, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul winhaj Saúl yik owal ayoch yuj, ix schekan winh ak'jokoch t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix ak'jik'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce t'a sjolom winh, ix ak'jipaxoch jun k'e'en coraza t'a snhi' sk'ol winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch jachan k'e'en espada winh t'a snanhal, ix yak'lan winh sb'eyi. Maj yal-laj sb'ey winh yet'ok, yujto manh k'ajanok winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. --Max yal-laj in b'ey yet' juntzanh tik, manh in k'ajanoklaj yet'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'el masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'ay, ix b'at winh b'i'an.

Anhej jun te' sk'okoch winh ix yik'a', ix sik'ank'e oye' k'olan k'e'en k'e'en winh t'a sti' ha ha', ix yak'anem k'e'en winh t'a yol jun syune' pa, yet'nak jun ch'anh mejme'ech winh, ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun winh filisteo chi'.
Hanheja' jun winh filisteo chi', ix snitzkot sb'a winh t'a slak'anil winhaj David chi', b'ab'el jun winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab' winh yuj.
Ayik ix iljikot winhaj David chi' yuj jun winh filisteo chi', ix yilan winh to te wach' yilji sniwanil winh, palta malaj yelk'och winh t'a winh, yujto kelem unin winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj David chi': --¿Tom tz'i' in tzila' yuj chi' tzach kot t'ayin yet' te' a te' chi'? xchi winh. Ix syamanoch winh skatab'an winhaj David chi' t'a sb'i sdiosal.
Ix yalan winh: --Kotanh t'a tik, ol wak' a chib'ejal schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha ach tik tzach kot ak' owal wet'ok yet' k'e'en espada yet' k'e'en a lanza yet' pax k'e'en a kotak lanza. Ha inxo tik tzin jawi wak' owal het'ok yet' spoder Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh soldado israel onh tik, haton malaj yelk'och halani.

Ha tiknaik, a Jehová ol ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab'. Ol ach in milchamok, ol in xikanel a jolom. Ol wak'anpax sniwanil heb' etchonhab' tik schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to a ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Dios t'a wal yel.

Masanil heb' anima molanek' tik, ol nachajel yuj heb' to manhok k'e'en espada, manhok k'e'en lanza syak'lab'ej Jehová yik skolanel heb' schonhab'. Ha jun owal tik yik Jehová, ha' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix kot winh filisteo chi' t'a yichanh winhaj David chi', hanheja' winhaj David chi' elanhchamel ix b'atpax winh t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yak'anemb'at sk'ab' winhaj David chi' t'a yol spa, ix yik'ank'eta jun k'e'en k'e'en winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smejme'ech chi', ix sjulan k'e'en winh. Ha wal t'a snanhal sat winh filisteo chi' ix och k'e'en, ix kan ch'apnaj k'e'en t'a snanhal sat winh chi', ix telwi winh, lachan ix aj winh t'a sat lu'um.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar winh yuj winhaj David chi'. Anhej yet' jun k'olan k'e'en k'e'en yet' jun ch'anh mejme'ech ix milji winh yuj winh. Malaj yespada winhaj David chi',

yuj chi' ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winh filisteo chi', ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en yespada winh winh t'a yol yatut. Ha yet' k'e'en ix xikel sjolom winh filisteo chi' winh. Ayik ix yilan heb' filisteo to toxo ix cham jun winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' chi', ix el lemnaj heb'.

Haxo yik ix yilan heb' soldado Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a sti' chonhab' Ecrón. T'a masanil yoltak b'e sb'atnhej t'a Saaraim, sk'och t'a Gat yet' t'a Ecrón chi', toxonhej teltumb'a ix ajkan sniwanil heb' soldado filisteo schami.
Ixlajwi sb'at tzak'an heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo t'a juntzanh lugar chi', ix meltzaj heb' yik'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix yik'ank'e sjolom jun filisteo chi' winhaj David chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en syamk'ab' winh filisteo chi' winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smantiado.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl sb'at winhaj David yak' owal yet' winh filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Abner, yajalil heb' soldado: --Abner, ¿mach smam jun winh kelem tik? xchi winh.
Mamin rey, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winhaj Abner chi'. --Skan t'a yol a k'ab' a k'anb'ani mach ay yik winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ayik wan smeltzaj winhaj David chi', ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo chi' yuj winh, yet'nak sjolom winh chi' winh, haxo winhaj Abner ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ach kelem, ¿mach a mam? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Yuninal in winhaj Isaí, winh a chekab' kajan t'a Belén, xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon winhaj David yet' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', te wach' ix yil winhaj David chi' winh icha wal syutej syailan sb'a.
Hanheja' winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak'kanoch yopisio winhaj David chi' winh, majxo yak'laj meltzaj winh winh t'a spat smam.
Ix yak' sti' winhaj Jonatán t'a winhaj David chi' to wach' ol yil-laj sb'a heb' winh t'a masanil tiempo, yujto te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yik'anpaxel masanil spichul winhaj Jonatán yik owal ayoch yuj, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj David chi' yet' k'e'en yespada, jul-lab' yet' cincho ayoch t'a snanhal winh.

Masanil b'aj ix chekji winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a owal, te wach'nhej ix elk'och winh, yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh yajalil t'a jun makan heb' soldado. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj heb' soldado yet' heb' ayoch yopisio yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayik ix jax heb' soldado smasanil t'a owal, ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo yuj winhaj David chi', ix laj elta heb' ix ix t'a junjun chonhab' yik scha'an heb' ix sjawi winhaj rey Saúl chi'. Sk'e chennaj heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, stzinhan k'e'en spandereta heb' ix yet' k'e'en splatillo.
Wan sb'itan heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'o'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix.

Ha jun chi', te ya ix och ix yab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix chichonk'e sk'o'ol winh, ix yalan winh: --Ste ik'jiwalcha'anh winhaj David t'a wichanh, yuj chi' syal heb' ix ix tik to lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winh, a inxo tik jayenhej mil ix in milchamok. Jab'xonhej wal yoch winh tik reyal in k'exulok, xchi spensar winh chi'.
Atax ta' ix ochkan chi'an sk'ol winh t'a winhaj David chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix och jun espíritu chuk yuj Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix och lokoax winh t'a sdespacho, ix och ijan winhaj David schalan te' arpa, ichataxon sk'ulej, yet'k'e jun k'e'en lanza winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix kot wal numnaj t'a sjolom winh ix yila', ix sjulanoch k'e'en slanza winh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', yik tz'ochkan ch'apnaj winh yet' k'e'en t'a sat pat chi' sna'an winh, palta chael ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi'.
Ix xiwk'e winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi', yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', haxo pax yet' winh jun, manhxo ayok ochlaj Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi', manhxo'ok t'a spat winh chi' ix munlaj winhaj David chi', palta to ix yik'el winh winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'anoch winh winh yajalil t'a jun mil heb' soldado, haton winh et'jinak heb' ayik ix xit'ek' heb' t'a owal.
Yalnhej b'aj ix ek' winhaj David chi', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix te wach' xiw winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh.
Masanil heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá, te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj heb'. Ste tzalaj heb' yet' winh yujto a winh skuchb'an heb' t'a owal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi': --Swak' ix b'ab'el wisil skuchan Merab etb'eyumok, anhej to jelannhej tzutej a b'a t'a owal, tzak'an owal kuj a onh schonhab' onh Jehová tik, xchi winh. Ix sna winhaj Saúl icha chi' yujto malaj snib'ej winh yoch smul smilan winhaj David chi', wach' hama tato a heb' filisteo smilan winh sna'an winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Mamin rey, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, manh niwanoklaj yelk'och in mam yet' heb' in k'ab' wok t'a skal heb' ketisraelal yik tzin och a nhi'ok, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal yak'an ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh, haton ix Merab, haxo t'a winhaj Adriel aj Mehola ix yak' ix winh.
Haxo junxo ix yisil winh skuchan Mical, te ay snib'ej ix t'a winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', te wach' ix yab' winh.

Yuj chi' ix sna'an winh to ol yak' junxo ix yisil winh chi' yetb'eyumok winhaj David chi', yik wach' yuj ix ol miljokcham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David t'a schaelal: --Ha tiknaik, wal yel ol ach och in nhi'ok, xchi winh.

Ix stz'akan yal winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio yuj: --Tzex lolon yet' winhaj David he ch'okoj, tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha winh rey, tzach ste xajanej winh, tzach ko xajanejpax a onh tik. Yuj chi' ach ochokab' snhi'ok winh rey chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix b'at heb' winh ay yopisio chi' yal juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Am he na'ani to sekojtak woch snhi'ok winh rey chi', ina to meb'a' in, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' yal t'ay, tas ix aj yalan winhaj David chi'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' ay yopisio chi': --Alek t'a winh, max stuplaj ix wisil tik winh icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima, anhej syik'kot 100-ok sjolom swinakil heb' winh filisteo winh t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj in pakan in b'a t'a heb' wajk'ol chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani yik smiljicham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix b'atxi heb' ay yopisio chi' yal t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix scha'an sk'ol winh yoch snhi'ok winh rey chi'. Ayik manto k'ochlaj sk'uhal,

ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix smilancham 200 heb' winh filisteo winh. Tz'akan ix yik'kot sjolom swinakil heb' winh winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yik tz'ochkan winh snhi'ok winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ix Mical yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yilan winh to a Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', ix yilanpax winh to te xajan winh yuj ix Mical chi',
yuj chi' ix te wach' xiwk'e winh t'a winh, ix te wach' och winh ajk'olal t'a winh.

Ha heb' filisteo ix te ochnhej heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel, palta a winhaj David chi', te jelan winh t'a owal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil soldado winhaj Saúl t'a juntak el, yuj chi' ix te b'inaj winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio to smilcham winhaj David heb'. Palta te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi',
yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Wan sna'an winh in mam ach smilchamok. Yuj chi' te lista tzutej a b'a k'ik'an, tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a junok b'aj te k'ub'eltak.
Yujto a k'ik'an chi', tzin b'at yet' winh in mam chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayach ek' chi', swalan t'a winh u'uj, tzaxo wal t'ayach tas tz'aj yalan winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh smam chi' yuj tastak wach' sk'ulej winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin, manh wach'ok tato tzach och ajk'olal t'a winhaj David a chekab', yujto malaj b'aj tz'och smul winh t'ayach, yujto niwan tas wach' ix ik' t'a spatik winh.

Ix ila' to ix sb'ek sb'a winh schami ayik ix smilancham winh filisteo winh, icha chi' ix aj skolchaj ko chonhab' tik yuj Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix il wal. Ix ach te tzalaji. ¿Tas yuj tza na' a milcham winh, ina to malaj jab'ok smul winh t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix scha yab' winhaj Saúl chi' tas ix yal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Tik swak' kan in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh tas ix aj yalan winh smam chi' t'ay. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj David chi' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yopisio t'a stz'ey winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochxi owal junelxo yet' heb' filisteo, ix elixta winhaj David chi' yak' owal yet' heb', te niwan heb' ix smilcham winh, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochxi jun espíritu chuk t'a winh yuj Jehová. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat, yet'nakk'e k'e'en slanza winh, haxo winhaj David chi' wan schalan te' arpa winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yik'ancha'anh k'e'en slanza winh rey chi', ix sjulanoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj David yik tz'ochkan ch'apan winh t'a sat pat chi' yuj k'e'en yalani, palta ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix b'atkan ch'apan k'e'en lanza chi' t'a sat pat chi'. Ix el lemnaj winhaj David t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' to sb'at och stanhwumal winhaj David chi' t'a spat, yik wach' haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, b'at miljokcham winh. Haxo ix Mical yetb'eyum winh ix halan t'ay: --Tato manh ol a kol a b'a t'a jun ak'wal tik, k'ik'an chamnak hachxo, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anelta jun ch'anh lasu ix t'a jun wentena, hata' ix emta winhaj David chi' yik skolan sb'a.

Ix yik'ankot jun sdiosal ix, ix yak'anek' jichan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj David chi'. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh xil nok' chiwa ix jalb'il t'a sjolom jun sdiosal chi', ix yak'anb'at jun sábana ix t'a yib'anh.
Ayik ix yak'anb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl b'at syam winhaj David chi', ix yalan ix Mical to pena'ay winh.
Ix schekanxib'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot winh t'a sat sch'at chi' t'a tik, a in ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.
Ix och heb' t'a yol spat winhaj David chi' yik syilan heb', tikni anhej jun yechel jichanek' t'a sat ch'at chi', ayoch jun xil chiwa sk'anh jolomok. Ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a ix Mical chi': --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tza kolanel jun winh wajk'ol chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Yujto ix yal winh t'ayin: Ol ach in milchamok tato max in a chaeli, xchi winh, xchi ix.

Icha chi' ix aj skolchaj winhaj David chi'. Ix b'at skolan sb'a winh b'aj ay winhaj Samuel t'a Ramá. Ix yalan winh t'a winh tas ix utaj yuj winhaj Saúl chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh t'a Naiot yik b'at kajnaj heb' winh ta'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to ha t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' winhaj David chi',

ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot winh. Ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' chi', ix yilan juntzanh heb' schekab' Jehová heb', wan sb'itan heb' yuj Yespíritu Dios, haxo winhaj Samuel chi' skuchb'an heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix och heb' t'a skal heb', ix b'itan heb'.
