Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj rey David t'a cuartel t'a Sion chi', yuj chi' Schonhab' Winhaj David ix sb'iejkani.
Ix sb'ok'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak chi', ix schab'at t'a ch'olan masanto ix k'och t'a smuroal chonhab'. Haxo winhaj Joab ix wach' b'oan stz'akub' chonhab' Jebús chi'.
Ix yik'an stek'anil yopisio winhaj rey David chi', yujto a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil aynhejoch yet' winh.

Ha heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak, ix och heb' winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ayik ix yak'anoch winhaj David chi' heb' reyal t'a yol smakb'en Israel smasanil. Ix te och wal heb' winh yet' winh yik syak'an reyal winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Haton slistail heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak chi': Ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Hacmoni, sat yaj winh t'a skal oxwanhxo heb' winh yetb'inajnakil chi'. Ha t'a junel ix smilcham 300 heb' winh winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza.
Haxo junxo winh t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo, yinhtilal winhaj Aho.

Ha t'a junel ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a Pas-damim ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo yak' owal ta'. Hata' ay jun munlajel b'aj awab'il ixim cebada. Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' soldado Israel t'a yichanh heb' filisteo,

haxo heb' winh chawanh chi' ix kan tek'naj t'a skal jun munlajel chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo chi' yuj heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkan chonhab' Israel yuj Jehová.

Ha t'a junel, a oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a sattak k'e'en yik b'at schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a jun k'e'en nhak'e'en skuchan Adulam. Haxo heb' filisteo ay scampamento heb' t'a sch'olanil Refaim.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ayek' scampamento heb' filisteo t'a Belén.
Yujto ste takji sti' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Komonok a ha ha' ay t'a stiel chonhab' Belén swuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'anelta ha ha' heb' winh t'a ha' uk'b'ila' t'a stiel chonhab' Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mokab' scha Dios wuk' ha ha' tik. Ichato ha' schik'il heb' winh tik swuk'ej tato swuk' ha', yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj yuk'ejlaj ha' winh. Haton jun tik ix sk'ulej heb' winh oxwanh te b'inajnak chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, yajal yaj winh t'a 30-xo heb' winh te b'inajnak. Ha t'a jun pekti', ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an sb'inajnakil winh t'a skal heb' winh 30 chi'.
Yuj chi' te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'. Ix och winh yajalok heb' winh, palta maj k'ek'och winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te b'inajnak pax winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Ha winh ix milancham chawanh soldado yuninal winhaj Ariel aj Moab. Haxo t'a junel ayik te ay k'e'en sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun jul. Hata' ix smilcham jun nok' choj winh.

Hanhejtona' ix smilcham jun winh aj Egipto winh. Nanhal am yoxil metro ste'el winh aj Egipto chi', haxo steal k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak, niwan spatik. Palta a winhaj Benaía chi' anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh. Ix yik'ek' k'e'en slanza winh aj Egipto chi' winh, haxo yet' k'e'en slanza winh chi', ix smilcham winh.
Ha yuj juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' ix yik' wal sb'inajnakil winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el b'inajnak chi'.
Niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a yichanh heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj k'ochlaj icha heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'jioch winhaj Benaía chi' yuj winhaj rey David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha heb' winh 30 b'inajnak chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Samot aj Harod, winhaj Heles aj Pelón,
winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa, winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot,
winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, winhaj Ilai aj Aho,
winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, winhaj Heled yuninal winhaj Baana aj Netofa paxi,
winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa ay t'a yol yik Benjamín, winhaj Benaía aj Piratón,
winhaj Hurai kajan t'a sti' ha' Gaas, winhaj Abiel aj Arba,
winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim, winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón,
heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén aj Gizón, winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Sage aj Harar,
winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sacar aj Harar paxi, winhaj Elifal yuninal winhaj Ur,
winhaj Hefer aj Mequera, winhaj Ahías aj Pelón,
winhaj Hezro aj Carmel, winhaj Naarai yuninal winhaj Ezbai,
winhaj Joel yuk'tak winhaj Natán, winhaj Mibhar yuninal winhaj Hagrai,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Berot. Ha jun winh chi' et'jinak syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
winhaj Urías hitita, winhaj Zabad yuninal winhaj Ahlai,
winhaj Adina yuninal winhaj Siza, yinhtilal Rubén, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal chi', 30 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh,
winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Maaca, winhaj Josafat aj Mitán,
winhaj Uzías aj Astarot, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Jehiel, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hotam aj Aroer,
winhaj Jediael yuninal winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Joha yuk'tak winh, aj Tiza heb' winh,
winhaj Eliel aj Mahab, winhaj Jerebai yet' winhaj Josavía. Ha heb' winh tik yuninal heb' winh winhaj Elnaam, winhaj Itma aj Moab,
winhaj Eliel, winhaj Obed yet' winhaj Jaasiel, aj Soba heb' winh.
Ayik wan spechji b'eyek' winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, ay jun nhilanh heb' winh jelan yak'an owal ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winh t'a Siclag.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh soldado chi' ay sjul-lab' heb' winh yet' ch'anh smejme'ech yet'nak. Syal sjulwaj heb' winh t'a schab'il sk'ab'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Haton heb' winh tik:

Ha winhaj Ahiezer sat yajal yaj winh yet' winhaj Joás yuk'tak winh, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Semaa aj chonhab' Gabaa, winhaj Jeziel yet' winhaj Pelet, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azmavet, winhaj Beraca yet' winhaj Jehú aj chonhab' Anatot heb' winh,
winhaj Ismaías aj Gabaón. Ha jun winh tik ayoch winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh 30 b'inajnak, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' winh, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Jahaziel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Jozabad aj Gedera,
winhaj Eluzai, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Bealías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Sefatías aj chonhab' Haruf,
winhaj Elcana, winhaj Isías, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Joezer yet' winhaj Jasobeam, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Coré,
winhaj Joela yet' winhaj Zebadías heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeroham aj chonhab' Gedor.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ayek' winh t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi' te jelan heb' winh, k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb' winh yak'an owal, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Te ow sat heb' winh icha nok' choj. Te jelan sb'ey heb' winh icha sb'ey nok' k'ultakil chej.

Ha sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal, schael t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh yuxluchil: Winhaj Ezer, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Mismana, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Jeremías yet' winhaj Macbanai.

Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha junok winh kennhej yopisio t'a skal heb' winh, yajal winh t'a junok 100 soldado, haxo junok winh niwan yopisio, yajal yaj winh t'a junok mil soldado.

Haton heb' winh ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán t'a b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ayik ix te k'e ha', wan yel ha' t'a stitak b'aj sb'eyi. Ha heb' winh ix pechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'lik ay t'a sk'axepaltak ha'.
Hanhejtona' ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Judá ix k'och yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.

Ix elta winhaj David chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Tato t'a junk'olal tzex jawi, yik tzex kolwaj wet'ok, tzex in cha t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, palta tato tzex jawi yik tzin eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ol jun, wach'chom malaj junok tas chuk ix in k'ulej, aokab' ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham ol yil sb'a heyet'ok, syak'anoch eyaelal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Amasai yajalil heb' winh 30 soldado b'inajnak, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Skak' wal och ko b'a het'ok ach David yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ha ach tik yet' heb' ayoch het'ok, wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, yujto a ko Diosal skolwaj wal het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix chaji heb' winh yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji yopisio heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado chi' yuj winh.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado yinhtilal Manasés, ix och heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh filisteo yak' owal yet' winhaj Saúl yalani. Haxo ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi', ix yalan heb' winh to max yal-laj sb'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix schek meltzaj winh heb' winh t'a Siclag. Yujto ix yal heb' winh icha tik: Haxo talaj tz'aji, a yet' winhaj Saúl syak'och sb'a winh, yujto yajal winhaj Saúl chi' winh, a onh xo tzonh smilcham winh t'a skal owal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ayik wan sjaxkan winhaj David t'a Siclag chi', hata' ix k'och heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés chi' yik syak'och sb'a heb' yet' winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Adnas, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Jediaiel, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Ziletai. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun mil soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'.

Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kolwaj yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um yujto te jelan heb' smasanil t'a owal. Ix och heb' winh yajalilok heb' winh soldado winhaj David chi'.
Junjun k'u sk'ib' sb'isul heb' winh soldado ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi'. Te niwan heb' winh, te ay pax smay heb' winh.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh soldado te jelan ix k'och t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal sk'exulok heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl yuj heb' winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová, haton heb' winh tik:
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 6 mil 800 soldado yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab', yet'nak pax slanza heb' winh, lista yaj heb' winh yak'an owal.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ay 7 mil 100 heb' winh soldado tek'an.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ay 4 mil 600 heb' winh soldado.
Ay pax 3 mil 700 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Joiada ayoch yajalilok heb' winh.
Ha winhaj Sadoc kelem winh, te tek'an winh t'a owal. Ay 22 heb' sk'ab'yok winh, yajal yaj heb' winh, ajun heb' winh yet' winh.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Saúl, ay 3 mil heb' winh soldado ix k'och yet' winhaj David chi'. Ayik mantzak uji jun tik, ken manh masanilok heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ay 20 mil 800 heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te b'inajnak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 18 mil heb' winak ix chekjikoti yik tz'ak'jikanoch winhaj David reyal.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ix jawi 200 heb' winh yajal yet' pax masanil heb' winh soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh. Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak tik, snachaj wal el yuj heb' winh tas smoj sk'ulej chonhab' Israel.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ay 50 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal, syalnhej sk'anan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal heb' winh, b'ekan sk'o'ol heb' winh skolwaj yet' winhaj David chi'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ay mil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' 37 mil heb' winh soldado yet'nak slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay 28 mil 600 heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, ay 40 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.

Haxo t'a heb' ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ay 120 mil heb' winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' pax t'a nanhalxo yinhtilal Manasés. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'akan yaj heb' winh yet' masanil syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ha masanil juntzanh heb' winh soldado tik, ix ja heb' winh t'a Hebrón ayik ix yak'ankanoch winhaj David heb' winh sreyalok chonhab' Israel. Hanhejtona' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb' smasanil.
Oxe' k'uhal ix ek' heb' yet' winhaj David chi' ta'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', yujto a heb' yetchonhab' heb' ix ak'an jantak tas ix swa heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'aniltak chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a najat, icha heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix yik'kot wa'el heb' kuchb'il yuj nok' b'uru, nok' camello, nok' mula yet' pax nok' wakax. Tzijtum makanhil wa'el ix yik'kot heb', icha ixim harina, takinh higo, takinh uwa, wino, aceite, nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Te niwan tas tz'ab'laj ix yik'kot heb', yujto manhxo jantakok tzalajk'olal t'a Israel chi'.
Ix lolon winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun nhilanh heb' winh soldado.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, tato scha he k'o'ol, scha'anpax sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, skawtej heb' ketisraelal ay t'a yol ko makb'en tik, heb' aytokan t'a juntzanhxo lugar. Skawtej pax masanil heb' sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita ayek' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',
yik wach' b'at kik'kot te' skaxail strato ko Diosal. Yujto atax t'a stiempoal winhaj Saúl ix b'atkan te' satk'olal ku'uj, xchi winhaj David chi'.
Masanil heb' chonhab', ix cha sk'ol heb' to icha chi' tz'aji, yujto wach' jun pensar chi' ix yab' heb'.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj rey David t'a yol masanil smakb'en, skotnhej t'a ha' Sihor t'a smojonal Egipto, masanto b'aj tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Amat, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Dios t'a Quiriat-jearim,
skuchanpax Baala t'a yol yik Judá. Ix b'at yik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios chi' heb' ta', haton Dios ay t'a yib'anh heb' querubín b'aj tz'ik'chajcha'anh sb'i.
Ix yik'elta te' skaxail strato Dios chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Abinadab, ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun te' ak' carreta. Haxo winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, ix kuchb'an b'ey te' carreta chi'.

Haxo winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal, ste tzalaj wal heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Yet' wal smasanil yip heb' sk'e cheneljok, sb'itan heb' yet' arpa, salterio, panderas, platillo yet' trompeta.
Palta ayik ix jawi heb' t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Quidón, a winhaj Uza chi' ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi', yujto ijan ix telwi nok' wakax tok'jinak te' carreta chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix chamkan winh ta' yuj, yujto ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj rey David chi', yujto ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a winhaj Uza chi', ix cham winh yuj. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'iejnhejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix te xiw winhaj rey David t'a Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: Tekan manhxo ol yal-laj wik'anb'at te' skaxail strato Dios b'aj kajan in, xchi winh.
Majxo yik'kot te' winh b'aj kajan chi', anhej to ix yal winh to skan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.

Ha te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', oxe' ujal ix kan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'. Ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix yak'kot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey David. Ix yak'anpaxkot heb' albañil winh yet' heb' nhikum te', ix yik'ankot te' k'ute' heb' yik sb'ochaj spalacio winhaj rey David chi'.
Yuj chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' to a Jehová ix ak'anoch winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ix ik'jicha'anh yopisio winh yuj Jehová yujto xajan chonhab' Israel yuj.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj rey David ix yik' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil ix alji yet' heb' ix.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón,
winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Elpelet,
winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía,
winhaj Elisama, winhaj Beeliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok masanil heb' israel, ix och ijan heb' sayan tas tz'aj yak'an ganar, palta elanhchamel ix yab' winh, ix elta winh t'a yichanh heb' chi'.
Ix jawi heb' filisteo chi' yak' chukal t'a heb' anima kajan t'a sch'olanil Refaim.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj rey David t'a Dios icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo tik? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ak' owal yet' heb', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj rey David b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Icha wal tz'aj sjakan sb'e junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ix aj sjakan b'e Jehová t'ayin t'a skal heb' wajk'o'ol, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi'.
Ix yaktejkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey David chi' nhusjoktz'aok.
Palta a heb' filisteo chi', ix jaxxi heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios, ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, manh ach och t'a sat heb' ak'an owal, palta to ha t'a spatik heb' tzach koti, b'aj ay te' bálsamo.

Ayik ol ab'ani ichato ay mach wan sb'eyek' t'a sk'ab'tak te te' chi', tzach och ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a in ol in b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh yik tzin milancham heb' soldado filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Dios, icha wal chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix satel heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix b'atnhej t'a Gabaón masanto ix k'och t'a Gezer.
Icha wal chi' ix aj sk'echa'anh sb'inajnakil winhaj rey David t'a masanil nación. Ha Jehová ix ak'an xiwk'e masanil nación chi' t'a winh.
Ix schekan winhaj rey David b'ochajk'e juntzanh pat t'a jun chonhab' skuch Schonhab' winhaj David. Ix sik'anel jun lugar winh b'aj tz'aj te' skaxail strato Dios t'a yol jun mantiado ix b'ochaji.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' manh levitaok, max yal yik'anb'ey te' skaxail trato heb', yujto a Jehová ix sik'anel heb' levita chi' yik syik'an b'ey te' kaxa chi' heb', yik tz'ak'jipax serwil yuj heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot masanil heb' yetisraelal winh, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Jehová yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'ilxo yuj winh.
Ix smolb'an pax masanil heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, 120 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Uriel yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, 220 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Asaías yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, 130 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Joel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán, 200 heb' ix molchaji: Ha winhaj Semaías yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, 80 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Eliel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Uziel, 112 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Aminadab yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.

Ix yawtan heb' winh sacerdote winhaj rey David chi', haton winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Abiatar yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Uriel, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Joel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eliel yet' winhaj Aminadab.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex levita ex tik, yajal heyaj t'a skal masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, b'o'ek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, yik syal eyik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'il wu'uj.
Yujto ha t'a sb'ab'elal, manhok ex ix eyik'kot te', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh, yujto manh chamok ix ko k'anb'ej kab'i tas sko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley, yik wach' syal yik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová sDiosal Israel chi' heb' winh.
Ix sb'akhankot te' heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yet' te' sb'akhlab'il, icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' levita to ha t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', sik'chajelta heb' winh sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton salterio, arpa yet' platillo.

Yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal Leví chi' ix sik'chajel heb' winh stzinhan platillo, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán yuninal winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Asaf yuninal winhaj Berequías sk'ab'yok winhaj Hemán chi' yet' winhaj Etán yuninal winhaj Cusaías. Ha heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Merari. Ix sik'chajpaxoch juntzanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an te' arpa: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jaaziel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Uni, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Elifelehu, winhaj Micnías yet' heb' winh stanhwan puerta, haton winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel.
Haxo winhaj Quenanías yajalil heb' winh levita chi'. Ha winh skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', yujto te jelan winh.

Haxo heb' winh stanhwan te' skaxail trato: Haton winhaj Berequías, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jehías. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Eliezer. Haton heb' winh spu'an trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios chi'.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb' ayik ix xit' yik'an te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' heb' levita chi' ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', yuj chi' ix yak' ukwanh nok' mam wakax heb' yet' ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il.

Ha pichul lino te wach' ayoch yuj winhaj rey David chi', icha pax chi' yik heb' winh levita b'akhjinak te' kaxa chi' yet' yik heb' winh sb'itani yet' yik winhaj Quenanías skuchb'an heb' winh. Ay pax och jun chaleka nab'a lino yuj winhaj rey David chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix ik'jikot te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix puchaj nok' ch'a'ak kalnel yet' trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo, salterio yet' arpa.

Ayik ix jawi te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' t'a Schonhab' winhaj rey David, haxo ix Mical ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winhaj Saúl, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentena. Ayik ix yilan ix to a winhaj rey David chi', sk'echennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' ix schakel winh ix t'a spensar.

Ix ak'jioch te' skaxail strato Dios chi' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'ilxok'e yuj winhaj rey David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanh silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan wach' lolonel winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' nok' chib'ej yet' juntzanh te' takinh sat uwa t'a junjun anima chi'.

Ix yak'ankanoch yopisio heb' winh levita winh yik smunlaj heb' winh b'aj ay te' skaxail strato Jehová, haton heb' winh chi' yowalil tz'ak'an yuj diosal, syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel t'a b'ital.

Ha mach skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', haton winhaj Asaf, haxo winh schab'il, haton winhaj Zacarías. Slajwi chi' skot pax winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel. Haton heb' winh chi' ay syamk'ab' yik b'it, ay salterio heb' winh, ay pax yarpa heb' winh. Haxo winhaj Asaf chi' stzinhan platillo.
Haxo pax heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Jahaziel, a heb' winh spu'annhej k'e'en trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' b'ab'elto ix yal winhaj rey David t'a winhaj Asaf yet' pax t'a heb' winh ayoch yet' winh to sb'itej juntzanh ak'oj yuj diosal tik heb' winh t'a Jehová:
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová. Kalekel yab'ixal. Kalek t'a masanil chonhab' tas ix sk'ulej.
Ko b'itejek b'it yuj kik'ancha'anh. Kalekel tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová.
Konh tzalajek yujto yik onhxo. Ayokab' tzalajk'olal yik skak'anem ko b'a t'ay.
Ko k'anek skolwal Jehová, kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh yuninal onh winhaj Jacob schekab' Jehová, a onh chonhab' israel onh tik, to sik'b'il onh eli, ko naekkot tastak satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' tas syutej sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, Yajal t'a masanil sat lu'um tik.
Syak'nhej elk'och strato t'a masanil k 'inal. Ha tas yalnakkani, syak'nhej elk'och t'a smilal makanhil anima tz'ek'i,
haton jun strato sb'onak yet' winhaj Abraham, b'aj yak'nakpax sti' t'a winhaj Isaac.
Ley ajnakkan jun tik t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha jun strato tik ix kan t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik t'a junelnhej,
ayik yalannakkan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' lum Canaán t'ayach, ol ochkan lum a makb'enok, xchinakkan t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Jaywanhanto sb'isul heb' ta'. Tonhej skomon ek' heb' t'a sat lum lum tik.
Tzijtum chonhab' b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' t'a yoltak smakb'en heb' rey.
Manh yalnakoklaj sk'o'ol Dios ixtajnak heb', yuj chi' icha tik yalnak t'a juntzanh heb' rey chi':
Manh eyixtej heb' in chekab' sik'b'ilel tik, xchi.
Konh b'itanek t'a Jehová ko masanil a onh kajan onh t'a sat lu'um tik. Kalekeli to tzonh skolnhej Jehová t'a junjun k'u.
Kalekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulej t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a masanil nación.
Yujto a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay. Te ay spoder t'a yichanh juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha sdiosal juntzanh chonhab', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, palta a Jehová b'oannak satcha'anh.
Niwan chekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' sb'inajnakil. Ha swach'il yilji yet' spoder scheklaj t'a skajnub'.
Ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', alek to a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay yujto niwan yelk'ochi. Ochanhek yet' eyofrenda t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Ochanhek ejmelal t'ay t'a skajnub' te wach' yilji.
Ib'xokab'k'e masanil anima t'a yichanh. A' ix tzatzb'itan yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj.
Tzalajokab' satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Kalek yab' junjun chonhab' to a Jehová rey toni.
k'anhokab' ha' mar, elokab' yaw masanil tas ay t'a yol ha'. Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum b'aj sb'o munlajel yet' masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Elokab' yaw te' niwak te' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto sja yak' yajalil t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach'nhej, tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek icha tik: Mamin, ko Kolumal ach, kolonh. Tzonh a molb'anxikot t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok nacional, yik skak' yuj diosal, skalan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a tzalajk'olal.

Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a masanil tiempo a onh israel onh tik, xe chi, xchi winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan masanil anima: Ujokab' icha tzal chi', xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', a winhaj rey David chi' ix ak'ankanoch winhaj Asaf yet' heb' winh yetlevitail yik syilannhej heb' winh yoch ejmelal b'aj ix kan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junjun k'u.

Ix kanpax winhaj Obed-edom yet' 68 heb' winh ajun yet' winh yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh. Haxo pax winhaj Obed-edom yuninal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hosa, a heb' winh ix tanhwankan spatil chi'.
Ix kanpax winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' heb' winh yetsacerdoteal ajun yet'ok yik syilan heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Gabaón, haton jun anhej Jehová ay yiko'.
Ha heb' winh snhusan silab' t'a Jehová t'a masanil tiempo t'a altar, t'a k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil, icha wal yajkan t'a sley Jehová ak'b'ilkan yuj t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha yet' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix kan pax winhaj Hemán, winhaj Jedutún yet' pax jaywanhxo heb' winh sik'b'ileli yik sb'itan heb' winh, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, spu k'e'en strompeta heb' winh, stzinhan splatillo heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it t'a Dios. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jedutún chi' stanhwan ti' puerta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj meltzaj masanil heb' anima chi' t'a spat. Ix meltzaj pax winhaj rey David yik b'at yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan yet'ok t'a spat.

Ayik kajanxoek' winhaj rey David t'a yol spalacio ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Dios icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a in tik ayinxo och t'a yol in palacio nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, palta haxo skaxail strato Jehová, ha t'a yol mantiado ayek'i, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Natán chi' icha tik: --Syalnhej a b'oan masanil tas tza nib'ej yujto ayoch Dios het'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winh in chekab' aj David to a in Jehová in swal icha tik t'a winh: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e junok in templo b'aj ol in kajnajok.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, manta b'aj tzin kajnaj t'a yol junok pat, palta to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado ix in ajek'i.

Masanil tiempo ix in b'eyek' yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi', malaj b'aj walnak t'a heb' yajalil heb' skuchb'ani to sb'o junok templo heb' nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay b'aj tzin kajnaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Tzalanpax t'a winh to a in swal icha tik: Ha in Jehová Yajal waj t'a smasanil, a in swal icha tik: Ha in ix ach wik'el t'a tanhwum kalnelal yik tzach och yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik.
B'ajtaktil ix ach ek'i ayinnhej och het'ok, ix in satel masanil heb' ajk'ol ix ak'an owal het'ok, ol ach wak'an b'inajok, icha sb'inaj heb' niwak yajal ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Hanhejtona' ix in sik'elta jun lum b'aj tzex kajnajkan a ex in chonhab' ex tik. Ha tik ol ex kannhej kajan t'a junelnhej. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok, manhxo ol ex tzuntzaj yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol icha ix ex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix ex kuchb'ani. Ha in ol in satel masanil heb' eyajk'o'ol. Swak'anpax ojtakejeli to ol wak'nhej opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayik ol lajwokek' a k 'inal, yik mukb'il hachxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal a k'exulok, tek'an wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha jun uninal chi' ol b'oank'e in templo b'aj ol in b'inajok. Ha in ol wak'nhejkan yopisio chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Ha in ol in och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Malaj b'ak'inh ol waktejkan in xajanani. Manh ichaok wutejnak waktankan in xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'nakel winh t'a yopisio yik ach och sk'exulok winh, manh ichok ta' ol wutok.
Ol wak'nhej yopisio uninal chi' t'a in chonhab'. Ha yopisio chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winh rey chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas wal welk'och a in tik? ¿tas pax wal yelk'och heb' in mam wicham, yuj chi' niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayin?

Ach in Diosal, manhoknhej juntzanh tik ix ak' t'ayin, wan alanpaxkani to ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winhtilal t'a b'ak'inh. Lajan tzin utej icha juntzanh heb' niwak winak t'a sat lu'um tik.
¿Tasto wal syal walan t'ayach yuj sniwanil welk'och tzak'a'? Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak wal tas waji.
Mamin Jehová, yujto tzin a xajanej a in a chekab' in tik, yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'o'ol, ix ak'an juntzanh opisio satub'tak tik t'ayin, ix ak'an wojtakejeli.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok. Ha achnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha ach tik.

Ha onh pax a chonhab' Israel onh tik, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan ket'ok, yujto a ach ix onh a kolo', yik tzonh ochkan a chonhab'ok. Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, te niwan ix aj a b'inaj ku'uj, yujto a k'ulejnak tas satub'tak ayik a kolannakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Ik'annakel juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yujto ix onh ak'och a chonhab'ok t'a junelnhej. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ach ochkan ko Diosalok.
Ha tiknaik Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och tas ix alkan t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal.

Elokab'k'och tas ix ala', yik wach' tzach ik'jicha'anh. Mamin Jehová, ol alchajok to a ach Yajal aj t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal ach pax a onh israel onh tik. Ol ochnhej pax winhtilal t'a reyal t'a junelnhej t'a ichanh.
Mamin ach in Diosal, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ol ochnhejkan winhtilal t'a wopisio. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in lesalwi t'ayach.
Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, a ach ix alkan jun wach'ilal tik t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, elokab' t'a a k'ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal, yik wach' ol ajnhej ek' heb' t'a ichanh. Ha ach ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb', ol scha'annhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' juntzanh tik, ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj winhaj rey David. Ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Gat winh yet' yaldeail t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'e'en tumin t'a winh.
Hanhejtona' ix ak'jipax ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba ay t'a stojolal Hamat yuj winh. Ha jun winh rey chi' wan smakan yikok lum lum masanto t'a ha' Éufrates.

Ix yamchaj mil carruaje yik owal yuj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado. Ix yamchajpax 7 mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 20 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok. Ix spol t'inhchaj sch'anhal yok masanil nok' chej et'jinak carruaje yik owal chi' heb', haxonhej nok' sk'anchaj yik stok'an 100 carruaje ix kani.
Ix k'och heb' soldado sirio aj Damasco yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix miljicham 22 mil heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a skal heb' sirio aj Damasco chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'e'en tumin t'a winh. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winhaj David chi', ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Hanhejtona', ix yik'anpaxek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh ayoch oro t'ay sk'an heb' yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Niwan pax k'e'en bronce ix yik'ek' winh t'a Tibhat yet' t'a Cun, haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'. Haton yet' k'e'en bronce chi' ix sb'o jun niwan pila winhaj rey Salomón. Ix sb'o pax juntzanh niwak oy winh yet' masanil yamk'ab' nab'a bronce ix k'anchaj t'a templo.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Toi sreyal Hamat to toxo ix ak'ji ganar masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winhaj rey David,

ix schekankot jun yuninal winh, skuchan Adoram. Yet'nak k'e'en oro winh, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce yik tz'ak'ji stzatzil sk'o'ol winhaj rey David yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a winh, yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winh. Ha winhaj Toi chi' yak'nak owal winh yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ix yak' masanil juntzanh k'e'en chi' winhaj rey David t'a Jehová. Junnhej ix aj yak'an k'e'en winh yet' k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata yik'nakek' winh t'a juntzanh nación tik: Haton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a heb' filisteo yet' t'a heb' amalecita.
Yet' pax winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia, yajalil jun makan heb' soldado winhaj rey David, ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Edom yuj winh. 18 mil heb' ix smilcham winh t'a yak'likal Atz'am Atz'am.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a Edom chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' edomita ix ochkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey David chi'. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winh, ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Ha winhaj David, ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh, t'a stojolal ix sb'o yaj winh tas yaj heb' chonhab'.
Ha winh yajalil heb' soldado, haton winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia. Haxo pax winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sacerdote heb' winh, haxo winhaj Savsa, tz'ib'um ab'ix winh.

Ha pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' quereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo, haton heb' stanhwumal winh rey, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', yajal yaj heb' yik skolwaj heb' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto a winh smam winh ix sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh yuj schamel winh smam winh chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita,

a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a a k'o'ol to niwan yelk'och winh a mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yujnhej chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil a k'o'ol heb' winh? Ma'ay. Ix chekjikot heb' winh yuj winh yik syil heb' winh tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb' winh, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' winh schekab' winhaj rey David chi'. Ix joxjiel xil sti' heb' winh, ix poljiel yoktak sti' spichul heb' winh masanto ix k'eul t'a sti' syo'op heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tas ix aj heb' winh, ix schekanb'at schaumal heb' winh yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb' winh. Ix alji t'a heb' winh to skan heb' winh t'a Jericó masanto sk'ib'xi xil sti' heb' winh chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj paxta heb' winh.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix yak'b'at 660 quintal k'e'en plata winhaj Hanún chi' t'a Mesopotamia, t'a Siria, t'a Maaca yet' t'a Soba yik skot carruaje yet' heb' winh soldado et'jinak yet' heb' winh soldado ayk'e yib'anh nok' chej yik skolwaj yet' winh.

Ix stupanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Maaca yik skot winh yet' 32 mil carruaje yik owal yet' soldado. Ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' ix tupchaj chi' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Medeba. Ix elpaxkot masanil heb' amonita chi' t'a yoltak schonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Ix yak' lista sb'a heb' amonita chi' t'a owal t'a yichanh schonhab' heb'. Haxo heb' winh rey ix yawtejkot heb' chi', ch'ok ix kan heb' winh t'a ak'lik.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab to ay heb' ajk'ol t'a yichanh yet' t'a spatik, ix sik'anel heb' soldado te jelan winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' ix yak'och winh yik skuchb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: Tato max onh tzak'wan t'a heb' sirio chi', elanhchamel tzex kolwaj ket'ok. Tato max ex tzak'wan t'a heb' amonita chi' jun, a onhxo ol b'at onh kolwaj heyet'ok.
Tek'b'ej a b'a, kak' owal yuj ko kolan heb' ketchonhab', haton schonhab' ko Diosal. Yak'okab' Jehová tas tz'el t'a sk'o'ol, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix el pax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai chi', ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joab chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' ay t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates yik skot heb' kolwal yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Sofac yajalil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer skuchb'an heb'.

Ix alchaj juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado Israel winh, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' heb' sirio chi'. Ix sb'oanoch soldado winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an owal yet' heb'.
Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'. Ay 40 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok ix chami yet' 7 mil heb' ayk'e t'a yol carruaje. Ix champax winhaj Sofac chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix och heb' t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj rey David chi', ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Atax ta' majxo yal sk'ol heb' sirio chi' ix kolwaj yet' heb' amonita.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempoal sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix kan winhaj rey David t'a Jerusalén, haxo winhaj Joab ix molb'anb'at heb' soldado yetisraelal yik syixtanb'at heb' tastak ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' amonita. Ix b'atnhej heb', ix yoymitan chonhab' Rabá heb', ix yak'an owal heb' yet'ok, masanto ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och winhaj rey David yik'kot scorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi'. Nab'a oro jun corona chi', tzijtum k'e'en k'e'en wach' yilji ayoch t'ay, ay am oxeok arroba yalil. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winhaj rey David chi'. Manh jantakok tas caro stojol ix yik' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo masanil heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel yet' k'e'en sierra, k'e'en piocha yet' k'e'en ch'akab'. Hanheja' icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' amonita t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajkot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och jun owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gezer. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Sipai. Ha winhaj Sipai chi' yinhtilal winh heb' cha'anh ste'el. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' filisteo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel.

Ix och junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jair ix milancham winhaj Lahmi yuk'tak winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Te niwan spatik yok slanza winhaj Lahmi chi', icha am spatik te te' b'aj sb'ak'chajoch anh ch'al yik heb' sch'alwi.
Ix och junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay junxo winh winak ta' te cha'anh ste'el, lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh, yinhtilal pax winh heb' cha'anh ste'el.
Ha jun winh chi', ix b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey David chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh niwak winak chi', a winhaj Réfah aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb' winh, palta ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado winh.
Ha winh Satanás ix och ajk'olal t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yak' winh sk'ulej winhaj rey David yik syik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado israel winh smasanil.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yet' pax t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ixikek eyik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado. Sb'at he chakot t'a chonhab' Beerseba, masanto tzex k'och t'a chonhab' Dan. Ayik slajwi chi' tzeyik'ankot sb'isul heb' chi' t'ayin, yik swila' jantak heb' t'a smasanil.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an k'ib' sb'isul schonhab' masanto maxtzak yal sb'ischaji. Mamin rey ayoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab' smasanil, ¿tas yuj tza nib'ej jun tik? Ha t'a jun tik ol och smul ko chonhab' tik u'uj, xchi winh.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal winhaj Joab chi', yuj chi' ix b'at heb'. Ayik ix lajwi yik'ancha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' soldado Israel chi' heb', ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yak'an jantak sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado winhaj Joab t'a winhaj David chi', ay 470 mil heb' winh soldado yik Judá yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo smakb'en Israel ay jun millón yet' 100 mil heb' winh winak stiempo sb'at t'a owal.
Palta maj ochlaj heb' winh winak yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín sb'isulok, yujto maj scha sk'ol winhaj Joab jun scheknab'il winh rey chi'.
Maj schapaxlaj sk'ol jun chi' Dios, yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ya'elal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.

Ichato chi' ix yalank'eta smul winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Te niwan in mul ix ochi, yujto ix in k'ulej jun tik, palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal jun in mul tik, yujto icha junok kistal anima ix wutej in b'a, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at il winhaj rey David, tzalan t'a winh to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ay oxe' tas swak' a sik'lej, a ach ol a sik'lej tas junok ol wak' t'ayach, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Gad chi' yil winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Sik'lej junok t'a skal juntzanh ya'elal tik:

¿Tom ha' oxe' ab'il wejel, ma oxe' ujal ol yak' heb' ajk'ol ex smilanchamok, mato oxe' k'uhal ilya ol yak' t'a yol a makb'en tik? Ha jun chi' wespada a in Jehová in tik, yujto a jun wángel ol satanel anima t'a yol a makb'en tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' sik'lej tiknaik yik wach' ol yal wak'an spak t'a Jehová, haton in chekankoti, xchi winhaj Gad chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Gad chi' icha tik: --Maxtzak nachajlaj wu'uj tas tzin sik'lej. Wach' hama to a Jehová tz'em sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, manhok anima swa sk'ab' t'ayin, yujto wojtak to niwan yok'elk'olal Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ilya Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', 70 mil heb' ix cham yuj.

Ix schekankot jun yángel Jehová yik satanel heb' anima t'a Jerusalén. Ayik wan satanel heb' anima chi', ix kusk'e sk'ol Jehová yuj jun ya'elal chi', ix yalan t'a jun yángel wan smilancham anima chi' icha tik: Yechelxo chi', aktej, xchi t'ay. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', a jun yángel Jehová chi', ay wal ek' b'aj wan stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo.

Haxo ix k'e k'elan winhaj rey David, ix yilan winh to ayek' jun yángel Jehová chi' t'a snanhal lum lum tik yet' satcha'anh, yet'nakk'e jun k'e'en espada, wan yak'anem k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yib'anh Jerusalén. Yet'nhej chi' ix em nhojan winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel masanto t'a sat lu'um, ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Mamin, a in wal ix wala' to tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' chonhab' tik. Ha in wal ix och in mul. Malaj smul heb' anima tik. Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jun ya'elal tik, ha t'a wib'anh yet' winhtilal tz'emi, manh a satel a chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Gad to syal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' to sb'ok'e junok altar winh b'aj stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' sb'ok'e jun altar yik tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'i Jehová, icha ix aj yalchaj chi'.
Ha winhaj Ornán yet' chanhwanh yuninal winh, wan stek'wi trigo heb', haxo ix yilan heb' to ayek' Yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix b'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ornán chi' to wan sk'och winh rey t'a slak'anil, ix elta winh b'aj wan stek'wi trigo chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tzok wal el t'a a k'o'ol, tza chonh jun lugar b'aj tzach tek'wi trigo tik t'ayin, yik tzin b'ok'e junok altar t'a Jehová, yik tz'och wa'an jun ilya tik t'a kal chonhab' tik. Chonh t'ayin icha wal jantak stojol, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Ornán chi' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, syal in sian jun lugar tik t'ayach yik tza b'oan tas snib'ej a k'o'ol. Swak'anpax nok' toro yik tz'och nok' silab'il yet' te' tek'lab' tik syal yoch te' t'a k'atzitzal, haxo ixim trigo tik, syal yoch ixim t'a ofrendail. Mamin rey, masanil juntzanh tik swak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach yuj masanil juntzanh tik, palta a in tik yowalil ol in tup juntzanh tik smasanil icha wal stojol, yujto max yal-laj wik'anek' a tastak, swak'an silab'il t'a Jehová. Max yal-laj wak'an junok tas silab'il to manh ol in tupu', xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smanan jun lu'um chi' winh rey chi' t'a 600 siclo k'e'en oro.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, ix snhusan silab' winh yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh jun silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a jun ángel chi' to syak'xiem k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yol yatut.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj rey David to ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán chi', ix yak'an juntzanhxo silab' winh t'a Jehová ta'.
Wach'chom a jun mantiado sb'onakk'e winhaj Moisés yikok Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' ay t'a Gabaón jun lugar cha'anh yik ejmelal,
palta maj yal-laj sb'at winhaj rey David ta' yik sk'anb'ej t'a Dios, yujto ix te xiw winh ayik ix yilan jun k'e'en espada winh yet'nak Yángel Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ha tik ol aj stemplo Jehová Dios yet' jun altar b'aj sko nhustz'a ko silab' a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to smolchaj masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a skal heb' israel. Ix sik'chajel heb' tzeyum k'e'en, haton k'e'en ol och t'a yik sb'ochaj stemplo Dios.
Niwan pax k'e'en hierro ix smolb'ej heb' yik tz'och k'e'en t'a lawuxal sk'anchaj t'a puerta. Niwan pax k'e'en bronce ix molb'aji, maxtzak yal-laj yechtaj k'e'en.
Niwan pax te' k'ute', maxtzak nachaji jantak sb'isul te' ix molchaji, yujto a heb' aj Sidón yet' heb' aj Tiro te niwan te' k'ute' chi' ix yik'kot heb'.

Ix sna winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: Ha winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, te uninto winh, haxo pax jun stemplo Jehová ol b'o chi', te niwan ol ajok. Ol te b'inaj yuj swach'il yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' a tiknaik yowalil ol in molb'ejkan tastak ol och t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ayik pitzanto winhaj David chi', te niwan tas ix smolb'ejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Salomón chi' winh, haton winh yuninal winh. Ix yalankan winh to a winh ol b'oank'e jun stemplo Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach wuninal, nab'ilxo wal wu'uj to tzin b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak t'ayin icha tik: Ix wila'' to a ach tik, manh jantakok anima ix a milchamok, manh jantakok pax owal ix ak'a', yuj chi' manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in templo chi'.

Palta ay jun uninal toto ol ajok, Salomón ol ak' sb'iej, malaj owal ol yak'a', yujto a in ol wak'och junk'olal t'a skal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha t'a stiempoal chi' ol wak' junk'olal yet' tzalajk'olal t'a in chonhab' Israel. A' ol b'oank'e jun in templo chi'. Ol och wuninalok, a inxo ol in och smamok. Ol wak'nhejkan yopisio t'a yinhtilal t'a chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, xchinak Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik ach wuninal, aokab' Jehová tz'ochnhej het'ok yik ol a b'oank'e jun templo chi', icha ajnak yalan chi' u'uj.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an a jelanil, yik wach' ayik ol ak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol a k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il.

Wach'nhej ol ajelk'och smasanil, tato ol a k'anab'ajej wal masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés kuj a onh israel onh tik. Ak' ip, tek'annhej tzutej a b'a. Manh ak' chab'ax a k'o'ol, manh ach xiwok.

Ix wak' wal wip yik smolb'ajkan 66 mil quintal k'e'en oro yik tz'och t'a stemplo Jehová chi' yet' 660 mil quintal k'e'en plata yet' jun niwan b'ulanh k'e'en bronce yet' k'e'en hierro maxtzak yal yechtaji. Manh jantakok pax te te' ix in chek molb'ajkanok yet' k'e'en k'e'en. Ha hachxo ol ak' tz'akwok.

Tzijtum heb' winh munlajwum ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' ol munlaj het'ok, heb' tzeyum k'e'en, heb' albañil yet' heb' nhikum te'. Maxtzak b'ischaj jantak heb' winh winak te jelan t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal, icha t'a k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata, k'e'en bronce yet' t'a k'e'en hierro ol munlaj het'ok. Yuj chi' jun, ochokab' munlajel, ochokab' Jehová het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil to tz'och heb' winh yet' winhaj Salomón chi' t'a munlajel. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. A' ix ak'annhej junk'olal t'ayonh t'a masanil ko makb'en, yujto ha' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' ix ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yet' t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh schonhab' onh tik.

Yuj chi' ak'ek wal och t'a he k'o'ol eyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal. Tzeyak' wal och t'a he k'o'ol he b'oank'e templo b'aj tz'ik'jicha'anh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol ak'jokoch te' skaxail strato chi' t'a yo'ol yet' pax masanil syamk'ab'il jun templo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ayik te icham winakxo winhaj rey David, ix yak'ankanoch yopisio winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Salomón yik tz'och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.
Ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yuj winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita.
Ix schekan b'ischaj heb' winh levita winh, haton heb' winh winak ek'alxo t'a 30 ab'il sk'inal, 38 mil sb'isul heb' winh.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi', ix sik'chajel 24 mil heb' winh skuchb'an heb' smunlaji yik sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová. Haxo 6 milxo heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a juezal yet' t'a yajalilok chonhab' chi'.

Chanhe' mil heb' winh ix och stanhwumalok puerta. Chanhe' mil pax heb' winh ix och yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová, sk'anan jantak yamk'ab' yik b'it heb' winh, haton juntzanh yamk'ab' scheknak winhaj rey David chi' b'ojok yik sk'anchaj ta'.
Makkiltakil ix yutej heb' winh levita chi' winh, icha smam yicham junjun makan heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Laadán yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Laadán chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jehiel, winh b'ab'el yuninal winh, winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', oxwanh pax heb' winh: Winhaj Selomit, winhaj Haziel yet' winhaj Harán. Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal winhaj Laadán chi'.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jahat b'ab'el, winhaj Zina schab'il, winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería. Ha winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería chi', manh wal tzijtumok yinhtilal heb' winh yik stzak'wan heb' yilan yopisio, yuj chi' junnhej makan ix aj heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat, chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Amram chi', haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Aarón chi' ix sik'chajel yet' yinhtilal yuj Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik syil heb' tastak yiknhej Jehová yaji, yik snhusan incienso heb', skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och ejmelal yet' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Haxo pax heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios jun, ix och heb' stz'akub'ok heb' yetlevitail.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Moisés, haton winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón chi', a winhaj Sebuel yajal yaji.
Ha winhaj Eliezer chi' junnhej yuninal winh, haton winhaj Rehabías, winh yajal yaji. Haxo pax winhaj Rehabías chi', tzijtum yuninal winh.
Ha winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Izhar, yajal yaj winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hebrón: Haton winhaj Jerías winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Amarías winh schab'il, winhaj Jahaziel winh yoxil yet' winhaj Jecamán winh schanhil.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Uziel: Haton winhaj Micaía winh b'ab'el yet' winhaj Isías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari, haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis.
Ha winhaj Eleazar chi' malaj junok yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay, haton heb' ix chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cis.
Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi, oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jeremot.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Leví, icha syal smakanhil ix aj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh ek'alxo t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio t'a templo.
Ix yal winhaj rey David icha tik: Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix onh ak'ankan kajan t'a tik a onh schonhab' onh tik, ix kan pax skajnub' t'a Jerusalén tik,
yuj chi' a heb' levita manhxo ol skuch b'eyek' smantiado Jehová heb' yet' pax jantak syamk'ab'il yik tz'och ejmelal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh yinhtilal Leví, ayik stz'akwi 20 ab'il sk'inal heb' winh, stz'ib'an sb'a heb' winh icha ajnak yalankan winhaj rey David t'a slajwub' slolonel.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix kan heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová, yik syilan yamak'il heb' winh yet' yoltak cuarto yet' yilan heb' winh sakb'itaj masanil yamk'ab' yiknhej Jehová yaji. Syilanpax juntzanh munlajel heb' winh t'a templo chi'.

Haton yik sb'ochaj ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová, syilan ixim harina heb' winh tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail, ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, juntzanh ofrenda sb'ochaj t'a yol xalten yet' ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite. Syilanpax echlab' heb' winh sk'anchaj t'a ofrenda.
Hanhejtona' yowalil aynhejek' heb' winh t'a templo chi', yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb' winh yet' aloj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a junjun k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil,

yet' yik snhuschaj silab' t'a Jehová t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, t'a sk'uhal k'inh ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' pax juntzanhxo k'inh te niwak yelk'ochi. Tz'ak'winhej serwil heb' winh t'a Jehová icha jantak sb'isul heb' winh yet' munlajel ak'b'il sk'ulej heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh chi' stanhwanpax mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' skajnub' chi'. Smunlajpax heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová chi' icha yajkan t'a yib'anh yinhtilal heb' winh yuj tas yalnakkan heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yilan yopisio heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi'. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', b'ab'laj chamnak heb' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi'. Mantalaj yuninal heb' winh schamnak heb' winh chi', yuj chi' anhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix och sacerdoteal.
Makkiltak ix aj heb' winh sacerdote yuj winhaj rey David chi', yuj winhaj Sadoc yinhtilal winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Ahimelec yinhtilal winhaj Itamar.

Haxo ix yilan heb' winh to a heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi' tzijtum sb'isul heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, yuj chi' 16 makan ix aj heb' winh, haxo heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi', wajxak makannhej heb' winh.

T'a sorteoal ix aj yochkan junjun makan heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, yujto ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar ay heb' winh niwak yajal sik'b'iloch t'a yopisio t'a templo t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' pax heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, ix sik' sorteo heb' winh t'a stzolal, jun yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi', jun pax yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smunlaj heb' winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Natanael yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví ix tz'ib'an sb'i heb' winh ayik ix sik'an sorteo chi' heb' winh. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sacerdote chi' yet' t'a skal heb' winh levita, testigo yajkan heb' winh.

Haton sb'i heb' winh tik ix kannhej t'a junjun makan t'a stzolal, icha syal sb'i heb' winh yajalil heb' winh ix sik'an sorteo chi', schael yich t'a heb' winh b'ab'el masanto t'a heb' winh slajwub', 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil: Winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Harim, winhaj Seorim, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Cos, winhaj Abías, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Secanías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Hupa, winhaj Jesebeab, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Imer, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Afses, winhaj Petaías, winhaj Hezequiel, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Gamul, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Maazías.

Haton heb' winh tik ix pojchajek' t'a stzolal t'a sacerdoteal yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a templo, icha syal sley Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, icha ajnak yalan t'a winhaj Aarón smam yicham heb' winh.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Leví tik: Haton winhaj Jehedías yinhtilal winhaj Subael, yinhtilal pax winhaj Amram.
Winhaj Isías b'ab'el t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Rehabías.
Winhaj Jahat yinhtilal winhaj Selomot, yinhtilal pax winhaj Izhar.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jerías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Jahaziel yet' winhaj Jecamán.
Winhaj Samir yinhtilal winhaj Micaía, yinhtilal pax winhaj Uziel.
Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Isías yuk'tak winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Jaazías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaazías chi': Haton winhaj Beno, winhaj Soham, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Ibri.
Chawanh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi': Haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis. Ha winhaj Eleazar chi', malaj yuninal winh. Haxo pax winhaj Cis chi', ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Jerameel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi chi': Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jerimot. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví.

Hanhejtona' heb' winh chi', t'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, icha ix sk'ulej heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Haton t'a yichanh winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh sacerdote, hata' ix och sorteo chi'. Lajannhej ix aj heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal winh b'ab'el winak yet' t'a skal yinhtilal winh tzak'anto.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, ix sik'el heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf heb', winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, yik skuchb'an heb' anima heb' ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Dios, yik syalanel slolonel Dios heb' yet' sonal arpa, salterio yet' pax platillo. Haton sb'i heb' ayoch t'a yopisio tik:

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Zacur, winhaj José, winhaj Netanías yet' winhaj Asarela. Ha winhaj Asaf chi' skuchb'an heb' winh. Ha winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios ayik syalan winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún, wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zeri, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Matatías yet' winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Jedutún chi' skuchb'an heb' winh, syalanpax slolonel Dios heb' winh yet' arpa yik tz'alji yuj diosal yet' yalchaj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a b'ital.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hemán, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Buquías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Sebuel, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Romanti-ezer, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Hotir yet' winhaj Mahaziot.

Ha heb' winh chi' yuninal heb' winh winhaj Hemán. Ha winhaj Hemán chi', schekab' Dios yaj winh, a winh tz'ak'an razón t'a winh rey. 14 yuninal winh ix yak' Dios yet' oxwanh yisil winh, yik tz'elk'och sti' Dios yak'nak t'a winh, ayik yalannak to niwan ol ajelk'och winh.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a winh smam heb' winh skuchb'an t'a b'it yik tz'och ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton platillo, salterio yet' arpa. Ha winhaj Asaf, winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hemán ayoch heb' winh t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh rey.
Ha sb'isul heb' winh k'ayb'annak sb'itan t'a Jehová chi' yet' yinhtilal, 288 heb' winh t'a smasanil.
T'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh sb'itani, tz'och heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' heb' winh kelemtak, heb' winh k'ayb'umxo yet' heb' winh wanto sk'ayb'ani.

Ayik ix lajwi yoch sorteo chi', icha tik ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal, 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil. Lajchawanh sb'ey heb' winh t'a junjun makan, aynhej yuj sb'a heb' winh. Ha t'a skal junjun makan heb' winh, ay junjun heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh, haton heb' winh tik, schael yich t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh slajwub': Winhaj José, winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zacur, winhaj Izri, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Buquías, winhaj Jesarela, winhaj Jesahías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Simei, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Subael, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Hotir, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Mahaziot, winhaj Romanti-ezer.
Hanhejtona' t'a stzolal ix aj spojchajb'at heb' winh tanhwum puerta, icha tik ix aj heb' winh: Haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré: Ha winhaj Meselemías yuninal winhaj Coré yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jediael, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Jatniel,
winhaj Elam, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Elioenai.

Ix yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom, yuj chi' tzijtum yuninal winh. Haton stzolal sb'i heb' winh tik: Winhaj Semaías, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Joa, winhaj Sacar, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amiel, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Peultai.
Haxo winhaj Semaías chi', ay heb' winh yuninal winh te niwak ix aj yelk'ochi, yuj chi' yajal ix aj heb' t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semaías chi', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Otni, winhaj Rafael, winhaj Obed, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Samaquías.

Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Obed-edom. Masanil heb' winh uninab'il yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb', te tek'an heb' winh, ay yip heb' winh smunlaji, 62 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok winh, 18 heb', te jelan heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa, yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Simri. Wach'chom manhok winh b'ab'el uninab'il yaji, a winh smam winh ix ak'anoch yajalil.
Haxo heb' yuk'tak winh: Haton winhaj Hilcías schab'il, yoxil winhaj Tebalías, schanhil winhaj Zacarías. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, 13 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix pojchajek' heb' stanhwan stemplo Jehová yet' heb' yajalil heb', icha ix aj juntzanhxo heb' yetlevitail heb'.
Sorteoal ix aj sch'oxji tas puertail stanhwej junjun makan heb', ayoch heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ichamtak winak.

Ha winhaj Selemías yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Selemías chi', jelan yak'an razón winh. Ha winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal norte yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok.
Haxo winhaj Obed-edom yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta t'a stojolal sur. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh ix tanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a templo.

Haxo winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hosa yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh, a heb' winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' jun puerta yik Salequet b'aj sk'e b'e. Ha heb' winh kuchb'um chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj stanhwan puerta chi' heb' winh.

Junjun k'u, ay wakwanh heb' winh stanhwan puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh t'a stojolal norte, chanhwanh pax heb' winh t'a stojolal sur, haxo pax b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Jehová chi', chatakwanh heb' winh stanhwan junjun puerta.
Haxo t'a yamak'il templo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh stanhwan t'a sti' scalleal, chawanh pax heb' winh stanhwan t'a yamak'il chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spojchajek' opisio chi' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' yik winhaj Merari.
Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' yetlevitail heb' tz'ilan b'aj sik'chaj tas yik Jehová yaji yet' b'aj smolchaj ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ay.
Ha winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Laadán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jehiel chi', haton winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel, a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ix ak'chajpaxoch heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Amram t'a yopisio, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Ha winhaj Sebuel, yinhtilal winhaj Gersón yuninal winhaj Moisés, a winh tz'ilan wal juntzanh tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ha winhaj Sebuel chi', sk'ab'yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Selomit, yujto a smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi', haton winhaj Eliezer yuk'tak winhaj Gersón smam yicham winhaj Sebuel chi'. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Zicri, winhaj Joram, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Rehabías yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok stanhwan tastak ak'b'il yikok Jehová yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal yet' heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado.
Ha juntzanh tas ix yak' heb' chi', haton tastak ix yik' heb' b'ajtak ix laj och owal, ix yak' heb' yik sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Jehová.

Hata' aypaxkan masanil tas yak'nakkan winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios, winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner yet' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia. Masanil juntzanh ak'b'il yikok Jehová chi', a winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok ix tanhwani.

Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar kotnak winhaj Quenanías yet' heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha heb' chi', manhxo'ok t'a stemplo Jehová ix och heb' t'a yopisio, palta to ix och heb' t'a niwak yajalil yet' juezal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha winhaj Hasabías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, ay mil 700 sb'isul heb', te jelan heb'. Ix ak'jioch yopisio heb' yilan tastak yik Jehová yaji yet' masanil tastak yik winh rey t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.

Haxo pax t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán chi', b'aj kajan heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Jerías yet' 2 mil 700 heb' sk'ab'yok, ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Yinhtilal pax heb' winhaj Hebrón. Ayik 40 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj David reyal, hata' ix saychajek'i b'ajtak kajan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón. Ix ilchaji to ay heb' kajan t'a Jazer t'a yol yik Galaad, te jelan pax heb', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch heb' t'a jun opisio chi'.

Junjun ujal tz'och 24 mil heb' winh winak t'a soldadoal. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal, ay heb' winh niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' tz'ilan tastak yik winh rey. Haton sb'i heb' winh ayoch yajalil tik, t'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh t'a junjun uj.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj a winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Zabdiel yinhtilal winhaj Fares tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a schab'il uj, a winhaj Dodai aj Aho tz'ochi. Haxo winhaj Miclot schab'il yajal yaji.
Haxo t'a yoxil uj, a winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada tz'ochi.
Ha winhaj Benaía chi', yajal yaj winh t'a 30 heb' soldado te b'inajnak, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amisabad, schab'il yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado tz'och t'a jun uj chi'.
Haxo t'a schanhil uj, a winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab aykanoch sb'i t'ay, palta haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winh ayoch yajalil sk'exulok.
Haxo t'a yo'il uj, a winhaj Samhut yinhtilal Izhar tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swakil uj, a winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yukil uj, a winhaj Heles aj Pelón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swajxakil uj, a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a sb'alunhil uj, a winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, yinhtilal Benjamín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajunhil uj, a winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yuxluchil uj, a winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajchawil uj, a winhaj Heldai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Otoniel tz'ochi.

Haxo pax heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel, haton heb' winh tik: Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, a winhaj Eliezer yuninal winhaj Zicri yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, a winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Maaca yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, a winhaj Hasabías yuninal winhaj Kemuel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Sadoc yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj Eliú yuk'tak winhaj rey David yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, a winhaj Omri yuninal winhaj Micael yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, a winhaj Ismaías yuninal winhaj Abdías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, a winhaj Jerimot yuninal winhaj Azriel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Azazías yajal yaji. Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Pedaías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a Galaad, a winhaj Iddo yuninal winhaj Zacarías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, a winhaj Jaasiel yuninal winhaj Abner yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, a winhaj Azareel yuninal winhaj Jeroham yajal yaji. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel.

Ayik ix yalan winhaj rey David to sb'ischaj masanil heb' israel, ix yalan winh to max b'ischajlaj heb' manto tz'akwi t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, yujto yak'nak sti' Jehová to ol yik' wal cha'anh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Israel icha sb'isul k'e'en k'anal.

Ix schael yich winhaj Joab yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj lajwoklaj yik'ancha'anh winh, yujto yuj jun chi' ix kot jun niwan ya'elal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Yuj chi' a sb'isul heb' chi' manh tz'ib'ab'ilok t'a yab'ixal winhaj rey David.

Ha winhaj Azmavet yuninal winhaj Adiel tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey. Haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Uzías tz'ilani jantak tas molan t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun aldea yet' t'a junjun cuartel ay t'a sattak mojon.
Haxo winhaj Ezri yuninal winhaj Quelub tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a slu'um winh rey chi'.
Haxo winhaj Simei aj Ramat tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' yuwa winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Zabdi aj Safat tz'ilan heb' smolb'an wino t'a yet'tal.
Haxo winhaj Baal-hanán aj Gedera tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' olivo yet' t'a te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a panhkiltak. Haxo winhaj Joás tz'ilan heb' smolan aceite yik sat te' olivo.
Haxo winhaj Sitrai aj Sarón tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a Sarón chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Adlai tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a panhkiltak.
Haxo winhaj Obil ismaelita tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' camello. Haxo winhaj Jehedías aj Meronot tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' b'uru.
Haxo winhaj Jaziz agareno tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa. Haton masanil heb' winh tik tz'ilan masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán yicham winhaj rey David chi', tz'ib'um winh, te jelan pax winh, ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Hacmoni tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'.
Yet' pax winhaj Ahitofel ak'um razón yajpax winh t'a winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Husai arquita, te wach' yak'an winh rey chi' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Ahitofel chi', a winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Abiatar ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo winhaj Joab sat yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a Jerusalén ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' Israel winhaj rey David: Haton heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' soldado tz'ilan winh rey chi' yet' heb' sat yajal yaj t'a junjun niwak nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix smolb'ejpax heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey chi', haton masanil lum lum yet' masanil nok' nok', heb' tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh, heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yet' masanil heb' soldado te tek'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh niwan yelk'ochi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e linhan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ab'ek he masanil ex wetchonhab'. Ay wal och t'a in pensar in b'oank'e junok templo b'aj skan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik wach' hata' skajnaj ko Diosal chi'. Toxo ix in molb'ej masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'ay.
Palta ix yal Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in kajnub' chi', yujto ak'um ach owal, manh jantakok anima a milnakchamok, xchi t'ayin.

Palta a Jehová ko Diosal chi' ix in sik'ankaneli yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, yujto ha' ix sik'anel yinhtilal Judá, yik syak'an yajalil t'a masanil kinhtilal. Haxo t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', a yinhtilal winh in mam ix sik'kaneli, haxo pax t'a yinhtilal winh in mam chi', a in ix in sik'el t'a skal heb' wuk'tak yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik.
Haxo tiknaik, ha t'a skal jantak heb' wuninal ix yak' Jehová chi', hata' ix sik'el winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, yik tz'ochkan winh reyal in k'exulok t'a ko chonhab' tik.

Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ha winh uninal aj Salomón, a winh ol b'oank'e jun in kajnub' yet' yamak'il, yujto a in ix in sik'kanel winh yik tz'ochkan winh wuninalok, a inxo ol in ochkan smamok winh.
Hanhejtona' ol wak'kan yopisio winh t'a junelnhej, tato ol stek'b'ej wal sb'a winh sk'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il yet' masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, icha sk'ulej winh tiknaik, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, wal t'a eyichanh he masanil ex wetchonhab', schonhab' Jehová yet' t'a yichanh ko Diosal tz'ab'an tas skala', scham wal walan t'ayex to tze b'eyb'alej wal masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajani, yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a jun chonhab' manhxo jantakok swach'il tik. Ha exxo ol eyak'kan smakb'enok heb' eyuninal t'a junelnhej.

Ha hachxo tik ach wuninal aj Salomón, ojtakej wal ko Diosal, tza k'anab'ajan wal yet' smasanil a k'o'ol. Yujto a Jehová yojtak masanil tas sko na' yet' tas sko nib'ej. Tato ol al a b'a t'ay, ol tak'wok t'ayach, palta tato ol ik'kanel a b'a t'ay jun, ol ach spatikejkanel t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik a Jehová ix ach sik'aneli yik ol a b'ok'e jun templo b'aj ol kajnajok, yuj chi' tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel, xchi winhaj rey David chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yumal winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi', haton yechel tas ol aj sb'o yamak'il yet' juntzanh cuarto b'aj ol sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh cuarto ol kan t'a cha'anh yet' juntzanh cuarto ol kan t'a yol templo chi' yet' jun lugar b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul.

Ix yak'anpax yumal masanil tas nab'ilxo yuj winh, haton tas ol aj sb'o yamak'il templo chi' yet' juntzanh cuarto ol och t'a spatiktak b'aj ol sik'chaj masanil syamk'ab'il yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Dios.
Ix yak'anpax yumal winh tas ol aj yoch heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita t'a stzolal yik ol munlaj heb' t'a templo chi' yet' slistail jantak yamk'ab' yik ejmelal ol och t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'an slistail winh jantak k'e'en oro yet' jantak k'e'en plata ol och t'a junjun makan juntzanh syamk'ab'il templo chi':
Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak yalil ol aj junjun sb'akhnub'al candil yet' junjun scandilal chi', tato oro, mato plata.
Icha pax chi' ix aj yalan winh yuj juntzanh mexa ol och oro t'ay b'aj ol em tzolan ixim pan to yik Jehová yaji yet' juntzanh mexa ol och plata t'ay.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak k'e'en oro ol och t'a k'e'en niwak tenedor yik chib'ej, t'a k'e'en niwak uk'ab' yet' t'a k'e'en niwak xalu yet' jantak k'e'en oro, ma k'e'en plata ol och t'a k'e'en kopa yet' t'a juntzanhxo k'e'en icha jantak yalil junjun makan.

Ix yalpax winh yuj jantak k'e'en oro te wach' ol och t'a jun altar yik incienso. Ix yalpax winh jantak k'e'en oro ol k'anchaj t'a jun carruaje, haton juntzanh yechel querubín jenhanb'at sk'axil t'a yib'anh te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios.
Masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkani, yujto a wal Jehová ix ak'an nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' tas ol aj sb'o jun munlajel chi', icha ix aj yechel.

Yuj chi', ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: Tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel. Manh ak' chab'axk'e a k'o'ol, manh ach xiwok, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal manh ol ach yaktejkani. Ol ochnhej het'ok yik ol yik'elk'och sb'a jun munlajel t'a jun templo tik.

Haton heb' sacerdote tik yet' heb' levita, icha syal jay makan heb', te b'ekan sk'ol heb' smunlaj t'a templo chi'. Te b'ekanpax sk'o'ol masanil heb' winh winak smunlaji, heb' jelan spensar smunlaj t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal yet' heb' yajal yaji.
