Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh wach' b'ochajxi altar t'a Jehová, ix yak'an silab' winh yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet' Dios yet' silab' yik ak'oj yuj diosal. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' aj Judá to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios.
Palta a heb' anima chi', hanheja' ix yak'nhej silab' heb' t'a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh, wach'chom ha t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' syak' yalani.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manasés chi' yet' slesal winh t'a Dios yet' tas ix schek Jehová yal heb' schekab', aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Tz'ib'ab'il pax slesal winh yet' tas ix aj spakan Dios. Hanhejtona' pax tas ix aj yoch spitalil winh yet' yik ejmelal ix sb'ok'e winh b'ajtak cha'anh yet' b'ajtak ix b'ochaj yechel Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios ayik manto sna sb'a winh t'a yichanh Jehová, aykan t'a yumal ix stz'ib'ejkan heb' schekab' Dios.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh b'aj ay juntzanh tas awab'il t'a spalacio. Haxo winhaj Amón yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Amón chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová winh t'a yib'anh icha ix sk'ulej winh smam winh. Ix snhus silab' winh t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'ilkan yuj winh smam winh chi', ix ochpax winh ejmelal t'ay.
Maj yik'emlaj sb'a winh t'a Jehová icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh chi', palta a wal chukal ix ste k'ulej winh.
Ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, a heb' winh ix milancham winh t'a spalacio.
Haxo heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix milanpaxcham heb' winh ix milancham winh. Haxo winhaj Josías yuninal winh ix yak'kanoch heb' reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha winhaj Josías chi', wajxake' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, tz'akan ix sb'eyb'alej winh icha sb'eyb'alejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Ayik 16 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik kelem unin wal winh, ix yak'an wal och winh t'a sk'o'ol sk'anab'ajan Jehová sDiosal winhaj David smam yicham winh. Haxo yik 20 ab'il winh, ix syamanoch winh yik'anel tas manh wach'ok t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix schekan winh satjiel masanil juntzanh b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh, yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios tzeyb'il yet' masanil yechel b'ob'il t'a k'e'en k'e'en.

Ha wal t'a yichanh winh ix mak'jipoj juntzanh altar yik masanil yechel Baal. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj altar b'aj snhuschajtz'a incienso b'ajtak cha'anh. Ix schekanpax winh mak'jipoj yechel komon Dios Asera yet' masanil juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios. Chok' ix ajkan smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'ajtak mukan heb' ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ix schekanpax winh nhusjoktz'a sb'akil heb' sacerdote t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi' t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj sakb'itan Judá yet' Jerusalén chi' winh.
Icha pax chi' ix sk'ulej winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a yol yik Manasés, t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, masanto ix k'och t'a yol yik Neftalí.

Ayik ix lajwi smak'jikanpoj masanil juntzanh altar, juntzanh yechel komon Dios Asera yet' juntzanhxo yechel komon Dios, chok' ix ajkani, ix mak'jipaxkanpoj masanil altar b'aj stz'a incienso t'a masanil yol yik Israel chi'. Ichato chi' ix meltzajxi winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik 26 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Josías chi', ayik toxo ix sakb'itej masanil jun nación chi' winh yet' skajnub' Jehová Dios, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochaj skajnub' Dios chi'. Ix ochkan jun munlajel chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yet' winhaj Amasías yajal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén yet' winh tz'ib'um, haton winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Joacaz.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' winh tik yil winhaj Hilcías sat sacerdote. Ix b'at yak'an k'e'en tumin heb' winh t'a winh, haton k'e'en ix scha heb' winh levita stanhwan spuertail stemplo Dios t'a heb' yinhtilal Manasés yet' heb' yinhtilal Efraín, haton masanil heb' kannak t'a yol yik Israel. Ay pax k'e'en ix yak' heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi', haxo heb' winh stupan heb' winh smunlaj t'a templo chi'.

Ix yak'anpax k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh nhikum te' yet' t'a heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', yik smanchaj k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il yet' pax masanil te te' tz'och syamnub'alok yet' pax spatzab'il juntzanh pat emnakkan lanhnaj yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak chi', te wach' ix yutej heb' winh yilan munlajel chi'. Ha heb' winh skuchb'an munlajel chi', a heb' winh levita, haton sb'i heb' winh tik: Winhaj Jahat yet' winhaj Abdías yinhtilal winhaj Merari, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Mesulam yinhtilal winhaj Coat. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh. Ay juntzanhxo heb' winh levita kuchb'um t'a b'it yet' pax t'a yamk'ab' yik b'it chi', a heb' winh tz'ilan heb' kuchum ikatz, ay pax heb' winh tz'ilan heb' smunlaji. Ay pax heb' winh tz'ib'um, ay pax heb' winh stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ayik wan yik'chajelta k'e'en tumin ix b'at ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', haxo winhaj sacerdote Hilcías ix ilanelta yumal b'aj aykan sley Jehová yuj winhaj Moisés.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um to ix ilchaj yumal ley t'a skajnub' Jehová. Ix yak'ankan winh t'a winhaj Safán chi'.
Haxo winhaj Safán chi' ix ik'anb'at t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a onh a chekab' onh tik wan ko b'oan masanil munlajel aykan och t'a kib'anh.
Ix molb'aj k'e'en tumin ix ul ak'chajkan t'a skajnub' Jehová, ix ak'chaj k'e'en t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi' yet' pax t'a heb' winh smunlaji, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha winhaj Hilcías ix yak' jun u'um winh t'ayin, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun u'um chi' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ha wal yik ix yab'an winh rey tas syal jun u'um chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh.

Ix yawtankot winhaj Hilcías winh, winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán, winhaj Abdón yuninal winhaj Micaía, winhaj Safán winh tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Asaías ay yopisio skolwaj yet' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixikek, b'at k'anb'ejek t'a Jehová wu'uj, yuj pax masanil anima kannak t'a Israel tik yet' t'a Judá yuj tas syal jun u'um ix ilchaj tik. Tekan aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh tiknaik, yujto a heb' ko mam kicham maj sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej pax heb' tastak aykan t'a jun u'um tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Hilcías yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ix chekjib'at yuj winh rey chi', ix b'at heb' winh yil ix Hulda ix schekab' Dios, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticva, yixchikin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi' sik'an masanil pichul t'a skajnub' Dios. kajan ix Hulda chi' t'a jun scha makanhil chonhab' t'a Jerusalén. Ayik ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan icha tik: Alek t'a winh ix ex chekankot he k'anb'ej chi' t'ayin
to a in Jehová in tik swala': Ol wak'kot junok ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima kajan t'ay, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a jun u'um ix awtaj t'a ichanh chi'.

Yujto ix in eyaktejkani, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tze nhus incienso. Tze tzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj masanil tas ix he k'ulej chi'. Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal in k'o'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, maxtzak tuplaj.
Yuj chi' alek t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin Jehová sDiosal in Israel tik to a in swal icha tik: Yujto ix a cha ab' tas syal jun u'um chi',

ix ak'an wal och t'a a k'o'ol, ix ak'anoch a b'a t'a yol in k'ab' ayik ix ab'ani to ay yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'ay, yujto ix ik'em a b'a t'a wichanh, ix a nhik'chitanb'at a pichul, ix ach ok'i, hanhejtona' in ix wab' pax tas ix ala'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach:

Ha in ol wak'elk'ochi to junk'olal ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchaj b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham. Ichato chi' ol jawok juntzanh ya'elal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix ul yalan spak tas ix b'at sk'anb'ej heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtajkot masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Judá yet' heb' yik Jerusalén chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e winh rey chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová yet' masanil heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a chi' yet' pax heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh levita yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi' yet' pax masanil heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ichamtak anima. Hata' ix schek winh rey chi' awtaj jun u'um chi' yab' masanil anima chi', haton tastak aykan t'a yumal strato Jehová ix ilchajelta yuj heb' t'a yol templo chi'.

Ix och linhan winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy. Hata' ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to t'a wal smasanil sk'o'ol winh ol sk'anab'ajej sb'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al chi', icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal strato Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima molanek' chi', heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yik Benjamín to syak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yajkan t'a yumal strato sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.

Ix schekan winhaj Josías chi' ik'jokel masanil yechel yajb'entak ay t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Ix yalan winh to tz'och masanil heb' ayek' t'a Israel chi' ejmelal t'a Jehová Dios. Yakb'an pitzanto winh, maj yik'el sb'a heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.

Ix och k'inh yuj winhaj Josías chi' yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová winh t'a Jerusalén chi', haton yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Ayik 14 yoch b'ab'el uj ix smilcham nok' kalnel heb' silab'il yuj k'inh chi'.
Ix yak'anoch heb' winh sacerdote winh t'a yopisio, ix iptzitaj heb' winh yuj winh yik syilan yopisio heb' winh chi' t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ix schekan winh smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh levita tz'ak'an serwil Jehová, haton heb' winh sk'ayb'an heb' yetisraelal. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Naekkoti to a te' skaxail strato Jehová, aykan te' t'a yol skajnub' Jehová sb'onak winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj David sreyal Israel. Yuj chi' a ex tik maxtzak he b'akhlaj b'eyek' te' t'a sjolom he jenhjab'. Ha tiknaik ak'ek serwil Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax heb' ketisraelal schonhab' ko Diosal chi'.
B'oekoch he b'a t'a stzolal, icha syal stzolal smakanhil heb' he mam eyicham, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan yuj winhaj David yet' winhaj Salomón chi'.
Tzex kan nanhalok ex levita ex tik t'a skajnub' Jehová chi', icha syal smakanhil eyaji, yik wach' tzex kolwaj t'a junjun makan heb' ketisraelal sk'ab'yok sb'a,

yik tze milancham nok' kelemtak kalnel silab'il yik k'inh tik. Yuj chi' sakb'itejek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' pax tas yowalil sakb'itaji, yik wach' syal sk'anab'ajan heb' ketisraelal tik masanil tas yalnakkan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a skal nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Josías chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh nok' ix yak' winh t'a heb' anima molanek' chi', yik wach' ay nok' syal yak'an heb' silab'il t'a k'inh chi'. Haton sb'isul nok' tik: 30 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa yet' 3 mil nok' kelemtak wakax.

Hanhejtona' heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol heb' winh yak'an silab' t'a heb' chonhab' chi', t'a heb' winh sacerdote yet' t'a heb' winh levita. Haxo pax winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Jehiel, haton heb' winh tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová, 2 mil 600 nok' kalnel yet' 300 nok' kelemtak wakax ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och k'inh chi'.

Ha winhaj Conanías yet' heb' winh yuk'tak, haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Josabad, haton heb' winh yajalil heb' winh levita, 5 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa ix yak' heb' winh yik tz'och k'inh chi'. Ix yak'anpax 500 nok' kelemtak wakax heb' winh yik syak' nok' heb' winh levita silab'il.
Ayik wach'xo yaj masanil yik tz'och k'inh chi', ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' winh sacerdote t'a stzolal yet' pax heb' winh levita, icha ix aj yalan winh rey.

Ix smilancham nok' nok' chi' heb' winh silab'il yik k'inh chi'. Ix yak'an schik'il nok' heb' winh levita chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote. Haxo heb' winh ix tzikanoch schik'il nok' chi' t'a altar. Ixlajwi chi' ix spatz'anel nok' heb' winh levita chi'.

Ix spojanek' xepu'al nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix yak'an heb' winh t'a junjun makan heb' ayto yuj sb'a, yik syak'an heb' t'a Jehová, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal yuj winhaj Moisés. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutej pax nok' wakax heb' winh.

Ix sb'olan nok' silab' yik k'inh chi' heb' winh, icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkani. Haxo juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi', ix stz'anh nok' heb' winh t'a yol chen yet' t'a yoltak xalten. Elanhchamel ix spukek' nok' heb' winh t'a heb' anima.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'an yik heb' winh levita chi' yet' pax tas yik heb' winh sacerdote, yujto a heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal Aarón te ay tas sk'ulej heb' winh sk'e ak'wal yik snhusan nok' silab' heb' winh stz'a smasanil yet' pax xepu'al nok'. Yuj chi' munil ix sb'o yik heb' winh levita chi', ix sb'oanpax yik heb' winh sacerdote chi' heb' winh.

Haxo pax heb' winh sb'itani, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf, ayoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi', icha yajkan yuj winhaj rey David, winhaj Asaf, winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, schekab' heb' tik winhaj rey David chi'. Haxo heb' winh stanhwan puerta, aypaxoch heb' winh yilan yopisio chi'. Malaj junok heb' winh syaktejkan yilan yopisio, yujto a heb' winh yetlevitail heb' winh sb'o'an nok' silab' heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji serwil Jehová t'a sk'uhal k'inh chi', yik tz'ak'jipax silab' t'ay t'a altar, haton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil, icha ix aj yalan winhaj rey Josías chi'.
Masanil heb' israel wan sb'o'an k'inh chi', uke' k'uhal pax ix swa ixim pan heb' malaj yich.

Malaj b'aj ix och junok k'inh icha jun chi' yiktax t'a stiempoal winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios. Malaj wal junokxo sreyal Israel ix ak'anoch jun k'inh chi' icha ix aj yoch yuj winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh levita yet' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel ayek' chi' yet' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun k'inh chi'.

Ayik toxo ix laj uji juntzanh chi', ayik toxo ix b'ochajxi skajnub' Jehová yuj winhaj rey Josías chi', haxo winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto, wan sb'at winh t'a ha' Éufrates yik syak' owal winh yet' chonhab' Carquemis. Haxo winhaj rey Josías chi' ix b'at smak sat winh.

Ha winhaj Necao chi', ix schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul alchaj t'a winhaj Josías chi' icha tik: Ach sreyal Judá, manh ak' owal wet'ok, yujto manhok het'ok tzin jawi wak' owal, palta a yet' junxo nación aytaxon wowal yet'ok, yujto ha Dios ix halan t'ayin to tzin pil wip wak'an owal tik. Aktej a telan a b'a yet' Dios yik wach' max ach satel yuj, yujto ha' ayoch wet'ok, xchikot winh.

Palta haxo winhaj Josías chi' maj meltzajlaj winh, to ix sk'exel sb'a winh yik syak'an owal winh. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Necao chi', wach'chom ha Dios ix halani. Yuj chi' ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a jun panhan yik Meguido.

Ha heb' sjulwajum winhaj Necao chi', ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' heb' t'a winhaj Josías chi'. Ix yamchaj winh sjulan heb', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' et'jinak scarruaje: Ik'ek in el t'a tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Ix yik'anelta winh heb', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol junxo schab'il carruaje, ix yik'ankot winh heb' t'a Jerusalén, hata' ix cham winh. Ix smukan winh heb' b'aj mukb'il heb' smam yicham. Masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ix ok' heb' yuj winh.

Haxo winhaj Jeremías ixb'o'an jun sb'ital yik snachajkot schamel winh. Ix kannhej jun b'it chi', masanil heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani, ayik sb'itan jun b'it chi' heb' yuj schamel junok anima, snakot winhaj Josías chi' heb'. Ha jun b'it chi' ix ochkan t'a stzolal sb'itan heb' israel yuj junok chamel, aykan t'a yumal sb'ital kusk'olal.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, te wach' icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a yumal sley Jehová
yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh ayik ix el yich yet' slajwub', aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ixlajwi chi' haxo masanil heb' anima ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winh smam chi'.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 23 ab'il sk'inal winh, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto ix ik'anel winh t'a reyal chi'. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en tumin winh sreyal Egipto chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi' yik syak'an 75 quintal k'e'en plata heb' yet' oxe' arroba k'e'en oro.

Haxo winhaj Eliaquim yuk'tak winhaj Joacaz chi' ix ochkan reyal t'a Judá chi' yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ix k'exchaj sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' yuj winh, Joacim ix sb'iejkan winh, haxo winhaj Joacaz chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yuj winh sreyal Egipto chi'.
Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim chi' reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová Dios.
Haxo winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia ix jawi yak' owal yet' winh, ix tzek'ji winh t'a k'e'en cadena, ix ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Hanhejtona' ix yik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanhxo chukal ix sk'ulej winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel yet' heb' yik Judá. Haxo winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joaquín yak'an reyal, 18 ab'il sk'inal winh. Oxe' ujal yet' lajunhexo k'uhal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik jun ab'il chi', ix yal winhaj Nabucodonosor to tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Joaquín chi' t'a Babilonia yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' te caro stojol ay t'a skajnub' Jehová. Haxo winhaj Sedequías ix ak'jioch reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén sk'exulok winhaj Joaquín chi'. Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', sk'ab' yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Joaquín chi'.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Maj sna sb'a sk'o'ol winh yuj skachnab'il ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' aj Jeremías.

Ijan ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor yalani, haton b'aj ix yak' sti' winh t'a yichanh Dios to junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winh. Junelnhej ix yak' pitb'okel spensar winh, majxo yal sk'o'ol winh ix meltzaj t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Hanhejtona' masanil heb' winh yajal t'a Judá chi', heb' winh sacerdote yet' masanil heb' anima, ix te k'e wal cha'anh heb' sk'ulan chukal te yajb'entak. Ha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il ix sb'eyb'alej heb', ix yixtanel skajnub' Jehová heb', haton jun sik'b'ilel yuj t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham heb', ix scheknhejkot heb' schekab' yik tzul kachji heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'ol t'a schonhab' yet' t'a skajnub' chi'.

Palta tonhej ix stzetzej heb' schekab' Dios chi' heb', malaj yelk'och tas ix yal heb' t'a sat heb'. Ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' schekab' Dios chi', masanto ix em wal yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh schonhab' chi', majxo yal-laj yoch wa'an.

Ixlajwi chi', ix chekjikot winh sreyal heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj Jehová, ix jawi winh yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi'. Ix miljicham heb' kelemtak t'a k'e'en espada t'a yamak'il skajnub' Dios. Manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal heb' t'a heb' kelemtak chi' yet' t'a heb' ix kob'estak, t'a heb' icham anima manhxa yip. Ix ak'jioch heb' smasanil t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi' yuj Jehová.

Masanil yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Dios, niwak yet' kotak, jantaknhej tas ay t'a skajnub' chi' yet' masanil sb'eyumal winh rey yet' yik heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh rey chi', pilan ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.
Ix snhusankantz'a skajnub' Dios chi' heb', ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuroal Jerusalén chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a spalacio winh rey heb', ix smak'anpoj masanil tas caro stojol heb'.

Haxo heb' maj miljokcham t'a owal chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix ochkan heb' chekab'ok t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal winh, masanto ayik ix ak'ji ganar Babilonia chi' yuj heb' aj Persia.
Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix schek Dios yal winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an yip lum lum, yujto 70 ab'il manhxalaj mach ix munlaj t'a sat lu'um.

Ayik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová alb'ilkanel yuj winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchaj u'um, syalan icha tik:

Ha in Ciro in tik sreyal in Persia, a in swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nación t'a sat lu'um tik t'a yol in k'ab'. A' ix halan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá. Yuj chi', yalnhej mach ex schonhab' ex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok. Ha tiknaik meltzajanhek t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi winh.

Ayik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix elk'och slolonel Jehová yalnakkanel winhaj Jeremías schekab'. Ha Jehová ix ak'an sna winhaj rey Ciro chi', yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun cheknab'il winh. Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol smakb'en, ix schekanpax winh pukchajel ab'ix, syalan icha tik:

Ha in Ciro in tik sreyal in Persia, a in swal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, ha' ix ak'anoch masanil nación t'a sat lum tik t'a yol in k'ab'. A' ix halan t'ayin to tzin b'ok'e skajnub' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá.
Yuj chi', yalnhej mach ex schonhab' ex Jehová, kolwajokab' Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok. Ha tiknaik ixikek t'a Jerusalén t'a yol yik Judá, tze b'oanxik'e skajnub' Jehová he Diosal chi' ta'.

Yalnhej mach ex ix to ex kan t'a tik, tato he gana tzex pax t'a Jerusalén, kolwajokab' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil chi', yak'okab' k'e'en oro heb', k'e'en plata yet' pax tastak yet' nok' molb'etzal nok' t'ayex. Yak'okab' pax yofrenda heb' yuj skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', xchi jun cheknab'il chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak' lista sb'a heb' yajalil t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá, t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' masanil heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita, haton heb' b'aj ix lolon Jehová t'a spensar to sb'at heb' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at sb'oanxik'e skajnub' Jehová heb'.
Haxo masanil heb' anima kajan t'a slak'anil heb', ix yak' k'e'en oro heb', k'e'en plata, nok' molb'etzal nok', tastak te caro stojol yet' pax juntzanhxo ofrenda to tz'el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani.
Ay pax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik skajnub' Jehová ik'b'ilkot t'a Jerusalén yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor, aykanoch t'a yol stemplo sdiosal winh.
Haxo winhaj Ciro chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Mitrídates, winh sik'um tumin to syik'elta juntzanh tastak chi' winh, sb'isan winh, syak'an winh t'a winhaj Sesbasar, winh ol och yajalil t'a Judá.
Haton sb'isul tastak tik: 30 k'e'en niwak uk'ab' nab'a oro, mil k'e'en niwak uk'ab' nab'a plata, 29 k'e'en kuchilub',
30 k'e'en yunetak uk'ab' nab'a oro, 410 k'e'en yunetak uk'ab' nab'a plata, haxo juntzanhxo tastak, mil sb'isul.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh tas nab'a oro yet' nab'a plata t'a smasanil, 5 mil 400. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' meltzaj winhaj Sesbasar yet' juntzanhxo heb' ayik ix paxta heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ix jaxkan heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Haton slistail heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, heb' ix jax t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá. Junjun heb' ix k'ochxikan t'a schonhab'. Haxo heb' winh kuchb'um t'a heb', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Zorobabel, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Nehemías, winhaj Seraías, winhaj Reelaías, winhaj Mardoqueo, winhaj Bilsán, winhaj Mizpar, winhaj Bigvai, winhaj Rehum yet' winhaj Baana.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 2 mil 172 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 372 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ara, 775 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Joab, 2 mil 812 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 945 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Zacai, 760 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bani, 642 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 623 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, mil 222 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, 666 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bigvai, 2 mil 56 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 454 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, hanhejtona' winh skuchanpax Ezequías, 98 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Bezai, 323 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Jora, 112 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasum, 223 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Gibar, 95 heb'.

Ay heb' yinhtilalkan heb' anima ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' ix meltzajpaxi, haton heb' tik: Eb' aj Belén, 123 heb'. Eb' aj Netofa, 56 heb'. Eb' aj Anatot, 128 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Azmavet, 42 heb'. Eb' aj Quiriat-jearim, heb' aj Cafira yet' heb' aj Beerot, 743 heb'. Eb' aj Ramá yet' heb' aj Geba, 621 heb'. Eb' aj Micmas, 122 heb'. Eb' aj Betel yet' heb' aj Hai, 223 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Nebo, 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Magbis, 156 heb'. Eb' ek'nak t'a junxo skuchan Elam, mil 254 heb'. Eb' aj Harim, 320 heb'. Eb' aj Lod, heb' aj Hadid yet' heb' aj Ono, 725 heb'. Eb' aj Jericó, 345 heb'. Eb' aj Senaa, 3 mil 630 heb'.

Haxo heb' sacerdote, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedaías, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa, 973 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Imer, mil 52 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Pasur, mil 247 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim mil 17 heb'.

Eb' levita yinhtilal winhaj Jesúa yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cadmiel, a heb' chi' yinhtilal pax heb' winhaj Hodabías, 74 heb'. Eb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf sb'itani, 128 heb' t'a smasanil. Eb' tanhwum puerta, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Salum, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ater, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Talmón, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acub, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hatita yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sobai, 139 heb' t'a smasanil.

Haxo heb' smunlaj t'a templo, haton heb' yinhtilalkan heb' winh ol b'inaj tik: Winhaj Ziha, winhaj Hasufa, winhaj Tabaot, winhaj Queros, winhaj Siaha, winhaj Padón, winhaj Lebana, winhaj Hagaba, winhaj Acub, winhaj Hagab, winhaj Salmai, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Gidel, winhaj Gahar, winhaj Reaía, winhaj Rezín, winhaj Necoda, winhaj Gazam, winhaj Uza, winhaj Paseah, winhaj Besai, winhaj Asena, winhaj Meunim, winhaj Nefusim, winhaj Bacbuc, winhaj Hacufa, winhaj Harhur, winhaj Bazlut, winhaj Mehída, winhaj Harsa, winhaj Barcos, winhaj Sísara, winhaj Tema, winhaj Nezía yet' pax winhaj Hatifa.

Ay pax heb' yinhtilalkan heb' ak'jinak serwil winhaj Salomón, haton heb' yinhtilal heb' winh ol b'inaj tik: Winhaj Sotai, winhaj Soferet, winhaj Peruda, winhaj Jaala, winhaj Darcón, winhaj Gidel, winhaj Sefatías, winhaj Hatil, winhaj Poqueret-hazebaim yet' pax winhaj Ami.
Masanil heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a skajnub' Dios yet' pax yinhtilal heb' ak'jinak serwil winhaj Salomón, 392 heb' t'a smasanil.

Ha winhaj Delaías yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Tobías yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Necoda, 652 heb'. Ha heb' tik ix kot heb' t'a Tel-mela, t'a Tel-harsa, t'a Querub, t'a Addán yet' t'a Imer. Ha heb' tik, maxtzak yal-laj sch'oxanel sb'a heb' tato yinhtilal Israel heb'.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Habaía, heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cos yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Barzilai, ix yal heb' to sacerdote heb', palta malaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkani tato yinhtilal sacerdote heb'. Yuj chi' maj chajioch heb' t'a opisio t'a sacerdoteal. Ha winhaj Barzilai chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' jun ix yisil jun winh aj Galaad skuchan Barzilai, yuj chi' a sb'i winh snhi' winh chi' ix ochkan t'ay.
Ix yalan winh yajal yaj t'a heb' to max yal swa'an wa'el heb' yik Dios yaji, masanto yik ol yil junok winh sacerdote t'a Urim yet' Tumim yik scheklaji tato yel yinhtilal sacerdote heb'.

Junnhej ix aj heb' anima chi' smasanil, 42 mil 360 heb'. Ch'ok pax yaj heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab', 7 mil 337 heb' t'a smasanil, ch'ok pax yaj 200 heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix sb'itani. Ay pax 736 nok' chej, 245 nok' mula, 435 nok' camello yet' 6 mil 720 nok' b'uru.
Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a Jerusalén, ay juntzanh heb' yajal t'a skal heb', ix yak' silab' heb' yuj sb'ochajxi skajnub' Jehová b'aj ayek' t'a peka'.
Icha syal jantak ix techaj yuj heb', a ix yak' heb' yik sb'ochajxi templo chi'. Mil 30 libra k'e'en oro ix yak' heb' yet' 5 mil 740 libra k'e'en plata yet' 100 pichul yik heb' sacerdote.

Ha heb' sacerdote, heb' levita sb'itani, heb' tanhwum puerta yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo yet' juntzanhxo heb' chonhab', ix kajnajkan heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Haxo masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' chi', ix b'at kajnajxikan junjun heb' b'aj ek'nak heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Toxo ix laj ajxi kajan heb' israel t'a schonhab'kani, haxo yik ix jawi jun yukil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' masanil t'a Jerusalén.

Haxo winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote yet' pax winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, ix syamoch heb' winh sb'oanxik'e altar yik Jehová Dios, yik syak' silab' heb' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha yajkan t'a ley yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios.

Yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a slak'anil, yuj chi' te wach' ix yutej heb' sb'oank'e jun altar chi'. Junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil snhus silab' heb' t'a yib'anh altar chi', yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová heb'.
Ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yik chinama, ix yak'an silab' heb' tz'ak'ji t'a junjun k'u, icha yalankan ley.
Ix yak'an silab' heb' to stz'a t'a junjun k'u, silab' ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj, silab' yuj k'inh tz'och t'a junjun ab'il yet' silab' mach tz'el t'a sk'o'ol yak'an t'a Jehová.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik yukil uj, ix scha'anel yich heb' yak'an silab' stz'ai, wach'chom manto em yich skajnub' Jehová.

Ix yak'an tumin heb' t'a heb' albañil yet' t'a heb' nhikum te'. Ix yak'anpax ixim trigo heb', wino yet' aceite t'a heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a heb' aj Tiro yik syak'ankot te' k'ute' heb' t'a Líbano. Skot te' t'a yib'anh ha' mar masanto sjawi te' t'a Jope, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Ciro sreyal Persia.

Ix el yich sb'ochajxi skajnub' Dios yuj winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac yet' heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' masanil heb' ix kot t'a Babilonia. T'a schab'il ujal yik schab'il ab'il sjawi heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix syamanoch heb' sb'oanxi skajnub' Jehová, ix yak'anoch jun munlajel chi' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' levita ek'xo 20 ab'il sk'inal.

Ha jun winh levita skuchan Jesúa, heb' yuninal winh yet' heb' yuk'tak winh, winhaj Cadmiel yet' heb' yuninal yet' pax heb' yinhtilal heb' aj Judá, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb'. Kuchb'um ix aj heb' t'a munlajel chi'. Ix kolwajpax heb' levita yinhtilal winhaj Henadad yet' heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' heb'.

Ayik ix yak'anem yich skajnub' Jehová chi' heb' albañil, ix k'e linhan heb' winh sacerdote, ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sacerdoteal, yet'nak strompeta heb' winh. Haxo heb' levita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf yet'nak splatillo heb', sb'itan heb' t'a Jehová, icha yalnakkan winhaj David sreyal Israel t'a peka'.

Sb'itan jun makan heb', stak'wipax nanhalxo heb', syalan heb' icha tik: Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto te wach', yujto te xajan onh a onh israel onh tik yuj t'a junelnhej, xchi masanil anima. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, sb'itanpax heb' t'a Jehová Dios yujto toxo ix emxi yich skajnub'.

Tzijtum heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' heb' yajalil chonhab' te ichamtak winakxo, yilnak jun b'ab'el templo heb'. Te cha'anh ix el yaw heb' yok'i ayik ix yilan heb' yem yich junxo ak' templo chi'. Tzijtum pax mach tz'el yaw yuj tzalajk'olal.
Maxtzak nachajel yuj heb' tz'ab'ani tas wan yuji chi'. Ay mach tz'ok'i, ay mach tz'awaj yuj tzalajk'olal, najat tz'ab'chaj yel yaw heb' yujto te cha'anh tz'awaj heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' ajk'ol yaj t'a heb' yik Judá yet' t'a heb' yik Benjamín to a heb' ix meltzajkot t'a Babilonia wan sb'oanxik'e stemplo Jehová sDiosal heb',

ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Zorobabel yet' t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan heb'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Komonok scha he k'o'ol sko b'o jun munlajel tik heyet'ok, yujto tzonh ochpax ejmelal t'a he Diosal chi' icha ex tik. Atax yik onh ik'chajkot t'a tik yuj winhaj Esar-hadón sreyal Asiria, atax ta' onh och ijan kak'an ko silab' t'a he Diosal chi', xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Zorobabel yet' winhaj Jesúa yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Manh ol yal-laj junnhej ol ko b'oxik'e skajnub' Jehová ko Diosal tik heyet'ok. Ha onnhej israel onh tik ol ko b'o'o, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winhaj Ciro sreyal Persia t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix och wal ijan heb' ajk'ol chi' yak'an chab'axk'e sk'ol heb', yik xiwcha'anh masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá chi' yik wach' maxtzak sb'oxik'e jun templo chi' heb'.

Ix yak'an k'e'en tumin heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a juntzanh heb' yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winh sreyal Persia t'a skal heb', yik smontaj heb', yik wach' skachoch wa'an heb' israel chi' heb' t'a jun munlajel chi'. Ichanhej chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' ayik ayoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, masanto ayik ix och winhaj Darío reyal.
Ayik ix scha'anpaxel yich winhaj Asuero yak'an reyal, ix ak'wipax queja heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatik heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén.

Hanhejtona' ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ix slajtiej sb'a winhaj Bislam, winhaj Mitrídates, winhaj Tabeel yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' winh. Ix stz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh lolonel heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ha t'a ti' arameo ix tz'ib'chaj ch'anh u'um chi'.
Haxo winhaj Rehum winh sat yajal heb' soldado yet' winhaj Simsai winh tz'ib'um, ix stz'ib'ejpaxb'at junxo carta heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Artajerjes chi'.

Haton jun carta tik ix yak'b'at heb' winh chawanh chi' yet' heb' winh yajal yaj yet' heb' winh yet' heb' winh ay yopisio kotnak t'a Persia yet' heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Erec, t'a Babilonia, t'a Susa, t'a yol smakb'en Elam

yet' t'a juntzanhxo nación. Haton heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a schonhab' yuj winhaj Asnapar, winh yak'nak yajalil t'a Asiria to niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ul ak'jikan heb' yuj winh t'a chonhab' Samaria yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates.
Ix yalanb'at heb' winh icha tik: Mamin rey Artajerjes, a onh a chekab' onh kajan onh t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, sko tz'ib'ej jun u'um tik t'ayach:

Mamin rey, skalb'at t'ayach to a heb' judío ak'b'il meltzaj t'a yol a makb'en, ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén tik. Wan sb'oanxik'e jun chonhab' heb', jun pit yutejnak sb'a. Toxo ix syamoch heb' sb'oanxik'e smuroal, wanxo sb'oel yuj heb'.

Mamin rey, skak'anpax ojtakejeli, tato ol b'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' tik yet' smuroal, a juntzanh anima tik manhxo ol yak' k'e'en tumin heb' syak'taxon t'ayach yet' k'e'en tumin sk'anel heb' t'a heb' tzek' t'a a makb'en tik. Yuj chi' manhxo ol k'och k'e'en tumin chi' t'ayach.
Yujto a onh tik mamin rey, ayonh och ach kak'an serwil, malaj ko gana to icha chi' ol ach utajok, yuj chi' skalb'at juntzanh tik t'ayach.

Saychajokab' iljok b'aj molb'ab'il tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' a mam icham. Hata' ol il yuj tas skalb'at tik, ol ojtakaneli to a jun chonhab' tik te chuk, ay smay heb' t'a juntzanhxo heb' rey yet' t'a juntzanhxo nación. Yuj schukal heb', ix satjiel schonhab' heb' tik.
Yuj chi' mamin rey, skalb'at t'ayach, tato sb'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' tik yet' smuroal, manhxa halan ik t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates tik, xchib'at heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot spak slolonel heb' winh chi' winhaj rey Artajerjes chi' icha tik: Ach sat yajal Rehum yet' ach Simsai tz'ib'um yet' heb' winh ayoch heyet'ok t'a Samaria yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi', swak' stzatzil he k'o'ol.
Ha tas ix eyalkot t'ayin, wach' ix aj yawtaj wab'i.
Ix in chek saychaj ilchajok, icha ix eyala'. Ix ilchaji to a heb' anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', te pit ix yutejnhej sb'a heb' t'a heb' rey ek'nakxo.

Ha t'a yik chi' ay heb' sreyal Jerusalén te tek'an, a heb' ix ak'an mandar t'a lum lum t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi'. Ix yak' k'e'en tumin heb' anima t'a heb' yuj stupan heb' b'aj kajan chi'.
Yuj chi' alek t'a juntzanh winak chi' to swanaj heb' smunlaji, mokab' b'ochajxik'e jun chonhab' chi', masanto a in ol wala'.
Manh tonhejok tzeyiloch jun chi' yik wach' max te ixtaxel yol in makb'en chi', xchikot winh rey chi'.

Haxo yik ix awtaj tas ix yalkot winhaj Artajerjes chi' t'a yichanh winhaj Rehum, winhaj Simsai yet' t'a yichanh heb' winh ajun yet' heb' winh, elanhchamel ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix ul yak'an pural heb' judío heb' winh yoch wa'an smunlaji.
Yuj schukal heb' ajk'ol chi', ix och wa'an sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto t'a schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Darío reyal t'a Persia.
Ha heb' winh schekab' Jehová Dios, haton winhaj Hageo yet' winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Iddo, ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén, tas syal Jehová Dios t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', ix och winhaj Zorobabel yuninal winhaj Salatiel yet' winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac t'a munlajel junelxo yik sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios chi'. Ix och heb' winh schekab' Dios chi' yiptzitan heb'.

Haxo pax winhaj Tatnai yajal t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, winhaj Setar-boznai yet' heb' winh yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' winh, ix ulek' heb' winh yal icha tik: ¿Mach ix halan t'ayex yuj chi' tze b'oxik'e jun niwan pat tik, tzeyak'anoch ste'al?
¿Tastak sb'i heb' sb'o'an jun niwan pat tik? xchi heb' winh.

Palta ha Dios ix och wal yet' heb' israel skuchb'an jun munlajel chi', yuj chi' maj kachjioch wa'an heb' munlajwum yuj winh yajal chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Anhejto ix stz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh lolonel heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Darío, ix stanhwan heb' winh tas ol aj spakan winh.
Haton scopiail tas ix stz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Tatnai, winhaj Setar-boznai yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yetyajalil heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Darío chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Mamin rey, junk'olalokab' aji.

Ha wal jun tik skak' ojtakejeli: Ix onh xit'ek' t'a Judá, ix kilani to wan sb'ochajxi skajnub' jun Dios niwan yelk'ochi. Wan yak'anoch k'e'en niwak k'e'en heb' tzeyb'il t'ay yet' te te' tzek' pax t'a yib'anh k'e'en. Te yelk'olal smunlaj heb', wanxo sb'o yuj heb'.
Ix ko k'anb'ej t'a heb' skuchb'an munlajel chi' mach ix halani sb'o'an jun munlajel chi' heb' yet' yak'anoch te te' chi' heb' t'ay.
Ix ko k'anb'ejpax kab'i tastak sb'i heb' skuchb'an heb' chi', yik sko tz'ib'anb'at t'ayach kalani.
Ix yalan heb' t'ayonh tob' tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sDiosal satcha'anh yet' sat lum tik, yuj chi' wan sb'oanxik'e jun spat chi' heb', jun sb'onak jun niwan rey t'a Israel t'a peka'.

Ix yalan heb' to a heb' smam yicham heb' tzuntzannakkot yowal sk'ol sDiosal satcha'anh chi', yuj chi' a ak'annakoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, yinhtilal heb' caldeo. Ha winh pojannak em jun pat chi', yik'annakb'at heb' anima winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Axob' t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Babilonia chi', ix ab' schekan winh b'ochajxik'e jun pat chi'.

Hanhejtona' yik'nak ab' b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a oro, nab'a plata ay t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Yak'annak och winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal t'a Babilonia chi'. Axob' winhaj rey Ciro ix ak'an juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' t'a winhaj Sesbasar, winh ix yak'och winh yajalil t'a Jerusalén.
Ix ab' yalan winh to syik'b'at juntzanh yamk'ab' chi' winh t'a Jerusalén chi' masanto yik sb'ochajxik'e skajnub' Dios chi' b'aj aytaxoni.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Sesbasar t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anem yich stemplo Dios chi' winh. Atax ta' ix chael yich sb'ochajxi, palta manto b'oel-laj tiknaik.

Ha tiknaik mamin rey, tato wach' skan jun tik t'ayach, saychajokab' ilchaj b'ajtak tz'ib'ab'il tastak yik heb' rey t'a spalacio heb' t'a Babilonia chi', tato yel to a winhaj rey Ciro chi' ix chekan b'ochajxi stemplo Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', mato ma'ay. Slajwi chi' tzalan kab'i tas tz'aj a na'an t'a yib'anh jun tik, xchib'at heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Darío chi' to saychaj tastak tz'ib'ab'il b'aj sik'b'ilkan tastak t'a Babilonia.
Palta ha t'a yol palacio t'a chonhab' Ecbatana, t'a yol yik Media, hata' ix ilchaj jun tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi', b'aj syal icha tik:

Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal, ix yalan winh icha tik: B'ochajokab'xi skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén. Wach' tz'aj yem yich sb'ochajxik'ei yik ha t'a yo'ol tz'ak'chaj silab'. 27 metro tz'ajk'e scha'anhil, 27 metro tz'ajpax yol schikin.

Ox tzol k'e'en niwak k'e'en tzeyb'il tz'och t'ay, jun tzol pax te te' ak'to tzek' t'a yib'anh k'e'en. Haxo k'e'en tumin ol k'anchajok, a b'aj smolchaj masanil k'e'en tumin t'a yol in makb'en, hata' tz'elta k'e'en.

Haxo juntzanh yamk'ab' nab'a oro yet' plata ik'b'ilkot t'a yol templo t'a Jerusalén yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia tik, ik'chajokab' meltzaj t'a Jerusalén chi', tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a yol templo chi', t'a b'ajtaxon ayek'i, xchi winh, xchi jun cheknab'il chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot winhaj rey Darío chi' icha tik: Ach Tatnai yajal t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates yet' ach Setar-boznai yet' ex yetyajalil heb' winh: B'esekel he b'a t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Manh eyamoch wa'an winh yajalil heb' israel yet' heb' skuchb'an munlajel yik sb'ochajxi skajnub' Dios b'ajtaxon ay yet'tal.

Ha in swala' to tzex kolwaj yet' heb' skuchb'an heb' wan sb'oanxi skajnub' Dios chi'. Ha t'a k'e'en tumin syak' heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, hata' tz'elta k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a munlajel chi'. Mokab' ek' tiempo yak'chaj k'e'en, yik wach' max och wa'an munlajel chi'.

Masanil tas tz'och yopisio t'a junjun k'u, mokab' yak' palta t'a heb' sacerdote ayek' t'a Jerusalén, icha tz'aj sk'anan heb': Nok' kelemtak wakax, nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel, yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a sDiosal satcha'anh. Mokab' yak'pax palta ixim trigo, atz'am atz'am, wino yet' aceite,
yik tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Dios, yik sk'anji in k 'inal yet' wal wuninal.

Ha in swalpaxi, tato ay mach max k'anab'ajan tas swal tik, tz'ik'chajelta junok spatzab'il spat, sjoychajem t'a yol lu'um, haxo ta' tz'ak'jik'e lokan. Haxo spat chi' sjuchajemi, tz'ochkan yet'talok b'aj b'at tzajok anima.

Ha Dios ix sik'anel Jerusalén chi' yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay ta'. Yuj chi' aokab' satanel heb' rey yet' smakb'en heb' stenanek' jun lolonel swal tik, ma heb' tz'ixtanb'at skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ha in Darío in swak' jun cheknab'il tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajaj masanil t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Tatnai yet' winhaj Setar-boznai yet' heb' winh yetyajalil heb' winh, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' winh icha ix aj yalankot winhaj rey Darío chi'.

Yuj chi', a heb' israel skuchb'an jun munlajel chi', ix yal smunlaj heb' yik sb'oanxik'e templo chi' heb' icha ix aj yalan heb' winh schekab' Dios, haton winhaj Hageo yet' winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Iddo. Ix b'oel templo chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová sDiosal Israel, icha pax ix aj yalan heb' winh sreyal Persia, haton winhaj Ciro, winhaj Darío yet' winhaj Artajerjes.
Ayik oxe' k'uhalxo yoch uj Adar yik swakil ab'il yoch winhaj Darío reyal t'a Persia, hata' ix b'oel templo chi'.
Haxo heb' israel, heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' masanil heb' ix xit'ek' t'a Babilonia, ix yak'och k'inh heb' yik tzalajk'olal yuj skajnub' Dios chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix yak' juntzanh silab' tik heb': 100 nok' kelemtak wakax, 200 nok' ch'ak kalnel, 400 nok' yunetak kalnel yet' lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa. Junjun nok' chiwa chi' yik junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, yik stupchaj smul heb' masanil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jioch heb' sacerdote t'a stzolal t'a yopisio. Ix ak'jipaxoch junjun makan heb' levita t'a yopisio t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Jerusalén chi', icha yajkan t'a ley Moisés.
Hanhejtona' pax heb' xit'nakek' t'a Babilonia, ix yak'och k'inh heb' yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto t'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj.

Haxo heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita, ix sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley. Ayik wach'xo yaj heb', ix yak'an nok' silab' yik k'inh chi' heb' yuj masanil heb' ix xit'ek' t'a Babilonia chi', haton heb' yetsacerdoteal heb' yet' heb' yetlevitail heb'.

Masanil heb' israel ix xit'ek' t'a Babilonia chi', ix chi nok' silab' yik k'inh chi' heb', yet' heb' ix yik'el sb'a t'a schukal juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a slak'anil. Junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' israel yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel chi'.

Uke' k'uhal ix och k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich yuj heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto a Jehová ix ak'anoch tzalajk'olal chi' t'a spensar heb'. A' ix k'exanpax spensar winh sreyal Persia, yuj chi' ix kolwaj winh yik sb'ochajxi skajnub'.

Ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ay jun winh skuchan Esdras. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winh, haton tik: Winhaj Seraías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Salum, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Finees, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Aarón winh b'ab'el sacerdote.

Ha winhaj Esdras chi', k'ayb'um winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová sDiosal Israel, haton k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Masanil tas ix sk'an winh, ix yak' winhaj rey Artajerjes chi' t'a winh, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Esdras chi' t'a Jerusalén tik yet' jun nhilanh heb' yetisraelal, haton heb' sacerdote, heb' levita sb'itani yet' heb' stanhwan puerta yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.

Ayoch Dios yet' winhaj Esdras chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh t'a Babilonia t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, t'a yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal. Ix jawi winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok t'a Jerusalén tik t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yo'il uj, hanheja' t'a yukil ab'il chi'.
Te ayoch t'a spensar winhaj Esdras chi' sk'ayb'an wal sk'ayb'ub'al Dios, sb'eyb'alan winh yet' sk'ayb'anpax heb' yetisraelal winh t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'.
Haton scopiail scheknab'il winhaj rey Artajerjes tik ix yak' t'a winhaj sacerdote Esdras, k'ayb'um t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová yet' scheknab'il ak'b'il t'a heb' yetisraelal:
Ha in Artajerjes in, yajal waj t'a juntzanhxo heb' rey, swak' stzatzil a k'o'ol ach Esdras, sacerdote ach, k'ayb'um ach pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha'anh.
Toxo ix walel t'a masanil heb' etisraelal, heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita ayek' t'a yol in makb'en tik, tato syal sk'ol heb' sb'at t'a Jerusalén chi' het'ok, b'atokab' heb'.
Ha in tik yet' ukwanh heb' tz'ak'an in razón, tzach kak'b'at ila' tas wal yaj Judá yet' Jerusalén chi', wan am sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il he Diosal ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' chi' heb'.
Ha k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro tz'el t'a ko k'o'ol kak'anb'at t'ayach, ik'b'at k'e'en t'a he Diosal a ex israel ex chi', haton jun ay skajnub' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Tzik'anpaxb'at masanil k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro ix a cha t'a heb' anima t'a yol yik Babilonia yet' jantak tas tz'el t'a sk'ol heb' etisraelal yet' heb' sacerdote yak'an yuj skajnub' he Diosal chi'.

Ha yet' k'e'en tumin chi' tza man nok' wakax, nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhxo tastak tz'ak'ji yet' nok', haton ixim trigo, ixim cebada, wino yik tz'ak'ji juntzanh chi' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi'.
Haxo jantakto k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata skani, ol xo heyila' tas b'aj wach' syal yoch k'e'en, icha syal tas snib'ej he Diosal chi'.
Haxo pax masanil yamk'ab' ix ak'ji t'ayach yik sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', a ach wal lak'an tzak' t'a a Diosal t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Yalnhej junokxo tas ay tz'och eyu'uj t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', syal he k'ananelta stojol t'a winh smolan k'e'en tumin t'a yol in makb'en.

Ha in rey Artajerjes in tik swal t'a masanil heb' molum tumin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates: Masanil tas sk'an winhaj Esdras winh sacerdote, winh k'ayb'um pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha'anh, elanhchamel tzeyak' t'a winh.
Syal eyak'an 75 quintalok k'e'en plata, 300 quintalok ixim trigo, 550 galónok wino, 550 galónok aceite yet' jantak atz'am atz'am sk'an winh.
Masanil tas sk'an sDiosal satcha'anh yuj skajnub', elanhchamelokab' tz'ak'chaji, yik wach' max kot yowal sk'ol t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' wal wuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil in makb'en.

Tzeyojtakaneli to max yal-laj he k'anan k'e'en tumin t'a heb' sacerdote, t'a heb' levita sb'itani yet' t'a heb' tanhwum puerta yet' t'a heb' smunlaj t'a stemplo Dios chi', haton k'e'en syak' heb' t'ayin, ma juntzanhxo k'e'en mol tumin.

Ha hachxo pax tik ach Esdras, hato ha' a jelanil ak'b'il yuj a Diosal, ak'och heb' juez yet' heb' yajal. Ha heb' ol b'oan tas snib'ej heb' anima kajan t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi'. Ha heb' tz'och yopisio chi', yowalil yojtak sk'ayb'ub'al a Diosal chi' heb', haxo heb' manh ojtannakok jun, tza k'ayb'ej heb'.

Haxo mach max k'anab'ajan scheknab'il a Diosal chi' yet' in cheknab'il a in rey in tik, elanhchamel tz'ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh, mato tz'ik'chajel t'a yol chonhab' chi', ma tz'ik'chajek' tastak ay t'ay, ma tz'ochkan t'a preso, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winhaj Esdras icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham, yujto ha' ix ak'an sna' winh rey chi' to niwan yelk'och skajnub' t'a Jerusalén.

Yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, wach' in t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yet' t'a heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' t'a sat masanil heb' niwak yajal ayoch yet' winh. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix in tek'b'ej in b'a in molb'an masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' wetisraelal, yik smeltzaj heb' wet'ok, xchi winhaj Esdras chi'.
Ha heb' winh yajal ix kot wet' t'a Babilonia ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, haton sb'i heb' winh tik icha tas yaj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh t'a junjun yinhtilal:

Haton winhaj Gersón, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Finees. Winhaj Daniel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Itamar. Winhaj Hatús, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Secanías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj David. Winhaj Zacarías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 150 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Elioenai yuninal winhaj Zeraías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, 200 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Secanías yuninal winhaj Jahaziel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 300 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Ebed yuninal winhaj Jonatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 50 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Jesaías yuninal winhaj Atalías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elam, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 80 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Jehiel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Joab, 218 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Josifías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bani, 160 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Bebai, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 28 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Hacatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, 110 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Ha winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Semaías t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, tzak'anxo ix meltzaj heb' winh yet' 60 heb' winh winak. Winhaj Utai yet' winhaj Zabud, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bigvai, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh.

Ha in Esdras in tik, ix in molb'ej heb' wetchonhab' tik t'a sti' jun ha ha' skuchan Ahava, oxe' k'uhal onh ek' ta'. Ix in sayanek' heb' levita t'a skal heb' anima chi' yet' t'a skal heb' sacerdote, malaj junok heb' ix ilchaj wu'uj.

Ix in chekanb'at winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Ariel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Natán, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Mesulam. Ha heb' winh tik niwak yelk'och heb' winh yet' pax heb' winh k'ayb'um, haton winhaj Joiarib yet' winhaj Elnatán.

Ix in chekb'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Iddo, yajal t'a jun lugar skuch Casifia yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh ta', haton heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a stemplo Dios to schekkot heb' anima heb' yik skolwaj heb' ket'ok t'a skajnub' ko Diosal.

Yuj skolwal Dios ix ik'chajkot winhaj Serebías yuj heb' winh, yujto a winh chi' te jelan winh, yinhtilal winh jun winh levita skuchan Mahli. Ha winhaj Serebías chi', ix kot winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yuk'tak, 18 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix yik'anpaxkot winhaj Hasabías heb' winh yet' winhaj Jesaías yet' pax yuninal heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok heb' winh, 20 heb' t'a smasanil, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Merari.
Ix jawipax 220 heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a templo, heb' ak'b'ilkanoch yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' skuchb'an heb' levita t'a yopisio. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walani to tzonh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a sti' ha' niwan Ahava chi', yik wach' sko cha ko mulej ko chukal t'a yichanh ko Diosal, sko k'ananpax t'ay to tzonh yik'b'at t'a wach'il yet' heb' kuninal yet' masanil tas ay t'ayonh.

Ix in k'ixwi in k'anan heb' soldado t'a winh rey, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yok yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, yik tzonh stanhwan heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a yoltak b'e, yujto toxo ix kal t'a winh rey chi' to a ko Diosal stanhwan masanil mach tz'ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol, palta skot yowal, syak'ankot ya'elal t'a yib'anh mach max k'anab'ajani.
Yuj wal chi', ix onh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix ko k'anan t'a Dios to tzonh stanhwej. Ix yab' wal tas ix kal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in sik'anel lajchawanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Serabías, winhaj Hasabías yet' lajunhwanhxo heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wechtan juntzanh silab' ix ak'chaj yuj sb'ochajxi stemplo ko Diosal, ix in pukanb'at t'a lajchawanh heb' winh sacerdote ix in sik'el chi'. Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ay k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix yak' winh rey yet' heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' pax tastak ix yak' heb' ketisraelal ayek' ta'. Ha t'a smasanil, ay 500 quintal k'e'en plata. Yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a plata, 75 quintal yalil yet' 75 quintal k'e'en oro yet' pax 20 uk'ab' oro, 17 libra yalil yet' chab'xo yamk'ab' bronce te wach' yaj sb'o'i, lajan stojol icha yamk'ab' oro.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex tik sik'b'il exxo el yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' masanil yamk'ab' ix siaj t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham.

Tze tanhwej wal k'e'en masanto ol echtaj k'e'en t'a yoltak scuartoal templo t'a Jerusalén t'a yichanh heb' yajalil heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' ketisraelal, xin chi t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita chi', ix scha'an masanil k'e'en silab' heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix echtaj chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yik syik'anb'at heb' winh t'a skajnub' ko Diosal t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik slajchawil k'uhal t'a b'ab'el uj, ix onh el t'a sti' ha' Ahava chi', ix onh kot t'a Jerusalén tik. Ha ko Diosal ix onh kolan t'a heb' ajk'o'ol yet' t'a heb' elk'um t'a yoltak b'e.
Ayik ix onh jawi t'a Jerusalén tik, oxe' k'uhal ix kik' kip.

Haxo t'a schanhil k'uhal jun, ix onh b'at t'a skajnub' ko Diosal yik tz'echtaj k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro yet' jantak yamk'ab' yik skajnub' ko Diosal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj t'a winh sacerdote skuchan Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías. Aypaxek' winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Finees yet' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Noadías yuninal winhaj Binúi.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix echtaj k'e'en, ix b'ischajpax k'e'en smasanil, tz'akan yaj k'e'en. Icha chi' ix aj stz'ib'chajkan k'e'en smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia, ix yak'an nok' silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Ix ak'chaj lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax ku'uj ko masanil, 96 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 77 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix ak'chaj pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup mul. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'il scheknab'il winh rey t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, yuj chi' a heb' ix kolwaj ket'ok t'a munlajel t'a stemplo ko Diosal.

Ayik ix lajwi juntzanh chi', ix jawi jaywanh heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' ketchonhab' t'ayin, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Tzijtum heb' ketisraelal yet' heb' sacerdote yet' pax heb' levita max yik'el-laj sb'a t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a ko chonhab' tik, palta a schuk b'eyb'al heb' cananeo, heb' heteo, heb' ferezeo, heb' jebuseo, heb' amonita, heb' moabita, heb' egipcio yet' heb' amorreo, a chi' sb'eyb'alej heb'.

Ha heb' chi' yet' heb' yuninal heb', wan yik'lan sb'a heb' yet' heb' ix yisil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Yuj chi' a schonhab' Dios toxo ix somchaj yet' juntzanh anima chi'. Ha wal heb' b'ab'el ix yak'och smul tik, haton heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal, xchi heb' t'ayin.
Ayik ix wab'an jun chi', ix in nhik'chitanb'at in pichul. Ix in tzukanel xil in jolom yet' xil in ti' yuj kusk'olal. Ix in em k'ojan, manhxo animaok in aj ix wab'i.

Masanil heb' xiw yuj yowal sk'ol ko Diosal yuj smul heb' ketisraelal, heb' janakxi t'a Babilonia, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' wet'ok. k'ojan innhej emi, manhxo in animaok swab'i, masanto t'a yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a yemk'uhalil.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix in k'e wa'an b'aj k'ojaninem chi', nhik'chimtak in pichul chi'. Ix in em kuman in lesalwi. Ix wik'ank'e in k'ab' t'a yichanh Jehová in Diosal.

Ix walan icha tik: Ach in Diosal, tzin te k'ixwi t'ayach. Tzin somchaj cha'anh. Maxtzak nachaj wu'uj tas swutej walan in b'a t'ayach, yujto ix te ek' yib'anh ko chukal. Ha ko mul chi' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh.

Atax t'a stiempoal heb' ko mam kicham, masanto tiknaik, te ayonnhej och ko k'ulan chukal. Yuj ko chukal ix onh ak'jioch yet' heb' ko reyal yet' heb' sacerdote t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sreyal juntzanhxo nación. Ix onh miljichamok. Ix onh ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ix elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ayonh, te k'ixwelal ix onh ajkani, icha wal kaj tiknaik.

Palta tiknaik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, yuj a wach'k'olal, ix onh a kol jaywanh onh ayonhek' tik. Yuj chi' syal ko kajnajxi t'a sat lum lum to ik yaj tik. Ha ach ix ak'xi ko tzalajk'olal, ix ak'anpax ko junk'olal b'aj chekab' kaji.

Wach'chom chekab' kaji, palta maj onh aktejkanlaj. Ix a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayonh t'a yichanh heb' sreyal Persia. Ix ak' ko k 'inal yik ix ko b'oanxik'e a kajnub' tik, yujto jub'ilemi. Ha ach tzonh a tanhwej t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik.
Haxo tiknaik, ach ko Diosal, ¿tas wal wach' kalan t'ayach, yujto toxo ix och ko mul? Maj ko k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il,

haton a cheknak yal heb' a chekab', heb' tzach ak'an serwil. Ha ach tik alnak t'ayonh to junelnhej te chuk sb'eyb'al juntzanh anima kajan t'a lum lum ol ak' kikej, manh jantakok chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a yol smakb'en.

Alannakpaxi to max yal-laj kak'an yik'laj sb'a heb' ix kisil yet' heb' yuninal heb'. Max yalpax yik'lan sb'a heb' kuninal yet' heb' ix yisil heb', max yalpax ko kolwaj t'a heb'. Alannakkani tato max ko k'ulej juntzanh chi', wach' ol aj yelk'och ko chonhab' tik, ol kak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol yuj a wach'k'olal, yik wach' skak'kan lum lum tik smakb'enok heb' kinhtilal t'a junelnhej.

Ha wal yuj ko chukal ix och t'ayach, yuj chi' ix jawi juntzanh ya'elal tik t'a kib'anh, palta a ach tik, ach ko Diosal, maj ak'och ko ya'elal icha tas smoj ko cha'ani, kennhej ya'elal chi' ix jawi t'a kib'anh. Palta ix el wal t'a a k'o'ol to pitzan jaywanhonhxo tik.
Tato te chuk skutejxi ko b'a t'ayach, tato skik'laj ko b'a yet' juntzanh ch'ok animail te chuk sb'eyb'al chi', ol am te kot owal t'ayonh, ol onh a sataneli, masanto manhxa junok onh ol onh kanok.

Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, te tojolnhej tzutej a b'a t'ayonh, yuj chi' ix to onh kan jaywanhonhxo tik. Palta ina jantak ko mul ix ochxi t'ayach, yuj chi' maxtzak ko tek'b'ej ko b'a koch t'a ichanh, xin chi t'a Jehová.

Yakb'an wan slesalwi winhaj Esdras chi', wan yok' winh syalank'eta smul heb' yetisraelal winh, kumanem winh t'a yichanh skajnub' Dios. Yakb'an chi', ix och hoyan jun nhilanh heb' yetisraelal winh t'a spatik, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin. Ix te ok' wal heb' yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Secanías yuninal winhaj Jehiel t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elam, ix halan t'a winhaj Esdras chi' icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko k'anab'ajej ko Diosal, yujto ix kik'laj ko b'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il, palta jun, ayto wal sb'onab'il jun tik t'ayonh.
Ha tiknaik, skak' ko ti', ol ko chek pax heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi' yet' yune'. Ol ko k'anab'ajan tas tzal chi' yet' tas syal heb' sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Dios het'ok, icha yalan cheknab'il chi'.
Yuj chi' k'e'anh wa'an, yujto a ach tik syal a b'oan yaj jun tik. Ol onh kolwaj het'ok. Tek'b'ej a b'a a b'oan jun munlajel tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e linhan winhaj Esdras chi', ix schekan winh yak' sti' heb' yajalil heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb' yik sk'anab'ajej heb' icha ix aj yak'an sti' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix el winhaj Esdras chi' t'a yichanh skajnub' Dios chi', ix b'at winh t'a scuarto winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Eliasib. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix swa winh, malaj pax tas ix yuk'ej winh, yujto ix te kus sk'ol winh yuj smul heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to a masanil heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, haton heb' jaxnak chi', to smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ix smol halan heb' winh yajal yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak to t'a schab'jial sk'och heb' anima chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Tato ay heb' max jawi t'a sk'uhal chi', tz'ik'jiek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb', spechjiel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' chi', xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', haxo t'a jun k'u chi', haton t'a 20 yoch sb'alunhil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' winh ay yopisio yik Judá yet' yik Benjamín t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix em k'ojan heb' smasanil t'a yamak'il skajnub' Dios. Ste ib'xi heb' yuj tas wan yalchaj chi' yet' pax yuj jun nhab' ow yemi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj sacerdote Esdras chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik ix och he mul yujto ix eyik'laj he b'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il. Icha chi' ix aj swach' och ko mul.

Ha tiknaik, alekk'eta he mul t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham, k'anab'ajejek tas snib'ej. Ik'ekel he b'a t'a skal heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il chi', tzeyaktanpaxkan heb' ix ix, ix eyik'laj he b'a yet'ok t'a skal heb' chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' anima chi' smasanil, te cha'anh ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ol ko k'anab'ajej icha tzal chi'.
Palta ina max ek'laj nhab' tik, max yal-laj ko kan t'a calle tik, yujto a jun tik, manh jun chab'nhejok k'uhal ol yak' sb'o'i, yujto te niwan onh ix och ko mul tik.

Wach' tato anhej heb' yajal skan t'a tik yik sb'o'an yaji, haxo masanil heb' kajan t'a yoltak ko chonhab', heb' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syal sjawi heb' t'a junok k'u to skan sk'uhal. Aokab' heb' juez yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' tz'ik'ankot heb'. Icha chi' ol ko k'ulej ko masanil, masanto ol yal stup yowal sk'ol ko Diosal t'a kib'anh yuj tas ix ko k'ulej tik, xchi heb'.

Masanil heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia chi', ix scha sk'ol heb' tas ix alchaj chi', palta anhej winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Asael yet' winhaj Jahazías yuninal winhaj Ticva yet' chawanh heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Mesulam yet' winhaj Sabetai maj cha'an sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' a winhaj sacerdote Esdras chi', ix yak'och juntzanh heb' winh yajal winh, haton heb' winh yajal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Ix tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' winh. Haxo t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik slajunhil uj, ix smolb'an sb'a heb', yik sch'olb'itan junjun makan heb'.
Haxo t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, hata' ix lajwi sch'olb'itaj masanil heb' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.

Haton sb'i heb' winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' heb' ix ch'ok chonhab'il chi': Ha t'a yinhtilal heb' sacerdote yet' t'a heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Jesúa yuninal winhaj Josadac: Haton winhaj Maasías, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Jarib yet' winhaj Gedalías.
Ha heb' winh ix yak' wal sti' schekan pax heb' ix ix chi'. Ix yak' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' winh silab'il t'a Dios yuj smul.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Imer: Haton winhaj Hanani yet' winhaj Zebadías.
T'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim: Haton winhaj Maasías, winhaj Elías, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Jehiel yet' winhaj Uzías.
T'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Pasur: Haton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Jozabad yet' winhaj Elasa.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal heb' levita: Haton winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Simei, winhaj Kelaía, (skuchan pax Kelita) winhaj Petaías, winhaj Judá yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Haxo t'a skal heb' sb'itani: Haton winhaj Eliasib. Haxo t'a skal heb' tanhwum puerta: Haton winhaj Salum, winhaj Telem yet' winhaj Uri.
Haxo t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal, t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Paros: Haton winhaj Ramía, winhaj Jezías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Malquías yet' winhaj Benaía.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elam: Haton winhaj Matanías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Jeremot yet' winhaj Elías.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Zatu: Haton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Zabad yet' winhaj Aziza.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bebai: Haton winhaj Johanán, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Zabai yet' winhaj Atlai.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bani: Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Jasub, winhaj Seal yet' winhaj Ramot.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab: Haton winhaj Adna, winhaj Quelal, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maasías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Bezaleel, winhaj Binúi yet' winhaj Manasés.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Harim: Haton winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Isías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Simeón,
winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Maluc yet' winhaj Semarías.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Hasum: Haton winhaj Matenai, winhaj Matata, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Jeremai, winhaj Manasés yet' winhaj Simei.

Haxo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bani: Haton winhaj Madai, winhaj Amram, winhaj Uel, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Bedías, winhaj Quelúhi, winhaj Vanías, winhaj Meremot, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Matenai, winhaj Jaasai.

Haxo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Binúi: Haton winhaj Simei, winhaj Selemías, winhaj Natán, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Macnadebai, winhaj Sasai, winhaj Sarai, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Selemías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Salum, winhaj Amarías yet' winhaj José.
Haxo t'a yinhtilal winhaj Nebo: Haton winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Zebina, winhaj Jadau, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Benaía.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il. Ay heb' winh ayxo yuninal yet' heb' ix.
Haton wab'ixal a in Nehemías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hacalías. Ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, t'a jun uj skuchan Quisleu, ayinek' t'a Susa scapitalil Persia.
Hata' ix k'och winh wuk'tak skuchan Hanani yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix kot yet' winh t'a Judá. Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' tas yaj Jerusalén yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' anima ik'b'ilkot t'a Babilonia.
Ix yalan heb' t'ayin: Ha heb' ketchonhab' chi' ayek' heb' t'a Judá, te kusk'olal yajek' heb', te k'ixweltak yajek' heb'. Haxo Jerusalén chi' mak'b'ilem smuroal, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix wab'an juntzanh chi', ix in em k'ojan, ix in ok'i. Ix in te kus wal jaye' k'uhal. Ix in och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.
Ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, te niwan elk'ochi, te ay a may, tzak'elk'och a trato yet' heb' tzach xajanani, heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.

Tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik. T'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal tzin tewi t'ayach ku'uj a onh a chonhab' onh tik, a chekab' kaji. Swalk'eta ko mul t'ayach. Ha onh tik yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ix och ko mul t'ayach.
Te chuk ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach. Maj ko k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il, a k'ayb'ub'al yet' tas a chek yalnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés t'ayonh.
Nakot tas alnak t'a winh a chekab' chi': Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', ol ex in saklemejkanb'at t'a skaltak juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.

Palta tato ol ex meltzajxok t'ayin jun, ol he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, tze b'eyb'alani, wach'chom sakleminak eyajkanb'at b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol ex in molb'ejxikot t'a jun lugar to sik'b'ilel wu'uj, b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xa chi.
Ha onh a chekab' onh tik, a chonhab' onh paxi, ix onh a kol yet' a poder.

Mamin, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' tas sk'an juntzanhxo heb' a chekab' to sko nib'ej tzach kik'cha'anh. Tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yik wach' scha yab' winh rey tas ol wala', xin chi. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ayin och sb'akhumalok swino winhaj rey Artajerjes chi'.
Ay jun k'u t'a yol uj Nisán, ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, ayik wan wak'an swino winh rey chi', ix yilan winh to kuseltak yilji in sat. Malaj b'aj icha chi' wiljitaxoni.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'ayin: --¿Tas yuj kuseltak yilji a sat? Ina manh ach penaokay swila'. Ichato ilk'olal aji, xchi winh rey chi'. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix in xiwk'ei,

ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' achnhej ek'i. ¿Tas yuj manh kuseltakok yilji in sat a na'ani, ina to a in chonhab' b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, emnak lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail? xin chi t'a winh.
--¿Tas swutej in kolwaj t'ayach tiknaik jun? xchi winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.

Ix walan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tato scha a k'ol mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a chab'at t'a Judá chi', b'aj mukan heb' in mam wicham, yik sb'at in b'oanxik'ei, xin chi t'a winh.

k'ojanem winh rey chi', k'ojanpaxem ix reina t'a stz'ey winh. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --¿Jantak tiempo tzach b'at jun? ¿B'ak'inh tzach jaxi? xchi winh. Ix walani jantak tiempo, ix scha'an sk'ol winh tas ix wal chi'.

Ix walanpax t'a winh icha tik: Tato wach' tz'aj tza na' mamin rey, ak'b'at junok carta t'a heb' winh gobernador ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, yik wach' tzin schaek' heb' winh ta' masanto tzin k'och t'a Judá.

Sb'at junokxo carta chi' t'a winhaj Asaf yilumal te' niwak te' ay ta', yik syak' te' winh t'ayin, yik tz'och te' t'a spuertail b'aj ay heb' stanhwan templo, t'a smuroal chonhab' chi' yet' t'a te' pat b'aj ol in ajok, xin chi t'a winh. Yuj swach'k'olal in Diosal, ix yak' masanil juntzanh tik winh rey chi' t'ayin.

Ayik ix in jawi t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi', ix wak'an jun carta ix yak'kot winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh. Ajun pax juntzanh heb' winh yajal heb' soldado yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix yak'kot winh rey chi' wet'ok.
Palta haxo ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón to ix in jawi yik tzin kolwaj yet' heb' wetisraelal, ix kot yowal heb' winh.
Ayik yoxilxo k'uhal in jawi t'a Jerusalén,

in k'e wa'an t'ak'walil yet' jaywanh heb' winh winak ajun wet'ok, palta malaj junok mach b'aj ix wala' tas ix yal Dios t'a in pensar yuj tas ol in k'ulej t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj nok' chej ix kik'b'ati, a innhej ix wik' nok' in kuchumal.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', onh elta t'a jun puerta t'a panhan, t'a stojolal sjaj ha' Dragón, onh ek' t'a spuertail b'aj sb'atkan k'alem. Ix wilan smuroal Jerusalén chi', mak'b'ilem lanhnajok, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail.
Ix ek' wilanpax jun puerta t'a sjaj ha ha' yet' pax stanque winh rey. Majxo yal-laj wek' yet' nok' in chej chi' ta'.
Hanheja' k'ik'to in k'ek'och t'a sti' ha' Cedrón. Ayik ix lajwi wilan muro chi', in meltzajxi b'aj in b'at chi', in ochxi t'a jun puerta t'a panhan chi'.

Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', manh yojtakok heb' b'ajtil ayinb'ati, manh yojtakok pax heb' tas tzin k'ulej. Malaj pax tas swal t'a heb' wetisraelal, t'a heb' sacerdote, t'a heb' yajal yaji yet' t'a heb' ol munlajok.

Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik eyojtak sik'lab'il to a jun pekti' b'aj ayonh ek' tik te chuklaj, ina ix mak'chajem lanhnaj chonhab' Jerusalén tik, tz'anakxopaxb'at spuertail. Yuj chi' ko molb'ejek ko b'a sko b'oanekxik'e smuroal tik, yik wach' maxtzak onh b'uchji, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayik ix walan t'a heb' jantak swach'k'olal Dios ix sch'ox t'ayin yet' tas ix yal winh rey t'ayin, ix yalan heb': --Ko yamekoch ko munlaji, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun munlajel chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Sanbalat aj Horón yet' winhaj Tobías yajal yaj t'a Amón yet' pax winhaj Gesem árabe, ix te b'uchwaj heb' winh t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' winh: --¿Tas ol he k'ulej? ¿Tom tze nib'ej tzeyik'el he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey? xchi heb' winh.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Yuj skolwal sDiosal satcha'anh, ol yal ku'uj. Ha onh schekab' onh tik ol ko yamoch ko b'o'ani, palta a ex tik, malaj eyalan heyik t'ayonh, malaj eyopisio, yujto manh ex ketchonhab'ok, xin chi.

Ha winhaj sat sacerdote Eliasib yet' heb' yetsacerdoteal, a heb' ix b'oanxi b'aj tz'och nok' kalnel, ix yak'anoch spuertail heb'. Ix sb'oanxik'e muro heb', ix b'atnhej t'a torre skuch Hamea masanto t'a torre skuch Hananeel, ix yak'ankanoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Haxo junxo makan muro chi', a heb' winh aj Jericó ix b'oanxik'ei. Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Zacur yuninal winhaj Imri ix b'oanxik'ei.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal winhaj Senaa ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ay spuertail yik nok' chay. Ix yak'anoch sjolom spuertail chi' heb', ix ochkan spuertail chi', ix ek'kan k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok.

Ix b'onhejb'at jun muro chi', a winhaj Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías yixchikin winhaj Cos ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Haxo winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Berequías, yixchikin winhaj Mesezabeel ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Haxo winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Baana ix b'oanxi junxo makan.
Haxo junxo makan a heb' aj Tecoa ix b'oanxik'ei, palta a heb' niwak winak yaj t'a skal heb', maj yal sk'ol heb' ix kolwaj yet' heb' skuchb'an jun munlajel chi'.

Ha winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Besodías, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ay jun puerta skuchan Jesana. Ix yak'anoch sjolom spuertail chi' heb' winh, ix ochpaxkan spuertail chi', ix ek'kan k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok.

Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Melatías aj Gabaón ix b'oanxik'e yet' winhaj Jadón aj Meronot yet' heb' aj Gabaón yet' heb' aj Mizpa, haton heb' ay t'a yalanh smandar winh yajal yaj t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates.

Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Uziel yuninal winhaj Harhaía, winh smunlaj yet' k'e'en k'e'en wach' yilji, a winh ix b'oanxik'ei. Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Hananías yuninal jun winh b'o'um perfume ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi' ix b'oanxik'e muro chi' masanto ix k'och t'a sti' jun muro lewan sat.
Haxo junxo makan a winhaj Refaías yuninal winhaj Hur ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha winh chi' yajal yaj winh t'a nanhal lugar t'a yol smakb'en Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Jedaías yuninal winhaj Harumaf ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a yichanh spat. Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Hatús yuninal winhaj Hasabnías ix b'oanxik'ei.
Ha junxo makan, a winhaj Malquías yuninal winhaj Harim yet' winhaj Hasub yuninal winhaj Pahat-moab, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e yet' jun torre skuch Hornos.
Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Halohes ix b'oanxik'ei. Ha winh chi' yajal yaj winh t'a nanhalxo lugar ayoch t'a yol smakb'en Jerusalén. Ix kolwajpax heb' ix yisil winh yet'ok.

Ha winhaj Hanún yet' heb' kajan t'a Zanoa ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' t'a ch'olan. Ix yak'anoch spuertail heb', ix ek'kan k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok. Ix sb'oanxik'e 450 metro muro chi' heb', masanto t'a spuertail b'aj sb'atkan k'alem.

Haxo winhaj Malquías yuninal winhaj Recab yajal t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Bet-haquerem, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' b'aj sb'atkan k'alem chi'. Ix yak'anoch spuertail winh, ix ek'kan k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Colhoze, yajal t'a yol smakb'en chonhab' Mizpa, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj ix kan sti' t'a sjaj ha ha'. Ix yak'k'e spatil winh, ix yak'anoch spuertail chi' winh, ix ek'paxkan k'atan k'e'en hierro syamnub'ok. Ix sb'oanxik'e muro chi' winh b'aj ay tanque skuch Siloé t'a slak'anil yawb'en te' heb' rey, masanto b'aj b'akhkiltak yem sb'e'al schonhab' winhaj David.

Ha winhaj Nehemías yuninal winhaj Azbuc, yajal t'a nanhal yol smakb'en chonhab' Bet-sur, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan muro chi'. Ix kotnhej t'a yichanh b'aj mukb'il winhaj rey David masanto ix k'och b'aj ay stanqueal ha ha', ix k'och b'aj ay scuartel heb' soldado.

Haxo heb' levita skuchb'ej winhaj Rehum yuninal winhaj Bani, a heb' ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Haxo t'a yichanhb'ati, a winhaj Hasabías yajal t'a nanhal smakb'en chonhab' Keila, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan sk'exulok heb' yetchonhab'.
Haxo b'aj ix k'och yik heb' chi', hata' ix sb'oxik'e juntzanhxo heb' sk'ab'yok heb'. Ha winhaj Bavai yuninal winhaj Henadad, yajal t'a nanhalxo smakb'en Keila chi', a winh skuchb'an heb'.
Haxo winhaj Ezer yuninal winhaj Jesúa, yajal t'a Mizpa, a winh ix b'oanxik'e jun makanhxo t'a yichanh b'aj smolchaj yamk'ab' yik owal b'aj skumlaj muro chi'.
Haxo winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Zabai, t'a smasanil sk'o'ol winh ix sb'oxik'e junxo makan b'aj skumlaj chi' masanto ix k'och t'a spuertail spat winhaj Eliasib, winh sat sacerdote.
Ha winhaj Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías, yixchikin winhaj Cos, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan sb'at t'a spuertail spat winhaj Eliasib chi' masanto b'aj slajwik'och spat winh chi'.
Haxo junxo makan, a heb' sacerdote kajan t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán ix b'oanxik'ei.

Haxo winhaj Benjamín yet' winhaj Hasub, a heb' winh ix b'oanxib'at t'a yichanh spat. Haxo t'a snhi' yik heb' winh chi', haxo winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Maasías yixchikin winhaj Ananías, a winh ix b'oanxik'e t'a slak'anil spat.
Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Binúi yuninal winhaj Henadad, a winh ix b'oanxik'ei, ix b'at t'a spat winhaj Azarías masanto ix k'och b'aj skumlaj t'a jun schikin.

Haxo winhaj Palal yuninal winhaj Uzai, a winh ix b'oanxik'e b'aj skumlaj chi' yet' jun torre ayel t'a spatik muro chi' t'a spalacio winh rey, haton t'a yamak'il spat heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi'. Haxo junxo makan, a winhaj Pedaías yuninal winhaj Faros ix b'oanxik'ei,

masanto ix k'och t'a spuertail b'aj tz'el heb' ix ix ik'oj ha', jun sb'atkan t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u, t'a slak'anil jun torre ayel t'a spatik muro chi'. Haxo junxo makan, a heb' smunlaj t'a templo kajan t'a Ofel, a heb' ix b'oanxik'ei.
Haxo heb' aj Tecoa ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan, sb'atnhej t'a yichanh jun torre chi' masanto t'a smuroal t'a Ofel chi'.
Haxo heb' sacerdote ix b'oanxik'e t'a yichanh spat junjun, sb'atnhej t'a spuertail b'aj tz'och nok' chej.

Haxo winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Imer ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a yichanh spat. Haxo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Secanías ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan b'aj ay heb' stanhwan puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Haxo winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj Hanún swakil yuninal winhaj Salaf, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan. Haxo winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Berequías ix b'oanxik'e jun makan t'a yichanh spat.

Haxo winhaj Malquías, winh b'o'um k'e'en wach' yilji, a winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan t'a spat heb' smunlaj t'a templo yet' t'a yik heb' chonhwajum yet' t'a yichanh spuertail b'aj ay heb' stanhwan chonhab' chi', masanto b'aj ay heb' stanhwan t'a schikin muro chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh b'o'um k'e'en wach' yilji yet' heb' winh chonhwajum, a heb' winh ix b'oanxik'e junxo makan, sb'atnhej b'aj ay heb' stanhwan t'a schikin chi', masanto ix k'och b'aj ay spuertail yik nok' kalnel.
