Ix sketzan nok' chej chi' winh t'a yalanh winh, ix ek' winh t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a parque, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ichaton tik tz'aj yik'jicha'anh junok mach to snib'ej winh rey syik'cha'anh, xchi winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yik'jiek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yuj winh, ix b'at winh yak'xikan winh t'a sti' spalacio winh rey chi', haxo winh elanhchamel ix paxkan winh t'a spat. Te kusk'olal ix aj winh, ix smakan sat winh yuj k'ixwelal.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum yet' t'a heb' yamigo masanil tas ix utaj winh chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', israel winh, yuj chi' wan slajwiem opisio tik t'a spatik winh. Manh ol ak'laj ganar winh, palta to a winh ol ach ak'an ganar, xchi heb'.
Manto lajwi yalan heb' icha chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a elanhchamel yik tz'ik'jib'at winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el ix schek b'ojok ix Ester chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey yet' winhaj Amán chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el chi'.
Haxo yik wan yuk'an wino heb' winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester chi' icha tik: --k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, wach'chom a nanhalok in makb'en tik tza k'ana', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato scha a k'o'ol tas tzin k'an t'ayach, anhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach to max in a cha miljokchamok, max champaxlaj heb' wetchonhab'.

Yujto a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' chi', ix onh chonhchaji yik tzonh satjiel t'a junelnhej. Komonok wal tonhej onh chonhchajb'at chekab'ok, tato icha chi' tekan manh smojok to swik'ek' a tiempo, okxo jun, to ol onh satjokel t'a junelnhej, xchi ix.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Asuero chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun chi'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun mach sna'an jun tzal chi'? xchi winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ha winh ajk'ol chuk spensar chi', haton winhaj Amán tik, xchi ix. Ha wal yik ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Amán chi', sakxonhej ix aj yilji sat winh yuj xiwelal t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh ix reina Ester chi'.

Ix k'e wan winh rey chi', ix te kot yowal winh, ix elta winh t'a yol pat b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix el winh b'aj ay yamak'il spalacio. Palta haxo winhaj Amán chi', ix yilan winh to wan yak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh winh, ix kannhej winh b'aj ix wa heb' chi', ix tewioch winh t'a ix reina Ester chi' to tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh yuj ix.

Ayik ix ochxik'och winh rey b'aj ix wa chi', ix yilan winh to kumanem winhaj Amán chi' t'a stz'ey b'aj k'ojanem ix reina chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom tza nib'ej tzixtej ix reina t'a wichanh t'a yol in pat tik? xchi winh. Ayik ix yalan juntzanh lolonel winh rey chi', elanhchamel ix makchaj sat winhaj Amán chi' yuj heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh chekab' skuchan Harbona icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a spat winhaj Amán tik, ix yak' b'ochajem jun te te' winh jun ch'anhil ix ajk'e ste'el. Hata' ol k'e lokan winhaj Mardoqueo yuj winh yalani, haton winh sk'ulejnak jun tas wach' t'ayach, xchi winh. --Hak'ekk'e lokan winhaj Amán tik t'a jun te te' chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e lokan winhaj Amán chi' t'a te', haton te' ix sb'ok'e winh yuj winhaj Mardoqueo yalani. Icha chi' ix aj sikb'i yowal sk'ol winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán, winh ajk'ol yajoch t'a heb' israel, ix yak' winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester. Haxo winhaj Mardoqueo chi', niwan yopisio winh ix ak'ji yuj winh rey chi', yujto toxo ix yal ix Ester chi' to te ayto yuj sb'a ix yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel k'e'en skolk'ab' winh rey chi', k'e'en ix ik'chajek' t'a winhaj Amán, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Haxo masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán ak'b'il t'a ix Ester chi', ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ochxi ix Ester t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix em kuman ix, ix och ijan ix yok'i. Ix tewi ix to tz'ik'jiel yopisio jun ley te chuk ix sb'o winhaj Amán chi'. Ix yalan ix to max elk'och tas syal jun ley chi' t'a heb' israel.
Ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh rey chi' nab'a oro t'a ix, ix k'e linhan ix t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' in t'a yol a sat, tato wach' tas tzin k'an tik tzab'i, tato t'a wal yel xajan in u'uj, komonok tzak' tz'ib'chajb'at junokxo ley yik tz'el yopisio tas syal jun ley ix yak'b'at winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag t'a masanil yol a makb'en b'aj syala' to satjiel masanil heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol techaj wuj wilan tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' wetchonhab' yuj tas ol aj ko satjieli, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Asuero chi' t'a ix yet' t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Amán chi' lokanxok'e winh t'a te te', yujto chuk tas ix snacha'anh winh t'a spatik heb' eyetchonhab'. Masanil tas ay t'a winh, toxo ix wak' t'ayach.

Ha tiknaik tz'ib'ejb'at icha tas tze na yuj swach'ilok masanil heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Tzeyak'anoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay. Yujto a junok ley b'aj ayoch in b'i yet' in sello t'ay, maxtzak yal-laj yek'i, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi', ayik 23 yoch yoxil uj skuch Siván. Masanil tas ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' israel, t'a heb' winh yajal, t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, t'a masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', skotto t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía. Ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra junjun chonhab' yet' t'a sti' heb' israel.

Ix ochpax sello winhaj rey Asuero t'ay yik scheklaji to a winh tz'alani. Ha heb' ix b'at spuk jun ley chi', ha t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, haton nok' schej winh rey ayek' t'a yet'tal, hata' ix k'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ley ix yalb'at winh rey chi', yalnhej tas chonhab'il b'aj ayek' heb' israel chi', syal smolb'an sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb'. Tato ay heb' ajk'ol yalnhej tas chonhab'il sk'och t'a heb' yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, syal satanel heb' ajk'ol chi' heb'. Yet' pax yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal heb' ajk'ol chi' syal satanel heb'. Syik'ankanek' heb' tas ay t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Ha juntzanh tik, junnhej k'uhal tz'aj sb'o t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', haton t'a jun k'u chekel yajkan t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.

Ha scopiail jun ley chi', yowalil spukax t'a junjun makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', yowalil tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil chonhab' yujto ley yaji, yik wach' ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil heb' israel chi' syak' lista sb'a heb' yik spakan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Ha heb' winh ix b'at yal jun ley chi', elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' schej winh. Ix alchajpaxel jun ley chi' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', b'ab'el chonhab' yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix elta winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ayoch spichul winh yik yopisio yuj, k'ik'mutz'inak yet' saksak yilji. Ayk'e jun niwan corona nab'a oro t'a sjolom winh, ayoch jun xotil winh nab'a lino k'ik'mutz'inak yilji. Masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Yuj chi' a heb' israel ix el lenaj ix yil heb', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ik'jicha'anh heb' ix yab'i.

Ayik ix k'och jun ley chi' t'a masanil lugar yet' t'a junjun chonhab', masanil heb' israel ix te tzalaji. Ix yak'anoch jun k'inh heb', ix wa heb'. Tzijtum heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' ix yak'och sb'a israelal yet' heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.

Ayik 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar, haton jun k'u chi' chekel yaji yik tz'elk'och tas syal jun ley alb'ilel yuj winh rey chi', haton t'a jun k'uhal chi' satjiel heb' israel yuj heb' ajk'ol chi' yalani. Haxo ix aji, maj elk'ochlaj icha chi', palta to a heb' ajk'ol chi' ix ak'ji ganar yuj heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ay heb'. Ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' ix snib'ej satanel heb' chi'. Manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', yujto toxo ix och xiwk'olal t'a skal heb' anima smasanil.
Masanil heb' winh niwak yajal ay t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yopisio, ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' israel, yujto ix te xiw heb' winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi',
yujto te niwan yopisio winh t'a spalacio winh rey chi'. Ha sb'inajnakil winh ix te pukax t'a masanil chonhab', yujto t'a junjun k'u ste niwanb'i yopisio winh chi'.
Ix miljicham heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a k'e'en espada yuj heb' israel chi'. Ix satjiel heb' smasanil, ix sk'ulej heb' israel chi' icha wal tas snib'ej.

Ha t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ay 500 heb' winh winak ix miljicham yuj heb' israel chi', palta malaj wal jab'ok tastak ay t'a heb' winh ix cham chi' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ix cham chi', ix cham heb' winh tik: Winhaj Parsandata, winhaj Dalfón, winhaj Aspata, winhaj Porata, winhaj Adalías, winhaj Aridata, winhaj Parmasta, winhaj Arisai, winhaj Aridai yet' winhaj Vaizata. Ha winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel, winh yuninal winhaj Hamedata, a winh ay yuninal heb' winh slajunhwanhil.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayik ix yab'an winh rey jantak sb'isul heb' anima ix cham t'a chonhab' Susa chi', haton b'aj kajan winh,

ix yalan winh t'a ix reina Ester icha tik: --Ha heb' etchonhab' toxo ix smilcham 500 heb' winh winak heb' yet' lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán t'a chonhab' Susa tik. Okxom pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol in makb'en tik, jantak am tas ix uji. Al t'ayin tasto tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix Ester chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato syal a k'o'ol, tzala' to a k'ik'an sk'ulejxi heb' wetchonhab' t'a chonhab' Susa tik icha tas ix sk'ulej heb' tiknaik icha yalan a ley. Tzalan paxi to sk'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Amán chi' t'a te te', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh rey to sk'ulaj icha chi'. Ix alchajel jun ley chi' t'a masanil yol chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix k'e lokan sniwanil lajunhwanh heb' yuninal winhaj Amán chi'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejxi sb'a heb' ayik 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, ix smilancham 300 xo heb' winh winak heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima chi' ix yik'ek' heb'.

Masanil heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en winh rey chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' ayik 13 yoch uj chi', yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol chi'. 75 mil heb' ajk'ol chi' ix smilcham heb', palta malaj jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' ix yik'ek' heb'. Ayik 14 yoch uj chi', ix och wa'an heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el t'a tzalajk'olal.

Haxo heb' israel kajan t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb' t'a 13 yoch uj yet' t'a 14, haxo t'a 15 ix och wa'an heb' smilancham heb' anima chi', ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el t'a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo pax heb' israel kajan t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yet' t'a juntzanh aldea malaj smuroal, ha t'a 14 yoch uj skuch Adar, hata' ix yak'och k'inh heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix sian wa'el heb' t'ay junjun.

Ix schekan tz'ib'chaj masanil juntzanh tas ix uji tik winhaj Mardoqueo, ix schekan winh to tz'ak'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal winh kajan t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', heb' kajan t'a slak'anil yet' heb' kajan t'a najat.
Ix yalanb'at winh to t'a 14 yet' t'a 15 yoch uj Adar t'a junjun ab'il, yowalil tz'och k'inh,

yujto ha t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi' a heb' israel ix satanel heb' yajk'o'ol. Ha wal t'a jun uj chi', a skusk'olal heb' yet' yok'elk'olal, ix meltzajkanoch t'a tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'och k'inh heb' yet' niwak wa'el, ix laj sian wa'el heb' t'ay junjun, ix yak'an skolwal heb' t'a heb' meb'a'.
Ha jun ley ix schek tz'ib'chaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan sb'eyb'alok heb' israel chi'.
Yujto a winhaj Amán ajk'ol t'a heb' israel chi', ix yak'och suerte winh t'a yib'anh heb' tas k'uhal satjiel heb' smasanil,

palta yujto ix b'at tewi ix Ester t'a winh rey, yuj chi' ix yak'elta jun ley winh to a masanil chukal ix sna winhaj Amán chi' sk'ulej t'a heb' israel chi', ha t'a yib'anh winh smeltzajkani. Yuj chi' ix ak'jik'e lokan winh yet' heb' yuninal t'a te te'.

Yuj chi' a juntzanh k'uhal chi' ix skuchkan Purim. Ha jun lolonel chi' syalelk'ochi, juntzanh tastak sk'an heb' t'a suerteal. Icha syal tas ix tz'ib'ejb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej heb',
a ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi' yet' yinhtilal yet' pax masanil heb' syak'och sb'a israelal. Yowalil syak'och chab' k'uhal k'inh chi' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, icha sk'uhal ix aj yalchajkani.

Icha chi' ix ajkani yik snachajkot yuj heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a junjun makan smakb'en winh rey yet' t'a junjun chonhab' to yowalil snakot heb', syak'anoch k'inh heb' yik Purim t'a sk'uhal ix cheklajkan chi' t'a masanil tiempo.

Haxo ix reina Ester yisilkan winhaj Abihail yet' winhaj Mardoqueo winh israel, ha t'a sb'i yopisio heb' chi', ix schek heb' tz'ib'chajb'at yuj k'inh yik Purim chi', yik swach' ak'chajoch yip jun ix schek b'ab'laj tz'ib'chajb'at heb'.
Ix schekan heb' pukchajb'at t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal heb' kajan t'a 127 makan yaj smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Ix ak'jib'at stzatzil sk'ol heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' yuj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix alchaji to yowalil tz'och k'inh yik Purim t'a sk'uhal chekelxo ix ajkani, icha wal ix yutej winhaj Mardoqueo yet' ix reina Ester chi' yalani. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yet' pax yinhtilal heb' yik snachajkot tzek'ojk'olal yet' kusk'olal.
Ha jun cheknab'il ix yak' ix Ester chi', a tz'alani tas tz'aj yoch k'inh chi'. Ha jun tik ix schek ix tz'ib'chajkani.
Ix yak'och k'e'en tumin winhaj rey Asuero t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima, haton heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en winh masanto heb' kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, yik syak' k'e'en heb' t'a winh.

Masanil sjelanil winh rey chi' yet' yopisio yet' yab'ixal tas wal yutejnak winh yak'an niwak opisio t'a winhaj Mardoqueo, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal tastak ujinak t'a yol smakb'en Media yet' Persia.

Ha winhaj Mardoqueo chi', ix ochkan winh schab'il yajalil t'a winhaj rey Asuero chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' yetisraelal. Te xajan ix ilji winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi', yujto ix sayjiek' swach'il heb' yuj winh, ix yak'an wal yip winh yik wach' tzalajk'olal yet' junk'olal tz'aj heb'.

Ha t'a yol smakb'en Uz ek'nak jun winh winak skuchan Job. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, te ay yelk'och Dios t'a sat winh. Sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal.
Ha winhaj Job chi' ay ukwanh yuninal winh yet' oxwanh yisil.

Ay 7 mil nok' skalnel winh, 3 mil nok' scamello winh, 500 moj nok' wakax smunlaji yet' 500 nok' b'uru. Manh jantakok heb' schekab' winh. Anhej wal winh te b'eyum t'a yichanh heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh chi', k'ajan heb' winh yoch k'inh t'a spat junjun. Stzolal yek' k'inh chi' t'a heb' winh, syawtan heb' ix oxwanh yanab' heb' winh chi' wa'el yet'ok.

Ayik slajwi yek'chaj k'inh chi' t'a heb' winh t'a stzolal, tz'awtajkot heb' winh yuj winhaj Job chi'. Ak'walto sk'e wa'an winh, snhusan silab' winh yuj junjun heb' winh, yik sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh t'a sat Dios, talaj tz'och smul heb' winh, syalan chuk heb' winh t'a Dios t'a spensar sna'an winh. Icha chi' sk'ulej winh t'a juntak el.
Ay jun k'u ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh t'a satcha'anh. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ix k'ochpax jun ángel ajk'o'ol, haton winh Satanás.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh: --In kot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal icha winh chi', te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, ay welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Manh nab'anhejok wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a ichanh.

Yujto max yal a k'ol to ay junok mach tz'ik'anek' junok tas t'a winh, ma tastak ay t'a yol spat winh yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh. Ha ach tzak'nhej a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ek'b'al sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh yet' sb'eyumal.
Palta k'inalok a tiknaik tzik'ek' masanil tas ay t'a winh chi', ol hilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ichokab' ta', ol xo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh chi', anhej to malaj tas tzutej sniwanil winh, xchi. Ixlajwi chi' ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay jun k'u, ayik wan swa heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' ix yisil winhaj Job chi' t'a spat winh b'ab'el winak,
ix jawi jun winh chekab' b'aj ayek' winhaj Job chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Wan ko munlaj yet' nok' wakax, haxo nok' b'uru wan swa nok' t'a ko lak'anil chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ix jawi heb' winh sabeo, ix miljikancham heb' winh munlajwum chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yelk'anb'at nok' wakax chi' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan jun winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix kot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh yuj Dios, ix cham masanil heb' winh tanhwum kalnel yet' nok' kalnel chi'. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh yoxil, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh caldeo, ox makan wal ix aj heb' winh yak'an owal t'ayonh. Ix smilancham masanil heb' winh stanhwan nok' a camello heb' winh, ix yelk'anb'at nok' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh uninal yet' heb' ix isil, wan swa heb', syuk'an wino heb' t'a spat winh b'ab'el uninal,

haxo ix aji, ix jawi jun tzijtumal ik' t'a stojolal lum takinh lu'um. Ix em lanhnaj spat heb' uninal chi' t'a yib'anh yuj jun ik' chi', ix cham heb' smasanil. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winhaj Job chi', ix te kus winh sik'lab'il. Ix snhik'chitan spichul winh, ix stzukanel xil sjolom winh, ix em nhojan winh ejmelal t'a Dios.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Malaj jab'ok tas wet'nak in alji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj pax jab'ok tas ol wik'b'ati ayik ol in meltzajxok. Ha Jehová ix ak'an masanil tas t'ayin, hanheja' pax tz'ik'anxiek'i. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay, xchi winh.
Wach'chom niwan ya'elal ix ek' t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi', palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto maj yal-laj chukal winh t'a spatik Dios yuj tas ix utaj chi'.
Ayik ix k'och sk'uhal smolb'anxi sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh, ix k'och pax winh Satanás t'a skal heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix in kot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj wal junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal chi' lajan yet' winh. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh. Ay wal welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal. U'uj wal ix in satel masanil tastak ay t'a winh, palta tokwal yuj chi' ix juwiel spensar winh, xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Tato malaj tz'ik'an sniwanil junok mach, ¿tok ay tas sna'a? B'ekan sk'ol slajwiel masanil tastak ay t'ay yik skolan sk'inal.
Palta tato a tiknaik ha t'a sniwanil winh chi' tzak'och junok ya'elal, ol hilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab' ta'. Olxo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' sniwanil winh chi', anhej b'i'an to malaj halan ik ik'anel sk'inal winh, xchi.
Ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ank'e juntzanh yab'il winh te niwan t'a sniwanil winhaj Job chi', schakot t'a yok winh masanto t'a sjolom winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at em k'ojan winhaj Job chi' t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh. Ix yik'ankot jab' sti' lum chen winh, sjotz'anek' lum winh t'ay.
Palta haxo ix yetb'eyum winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --¿Tom hanheja' wach'nhej tzutej a pensar? Al chuk t'a Dios, tzach cham b'i'an, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ach ix, lajan wal a lolon icha heb' ix ix malaj jab'ok spensar. Toxo ix ko cha swach'k'olal Dios, ¿tom manh ol ko chapax ko ya'elal syak'a'? xchi winhaj Job chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom ayoch sya'elal winh, palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto malaj chuk ix yal winh t'a spatik Dios.

Ay oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi': Haton winhaj Elifaz aj Temán, winhaj Bildad aj Súa yet' winhaj Zofar aj Naamat. Ayik ix yab'an spekal masanil juntzanh ya'elal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi' heb' winh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a sk'ol skot yak' sniwanil sk'ol winh, yik tzul mol kus pax heb' winh yuj sya'elal winh chi'.

Najatto wan skot heb' winh, ix yilankot winhaj Job chi' heb' winh. Pural ix och sat heb' winh t'a winh, yuj chi' ix syamanoch heb' winh yok' yuj winh. Ix te kus heb' winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul heb' winh. Ix stzipancha'anh pokok heb' winh t'a cha'anh, haxo t'a sjolom heb' winh tz'em lu'um.

Ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a sat lum yet' winh, uke' k'uhal, uke' ak'wal ix ek' heb' winh yet' winh ta', malaj junok b'elanh lolonel ix yal heb' winh, yujto te ow yak'an sya'elal winhaj Job chi' ix yil heb' winh.
Ayik ix lajwiek' juntzanh chi', ix skatab'an winhaj Job chi' jun k'u b'aj aljinak. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal ayik skuchannak in och ix in nun. Tzin katab'ej jun k'u ayik waljinak.
Komonok a jun k'u chi' och t'ak'walilal. Komonok kannhej icha chi' yuj Dios, maj sakb'ok.
Komonok ay wal junok niwan wewen ochnak, yik wach' k'ik'b'ikaneli. Komonok ay wal junok niwan k'ik' asun musani, ma junok k'ik' och t'a sat k'u, yik ay xiwk'olal t'a jun k'u chi'.
Komonok k'ik' k'inal ajkan jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' maj och jun k'u chi' sb'isulok sk'uhal yik jun uj chi' yet' jun ab'il chi'.
Komonok malaj tas uji t'a jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' malaj aw yik tzalajk'olal ochi.
Komonok skatab'aj jun ak'wal chi' yuj heb' ajb'a'al, haton heb' syal skuchb'an nok' leviatán.
Komonok maj k'eul k'e'en niwak k'anal t'a jun k'inhib'alil chi'. Komonok maj k'eul sakil k'inal stanhwaj sk'euli yet' sakil yich cha'anh.
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal chi', yujto maj syamoch wa'an waljub'al. Tato ma'ay, tekan max wil jantak ya'elal yet' kusk'olal tik.
Oktom cham in t'a yol sk'ol ix in nun. Oktom cham in ayik wan walji.
Oktom malaj jolom penek cha'an in. Oktom malaj im in chu'u yik tzin k'ib'i.
Oktom chamnak in, tzalajk'olal am tzin way tiknaik. Junk'olal am swik' wip
yet' heb' rey yet' heb' yajal, haton heb' ix b'oanxik'e juntzanh niwak pat emnak lanhnajok,
ma yet' heb' niwak yajal b'ut'an spalacio yuj k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata.
¿Tas yuj maj in mukchaj icha junok unin tonhej tz'ek'i, ma icha junok unin chamnakxo tz'alji?
Ha b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, hata' slajwikan b'aj syixtej anima heb' chuk. Ha pax ta' syik' yip heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chi'.
Hata' syik' yip heb' icha preso yaj t'a munlajel, manhxa b'aj syab' heb' stumaj yuj heb' tz'ilan munlajel chi'.
Hata' ayek' heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' elnakxo t'a yalanh smandar spatrón. Lajanxonhej heb' smasanil.
¿Tas yuj syak' Dios sakil k'inal yil heb' tz'ixtaji? ¿Tas yuj syak' sk'inal heb' ayoch t'a sya'elal,
heb' snib'ej cham sb'a, palta max chamlaj heb', wach'chom snib'ej chamel chi' heb' t'a yichanh b'eyumal?
Ha jun anima chi' schax stzalajk'olal yuj ayik toxo ix b'atkan t'a yol b'aj smukchaji.
¿Tas yuj hanheja' yak'an in k 'inal Dios, a in to manh wojtakok tas ol in ajok, a in icha wal to makan in yuj?
Maxtzak yal in wa'i, maxtzak yal pax wuk'an ha' yuj ok'el yuj in ya'elal.
Ha tas b'aj swekxiw in b'a, haton sjawi t'a wib'anh.
Maxtzak yal wik'an jab'ok wip, manhxalaj swach'il waji. Manhxa jab'ok in junk'olal, haxonhej ya'elal tzin ik'ani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Elifaz aj Temán t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ach Job, tekan chuk tzab'i tato ay mach stek'b'ej sb'a slolon het'ok, palta maxtzak techaj wu'uj tato tonhej swab'i.
Yujto tzijtum mach b'aj ix ak' k'ayb'ub'al, ix ak'an pax stek'anil heb' somchajnakeli.
Ix ak' stek'anil heb' telwinak. Ix a yamanoch wa'an heb' ay schab'k'olal,
haxo yik ix ja ya'elal t'a ib'anh tik, manhxa jab'ok a tek'anil.
Ha ach tik tza k'anab'ajej wal Dios, tojol a b'eyb'al halani. ¿Tas yuj somchajel a k'ol tiknaik?
Nawalkoti, ¿tokwal sjawi ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul? ¿Tokwal komon scham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al?
Ha swilani, a heb' sk'ulan chukal, a tas sk'ulej heb' chi' sjawi t'a yib'anh.
Syak'kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', satjiel heb' t'a junelnhej yuj, icha tz'aj satjiel tastak yuj chakxuxum ik'.
Tz'el yaw heb' icha yel yaw nok' choj, palta ha Dios tz'ak'an em numan heb', icha yem numan nok' choj smak'jiel ye.
Maxtzak yal-laj swa nok', scham nok' yuj wejel, haxo nok' yunetak, toxonhej saklemkanb'at nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj heb' chuk chi' yuj Dios.
k'unnhej ix k'och jun lolonel ix sajjioch t'a in chikin, pural wal ix wab'i.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik yoralil sway anima, ix in wayichej jun tas te xiwub'tak.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, ix in ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal.
Ay jun icha spixan anima ix wab' yek' masasok t'a in sat, ix k'e chijan xil in jolom yuj xiwelal.
Ix k'och linhan jun pixan chi' t'a in tz'ey ix wab'i. Maj wilochlaj. Haxo ix wab'ani ix sajsonk'ei, ix yalan icha tik:
¿Tokwal ay junok anima tojol t'a yichanh Dios? Wach'chom ay mach te tek'an, ¿tokwal malaj jab'ok spaltail t'a yichanh mach ix b'o'ani?
Ina max yak' wal och Dios heb' schekab' ay t'a satcha'anh yipok sk'o'ol. Inatax heb' ángel tz'och spaltail heb' t'a yichanh.
Okxom wal heb' anima. Jab'nhej sk'inal heb', lajan heb' icha junok xan pat b'ob'il t'a yib'anh lum pokok, k'un yem lanhnajok. Syal stek'chajem heb' icha nok' ij.
Wach'chom wach' heb' t'a k'inhib'alil, haxo tz'emkan k'u, satxikanem heb'. Satel heb' t'a junelnhej, malaj mach skus yuj heb'.
Icha yik tz'em lanhnaj junok mantiado spolchaj sch'anhal, icha chi' yaj sk'inal heb' anima. Tz'ek'b'at lemnajok, malaj jab'ok jelanil syik'kan heb', xchi jun pixan chi' t'ayin.
Ha tiknaik ach Job elokab' aw, ol kila' mach junok ol tak'wok t'ayach. ¿Mach junok ángel ol ach kolanok?
Ha junok anima chuk spensar, schichon sk'o'ol, snib'anoch tastak. Ha schichonk'olal chi' ol ik'anel sk'inal.
Wilnak heb' chuk spensar, slaj k'echa'anh tastak ay t'a heb', palta elanhchamel satxiem juntzanh chi'.
Ha yalyuninal heb', manhxa mach skolwaj t'a heb'. Ayik sk'och heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, manhxalaj tz'aj yelk'och heb', manhxa mach skolan heb'.
Ayik tz'elul sat yawb'en heb', haxo heb' anima wan scham yuj wejel slajaneli, sayanelta heb' t'a kaltak k'i'ix. Haxo heb' malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, syiloch sk'o'ol heb' t'a sb'eyumal heb'.
Ha ya'elal manh b'ajokto skoti, manhokto t'a yol lu'um sk'eta.
Toxonton yik ya'elal kaji, icha te namix k'ak' tz'elnhejta t'a kal k'ak'.
Tato a in tik icha aj tik waji, elanhchamel am swak'och in b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha Dios satub'tak tastak sk'ulej, manhxo b'ischajb'enok tas k'ulej chi'. Malaj mach snachajel yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik. Icha chi' tz'aj yoch yalil masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um.
Ha tz'ik'ancha'anh heb' anima emnakil syutej sb'a, hanheja' pax tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayoch t'a sya'elal.
Ha Dios chi' sjuanb'at tas nab'il yuj heb' jelan, yik max elk'ochi.
A' syamanoch wa'an heb' jelan t'a chukal, yik max elk'och tas snib'ej heb' t'a chukal chi'.
Ha wal t'a chimk'uhalil stelwi heb', k'ik'k 'inal t'a heb'. Icha wal to t'ak'walil sb'eyek' heb', toxonhej tzek' machmon heb'.
Ha Dios skolan heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar, hanheja' skolan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
A' ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' malaj stek'anil, ha' smakan sti' heb' manh tojolok syutej sb'a.
Wach' yik heb' skachji yuj Dios. Manh a patikejel a kachnab'il syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'.
Tato ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an echnaj junok mach, ha' tz'anhtanpaxi. Tato ha' tz'ak'anoch sya'elal junok mach, a tz'ak'anpax b'oxok sk'o'ol.
Tzijtum el ol ach kolchaj yuj Dios t'a tas ay smay. Manh ol ach scha ak'jok ganar yuj junok tas sjawi t'a ib'anh.
T'a stiempoal wejel ol ach kolchaj yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ayik ay owal, hanheja' ol ach kolanpaxok.
Ha Dios ol ach kolan t'a tas syal heb' alum pekal. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik sjawi yalnhej tas t'a ib'anh.
Ayik ol jawok wejel, ma owal, tonhej ol ach tzewajok. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik ol jawok nok' chium nok'.
Ha b'aj ol ach munlajok, malaj k'e'en k'e'en ol ach ixtanok. Ha nok' chium nok', malaj tas ol ach yutej nok'.
Ol ajxok jantak tastak t'a a pat. Ayik ol a b'isan nok' a molb'etzal nok' tz'akannhej yajek' nok'.
Tzijtum ol aj sb'isul inhtilal icha anh ank'ultak sk'ib' t'a sat lum lum.
Icham winak hachxo ol ach chamok, icha junok tob'anh ixim trigo k'anxo sjochchaji.
Ach Job, a tas kojtak a tzonh k'ayb'ani. Kojtak to icha chi' yaji, yuj chi' scham wal a b'eyk'olan juntzanh tik, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Tato smasanil in ya'elal yet' in kusk'olal tik, tz'echtaj t'a yol junok echlab',
tekan ek'to yalil t'a yichanh yarenail sti' ha' mar, yuj chi' ix in komon alej icha tik.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ichato ix och ch'apnaj sjul-lab' t'ayin, haxo svenenoal spukax t'a in niwanil. Toxo ix oymaj tas ay smay t'ayin yuj.
¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru tato ay yanh nok'? ¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' mam wakax tato ay tas sk'ux nok'?
¿Mach schi'an junok chib'il wa'il tato malaj yatz'amil? ¿Tokwal wach' sloji sakil nok' nholob' tato malaj yatz'amil?
Icha chib'il wa'il malaj yatz'amil, icha chi' tas tzin chi tiknaik swab'i. Manhxalaj in gana in wa'i.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios yak'an tas tzin k'an t'ay. Komonok syak' tas tzin nib'ej.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios chi' in sataneli, yik tzin lajwiel t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom swab' sya'il yuj in ya'elal yet' in kusk'olal tik, palta tzin te tzalaji, yujto swak'nhej och sley Dios yipok in k'o'ol, haton Dios Haxonhej Ochi.
Manhxalaj wip swab'i yik swak'an techaj in ya'elal tik, ¿tasxom yuj komon pitzan hinto?
¿Tokwal lajan stzatzil in niwanil tik icha k'e'en k'e'en? ¿Tokwal icha stzatzil k'e'en bronce stzatzil in b'ak'chil?
Maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a t'a yol wiko'. Manhxa junok mach skolwaj wet'ok.
Ha junok mach ayoch t'a sya'elal, wach'chom manhxa yelk'och Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ay, palta smoj wal tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol yuj heb' swach'k'o'ol.
Palta a ex tik ex wamigo, tonhej ix in he wach' juejeli. Lajan ex icha junok ha' eluma' stup t'a smelemal.
Ayik syak'an nhab' tat tz'aj sat ha' sb'eyi kalan ha' yet' k'e'en che'ew, ma yet' k'e'en sakb'akom.
Ayik tz'ulax k'e'en che'ew chi', stupem ha' eluma' chi', haxo yik tzowaj k'ak' stakjiem ha'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, sb'at heb' t'a titak b'e yik sayan ha' heb' yuk'ej, haxo tz'aji, satkanb'at heb' t'a lum takinh lu'um chi', hata' schamkan heb'.
Ha heb' b'eyum anima aj chonhab' Temán yet' heb' aj Sabá, say ha ha' heb' yojtaktaxon b'aj skani,
haxo yik sk'och heb' b'aj aytaxon ha' chi', takinhxo yet'tal ha', toxonhej stakkank'e sk'ol heb'.
Icha chi' heyaj t'ayin a ex tik, yujto ayik tzeyilanoch jantak in ya'elal tik, tonhej tzex xiwk'ei.
Palta a in tik, malaj tas tzin k'an t'ayex. Malaj tumin tzin k'an t'ayex yik tzin kolchaji.
¿Tokwal tzin k'an he kolwal yik tzin kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' jun ajk'ol t'ayin, ma t'a juntzanh heb' elk'um?
Hak'ek in k'ayb'ub'al, ol in cha wab' t'ayex. Ch'oxek och in mul chi' t'a in sat.
Malaj junok mach spatikanel junok pensar to wach', palta a ex tik, manhxa stzolal tas tzeyak'och t'a wib'anh.
Ha ex tik nab'anhej tzin he tumej, palta eyojtak to a slolonel junok mach ayoch t'a sya'elal, ay b'aj malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha ex tik, syal eyak'an he suerte t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' ob'iltak. Syalpax he chonhanel junok eyamigo.
Ochanhek k'elan t'a in sat, tato tonhej swesej.
Aktejek eyalan juntzanh chi' t'a in patik. Komonok tzeyojtakejeli to yel juntzanh swal tik.
Ha he na'ani to esalwum in. Ha he na'ani to manh wojtakok tas yel yet' tas manh yelok.
Ha onh anima kajan onh t'a sat lum tik, lajan wal kab'an sya'il icha junok soldado ma icha junok chekab' yaji.
Ha junok chekab', snib'ej elanhchamel sk'ik'b'i. Ha junok munlajwum, snib'ej elanhchamel scha stojol.
Icha chi' waj yet' in ya'elal tik, ujal swab' sya'il. Junjun ak'wal aynhejoch in kusk'olal.
Ayik tzin ek' jichan, te najat yek' ak'wal swab'i. Tzin tzaktzaj wek' b'alb'onok, max sakb'ilaj. Swalan icha tik: ¿Janik' ol in k'e wa'an? xin chi.
Majnakel in niwanil tik yuj nok' ha'ay. Takinh kechinak sat, slaj k'e tzililjok tz'elxi spojowal.
Ha in k 'inal elanhchamel tz'ek'i, icha yek' sjul-lab' heb' ch'alwum sjulek' t'a skal sch'al. Wan sk'och in k 'inal tik t'a slajwub', manhxa tas ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, nakoti, a jab' in k 'inal tik, lajan icha yik skik'an junelok kik'. Manhxa b'ak'inh tzalajk'olal ol in ajok.
Ha heb' anima tzin ilan tiknaik, manhxo ol in yil-laj heb'. Ol in satelok, manhxo ol in ilpaxlaj.
Icha yek' numumok asun satxikanemi, icha chi' tz'aj satxiem junok anima ayik sb'at mukchajkan t'a kampusante. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol jaxok, manhxa b'ak'inh ol yiloch heb' sk'ab'yok.
Yuj chi' max yal wem numan, yuj in ya'elal yet' in kusk'olal tik, ol walnhej tas swala'.
Mamin ¿tom lajan in icha nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar tzila', yuj chi' aynhejoch a sat t'ayin?
Ayik tzin na'ani, tekan wach' ol in way jab'ok t'a in ch'at, tope tz'och wa'an jab'ok in ya'elal tik yik tzin way jab'ok, xin chi.
Haxo juntzanh wayich xiwub'tak tzak' wila'', tzin a te xib'tani.
Más wach' tzin a b'inchamok, más wach' tzin cham t'a yichanh to pitzan in.
Maxtzak techaj wuj swab'i, nab'axonhej pitzan in. Manhxo in ixtej. Ha in k 'inal tik lajan icha yik skik'an junelok kik'.
¿Tas kelk'och a onh anima onh tik, yuj chi' tzonh ik'cha'anh? ¿Tas yuj tzach och ilk'olal ku'uj?
¿Tas yuj aynhejoch a chum t'ayonh t'a junjun k'u, tzonh ak'annhej prowal?
¿Tas yuj max ik'el jab'ok a sat t'ayin, yik syal in b'uk'anem jab'ok yal in ti'?
Ach Dios, Yilumal anima aji. Tato tz'och in mul, ¿tom tzab' sya'il yuj? ¿Tas yuj a t'ayin tzak'och ijan a jul-lab'? ¿Tom al wajoch t'ayach icha junok ikatz?
¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal in mul? ¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal tastak chukal ix in k'ulej? Toxo wal tzin b'atkan t'a yol lu'um. Ol in a sayek'i, manhxo ol in chax u'uj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
¿B'ak'inh ol aktej a lolon icha tik? Lajan a lolonel tik icha junok owal chakxuxum ik'.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, malaj b'ak'inh syixtejb'at tojolal, max yik'ek' smakb'en junok anima.
Tekan ix och smul heb' uninal chi' t'a Dios, yuj chi' ix ak'ji sya'elal heb' yuj t'a smojalil.
Ak' wal och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, tza k'anan t'ay to tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayach.
Tato wach' a pensar, tojolnhej tzutej a b'a. Ol ach skol Dios chi', ol yak'anxi masanil tastak iktaxon yaji.
Ha a b'eyumal t'a yalanhtaxo, manhxo ol yal slajb'an sb'a yet' jantak tas ol ajxok t'ayach.
k'anb'ejek' ab'i tas ek'nak heb' anima t'a peka', tza k'ayb'an sjelanil heb' chi'.
Ha onh tik ichato ewi onh alji, malaj jab'ok tas kojtak. Ha ko k 'inal t'a sat lum tik lajan icha yek' junok enhul.
Ha heb' anima t'a peka', jantak tas b'aj syal ach sk'ayb'ankan heb'.
Ha te' junco yet' te' papiro, anhej b'aj ay ha ha' sk'ib' te'.
Te ya'ax te', palta tato stup ha', b'ab'el stakjixiel te' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo te te'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj heb' sk'ulan chukal, haton heb' sb'atkan Dios satk'olal yuj, maxtzak elk'och tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb'.
Ha tas komon ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chi', lajan wal icha ch'alxim.
K'inalok ay mach tz'och yub'naj t'a ch'alxim chi', malaj jab'ok yip. K'inalok tzonh kan t'unhnaj t'ay, max techajlaj yuj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan wal heb' icha sat anh ank'ultak tz'el tziknaj yuj yok k'u, spukaxkanb'at t'a skaltak awb'en,
sb'atkan t'a slot'iltak k'e'en k'e'en, slaj k'ib' anh, sb'at anh t'a yib'anhtak k'e'en.
Palta tato ay mach stok'ank'eta anh, manhxa mach ojtannak tato ek'nak anh ta'.
Icha chi' tz'aj slajwiel anh, ch'okxo junokxo ank'ultak sk'ib' b'aj tok'b'ilk'eta anh chi'.
Ha Dios, max aktajkan junok mach wach' spensar yuj. Max kolwajlaj t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tato tza na a b'a, ha' ol ach ak'anxi tzewajok, ol yak'anxi a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo pax heb' ajk'o'ol, ol k'ixwokkan heb'. Ha spat heb' chuk spensar chi', ol lajwokelok, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Wojtak wal sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji. Palta, ¿tok ay junok onh syal kalanoch ko b'a wach'il t'a yichanh Dios?
K'inalok sko telaj ko b'a yet'ok, malaj am junok tas syal ko pakan t'ay t'a milok tas sk'anb'ej t'ayonh.
Ha Dios te niwan sjelanil yet' spoder. K'inalok sko tek'b'ej ko b'a t'a yichanh, ¿tokwal stechaj ku'uj?
Ha yuj yowal sk'ol Dios tz'ib'xik'e lum niwak witz, tz'el lum k'akap, malaj mach ojtannak tato tzuji juntzanh chi'.
Ayik stzikub'tanhan lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, tz'ib'xi sb'akhnub'al lu'um.
Ha Dios chi' syal yalan t'a k'u to max jawilaj, syalanpax t'a k'e'en k'anal to max yak'laj yok k'e'en.
Malaj junok mach ix kolwaj yet'ok ayik ix yak'anb'at jenhan satcha'anh. Hanheja' pax stek'anem sat ha' mar yik sk'e chulnaj ha'.
A' ixb'o'an juntzanh k'e'en k'anal skuch niwan Osa, k'e'en Oxt'ilanh, k'e'en Mootz yet' juntzanhxo k'e'en yaman yaji scheklaj t'a stojolal sur.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok tastak satub'tak sk'ulej. Ha juntzanh chi' malaj junok mach syal snachajel yuj.
Tato tzek' Dios t'a ko tz'ey, max yal-laj kilani. Tato tzek' t'a chi' ¿tok snachajel wu'uj?
Tato ay tas syik'ek' t'a junok mach, ¿mach syal skachanoch wa'an? ¿mach syal sk'anb'an t'ay tas sk'ulej?
Tato skot yowal sk'ol Dios chi', max yal yoch wa'an t'a ichnhej ta'. Ha heb' ayoch yet' Rahab ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.
Yuj chi', ¿tas lolonel syal walani yik tzin pakan t'a Dios?
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta max yal-laj in tak'wi t'ay. In juezal yaji, tzin k'anan yok'elk'olal t'ayin.
K'inalok swawtej Dios chi' b'aj tzin ch'olb'itaji, wach'chom sk'ochi, palta ¿tokwal ol scha yab' tas swala'?
Haxo tz'aji, tzam in yak' lajwok yet' junok ik'nhab' te ow, swach' niwtaj in ya'elal tik t'a ichnhej ta'.
Maxtzak xom yal wik'an wip junok rato. Tzam te wach' niwtaj in ya'elal tik yuj.
K'inalok swak' pural Dios chi' yik sb'o'an icha tzin nib'ej, max yal-laj yujto haton Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. K'inalok swawtej t'a yichanh heb' juez, ¿mach syal yak'an pural sk'ochi?
K'inalok swala' te wach' in, haxo in lolonel sch'oxaneli to ay in paltail. K'inalok swala' to malaj jab'ok in paltail chi', axom Dios tz'alani to manh yelok.
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, palta malaj welk'och t'a yol in sat, maxtzak yal in k'ol pitzan in.
Ha in na'ani, lajanxonhej smasanil. Ha Dios chi' satanel heb' ay smul yet' heb' malaj smul.
K'inalok sjawi chamel t'a yib'anh masanil anima, malaj tas sna Dios chi' ayik slajwiel anima malaj smul.
Skan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk yuj, smakchaj sat heb' juez yuj. Tato manhok Dios sk'ulani, ¿mach sk'ulan jun?
Elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal, malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal swila'.
Lajan wal sb'ey in k 'inal tik icha sb'ey junok te' balso t'a sat ha ha', haton te' b'ob'il yet' te' papiro. Lajan pax icha sb'at xumumok nok' ch'akb'a yik syaman schib'ej nok'.
K'inalok sb'atkan in ya'elal tik satk'olal wu'uj, tzalajk'olal am tzin ajkani.
Palta masanil in ya'elal tik tonhej tzin somchajel yuj, yujto wojtak to max in yal Dios wach'il.
Tato ay in mul yalani, nab'anhej swak' wip walani to wach' in.
Wach'chom tzin b'ik in k'ab' yet' nok' xapon, ma yet' yal ta'anh,
palta ha Dios tzin yak'nhejem t'a skal ha ha' sok'omtak, haxo in pichul sk'ixwi wu'uj.
Max yal in pakan in b'a t'a Dios icha t'a junok komon anima. Max yal walani to syal in b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh heb' juez.
Komonok ay junok mach syal yak'an wil-laj in b'a yet'ok, syalan tas tzonh aj ko chawanhil.
Oktom ay junok mach syal yalan t'ay yik tz'och wa'an yak'anoch in ya'elal, tz'och wa'an in xib'tani.
Tato icha chi', maxtzak am in xiw in loloni, yujto malaj in mul icha eyalan tik.
Manhxa in gana pitzan in. Ol wak' cheklaj in ya'elal tik, ol in lolon yet' in k'ak'alk'olal.
Swal t'a Dios, manh tonhejok tzak'och in mul t'a wib'anh, al t'ayin b'aj ix och in mul chi'.
Ina a ach in a b'onak, ¿tom wach' tzab'i tzin a chakkaneli? Chuk tz'alji t'ayin, haxo yet' tas sna heb' chuk spensar tzach ochi.
¿Tom lajan ilan icha kilan a onh anima onh tik?
¿Tom lajan a k 'inal icha jab' kik a onh chamelb'a anima onh tik?
Yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tza say walek' in mul yet' in paltail?
Wach'chom ojtak to malaj in mul, malaj junok mach syal in skolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ha ach wal ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik tza nib'ej tzin a sateli.
Nakoti to t'a lum lum ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik, tzin ak'anxikanoch pokokal.
Ix a b'o in niwanil tik icha tz'aj sb'o nok' queso ayik spajb'i nok' lech.
Ha ach ix ak' syamlaj sb'a in b'akil yet' in ch'anhal. Ix ak'anoch in b'ak'chil yet' in tz'umal t'a spatik.
Ix ak' in k 'inal, ix in a xajanani. Ix in a tanhwej, yuj chi' pitzan in.
Palta haxo tiknaik jun, snachajel wu'uj to ay tas k'ub'eltak tza na' t'a in patik.
Wan in hilani tato tz'och in mul, max in ak' niwank'olal jab'ok yuj in mul chi'.
Tato ay in mul, ob'iltak in. Tato malaj in mul, palta max yal woch t'a ichanh t'a junk'olal, yujto tzin k'ixwi, tzin na'ankot in ya'elal.
Tato swik'cha'anh in b'a, satub'tak am tzutej in a sataneli. Icham syutej nok' choj spechan junok nok' yik schi'a, icha chi' am tzin utej.
Tza say juntzanh testigo t'a in patik. Tzak' wal kot owal t'ayin, icha skot nhilnaj heb' soldado yak'an owal.
¿Tas yuj in a chanak aljok? Komonok ayik manto in aljok ix in chamkani, yik malaj mach iljinak in.
Komonok ayik waljinak t'a in nun, wik'chajnakb'at t'a kampusante, ichato malaj mach cheklajnak.
Yakb'an to jab'nhej in k 'inal tik, elok t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in junk'olal. Elok t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in tzalajk'olal,
yik manto in b'at t'a chamub' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal b'aj maxtzak yal in paxta. Ha t'a jun lugar chi', wewentak yilji, k'ik' k'inal xonhej, manhxalaj jab'ok sakil k'inal, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Zofar aj Naamat t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha juntzanh a komon lolonel tik smoj wal spakji t'ayach. Manh yujok to tzach te loloni, scheklaji to wach' ach.
Ha a na'ani yujto tzach te loloni manhxa tas skala'. Ha a na'ani to manhxalaj mach syal spakan juntzanh a b'uchwal lolonel tik.
Ha ach tik tzala' to wach' ach t'a yichanh Dios, tzaloch a b'a wach'il.
Komonok slolon Dios spakan juntzanh tzal chi',
sch'oxan sjelanil t'ayach k'ub'eltak yaji, haton juntzanh max yal snachajeli. Ichato chi' ol hilani to mantzak yak' a ya'elal Dios icha wal smoj a cha'ani.
¿Am a na'ani to ol ojtakej wal el sjelanil Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, haton juntzanh k'ub'eltak yaji?
¿Tas wal ol aj ojtakanel jun jelanil chi'? Yujto ek'b'al te cha'anh yajk'e icha yajk'e satcha'anh tik. Te ek'b'al jul yajem t'a yichanh b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Te ek'b'al t'a yichanh lum lum tik. Te lewan sat t'a yichanh ha' mar.
Tato ha Dios tzach awtani yik tzach sch'olb'itej, ¿mach junok syal skachanoch wa'an?
Yojtak heb' esalwum, hanheja' syil jantak chukal, ¿mato tza na' to manh yojtakok Dios chi'?
¿Tokwal syal yalji junok nok' b'uru icha spensar junok anima? Icha chi' junok mach malaj spensar, ¿tokwal ol yal sjawi spensar?
Tato tza tojolb'itej a pensar, al a ya'elal t'a Dios.
Aktejkan a k'ulan chukal yet' juntzanh tas tza k'ulej t'a elk'altak.
Tato icha chi', wach' ilji t'a sat Dios, manhxalaj b'aj ol ach k'ixwok. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajok, manhxa b'aj ol ach xiwok,
haxo sat a k'ol t'a a ya'elal ix ek' tik. Icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi, icha chi' ol aj sat t'a a k'o'ol.
Wach'chom ix ach kan t'a k'ik' k'inal yuj a ya'elal tik, palta haxo tiknaik ichato ol sakb'okpaxel t'a ib'anh icha t'a k'inhib'alil. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajxok, ichato chimk'uhalil b'aj ayach ek'i.
Junk'olal ol ach ajxok, yujto ay tas ayoch yipok a k'o'ol. Ha Dios ol ach tanhwanok, junk'olal ol ach wayok.
Ol ik' ip, malaj tas ol ach xib'tanok. Tzijtum mach ol jawok ach sayek'i, wach' ol ach aj yet' heb'.
Haxo heb' chuk spensar, olto skomon sayej heb' b'aj skolchaji, palta nab'axonhej. Manhxo ol ilchaj b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb', haxonhej chamel ol yak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix spakanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha wal swab'ani to a exxonhej eyojtak masanil tas t'a skal masanil anima. Ayik ol ex chamok, tekan ol satkanel jelanil.
Palta a in pax tik ay pax in pensar, mato yelxo wal malaj jab'ok tas wojtak t'a eyichanh he na'ani, ¿mach wal junok manh ojtannakok juntzanh tik?
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, ma in paltail, wach'chom ix yab' Dios in tewi t'a yalanhtaxo, haxo tiknaik toxonhej tzin tzetzaji.
Ha ex malaj jab'ok tas tzex ik'an tik, tzex te b'uchwaj t'ayin. Lajan ex icha junok mach swach' ekan telwok junok mach wanxo stelwi.
Ha heb' elk'um, tzalajk'olal yaj heb' t'a yol spat. Ha heb' tz'alan chuk t'a Dios, junk'olal yaj heb'. Ha sna'an heb' to malaj tas ol utaj heb' yuj.
k'anb'ejek t'a nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a nok' sjenhwi, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok'.
k'anb'ejekpax t'a nok' tzek' nhernhon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok' t'a jelanil.
Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', yojtak nok' to a tas tzuji a Jehová tz'ak'ankoti.
Ha t'a yol sk'ab' ay sk'inal masanil tastak pitzan, syak'an yik' yik' heb' anima.
Ha yol ko ti' tz'ab'lan swach'il tas skab'lej. Ha pax ko chikin tz'ab'an tas tz'alchaji.
Ha heb' ichamtak winak, ayxo spensar heb', yujto tzijtumxo ab'il syil heb', yuj chi' ay spensar heb'.
Palta ha Dios toxonton jelan, syal yuj smasanil.
Ha tas satel Dios, manhxa junok mach syal sb'oanxi. Ha junok mach syamchajoch wa'an yuj Dios, manhxa junok mach skolani.
Tato ha' syamanoch wa'an nhab', stakjiel masanil tastak t'a sat lu'um tik. Tato syak'paxkot nhab', sb'at ha' t'a yalanh lu'um.
Ha Dios ay spoder, jelan toni, tz'elnhejk'och yuj. A' t'a yol sk'ab' ayek' heb' smusan sat heb' anima yet' pax heb' tz'ak'ji musansatil chi'.
A' tz'ak'an satel spensar heb' jelan. Haxo heb' juez somchajkank'e spensar heb' yuj.
A' tz'ik'anel heb' rey t'a yopisio, syak'an ik'jokb'at heb' t'a preso t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, b'eranel heb' sb'atkan heb'.
A' tz'ak'an kistalax heb' sacerdote. A' tz'ak'an ak'jok ganar heb' niwak yopisio.
Ha heb' ak'um razón yipk'olal yaji, manhxalaj tas syal yalan heb'. Ha heb' ayoch yopisio sch'olb'itan heb' anima, tz'ik'jiek' sjelanil heb' yuj.
A' tz'ak'an patikajkanel heb' niwak yelk'och t'a heb' anima. Haxo heb' te tek'an, tz'elkan yip heb' yuj.
Syak'an ojtakajel tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Syak'an cheklaj tas manh ojtakab'ilok.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ik'ancha'anh juntzanh niwak chonhab', hanheja' satanpaxeli. Ha saklemanb'at heb' anima, hanheja' smolb'anxi heb'.
Ha tz'ik'anek' sjelanil heb' yajalil junok chonhab', yuj chi' ichato satkanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lum b'aj manhxalaj b'e.
Toxonhej machmon yek' heb' icha t'a k'ik' k'inal. Toxonhej sketkonek' heb' icha heb' uk'um anh.
Masanil juntzanh tik ix wil wal yet' in sat, ix wab' wal yet' in chikin.
Ha tas eyojtak a ex tik, wojtakpaxi, mantok yelxo wal emnakil waj t'ayex.
Palta tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin nib'ej tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok.
Ha ex tik, yuj eyesalwumal tze k'ub'anel tas yel. Lajan ex yet' heb' anhtum malaj wach' yochi.
Komonok numan tzex aji, yik icha chi' scheklaji to jelan ex.
Maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ol wal tas nab'il wu'uj.
¿Am he na'ani to ol ex kolwaj t'a Dios yuj eyesalwumal chi'? ¿Am he na'ani to ay tas ol yik' t'a he ak'oj musansatil chi'?
Tze nib'ej tzeyak'och he b'a yet' Dios, tze kolan he na'ani.
Palta k'inalok tzex ch'olb'itaj yuj Dios chi', ¿tas tzex aj he na'ani? ¿Tzam yal eyak'an musansatil, icha tzeyutej junok anima?
Tato tze komon ak'ejoch he b'a yet' Dios he na'ani, ol ex stumej sik'lab'il.
Ha wal smay ol ik'an he xiwi, mato syal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a yichanh he na'ani.
Ha juntzanh peka' k'ayb'ub'al tzeyala', malaj yelk'ochi, lajan icha junok muro nab'a lu'um skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Haxo tiknaik, tz'inek xe chi to ol in lolonok, taxonhej skot t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wal tik.
Wach'chom skotxonhej t'a wib'anh, palta ol walnhej.
Wach'chom yuj chi' tzin smilcham Dios, palta ol wak'nhejoch yipok in k'o'ol. Ol in kolnhej in b'a t'a yichanh.
Talaj hata' ay in kolnab'il, yujto a junok mach chuk max stek'b'ej sb'a yoch t'a yichanh Dios.
Maklejek wal eyab' tas ol aj walani.
Toxo ix in na' tas ol wutej in kolan in b'a, wojtak to wach' ol in elk'ochok.
Tato ay mach sch'oxaneli to ay in mul, syal woch wa'an walani masanto tzin chami.
Ach in Diosal, chab'nhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach, icha chi' syal in k'och t'a ichanh.
Aktejxo ak'anoch in ya'elal tik, manhxo in a xib'tej yet' tas ay smay.
Awtej in, ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ma jun, tzin b'ab'laj loloni, tzach tak'wi t'ayin.
Al t'ayin, ¿b'ajtil ix och in mul, ma in paltail? ¿B'ajtil ay b'aj ix in ek' t'a yib'anh chi'?
¿Tas yuj tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj icha junok ajk'ol tzin utej?
Lajan in icha junok xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', ma icha anh takinh ak. ¿Tas yuj tzak' owal wet'ok, tza nib'ej tzin a sateli?
Te ya tzal t'ayin swab'i. Tza k'anb'an t'ayin tastak in mul yiktax in kelemal.
Ichato ix ak'och k'e'en cadena t'a wok, k'elan achnhej ochi b'aj tz'em wok.
Yuj chi' wanxo in k'ab'at icha junok tas sk'ai, ma icha junok pichul ijtakxo.
Ha onh anima onh tik tzonh alji t'a ko nun, jab'nhej tiempo skila', skalnhej ya'elal tzonh ek'i.
Lajan ko k 'inal tik icha junok anh xumak wanto spojeli, elanhchamel stakjipaxi. Lajan pax icha tz'aj satxikanem junok enhul.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj tzak' wal och a sat t'ayin to anima innhej? ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza ch'olb'itej junok tas malaj yelk'ochi?
¿Tok ay mach syal yik'anel tas wach' t'a skal tas manh wach'ok?
Ha ach tik tzala' jantak tiempo syil junjun anima. Chekel yaji jaye' sb'isul k'uhal skila', max yal yek' jayeokxo k'uhal u'uj.
Ik'el a sat t'ayin yik tzin kan t'a junk'olal. Ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ol icha stzalajb'i sk'ol heb' munlajwum, ayik slajwi smunlaj heb'.
Ayik sch'akjiel junok te te', skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol to ol ja swol te', haxo te swol chi' sk'ib'xi.
Wach'chom te ichamxo te' sch'anhal yib' chi', wach'chom wanxo sk'ab'at te' yib',
haxo yik tz'emk'och sikal ha ha' t'a te', syaxb'ixi te', swolanxi te' icha junok te' yuneto tz'awchaji.
Ha onhxo pax anima onh tik, ayik tzonh chami, manhxa tas syal ku'uj. Ayik tz'el ko pixan, manhxalaj mach tzonh hilani.
Icha tz'aj sk'e wa'an xob'al ha' mar, ma icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi,
icha chi' tz'aj ko cham a onh anima onh tik. Yakb'an aytoek' satcha'anh tik, malaj wal junok chamnak anima ol komon pitzwok b'aj mukan, malaj junok ol komon k'e wa'an t'a yet'tal chi'.
Komonok tzin a k'ub'ejel t'a chamel chi', yakb'an tzek'b'at yowal a k'o'ol. Tza na'anpaxi b'ak'inh tzin a naxikoti.
Ha junok anima schami, ¿tom ol pitzwokxi? Palta a inxo tik ol wak' techaj in ya'elal tik, masanto ol k'och sk'uhal wel t'a libre.
Ol ach awaj t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol am ach tzalaj in ilanochi, yujto a ach a b'onak in.
Ha tiknaik, k'elan ach och t'a in b'eyb'al. Haxo t'a jun k'uhal chi', manhxo ol ik' a cuenta t'a in mul.
Ol b'atkan in chukal chi' satk'olal u'uj. Ol ak'an lajwok in mul.
Ha lum niwak witz ayik tz'elta lum k'akapil, satem lu'um, haxo k'e'en niwak k'e'en tz'el k'e'en t'a yet'tal.
Hanhejtona' icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'e'en k'e'en t'a yol sb'e ha ha', ma icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at lum lum yuj ha', icha chi' tz'aj ak'an lajwok tas ayoch yipok ko k'o'ol a onh anima onh tik.
Ha ach te ek'b'al achnhej t'a kichanh, tzonh ik'anxi meltzaj t'a junelnhej, tzak'an ixtax ko sat yik tzonh chami.
Wach'chom a heb' kalkuninal te b'inajnak ol aj heb', mato ay heb' manhxalaj ol aj yelk'ochi, palta manhxo kojtakok, manhxalaj mach ol yal yalan kab'i.
K'inalok chamnak onhxo, haxonhej am ku'uj skak' pensar, yujto skab'wal sya'il, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
Ha mach jelan, manh smojok stak'wi t'a komon lolonel, manh smojok pax syik'cha'anh sb'a syalan tas tonhej sb'at yuj ik'.
Manh tonhejok skomon loloni, max sk'anlaj komon pensar.
Ach Job, tzala' to malaj yelk'och xiwk'olal t'a Dios, malaj pax yelk'och ejmelal t'ayach.
Ha yuj tas tzala' a sch'oxanel a mul. Tza nib'ej tza musej ko sat yet' sjelanilal a pensar chi'.
Manh a na' to a in ol walk'eta a mul, a yuj tas tzala' tzik'kot t'a ib'anh.
¿Tom a a na'ani to a ach b'ab'el b'ob'il ach? ¿Tom ayachxo ayik ix laj b'oji lum niwak witz?
¿Tom tz'eyanoch a chikin ayik ix sna'an Dios tas ol sk'ulej? ¿Tokwal a achnhej jelan ach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik?
Masanil tas ojtak, kojtak pax a onh tik.
Ha ko jelanil, ix ko k'ayb'ej t'a heb' ichamtak winak sakxo xil sjolom, haton heb' ichamtak winak t'a yichanh winh a mam.
Ha Dios snib'ej syak' sniwanil a k'ol yet' lolonel k'ununi skal t'ayach, ¿tas yuj max a cha ab'i?
¿Tas yuj tzik'el a b'a t'a Dios, tz'elwalkot jinhjinh yol a sat skot owal?
¿Tas yuj skot wal owal t'a Dios, komonxonhej tzal juntzanh lolonel?
¿Tok ay junok anima wach'nhej to malaj jab'ok smul?
Inatax heb' ángel, manh ayokoch heb' yipok sk'ol Dios yet' pax satcha'anh, manh wal yelxo wach'ok t'a yol sat.
Okxo wal a onh anima onh tik yajb'entak onh. Icha ko komon uk'an ha ha', icha chi' ko k'ulan chukal chi'.
Ach Job, komonok tza maklej ab' tas ol wala'. Ha jab'ok tas wojtak, ha' ol wala'.
Ha heb' aj pensar, a heb' ix onh k'ayb'ani. Ha tas yojtak heb' chi' sk'ayb'ejnakkan heb' t'a heb' smam yicham.
Haton t'a heb' smam yicham heb' chi' ak'b'il lum lum tik, manh skalejnakok sb'a heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha heb' anima chuk sb'eyb'al, tzapan sk'inal heb', skalnhej ya'elal tzek' heb'.
Ayik syab'an heb' sk'anh junok tas, xiwk'e heb'. Haxo yik malaj tas sna heb', sjawi heb' elk'um, syelk'anb'at heb' tas ay t'a heb'.
Manhxa tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' yik skolchaj heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Ayxo och ijan k'e'en kuchilub' t'a heb' yik scham heb'.
Haxo sniwanil heb' ol chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok. Yojtak heb' to a tas ol kot t'a yib'anh heb', manh ol ek'laj.
Ha ya'elal yet' ilk'olal ol ak'an xiwk'e heb', icha tz'aj ko xiwk'e t'a yichanh junok yajal sjawi yak' owal t'ayonh.
Icha chi' tz'aj sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh.
Ichato yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', sb'at lemnaj heb' yak' owal yet' Dios.
Te b'ak'ech sat heb' yet' sniwanil,
yujto yak'nak ganar juntzanh chonhab' heb', yikannakkan juntzanh pat heb' manhxalaj yajal, palta ol lajwokel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' juntzanh pat chi' yuj owal.
Manh najtilok ol ek' heb' yet' sb'eyumal. Ol satel heb' icha yek' swewenal asun.
Manhxo ol yal skolanel sb'a heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' k'ab' te' stz'a yuj k'ak', ma icha junok te te' tz'el xumakil yuj ik'.
Mokab' yak'och tas chuklaj heb' yipok sk'o'ol, yujto a spak ol scha heb' haton ya'elal.
Ol pet cham heb', icha junok te' k'ab'te' stzepjiel t'a snunal maxtzak yaxb'i.
Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok ib' te' uwa tz'el b'ulnaj sat ayik manto k'inhb'i, ma icha junok te' olivo tonhej sk'ajb'anel xumakil.
Ha heb' chuk chi', malaj yinhtilal heb' ol elkanok. Ha jantak sb'eyumal heb' ix yik' t'a elk'altak, tonhej ol tz'akanb'atok.
Haton heb' anhej chukal nab'il yuj, anhej ixtoj anima na'an yuj heb', xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ayxo skajwi in te ab'an juntzanh lolonel tzeyalub'tanhej tik. Tzeyak'och he b'a eyak'an sniwanil in k'o'ol, palta anhej ya'elal tze wach' ik'ejkot t'a wib'anh.
¿Tom malaj slajwub' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? ¿Tas eyaji yuj chi' anhej wal ha' he pakan t'ayin?
K'inalok a ex tik icha wal waj tik eyaji, max am wal-laj icha tzeyutej eyalan tik t'ayin, max am in tzikub'tanhej in sat walan jantak lolonel t'ayex.
Palta jun, a am lolonel wach' syak' sniwanil he k'o'ol, syak' he tek'anil, a am swal t'ayex.
Manh yujok to tzin loloni, tz'och wa'an in ya'elal tik, manh yujok pax to tzin em numan tz'ochpax wa'an.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an lajwokel wip. Ha pax tz'ik'anel heb' wamigo t'ayin.
Ichato preso waj yuj. Jantak tas syik'cha'anh heb' anima t'a in patik, jantak es lolonel syik'kot heb' t'a wib'anh.
Ha Dios tzak'anoch wu'uj yik tzin sataneli, icha junok nok' chium nok'. Ay wal och sat t'ayin, icha wal to wajk'o'ol yaji.
Jantak heb' anima smolb'ej sb'a yik tzin sb'uchan heb'. Stz'itanb'at in sat heb', emnakil tzin yutejkan heb'.
Ha Dios ix in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima te chuk spensar.
Junk'olal wajek'i, ix in swekchitani. Ix och yub'naj t'a in jaj, chok' ix in yutej, ix in yak'anoch t'a sat sjul-lab'.
Yalnhej b'aj sjawi sjul-lab' chi' t'ayin, ichato sk'axpaj t'a in niwanil tik, manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal t'ayin. Toxonhej spukkanb'at yol in k'ol t'a sat lu'um.
Jantak in aj in lajwi yuj. Skot wal t'ayin icha junok soldado te tek'an.
Te kusk'olal waji, ayoch pichul ya swa wu'uj, manhxa jab'ok wopisio.
Ste mal in sat wok'i, sk'ik'b'i k 'inal swila'.
Icha chi' waji, wach'chom malaj mach b'aj ix och in mul, wach'nhej in lesal.
Mokab' k'ub'chajel jantak chukal ix ak'jioch t'a wib'anh. Ab'chajokab'i ayik tzin tewi yik tzin k'anan tojolal.
Ay jun ayoch in testigook ayek' t'a satcha'anh, ha' ol och wet'ok.
Ha heb' wamigo tonhej tzin sb'uch heb', a inxo tik tzin ok'nhej t'a yichanh Dios.
Ayok wal junok mach tz'alan t'a Dios wu'uj, icha syutej junok mach skolan junok yetanimail.
Jayexonhej ab'il ayin ek'i, haxo in b'at t'a chamel chi' b'aj maxtzak yal ko paxta.
Jab'xonhej wal syal wik'an wik' swab'i. Wanxo sk'och in k 'inal t'a slajwub', wach'xo yaj wet'tal t'a kampusante.
Ha heb' anima, oyanoch heb' in sb'uchani, masanil tiempo syak' kus in k'ol heb', maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a t'a heb'.
Palta Mamin kolin, yujto malaj junokxo mach syak'och sb'a in skolani, a achnhej syal u'uj.
Ha ach ix a k'ub'ejel jelanil t'a juntzanh heb' winh wamigo tik, manh in a cha ak'jok ganar yuj heb' winh.
Elokab'k'och icha syal jun ab'ix: Ha junok mach syixtej junok yamigo, haxo yuninal ol ab'an sya'il yuj jun tas sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ach ix ak' yal chuk heb' anima t'ayin, ix laj stzub'an in sat heb'.
Toxonhej k'ik'aminak wilan yuj in ya'elal. Ichato manh chekelok in niwanil tik, yujto ix in te b'akb'i.
Ayik syilan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al tas tzin ik'an tik, sat sk'ol heb', skot yowal heb', yujto chuk in sna'an heb'.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, wach'nhej ol elk'och heb'. Ha heb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, ol k'enhejcha'anh heb'.
Palta kotanhek t'a tik ex wamigo. Malaj junok aj pensar tz'ilchaj wuj t'a he kal.
B'elb'on yek' in k 'inal, haxo tas nab'il wu'uj, ma tas tzin nib'ej, toxo ix juwieli.
Ha ex tik a t'ak'walil tzeyaloch k'uhalil, haxo yik k'ik'k 'inal, tzeyalani, lak'anxo ay sakil k'inal.
Toxonhej tzin tanhwej in chami, yik sk'och telan in niwanil sway t'a kal k'ik' k'inal.
Ha nok' ha'ay yet' kampusante swaloch in mam in nunok yet' wanab'ok.
¿B'ajtil ay tas swak'och yipok in k'o'ol? ¿Ay am mach ojtannak tas ol in ajok?
¿Tom ol k'och jun chi' wet' t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak? ¿Tom ol kannhej wet' ta' t'a yol lum lum chi'? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad icha tik:
¿B'ak'inh wal ol aktej a loloni? Nachajokab' u'uj, ichato pax chi' syal ko loloni.
¿Tas yuj tzonh al nok'al, manhxa jab'ok kelk'och t'a a sat?
¿Tas yuj tza chalchitej a b'a yuj chichonk'olal? ¿Am a na'ani yujto icha chi' tzutej a b'a ol kan tzinan lum lum tik, ma ol k'exwok yet'tal k'e'en tenam?
Ha tas ayoch yipok sk'ol junok mach chuk spensar, ol tupemok, icha stup junok candil wanxo stup sk'ak'al.
Ol tup sk'ak'al scandil t'a yol spat, manhxa sakil k'inal ta'.
Maxtzak yal yek' yet' stek'anil, wan slokan sb'a yok, stelwi yuj tas nab'il yuj.
Ichato ol em junok ch'anh ya'al t'a yol sb'e, ol kan sut'naj t'a yol jun ch'anh ya'al chi'.
Ol em jun ch'anh ya'al chi' t'a yol sb'e. Ha t'a sjaj yok ol och sut'naj ch'anh.
k'ub'eltak yajem jun ya'al chi' t'a yol sb'e.
Aynhejoch xiwk'olal t'a spatik yichanh, ichato spechji b'eyek'ok.
Ay tas t'ay t'a peka', haxo tiknaik wan scham yuj wejel, a ya'elal k'elanxo och t'ay.
Ha jun ilya slajanel sniwanil, haxo sk'ab' yet' yok ichato ol k'uxjokb'at yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ol ik'jokel t'a skal junk'olal b'aj kajan, ol nherjokkanb'at t'a yichanh jun aj chamel.
Ch'okxo mach ol kajnajkan t'a skajnub'. Ayik toxo ix cham chi', ol tzikchajek' azufre t'a yol spat chi', yik satel jun yab'il chi'.
Lajan wal icha junok te te' takinhxo sch'anhal yib' yet' sk'ab'tak.
Ha sb'inajnakil ol satkanel t'a sat lu'um tik. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol b'inajok.
Ol ik'chajel t'a skal heb' pitzan b'aj sakk'inal. B'aj ay heb' chamnak t'a k'ik' k'inal ol yumjokkanb'atok.
Manhxa yinhtilal ol kan t'a schonhab' yet' b'aj kajan.
Ayik ol ab'chaj tas ix jawi t'a yib'anh, ol xiwkank'e heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u.
Icha wal chi' ol aj satel heb' chuk, haton heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
¿B'ak'inh wal ol eyaktej he tzuntzan owaj in ya'elal tik, tzeyak'an kus in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel tik?
Ayexnhejoch eyalan chukal lolonel t'ayin. ¿Tom max ex k'ixwi eyalan t'ayin?
K'inalok yel ay in mul chi', ¿tom tzeyab' sya'il yuj?
Tzeyik' wal cha'anh he b'a t'ayin yuj in ya'elal tik, tzeyalanoch t'a in sat to chuk in.
Palta komonok snachajel eyu'uj to ha Dios icha tik tzin utani. A' ix in ak'anem t'a yol jun ya'al tik.
Skomon el waw, swalan icha tik: Swab' wal in chami, xin chi. Palta malaj mach stak'wi t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej ay mach tzin kolani, palta malaj mach sb'o'an yaj t'ayin.
Ha Dios ix makan yol in b'e, yik maxtzak yal in b'eyek'i. Ichato t'a skal k'ik' k'inal tzin ek' yuj.
Ix yik'ek' in b'eyumal, ix yik'anek' sniwanil welk'ochi.
Ix in satem t'a junelnhej. Ha tas ayoch yipok in k'o'ol, pilan ix lajwiel icha junok te te' malaj sch'anhal yib'.
Ix sekkot yowal sk'o'ol t'a wib'anh, icha wal junok yajk'o'ol ix in yutej.
Masanil heb' soldado Dios chi' ix och hoyan t'ayin. Ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak in pat yik syak'an owal heb' wet'ok.
Ha Dios chi' ix ik'anel heb' wuk'tak yet' heb' wamigo t'a in tz'ey, ichaxonhej junok komon anima ix in yutejkan heb'.
Ha heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok yet' heb' wamigo, ix in yaktejkan heb', ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'.
Haxo heb' kajan t'a in pat yet' masanil heb' in chekab', icha junok ch'ok animail ix in ajkan t'a heb', maxtzak in yilochlaj heb'.
Tato swawtejkot junok heb' in chekab' chi', maxtzak tak'wilaj heb' t'ayin, wach'chom tzin tewi t'a heb'.
Ayik tzin k'och t'a stz'ey ix wetb'eyum, chuklaj sjab' xob'al in ti' syab' ix, haxo heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, tzin syajel heb'.
Icha pax chi' heb' unin tzin spatikejel heb'. Ayik syilan heb' wek'i sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Ha wal heb' ek'b'al te wach' wak'an yet'ok, tzin spatikejel heb'. Ha wal heb' tzin te tzalaj yet'ok, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Toxo ix takjioch in tz'umal yet' in b'ak'chil t'a in b'akil, tewelxonhej pitzan in.
Ex wamigo, ok'okab' he k'o'ol t'ayin, yujto ha Dios ix ak'ankot jun ya'elal tik t'a wib'anh.
¿Tas yuj tzak'anexnhej wu'uj, icha tzin yutej Dios? ¿Tom manh k'okb'ilokxo in eyak'an kusok?
Ayok wal mach stz'ib'ankan juntzanh in lolonel tik. Komonok tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Komonok a yet' k'e'en cincel nab'a hierro tz'ak'jikanoch t'a k'e'en k'e'en yik skan t'a junelnhej.
Wojtak to a in Kolumal pitzannhej, haxo t'a slajwub' k'uhal ol emul t'a sat lum tik yik tzin skolani.
Wach'chom slajwiel in tz'umal tik, palta ol wil wal och Dios yet' in niwanil tik.
Ha in wal lak'an ol wil wal och yet' in sat, manh ch'okok mach ol ilanok. Wanxo slajwik'och wip swab'i.
Ayik swab'an eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas wal skutej kak'an kus sk'ol winh, yujto munil a winh tz'ik'ankot sya'elal chi' t'a yib'anh? xe chi.
Palta xiwanhek t'a k'e'en espada, haton yowal sk'ol Dios syak'lab'ej t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ojtakejekeli to ay jun Dios tzonh ch'olb'itani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Zofar aj Naamat icha tik:
Ach Job, maxtzak yal-laj to tonhej numan tzin aji. Yuj chi' tzin nib'ej tzin tak'wi t'ayach.
Ix onh a b'uch wal yet' a chukal lolonel, palta wojtak tas ol aj in pakan t'ayach.
Ha ach tik ojtaktaxoni to atax yik ix te k'ib'cha'anh anima t'a sat lu'um tik,
a stzalajk'olal heb' chuk max najtilaxlaj. Junnhej rato syak' jab' stzalajk'olal heb' chi'.
Wach'chom te cha'anh yajk'e heb' icha scha'anhil satcha'anh, haxo sjolom heb' sk'ek'och b'aj ay asun,
palta ol lajwokem heb' icha stza' nok' nok', haxo heb' yamigo heb', manhxo ol nachaj yuj heb' b'aj ol k'ochkan heb' chuk chi'.
Ol satem heb' t'a ichnhej ta' icha junok wayich. Manhxalaj mach ol ilanoch heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ilantaxonoch heb' yet' heb' junnhej tzek' yet' heb', manhxa b'ak'inh ol iljokoch heb' yuj heb'.
Ha tas yelk'ejnak heb', haxo heb' yuninal heb' ol ak'an meltzaj t'a heb' meb'a' b'aj yelk'ejnak heb' chi'.
Ayik tek'an wal yip heb' t'a skelemal, ol emkan heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Wach'chom te wach' sk'ulan chukal heb' syab'i, ste tzalaj heb' yet'ok,
te chi' jun chukal chi' t'a heb',
haxo t'a yol sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch venenoal, icha svenenoal nok' chan.
Masanil sb'eyumal heb' ix sb'uk'emi, ol xejejxik'eta heb', yujto ha Dios ol ik'ank'eta t'a yol sk'ol heb' chi'.
Ichato ix stz'ub'b'at svenenoal nok' chan chi' heb'. Ha jun veneno chi' ol ik'an scham heb'.
Manhxo ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas ay t'ay, haton lech, nok' yal chab' to manhxa yalnab'il.
Masanil tas yik'nakek' heb', yowalil ol yak'xi meltzaj heb'. Manhxo ol yal yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' sb'eyumal chi'.
Ix te ixtaj heb' meb'a' yuj heb', manhxa jab'ok tas ix kan t'a heb'. Ha heb' chuk chi' ix makank'e yikok juntzanh pat to manhoklaj heb' b'ojinak.
Manhxa jab'ok tas ix kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Haxonhej heb' smakb'ej sb'a t'ay smasanil, palta manh najtilok ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet'ok.
Ayik tzijtum tas tz'aj t'a heb', tzijtum pax kusk'olal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha wal yik wan yak'an b'ut'jok sk'ol heb', syak'an snib'ej heb' yet' tastak ay t'ay, hata' ol sekkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato ol yak' ganar heb' yel t'a k'e'en espada nab'a hierro, haxo jul-lab' nab'a bronce ol ek' t'a heb'.
Ha jun jul-lab' chi' ol k'axpajek' t'a sniwanil heb'. Ol ek' t'a seyub' heb', ol elk'och t'a yich spatik heb'. Ol te xiwk'e heb' yuj jun chi'.
Ha k'ik' k'inal ol k'ub'anel tastak sik'an yuj heb'. Ha jun k'ak' max tupi, ha' ol nhusantz'a masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ha Dios ol ak'an cheklaj schukal heb'. Ol yalanpax heb' anima to ay smul heb'.
Ayik ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel masanil sb'eyumal heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik nab'il yuj Dios t'a yib'anh heb' chuk chi', wach'xo yajkan t'a yib'anh heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Maklejek wal eyab' tas swala', tato icha chi' ol eyak' sniwanil in k'o'ol.
Niwan tzeyutej he k'o'ol yakb'an tzin loloni. Slajwi in lolon chi' tzex b'uchwajxi t'ayin b'i'an.
¿Tokwal a yet' junok anima wan wak'an owal? ¿Tom manh smojok skus in k'o'ol he na'ani?
Ilineknab'i ol ex xiwb'atok, manhxalaj tas ol elta t'a he ti'.
Ayik tzin na'ankot juntzanh chi', tz'ib'xik'e in niwanil tik yuj xiwelal.
¿Tas yuj niwan tiempo syil heb' chuk? Sk'och heb' icham animail, sb'inaj wal heb'.
Tzato yil heb' sk'ib' yuninal, stzalaj pax heb' yoch hoyan heb' yixchikin t'a stz'ey.
Malaj tas xib'tan heb', junk'olalnhej yajek' heb'. Malaj sya'elal heb' tz'ak'ji yuj Dios.
Ha nok' smam swakax heb', wach'nhej yel yinhtilal nok'. Ayik stajni nok' snun swakax heb', max ek'laj yune' nok'.
Ha yalyuninal heb' sk'e cheneljok heb' icha sk'e tz'itiljok nok' yunetak chiwa.
Ayik syab'an heb' yoch sjajil yamk'ab' yik b'it, haton te' arpa, te' tanhb'il yet' te' spukhaji, sk'e cheneljok heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk chi', junk'olal tz'aj sb'atkan heb' b'aj smukchaji.
Syalan heb' t'a Dios: Manh onh a tzuntzej, max yal ko k'ol skojtakejel a cheknab'il.
¿Mach jun Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', yik tzonh och ejmelal t'ay? ¿Tas skak' yala' tzonh tewi t'ay? xchi heb'.
Ha sna'an heb' chuk chi' to yujnhej sjelanil heb' ay sb'eyumal heb'. Ha inxo tik max in cha wab' tas syal heb'.
¿Tom skomon cham heb' chuk icha tz'aj stup junok candil? ¿Tom skomon jawi ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'? ¿Tom skomon kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb' syab'an sya'il heb' yuj?
¿Tom skomon saklemb'at heb' icha anh ak tz'ik'jib'at yuj chakxuxum ik'?
Ha eyalani to hato heb' uninab'il stupan smul smam. Palta a in tik swala' to smoj a wal lak'an heb' stupan smul chi', yik syojtakejel heb' to yuj smul heb' icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' smojton scha'an ya'elal heb' sjawi t'a yib'anh yuj yowal sk'ol Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil.
Ayik toxo ix cham heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' yuj tas skotkan t'a yib'anh yuninal heb' chi'.
Palta, ¿mach syal sk'ayb'an Dios t'a jelanil? Anhejton wal Dios chi' sch'olb'itan heb' te niwak yelk'ochi.
Ay heb' wach'nhej tz'aj yek'i, tek'an wal yip heb' scham heb'.
Ay pax heb' jun, te kusk'olalnhej tz'aj yek' heb' scham heb', malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal syil heb'.
Palta jun, a b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak chi', lajannhej ol aj heb'. Junlajan ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ha'ay.
Wojtak tas tze na t'a in patik yet' he chuk pensaril.
Tze na'an icha tik: ¿B'ajtom ix kan spat jun winh chuk tik, jun winh yajalxo ix yutej sb'a tik? xe chi.
¿Tom malaj b'aj tzex lolon yet' heb' anima sb'eyek'i? ¿Tom maj eyab' tas syik'tiej heb'?
Ayik skot yowal sk'ol Dios, syak'ankot junok ya'elal, haxo heb' chuk malaj tas tz'ik'an heb'.
¿Mach tz'alanoch t'a sat heb' yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'? ¿Mach ol ak'an spak yuj tas sk'ulej heb' chi'?
Haxo sb'at mukchajkan heb', stanhwaj b'aj smukchaj heb' chi'.
Siklab'inak lum lum sb'atkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Jantak heb' mukb'ilxo ta', jantakto pax heb' ol mukjokpaxok.
¿Tas tz'aj eyak'an sniwanil in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? Nab'a es juntzanh tzeyal tik t'ayin, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
¿Tokwal ay tas ol yik' Dios t'a junok anima, wach'chom to aj pensar?
K'inalok te tojol tzutej a b'a, mato malaj a mul, ¿tom ay jab'ok tas ol yik' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'a a patik?
Manh yujok to tza k'anab'ajej, ma yuj a wach'il syak'an a kachnab'il yet' a ya'elal Dios chi'.
Palta yujto a wal a chukal yet' a mul chi' malaj slajwub'.
Ix a k'ankanek' spichul heb' meb'a' ayik ix ak'an tas sk'ex heb', wach'chom ix elkan b'eran heb'.
Wach'chom te b'inajnak ach, to ik masanil lum lum tik, palta maj ak' jab'ok ha' yuk'ej heb' ay stakinhtial, maj ak' pax wa heb' ay swejel.
Ix a chek meltzaj heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' t'a heb' ix. Ix ik'anek' tas aykan t'a heb' chamnak smam.
Yuj chi' tzoymaj chukal t'a a patik tiknaik, tzach somchajk'e yuj tas ay smay.
Ichato k'ik' k'inal yaj t'ayach, maxtzak yal ilan jab'ok. Icha wal to a junok ha' eluma' wan ach yik'anb'ati.
Ha Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, najat ayk'e t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'anal, syilemta masanil tastak tzuji.
¿Am a na'ani to max yil ko b'eyb'al? ¿Tom a k'ik'al asun tzach k'ub'anel t'ay?
¿Am a na'ani to yuj k'ik'al asun chi' max yil Dios, yakb'an wan sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'?
¿Tom tza tek'b'ejnhej a b'a a b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al heb' peka' anima chuk sb'eyb'al?
Pet chamnak heb' chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at junok mach yuj ha' eluma'.

Wach'chom ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil ix ak'an b'ut'jok spat heb' yuj masanil tastak, palta ix spatikejel Dios chi' heb'. Sna'an heb' to malaj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj. Mokab' in na icha sna heb' pit syutej sb'a chi'.
Ayik ol yilan heb' wach' spensar satel heb' chuk, ol tzalajk'e heb'. Haxo heb' malaj smul tonhej ol tzewaj heb' ol yalan heb' icha tik:
Ha heb' kajk'o'ol wan satel heb', wan stz'ab'at sb'eyumal heb', xcham heb'.
Ach Job, ochanhxi junk'olal yet' Dios, tato icha chi' wach' ol ach ajxiek'i.
Schaokab' a k'ol to ha Dios chi' tzach k'ayb'ani. Kanokab' wal slolonel t'a a pensar.
Tato tzik'em a b'a, tzak'anxioch a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', ol ach yik'xicha'anh. Tato najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a a pat,
tato manhxa yelk'och k'e'en oro jantak swach'il t'a yol a sat, ichaxonhej lum pokok, ma k'e'en komon k'e'en ay t'a yoltak ha ha' tz'ajkan k'e'en t'ayach,
tato icha chi' tzutej a b'a, ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi' ol och a b'eyumalok, icha jantak k'e'en oro, ma k'e'en plata.
Ol ach tzalaj yet'ok, ol ak'paxoch yipok a k'o'ol.
Tato ay tas ol a k'an t'ay, ol yab' tas ol ala', a hachxo ol ak'elk'och b'aj ix ak' a ti' t'ay.
Ha tastak ol a na'a, ol elk'och t'ayach, yujto a swach'k'olal Dios ol ochnhej het'ok.
Ha Dios tz'ik'anem heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, skolwaj t'a heb' emnakil syutej sb'a.
Hanheja' skolan heb' malaj smul, ol ach skol paxi tato malaj a mul, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha tiknaik hanheja' yel waw yuj in ya'elal tik. Wach'chom tzin te k'akwi, palta hanheja' yak'anoch in ya'elal Dios.
Komonok swojtakejeli b'ajtil tz'ilchaj Dios chi' wu'uj, tas pax tz'aj in k'och b'aj ay sdespacho.
Tato icha chi' tzam wal t'ay yuj in ya'elal tik, yujto tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ay yuj in kolan in b'a.
Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas ol yal t'ayin.
¿Tokwal ol yak'lab'ej yip yik tzin skachanem numnajok? Ma'ay, ol smaklej yab' tas ol wala'.
Ol am yojtakejeli to yel swala', ol am yalani to malaj in mul. Icham chi' ol aj in yak'anel t'a libre t'a junelnhej.
Tzin sayek' Dios t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, malaj ayek' ta'. Tzin saypaxek' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, max ilchajpaxlaj wuj ta'.
Tzin sayek' t'a stojolal norte, max ilchajlaj wu'uj. Hanhejtona', tzin sayanxi t'a stojolal sur, max sch'ox pax sb'a t'ayin ta'.
Palta yojtak in b'eyb'al. Ayik ol lajwok in yak'an prowal, wach'xonhej ol in ajkan icha k'e'en oro sb'o t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha jun b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan t'ayin, malaj b'ak'inh swaktejkan in b'eyb'alani.
Tzin k'anab'ajejnhej scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al. Ek'b'alxo yelk'och scheknab'il chi' t'a yichanh b'eyumal t'a yol in sat.
Ayik sna'an Dios sk'ulan junok tasi, sk'ulejnhej, malaj junok mach syal skachanoch wa'an.
Ha tas nab'il yuj sk'ulan t'ayin, sk'ulejnhej. Tzijtumto pax tas nab'il yuj t'a wib'anh.
Yuj wal chi' tzin te xiw t'ay. Anhej tzin na'ankoti tzin te xiwk'ei.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, yuj tz'el wip yuj xiwelal.
Wach'chom maxtzak wil-laj yuj k'ik' k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik, palta max in emlaj numan.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ¿tas yuj max yal sk'uhal ayik sch'olb'itani, yik wach' stanhwaj yuj heb' swach'k'ol chi' t'a jun k'u chi'?
Ha heb' chuk sk'ex stz'akanhil lum lum heb', syelk'an nok' kalnel heb', syak'anoch nok' heb' t'a skal nok' yiko'.
Syik'anek' nok' sb'uru heb' meb'a' chamnak smam heb', sk'anankan nok' swakax heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum yuj k'e'en tumin syak' heb' majanil.
Tz'ik'jikanel heb' meb'a' t'a yoltak b'e yuj heb'. Haxo heb' anima emnakil yek'i, sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a heb' chuk chi'.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi' lajan tz'ajkan heb' icha nok' kaltakte'al b'uru t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' say wa sb'a heb'. Ha t'a tzinan lum chi' say swa'el yalyuninal heb'.

Ha heb' meb'a' chi' sb'at heb' t'a smunlajel heb' ch'ok animail. Sb'at sik'k'e ixim jolom trigo heb', sb'at pax heb' t'a skal yawb'en uwa heb' chuk chi', sb'at heb' say te' sat tzato kani ayik smolji.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', malaj spichul heb' ayochi tzek' ak'wal. Malaj jab'ok tas spichan heb' t'a si'ik.
Ayik syak'an nhab', tzek'chaj ha' t'a heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en skol sb'a heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' syik'ek' snenetak unin heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum heb', yik skan t'a heb' yuj tas syak' heb' majanil t'a heb' ix.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', jab'tzin spichul heb' ayochi. Tz'ek' heb' kuchoj trigo, palta wan schampax heb' yuj wejel.
Smunlaj heb' yet' k'e'en molino tz'ik'anelta aceite. Stek'anel yal sat te' uwa heb', palta wan schampax heb' yuj takinhtial.
Haxo heb' ya yaji, tz'el yaw heb' sk'anan kolwal. Wan scham heb' t'a kal chonhab', palta max ab'chajlaj yel yaw heb' yuj Dios.
Ay heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun b'e yik sakil k'inal, max sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb'.
Ayik k'ik'to sk'e wa'an heb' mak'umcham anima, yik sb'at smak'ancham heb' meb'a' heb'. Haxo tzek' ak'wal, a elk'al syak' heb'.
Ha heb' tz'em ajmulal stanhwej heb' sk'ik'b'i, smakan sat heb'. Sna'an heb' icha tik: Malaj mach ol onh ilanochok, xchi heb'.
Ha heb' elk'um chi', a t'ak'walil tz'och heb' elk'al t'a te' pat. Haxo t'a k'uhalil makan heb', yujto max schalaj sk'ol sakil k'inal heb'.
Xiw heb' t'a sakil k'inal chi', haxo k'ik' k'inal stzalaj heb' yet'ok, yujto hata' xiw juntzanhxo anima.
Ha heb' chuk chi', elanhchamelnhej ol ek' heb' icha sb'ey swomal ha ha', haxo slu'um heb' ol katab'ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol munlaj b'aj ay yawb'en uwa heb'.
Icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'e'en che'ew yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, icha chi' ol aj satem heb' chuk chi' b'aj smukchaji.
Ha heb' chuk chi' sb'atkan heb' satk'olal yuj snun. Manhxa mach sna'ankot heb', haxo nok' ha'ay schianb'at heb'. Stelwi heb' icha tz'aj stelwi junok te te' sch'akchaji.
Tz'ixtaj heb' ix ix toxon max unewilaj yuj heb'. Max kolwajpaxlaj heb' t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Palta ha Dios yet' spoder satanel heb' chuk chi'. Ha wal yik sch'oxan spoder Dios chi', manhxa junok mach max xiw t'a chamel.
Tato tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios, junk'olal pitzan heb' chuk chi', palta aynhejoch sat t'a tas sk'ulej heb'.
Kennhej tiempo tz'ik'jicha'anh heb' chuk chi', palta elanhchamel satxikanel heb'. Icha tz'aj stakji ixim trigo jochb'ilxo, icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Tato manh ichokta', ¿mach ex syal eyalani to wan wesani, to satnak in? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
Ha Dios ay spoder, xiwub'tak, a tz'ak'anoch junk'olal t'a skal heb' ay t'a satcha'anh.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak k'e'en k'anal b'ob'il yuj, ¿tom ay junok mach b'aj max k'och sakil k'inal yuj?
¿Tokwal ay junok anima malaj smul t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tokwal ay junok mach te wach'?
Ha k'e'en uj malaj yok k'e'en t'a yichanh. Haxo k'e'en k'anal manh wach'ok k'e'en t'a yol sat.
Okxo wal onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha nok' ha'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Yipk'olal ix kolwaj a lolonel ix al t'ayin t'a in kusk'olal tik, yuj am to tzila' to manhxalaj wip.
Wach' jun, syal ak'an in razón, tzin a k'ayb'an a in malaj in pensar tik.
¿Mach ix lolon t'a a pensar yuj chi' tzala'? ¿Mach ix halan t'ayach, yuj chi' tzal icha chi'?
Ha heb' chamnak ayek' t'a sjulal yich ha' mar, tz'ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak, chekel yaj t'a yichanh Dios, chekel yaj junjun heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha ix jenhb'anb'at satcha'anh t'a stojolal norte b'aj jakan, malaj tas t'ay. Ix sb'oanoch lum lum b'aj malaj tasi.
Ha tz'ak'anb'at ha ha' t'a skal asun, palta max nhik'chajlaj asun chi' yuj yalil ha'.
Ha tz'ak'an k'ik'b'okel sat k'e'en uj, wach'chom k'ojan k'e'en, palta ha' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a sat k'e'en.
Ha ix ak'anem yechel t'a yib'anh ha' mar b'aj sk'och k'aman sakil k'inal yet' k'ik' k'inal.
Ha yipumal satcha'anh tz'ib'xi, xiwpaxk'ei ayik stumwaj Dios chi'.
Ha yuj spoder ix skachanoch wa'an ha' mar, yuj sjelanil ix yak'an ganar nok' niwan Rahab.
Jun pusnhej syak'a' sk'achwi, a yet' spoder stekancham nok' chan mekan kuman sb'ati.
Ha jantak tas satub'tak sk'ulej ix kab' tik, jab'nhej. Ha tas ix kab' tik tonhej ix ko mak ab'ej. Okxom wal to tz'akan tz'aj kab'ani, maxtzak am nachajel ku'uj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix lolonnhej winhaj Job:
Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, haton jun max yal sk'ol sb'o'an yaj tas waji, haton tz'ak'an ixtaxel in pensar yuj in ya'elal,
yakb'an pitzan hinto, yakb'an tzato yal wik'an wik' yuj, anhej tas yel ol wala', manh ol wal tas manh yelok.
Toxon malaj b'ak'inh ol wala' to yel tas tzeyal t'ayin. Manh ol in chaoch t'a wib'anh to ay in mul.
Ol walnhej to wach' in pensar, manh ol in k'ex tas swala'. Tzin b'eyk'olej wal in b'a to malaj in mul swab'i.
Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, jaokab' ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', icha ya'elal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' chuk.
¿Tasto wal ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chuk, ayik tz'ik'jiel sk'inal heb' yuj Dios?
Ayik ayoch heb' t'a sya'elal, ¿tom ol scha yab' Dios ayik ol tewok heb' t'ay?
¿Tokwal tz'ilchaj stzalajk'olal heb' t'a Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil tato malaj b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'ay?
Ha tiknaik ol in ch'ox wal sniwan poder Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayex yet' tas nab'il yuj.
Ha ex tik eyilnakxo juntzanh chi', haxo tiknaik jun, ¿tas yuj tzex lolon t'a manh pensaril?
Ha jun ya'elal tik syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil spakok t'a heb' ixtum anima.
