Kolinel t'a sti' juntzanh heb' icha nok' choj chi', kolinel t'a sch'a'ak juntzanh icha wal nok' k'ultakil wakax chi'.
Ol walanel ab'ixal t'a heb' wetchonhab'. Ayik ol smolb'an sb'a heb', ol ach in b'itej t'a skal heb', ol walan icha tik:
Mach onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay. B'inajnakokab' ku'uj masanil onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob. Masanil onh yinhtilal onh Israel, kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay.
Ha Jehová maj yaktejkanlaj heb' ayoch sya'elal. Manh tonhejok ix yilochi, maj sk'ub'ejel-laj sb'a. Ayik ix sk'anan skolwal heb', ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi' yab'ani, xin cham t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh junok sniwan molchajelal heb' a chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' tzach xajanani. Ol wak'elk'och in ti' ix wak' t'ayach.
Ol wa heb' meb'a', ol b'ut'jokkan sk'o'ol heb'. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Masanil juntzanh ch'ok nacional yet' yinhtilal kajan t'a slajwub'k'och sat lu'um tik, ol nachajkot Jehová yuj heb', ol ja heb' t'ay, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh.
Yujto a Jehová ay yik masanil opisio, a Yajal yaj t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Masanil heb' b'eyum ol wa heb', ol yak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Masanil heb' chamelb'a yaji, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh yujto malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a chamel.
Ha heb' ichikinab'il t'a yik b'ak'inh, ol yak'em sb'a heb' t'a Jehová. Ol alchajel yab'ixal winh Yajal t'a heb' anima toto ol aljok.
Ha yab'ixal stojolal yet' swach'il tas sb'onak, ol alchaj t'a heb' toto ol aljok chi'.
Mamin Jehová Wilumal aji. Icha junok tanhwum kalnel aj t'ayin, yuj chi' malaj tas syak' palta t'ayin.
Ichato a b'aj yax anh ank'ultak tzak' wik' wip. Ichato ha t'a ha ha' malali sb'eyi, hata' tzin ik'b'ati.
Tzak'an wip t'a junjun k'u, tzin ik'anb'at t'a yoltak b'e wach', icha yaj alannakkani.

Mamin, wach'chom tzin ek' t'a ch'olkixtak b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal, max in xiwlaj yuj junok tas ay smay, yujto ayach ek' wet'ok. Icha junok winh tanhwum kalnel yet'nak te' sk'okoch yet' pax jun te' ay sch'okal, icha chi' tzutej in a tanhwani, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj.
Tza b'o in wa'el t'a yichanh heb' wajk'o'ol. Tzak'k'e aceite t'a in jolom, tzak'an b'ut'jok in waso masanto tz'el malnaj t'a sti'.
Ha a wach'k'olal yet' b'aj tzin a xajanej aynhejek' wet'ok yakb'an pitzan in. Mamin Jehová, ol in aj kajan b'aj ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha Jehová ay yik lum lum tik. Ha ay pax yik masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Yujto a ix b'oanem yich lum lum tik t'a yich ha' mar yet' t'a yich ha' niwak ha'.
¿Mach heb' syal sk'ek'och t'a jun tzalan to yik Jehová? ¿Mach heb' syal yajek' b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová chi'?
Haton heb' tik syal sk'ek'ochi: Eb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, heb' te wach' spensar, heb' max yak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, heb' max skomon ak'ej sti' yuj yak'an musansatil junokxo anima.
Ha Jehová Dios Skolumal heb', a tz'ak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. Syak'anpax spak t'a heb' icha smojal yuj swach'il heb' chi'.
Icha chi' sb'eyb'al heb' snib'ej yoch t'a yichanh Dios Kajalil a onh yinhtilal onh kan Jacob.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jakek jun sniwan puertail he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jakek te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, haton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Haton Jehová, te ay yip, te ay spoder. Ha Jehová syak'nhej ganar owal.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jakek jun sniwan puertail he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jakek te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, haton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Ha Jehová Yajal t'a smasanil, haton Rey Te B'inajnak.
Mamin Jehová, tik wal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Ach in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol. Manh in aktejkan t'a skal niwak k'ixwelal. Manh in a cha yak' ganar heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayin yik max tzalaj heb' in stzetzani.
Wojtak wal to a masanil heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol, manh ol k'ixwokel-laj heb'. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayach t'a nab'anhej, k'ixwokab'el heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin. T'a juntzanh a b'e chi' tzin ik' b'eyok.
k'ayb'ej in t'a a lolonel te yel, yik wach' tzin b'ey t'a wach'il, yujto in Diosal ach, in Kolumal ach. Ha achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, nakot a chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal, jun toxonton ix ak' kila'.
Haxo pax juntzanh in mul jun, manhxo a nakoti. Manhxo'okab' a nakot in chukal t'a yiktax ix wak'an kelemal. Mamin, tzin a nakot yet' a niwan chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, wach' ach toni, tojol ach toni. Yuj chi' tza tojolb'itej sb'eyb'al heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tza ch'oxan pax heb' emnakil t'a sb'e'al tojolal, haton b'eyb'al tza nib'ej.
Yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tza k'anab'ajej pax tas tzala', yuj chi' tza kuchb'ej heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il icha syal a trato.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan in chukal. Ak' in niwank'olal icha wal ix utej halani.
Ha mach tzach k'anab'ajani, tza k'ayb'ej heb'. T'a jun b'e wach' tzik'b'at heb'.
Toxonton tzik'cha'anh heb'. Ha heb' yuninal heb' ol ikankan lum lum tik.
Ha heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, haton heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach, tzak' razón t'a heb', tzak'an pax elk'och a trato t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach ayoch in pensar. Ha ach ol in a kolel t'a ch'anh ya'al.
Mamin, ilinkoti, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Ina to in ch'okojil, te ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ix te niwanb'i wilk'olal tik, kolinel t'a in somk'olal.
Ilinkot t'a in kusk'olal yet' t'a in ya'elal, tzak'ankan niwank'olal in chukal.
Il tonab'i, manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ste chichonoch sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Tanhwej in, manh in a cha chamok, manh in a chab'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Komonok tzin a kolo', yujto wach' in b'eyb'al, malaj in mul. Ha ach ayachoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, kolonhkanel a onh israel onh tik t'a ko kusk'olal yuj masanil sya'elal.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxkaneli to malaj in mul, yujto anhej tas wach' ayoch t'a in pensar in k'ulani. Mamin, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, malaj in chab'k'olal t'ayach.
Mamin, ilin, b'eytzitej in pensar yet' tas tzin nib'ej.
Yujto max b'atkanlaj a wach'k'olal satk'olal wu'uj, tzach in k'anab'ajejnhej.
Manh junnhejoklaj tzin ek' yet' heb' ixtum anima. Malaj b'aj junnhej tzin ek' yet' heb' chab' sat.
Tzin yajkanel smolchajelal heb' chuk chi'. Wal yel malaj b'aj wach' wak'an yet' heb' tz'ixtanb'at wach' b'eyb'al.
Tzin b'ikel in k'ab' yuj in ch'oxaneli to malaj in chukal. Ichato chi' b'i'an tzin ek' oyoyok t'a spatik yichanh altar,
swalan wach' lolonel t'a b'ital, swalanel masanil tas satub'tak tza b'o'o.
Mamin Jehová, tzin xajanej a templo b'aj kajan ach ek'i. Hata' tz'alchajel sniwanil elk'ochi.
Manh ik'el in k 'inal yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh in a satel yet' heb' milum anima,
yujto anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej, b'ekan sk'ol heb' scha'an k'e'en tumin yik smontaji.
Ha inxo jun, tzin nib'ej tzin b'eynhej t'a in wach'ilal, yuj chi' kolinel Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin,
yik tek'annhej waj t'a b'eyb'al wach'. Mamin Jehová, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal heb' molanek' t'a ichanh.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayin, in Kolumal paxi. ¿Machto wal b'aj syal in xiwi? Ha tzin kolani, yuj chi' malaj b'aj tzin xiwi.
Ha heb' chuk smol sb'a t'a in patik yik tzin satanel heb' yalani, palta a heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, ol lajwokel heb'.
Wach'chom junok b'ulan soldado tz'och hoyan t'a in patik wichanh, wal yel, manh ol in xiwlaj. Wach'chom sk'e wa'an heb' yak' owal wet'ok, hanheja' wak'anoch Dios yipok in k'o'ol.
Junnhej wal tas tzin k'an t'a Jehová, haton jun tik tzin nib'ej: To tzin ek' t'a stemplo Dios yakb'an pitzan in yik swil sniwanil yelk'och Dios chi', swak'anpaxem in b'a t'ay.
Ayik ol jawok ya'elal t'a wib'anh, a ol in k'ub'anelok. Ha t'a skajnub', hata' ol in sk'ub'ejeli. Ol in yik'k'e t'a yib'anh junok k'e'en yik tzin kolchajkaneli.
Ichaton wal chi' ol aj in skolankanel t'a heb' ajk'o'ol oyanoch t'a in patik wichanh. T'a skal aw yet' tzalajk'olal ol wak' in silab' t'a Jehová t'a yol stemplo. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'a b'ital t'ay.
Mamin, a t'ayach tzin awaji, cha ab' t'ayin. Ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, a in pensar ix halan t'ayin to tzin nitzkot in b'a t'a a tz'ey. Yuj chi' swak' wip in nitzanoch in b'a t'a a tz'ey chi'.
Manh a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin. Manh in a chek meltzaj yet' yowal a k'o'ol. Ha achtaxon tzin a kolo'. Ach in Diosal in Kolumal ach, manh in aktejkan in ch'okoj.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom tzin yaktejkan heb' in mam in nun, palta a ach ol in a tanhwej.
Mamin, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin, ik' in b'at t'a yol b'e tojol, yuj heb' ajk'o'ol snib'an in yak'an telwok.
Manh in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Sk'e wa'an heb' t'a in patik, syesan in mulok heb'. Snib'ej heb' tzin yak' chamok.
Mamin Jehová, swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin yakb'an pitzan hinto, tato ma'ay, toxom ix pax wip naik.
Ex wetchonhab', ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'o'ol. Wal yel, ak'eknhejoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swal in b'a, icha nhak'e'en aj t'ayin, manh ach b'at mikan t'ayin. Tato max ach kolwaj t'ayin, haton wal in b'at t'a skal heb' chamnak chi' b'i'an.
Mamin, snib'ej in k'o'ol tzab'i ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Swik'k'e in kab' t'a yol a templo, tzin k'anan a kolwal.
Manh ak' in ya'elal icha tzutej heb' sk'ulan chukal, haton heb' stz'akan yal wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetanimail, palta anhej chukal sna heb' t'a spatik heb' anima chi'.
Ak' spak t'a heb', icha syal tastak sk'ulej heb', icha syal tas chukal sk'ulej heb', ichato chi' b'i'an, tzak'anoch sya'elal heb'.
Malaj yelk'och juntzanh tastak ix a b'o t'a yol sat heb'. Ha heb' chi' ol a satkanel heb', manhxo ol ik'chajk'e wa'an heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yab' tas ix wal t'a skal in ya'elal.

Ha Jehová Wipumal, ha' tzin kolan icha junok k'e'en k'e'en tz'och wenhulok. Ha swak'och yipok in k'o'ol, tz'ochnhej wet'ok, yuj chi' manh jantakok stzalaj in k'o'ol. Tzin b'itani, swak'an pax yuj diosal t'ay.
Ha Jehová ayoch yipumalok heb' schonhab', skolwajpax t'ayin, to sreyal in heb', sik'b'il in el yuj.
Mamin Jehová, kolkanel a chonhab', ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' iktaxoni. Tanhwej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ex aj satcha'anh, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay to syal yuj smasanil, te b'inajnak.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová icha t'a smojal. Hak'ekem he b'a t'ay t'a stemplo te wach' yilji.
Ha Jehová Dios te niwan yelk'ochi, tz'ab'chaj sjaj t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ha tz'ak'an k'anh k'u, a tz'ak'an mandar t'a yib'anh ha' owal mar chi'.
Ha sjaj Jehová tz'ab'chaji, manh jantakok spoder. Yuj sjaj chi' scheklaji to te niwan yelk'ochi.
Yuj yaw Jehová sjekchajkanb'at te' k'ute'. Yuj Jehová spojkan juntzanh te' niwak k'ute' t'a Líbano.
Ha juntzanh lum niwak witz yik Líbano yet' lum yik Sirión, tz'ib'xi lum yuj Jehová. Sk'e b'akhnaj lum witz chi', icha sk'e chennaj junok nok' kelem wakax.
Ha yaw Jehová, a tz'ak'ankot kopnaj lheb'lon.
Ha yaw Jehová tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um. A' tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um yik Cades.
Ha yuj yaw Jehová tz'el jekeljok sk'ab'tak te' ji, haxonhej yib' te' skan t'a sat lum witz. Haxo t'a stemplo tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay yuj heb' anima smasanil.
Ha Jehová ak'annak yajalil t'a jun ha' owal ha' mukwajum. Yajal yaj t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha tz'ak'an yip heb' schonhab'. Yuj swach'il sk'o'ol Jehová, syak' junk'olal t'ayonh a onh schonhab' onh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yet' in wach' lolonel, yujto ix in a sik'k'e wa'an t'a skal in niwan ya'elal, maj in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin, in Diosal ach, ix in k'an a kolwal, ix ak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol.
Mamin, a ach ton ix in a kolel t'a chamel. Ix ak' in k 'inal, maj in a chab'atlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová, mach ex to schonhab' ex, b'itejek yujto anhej Te Niwan Yelk'ochi.
Yujto junnhej rato ay yowal sk'o'ol, haxo swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Wach'chom tzonh ok' t'ak'walil, haxo yik sk'inhib'i sja ko tzalajk'olal.
Ayik te wach' waji, ix in na' icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol in telwok yuj junok tas, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, yuj wal swach'il a k'o'ol, ix in ak'kanoch b'aj malaj tas tzin ik'ani. Palta ayik ix ik'anel a b'a t'ayin, ix somchajkanel in k'o'ol.
Mamin, ix ach wawtej, ix walan in b'a t'ayach:

¿Tasto a ganar t'ayin, k'inalok tato tzin chami, tzin mukchaji? Manhxo ol yal-laj ach sb'itan heb' toxo ix och pokokal. Manh ol yal pax laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj swach'il tas ix a b'o'o, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' wal tas swala', ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Mamin, ochannhej wet'ok.
Ix ak'an k'exmaj in ya'elal t'a tzalajk'olal. Ix ik'anel in kusk'olal, ix ak'ankanoch k'apak pichul yik k'inh in pichulok.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ach Jehová in Diosal, max yal-laj wem numan. Tzin b'itan t'ayach t'a aloj wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a. Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzin a cha somchajeli. Kolinel yuj a tojolal.
Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'ayin, tzin a kolan t'a elanhchamel. Ochanh in nhak'e'enok b'aj ol in kol in b'a.
Yujto in nhak'e'en ach, in cuartel ach, yuj chi' ochanh wenhulok. Ik' in b'eyok yik manh ol ach alchaj chukal.
Kolin t'a jun ya'al ix em t'a wichanh, yujto in Kolumal ach.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, swak'kanoch in b'a t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tzin a kolkaneli, to tz'elk'och syal a lolonel.
Tzin chakel heb' anima syak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi. Ha inxo Mamin Jehová, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Tzin tzalaj wal yuj a wach'k'olal. Ha ach ix ik'el in kusk'olal, ojtak pax in ya'elal.
Maj in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'o'ol. Te lewan b'aj ix in kan u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, yujto ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Ix te chakb'i in sat wok'i, manhxalaj yip in pixan yet' in niwanil.
Ha in k 'inal slajwiem t'a skal in ya'elal. Ha wab'ilal slajwiel yuj in k'akwi. Ha kusk'olal tz'ik'anel wip, k'ununi yel yip in niwanil tik swab'i.
Tzetzab'il in yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, b'uchb'il in yuj heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil. Yajb'il in kanel yuj heb' ojtannak in. Ha heb' tzin ilan t'a yoltak b'e, tz'el heb' t'ayin.
Junelnhej ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'. Icha wal to manhxo in animaok swab'i, icha wal junok lum xalu pojnak, icha chi' waji.
Swab' sajson heb' wetchonhab' t'a in patik. Yalxonhej b'ajti'il, ay xiwk'olal sja t'ayin. Junlajanxonhej sna'an heb' t'a in patik. Nanon yek' sk'o'ol heb' tas syutej in yak'anchamok.
Ha inxo jun Mamin Jehová, a achnhej ayachoch yipok in k'o'ol. Toxonton swala': Ha ach wal tik, in Diosal ach, xin chi.
Yol wal a k'ab' ay in k 'inal. Kolinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tzak'anoch wu'uj.
Il in wal och a in a chekab' in tik yuj swach'il a k'o'ol, tzin a kolanel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin, wan walan in b'a t'ayach. Manh in ak'b'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal. Ha heb' chuk tzak'kanb'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal chi', tzak'ankanb'at heb' b'aj tzinan, b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Ha heb' sna'ank'e lolonel, numk'ajokab' heb', yujto syal lolonel heb' ya t'a heb' anima wach'. Spatikejel heb' wach' spensar heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' wach' chi'.
Yel ton wal niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'a heb' tzach ik'ancha'anh. T'a yichanh heb' anima tzak' a wach'ilal t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol.
Ha t'a a tz'ey tza k'ub'ejel heb' t'a chukal sna heb' puch winak. Ha b'aj ay ach tza kolel heb' t'a schukal lolonel heb' ajk'olal yajoch t'a heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach Mamin Jehová, yujto satub'tak tas ix a b'o t'ayin yuj a wach'k'olal, ayik oyanoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a in patik wichanh.
Ha wal yik manhxo animaok in k'o'ol, ix in na' to ix in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, haxo wal yik ix in k'anan a kolwal, ix ab' in tewi.
Xajanejek Jehová, masanil ex yikexxo yujto ha' stanhwan heb' sk'anab'ajani, palta tz'akan syutej yak'an ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a.
Tek'b'ejek he b'a mach ex tzeyak'och Jehová yipok he k'o'ol.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'chaj lajwok smul, sukchaj sat schukal heb'.
Te wach' yik heb' syal Jehová to manhxalaj smul heb' t'a yichanh, haton heb' maxtzak k'ub'anel smul t'a heb' yetanimail.
Ayik manto walk'etalaj in mul, yelxo wal ijan ix lajwiel in niwanil ix wab'i, yujto ix in te k'akwi.
Ach in Diosal, k'uhal t'ak'wal yelk'olal ix ak'och in ya'elal. Icha wal anh takinh ank'ultak stakjiel yuj waresma, ichinta ix wab'i.
Ichato chi' ix walank'eta in mul chi' t'ayach, malaj tas ix in k'ub'ejeli. Ix el wal t'a in k'o'ol walan in b'a t'ayach. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová ix in ak' niwank'olal.
Yuj wal chi' jun, yalokab' sb'a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani yakb'an tzato yala'. Wach'chom sja ya'elal icha ha' eluma', palta max yamchajlaj heb' yuj.
Ha ach ay ach och wenhulok, a ach ol in a kolel t'a ya'elal. Tzach in b'itej yujto ix in a koleli.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin: Ol ach in k'ayb'ej t'a tas ol a k'ulej. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach b'ajtil ol ach b'atok, ol ach in tanhwej.

Manh utej a b'a icha nok' chej ma icha junok nok' mula, a juntzanh nok' chi' max nachajel-laj yuj nok'. Yowalil syamchajoch wa'an nok' yet' k'e'en freno. Tato manh ichokta tz'utaj nok', max sk'anab'ajejlaj nok', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh jantakok ya'elal ol kot t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' ayoch Dios yipok sk'o'ol, a swach'k'olal Dios chi' ol moyank'e heb'.
Hak'ek tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol t'a Jehová ex anima wach' he pensar. B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal he masanil ex ayex och t'a stojolal.
Ex anima wach' he pensar, b'itejek Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal. Yujto a heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, smojton wal sb'itan heb' t'a Jehová chi'.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yet' te' arpa. B'itananhek t'ay yet' salterio lajunhe' sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová yet' ak' b'it. Wach' tzeyutej he b'itan t'ay t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yujto a slolonel Jehová yel toni. Ha tas sb'o'o, a sch'oxaneli to syak'elk'och tas syala'.
Ha Jehová, a tojolal yet' wach' b'eyb'al snib'ej. Sch'oxel sb'a swach'k'olal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tonhej ix yal Jehová, ix b'o satcha'anh yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
A' ix molb'ankan ha ha'. Ha ha' mar tonhej malanek' ha' t'a yet'tal yuj.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik. E masanil kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ayokab' he xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.
Yujto ha' ix halani, ix b'o smasanil. A' ix halani, wach' ix ajkan masanil tas.
Ha Jehová smak'an lajwok spensar juntzanh ch'ok nacional.
Haxo tas sna'a, aynhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tzalajk'olal yik junok nación to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok, to sik'b'ilel yuj yik tz'och yikok.
Ha t'a satcha'anh k'elanemta Jehová, syilanemta masanil anima.
Ha b'aj kajanek' Jehová syilkot masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.
A' ixb'o'an spensar heb' smasanil. Hanheja' pax smaklan yila' tas sk'ulej heb'.
Manh yujok to te niwan sb'isul soldado ol kolchajel junok yajal. Manh yujok to te ay yip junok soldado, ol kolchajok.
Ha nok' chej, malaj yopisio nok' skolan heb' anima. Wach'chom te ay yip nok', palta max yal-laj skolwaj nok'.
Ha Jehová k'elanoch t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, haton heb' ayoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'o'ol.
Skoljikanel heb' yuj t'a chamel, tz'ak'ji wa heb' yuj t'a stiempoal wejel.
Ha onh tik, a Jehová skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. A' tzonh kolani, tzonh stanhwan paxi.
Yuj chi' stzalajb'i ko k'o'ol yuj. Skak'anoch yipok ko k'o'ol, yujto Axonhejochi.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'och a wach'k'olal t'ayonh, yujto tzach kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Swik'cha'anh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo, swalnhej wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha t'ay stzalaj in k'o'ol. Ab'ek ex anima emnakil, tzalajanhek.
Alekel yab'ixal sb'inajnakil Jehová wet'ok, junnhej skutej kik'anek cha'anh.
Ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix tak'wi t'ayin, ix yik'kanel masanil in xiwk'olal.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'o'ol, stzetzon sat heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, malaj b'aj sk'ixwi heb'.
Ix wal in b'a t'a Jehová, wach'chom te malaj welk'ochi, haxo ix ab'ani, ix in skolanel t'a masanil wilk'olal.
Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a sat, a yángel tzoymaj t'a spatik yichanh heb', haxo skolchaj heb' chi' yuj.
Ak'lejek heyila', ol heyilani to te ay swach'k'olal Jehová. Te wach' yik heb' skol sb'a t'a Jehová chi'.
Mach ex yikex Jehová, ayokab' yelk'och t'a he sat. Malaj tas ol yak' palta t'a heb' ay yelk'och Dios t'ay.
Ha nok' choj, tz'el yip nok' yuj wejel, haxo pax heb' syak'em sb'a t'a Jehová, malaj b'ak'inh ol yak' palta junok tas wach' t'a heb'.
Ex unin, kotanhek, ab'ek tas swala', ol ex in k'ayb'ej yik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a Jehová.
Tato syal he k'ol snajatb'i he k 'inal, he gana pax tzalajk'olal tzek' junjun k'u eyu'uj,
manhxo eyal chukal lolonel, manhxo eyesej.
Ik'ekel he b'a t'a chukal, manhxo eyak' owal, haxo wach'il tze k'ulej, tze b'eyb'alan junk'olal.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, smaklan wal yab'i ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Jehová, aykot yowal sk'ol t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yik satel heb', yik manhxa mach ol na'an heb'.
Syab' Jehová ayik syalan sb'a heb' anima wach' spensar t'ay, skolchajkanel heb' t'a masanil yilk'olal.
Ha Jehová ayek' t'a stz'ey heb' anima manhxo animaok yet'nak syab'i, skolankanel heb' somchajel sk'o'ol yuj kuselal.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, wach'chom tzijtum tas tz'ik'an heb', haxo Jehová skolanel heb' t'a masanil juntzanh sya'elal chi'.
A' stanhwan heb', malaj junok sb'akil heb' ol k'ichajok.
Haxo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, a yuj schukal heb' chi' ol chamok. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haxo Jehová ol kolan heb' schekab'. Ha heb' skol sb'a t'ay, manh ol kotkanlaj t'a yib'anh heb'.
Mamin Jehová, telaj a b'a yet' heb' stelaj sb'a wet'ok, ak' owal yet' heb' tz'ak'an owal wet'ok.
Ik'elta a yamk'ab' yik owal, tzul in a kolani.
Ik'elta a lanza tza makan sat heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok. Al t'ayin to in Kolumal ach.
Ha heb' snib'ej in chami, somchajokab'b'at heb' yuj k'ixwelal. Ha heb' snib'ej ay tas skot t'a wib'anh, meltzajokab'b'at heb' t'a spatik.
Ichokab' smatz'il ixim trigo syik'b'at ik', ichokab' ta tz'aj heb'. Pechjokab'b'at heb' yuj ángel.
K'ik'olinakokab'i, nhereriokab' sb'e heb', haxo ángel spechan heb'.
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta ix yak'em in ya'alil heb'. Malaj in mul, palta ix sjoy jun olan heb' yik wach' tzin b'at t'a yo'ol sna'an heb'.
Yuj chi', mokab' na'anok yuj heb' ayik sjawi niwak ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'. Kanokab' heb' t'a sya'alil ix yak'em chi'. B'atokab'kan heb' t'a yol jun olan ix sb'o chi'.
Ichato chi' ol wak'an tzalajb'ok in k'ol t'ayach Jehová. Ol el lenaj ol wil yuj a kolwal.

T'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿machto wal junok icha ach tik? Ha heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ayoch t'a tzapan majanil, tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' te ay yip, to syik'ek' heb' tastak ay t'a heb', xin chama.
Skot heb' testigo esum, haxo tas manh wojtakok sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin.
Ha in wach'k'olal chuk ix yutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin, ix in stzuntzej kus heb'.
Ha inxo, ayik ya'ay heb', ix wak'och pichul yik kusk'olal, maxtzak in walaj yuj kusk'olal, ya swab'i. Max waktejkanlaj in lesalwi t'a in pixan yuj heb'.
Kusnak in k'o'ol ix in b'eyek'i, icha wal to a yuj junok wamigo, ma wuk'tak, ma icha in nun tzin kus yuj.
Ayik ix in telwi, ix k'e umnaj heb' smasanil in stzetzani. Ichato ch'ok animail in t'a heb', ichato manh in yojtakok heb'. Max yaktejkanlaj heb' in ste b'ajani.
Te ya ix in ek' yuj heb', ix in sb'uch heb', ix kot k'elan heb' t'ayin yet' schichonk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tom tonhej ol ach och k'elan yuj jun tik? Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha nok' choj, tz'el yaw, skot t'ayin.
Ol walel yab'ixal a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh heb' tzijtumal anima molanek'i. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab'.
Mokab' tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Mokab' reprepan sat heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Malaj snib'ej heb' t'a junk'olal. Snib'ej heb' snak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' munil ayek'i.
Te cha'anh tz'el yaw heb' t'ayin, syalan heb': Ix kil tas ix a k'ulej chi', toxo ix kila', xchi heb'.
Mamin, ix il wal. Ak' yowalil t'a heb', manh ach najatb'okb'ati, manh ach el t'a in tz'ey.
Mamin ach Wajal, in Diosal ach, kotanh, kolin, b'o yaj tas swal tik. Ochanh wet'ok.
Ach Jehová in Diosal ach, b'o yaj t'ayin hato syal a tojolal, in gana to max in tzetzaj yuj heb'.
Mokab' yal heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ix elk'och icha ko gana. Junelnhej ix kixtejkanb'at winh, mokab' xchiok heb'.
Ha heb' stzalaj yuj in ya'elal, k'ixwokab'kan heb', somchajokab'el sk'o'ol heb'. K'ixwokab'el heb' niwak winak syutej sb'a t'a wichanh.

Haxo heb' snib'ej to wach' tzin elk'ochi, tzalajokab' sk'o'ol heb'. Elokab' yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal. Yalokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo: Ha Jehová, te niwan ton yelk'ochi, stzalaj wal yuj swach'il jun schekab' tik, xchiokab' heb'.
Mamin, ol walel a tojolal, ol walnhej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, anhej chukal chi' ayoch t'a spensar heb' sk'ulani. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och Dios t'a sat heb'.
Yujto syaloch sb'a heb' wach'il, manh ojtakab'ilok smul heb' chi' sna'ani. Max snalaj heb' yaktejkan schukal chi'.
Anhej chukal lolonel syal heb', naumk'e lolonel heb'. Syaktejkan wach' pensaril heb', max sb'olaj wach'il heb'.
Ayik waynak heb' t'a sat sch'at, toxonhej snanonek' sk'o'ol heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh wach'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max yal-laj sk'ol heb' syik'el sb'a t'a chukal.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, te niwanxo pax a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha'anh sk'ek'ochi, tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Ek'al a wach'ilal t'a yichanh lum niwak witz. Ha a tojolal, ek'al t'a sjulal yich ha' niwak mar. Mamin Jehová, ilb'il heb' anima yet' masanil nok' nok' u'uj.
Ach Dios, satub'takxonhej a wach'k'olal, yuj chi' sko kol ko b'a t'ayach, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh tz'och t'a yalanh snun.
Tzonh b'ut'ji yuj jun niwan wa'el tzak' t'ayonh. Ha ha ha' manhxo jantakok swach'il yuk'ji tzak' kuk'ej.
Yujto a t'ayach skot ko k 'inal icha yaj sjaj ha ha'. Yujnhej a sakil k'inal ay ko k 'inal.
Ha onh kojtak hachxo, ayokab' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh. Ha onh wach' ko pensar, kolonhkaneli.
Manh a cha yak' chukal heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a t'ayin. Manh a cha in spech b'eyek' heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ileknab' b'ajtil ix telwi heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ix telwi heb', manhxa b'ak'inh ol k'ex wa'an heb'.
Mokab' somchajel ko k'o'ol yuj heb' sk'ulan chukal. Mokab' ko nib'ejoch sb'eyumal heb'.
Yujto elanhchamel ol satel heb', icha stakji anh ak sjochchajeli, ma icha stakjiel anh ank'ultak.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol, ko b'o'ek tas wach'. Konh kaneknhej kajan t'a lum lum tik, ol onh ak'jok wa t'a ak'ank'olal.
Kak'ek tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol t'a Jehová, a ol ak'an tas sko nib'ej.
Skab'enejoch ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, skak'anoch yipok ko k'o'ol, a ol kolwaj ket'ok.
Haxo ol ak'an cheklaj swach'il ko b'eyb'al icha wal tz'aj scheklaj yok k'u t'a chimk'uhalil.
Numan skutejek ko b'a t'a yichanh Jehová. Niwan skutejek ko k'o'ol ko tanhwan skolwaj ket'ok. Manh kak'ek somchajel ko k'o'ol yuj heb' te wach' tz'elk'och yuj chukal sk'ulej.
Ko satekel kowal, kak'ek tup ko k'ak'alk'olal. Mokab' te chichon ko k'o'ol, ta ma'ay, chuknhej tas ol onh ajelk'ochok.
T'a wal yel ol satel heb' sk'ulan chukal, a onhxo pax skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol jun, ol ko cha ko makb'en yik b'aj ol onh kajnaj t'a lum lum tik.
Ayik jaye' k'uhal tik, manhxalaj heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Wach'chom ol ko sayek' heb', palta manhxo ol ilchajlaj heb' ku'uj.
Haxo heb' anima emnakil, ol aj heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, ol yak'an wal snib'ej heb' yajek' t'a junk'olal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, nanon yek' sk'o'ol heb' yak'an chukal chi' t'a anima wach' sb'eyb'al. Juch'uch'i sk'uxan ye heb' t'a heb' yuj chichonk'olal.
Haxo Jehová tonhej stzewaj yuj heb', yujto yojtak to lak'anxo sja ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syik'elta yespada heb', sb'o'an sjul-lab' heb' yik wach' slajwiel heb' emnakil anima meb'a', to smilcham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' yalani.
Ha k'e'en yespada heb' chuk chi', hanheja' k'e'en ol ek' t'a spixan heb'. Haxo sjul-lab' heb' chi', ol kanhchajkanb'at te'.
Yelxo wal te wach' jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima wach' spensar, t'a yichanh sb'eyumal jantak heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ol satel sb'eyumal heb' anima chuk chi' yuj Jehová, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ol koljok heb' yuj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' malaj spaltail, haxo tas ay t'a heb', malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok.
Ayik te chuk tiempo yujto te ay wejel, manh ol ek'laj heb' k'exab', aynhej tas ol swa heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol satel heb' icha wal stakji anh xumak ay t'a kaltak te'. Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová, ol satkanel heb' icha wal satem te' tab'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'och heb' majan, maxtzak yak' meltzaj smajan heb' chi'. Haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ay yok'elk'olal heb', elb'ennhej yel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' scha'an swach'k'olal Jehová, a heb' ol kajan lum lum, haxo pax heb' chuk katab'il yuj, ol ik'chajel heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ha Jehová skuchb'an b'ey heb' anima wach' spensar ayik wan sb'ey heb' t'a tojolal.
Wach'chom stelwi heb', palta max ek'laj tiempo sk'exwan heb', yujto yamb'il sk'ab' heb' yuj Jehová.

Atax t'a in kelemal masanto yik icham winak inxo tik, malaj b'aj ix wil yaktajkan junok anima wach' spensar yuj Jehová yik tzek' t'a sya'elal. Malaj pax b'aj ix wil yuninal heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi' sk'anan wa sb'a t'a titak pat.
Tz'ok'nhej sk'o'ol heb' wach' pensar chi' t'a heb' yetanimail, aynhej tas syak' heb' majanil. Haxo yuninal heb' chi', syik'kot yaxilal heb' t'a skal heb' yetanimail.
Yuj chi', kaktejekkan chukal, sko k'ulan wach'il, ichato wal chi' wach' ol onh aj t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto stzalaj Jehová yet' tojolal, malaj b'ak'inh syaktejkan heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. T'a masanil tiempo skolchajel heb'. Haxo yinhtilal heb' sk'ulan chukal, satjiel heb' yuj Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar chi' ol ik'ankan lum lum tik, ol kajnajek' heb' t'a lum t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, slolon heb' t'a jelanil, wach'nhej tas syal heb'.
Ha sk'ayb'ub'al Dios yet'nak heb', yuj chi' malaj b'aj ol em heb' t'a chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, aynhejoch sat heb' t'a heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, snib'ej heb' smilcham heb'.
Palta manh ol ak'chajkanlaj heb' wach' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk chi' yuj Jehová. Manh ol stak'laj Dios skotkan t'a yib'anh heb' wach' t'a yichanh ley.
Kak'ekoch Jehová t'a ko k'o'ol, sko k'anab'ajanek. A' ol onh ik'ancha'anh. Ol yak' lum lum tik t'ayonh. Ol kil wal satel heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ix wil wal yixtan heb' yetanimail heb', ix yik'chanh sb'a heb', niwakil syutej sb'a heb' icha junok te te' manh jantakok sk'ab', te yax xi'il.
Palta ix satel heb', manhxalaj mach ix kani. Ix in say heb', palta majxo ilchajlaj heb' wu'uj.
Scham wal kilan heb' wach' spensar max k'ulanlaj chukal chi', te wach'nhej ol elk'och heb' yujto a junk'olal sayek' heb'.
Haxo heb' pit, ol satjokel heb'. Ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal heb' b'ak'inh.
Ha Jehová skolanel heb' anima wach' spensar. A' ayoch yenhulok heb' ayik sja ya'elal.
A' ol kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, yujto ha' ayoch yipok sk'o'ol heb'.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak' in ya'elal yuj yowal a k'o'ol. Manh ak' in ya'elal yakb'an aykot a k'ak'alk'olal.
Toxo ix och tzolan a jul-lab' t'ayin, ix ak'och in ya'elal.
Ha yuj yowal a k'o'ol chi', masanil in niwanil tik te ya' ay swab'i, yujnhej to ix och in mul t'ayach.
Ha in chukal ichato k'ojank'e t'a wib'anh icha ikatz, maxtzak techajlaj wu'uj.
Yujnhej in pital, wanxo sk'e sjab' wechen yujto wan sk'ab'ati.
nhojan in emi tzin b'eyi. Junelnhej lachan waji. Maxtzak och wa'an jab'ok in kusk'olal.
Wan in cham yuj k'ixwelal swab'i. Masanil in niwanil te ya ay swab'i.
Ix te b'uychaj in niwanil tik, manhxalaj jab'ok yip. Tzin k'akwi yuj wilk'olal.
Mamin Wajalil, ojtak masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ayik sik'son sja in k'o'ol, ichanh yaj jun tik.
Toxonhej ste tinhtinhan in pixan yab'an sya'il. Numumi yel wip, maxtzak yal-laj wilani.
Ha heb' anima wach' wak'an yet'ok yet' heb' junnhej tzin ek' yet'ok, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in ya'elal.

Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, wan yak'anem in ya'alil heb'. Ha heb' snib'an yak' chukal t'ayin, anhej chukal syal heb' t'a in patik. Max ochlaj wa'an heb' snaub'tanhan tas ol in yutok t'a elk'altak.
Ha inxo pax jun, ichato makan in chikin, max wab'laj tas syal heb', ichato max ujilaj in loloni, malaj tas tz'elta t'a in ti'.
Lajan in icha junok mach max yab'laj, max yal-laj yalan sb'a.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, a ach ol in a tak'wej.
Ha jun tik tzin k'an t'ayach: Mokab' in stzetzej heb' ajk'ol chi'. Mokab' b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal tato tzin ak'ji ganar.
Palta ijanxo wal tzin ak'ji ganar swab'i. Max och wa'an jab'ok in ya'elal tik.
Ol walk'eta in mul. Manhxo in animaok swab' yuj in chukal.
Ha heb' ajk'ol snib'ej in chami, toxo ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb'. Manhxo jantakok ix te aj heb' tzin chakani, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Chuknhej syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Yujnhej to tzin b'eyb'alej wach'il, tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, manh in aktejkani. Ach in Diosal, manh a b'esel a b'a t'ayin.
Ach Wajalil, ach in Kolumal, kotanh t'a elanhchamel tzin a kolani.
Ix wak' pensar to ol in ya'ilej in b'eyb'al, yik max och in mul yuj tas swala'. Tzin yamoch wa'an in ti' yakb'an ayek' heb' anima chuk spensar t'a wichanh.
Ix in em numnajok, majxo walpaxlaj wach' lolonel. Palta haxo in ya'elal ix te niwtaji.
Wanxo stz'a in pixan ix wab'i. Yakb'an wan in te naub'tanhani, ix wach' och pitz'an t'a in pixan. Yuj chi' cha'anh ix in awaji, ix walani:
Mamin Jehová, ak' wal wojtakejeli to chamel b'a waji, to jayenhej ab'il in k 'inal. In gana snachajel wu'uj to elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal.
Kennhej in k 'inal ix ak'a'. Manh niwanoklaj in k 'inal t'a ichanh. Ha onh anima onh tik, icha wal kik'an jab'ok kik', icha chi' ko k 'inal.
Icha wewen kaj ko masanil. Nab'anhej sko mak' k'unb'ok ko b'a. ¿Tokwal skak' ko gana yet' ko b'eyumal sko molb'ejk'e b'ulan? Manh kojtakok mach ol ik'ankanb'atok.
Mamin Wajal, haxo tiknaik, ¿tas wach' swak'och yipok in k'o'ol? Ha ach ton ayach och yipok in k'o'ol.
Kolinel t'a masanil in chukal. Manh in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' chuk spensar.
Icha wal heb' max ujilaj sloloni, icha chi' ix wutej in b'a. Manhxalaj tas ix elta t'a in ti', yujto a ach tik ix ak'och juntzanh tik t'ayin.
Ik'el in ya'elal ix ak'ochi. Wanxo in lajwiel swab' yuj b'aj ix in a mak'a'.

Ha ach tzak'och ko ya'elal a onh anima onh tik. Tzak'anoch ko tz'u'umal yuj ko mul. Ha ach tzak' lajwok tas nib'ab'il ku'uj, ichato tz'ijaxb'ati. Ko masanil, icha wal kik'an kik', icha chi' yek' ko k 'inal.

Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal tik, kotanh k'elan t'ayin ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Manh ak' sat a k'o'ol t'a yal in sat tik. Mamin, a t'ayach, ek'elb'anhej wek' t'a sat lu'um tik icha heb' in mam wicham.
Mamin, manh ak'kot a k'ak'alk'olal t'ayin, yik wach' tzin tzalaj junok rato, yakb'an manto el-laj in k'o'ol.
Ix in tanhwejnhej skolwal Jehová, haxo ix ab'ani ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Ix in yik'k'eta t'a jun olan te ay smay. Ix in skol b'aj sitz'atak. Ix in yak'ank'e t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en k'e'en yik tzin tek'b'ej in b'a.
Ix yak' wal jun b'it ak'to t'ayin, b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Komonok sat sk'ol jantak heb' tz'ilan jun tik, yik syak'och Jehová heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'o'ol, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, haton heb' tz'och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios.

Mamin Jehová in Diosal, manh jantakok juntzanh tas satub'tak ix a b'o'o yet' jantak a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayonh. Malaj junok mach syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok. In gana swalel masanil a wach'k'olal chi', palta max in tzak'wanlaj, yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Max a nib'ejlaj nok' nok' yet' ixim trigo silab'il. Malaj nok' nok' tza k'ana' yik snhusji silab'il t'ayach, ma silab' yik stupkanel ko mul. Palta ix a jak in chikin yik tzin cha wab' tas tzala'.
Yuj chi' ix wala': Tik tzin ja'i, xin chi. Ha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel, a wab'ixal syala'.
Ach in Diosal, snib'ej in k'o'ol tzin k'ulej icha a gana. Ayoch a k'ayb'ub'al t'a in pensar.
Mamin Jehová, ix walkanel yab'ixal a tojolal t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. Ojtak wal to malaj b'aj ix waktejkan walaneli.

Malaj b'aj max walel a tojolal. Ix walel yab'ixal to tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala', tzak'anpax kolnab'il. Malaj b'aj ix in k'ub'ejel t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab' molanek'i, to te niwan a wach'k'olal, yelnhej pax tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'nhej ok'elk'olal t'ayin. Ilinnhej yet' a wach'k'olal icha ix aj halani.

Yujto te ay tas sjawi t'a wib'anh, maxtzak b'ischajlaj wu'uj. In yamchajelta yuj in chukal. Ichato maxtzak yal-laj wilani. Ek'b'al in chukal chi' t'a yichanh sb'isul xil in jolom. Wanxo somchajel in k'o'ol.
Mamin, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kotanh, kolineli. Kotanh elanhchamel, tzach och wet'ok.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, jawokab' k'ixwelal yet' somk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. B'atokab' heb' elelal t'a skal niwak k'ixwelal, yujto snib'ej heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ha heb' tzin b'uchani, kanokab' heb' t'a manh pensaril yuj somk'olal.
Haxo masanil heb' ayoch spensar t'ayach, tzalajokab' heb' t'ayach. Te niwan elk'och ach Jehová, xchiokab' heb' snib'an a kolwal.
Ha inxo jun, ob'iltak in, ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Mamin, mokab' in b'atkan satk'olal u'uj. Ha ach tzach ochtaxon wet'ok yik tzin a kolani. Ach Jehová in Diosal, manh ik'ek' tiempo in a kolani.
Wach' yik heb' skolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', a Jehová ol kolanel heb' t'a skal sya'elal.
A' ol tanhwan heb', ol ak'jok sk'inal heb' yet' stzalajk'olal yuj t'a sat lu'um tik. Manh ol ak'jok ochlaj heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yuj.
Ol ak'jok yip heb' t'a skal sya'elal yuj Jehová, ol b'oxok sk'o'ol heb'.
Ha in ix wala': Mamin Jehová, ok'ok a k'o'ol t'ayin. Anhtej in, yel toni ay in mul t'ayach, xin chi.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, syal chuk heb' t'ayin: Komonok spet chami yik manhxo ol nachajkotok, xchi heb'.
Sja heb' yak' in paxyal, palta manhok t'a swach'il sk'ol heb' tzul in yila'. Masanil tas syilb'at heb' t'ayin, sik'kan heb' t'a spensar, haxo t'a yoltak b'e syal in pekal heb'.
Ha heb' tzin chakaneli, smolb'ej sb'a heb', syalan in pekal heb'. Chuk tas sna heb' t'a in patik.
Syalan heb': Ha sya'elal jun tik, manhxa yanhal. Toxo ix b'atkan t'a sat sch'at, manhxo ol b'oxlaj sk'o'ol, xchi heb'.
Ha jun wamigo junnhej tzin wa yet'ok, yip in k'o'ol walani, ha' ix och ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Ik' in k'e wa'an yik ol wak'anek' in pak t'a heb'.
Tato manh ol tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ichato chi' ol nachajel wu'uj to tzach tzalaj wet'ok.
Ha inxo pax jun, malaj in mul t'a ichanh, yuj chi' ix in a ketz yet' a k'ab'. Ayinnhejokab' ek' t'a ichanh t'a masanil tiempo.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i.
Ach in Diosal, tzach in nib'ej wal icha junok nok' k'ultakil chej tzek' sayoj ha' yuj takinhtial.
Ach Dios pitzan, a wal in pensar tzach nib'anochi, ¿b'ak'inh ol in k'och t'a ichanh junelxo?
k'uhal t'ak'wal wok'i. Haxonhej wok'el tik ayoch in waelok, yakb'an sb'uchwaj heb' anima t'ayin sk'anb'ejnhej heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi? xchi heb'.

Ayik tzin na'an juntzanh tik, ste och pitz'an t'a in k'o'ol. Tzin na'ankoti ayik ay in ek' t'a skal heb' anima, yik tzin kuchb'an heb', yik tzonh b'at t'a a templo. Manhxo jantakok yel yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal yet' ak'oj yuj diosal. Niwan k'inh ton wal jun chi'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal te kusk'olal waj tiknaik, yuj chi', manh jantakok ach in na'ankot t'a yol yik ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik switzal Hermón yet' switzal Mizar.
Icha sk'anh yem ponholjok ha ha' t'a niwak pajaw, icha wal chi' juntzanh niwak kusk'olal tzek' t'a wib'anh u'uj.
Ach Jehová, ha t'a k'uhalil tza ch'oxnhej a wach'k'olal t'ayin, haxo t'ak'walil, max in och wa'an ach in b'itani, max in och pax wa'an in lesalwi t'ayach, yujto a ach tzak' in k 'inal.
Swalan icha tik t'ayach: Ach in Kolumal, ¿tas yuj tzin b'atkan satk'olal u'uj? Yuj chi' kusnak in k'o'ol ayik tzin b'eyek'i, yujto tzin yixtej wal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Swab' wal sya'il, icha wal to smak'jipoj in b'akil b'aj tzin yixtej heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. Junjun rato sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin sk'anb'an heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi'? xchi heb'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal, ch'oxeli to malaj in mul. Ochanh walumalok t'a juntzanh anima malaj elk'och t'a yol sat tik. Kolinel t'a heb' naumk'e lolonel yet' t'a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Ach in Diosal, in Kolumal ach, ¿tas wal yuj najat tzin ik'kanel t'a ichanh? ¿Tas wal yuj kusnak in k'o'ol tzin b'eyek'i, tzin yixtan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin?
Ch'ox a sakil k'inal t'ayin yet' a lolonel te yel, yik wach' ol in sch'ox t'a sb'e'al jun tzalan yik ejmelal b'aj kajan ach ek'i.
Ach in Diosal, ol in k'och t'a altar, hata' ol ach in b'itejnhej yet' te' arpa, yujto a ach tzak' in tzalajk'olal.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach ko Diosal, ix kab' a poder yujto a heb' ko mam kicham ix halan t'ayonh tas utejnak heb' t'a peka'.
Yet' a poder ix a pechel juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ix a satankanel heb' t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ko mam kicham chi' ix ak' kajnaj t'a tik.

Manhok yet' yip heb', manhok pax k'e'en yespada heb' ix yak'lab'ej ayik ix yik'an jun lu'um tik heb'. Maj yik'laj jun lu'um tik heb' t'a ak'oj owalil, palta yuj a poder, yuj ipalil yet' yuj a wach'k'olal ix yak' ganar jun owal chi' heb', yujto xajan heb' u'uj.
Ach ko Diosal, ko Reyal ach, a ach alnak, yuj chi' kak'nak ganar a onh yinhtilal onh kan winhaj Jacob tik.
Ha ach ton tzach och ket'ok, yuj chi' skak' ganar heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. Yuj ipalil skan heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a yalanh ku'uj.
Manhoklaj yamk'ab' yik owal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, manhokpaxlaj yuj k'e'en kespada ol kak' ganar owal.
Ha heb' kajk'o'ol schichonoch sk'o'ol t'ayonh, tzonh a kol t'a yol sk'ab' heb', k'ixwelal tz'ajkan heb' u'uj.
Anhej t'ayach ol kak'nhej tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol, a achnhej ol ach ko b'itej.
Palta a tiknaik Mamin, ix onh a patikejeli, ix onh ak'anoch t'a k'ixwelal, maxtzak yal-laj a k'o'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado.
Ha ach ix onh aktejkani, yuj chi' ix onh el lemnaj t'a heb' kajk'o'ol. Ha heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayonh, ix yik'b'at heb' tastak ay t'ayonh.
Ix onh ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb', icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok. Ix onh a saklemejkanb'at t'a skal juntzanh nación.
Te yechel ix onh a chonhkanel a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' ganar yuj b'aj ix onh a chonhel chi'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a ko lak'anil. Tzonh stzuntzan heb', malaj kelk'och t'a heb'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhej wal yik tzonh yilan heb', tzonh ste tzetzan heb'.
Junjun k'u, toxonhej tzonh te em nhojan yuj k'ixwelal.
Tzonh stzuntzan heb' kajk'o'ol snib'ej onh yixtani. Malaj kelk'och t'a heb'.
Haton juntzanh tik skot t'a kib'anh, wach'chom maj ach b'atkan satk'olal ku'uj. Ina to sko k'anab'ajejnhej a trato ak'nak t'ayonh.
Max ko nalaj ach ko patikejeli. Malaj a k'ayb'ub'al ix kaktejkani.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ichato tzonh aktejkan t'a skal nok' nok' ay smay, ichato onh a makchejem b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal.
Ach ko Diosal, k'inalok ach b'atkan satk'olal ku'uj, haxo t'a komon Dios ix kak'em ko b'a,
ix am ila', yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak manh ojtakok.
Palta u'uj junjun rato ijan onh smilancham heb' ajk'ol chi', icha nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj schami, icha chi' tzonh yutej heb'.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj ichato waynak ach b'ati? Ilonhkoti, manh onh a patikejkanel t'a junelnhej.
¿Tas yuj tzach b'at mikan t'ayonh? ¿Tas wal yuj tzonh b'atkan satk'olal u'uj t'a skal ko niwan ya'elal tik?
Toxo wan yel kip, maxtzak yal-laj ko loloni, toxonhej tzonh ek' telton t'a sat lu'um.
Pil ip. Kotanh. Kolonh eli yujto te xajan onh u'uj.
Ay wal ek' wach' lolonel t'a in pensar. Ol in b'itan t'a winh rey yet' juntzanh in lolonel chi'. Ha in ti' lajan icha stz'ib'lab' junok mach te jelan stz'ib'ani.
Ach rey, a achnhej wach' ilji t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh winak. Te wach'nhej tas tzala', te jelan a loloni yujto syak'nhej swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh.
Ak'och jachan k'e'en espada t'a a nanhal, ach winak te ak'um owal, te b'inajnak ach, te ay wal elk'ochi.
Ixik t'a yib'anh nok' a chej yet' a poder yik tzak'an ganar owal, yik sb'oji yaj lolonel t'a stojolal t'a heb' emnakil. Niwan tastak satub'tak ol a k'ulej yet' ipalil.
Ach ko reyal, a jul-lab' te jay snhi' ol b'at ch'apnaj t'a snhi' sk'o'ol heb' ajk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ol telwok heb' anima yik juntzanh chonhab' t'a skal ok.
Ach ko Diosal, yajal ach t'a smasanil tiempo. Yajal ach, wach'nhej tz'aj a ch'olb'itan tastak.
Ha wal tojolal scha a k'o'ol, max schalaj a k'o'ol chukal. Yuj chi' ix ach sik'el Dios, haton a Diosal. Ix yak' niwan tzalajk'olal t'ayach t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio het'ok.
Tz'el sjab' sperfumeal mirra, áloes yet' te' canela ayoch t'a a pichul. Ha son ay sch'anhal ol ak'an tzalaj a k'o'ol t'a a pat marfilnhej ayoch yelwanub'ok.
Ay heb' ix yisil heb' winh rey t'a skal heb' awtab'il u'uj. Ha t'a a tz'ey t'a a wach', hata' ayek' ix reina. Ha k'e'en oro yelxo wal wach' ayoch t'a spichul ix.
Ach yisil rey, maklej wal ab'i, scham wal ab'an tas ol wal t'ayach. Manhxo a na heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' etchonhab',
yujto a winh rey chi' snib'an swach'il ilji, haton winh ajalil. Hak'em a b'a t'a winh.
Ol yak' silab' heb' aj Tiro t'ayach. Ha heb' niwak b'eyum, ol snib'ej heb' yoch amigook.
Tik sja ix ix wan yoch yetb'eyumok winh rey, wach'nhej yilji ix, yisil pax ix junokxo winh rey. Oro ayoch yelwanub'ok spichul ix.
Wach'nhej yaj sb'o ix yet' spichul, tz'ik'jib'at ix t'a winh rey. Tzak'anoch heb' ix kob'estak yuk'lewok ix, haton heb' ix yamiga ix.
Stzalaj heb' ix sb'at heb' ix, masanto sk'och heb' ix t'a spat winh rey chi'.
Ach rey, a heb' uninal ol em k'ojan b'aj tz'emtaxon k'ojan heb' a mam icham. Ol ak'anoch yopisio heb' yik syilan masanil yol a makb'en tik heb'.
Ha in ol wak' nachajkot a b'i yuj masanil anima toto ol aljok t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ol yal wach' lolonel junjun chonhab' t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha Dios ayoch kenhulok, hanheja' pax ayoch kipumalok. Ha tz'och ket'ok ayik ayonh t'a skal ya'elal.
Yuj chi' max onh xiwlaj. Wach'chom stzikub'tanhaj lum lum tik, skot juyuljok juntzanh witz t'a yol ha' mar,
wach'chom sk'anh ha' mar chi', sk'epax chulnaj sat ha', wach'chom stzikub'tanhaj jolomtak witz yuj yowal ha', palta max onh xiwlaj.
Ay jun ha' niwan ha' tz'ak'an tzalaj sk'ol heb' kajan t'a schonhab' Dios, haton b'aj kajan Dios ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ha Dios ayek' t'a schonhab' chi', yuj chi' manh ol satel-laj. Ha tz'och yet' schonhab' chi' ayik wan sakb'i.
Tz'el yaw juntzanh niwak chonhab' yuj owal. Ol satel juntzanh nación chi'. Ol ulaxb'at lum lum tik ayik ol ab'chaj sjaj Dios.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ayek' ket'ok. Ha sDiosal ko mam kicham Jacob, a ayoch ket'ok, ay paxoch kenhulok.
Ul ilek satub'takil tas ix aj satjiel heb' ajk'ol t'a sat lu'um tik yuj Jehová.
Slajwiek' owal yuj masanto t'a slajwub' yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Skanhchajkanb'at sjul-lab' heb' yuj. Ha k'e'en lanza, chok' tz'aj k'e'en yuj. Syak'anoch sk'ak'al carruaje yik owal chi'.
Syalan Dios chi' t'a juntzanh nación: Aktejek eyak'an owal. Nachajokab'el eyu'uj to a in ton Dios in. Ol alchajel in poder t'a skal masanil nación t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi Dios.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ayek' ket'ok. Ha sDiosal ko mam kicham Jacob, a ayoch ket'ok, ay paxoch kenhulok.
Tz'itek he k'ab' he masanil ex nación. Awajanhek t'a Dios t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yujto a Jehová, ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil, sat ko k'o'ol yuj stzikikial. Haton Yajalil t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ix laj kan juntzanh nación t'a yalanh yuj, ix yak'ankanoch t'a yol ko k'ab'.
A' ix sik'anel lum lum b'aj stzalajb'i ko k'o'ol a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik, a onh ton te xajan onh yuj.
Ha Jehová Dios toxo ix k'ek'och t'a sk'ojnub' t'a skal aw yik tzalajk'olal yet' t'a skal yik wan yok' k'e'en trompeta.
Konh b'itanek, konh b'itanek t'a ko Diosal. Konh b'itanek, konh b'itanek t'a ko Reyal.
Konh b'itanek t'a aloj wach' lolonel t'a Dios, yujto ha' Yajal yaj t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha Dios ayoch Yajalil t'a smasanil nación. k'ojanem t'a sk'ojnub' to anhej ay yiko'.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima niwak yopisio t'a skal nación. Ix och heb' ko tz'akub'ok a onh schonhab' onh sDiosal ko mam kicham Abraham.
Ha Dios ay yik heb' yajal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' te niwan yelk'och t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, yelxo wal niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ay t'a yol schonhab', haton tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ay.

Manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji jun tzalan tik, cha'anh ayk'ei. Ha t'a chon tzalan Sion tik, b'aj kajan Dios, a tik ay wal stzalajk'olal masanil heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha Sion tik schonhab' Winh Rey yelxo wal niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha Dios ayek' t'a juntzanh palacio t'a tzalan Sion tik. Ojtakab'il to ha Dios ayoch ko kolumalok.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh rey, ix kot nhililok heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Sion tik.
Palta ayik ix yilan jun chonhab' tik heb' winh, ix sat sk'o'ol heb' winh. Ix somchajel sk'o'ol heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh elelal.
Ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj xiwelal, tz'ib'xi heb' winh yuj ya'elal, icha junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Icha tz'aj spojb'at te' barco yik chonhab' Tarsis yuj owal ik' skot t'a b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ix aj satel heb' winh yuj Dios.
Ha t'a schonhab' Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix kil wal yelk'och icha wal alb'ilkan t'ayonh. Ha Dios ol yak'nhej stek'anil Jerusalén.
Ach ko Diosal, ayik ayonhek' t'a a templo, sko nakot a niwan wach'k'olal.
Ach ko Diosal, te b'inajnak ach t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach. Tza b'o yaj masanil tas t'a stojolal yet' a poder.
Ay stzalajk'olal heb' aj Sion. Te tzalajokab' heb' aj Judá yujto t'a stojolal ix a b'o yaj smasanil.
Ek'anhek oyoyok t'a spatik yichanh Sion, tze b'isani jaye' storreal.
Scham wal he sayan eyil smuroal. Schampax eyilan spat heb' yajal, yik wach' ol yal eyalanel yab'ixal t'a heb' unin manto aljoklaj.
Ha sDiosal Sion, haton ko Diosal t'a junelnhej. Ha tzonh ik'annhej b'eyok masanto t'a slajwub'.
Ex anima ay t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel tik.
Ab'ek ex b'eyum yet' ex meb'a', mach ex ay eyelk'ochi yet' ex komon anima ex.
Ol in lolon t'a jelanil, ol wal juntzanh pensar ajaltak snachajeli.
Ol in maklej wal wab' slolonel heb' jelan. Ol in b'itej tas ix in k'ayb'ej chi' yet' sonal te' arpa.
¿Tas yuj ol in xiwok ayik ol ja juntzanh sk'uhal ya'elal t'ayin, ayik ol k'och hoyan heb' ajk'o'ol t'ayin?
Ha heb' ajk'ol chi', a sb'eyumal heb' syak'och yipok sk'o'ol, syik'ancha'anh sb'a heb' yujto manh jantakok tas ay t'a heb'.
Palta malaj junok mach syal skolan yetanimail t'a yol yiko', ma smananel sk'inal t'a Dios.
Max yal-laj ko mananel ko k 'inal yik wach' ayonnhej ek'i, yik max onh chami, yujto max techajlaj ko tupani.
Ina skila' to junlajan scham anima smasanil. Scham heb' jelan, schampax heb' man jelanok, haxo sb'eyumal heb', ch'ok mach b'aj skani.
Wach'chom manh jantakok ko lu'um, palta nab'anhej. Ha b'aj tzonh mukchaji, hata' ayonnhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Junelnhej ol onh kannhej ta'.
Ha onh anima onh tik, manh masanilok tiempo ayonhek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Wach'chom yel te b'eyum onh, palta tzonh chamnhej icha scham nok' nok'.
Icha pax chi' tz'aj satel heb' syipk'olej sb'a, haton heb' syaloch sb'a wach'il.

Ha juntzanh anima chi', a chamel ayoch yilumalok heb'. Ha tz'ik'anb'at heb' b'aj smukchaj chamnak. Ayik ol sakb'ok, t'a sk'uhal yik ol onh ch'olb'itajok, a heb' anima wach' spensar ol ak'an ganar t'a yichanh heb'. k'ojank'olal ol satem sniwanil heb', haxo b'aj smukchaj chamnak ol och skajnub'ok heb'.
Ha in xo jun, ha Dios ol in ik'ankanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ol in yik'anb'at yet'ok.
Ex wetanimail, manh eyak' pensar yuj heb' tz'och b'eyumal, heb' ste k'echa'anh sb'eyumal t'a spat.
Yuj chi' manh he na'a, yujto ayik ol cham heb', malaj jab'ok tas ol yik'b'at heb' yet'ok, manh ol b'atlaj sb'eyumal heb' chi' yet'ok.
Wach'chom te tzalajk'olal yik heb' ayik pitzan heb', ma tz'alji pax wach' lolonel t'a heb' yuj heb' yetanimail yuj sb'eyumal chi',
ol ja sk'uhal scham heb', icha ix aj scham heb' smam yicham heb', manhxo ol yil-laj sakil k'inal heb'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, tato max nachajel yuj heb' to ek'elb'anhej yek' masanil tas, lajan ol aj scham heb' icha tz'aj scham nok' nok'.
Ha Jehová, Dios Axonhejochi, a ix loloni. Ix yawtej heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'aj sjawi k'u masanto b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha t'a tzalan Sion, haton chonhab' te wach' yilji, hata' sch'ox sakil k'inal Dios.
Tik sja ko Diosal, palta manh ichnhejoktalaj ol jawok. Ha t'a spatik yichanh ay jun k'ak' to satumeli yet' jun chakxuxum ik'.
Hato t'a cha'anh tz'awtaj heb' aj satcha'anh yet' heb' kajan t'a sat lum lum tik yuj Dios, yik wach' syil heb' sch'olb'itaj schonhab'.
Syal Dios icha tik: Molb'ejek he b'a ex wikxo, a ex eyak'nak jun silab' t'ayin, ayik eyak'annak he trato wet'ok, xchi.
Ha satcha'anh sch'oxani to ha Dios Juez ton t'a stojolal.
Syalanpax Dios icha tik: Ex in chonhab' Israel, ab'eknab'i, jichan ol wutej walanoch he paltail t'a he sat. Ha in Dios in, he Diosal in.
Maj ex in tumejlaj yuj eyofrenda tzeyak'taxon t'ayin yet' nok' nok' tze nhus silab'il t'ayin t'a waltar.
Max in k'anlaj nok' kelemtak wakax molb'il eyu'uj. Malaj nok' mam chiwa t'a yol he makte' tzin k'an t'ayex.
Wiknhej masanil nok' kaltakte'al nok', wik pax nok' molb'etzal nok' ay t'a jolomtak witz.
Wik masanil nok' much ay t'a kaltak te' yet' masanil tas tzek' t'a kal wayumtak.
K'inalok ay in wejel, manh ol wal-laj t'ayex, yujto wik jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'ay.
¿Tokwal a sb'ak'chil nok' wakax tzin chi'a? ¿Tokwal a pax schik'il nok' mam chiwa swuk'ej?
Ha silab' tzin nib'ej, to tzeyak' yuj diosal t'ayin, tzeyak'elk'och tas tzeyaltej t'ayin, a in ton ek' in to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ayik ay eyaelal, awtejinek, ol ex in kolo', a exxo ol in eyik'cha'anh, xchi Dios.
Haxo t'a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, syal Dios icha tik: ¿Tok ay eyalan heyik eyalanel in k'ayb'ub'al, ma eyalanel yab'ixal in trato?
Ina to max yal-laj he k'o'ol tzex in kacha', malaj yelk'och in lolonel t'ayex.
Ayik sja winh elk'umtaxoni, tzex k'e urnaj he b'at yet' winh. Te wach' eyak'anpax yet' heb' sk'ulan ajmulal.
Palta a tas tze k'ulej, to tze nak'e lolonel, max ex och wa'an eyesani.
Ha t'a heb' eyuk'tak junnhej he nun yet'ok, tzeyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik heb'.
Ayik ix he k'ulan juntzanh chukal tik, malaj tas swala'. Yuj chi' tze na' to lajan in heyet'ok, palta ol waloch he mul chi' t'a he sat, ol wil-lajoch in sat heyet'ok.
Ha ex tzin b'at satk'olal eyu'uj tik, wach'okab' tz'aj snachajel jun tik eyu'uj, haxo talaj tz'aji, ol ex in jatchitejb'ati, manhxalaj mach ol ex kolan t'ayin.
Ha mach tz'ak'an yuj diosal t'ayin, ay welk'och t'a yol sat. Ha mach tzin k'anab'ajani, ol in kolkaneli, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal yujto tzin a xajanej, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Ha yuj a niwan ok'elk'olal, suksat in mul.
B'ik in el t'a masanil in mul, tzin a sakb'itani.
Yel toni ix och in mul, ix in ek' t'a yib'anh, max b'atlaj satk'olal junok rato in mul chi' wu'uj.
Ix och wal in mul chi' t'ayach. Ix in k'ulej chukal t'a yol a sat. Yuj chi' smoj wal ak'an in ya'elal. Max yal-laj yalchaj chukal t'ayach ayik tzin a ch'olb'itani.
Wal yel, yiktax waljub'al chuk in. Toxonton chuk in atax yik kuchb'il hinto och yuj ix in nun.
Wal yel tza xajanej mach snib'ej tojolal t'a smasanil sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ak' a jelanil t'ayin.
nhikkanel in mul yik tzin sakb'ikaneli. B'ik in eli, yik wach' sakxonhej tzin ajkan icha k'e'en sakb'akom.
Ak'xi in tzalajk'olal in k'ana' yik tz'el in kusk'olal yuj b'aj ix ak' in ya'elal sik'lab'il.
Manhxo a nakot in mul chi', tza sukan sat masanil in chukal.
Ach in Diosal, tojolb'itej in pensar. Ha junok ak' b'eyb'al tzak' t'ayin yik tzin k'anab'ajej yet' smasanil in k'o'ol.
Manh in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, manh ik'paxel a Santo Espíritu t'ayin.
Ak'xi in tzalajk'olal yuj in kolnab'il. Ak' wip yik b'ekan in k'o'ol ach in k'anab'ajani,
yik wach' tzin k'ayb'ej heb' chuk yik sb'eyb'alej a b'eyb'al heb' yik smeltzajoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ach in Diosal, ix ak' in kolnab'il, manhxo a cha in mil anima, kolinel t'a in mul yik ol walan a tojolal t'a b'italil.
Mamin, jak in ti' yik ol ach in b'itani.
Tato a ofrenda, ma silab' nhusb'il tza nib'ej, tzam wak'laj, okxo jun, max a nib'ej paxlaj.
Ha tas a gana, haton heb' skus sk'ol yuj smul. Ach in Diosal, max a patikejel-laj anima syik'em sb'a yujto sna sb'a yuj smul.
Ak' a wach'k'olal t'a Sion. Yuj swach'il a k'o'ol, b'oxik'e smuroal Jerusalén.
Ichato wal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal ol aj a cha'an silab' a gana tz'ak'ji t'ayach, haton nok' nok' snhusji. Ichato chi' ol ak'jok nok' wakax silab'il t'ayach t'a altar.
Ach to jelan ach t'a owal, ¿tas yuj tzik'cha'anh a b'a t'a a chukal? Ha swach'k'olal Dios aynhejek' t'a smasanil tiempo.
Anhej chukal a gana tza k'ulej. Ha a ti' tzak'lab'ej t'a lolonel manh yelok, icha wal junok k'e'en kuchilub' te jay ye syak'lab'ej junok anima smil-lab'ok.
Ha chukal a gana t'a yichanh wach'il. Ha lolonel es a gana t'a yichanh lolonel yel.
Ach anima chab' sat, a wal lolonel yik tz'ixtan anima a gana.
Palta ha Dios ol ach satanel t'a junelnhej. Ol och yub'naj t'ayach, ol ach yik'ankanel t'a a pat, ol yik'anel a k 'inal.
Ha heb' sk'anab'ajan Dios ol yil jun tik heb', ol xiw heb' t'ay, palta ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a jun winh chuk chi'.
Ol yalan heb': Ilek wal winh maj ak'anoch Dios yipok sk'o'ol. Anhej wal t'a niwak b'eyumal ix yak'och sk'ol winh, aynhejoch spensar winh sk'ulan chukal, xcham heb'.
Ha inxo tik, lajan in icha junok te' olivo te ya'ax, wach' sk'ib' t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios. Anhej swach'k'olal Dios ol wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, ol wak'nhej yuj diosal yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin. Tzach wak'nhejoch yipok in k'o'ol yujto wach' ach. Ol walel ab'ixal t'a yichanh heb' ikxo, to toxonton wach' ach.
Ha heb' chuk spensar sna heb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxonhej ix aj sjuanel spensar heb'. Yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Manhxalaj mach sk'ulan wach'il.
Hato t'a satcha'anh k'elanemta Dios t'a anima, yik syila' tato ay heb' syak'och spensar t'ay, yik syilpaxi tato na'an yuj heb'.
Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chuk sb'eyb'alej heb' smasanil. Junlajanxonhej tz'aj sjuwib'at heb'. Manhxalaj junok mach tzato b'eyb'alan wach' b'eyb'al. Toton manhxa wal junok.
Icha wal to malaj spensar heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ha heb' chi' satanel heb' yetchonhab', icha wal to swa'el heb' yaj heb', max yal-laj sb'a heb' t'a Dios.
Tz'ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal wach'chom malaj tas xib'tan heb'. Ha Dios ix saklemankanb'at sb'akil heb' ajk'o'ol, k'ixwelal ix ajkan heb' yujto ix patikajel heb' yuj Dios.
Komonok ha t'a tzalan Sion skot ko kolnab'il a onh israel onh tik. Ayik ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal Dios t'a kib'anh, ol tzalaj ko k'o'ol a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ol el lenaj ol kila'.
Ach in Diosal, kolin icha ajnak halan t'ayin. Kolin yujto syal u'uj smasanil.
Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal tik. Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'a tas swala'.
Yujto a heb' anima manh wojtakok tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' komonnhej tz'ak'an chukal t'a yetanimail. Snib'ej heb' to tzin chami. Malaj elk'och t'a heb'.
Palta jun, tik wal a ach ayachoch wet'ok. Tik wal u'uj pitzan in.
Ha schukal heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin ol meltzajoch t'a yib'anh u'uj. Mamin, satkanel heb' yujto tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' in silab' t'ayach t'a yol wiko', ol ach in b'itani yujto wach' ach,
yujto ix in a kolel t'a smasanil wilk'olal. Ix wilan skan heb' ajk'o'ol t'ayin t'a yalanh u'uj.
Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal, manh a patikejel tas tzin k'an t'ayach.
Kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin in k'ana. T'a skal in ya'elal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Tzin ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal yuj heb' chuk ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj yajk'olal. Te niwan in ya'elal ix yak'kot heb' t'a wib'anh. Yet' wal yowal sk'ol heb' tzin spechan b'eyek' heb'.
Syab' wal sya'il in pixan yuj heb'. Toxo ix jawi smay chamel t'a wib'anh.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, wan wib'xik'e yuj.
Tzin na'ani, komonok ay in k'axil icha nok' uch, tzam in b'at jenhenhok, tato icha chi' junk'olal am tzin aji.
Tzam in b'at jenhenhok t'a najat, a am laj t'a tzinan lu'um tzin kajnaji.
Tzam in b'at in kol in b'a yuj yowal junok anima icha owal ik'nhab' yaji, xin chi.
Mamin, satkanel heb' chuk, jub'at tas syal heb'. Anhej owal swil t'a yol chonhab' tik, malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal heb'.
k'uhal t'ak'wal yek' heb' yoymitej chonhab' t'a yib'anh muro. Ay wal chukal t'a yol chonhab' yet' naoj cha'anh es. Ix te juwiel chonhab' yuj heb'.
Komonxonhej sk'ulej chukal heb' t'a yoltak calle yet' ak'oj musansatil.
Tato a heb' komon ajk'o'ol tzin ixtani, tzam techajlaj wu'uj. Tato a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayin icha chi' tzin utani, tzam in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'ay.
Okxo tiknaik, a mach wuk'lew yaji, in wach' k'ol yaji, ha' tzin utan icha tik.
Junnhej ix b'at wet' t'a stemplo Dios. Ix onh lolon t'a amigoal. Junnhej ix ek' wet' t'a skal heb' anima t'a templo chi'.
Jaokab' juknaj chamel t'a heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayin. Pitzanokab' heb' tz'emkan heb' b'aj smukjiem heb' chamnak, yujto ay wal och chukal t'a spensar heb' yet' t'a yol spat heb'.
Ha in tik, ha t'a Jehová Dios ol wal in b'a. A' ol in kolanok.
T'a k'inhib'alil, t'a chimk'uhalil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil, ol wal in b'a t'ay t'a skal yal in sat, haxo ol ab'an tas ol wala'.
A' ol in kolanel t'a skal owal. Manh ol in chajoklaj cham yuj, wach'chom tzijtum heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha Dios Yajal t'a masanil tiempo, ha' ol ab'an tas swala', emnakil ol ajkan heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj, yujto max sk'exlaj jab'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max xiwpaxlaj heb' t'ay.
Ha winh wuk'lew chi', ix yik'cha'anh sk'ab' winh t'ayin, wach'chom in wach' k'ol in b'a yet' winh. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj b'aj ix yak' sti' winh yoch wamigook.
k'ununi slolon winh, palta haxo t'a spensar winh, anhej owal snib'ej winh. Te k'ununi syutej winh sloloni, palta icha k'e'en espada te jay ye, icha chi' yaj slolonel winh chi'.
Masanil tas tzin na'a, ol wak'b'at t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ha' ol ak'an in tek'anil. Tato k'anab'ajum swutej in b'a t'ay, malaj b'ak'inh ol in scha telwok.

Ach in Diosal, a heb' mak'umcham anima yet' heb' naumk'e es, tzapan ol aj sk'inal heb', manh ol yil-laj nanhalb'ok sk'inal heb'. Ha ach ton ol ak'b'at heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak. Palta a in tik, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, ay heb' anima tzin pechanek'i. Aynhejoch heb' yak'an owal t'ayin, manhxo animaok tzin ajkan yuj heb'.
Ha heb' ajk'ol t'ayin, manhxo jantakok heb', max yaktej heb' in spechanb'eyek'ok. Yuj yak'umtakil heb' syak' owal heb' wet'ok.
Ayik tzin xiwi, a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, swalan wach' lolonel yuj tas alb'ilkan u'uj. Tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj yuj tas sna heb' anima in yutej.
Max yaktej heb' yalan lolonel te ya t'ayin. Anhej tas tz'aj in yixtan heb', a nab'il yuj heb'.
Yalxonhej b'ajtil sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' yik tzin smaklani. Stanhwan heb' janik' ol in smilcham heb'.
Ach in Diosal, ak'kan juntzanh anima chi' t'a yalanh yuj yowal a k'o'ol. Manh a cha skol sb'a heb' t'a yalanh ya'elal yuj schukal chi'.
Ojtak jantakxo sb'isul tzin elek'i. Ojtak jantak yal in sat ix eli. Wojtak to tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh tik u'uj.
Ha heb' wajk'o'ol, ol el heb' ayik ol in k'anan a kolwal. Ha in tik wojtak wal to ay ach och wet'ok.
Ach Jehová Dios, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, swalan pax wach' lolonel yuj tas alb'ilkan u'uj.
Ach Dios, tzach wak' wal och yipok in k'o'ol, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj yuj tas sna heb' anima in yutej.
Ach in Diosal, ol wak' silab' yik ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach icha ix aj wak'an in ti' t'ayach.
Yujto ix in a kol t'a chamel, ix in a kolani yik maj in telwok. Yuj chi' tzin b'eyek' t'a ichanh t'a jun sakil k'inal tzak' t'a heb' pitzan.

Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il. In gana tzin kol in b'a t'ayach icha tz'aj skolan sb'a nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun, masanto ol lajwokek' jun ya'elal tik.
Ach in Diosal te niwan elk'ochi, tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto a achnhej tzach kolwajnhej wet'ok.
Ha yuj a wach'k'olal, yuj pax to tz'elk'och tas tzala', yuj chi' masanto t'a satcha'anh tzak'kot in kolnab'il. Ol in a kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin ixtan chi'.
Ichato t'a skal nok' choj schi'an anima ayin ek'i. Ha k'e'en ye heb' lajan icha k'e'en lanza yet' te' jul-lab'. Ha tas syal heb', lajan icha k'e'en espada te jay ye.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha'anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chekel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin, ix yak'em in ya'alil heb', manhxo animaok waj yuj heb', ix sb'o'an jun olan heb' t'a yol in b'e, palta hanheja' heb' ix b'at t'a yo'ol.
Ach in Diosal, b'ekan in k'o'ol, in gana tzach in b'itej yet' wach' lolonel.
Yuj chi' ol wak'el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itej yet' te' arpa yet' salterio. Ayik wan sakb'i, ol el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itani.
Mamin, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh chonhab'. Ol ach in b'itej t'a skal juntzanh nación.
Niwan ton a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha'anh sk'ochi. Tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha'anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chekel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha ex wal juez ex tik, ¿tojol am wal tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan yaj junok tasi? ¿Yel am wal to t'a smojalil tze b'o yaj owal?
Palta jun, chuk tzeyutej he b'o'ani. Kuchb'um ex t'a elk'al yet' t'a mak'wal t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, atax manto alji heb', chuktaxon heb'. Esalwumtaxon heb' atax yik yaljinak heb'.
Lajan heb' yet' nok' chan ay svenenoal. Lajan heb' yet' nok' ajawchan max ab'anlaj.
Max yab'laj sonal heb' winh mago nok', haton heb' winh jelan syal yak'an kistalax nok'.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, ik'el yip heb'. Utejkan heb' icha junok nok' choj mak'b'ilpoj yalanh sti'.
Satokab'em heb' icha tz'aj satem ha ha' stob'b'ati. Ayik sjulwaj heb', malajokab' snhi' te' sjul-lab' heb' chi'.
Ulaxokab'b'at heb' icha nok' unin. Ichaokab' junok unin manh tz'akanok yujal a tz'alji, max yil-laj sakil k'inal, ichokab' ta' tz'ajkanb'at heb'.
Icha te' takinh k'i'ix, smolchajoch spayulok lum chen, stup sk'ak'al te' ayik manto xejk'e lum chen chi', ichokab' ta' tzutej ik'ankanel heb' chuk sb'eyb'al chi', ayik pitzanto heb'.
Ha heb' sk'anab'ajan Dios, ol tzalaj heb' ayik ol ek' spak heb' t'a heb' chuk chi'. Ol sb'onhanb'at yok heb' t'a skal schik'il heb'.
Yuj chi' ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan slolonel Dios. Ayton jun Dios sch'olb'itan heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xcham heb'.
Ach in Diosal, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Kolinel t'a heb' skot t'ayin yuj yajk'olal.
Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Kolinel t'a heb' mak'umcham anima.
Mamin Jehová, tzin smaklej heb' anima te ow yik tzin smak'ancham heb', palta manh yujok in chukal, malaj tas ix wutej heb'.
Mamin, malaj in mul t'a heb'. Malaj tas chuk ix in k'ulej. Palta snanonek' sk'ol heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin. Mamin, il in koti, kotanh, tzul in a kolani.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a smasanil, ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, kotanh elanhchamel, tzak'anoch sya'elal juntzanh nación. Mokab' ok' a k'o'ol t'a heb' smeltzajoch yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ayik sk'ik'b'i sjawi heb', tz'el yaw heb' icha nok' tz'i', slajwi chi' slaj ek' heb' t'a kal chonhab'.
Swoman sti' heb' tzek' heb', haxo lolonel te ya syal heb'. Malaj mach tzab'an kalani, xchamlaj heb'.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, tzaton ach tzewaj yuj heb'. Tzach b'uchwaj t'a juntzanh nación chi'.
Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach ipan in kolan in b'a, yujto a ach ay ach och wipumalok yet' wenhulok.
Ach in Diosal, xajan in u'uj, a ach ol ul in a kolo'. Ol a ch'ox t'ayin tas wal ol aj skan heb' wajk'ol chi' t'a yalanh u'uj.
Ach Jehová ko Kolumal, tzikub'tanhej heb' yet' a poder. Emnakilokab' tzutejkan heb', palta manh a mak'chamlaj heb' yik a sya'elal heb' chi' manh ol b'atlaj satk'olal yuj heb' wetchonhab'.
Tz'och smul heb' yuj masanil tas syala'. Kanokab' heb' t'a yalanh yuj yak'umtakil, yuj yesalwumal yet' yuj skatab'wumal heb'.
Satel heb' yet' yowal a k'o'ol. ¿Tasto wal yuj pitzan heb'? Ach Dios Kajal a onh yinhtilonhkan winhaj Jacob, elokab' a pekal masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Sjawi heb' t'ak'walil, tz'el yaw heb' icha nok' tz'i', slaj ek' heb' t'a kal chonhab' say swa'el, tz'awaj heb' icha yok' nok' tz'i', yujto max yab'laj sk'o'ol swa'el heb'.
Ha in xo pax jun, ol ach in b'itej t'a k'inhib'alil. Ol walel sniwanil elk'ochi yet' a wach'k'olal t'a b'ital, yujto ayachnhejoch wenhulok. In Kolumal ach t'a stiempoal ya'elal.
Ach in Diosal, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a b'ital. In Kolumal ach, in Diosal ach, xajanab'il in u'uj.
Ach ko Diosal yet' wal yowal a k'o'ol ix onh aktankani. Ix onh aktejkani, onh ak'ji ganar. Mamin, ak'xikot kip tiknaik.
Ix ak' ib'xok jun lum tik, ix jatkanb'at lu'um. Ha tiknaik, makxi sjatelal lum chi', yik mantzak ib'xilaj lu'um.
Ha onh a chonhab' onh tik, niwan ya'elal ix ak' kila'. Ichato te niwan wino ix ak' t'ayonh, ix k'e t'a ko jolom.
Ix ak' jun ch'oxnab'il t'a heb' niwan elk'och t'a yichanh yik wach' max yamchaj heb' yuj sjul-lab' heb' ajk'o'ol.
Tak'wanh t'ayonh, kolonheli, yujto masanil syal u'uj. Kolonhkanel a onh xajanab'il onh tik u'uj.
Ix lolonkot Dios masanto t'a skajnub', ix yalan icha tik: Ol tzalaj in k'o'ol ayik ol in kotak pojanb'at lum Siquem yet' yak'likal lum Sucot.
Haxo lum Galaad yet' lum Manasés wik yaj lu'um. Ha Efraín icha in k'e'en xumpil yaji. Haxo Judá icha sk'okochal wopisio yaji.
Ha Moab, icha yet'tal b'aj tzin b'ik in b'a yaji. Ha t'a yib'anh Edom ol wak'kanb'at in xanhab'. T'a tzalajk'olal ol in awajok yujto ol wak' ganar heb' filisteo, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal ¿mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a jun chonhab' ayoch smuroal t'a spatik yichanh? ¿Mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a Edom?
Ach ko Diosal, ix onh a patikejeli. Maxtzak yal-laj a k'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado t'a owal.
Ochanh ket'ok, kolonhel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh. Ha skolwal heb' ketanimail t'ayonh, malaj yalani.
Ach ko Diosal, a yet' a kolwal ol kak' ganar owal. Ha ach ol a tek'kanem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ach in Diosal, il in koti. Tz'el waw yuj ya'elal tzin ik'ani. Cha ab' in lesal.
Hato b'aj slajwik'och sti' lum lum tik tzin awaj t'ayach, tz'el yip in pixan swab'i. Ik' in k'e t'a yib'anh junok niwan k'e'en yik tzin kolchaji.
Ha ach ayachoch in kolnab'ilok. Icha junok cuartel aj t'ayin, tzin a kol t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
In gana tzin kajnaj t'a a kajnub' t'a masanil tiempo. In gana tzin k'ub'ej in b'a t'a yalanh a wach'k'olal, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Ach in Diosal, hab'nak tas in ti' wak'nak t'ayach, ix ak' in makb'en yet' heb' ay elk'och t'ay.
Najatokab' tzutej in k 'inal a in rey in tik. Niwanokab' ab'il swila'
yik swak'an yajalil t'a ichanh. Tanhwej in yet' a wach'k'olal, yujto tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Icha chi' ol ach in b'itej t'a masanil tiempo. Junjun k'u ol in k'anab'ajan b'aj wak'nak in ti' chi' t'ayach.
Anhejton t'a Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wu'uj. Ha t'ay skot in kolnab'il.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, a tz'ochpax wenhulok. Malaj b'ak'inh ol in ak'jok ganar yujto ha' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktej eyoch b'ulan t'ayin yik ol in he tek'ankanem eyalani? Ichato toxo wal tzin telwi icha junok pat k'axo, ma icha junok makte' toxo tzek' leknajok.
Haxonhej tas tz'aj yixtaxel in b'inajnakil tze naub'tanhej. E k'inalxonhej he na'ank'e es. Tze tz'ak eyal wach' lolonel t'ayin, palta haxo t'a he pensar, tzin he katab'ej.
Anhej t'a Dios tz'ilchaj junk'olal wu'uj. Anhej ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Anhej tzin kolaneli, tz'ochpax wenhulok. Manh ol in telwoklaj. A' ayoch in kolnab'ilok.
Ha t'a Dios skot in kolnab'il, yuj chi' ay welk'ochi. A' ayoch wenhulok yet' in kolnab'ilok.
Ex wetchonhab', anhej Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol. T'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tzex lesalwi t'ay, yujto a ko kolnab'il yaji.

Ha heb' anima, junelnhej malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb', wach'chom meb'a' heb', ma b'eyum heb'. K'inalok tz'echtaj yalil heb' t'a junok echlab' smasanil, toton max cheklajlaj jab'ok yalil heb' chi', yuj chi' manh kak'ek ochlaj ko pensar t'a heb'.
Manh eyak'och ixtoj anima, ma elk'al yipok he k'o'ol. Tato tzex och b'eyumal, manh eyak'och he b'eyumal chi' yipok he k'o'ol.

Manh jantakok wab'an yalchaji to ha Dios aljinakkan icha tik: Ha in Dios Yajal in tik, masanil syal wu'uj, aynhej pax in wach'k'olal. Tzin paktzitej t'a junjun anima icha syal tas tz'el sk'ulani, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal, toxonton in Diosal ach. Tzach in nib'ej t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, tzach snib'ej in pixan icha tz'aj snib'an nhab' lum lum takinh.
In gana tzach wiloch t'a a templo, ol cham wal in k'o'ol wilan a poder yet' a tzikikial.
Te niwan yelk'och a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh b'aj pitzan in t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi', ol ach in b'itej.
Yakb'an pitzan in, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol in mojb'ejk'e in k'ab' t'ayach t'a in lesal.
Wach'xonhej ol ajkan in k'o'ol u'uj, icha junok mach syak' wal snib'ej yet' junok wa'el te wach'. Yet' in tzalajk'olal ol ach in b'itej.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik jichan inxo ek'i, tzach in naub'tanhani, aynhejoch in pensar t'ayach.
Ha ach ton tzach kolwaj wet'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin na' icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Junnhej waj het'ok sik'lab'il. Max in aktejel-laj yet' a wach' k'ab'.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol sjulal b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Ol miljokcham heb' t'a k'e'en espada, haxo nok' okes ol chianb'at heb'.
Ha inxo pax rey in tik jun, ol wak' tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol het'ok ach in Diosal. Masanil heb' tzach ak'an b'inaj b'aj syak' sti', ol tzalaj heb'. Haxo pax heb' tz'esan jun, ol ke'ekaxkan heb' u'uj.
Ach in Diosal, tik wal swal in b'a t'ayach, ab' in lesal. k'ub'ejel in k 'inal t'a heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
k'ub'ejinel t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Kolinel t'a heb' sna'an yak' chukal t'ayin t'a elk'altak.
Ste k'asanb'i sti' heb', icha snhikchajoch ye junok k'e'en espada. Ha tas syal heb' t'ayin te ya, lajan icha junok jul-lab'.
T'a k'ub'eltakil sjulwajb'at heb' t'a heb' malaj smul. Max xiwlaj heb' sjulwajb'ati ayik manh na'anok.
Munil syiptzitej sb'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Snanonek' sk'ol heb' yak'anem ya'al t'a elk'altak. Malaj mach tz'ilan heb' yalani.
Scham wal sna'an heb' tas syutej sb'o'an chukal. Wach'xonhej syutej heb' yak'an spensaril. Ha tas sna heb' chi', k'ub'eltak yaj t'a spensar heb'.
Ha Dios ol ak'an echnaj heb' yet' sjul-lab'. Satk'olal yaj heb' ol satjokel heb'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' ol ak'an telwok. Masanil heb' ol ilan heb', ol ib'xok heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ichato chi', masanil heb' anima, ol xiw heb' t'a Dios. Masanil tas b'ob'il yuj Dios chi' ol yalel heb'. Masanil tastak sk'ulejnak Dios chi', ol snaub'tanhej heb'.
Ha heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, ol tzalaj heb' yet' Jehová, ol sayan pax kolwal heb' t'ay. Masanil heb' anima wach', junk'olalxonhej ol aj heb'.
Ach ko Diosal, smoj wal yalji wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a Sion. Ha moj wal skak'elk'och tas skaltej t'ayach.
Masanil heb' anima sja t'ayach yujto tzab'nhej slesal heb'.
Ha jantak ko chukal tz'ak'an yajalil t'a kib'anh, palta a hachxo tza suk sat ko mul chi'.
Te wach' kiko', yujto a ach ix onh a sik'kaneli yik wach' ayonhek' t'a a templo. Wach' kaj yuj swach'il tas ay t'a a kajnub', haton a templo te niwan yelk'ochi.

Ach Dios ko Kolumal, tza paktzitej ko lesal yet' tas satub'tak tza k'ulej t'a stojolal. Masanil anima kajan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haton heb' kajan t'a tik yet' heb' kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol ach yak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Te tzatz ix utejkan juntzanh lum niwak witz yuj a poder yet' ipalil.
Ha ach tzak' numk'aj sat ha' mar. Ayik sk'e somnaj juntzanh niwak chonhab', a ach tzak' pax numk'ajok.
Ha heb' kajan t'a juntzanh najatil lu'um, tz'ib'xik'e heb' t'a yichanh tas satub'tak tza k'ulej. U'uj wal ay tzalajk'olal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ayachnhejoch ilan lum lum, tzak' snhab'il lu'um, tzak'anpax k'ib' tas tz'awchaj t'a lu'um. Tzak' k'ib' ixim trigo yuj ha ha' tz'el yok. Ichaton wal chi', tzutej a b'oan lum lum tik.
Ha ach tzak' yaxb'ok sat lu'um, tzak' ch'ayxok sch'olkiltakil lu'um, tzak'an k'unb'ok lum yuj yax nhab', tzak'an pax a wach'k'olal yik satan tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lu'um.
Manh jantakok sat awb'en syak' t'a junjun ab'il yuj nhab' tzak'koti.
Syaxb'i anh ank'ultak t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj swa nok' kalnel. Haxo tzalkixtak wach' tz'aj yilji yuj awb'en.
Sb'ut'jiel tzalkixtak yuj nok' kalnel. Haxo opkixtak, sb'ut'jikanel yuj ixim trigo. Yuj chi' sb'itan heb' anima smasanil, tz'el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
E masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'itananhek t'a Dios t'a tzalajk'olal.
B'itejek sb'inajnakil. B'itananhek t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Alek t'a Dios icha tik: Mamin a tas tza b'o'o, te satub'tak. Ha wal t'a ichanh stelwikan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, yujto te niwan a poder.
Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik syak'em sb'a t'ayach, tzach sb'itan heb', xe chi t'ay.
Kotanhek, ilek wal tas sb'onak Dios. Satub'tak tas sk'ulej yuj ko wach'ilok a onh anima onh tik.
Takinh lu'um ajnak ha' mar yet' ha' niwak ha' yuj, haxo ta' ek'nakkot heb' ko mam kicham. Tzalajokab' ko k'o'ol t'a Dios.
Ha yet' spoder syak' yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Aynhejoch sat t'a junjun nación, yik wach' max och heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a ajk'olal t'ay.
Ex junjun nación, alek wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Ab'chajokab' he b'itan t'ay t'a wach' lolonelal.
Yujto ha' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, max onh schalaj telwok.
Ach Dios, tik wal ix il ko pensar. Icha wal sakb'itaj k'e'en plata, icha wal chi' ix aj onh a sakb'itani.
Ix onh ak'kan t'a te' ya'al. Yelxo wal te al ikatz ix ak' ko kuchu'.
Ha heb' komon anima ix ak'lab'ej onh stek'ani. Ix onh ak' ek' t'a skal te' k'ak' yet' t'a yol ha' niwak ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix onh ik'anb'at b'aj junk'olal tzonh aji.
Ol in och t'a yol a templo yuj wak'an in silab' t'ayach. Ichato wal chi' ol wak'anelk'och in ti' wak'nak t'ayach,
haton tas walnak ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ha nok' nok' b'ak'ech ol in nhustz'a t'a altar. Ol wak' nok' wakax, nok' mam chiwa yet' pax nok' ch'ak kalnel in silab'ok t'ayach, haton tik scha a k'o'ol.
Kotanhek he masanil, mach ex ay yelk'och Dios t'a he sat. Maklejek eyab' t'ayin, ol wal t'ayex jantak swach'k'olal t'ayin.
Ix in k'an skolwal wet'ok, ix walan wach' lolonel t'ay.
K'inalok tato a chukal ix in nib'ej in k'ulej, maj am schalaj yab' Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil tas ix in k'an t'ay.
Palta ix yab'i tas ix in k'an chi' t'ay, ix sk'anab'ajej in lesal.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios, yujto max spatikejel in lesal, manh puraloklaj ix yak' swach'k'olal t'ayin.
Ach ko Diosal, ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh. Ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayonh, ach tzalajokab' ket'ok
yik syojtakejel masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik tas snib'ej a k'o'ol yet' kolnab'il tzak'a'.
Ach Dios, b'itanokab' junjun chonhab' t'ayach. Masanilokab' chonhab' sb'itan t'ayach.
Awajokab' junjun nación t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto tza ch'olb'itej yaj junjun chonhab' t'a stojolal. Ha ach ton tza kuchb'ej junjun nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ach Dios, b'itanokab' junjun chonhab' t'ayach. Masanilokab' chonhab' sb'itan t'ayach.
Haxo lum lum, ol yak' sat awb'en t'a lu'um, ol yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh.
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh. Niwanokab' yelk'och Dios t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ayik syak'an owal Dios, sakleminak tz'aj yel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha heb' schichonoch sk'ol t'ay, tz'el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh.
