Manh ol yal-laj heb' anima tzek' t'a stz'ey anh ank'ultak chi': Yak'okab' syaxilal Jehová t'a yib'anh anh. Sko k'an yaxilal t'a yib'anh anh, manh xchiok heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach yujto ayin och t'a wilk'olal, ichato ay in ek' t'a jun olan te jul yich swab'i.
Mamin, ab' in jaj tiknaik, ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin ayik tzin awaj in k'anan a kolwal.
Mamin Jehová, k'inalok tato tz'ib'ab'il ko chukal u'uj ¿mach wal ol stek'b'ej sb'a t'a ichanh?
Palta a t'ayach tz'ilchaj niwank'olal ku'uj, yik wach' ay elk'och t'a ko sat.
Mamin Jehová, t'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol tzin tanhwej yik tzach jawi in a kolo'. Swak'och a lolonel yipok in k'o'ol.
Mamin, ek'al in tanhwan a kolwal t'a yichanh heb' winh stanhwumal chonhab' snib'ej spet sakb'i. Ek'alto in maklan a kolwal chi' t'a heb' winh stanhwan heb' chonhab' chi'.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol a onh israel onh tik, yujto ay yok'elk'olal, b'ekannhej sk'o'ol skolwaji.
A' ol onh kolanel t'a yalanh smasanil ko mul.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak'umtakok swutej in b'a, max wik'lajcha'anh in b'a, max wak'och in b'a t'a tas niwak yelk'ochi, t'a tas max in tzak'wanlaj in b'o'ani.
Palta munil ayin ek'i, malaj tas tzin na'a. Icha wal junok nene' slajwi schuni, chelb'ilk'e yuj snun, icha chi' waji.
Ex wetchonhab', kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová Te ay ip, ko Diosal ach a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, nakot winhaj David yet' sya'elal. Nakot sti' winh ix yak' t'ayach ayik ix yalan winh:
Manh ol in och t'a yol in pat, manh ol in ek'laj jichan t'a sat in ch'at,
manh ol in mutz'laj in sat, manh ol ochlaj numnaj jab'ok in wayanh
ayik manto in b'o junok kajnub' b'aj skajnaj Jehová ko Diosal Te ay yip a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, xchikan winh.
Ha t'a Efrata ix kab' yab'ixal te' skaxail strato Dios, haxo t'a yol lum smakb'en winhaj Jaar ix ilchaj te' ku'uj.
Koyek t'a stemplo Jehová, haxo ta' tzonh emek kuman t'a yichanh.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh t'a a kajnub' aynhej ek'i. Kotanh yet' te' skaxail a trato, haton b'aj scheklajel a poder.
Aokab' wach'il sb'eyb'alej heb' a sacerdote. Elokab' yaw heb' ikxo t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yuj tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' aj David, manh ik'el a sat t'a winh rey sik'b'ilel u'uj.
Ach Jehová, ix ak'kan a ti' t'a winhaj David t'a sjichanil to manh ol a k'exlaj tas ix ala', ayik ix halan icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol wak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Tato sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' inhtilal yet' tastak ol wal t'a heb', ol ochnhej heb' t'a a despacho t'a masanil tiempo, xa chi t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a sik'kanel lum tzalan Sion yik tzach kajnaj ta', yujto icha chi' snib'ej a k'o'ol.
Ix halan icha tik: Haton jun tzalan tik b'aj in gana tzin kajnaji. Ol in kajnaj t'a lu'um yujto icha chi' ix aj scha'an in k'o'ol.
Manh jantakok wa'el uk'el ol wak' t'a heb' ayek' kajan ta', ol wak'an b'ut'jok sk'o'ol heb' meb'a'.
Ol in kol heb' sacerdote. Haxo heb' ol in k'anab'ajanok, ol wak' awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a Sion chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj David reyal. Ha winh sik'b'ilel wu'uj, manhxa b'ak'inh ol yaktej heb' yinhtilal winh yak'an reyal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh ol wak'kan k'ixwelal heb'. Haxo yopisio winh, ol wik'cha'anh, xa chikan ach Jehová.
Naeknab'i, manh jantakok swach'il scha'an sb'a yaj heb' sk'ab' yok sb'a ayik junnhej tz'aj spensar heb'.
Lajan yet' jun perfume manh jantakok swach'il skot jililok t'a sjolom winhaj sacerdote Aarón, tz'emul t'a xil sti' winh, tz'emk'och t'a spayual sjaj spichul winh.
Lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'em t'a sjolom lum witzal Hermón, tz'empax t'a lum tzalan Sion. Ha b'aj ay junk'olal chi', syak'b'at swach'k'olal Jehová, haton k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ex schekab' Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay mach ex tze tanhwej stemplo tzek' ak'wal.
Ik'ekk'e wan he k'ab' t'a stojolal skajnub' Jehová, tzeyalan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha Jehová b'oannak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, aokab' tz'ak'ankot swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh masanto t'a lum tzalan Sion.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex schekab' ex Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Mach ex ayex ek' t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová ko Diosal,
alek wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto wach'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te ay swach'k'olal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ix onh sik'kanel a onh israel onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob, yik tzonh och yikok.
Ha in tik wojtak wal sik'lab'il to a Jehová ko Diosal, yelxo wal ek'b'al yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil komon Dios.
Syalnhej sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej sk'ulej, wach'chom t'a satcha'anh, ma t'a sat lu'um tik, ma t'a ha' mar, ma pax t'a yich ha'.
A' tz'ak'ankot asun b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. A' tz'ak'anek' kopnaj lheb'lon ayik syak'an nhab'. A' sjakanelta ik' b'aj molanek' yuj.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun patil heb' aj Egipto yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' junjun nok' snok' heb'.
Ha t'a snanhal chonhab' Egipto chi', ay juntzanh tas te satub'tak sk'ulejnak yik syak'an sya'elal winh rey yet' pax heb' schekab' winh.
Tzijtum juntzanh chonhab' satnakel yuj, smilannakcham heb' rey te niwak yopisio.
Smilnakcham winhaj Sehón, sreyal heb' amorreo yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán yet' masanil heb' rey t'a yol yik Canaán.
Haxo lum slu'um heb' rey chi' yak'nak t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik, yik skikejkan lu'um.
Mamin Jehová, a a b'inajnakil malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok. T'a masanil tiempo ol ach nachajkotok.
Ha Jehová sb'o'an yaj owal t'a heb' schonhab', tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' schekab'.
Ha sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, nab'a oro, nab'a plata, anima sb'o'ani.
Ay sti' sdiosal heb' chi', palta max lolonlaj. Ay sat, palta max yil-laj.
Ay schikin, palta max yab'laj, max yik'laj yik'.
Ha heb' sb'o'an juntzanh yechel chi' yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, lajan heb' yet'ok.
Ex wetisraelal, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex sacerdote, ex yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ex yinhtilal winhaj Leví, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Mach ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a Sion, haton t'a Jerusalén b'aj kajan. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto te wach' spensar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios, haton sDiosal masanil juntzanh Dios, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios Yajal heb' yajal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Anhej sb'o'an tas te satub'tak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak satcha'anh yet' sjelanil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannakk'e lum lum t'a yib'anh ha' mar te jul yich, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'u yet' k'e'en uj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'u yik ay sakil k'inal t'a k'uhalil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'oannak k'e'en uj yet' k'e'en k'anal yik ay sakil k'inal t'ak'walil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun pat t'a Egipto, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annakelta heb' israel ko mam kicham t'a Egipto chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yet' wal spoder yik'nakelta heb', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' pojannak em snanhal ha' Chakchak Mar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek'ta heb' israel t'a snanhal ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Palta haxo winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado, b'atnakkan heb' yuj t'a yol ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' t'a tzinan lu'um, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' niwak rey, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annakel sk'inal heb' rey te b'inajnak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Haton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, ik'jinakel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yet' pax winhaj Og sreyal Basán, ik'jinakel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek' lum slu'um heb' rey chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yak'nakkan lu'um kikok a onh israel schekab' onh tik, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' onh na'ankoti ayik ayonhek' t'a skal ya'elal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix onh skolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' tz'ak'an tas swa heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal satcha'anh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Babilonia, onh em k'ojan ayik ix ko na'ankot Sion, ix onh ok' b'i'an.
Ix kak'k'e lokan te' arpa t'a sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a sti' ha ha' chi'.
Ha heb' ix onh ik'anb'at icha t'a preso, ix b'uchwaj heb' t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal, a sb'ital Sion tze b'itej t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
¿Tom ol ko b'itej b'it yik Jehová t'a lum ch'ok chonhab'il? xko chi.
Tato sb'at satk'olal Jerusalén wu'uj, satokab' sjelanil in wach' k'ab' tik in chalan te' warpa.
Tato manhxo na'anok Jerusalén wu'uj, tato manhxa pax in gana t'ay t'a yichanh pax tas snib'ej in k'o'ol, kanokab' lotznaj wak' t'a in jo'om, yik wach' manhxo ol yal-laj in b'itani.
Mamin Jehová, nakot heb' aj Edom, yujto ayik ix yamchaj chonhab' Jerusalén, ix yal heb' icha tik: Pojekemi, pojekemi, masanto scheklaj cimientoal yich, xchi heb'.
Ex aj Babilonia, ol ex satpaxelok. Te wach' yik mach ol ak'anek' spak chukal tas ix onh eyutej.
Te wach' yik mach ol yaman heb' eyuninal, ol smak'anpoj sjolom heb' t'a spatiktak k'e'en k'e'en.
Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh juntzanh Dios.

Ol in em kuman t'ayach t'a stojolal a templo to iknhej yaji, yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tzak'elk'och tas tzala'. Ix ik'cha'anh a b'i yet' a lolonel t'a yib'anh masanil tastak.
Ix ach tak'wi t'ayin ayik ix in awaj t'ayach, ix ak'an wip.
Masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach ayik ol yab'an heb' tas alnakkani.
Ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj tastak a b'onak, yujto te niwan yelk'och a b'inajnakil.
Wach'chom te niwan elk'ochi, palta tz'ok' a k'ol t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i, haxo heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, max ach b'atlaj k'elan t'a heb'.
Ayik ay in ek' t'a skal tas ay smay, pitzan innhej u'uj, tzak'ankot a poder, tzin a kolanel t'a yowal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ach Jehová, ol ach och wet'ok yik wach'nhej tzin elk'och t'a tas tza na t'ayin. Ha a wach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Ha tastak ix ik'el yich t'ayin, mokab' kan xepan.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak in sik'lab'il, ix in a b'eyk'olej sik'lab'il.
Ojtak ayik tzin em k'ojan yet' pax yik tzin k'e wa'an. Ayokto tzojtakanel tas tzin na'a.
Ojtakxo b'ajtil tzin ek'i yet' b'ajtil swik' wip. Ojtak pax masanil tas tzin k'ulej.
Ayik mantzak in na tas ol wala' a hachxo pax Mamin, ojtakxo.
Ayachnhejek' t'a in patik wichanh, b'akhanb'at a k'ab' t'a wib'anh.
Satub'tak yoch a jelanil tik, manh jab'ok snachajel wu'uj, te niwan yelk'ochi, ste sat in k'o'ol yuj.
¿B'ajto wal ol in b'at elelal t'a Espíritu? ¿B'ajto wal ol in b'at elelal t'a ichanh?
Tato tzin k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, hata' ayach ek'i. Tato tzin em t'a yol lu'um, ay ach pax ek'ta.
Tato tzin b'at t'a yichanhb'at b'aj sjawi k'u, ma tzin b'at kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar b'aj tz'em k'u,
palta sk'och pax a k'ab' t'ayin ta'. Tzin a ketzcha'anh yet' a wach' k'ab', tzin ik'an b'eyok.
Tato tzin na in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, mato a sakil k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik tz'och k'ik'alk'inalil,
a t'ak'walil chi' max yal-laj in sk'ub'anel t'a ichanh. Ha k'ik' k'inal, lajan yet' sakil k'inal t'a ichanh. Malaj sk'exanhil t'ak'walil t'a ichanh, yujto sakilk'inalnhej masanil t'ayach.
Ha ach ton ix a b'o masanil tas t'a in niwanil tik. Ha ach ix in a b'o t'a yol sk'o'ol in nun.
Swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto satub'tak tas tza b'o'o. Sat in k'ol in na'ani, palta wojtak sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji.
Ayik ix k'ib' in niwanil tik t'a yol sk'ol in nun, wach'chom manh chekelok, palta manh k'ub'eltakok yaj t'a yol a sat.
Ha ach ix il in niwanil tik ayik manto in aljilaj. Masanil sb'isul sk'uhal in k 'inal, tz'ib'ab'il t'a yol a libro ayik mantalaj junok k'uhal swila'.
Ach in Diosal, max nachajel-laj wu'uj tas yaj a pensar t'ayin. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok a pensar chi'.
Tato tzin och ijan in b'isani, ek'to sb'isul t'a yichanh k'e'en arena. Ayik tz'el in wayanh, ayinnhej ek' t'a ichanh.
Ach in Diosal, ik'el sk'inal heb' sk'ulan chukal. Najat tzik'kanel heb' mak'umcham anima t'a in tz'ey.
Yujto chuk tas syal heb', tzach yalub'tanhej heb' t'a chukal.
Mamin Jehová, tzin chak heb' tzach chakani, max in nib'ejlaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach.
Junelnhej malaj in gana swil heb', aypaxoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin walani.
Ach in Diosal, b'eytzitej tas waji, il pax in pensar.
Ila' tato wan in b'at t'a chukal b'eyb'al, tzin a kuchb'anb'at t'a sb'e'al k 'inal to aynhej t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al,
yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' na'annhej chukal yuj, yujto anhej owal sna heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha sti' heb' icha wal sti' nok' chan, a tas syal heb' icha wal svenenoal sti' junok nok' chan smilan anima.
Mamin Jehová, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, heb' na'annhej yuj tas tz'aj in yak'an telwok.
Ha juntzanh heb' anima syik'cha'anh sb'a chi', ix yak'em ya'al heb' t'a yol in b'e.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach ix wala': In Diosal ach, ab' tas swala' ayik tzin awaji swalan in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin Dios, ach Wajalil, in Kolumal to syalnhej u'uj, a ach ton tzin a kol t'a skal owal, xin chi.

Mamin Jehová, manh ak' snib'ej heb' sk'ulan chukal, manh ak' snib'ej spensar heb' yik max yik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Ha heb' tzoymajoch t'ayin, sna tastak heb', palta aokab' tas sna heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh.
Emokab' tzak'ak' chak xilinak t'a yib'anh heb', b'atokab' heb' t'a skal k'ak'. Yumjokab'b'at heb' t'a yol xab' olan, b'aj maxtzak yal-laj sk'eta heb'.
Mokxob' kajnajek' heb' alum chukal lolonel t'a sat lu'um tik. Jawokab' ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, satokab'el heb'.
Wojtak a in tik to a ach tza b'o yaj yowal heb' meb'a', tza kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tz'ik'ankanek' junok tas t'a heb'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, ol ajnhejek' heb' t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach, kotanh t'a elanhchamel. Ab' in jaj ayik swalan in b'a t'a ichanh.
Mamin, wach'okab' sk'ek'och in lesal icha wal sk'e stab'il incienso t'a ichanh. Haxo in k'ab' mojank'e t'ayach, lajanokab' wal icha ofrenda t'a yemk'uhalil t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová, tanhwej in ti', yik wach' manh ol wal chukal lolonel.
Najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a in pensar. Manh in a cha b'eyek' t'a chukal b'eyb'al. Manh in a chab'at wa'el b'aj ay sniwak wa'el heb' sk'ulan chukal.

Tato a junok anima wach' tzin mak'ani, wach'ton tzin yutej. Tato tzin stumej, icha wal to syak'och perfume t'ayin, yuj chi' scha in k'o'ol. Palta tzin lesalwinhej yik wach' syamchajoch wa'an tas sk'ulej heb' chuk.
Ha heb' yajalil heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol ekchajb'at heb' t'a sattak tenam, icha chi' ol aj yilan heb' anima to yel ix wala'.
Ha sb'akil heb', sakleminak ol ajkanb'at b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, icha tz'ajkanb'at lum lum ayik sb'oji junok olan.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal ach, ay wal och in pensar t'ayach. Ha t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il, manh in aktejkani.
Kolinel t'a sya'al heb' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayin.
Kanokab' heb' chuk chi' t'a sya'al chi', a inxo jun, ol in ek'nhej.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach tzin awaji ayik swalan in b'a. Swak' wal wip in k'anan t'ayach to tz'ok' a k'o'ol t'ayin.
T'a ichanh swal in b'a, a wal t'a ichanh swal wilk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ayik manhxo animaok waj swab'i, ojtak wal in b'e. Ha t'a jun b'e b'aj tzin b'ati, hata' ix yak'em ya'al heb' ajk'ol t'ayin.
Tzin b'at k'elan t'a in wach', malaj junok mach sjawi yik tz'och wet'ok. Malaj mach tzin kolani. Malaj mach tz'och ilk'olal wu'uj, wach'chom tzin chami.
Mamin, a wal t'ayach swal in b'a, swalan icha tik: Ha t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, a achnhej tzach in nib'ej t'a yichanh masanil tas t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kotanh k'elan t'ayin tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto malaj wip. Kolinel t'a heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, yujto te ay yip heb' t'a wichanh.
Ik' in elta t'a skal in ya'elal in k'ana', yik wach' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar ol och hoyan heb' t'a in patik ayik ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Tak'wanh t'ayin, ina to te tojol ach, tzak'annhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Manh a k'anb'ej tas waj a in a chekab' in tik, yujto malaj junok mach wach' yaj t'a a sat.
Ix in pechji b'eyek' yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix in stek'anem heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ix in yak' kajnaj heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, icha wal yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Manhxo animaok waj tiknaik swab'i, te somchajnak in k'o'ol.
Tzin nakot juntzanh k'uhal ek'nak t'a peka', tzin naub'tanhan masanil tas a b'onak t'a yalanhtax chi'.
Ha t'ayach tzin mojb'ejk'e in k'ab', tzach in nib'ej wal, icha wal junok lum takinh lu'um snib'an ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel, toxo wal tz'el in k'ol swab'i. Manh a yaej a kolwal t'ayin. Icha wal heb' chamnak smukchajemi, icham chi' ol in ajok tato tza yaej a kolwal t'ayin.
Ak' in nakot a wach'k'olal t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, ina to a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol. Ch'ox t'ayin tas ol aj in b'eyb'ati, yujto wan in lesalwi t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, yujto a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il.
k'ayb'ej in yik tzin b'o icha tas tza nib'ej, yujto in Diosal ach. Aokab' Espíritu wach' tzin ik'an b'ey t'a a wach' b'eyb'al.
Mamin, manh in a cha chamok, yik wach' max alchaj chukal lolonel t'ayach. Ik' in elta t'a skal wilk'olal, yujto wach' ach toni.
Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' tza satkanel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto a chekab' in.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, haton tz'ak'an wip. Haton wal tzin k'ayb'ani, syak'anpax in jelanil yik wach' swak' owal.
Haton icha in nhak'e'en, icha wal in cuartel, in Kolumal paxi. A' tzin k'ub'aneli. A' ayoch wenhulok. A' tz'ak'anoch heb' chonhab' t'a yalanh in mandar.
Mamin Jehová ¿tas wal jab'ok kelk'och a onh anima onh tik t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti? ¿Tas wal kelk'ochi yuj chi' tzonh a ya'ilej?
Ha onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha wal b'aj skik' kik', haxo ko k 'inal icha wal junok enhul tz'ek'i.
Mamin, jak spuertail satcha'anh yik tzach emuli. Tzach emul t'a jolomtak witz yik sk'e stab'il lum u'uj.
Julemta junok a jul-lab', haton jun k'ak' tzek' kopnajok, tza pechanb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a skal somk'olal.
Masanto t'a satcha'anh chi' tzak'emta a k'ab' tzin a kolanel t'a jun ha' mar te niwan, syalelk'ochi, haton heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Kolinel t'a heb' esalwum chi', haton heb' syik'cha'anh sk'ab' syak'an sti' t'a tastak manh yelok.
Ach in Diosal, ol in b'itej jun ak' b'it t'ayach. Ol in b'itan yet' sb'ital salterio t'ayach.
U'uj wal, syal yuj heb' rey, a ach ton ix in a kol t'a k'e'en espada tzonh milanchamok, a in David a chekab' in tik.
Ha tiknaik, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' esalwum syak' sti' t'a tastak manh yelok syala'.
K'ib'okab' heb' kuninal icha wal tas tz'awchaj to ya ilab'il. Ha heb' ix kisil lajanokab' heb' ix icha junok yoyal templo tzeyb'il, te wach' yilji.
Ha ko pat, b'ut'jinakokab'el yuj junjun makan wa'el. Ha nok' ko kalnel, k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a smilal. Manhxo b'ischajb'enokab' tz'aj sb'isul nok' ko wakax.
Unewiokab' nok', mokab' tonhejok tzek' sti' nok'. Malajokab' mach tz'el yaw t'a yol scalleal ko chonhab' yuj ya'elal.
Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to icha chi' yaji. Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok.
Ach in Diosal, a ach ton in Reyal ach, ol walkanel a b'inajnakil. T'a masanil tiempo ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach.
Junjun k'u ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol ach wik'ancha'anh t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton elk'ochi, a moj ton wal yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ha a b'inajnakil, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Ha heb' mamab'il, ol yalel yab'ixal tastak tza k'ulej t'a heb' yuninal. Haxo heb' uninab'il chi', ol yal pax heb' t'a heb' yixchikin.
Ol yalel yab'ixal a tzikikial heb', haton te niwan yelk'ochi, a inxo jun, ol in naub'tanhej tas satub'tak tza k'ulej.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal tas satub'tak ix a k'ulej, te ay pax smay. Ha inxo tik, ol walel a b'inajnakil.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal jantak a niwan wach'k'olal, te cha'anh ol aljok to te wach' ach toni.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton a wach'k'olal, ay pax ok'elk'olal, manh elanhchamelok skot owal, tz'ok'nhej a k'o'ol t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal te wach' ach t'a masanil anima. Masanil tas a b'onak, te xajan u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, masanil tastak b'ob'il u'uj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' a chonhab' t'ayach.
Yalokab'el heb' to te wach' ak'an yajalil. Yalokab' wach' lolonel heb' t'a tas ix a k'ulej, a sch'oxanel a niwan poder.
Ha yab'ixal a poder yet' a b'inajnakil t'a opisio, ol yab' heb' anima.
Ha opisio aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ach tik tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'. Te wach' ach yet' masanil tas a b'onak.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' yip heb' toxo wal stelwi, tzik'an k'e wa'an heb' tz'ixtaxi.
Ha masanil heb' anima, stanhwej a kolwal heb', yujto a ach tzak' swa'el heb' t'a stiempoal.
Elb'ennhej tas u'uj t'a smasanil a k'o'ol, tzak'an swa'el masanil tas pitzan.
Mamin Jehová, tojolton a b'eyb'al, te ay a wach'k'olal t'a tas a b'onakkani.
B'ekannhej a k'ol a kolwaj t'a heb' syal sb'a t'ayach t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' tas icha snib'ej heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach. Ayik sk'anan heb', tzab'i tza kolan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, tzil heb' tzach xajanani. Haxo heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, tza satel heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Haxo pax masanil tas b'ob'il u'uj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. T'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Yakb'an pitzan hinto ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay. Yakb'an ayinto ek'i, ol in b'itan t'a in Diosal.
Manh eyak'och anima niwan yelk'och yipok he k'o'ol, yujto animanhej heb', yuj chi' max yal-laj skolwaj heb'.
Ayik scham heb', tz'ochkan heb' pokokal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' slajwikanel tastak sna heb' sk'ulej.
Te wach' yik mach scha'an skolwal sDiosal winhaj Jacob. Anhej Jehová Dios chi' ayoch yipok sk'o'ol.
Ha Jehová b'oannak satcha'anh, lum lum, ha' mar yet' masanil tastak ay t'a junjun makan chi'. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
A' sb'o'an yaj b'aj tz'ixtaj heb' anima, syak'anpax swa'el heb' ay swejel. A' skolanel heb' ayoch t'a preso.
Ha Jehová sjakan sat heb' max ujilaj yilani, sketzan k'e wa'an heb' stelwi. Xajan heb' anima wach' spensar yuj.
Ha Jehová skolan heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhejton pax ha' tz'ilan heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Palta tz'ak'ji somchaj heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj.
Ex aj Sion, a Jehová ol ak'an Yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ko Diosal ol och Reyal t'a junelnhej. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Manhxo jantakok swach'il ko b'itan b'it t'a ko Diosal. Smojton wal ko b'itan t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it te wach'.
Ha Jehová sb'oanxi Jerusalén, ol smolb'ejxikot heb' ketisraelal sakleminak yajkanb'ati.
Ha tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' pitz'anoch kuselal t'a spixan. A' tz'anhtan sya'elal heb' chi'.
A' na'annak jantak sb'isul k'e'en k'anal sb'onak, yak'annakoch sb'i junjun k'e'en.
Yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal tik, niwan spoder, malaj slajwub'al sjelanil.
A' tz'ik'an k'e wa'an heb' anima emnakil yek'i, palta a heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'ik'chajkanem heb' sik'lab'il yuj.
Ko b'itejek Jehová yik skak'an yuj diosal yet' te' arpa sko b'itejek.
A' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a satcha'anh, slajwi chi' syak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um tik. A' tz'ak'an k'ib' anh ank'ultak t'a tzalkixtak.
Anhejton pax ha' tz'ak'an swa'el nok' nok' yet' nok' yunetak joj ayik tz'el yaw nok' yuj wejel.
Ha Jehová, max tzalajlaj yet' heb' anima tz'ak'anoch yip nok' chej, ma yipal heb' soldado yipok sk'o'ol.
Palta stzalaj yet' heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, haton heb' tz'ak'anoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'o'ol.
Ex aj Jerusalén, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex aj Sion, ko b'itejek ko Diosal.
A' tz'ak'anoch yip yijchulok spuertail chonhab' Jerusalén, syak'anpax swach'k'olal t'a heb' kuninal.
A' tz'ak'an junk'olal t'a yol smakb'en ko chonhab' tik, syak'anpax b'ut'jok yuj ixim trigo te wach'.
A' tz'ak'ankot slolonel t'a sat lu'um tik, elanhchamel tz'elk'ochi.
Ha ko Diosal tz'ak'ankot k'e'en sakb'akom icha yilji sak lana. A' tz'ak'anoch k'e'en che'ew pokokal, icha k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh tz'ajkan k'e'en.
A' tz'ak'ankot k'e'en sakb'at icha k'e'en kotak k'e'en. Haxo wal sikal k'e'en, malaj junok mach stechaj yuj.
Syalanpaxi to tz'ulaxb'at k'e'en, syak'ankot ik', yik sb'ey yalil k'e'en chi'.
Ha slolonel yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, ix yak' kojtakejel a onh israel yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik.
Manh ichokta' ix yutej t'a junokxo nación. Maj yojtakejel-laj sk'ayb'ub'al ko Diosal juntzanhxo chonhab' chi'. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanto t'a scha'anhil satcha'anh.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay masanil ex yángel. Alek wach' lolonel masanil ex soldadoal satcha'anh.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh Jehová yuj k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj k'e'en nitk'anal te wach' yilji yok.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj satcha'anh, to cha'anh ay yet' pax yuj ha ha' ayek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tonhej ix yala' ix b'okan smasanil.
A' ix b'oankan masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yet'tal yik wach' ayek' ta' t'a masanil tiempo, ix yak'ankanoch t'a sleyal to malaj b'ak'inh ol k'exchajok.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' pax nok' ay t'a sjulal yich ha',
yet' lheb'lon, k'e'en sakb'at, k'e'en sakb'akom, k'ik'al asun yet' chakxuxum ik', k'anab'ajumokab' syutej sb'a t'a slolonel Jehová chi'.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel lum niwak witz t'a Jehová, lum tzalkixtak, te te' syak' sat, te' k'ute',
yet' nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi yet' pax nok' much.
Ex sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', ex yajal yet' ex tze b'o yaj heb' chonhab',
ex winak, ex ix, ex ichamtak anima yet' pax ex unin, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil yujto anhej te b'inajnak. Ha stzikikial ay masanto t'a yib'anh satcha'anh yet' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
A' ix ak'an kipal a onh schonhab' onh tik. Kalek wach' lolonel t'ay a onh israel onh tik, a onhton te xajanab'il onh yuj. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ko b'itejek ak' b'it t'a Jehová. Ko b'itejek b'it t'ay b'aj molan onh ek' a onh yik onhxo tik.
Ex wetisraelal, konh tzalajek yet' ko Diosal cha'annakel yich ko nación tik. Konh tzalajek yet' ko Reyal a onh aj chonhab' Sion onh tik.
Konh k'e'ek cheneljok skalanek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yik skak'an ejmelal t'ay. Konh b'itanek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pandereta,
yujto stzalaj ket'ok a onh schonhab' onh tik. Ol yak' ko tzalajk'olal a onh emnakil onh tik, yujto ol yak' ko kolnab'il.
Yuj sniwanil yelk'och Jehová, konh tzalajek a onh yik onhxo tik. Hanhejtona' konh b'itanek t'ay yuj tzalajk'olal ayik tzonh waykan ochi.
K'eokab' kaw ko b'itan t'a Dios, haxo jun k'e'en espada ay ye t'a schab'il pak'anh yamb'il ku'uj,
yik skak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, skak'anoch ya'elal t'a juntzanh nación,
yik wach' tz'och k'e'en cadena t'a sreyal heb' yet' t'a heb' anima ay yopisio t'a skal heb',
yik skotkan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', haton tz'ib'yajkani. Ha jun niwan opisio tik syak' Dios t'a masanil heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. B'itananhek t'a Dios t'a skajnub'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te niwan sb'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh.
B'itananhek t'a Dios yuj tas satub'tak sb'o'o. B'itananhek t'ay yuj sb'inajnakil, malaj junok mach lajan yet'ok.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en trompeta. B'itananhek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pax salterio.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' pandereta, tzex k'epax cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal. B'itananhek t'ay yet' flauta yet' pax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ay sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en platillo tzinhinhi sk'anhi. B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en platillo cha'anh sk'anhi.
Masanil tastak syik' yik', b'itanokab' t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ha sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Salomón, haton winh yuninal winhaj David sreyal Israel.
Ix tz'ib'chajkan juntzanh lolonel tik yik wach' snachajel jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al, yik skolwaji, yik wach' snachajel juntzanh lolonel ay yelk'och ku'uj.
Yuj chi' syal ko b'eyb'alan jelanil, wach'ilal yet' tojolal icha wal yaji.
In gana to sjelanb'i spensar heb' kelemtak, heb' mantalaj spensar, to tz'ak'ji yojtakejel heb', yik syil sb'a heb'.
Yab'okab' juntzanh tik heb' ay spensar yik wach' ste ojtakejel heb'. Yab'okab' pax heb' jelan yik wach' ste jelanb'i heb' yuj.
Ha juntzanh lolonel tik skolwaj ket'ok yik snachajel ku'uj tas syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel satub'tak yet' ajaltak, haton tas syal heb' jelan.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, aynhejokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato sko nib'ej manh pensaril jun, ko patikejokab' el jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'alchaji.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' a k'ayb'ub'al swala', manh a patikejel razón syak' ix a nun t'ayach.
Yujto a juntzanh ko k'ayb'ub'al tik ol b'o a b'eyb'al yuj, icha wal junok mach te wach' tz'aj sb'o'an sb'a yet' spichul.
Tato a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al tzach montanb'ati, manh ach b'atok.
K'inalok ay b'aj syal heb' t'ayach icha tik: Ochanh ket'ok yik wach' b'at ko maklejek t'a yol b'e, yik sko mak'cham junok anima tzek' ta'.
Malaj tas na'an yuj, ol ko yamani, ol ko mak'anchamok.
Ichato chi' b'i'an ol kik'ankan masanil makanhil b'eyumal, ol ko b'ut'an ko pat yuj masanil tas ol kelk'ej chi'.
Kotanh, ochanh ket'ok, ol kak'an ik t'a tastak ol kik'a', k'inalok xchi heb'.
Palta ach wuninal, manh ach b'at yet' heb'. B'esel a b'a t'a yol sb'e heb'.
Yujto haxonhej chukal syak' yip heb' sk'ulani, toxonhej snanon sk'o'ol heb' smak'ancham anima.
Tato syil junok nok' much yem sya'alil, nab'anhej am tz'emi.
Palta a juntzanh winak chi', a sya'alil heb' syak'emi, hanheja' heb' ol smilcham sb'a t'ay.
Ha heb' snib'ej tz'och b'eyumal t'a spatik chukal, ol k'och ijan ol cham heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Ha t'a yoltak calle, b'aj sja b'e, t'a mercado yet' t'a yalnhej b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, tzonh yawtej Dios yik syak'an ko razón. Syalan icha tik:
Ha ex kelemtak ex tik, ex mantalaj he pensar, toxonton b'uchumtak ex, ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he nib'an he manh pensaril chi'? ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he b'uchwaji yet' he patikanel jelanil?
Chaek eyab' tas b'aj ol ex in kacha', tato icha chi', ol wak' in razón t'ayex, ol wak' eyojtakejel in lolonel.
Ha in tik tzex wawtejkoti, palta malaj he gana tze cha eyab'i.
Tze patikejel tas swala', max yal he k'ol tzex kachji.

Yuj chi' ol ex in tzetzej ayik ol ja chukal t'a eyib'anh, ayik ol ja xiwk'olal, ya'elal, ilk'olal yet' kusk'olal t'a eyib'anh, icha tz'aj sja junok chakxuxum ik' slajanel masanil tastak. Ayik wan he cham yuj xiwelal chi', toxonhej ol in b'uchwaj t'ayex.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', ol ex te awaj t'ayin, palta manhxo ol in tak'woklaj t'ayex. Ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, palta manh ol wab'laj.
Yujto tze patikejel jelanil, malaj he gana ay welk'och t'a he sat,
malaj he gana tzeyab' tas swala', tze patikejel he kachnab'il swak'a',
yuj chi' ol eyab' sya'il yuj he b'eyb'al chi', ol ex somchajcha'anh yuj.
Ha heb' mantalaj spensar, ol cham heb' yuj smanh pensaril. Ol satel heb' chuk spensar, yujto malaj yelk'och razón tz'ak'ji t'a heb'.
Haxo pax heb' scha'an yab' tas swala', junk'olal ol aj heb', malaj b'aj ol xiw heb', xchi Dios.
Ach wuninal, ak'och juntzanh in lolonel tik t'a a k'o'ol, sik'kan juntzanh in cheknab'il tik t'a a pensar.
Maklej ab' jelanil swala', ak' ip a na'aneli.
T'a smasanil a k'o'ol tza k'an a jelanil yik ol ach jelanb'ok.
Ak' ip a sayanek'i, icha tz'aj saychaj k'e'en plata, ma junok b'eyumal to k'ub'aneli.
Icha chi' ol aj snachajel u'uj, tas ol aj a k'anab'ajan Jehová yik tzojtakejel t'a wal yel.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an jelanil. Yuj slolonel skojtakejel smasanil, syak'an jelanb'ok ko pensar.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sjelanil heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, haton heb' max esanlaj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' wach' syutej sb'a, haton heb' sk'anab'ajani.
Yuj chi' tato tza maklej ab' in cheknab'il, ol ojtakejel tojolal yet' tas smoj tza k'ulej, yik wach' ol aj a b'eyb'al.
Icha chi' ol aj sjelanb'i a pensar, ol ach tzalaj yet' tas ojtak chi'.
Ha jelanil yet' wach' pensaril, haton juntzanh chi' ol ach kolanok.
Ha yuj juntzanh chi' ol ik'el a b'a t'a juntzanh chuk b'eyb'al yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima chuk spensar.
Ha heb' anima anhej chukal sk'ulej chi', syaktejkan wach' b'eyb'al heb'.
Stzalaj wal heb' yet' schuk b'eyb'al chi', ste k'echa'anh heb' yet' sb'eyb'al malaj swach'il chi'.
T'a sb'eyb'al heb' chuk chi' syak'och spensar, syaktankan jun b'eyb'al heb' wach'.
Ha jelanil yet' wach' pensaril, ol ach skolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ix ix ayxo yetb'eyum, haton heb' ix ajmul ix wach' smontan yet' slolonel te wach',
to yaktejnakkan yetb'eyum yik'nak t'a skob'esal, sb'atkan satk'olal sti' yak'nakkan t'a yichanh Dios.
Tato tzach b'at t'a sb'e'al spat heb' ix chi', wan a b'atkan t'a sb'e'al chamel.
Ha mach tz'ochkan t'a yol spat heb' ix, manhxa b'ak'inh tz'elxita heb', maxtzak yal-laj skajnajxi t'a wach' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tato tza cha ab' jelanil chi', ol a b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' tojol spensar.
Ha heb' tojol syutej sb'a, heb' malaj jab'ok spaltail, najtil ol ek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Haxo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al yet' heb' ixtum anima, ol ik'jokel heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik icha ko tok'ank'eta junok anh ank'ultak.
Ach wuninal, manh ak' sat a k'o'ol t'a juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al tik. Sik'kan in cheknab'il tik t'a a pensar,
yik wach' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal yuj, tzalajk'olalnhej ol ach ek'ok.
Manh aktejkan a b'eyb'alan wach'il, tza k'anab'ajejnhej tas ix ala'. Cham wal a na'ani, satta a k'o'ol t'ay.
Yuj chi' wach' ach ol ach yil Dios, ol ach b'inajpax yuj heb' anima.
Ak'nhejoch a pensar t'a Jehová, manh ak'och a jelanil yipok a k'o'ol.
Nakot Jehová t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej yik wach' a ol kolwaj het'ok t'a smasanil.
Manh a na' to te jelan ach, niwanokab' yelk'och Jehová t'ayach, tzik'el a b'a t'a skal chukal.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, junk'olal ol ach ajok, tek'an ol ach ajok.
Ch'oxeli to niwan yelk'och Jehová t'ayach. Tzak'an junok ofrenda t'ay t'a tas ay t'ayach yet' pax t'a juntzanh sb'ab'el sat tas tzawej.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, malaj b'ak'inh ol yak' palta a wa'el yet' tas tzuk'ej.
Ach wuninal, manh a patikejel skachnab'il Jehová, mokab' kot owal ayik tzach stumani.
Yujto a heb' xajanab'il yuj, haton heb' chi' skacha', icha wal tz'aj skachan yuninal junok mamab'il to stzalaj yet'ok.
Tzalajk'olal yik heb' syik' sjelanil, haton heb' te ay spensar.
Yujto a tas tz'ik'ji t'a juntzanh chi' yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh tas tz'ik'ji t'a k'e'en plata, ma k'e'en oro.
Ha jelanil chi', yelxo wal te wach' t'a yichanh swach'il yilji k'e'en tz'och kolk'ab'il. Max yal-laj ko lajb'an jun jelanil chi' yet' juntzanhxo tastak te nib'ab'il.
Yuj jelanil chi' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal, yuj ol ik' a b'eyumal, ol ach b'inaj pax yuj.
Tato sko b'eyb'alej jelanil, tzalajk'olal tzonh ek'i, junk'olal tzonh aji.
Tato tz'ilchaj jelanil ku'uj, ay ko k 'inal, wach' ol onh ek'ok, tzalajk'olal kiko'.
Ha Jehová ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' sat lum tik yuj sjelanil yet' yaj pensaril.
Yuj sjelanil chi' sk'eul sjaj ha ha', skotpax yal ak'wal t'a skal asun.
Ach wuninal, manh aktejkan a jelanil yet' a wach' pensaril, manh ik'el a sat t'ay.
Yujto ol najatb'ok a k 'inal yuj, wach' ol ach elk'och t'a sat heb' anima yuj.
Te junk'olalnhej ol ach ek'ok, malaj b'ak'inh ay tas ol ach ik'anok.
Ayik ol ik'an ip, malaj mach b'aj ol ach xiwok, t'a tzalajk'olal ol ach wayok.
Yujto ayoch Jehová yipok a k'o'ol, yuj chi' manh ol ach schakan t'a junok ya'al, manh ol a na' to ay tas ol ja t'a ib'anh, icha sja t'a yib'anh heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Manh ach b'at mikan t'a heb' sk'anan kolwal t'ayach tato syal tzach kolwaj t'a heb'.
Tato syal a kolwaj tiknaik, mokab' ala' to k'ik'anto tzach kolwaji.
Manh a na ak' chukal t'a heb' kajan t'a a lak'anil, yujto malaj schab'k'olal heb' t'ayach.
Manh ik'b'at heb' etanimail t'a yichanh heb' yajal tato malaj tzach yutej heb'.
Manh a nib'ejoch b'eyumal icha syutej sb'a heb' malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal, manh a k'ulej icha sb'eyb'al heb' chi'.
Yujto max scha sk'o'ol Jehová heb' chuk syutej sb'a chi', haxo pax heb' wach' syutej sb'a, wach' yak'an yet' heb'.
Skot skatab' Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' chuk sb'eyb'al yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan yet' heb', haxo pax t'a heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, syak' swach'k'olal.
Sb'uchwaj Jehová t'a heb' b'uchumtak, haxo t'a heb' emnakil syutej sb'a, syak' swach'k'olal.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan wach'il, ol ik'jokcha'anh heb', haxo heb' chuk spensar, ol ak'jok k'ixwelal heb'.
Ex wuninal, chaek eyab' in lolonel swala'. Maklejek eyab'i yik wach' ol jelanb'ok he pensar yuj.
Ha k'ayb'ub'al te wach' swak' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzeyailejnhej t'a masanil tiempo.
Ayik kelem unin in, ayinto ek' t'a yol spat in mam, yelxo wal xajanab'il in yuj ix in nun.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', icha tik ajnak yak'an in k'ayb'ub'al winh in mam. Yalannak winh icha tik: Sik'kan in lolonel tik t'a a pensar, k'anab'ajej tas swal tik, yik wach' ay a k 'inal.
Cha a jelanil yet' a wach' pensaril, manh ak'b'at in lolonel tik satk'olal.
Xajanej a jelanil, manh a patikejeli, yujto ol ach kolchaj yuj.
Yowalil tza sayek' jelanil t'a junjun k'u. Wach'chom ajaltak tz'aj yilchaj u'uj, palta te wach' hama tato a tza b'ab'laj sayejek' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo tas ay t'ayach.
Nib'ejoch jelanil, yik wach' ol ach ik'jokcha'anh yuj, yik wach' niwan ol aj elk'och t'a yol sat heb' etanimail.
Ha yuj jelanil chi', wach' ol ach elk'ochok, ol och k'elan heb' anima yuj a jelanil chi', xchikan winh in mam chi' t'ayin.
Haxo tiknaik ach wuninal, cha wal ab' juntzanh in lolonel tik, yik wach' ol najatb'ok a k 'inal.
Ha in ol ach wik' b'ey t'a sb'eyb'al heb' jelan, ol wak'an a b'eyb'alej tojolal.
Ha t'a tojol b'eyb'al chi', malaj tas ol ach yamanoch wa'an, wach'chom yelk'olal ol ach b'atok, palta manh ol ach telwoklaj.
Ak'och a pensar t'a k'ayb'ub'al tik, manh a patikejeli. Yelxo wal tza b'eyb'alej yik wach' ay a k 'inal.
Manh ach b'at tzak'an t'a spatik heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh a k'ulej icha tas sk'ulej heb'.
B'esel a b'a t'a skal heb', ak' ip a b'eyb'alan wach'il.
Max ochlaj swayanh heb' tato max sk'ulej chukal heb', max yik'laj yip heb', tato malaj junok mach syixtej heb'.
Ha chukal yet' ixtoj anima, a juntzanh chi' swa'el heb' yaji.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' tojol spensar, lajan icha ayik wanto sakb'i masanto sk'e k'u, scheklaj spatik yichanh heb' yuj.
Haxo sb'eyb'al heb' chuk spensar jun, lajan icha yik tzonh b'eyek' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, manh chekelok b'aj sko tenoch kok.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in lolonel tik, maklej wal ab' sik'lab'il.
Mokab' ik'el a sat t'ay, sik'kan t'a a pensar,
yujto a juntzanh lolonel tik tz'ak'an sk'inal heb' tz'ilchaj yuj.
Tza ya'ilej a pensar t'a yichanh masanil tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto a a pensar chi' tzach kuchb'an t'a wach'il, ma t'a chukal.
Manh esalwumok tzutej a b'a, manh a komon alej pax chukal lolonel.
Te tojolnhej tzach b'at t'a ichanh t'a sb'e'al wach'il, manh ach b'at k'elan t'a tas malaj swach'il.
Tza ya'ilej wal tas tza k'ulej icha wal ko sik'lan ko b'e b'aj tzonh b'eyi, aokab' wal sb'e'al wach'il b'aj tzach ochi.
Manh ach elkan t'a jun b'e te tojol, manh ach b'atkan t'a sb'e'al chukal.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in jelanil tik, scham wal a maklan ab' in razón wach' swala'.
Icha chi' ol aj snachajel u'uj, ol yal a lolon yet' jelanil.
Ha junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum, te wach' slolon ix, k'ununi slolon ix yik tzach smontejb'at ix t'a chukal.
Haxo t'a slajwub'al, lajanxo tz'aj ix icha anh ixaj te k'a', icha wal tz'aj ko lajwi yuj k'e'en espada chab' ye.
Ha mach sb'eyek' yet' jun ix ix chi', ol chamok. Ha sb'eyb'al jun ix ix chi', b'eal chamel yaji.
Ha t'a ix chi' malaj yelk'och sb'e'al k 'inal, max snalaj ix tato wach', mato chuk sb'eyb'al ix chi'.
Yuj chi' ach wuninal, ab' tas swala'. Manh ik'kanel a b'a t'a a kachnab'il swak' tik.
Najat tzach el t'a stz'ey ix ay yetb'eyum chi', xach k'ochta wal t'a spuertail spat ix.
Tato ma'ay, ol satel a b'inaj t'a wach'il, elanhchamel ol ach cham yuj junok winh malaj yok'elk'olal.
Tato icha chi' tza k'ulej, jantaknhej a b'eyumal ix ilchaj u'uj ayik ix ak'an wal ip a munlaji, ol ak'kanb'at t'a yol sk'ab' junok ch'ok animail.
Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal ix, toxonhej ol ach ok'kanek'ok, jab'jab'il ol lajwokem a niwanil.
Haxo ol halan icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj ix in patikejel in kachnab'il? ¿Tas wal yuj maj in k'anab'ajej?
Maj yal in k'o'ol ix in cha wab' tas ix yal heb' in k'ayb'umal, oktom ix in cha wab' t'a heb'.
Haxo tiknaik jab'xonhej maj in juwiel t'a yichanh masanil chonhab' t'a junelnhej, xa chama.
Uk' ha ha' iktaxon yaji yik wach' tzek' stak'inhal a ti'. (Syalelk'ochi anhej yet' ix etb'eyum tzak' a gana.)
¿Tas wal yuj ol aj uninal yet' heb' ix ix tzek' t'a yoltak calle?
Wach' skolwaj heb' uninal het'ok, t'a yichanh junokxo mach b'aj skolwaj heb' uninal chi'.
Tzalajanh, ayokab' uninal yet' ix etb'eyum chi', haton ix, ix ik' a b'a yet'ok ayik kelem achto.
Wach'okab' yilji ix t'a yol a sat, icha wal junok nok' k'ultakil chej. Mokab' lajwok a tzalajk'olal t'a ix, ayokab' a tzalajk'olal chi' yujto xajan ach yuj ix.
Ach wuninal, manh ak' somchajel a pensar yuj junok ix ix ayxo yetb'eyum. ¿Tas yuj ol ach och chelchel t'a junxo ix ix chi'?
Ha Jehová wan ton yilan ko b'eyb'al junjun onh, malaj junok tas max uji yilani.
Ha heb' chuk, hanheja' schukal heb' chi' ol ak'an juwokelok. Hanheja' schukal heb' chi' ol tzek'anok, icha ko tzek'ji t'a junok lasu.
Yujto max syamoch wa'an sb'a heb', yuj chi' ol b'atkan heb' t'a chamel. Yuj smanh pensaril heb' chi', ol satkanel heb'.
Ach wuninal, tato tzak'och a b'a a majnan k'e'en tumin yuj junok ch'ok animail t'a junok etchonhab',
wan ak'anem a ya'alil, ol kotkan t'a ib'anh yuj b'aj ix ak'och a b'a chi'.

Ach wuninal, icha tik tzutej a kolanel a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh aj tumin chi'. Ixik, emnakil tzutej a b'a tzach tewi t'a winh, tza k'anan niwank'olal a b'a t'a winh yik max ach yak' pural winh a tupanel sb'ok winh b'aj ix ak'och a b'a chi'.
Smoj wal maxtzak ach way yuj, mokxob' ik' ip junok rato
masanto tzach el t'a yalanh, icha wal yel junok nok' k'ultakil chej t'a junok mach pechjinak, ma icha yel junok nok' much t'a junok ya'al.
Ach anima malaj a gana a munlaji, ilnab' nok' ch'ekem, sik'lab'il tzila' tas syutej nok' smunlaji yik tz'ilchaj swa'el nok', scham wal a k'ayb'an t'a nok'.
Wach'chom malaj mach schekan munlaj nok', malaj yajal nok' tz'alan yab' tas sk'ulej,
palta ayik stiempoan swa'el nok', syak' wal yip nok' smunlaji yik smolankan swa'el nok' chi'.
Ach anima malaj a gana a munlaji, k'okb'ilxo chi' tzach wayi. k'okb'ilxo chi' tzach ek' jichan.
Yakb'an skot numumok a wayanh, sneknekan a jolom, jeljumb'a tz'aj a k'ab', te wach' tz'aj a wayi,
haxo tz'aji, skot mheb'ail t'a ib'anh, ste b'at t'a ib'anh icha junok winh elk'um et'jinak junok k'e'en kuchilub'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, anhej es tzek' yal heb' t'a skal heb' anima.
Smutz'mutz'an sat heb' yak'an yechel, sch'oxanpax heb' yet' yiximal sk'ab'.
Junelnhej te chuk spensar heb', haxonhej malaj swach'il sna sk'ulej heb'. Ha b'aj tzek' heb', anhej owal sk'ekan wa'an yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' elanhchamel ol ja ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'. Junnhej mutz'satil ol aj slajwiem heb', manhxa tas ol yal yuj heb'.

Ay uke' tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a junelnhej: Haton ik'ojchanhb'ail, esalwumal, mak'ojcham anima malaj smul, naojcha'anh tas malaj swach'il, chukal sk'ulaji, ak'ojoch es t'a yib'anh junokxo mach yet' ik'ojcha'anh owal t'a skal anima.
Ach wuninal, sik'kan juntzanh in k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a a pensar yet' a k'ayb'ub'al syak' ix a nun.
Sik'kan t'a a pensar, na'annhejokab' u'uj t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ol ach kuchb'an b'aj ol ach ek'ok, manh ol ach xiwok ayik ol ach wayok. Ayik ol el a wayanh, hanheja' juntzanh tik na'an u'uj.
T'a wal yel a a kachnab'il yet' a k'ayb'ub'al tik, icha sakk'inal yaj t'ayach. Ha a kachnab'il chi' yet' a pensar tzach kuchb'anb'at t'a sb'e'al k 'inal.
Ha ol ach kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' ix ix chuk spensar yet' ix ayxo winh yetb'eyum to te wach' smontan yet' slolonel.
Manh ak'och a pensar t'a swach'il yilji ix, manh a cha somchajel a k'o'ol yuj chajtil tzach aj yilanoch ix.
Ha mach smulan yet' ix ajmul ix, skot mheb'ail t'a yib'anh, haxo mach smontaj yuj ix ay yetb'eyum yik smulan ix yet'ok, syik'kot chamel t'a yib'anh.
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'ik'anb'at te' tzak'ak' t'a snhi' sk'o'ol, max ek'b'atlaj stz'ab'at spichul yuj te'.
Ha mach sb'ey t'a yib'anh te' tzak'ak', max ek'b'atlaj stz'ab'at yok yuj te'.
Ha mach smulan yet' ix ix ay yetb'eyum chi', yowalil skot t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok elk'um tz'elk'an junok tasi yujto ay swejel, tzato naji wal t'a yib'anh,
palta wach'chom icha chi', tato syamchaji, yowalil ukel tz'aj stupan tas ix yelk'ej chi', taxonhej manhxalaj tas skan t'ay.
Tato ay mach tzek' yet' ix ayxo winh yetb'eyum, yelxo wal malaj jab'ok spensar. Ha mach icha chi' sk'ulej, anhej syak' lajwok sb'a.
Ol scha sya'elal, ol mak'jokpaxi, manhxa b'ak'inh ol b'at sk'ixwelal chi' satk'olal yuj heb' anima.
Ha winh ix ixtaj ix yetb'eyum chi', te ow winh icha te tzak'ak', manh jab'ok syak' niwank'olal winh ayik sk'och stiempoal yak'anek' spak winh.
Ha silab' winh ay smul chi' syak' t'a winh, max schalaj winh, wach'chom te niwan silab' chi', palta max yak'laj niwank'olal winh.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' in lolonel tik. Ha juntzanh in cheknab'il swak' tik t'ayach, yowalil tza sik'kan t'a a pensar.
k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il tik yet' in k'ayb'ub'al yik wach' ol ach ek'ok. Icha skutej ko ya'ilan snenal yol ko sat, icha chi' tzutej a ya'ilan a kachnab'il swak' tik.
Na'annhejokab' u'uj, tza sik'ankan t'a a pensar.
Xajanej a jelanil yujto icha anab' yaji, ma icha a wach'k'o'ol.
Icha chi' ol aj a kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' ix ajmul ix, haton ix ayxo yetb'eyum, ix te wach' smontan yet' slolonel.
Ay junel ix wilelta t'a swentenail in pat,
ay juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak malaj jab'ok sjelanil ayek'i. Haxo ix wilani, ay jun winh malaj jab'ok spensar t'a skal heb' winh chi'.
Ayik wanxo yem k'u, wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix ek'ixk'och winh t'a jun esquina, ix sk'axpitanek' calle winh, t'a stojolal b'aj ay spat jun ix ix ay yetb'eyum.
Ix elta lemnaj ix scha winh. Icha spichul heb' ix ajmul ix spichul ix ayochi, icha pax spensar heb' ix chi' spensar ix.
Komonnhej slolon ix, max k'ixwilaj jab'ok ix, max emlaj k'ojan ix t'a spat.
Anhej t'a yoltak calle tzek' ix, t'a mercado yet' t'a yesquinailtak calle, hata' smaklej ix yek' junok winak.
Ha jun ix chi', ix och lak'naj ix t'a winh kelem chi', ix och tz'ub'naj ix t'a sti' winh, maj k'ixwoklaj jab'ok ix, ix yalan ix icha tik:
Ha tiknaik ix wak' in silab' yik in junk'olal alb'ilxo wu'uj, yuj chi' ayto nok' chib'ej t'a in pat tiknaik.
Yuj chi' ix in elta ach in maklej, yujto in gana tzach wila''. Tik ach ilchaj wu'uj.
Ha t'a sat in ch'at toxo ix in lich'em jun sábana nab'a lino, kotnak t'a Egipto.
Toxo ix wak'och perfume t'ay, toxonhej suk'uk'i sjab', haton mirra, áloes yet' te' canela.
Kotanh wet'ok, ol kak' wal ko gana masanto ol sakb'ok. Ol kak' wal tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol ko xajanan ko b'a.
Ha winh wetb'eyum, malaj winh ayek' t'a in pat tik, yujto ay b'aj te najat ix b'at winh.
Ix yik'b'at jun mukuk k'e'en tumin winh, yuj chi' manto ol jalaj winh masanto ol k'och sk'uhal sk'ojnaj k'e'en uj, xchi ix ix chi'.
Ha tas te wach' ix yal ix chi', elanhchamel ix montaj winh kelem chi' yuj.
Yuj chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj ix, icha yik'jib'at junok nok' wakax b'aj ol chamok, ma icha junok nok' k'ultakil chej skan t'a ch'anh ya'al,
masanto ol ek' junok jul-lab' t'a spixan nok'. Icha pax junok nok' much skan t'a te' ya'al, icha chi' yaj winh, max snalaj jab'ok winh tato ha t'a spat ix chi' ol cham winh.
Yuj chi' ach wuninal, maklej ab' tas swala'. Tanhwej wal ab' in lolonel tik.
Manh a juel a wach' b'eyb'al t'a junok ix ix icha chi' spensar, yik wach' manh ol ach satelok.
Yujto tzijtumxo mach toxo ix cham yuj heb' ix ix icha chi' sk'ulej. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok mach scham yuj heb' ix.
Tato tzach b'at t'a sb'e'al spat heb' ix ix icha chi', wan a b'atkan t'a sb'e'al chamel.
Ex kelemtak ab'ek, yujto tzex awtaji yik tzeyik' he jelanil, yik sk'ib' pax he pensar.
Yalnhej b'aj ayex ek'i, t'a junok tzalan, ma t'a yol b'e, ma b'aj schalaj sb'a b'e, tzex awtaji.
Hanhejtona' t'a spuertail he chonhab', tzex awtajpaxi.
E masanil ex anima ayex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ab'ek.
Ex kelemtak to mantalaj he pensar, k'ayb'ejek he b'a t'a jelanil. Ex chuk he pensar, sayek jelan pensaril.
Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il, ol alchaj juntzanh tastak niwak yelk'och t'ayex, manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Te yel tas ol alchaj t'ayex, malaj tas tonhej ol nachajk'eok.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel tik wach'nhej, malaj jab'ok es t'ay.
Ha heb' jelan, sekojtak tz'aj snachajel juntzanh lolonel tik yuj heb'. Ha heb' ay spensar yojtak heb' tas syalelk'ochi.
Hak'ek eyip eyik'an he jelanil yet' aj pensaril, yujto yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata.
Yelxo wal te wach' jelanil t'a yichanh k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji yet' t'a yichanh junok tas snib'aj wal ochi.
Ha jelanil, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' wach' pensaril. Syak' kojtakejel juntzanh wach' razonal.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, sko chakkanel chukal. Tato jelan onh, max yal-laj kik'ancha'anh ko b'a. Max ko nib'ejochlaj chuk b'eyb'al yet' es.
Tato ay ko jelanil, syal ko na'an junok tas sko k'ulej t'a stojolal, tz'elnhejpaxk'ochi.
Ha yuj jelanil syak' yajalil heb' rey, tojol syutej heb' sch'olb'itan tastak yaj heb' yetanimail.
Yuj jelanil chi', a heb' ayoch yajalil, wach' syutej heb' stanhwan schonhab', wach' pax syutej heb' sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima.
Ha mach sayanek' jelanil yet' smasanil sk'o'ol, tz'ilchaj yuj.
Yuj jelanil chi', tz'aj ko b'eyumal, tzonh b'inaj yuj, ay pax kelk'ochi.
Ha tas tz'ilchaj yuj jelanil chi', yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata sik'b'ileli.
Yuj jelanil, sko b'eyb'alej wach'ilal yet' tojolal.
Ha mach snib'an jelanil, ol yik' sb'eyumal yuj. Ol b'ut'jok spat yuj masanil tastak wach'.
Ha jelanil chi', aytaxonek'i ayik ix el yich smunlajel Jehová, ayik manto sb'o masanil tastak,
ayik manto sb'o yol yib'anhk'inal tik,
ayik mantalaj ha' niwak mar, mantalaj pax sjaj ha' niwak ha' sk'euli yet' pax sjaj ha' kotak ha'.
Ayik manto sb'olaj lum tzalkixtak yet' lum niwak witz, ayxoek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ix yik'kanel yich jelanil Jehová ayik manto sb'olaj lum lum tik, mantalaj spokokal jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik ta'.
Ayik ix sb'oank'e satcha'anh masanto b'aj schalaj sb'a yet' ha' mar, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ayik ix sb'o'an asun ay t'a satcha'anh yet' pax yik ix syamanoch wa'an ha' mar,
ayik ix yalan t'a ha' mar chi' to manh ol el ha' b'aj aykani yet' pax ix yak'anem yich lum lum tik, aytaxon ek' jelanil chi' ta'.
Ha yuj sjelanil Dios ix sb'ok'e masanil tastak, ste tzalaj yuj tastak ix sb'o chi', yujto ha' sch'oxanel sjelanil.
Stzalaj yuj yol yib'anhk'inal yet' heb' anima sb'onak.
Haxo tiknaik ex anima, ab'ek wal tas tz'alchaj t'ayex, b'eyb'alejek jelanil yik te wach' eyiko'.
Chaek eyab' he k'ayb'ub'al, manh he patikejel jelanil.
Te wach' yik mach scham wal yab'an lolonel yik jelanil,
yujto a mach tz'ilchaj jelanil chi' yuj, tz'ilchajpax sk'inal, syik'anpax swach'k'olal Jehová.
Palta a mach max cha'an yab' lolonel yik jelanil, munil syik'kot ya'elal t'a yib'anh.
Ha ix wilani, ichato ay jun ix ix, ix sb'ok'e spat, te wach' ix aj yilji, uke' wal yoyal ix yak'em ix.
Ix smilcham nok' nok' ix, ix sb'o'an jun niwan wa'el ix, ix sb'o'an wino ix te wach', ix sb'oanb'at ix t'a sat smexa.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' ix t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak ay t'a yol chonhab'.
Haxo heb' schekab' ix chi' ix halan icha tik: Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek. Ex malaj he pensar, kotanhek.
Ol ex waok, ol eyuk'an wino to wach'xo yaji.
Aktejekkan he manh pensaril chi' yik wach' tzalajk'olal ol ex ajok. B'eyb'alejek sb'eyb'al heb' te jelan spensar, xchi heb' schekab' ix chi'. Ha jun ix ix chi', a jelanil sch'oxo'.
Tato tzal t'a heb' b'uchumtak to chuk sk'ulej heb', anhej lolonel manh wach'ok ol yal heb' t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' chuk to manh wach'ok syutej sb'a heb', tonhej ol ach sb'aj heb'.
Tato tza kach heb' anima ak'umtak, ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ayach. Tato tzal t'a heb' ay spensar b'ajtil tz'och spaltail heb', ol ach xajanej heb'.
k'ayb'ej heb' jelan yik wach' ol te jelanb'ok heb'. k'ayb'ej heb' anima wach' spensar yik wach' ol ste ojtakejel heb'.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato skojtakejel Dios to Haxonhej Ochi, tz'akan ko pensar sik'lab'il syal chi'.
Ha yuj jelanil chi', ol najatb'ok ko k 'inal, te tzijtum ab'il ol kila'.
Tato ay ko jelanil, kiknhej yaj wach'ilal. Tato b'uchumtak skutej ko b'a jun, munil t'a kib'anh ol kotkan ya'elal.
Ha junok ix ix malaj spensar, manh jantakok slolon ix, max k'ixwilaj jab'ok ix, malaj pax jab'ok tas snachajel yuj ix.
Tonhej tz'em k'ojan ix t'a yol xila, t'a sti' spat cha'anh yajk'e t'a tzalan t'a yol chonhab',
syawtankot heb' tojolnhej tzek' t'a yol b'e chi' ix, syalan ix icha tik:
Ex kelemtak mantalaj he jelanil, kotanhek, xchi ix. Syalanpax ix t'a heb' malaj spensar:
Ha ha ha' tz'elk'aji, te wach' yuk'ji ha'. Ha jab'ok wa'el sko wa t'a elk'altak te wach', xchi ix.
Haxo heb' winh kelemtak chi', manh yojtakok heb' winh tato a heb' winh yawtejnakkot ix, chamnakxo heb' winh tiknaik.
Ha juntzanh slolonel winhaj Salomón: Ha heb' uninab'il ay spensar, syak' tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol smam snun heb'. Haxo heb' malaj spensar, syak' kus sk'ol smam snun heb' chi'.
Tato skik' ko b'eyumal t'a chukal, malaj skak' yala'. Tato tojol ko b'eyb'al, tzonh kolchajel yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha Jehová malaj b'aj ol scha cham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yuj wejel, palta haxo heb' chuk jun, max chajilaj yak' snib'ej heb' yuj.
Tato malaj ko gana tzonh munlaji, skot mheb'ail t'a kib'anh. Tato tzonh munlaj sik'lab'il jun, tzonh och b'eyumal.
Tato ay ko spensar, sko molb'ejkan sat tas skawej t'a stiempoal. Tato tonhej tzonh way t'a stiempoal smolchaj sat awb'en chi' jun, skak' k'ixwelal ko b'a.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, manh jantakok swach'k'olal Dios scha heb'. Haxo heb' chuk jun, a yuj chukal sk'ulej heb', skotkan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, t'a wach'ilal ol aj snajikot heb'. Haxo pax heb' chuk jun, manhxa mach ol na'ankot heb'.
Tato ay ko pensar, ol ko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko k'ulej. Palta tato tonhej tzonh komon lolon jun, ol onh satel yuj.
Tato wach' ko b'eyb'al, malaj b'aj ol onh xiwok. Tato a chukal sko k'ulej jun, ol onh yamchajelta.
Ha heb' stz'eptz'epan sat sna'an junok chukal, skotkan niwak ya'elal yuj heb'. Yujto ste komon lolon heb', yuj chi' ol satel heb'.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, a ol ak'an wach'ilal t'a skal heb' anima. Haxo heb' chuk jun, a yuj chukal sk'ulej heb', ol kotkan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato ay ko chichonk'olal, a owal sk'e wa'an ku'uj. Palta tato sko xajanej heb' ketanimail, skak'nhej niwank'olal heb'.
Tato ay ko pensar, scheklajel ko jelanil t'a tas skala'. Tato malaj ko pensar jun, tzonh mak'jinhej t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.
Tato jelan ko pensar, sko ya'ilej tas skala'. Palta tato malaj ko pensar jun, tzonh te loloni, anhej chukal sk'e wa'an yuj tas skal chi'.
Ha heb' b'eyum, a sb'eyumal heb' skolani. Haxo pax heb' meb'a' jun, malaj tas syal skolan heb'.
Ha ko k 'inal sko cha spakok ko wach' b'eyb'al. Palta tato chuk skutej ko b'a jun, a ya'elal sko cha spakok.
Tato sko cha kab' ko kachnab'il, snajatb'i ko k 'inal. Tato max ko cha kab' jun, kennhej tiempo skila'.
Ha heb' elk'altak schichon sk'ol t'a junokxo anima, esalwum heb'. Ha heb' anhej aloj pekal tzek' yala', malaj jab'ok spensar heb'.
Tato tzonh te komon loloni, tz'och ko mul t'a skal tas skal chi'. Tato max onh lolon jun, ay ko pensar syal chi'.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, te niwan yelk'och icha k'e'en plata te wach'. Haxo pax spensar heb' chuk jun, malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha slolonel heb' wach' spensar, manh jantakok heb' sk'ayb'aj yuj. Haxo heb' malaj spensar jun, scham heb' yuj smanh pensaril chi'.
Ha yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, tzonh och b'eyumal, manh yujok b'aj tzonh te munlaji.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, ste k'echa'anh heb' ayik sk'ulan chukal heb'. Haxo heb' ay spensar jun, syak' tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol heb' yuj sjelanil.
Ha tastak b'aj xiw heb' chuk, a sjawi t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' wach' spensar jun, tz'elk'och tas snib'ej heb'.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, kennhej tiempo tzek' heb' icha junok chakxuxum ik'. Haxo pax heb' wach' spensar jun, aynhejek' heb' t'a junelnhej.
Tato sko chek junok jaragana, skab' sya'il yuj, ek'to t'a spajil yal nok' vinagre t'a k'e'en que, ek'to icha sya'il sb'at te tab' t'a yol ko sat.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, snajatb'i ko k 'inal. Palta tato chuk sko k'ulej jun, stzap ko k 'inal.
Ha tas sjawi t'a yichanh heb' wach' spensar, haton tzalajk'olal. Haxo tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chuk jun, max elk'ochlaj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' wach' sb'eyb'al. Haxo heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, ol satjokel heb' yuj.
Ha heb' wach' spensar tek'annhej yajek' heb'. Haxo heb' chuk spensar, manh niwanok tiempo tzek' heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, anhej jelanil syal heb'. Haxo heb' chuk slolon jun, maxtzak chajilaj lolon heb', ichato spolchajel yak' heb'.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, tzonh tzalaj yuj tas syal heb'. Haxo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, anhej chukal lolonel syal heb'.
Ha echlab' manh tz'akanok, max schalaj sk'ol Jehová. Haxo echlab' tz'akan jun, stzalaj sk'o'ol yet'ok.
Ha heb' ak'umtak, syak' k'ixwelal sb'a heb'. Haxo heb' emnakil syutej sb'a, jelan tz'aj heb'.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, a stojolal heb' chi' skuchb'ani. Haxo pax heb' chuk jun, satel heb' yuj schab'satil.
Ayik ol jawok sk'uhal ko ch'olb'itaji, manhxalaj yopisio ko b'eyumal, haxonhej ko tojolal ol onh kolanel t'a chamel.
Tato tojol skutej ko b'a, a tojolal chi' tzonh ik'an b'ey t'a wach'ilal. Haxo heb' chuk jun, hanheja' schukal heb' chi' tz'ik'an sateli.
Tato tojol skutej ko b'a, a tojolal chi' tzonh kolan t'a yol sk'ab' chukal. Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, a chukal snib'ej heb', a tz'ik'ankot t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ayik scham heb' chuk, scham heb' yet' tas ayoch yipok sk'o'ol. Maxtzak elk'ochlaj tas nab'il yuj heb'.
Ha Jehová skolan heb' tojol spensar t'a skal ya'elal, haxo heb' chuk tz'ochkan t'a sya'elal sk'exulok heb' tojol spensar chi'.
Ha yaloj pekal heb' chuk, satel heb' yetanimail heb' yuj. Palta a sjelanil heb' wach' spensar, ha' skolan heb' anima chi'.
Ayik sk'echa'anh heb' wach' spensar, ste tzalaj heb' anima yuj heb'. Haxo yik scham heb' chuk jun, tz'och k'inh yuj masanil heb' anima.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, sk'e wa'an schonhab' heb' yuj sb'eyb'al chi'. Palta haxo pax schonhab' heb' chuk, satel yuj schukal sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, chuklaj tas syal heb' t'a spatik heb' yetanimail. Haxo heb' ay spensar jun, cham na'ab'il slolonel heb' syala'.
Ha heb' alum pekal, syalelta heb' masanil tas tz'alchaj t'ay t'a k'ub'eltakil. Haxo heb' wach' spensar jun, a tas syab' heb', tonhej sik'kan heb' t'a spensar.
Tato malaj mach skuchb'an junok chonhab' t'a wach'il, manh tek'anok jun chonhab' chi'. Palta tato tzijtum heb' tz'ak'wi razón, wach' tz'elk'och jun chonhab' chi'.
Tato skak'och ko b'a fiadoral t'a junok anima manh kojtakok, chuk tzonh ajelk'ochi, tato max ko tak' jun, malaj jab'ok tas sko na'a.
Ha heb' ix ix wach' spensar, tz'ik'jicha'anh heb' ix. Haxo heb' winh winak pek' tumin, anhej k'e'en tumin chi' tz'ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Tato tz'ok' ko k'o'ol t'a heb' ketanimail, a t'ayonh syak' wach'il. Tato skak' chukal t'a heb' ketanimail chi' jun, hanheja' onh skik'kot chukal t'a kib'anh.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, a tas wach' scha heb' spakok yalani. Haxo heb' tojol spensar jun, wal yel te wach' tas scha heb' spakok sb'eyb'al chi'.
Tato sko b'eyb'alej tojolal, wach' ol ek' yib'anhk'inal ku'uj. Tato a chukal sko k'ulej jun, ol onh cham yuj.
Ha Jehová schakanel heb' anhej chukal ayek' t'a spensar sk'ulani, haxo heb' te wach' sb'eyb'al, stzalaj yet' heb'.
Ayik sch'olb'itaj heb' anima, max ek'b'atlaj yak'jioch ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' chuk, haxo heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, malaj tas tz'ak'jioch t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha junok ix ix te wach' yilji, palta malaj spensar ix, lajan ix icha junok k'e'en k'e'en xokanxokan nab'a oro ayoch t'a snhi' nok' chitam.
Ha tas snib'ej heb' tojol spensar, anhej wach'ilal yet'nak. Haxo tas snib'ej heb' chuk jun, anhej ya'elal yet'nak.
Ha heb' elb'en yuj, siejb'at heb' tastak ay t'ay, tz'och heb' b'eyumal. Ay pax heb' te ya yel yuj, ste kotkan mheb'ail t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha wal heb' tz'el t'a sk'o'ol yak'ani, yelxo wal ste aj tastak t'a heb'. Ha heb' skolwaji, skolji pax heb'.
Ha heb' max chonhanlaj ixim strigo, tonhej smolb'ejkan ixim heb', te chuk syal anima t'a spatik heb'. Haxo heb' yechel schonhan ixim jun, a wach'il tz'aljikan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' ayek' t'a spensar sk'ulan wach'il, a swach'k'olal heb' anima tz'ilchaj yuj heb'. Ha pax heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, a chukal chi' sjawi t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato a ko b'eyumal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, ol onh lajwokelok icha sk'ajb'anel te' xiltak te'. Tato tojol ko pensar jun, wach' ol onh elk'och icha syaxb'i sk'ab' te te'.
Ha heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'a smam snun, ma t'a heb' yuk'tak yet' t'a heb' yanab', malaj jab'ok tas ol ak'jokkan t'a heb'. Ha heb' malaj spensar, chekab' tz'ajnhejkan heb' t'a heb' ay spensar.
Ha spak scha heb' wach' spensar to snajatb'i sk'inal heb'. Ha heb' jelan, wach' smontan heb' anima heb'.
Ha heb' tojol spensar scha spak heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hanhejtona' heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' ajmul, manh ol ek'b'atlaj scha'an sya'elal heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Tato ay yelk'och t'ayonh ayik tzonh kachji, wanton ko xajanan jelanil syal chi'. Tato schichon ko k'o'ol ayik tzonh kachji jun, malaj ko pensar.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, sch'ox swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heb', haxo heb' chuk spensar jun, tz'ak'ji sya'elal heb' t'a smojal yuj.
Ha chukal malaj jab'ok tas syak' yipok ko k'o'ol. Haxo pax wach' pensaril jun, syak' wal ko tek'anil.
Ha junok ix ix te wach' spensar, k'ak' sk'o'ol winh yetb'eyum ix yuj. Haxo pax junok ix ix te chuk spensar jun, tz'ixtaxel winh yetb'eyum ix yuj.
Ha heb' anima tojol spensar, anhej tojolal nab'il yuj heb'. Haxo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, anhej ak'oj musansatil anima na'an yuj heb'.
Ha yuj slolonel heb' chuk, scham anima. Haxo pax yuj slolonel heb' wach' spensar jun, skolchaj heb' anima t'a chamel.
Ayik sjawi sya'elal heb' chuk, satel heb'. Haxo pax heb' wach' spensar, niwan tiempo syil heb' yet' heb' yuninal.
Ha heb' anima jelan spensar, wach' lolonel tz'alchaj t'a heb'. Haxo pax heb' ayoch chukal t'a spensar jun, patikab'il el heb'.
Ha heb' malaj yelk'ochi, palta ay heb' tz'ak'an serwil heb', te wach' yik heb' t'a yichanh pax heb' niwak winak syutej sb'a, palta malaj tas wach' swa'an heb'.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, sya'ilej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Haxo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, syixtej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha heb' smunlaj t'a sat lu'um tik, jantak tas wach' swa'an heb'. Haxo heb' malaj spensar jun, tonhej sb'alek' tiempo heb'.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, snib'ejoch sb'a heb' b'eyumal yuj chukal sk'ulej. Haxo pax heb' wach' spensar jun, ha t'a smunlajel heb' syik'elta tas tz'och yuj.
Ha heb' chuk, sya'alej sb'a heb' yuj es syala'. Haxo pax heb' tojol spensar jun, wach'nhej tz'aj yel heb' t'a tas sja t'a yib'anh.
Junjun mach scha spak yuj tastak syala', scha'an pax spak yuj tastak sk'ulej.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, wach'nhej tas sk'ulej heb' sna'ani. Haxo pax heb' ay spensar jun, scha yab' razón heb'.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, elanhchamel sch'oxel yowal sk'ol heb'. Haxo pax heb' ay spensar jun, tonhej smak'ek' heb' tas tz'utaji.
Ha heb' testigo wach', anhej yel syal heb'. Haxo pax heb' testigo chuk jun, anhej es syal heb'.
Ha heb' komonnhej sloloni, syak' echnaj spixan heb' yetanimail heb' icha yet' junok k'e'en kuchilub'. Haxo pax heb' jelan spensar jun, sniwanej sk'ol heb' anima heb' yet' tas syala'.
Ha heb' anhej yel syala', niwan tiempo syil heb'. Haxo heb' tz'esan jun, elanhchamel satel heb'.
Ha heb' chuk, anhej ak'oj musansatil na'an yuj heb'. Haxo heb' sayanek' junk'olal, a tzalajk'olal tz'ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha heb' wach' spensar, malaj chukal sja t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha heb' chuk jun, sja b'ulnaj juntzanh ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha Jehová schakanel heb' esalwum. Haxo pax heb' anhej yel syal jun, xajan heb' yuj.
Ha heb' jelan spensar, max yik'cha'anh sb'a heb' yuj tas yojtak. Haxo heb' malaj spensar jun, sch'oxel smanh pensaril heb'.
Ha heb' smunlaji, syak' mandar heb'. Haxo pax heb' malaj snib'ej smunlaj jun, chekab' tz'aj heb'.
Ha ilk'olal syak' kus ko k'o'ol. Haxo pax junok wach' lolonel jun, syak' ko tzalajk'olal.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, kuchb'um tz'aj heb' t'a heb' yetanimail t'a wach'il. Haxo pax heb' chuk spensar jun, skuchb'ejb'at heb' yetanimail heb' t'a chukal.
Ha heb' jaragana pechum nok', max sb'olaj nok' syamchaj yuj heb'. Haxo pax heb' jelan spensar jun, jantak b'eyumal tz'ilchaj yuj heb'.

Ha sniwanil yelk'och heb' ichamtak winak, haton heb' yixchikin heb'. Ha heb' uninab'il, ma isilab'il, sk'echa'anh heb' yuj smam snun.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, manh smojok syal lolonel yik jelanil heb'. Ha heb' yajal, manh smojok a es syal heb'.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan yak'an tumin t'a elk'altak, a sna'an heb' to wach' tz'elk'och heb', yujto yalnhej b'aj tzek' heb' syalnhej icha snib'ej heb'.
Ha heb' stechaj yak'an niwank'olal b'aj tz'ixtaji, snib'ej heb' to xajan tz'ilji heb' yuj anima. Haxo pax heb' hanheja' yalub'tanhan junok lolonel jun, tz'el heb' swach'k'o'ol heb' t'a stz'ey.
Niwan tas sb'o yuj junok b'elanh kachnab'il t'a heb' ay spensar, t'a yichanh pax to jantak smak'ji heb' malaj spensar.
Ha junok pitnhej syutej sb'a, anhej chukal saya', schekchajb'at junok chekab' malaj yok'elk'olal t'ay.
Tato sko chalaj ko b'a yet' junok nok' nun oso elk'ab'ilb'at yune', yelxo wal wach' kik t'a yichanh to sko chalaj ko b'a yet' junok anima chuk spensar wan sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' chuk syutej spaktzitan wach'il, malaj b'ak'inh tz'el ya'elal t'a yol spat heb'.

Icha yaj ha ha' molanek'i ayik sjakwielta ha', k'ojank'olal yelta ha' masanto sniwanb'i yelta ha', icha chi' yaj junok owal kennhej tz'aj yel yich, palta niwan tz'ajelk'ochi, yuj chi' wach' tato skak' niwank'olal a manto el yich owal chi'.
Tato a heb' juez tz'ak'an niwank'olal t'a yib'anh heb' ay smul, ma syak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul, a wal chab' chi' max schalaj sk'ol Jehová.
¿Tas yuj sja heb' chuk spensar yet' stumin, yik snib'ej heb' sman sjelanil? ¿Tas wal ol och yuj heb'? Ina toxonton malaj spensar heb'.
Ha heb' wach' yak'antaxon ket'ok, aynhejoch heb' ket'ok. Ayik ay ko ya'elal, icha wal ko k'ab' kok syutej sb'a heb' t'ayonh.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, yalnhej mach b'aj tz'ochkan heb' fiadoral, stak'wankanoch heb' t'a yib'anh.
Ha heb' scham wal stzuntzan heb' yetanimail, schampax wal heb' yak'an owal. Ha heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, munil syak' lajwokel sb'a heb'.
Ha heb' te chuk spensar, malaj b'ak'inh tz'ilchaj wach'ilal yuj heb'. Ha heb' slolon t'a chab'satil, skotkan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' smam heb' chuk spensar, malaj tzalajk'olal scha heb' yuj heb' yuninal chi', anhej kusk'olal scha' heb'.
Ha tzalajk'olal lajan icha junok remeyo, haxo pax kusk'olal jun, tonhej syik'el kip.
Ha heb' yajal chuk, scha k'e'en tumin heb' t'a elk'altak yik wach' max sb'olaj yaj owal heb' t'a wach'ilal.
Ha heb' ay spensar, a jelanil sayek' heb'. Haxo heb' malaj spensar jun, tonhej tzek' k'elelok heb'.
Ha heb' uninab'il malaj spensar, anhej yowal smam snun heb' syik'koti, anhej skusk'olal heb' syak' heb'.
Manh wach'ok tato tz'ik'jiel smultu heb' malaj smul, okxom wal to tz'ik'jiel junok t'a yopisio yujto wach' syutej sb'a.
Ha heb' malaj wal tas syala' yet' heb' syamoch wa'an sb'a, aj pensar heb'.
Ha heb' anima malaj spensar, tato max komon lolon heb', tzam nachaji to ay spensar heb'.
Ha heb' syik'el sb'a t'a skal heb' yetanimail, anhej tas snib'ej heb' sayek'i, max schalaj yab' junok razón wach' heb'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, malaj snib'ej heb' sk'ayb'ej junok tas, anhej heb' snib'ej syal yiko'.
Tato tz'och heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a ko kal, tzonh ak'ji k'ixwelal yuj heb'. Tato tz'och heb' b'uchumtak t'a ko kal, tzonh b'uchji yuj heb'.
Ha tas syal heb' anima ay spensar, niwan jelanil syal kik'an yuj. Ha tas syal heb' chi', lajan icha junok ha ha' jul yich, ma icha sikal ha ha' to sk'eul sjaj.
Tato ayik heb' tz'och smul syik' heb' winh yajal, haxo tas syal heb' malaj smul, max schalaj yab' heb' winh, yelxo wal manh wach'ok.
Ha yuj tas syal heb' malaj spensar, sk'e wa'an owal. Ha yuj tas syal heb' chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha yuj tas syal heb' chuk spensar, tz'ochkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Yuj tas syal heb' chi', munil sya'alej sb'a heb'.
Ha tas syal heb' alum pekal, lajan icha juntzanh tas wach' sloji, sk'och wal schi'al t'a sk'ol heb' tz'ab'an chi'.
Ha heb' jaragana yet' heb' sjuanel junok tasi, ichato yuk'tak sb'a heb'.
Ha Jehová lajan icha junok cuartel te wach', a t'ay sk'och heb' tojol spensar skol sb'a.
Ha sna'an heb' b'eyum to a sb'eyumal heb' lajan icha junok muro ayoch t'a junok chonhab' yik skolji yuj.
Ha ik'ojchanhb'ail tzonh ik'jiemta yuj, haxo emnakilal, tzonh ik'jicha'anh yuj.
Yelxo te k'ixwelal tato tzonh komon tak'wi ayik manto kab' junok lolonel sik'lab'il.
Tato tek'an spixan junok pena'ay, stechaj sya'elal chi' yuj. Haxo pax junok manh tek'anok spixan jun, maxtzak techajlaj yuj.
Ha heb' aj pensar, tz'ilchaj jelanil yuj heb', yujto b'ekan sk'o'ol heb' sk'ayb'ani.
Yuj tas ko siej, yalnhej mach anima tzonh cha'ani, wach'chom heb' anima niwak yopisio.
Ha heb' b'ab'el syal sb'a, ichato skol sb'a heb' sna'ani, palta ayik sk'och heb' yajk'o'ol heb' chi' jun, scheklajeli tas yaj yowal heb' chi'.
Ha suerte tz'alani slajwi junok owal, yuj chi' spojchaj snanhal heb' wan yak'an owal chi'.

Tato sko tzuntzejkot yowal junok ko k'ab' kok, más sekojtak ko satanel junok chonhab' ay smuroal yet' spuertail wach' yajoch yijchul t'a yichanh yik tzonh ochxi wach'il yet'ok, yujto tek'an yaj spensar.
Ha yuj tas skala', skot ya'elal ma skot tzalajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ha lolonel syal yik'ankot ko chamel, ma ko k 'inal, yuj chi' wach' tato sko na tas skala', yik wach' tzonh elk'ochi.
Ayik tz'och yetb'eyum heb' winh winak, tz'ilchaj wach'ilal yuj heb' winh, yujto scha swach'k'olal Jehová heb' winh.
Ha heb' meb'a' stewi heb', haxo heb' b'eyum, te ak'umtak syutej sb'a heb' stak'wi.
Tato te ay kamigo, ay smay tzonh ixtaxel yuj heb'. Palta ay pax heb' kamigo yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh heb' ko k'ab' kok.
Ha junok meb'a' wach' syutej sb'a, yelxo te wach' yik t'a yichanh pax junok chuk spensar tz'esani.
Manh wach'ok tato t'a smasanil ko k'ol sko komon b'oej junok tas manh kojtakok. Ha tas sko k'ulej t'a elanhchamel ay b'aj manh wach'ok tz'ajelk'ochi.
Ha smanh pensaril heb' anima skuchb'an satok, haxo tz'aji, ha t'a yib'anh Jehová syak'och heb'.
Ha heb' b'eyum, manh jantakok anima tz'och yamigook heb' yuj sb'eyumal chi', haxo pax heb' meb'a' jun, tz'aktajkan heb' yuj heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha heb' syak'och sb'a testigoal t'a tas manh yelok, yowalil syab' sya'il heb'. Haxo heb' tz'ak'an es, manh ol kolchajlaj heb'.
Ha heb' b'ekan sk'o'ol sian junok tas, masanil anima sayanek' heb' yuj yoch yamigook.
Ha heb' meb'a', spatikajel heb' yuj heb' sk'ab'yok, okxom pax heb' yamigo heb', ¿tom hato heb' chi' manh ol aktankan heb'? Toxonhej syixtej sb'a heb' yawtanxikot heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha heb' sb'eyb'alan tas wach' sk'ayb'ej, sya'ilej sb'a heb', masanil tas te wach' tz'ajelk'och t'a heb'.
Ha heb' tz'och testigoal t'a tas manh yelok, yowalil syab' sya'il heb'. Tz'ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh heb' tonhej tz'esan chi'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, manh smojok to syak' tzalajb'ok sk'o'ol heb' t'a wach'il, hanhejtona' heb' ayoch chekab'ok, manh smojok yak'an yajalil heb' t'a yib'anh heb' niwak winak.
Ha heb' syamanoch wa'an yowal sk'o'ol, ay spensar heb', sb'inaj heb' t'a wach'il tato tonhej smak'ek' heb' yuj tas tz'utaji.
Ha yowal sk'o'ol heb' winh rey ay smay icha junok nok' choj tz'awaji. Haxo pax swach'k'olal heb' winh jun, syik'kot wach'ilal icha yal ak'wal tz'em t'a yib'anh anh ank'ultak.
Ha heb' uninab'il malaj spensar, syab' sya'il smam heb' yuj. Ha heb' ix ix ow t'a heb' yetb'eyum, lajan heb' ix icha junok tz'uj st'ujt'ujani.
Sko cha ko pat yet' ko b'eyumal yuj tas syak'kan ko mam. Haxo ix ketb'eyum ay spensar, ha t'a Jehová sko cha ix.
Yuj ko jaraganail skot ko wayanh. Tato max yal-laj ko k'o'ol tzonh munlaji, ol kab' sya'il yuj wejel.
Ha heb' sk'anab'ajan junok cheknab'il, ichato wan stanhwan sk'inal heb'. Haxo pax heb' max yil sb'eyb'al jun, ol miljokcham heb'.
Ha heb' skolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', ichato ha t'a Jehová wan yak'an heb' majanil, haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'an meltzaj jun majan chi' t'a heb'.
Ko kachek heb' kuninal yakb'an yunetakto heb' yik max b'atkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha heb' skot yowal t'a elanhchamel, schaokab' spak heb' icha t'a smojal. Tato sko kol heb' t'a sya'elal chi', sb'eyb'alejnhej yowal heb' chi'.
Tato sko cha kab' razón yet' ko kachnab'il, ol onh jelanb'ok.
Manh jantakok tas sko na'a, palta anhej tas sna Jehová tz'elk'ochi.
Ha tas sko nib'ejoch t'a heb' ketanimail, to tz'elk'och tas syal heb'. Yelxo te wach' tato meb'a' onh t'a yichanh to skesej.
Tato ay yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, sko cha ko k 'inal, yuj paxi tzonh aj t'a tzalajk'olal, malaj tas skab' sya'il.
Ha heb' jaragana syak'em sk'ab' heb' t'a yol yuk'ab', palta te ajaltakxopax yik'ank'eta heb' tas ayem t'a yol yuk'ab' chi', yujto te jaragana heb'.
Ayik tz'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' puch winak, sjelanb'i spensar heb' mantalaj spensar. Ayik skachji heb' ay spensar, snachajel yuj heb' t'a elanhchamel.
Ha heb' tz'elk'an junok tas t'a smam, ma heb' spechanel snun t'a spat, te k'ixwelal syutej sb'a heb'.
Ex wuninal, tato max he cha eyab' he kachnab'il, wan eyik'ankanel he b'a t'a k'ayb'ub'al te wach'.
Ha heb' testigo chuk spensar, malaj yelk'och tojolal t'a heb', stzalaj heb' yet' schukal spensar chi'.
Wach'xo yaj ya'elal ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' ak'umtak. Wach'xo pax yaj te' jixk'ab'te' ol jixchajoch t'a heb' malaj spensar.
Ha heb' tz'uk'an anh, sb'ajwaj heb'. Sk'e somnaj heb' yak'an owal ayik syuk'an anh anh chi' heb'. Ha heb' syak'b'at sb'a t'a skal uk'el anh chi', te malaj spensar heb'.
Ha heb' rey te ow, lajan heb' icha junok nok' choj tz'el yaw yuj yowal, a heb' stek'b'ej sb'a stzuntzan heb', ay smay scham heb' yuj heb'.
Te wach' yik heb' max mojan owal. Haxo heb' chuk spensar jun, syak'och sb'a heb' t'a skal owal chi'.
Ha heb' jaragana, max munlajlaj heb' t'a stiempoal ayik tz'awchaj ixim awal, malaj pax tas sjach' heb' ayik tz'elul stiempoal jach'oj.
Ha tastak k'ub'ab'ilel t'a ko pensar, lajan icha junok ha ha' ay t'a yol junok olan jul yich, palta haxo heb' ay spensar jun, syalnhej snachajel yuj heb' tastak ay t'a ko pensar chi'.
Tzijtum heb' tz'alani to tzonh xajanej heb', palta chekelnhej heb' syal kak'anoch yipok ko k'o'ol.
Ha heb' tojol spensar, haton heb' malaj jab'ok chukal t'a sb'eyb'al, te tzalajk'olal skan heb' yuninal heb'.
Ayik tz'em k'ojan heb' rey t'a sk'ojnub' yik sch'olb'itan junok tas heb', anhej syilanoch jun chukal chi' heb', elanhchamel sb'o'i.
Malaj junok onh syal kalani to wach' ko pensar, mato malaj jab'ok ko mul.
Ha echlab' manh tz'akanok yet' ch'anh cuerda niwak, max schalaj sk'o'ol Jehová.
Ha yuj sb'eyb'al heb' anima, scheklajeli tato wach' spensar heb'. Yet' pax heb' unin, ha t'a heb' scheklajeli tato wach' heb', tato tojol pax heb'.
Ha Jehová ixb'o'an ko chikin yik skab'i yet' yol ko sat yik skila'.
Manhoknhej wayanh sko k'ulejek, ta ma'ay ol kot mheb'ail t'a kib'anh, kak'ek kip ko munlaji yik wach' ol yak' sobre tas sko wa''a.
“Chuklaj juntzanh a chonh tik,” xchi heb' smanwaji, haxo yik toxo ix manwaj heb' chi', syalan heb', “Te jelan onh, yujto yechel ix el tas ix ko man tik,” xchi heb'.
Manh jantakok k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en k'e'en wach' yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta a heb' slolon t'a jelanil, manh komonok tz'ilchaj heb'.
Ha heb' tz'och fiadoral t'a junok ch'ok animail, yik'okab'el spichul heb' yik syak'kan heb' yuj smajananub'alok.
Ha heb' tz'ik'an jab'ok wa'el t'a elk'al, manhxo jantakok swach'il swaji syab' heb', palta haxo t'a slajwub'alxo, icha wal to a k'e'en k'aj k'e'en tz'och t'a yol sti' heb' syab'i.
Ha junok tas sko na', wach' tz'ajelk'ochi tato sko k'anab'ajej junok razón wach'. Syal kak'an ganar heb' kajk'o'ol t'a owal, tato wach' skutej kak'an slajtial.
Ha heb' alum pekal, max sk'ub'ejel-laj juntzanh lolonel heb' k'ub'eltak yalji, yuj chi' manh junnhejok tzonh aj yet' heb'.
Ha heb' sb'ajan smam snun, slajwiel sk'inal heb' icha junok candil stupi.
Ha b'eyumal tz'ilchaj t'a sekojtakil t'a sb'ab'elal, ha t'a slajwub' kuseltakxo tz'ajelk'ochi.
Malajokab' b'ak'inh skala': Ol ko pak ko b'a, mokab' xko chiok. Anhej to skak'och Jehová t'a ko k'o'ol, yik A' ol onh kolanok.
Ha juntzanh echlab' manh tz'akanok, te chuk, chakb'ilpaxel yuj Jehová.
Ha Jehová tzonh ik'an b'eyok, yuj chi' manh kojtakok tas ol ja t'a kichanh.
Tato elanhchamel skak' ko ti' t'a Dios, slajwi chi' sko na'anxi ko b'a, te ay smay.
Ha heb' rey ay spensar, spechel heb' chuk heb' t'a yichanh, skan heb' chi' t'a yalanh yuj heb'.
Ha razón syak' Dios t'ayonh, icha sakil k'inal yaji yik skil ko b'a yet' ko pensar.
Ha heb' rey, yelxo te wach' yajoch heb' t'a yopisio, tato sb'eyb'alej wach'k'olal heb' yet' tojolal.
Ha heb' kelemtak ste tzalaj heb' yet' yip, haxo heb' ichamtak winak te niwan yelk'och heb' yujto sakxo xil sjolom heb'.
Ha heb' chuk, sja spensar heb', ayik smak'ji heb' t'a junok tz'u'um, syaktanpax heb' sk'ulan chukal, ayik staji schik'il heb' smak'ji.
Ha t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, hata' ayoch spensar heb' rey, icha sekojtakil sk'exchaj sb'e ha ha', icha chi' tz'aj sk'exchaj spensar heb' rey chi' yuj.
Ha heb' anima sna heb' to wach'nhej tas sk'ulej heb', palta a Jehová sch'olb'itan tas yaj spensar heb'.
Tato sko b'eyb'alej wach'ilal yet' tojolal, a juntzanh chi' ek'alto yelk'och t'a yol sat Jehová t'a yichanh juntzanh silab'.
Ha heb' anima malaj yelk'och Jehová t'ay, a tas sk'ulej heb' yuj yak'umtakil yet' yik'ojchanhb'ail, chuk toni.
Ha junok tas cham na'ab'il tz'aji, wach' tz'elk'ochi. Haxo pax tas komonnhej sb'o jun, a mheb'ail skotkan yuj.
Ha heb' syik' sb'eyumal yuj es syala', junnhej rato slajwiel sb'eyumal heb' chi', haxo chamel sjakan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' chuk, hanheja' schukal heb' chi' sataneli, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sb'eyb'alej tojolal.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' chuk spensar, manh tojolok, haxo pax sb'eyb'al heb' wach' spensar jun, te tojol.
Yelxo te wach' tzonh aj t'a junok yune' pat ko ch'okoj, t'a yichanh pax tzonh aj t'a junok niwan pat te wach' yet' junok ix ix aynhejkot yowal.
Ha heb' chuk, anhej chukal sna heb' sk'ulej, manh jab'ok tz'ok' sk'o'ol heb' t'a heb' yetanimail.
Ayik tz'ak'jioch sya'elal heb' puch winak, sk'ayb'ejkan jelanil heb' mantalaj spensar. Ha heb' ay spensar, tonhej tz'alji t'a heb', snachajel jelanil yuj heb'.
Ha Dios tojol toni, scham wal yilan heb' chuk, yuj chi' a tz'ak'anoch sya'elal heb', yik satel heb'.
Tato max ko cha kab'i ayik stewioch heb' meb'a' t'ayonh, haxo pax yik tzonh tewi t'a Jehová yik sko k'anan kolwal t'ay, max schapaxlaj yab' t'ayonh.
Ha silab' tz'ak'ji t'a k'ub'eltak, stup yowal sk'o'ol heb' anima yuj.
Ayik sb'o junok lolonel t'a tojolal, a heb' wach' spensar ste tzalaj heb', haxo heb' chuk spensar jun, ste xiw heb' yuj.
Ha heb' tz'ik'ankanel sb'a t'a wach' b'eyb'al, wan sb'atkan heb' t'a skal heb' chamnak.
