Yuj chi' a in swala' tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Chuklaj tas wan ex stanhwani. Ha k'e'en espada ol ex milancham wu'uj, ol ex em kuman, ol tzepchajel he jolom. Yujto ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'wok t'ayin, ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i. Ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal max scha in k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' a heb' in chekab' ay tas swa heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj wejel. Ay tas ol yuk'ej heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj takinhtial. Ol tzalaj heb', a exxo tik k'ixwelal ol ex ajkanok.
Ol b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, a exxo tik, ol ex ok' yuj kusk'olal yuj ya'elal.
Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wuj chi', ol ex yak' b'inaj heb' ayik ol skatab'an junokxo anima heb'. Ol ex in sateli, palta ha t'a heb' in chekab' ol wak' jun ak' b'i yik syak' b'inaj heb'.

Yalnhej mach t'a jun chonhab' tik sk'an wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, a t'ayin ol sk'ana', a in Dios in swak'elk'och tas swala'. Yalnhej mach syak' sti' t'a junok tasi, a in b'i ol yak' b'inajok. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', jantak ya'elal toxo ix ek'b'ati, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxo ol in nakoti.
Ab'ek, ol in b'o jun ak' satcha'anh yet' jun ak' yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha tastak ek'nakxo, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxa b'ak'inh ol nachajkotok.
Tzalajanhek t'a masanil tiempo yuj tas ol in k'ulej, yujto ol in b'oxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén b'aj ay tzalajk'olal, a heb' anima kajan ta' ol tzalaj heb' wu'uj.
Ol in tzalajpax wal yuj in chonhab' Jerusalén chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol ab'chaj yel yaw heb' anima yuj ya'elal ta'.

Malaj heb' unin jayenhej k'uhal ol ek' ta' ol chamok, malaj pax heb' icham anima manto k'och yab'ilal ol chamok. Tato ay mach scham t'a 100 ab'il sk'inal, unin animato schami. Ha mach ol chamok ayik manto k'och t'a 100 ab'il chi', a yuj schukal spet chami.
Ha heb' in chonhab' chi' ol laj sb'o spat heb', ol kajnaj heb' t'a yo'ol. Ol yawej yuwa heb', manh ch'okok mach ol loan sat.

Manhxo tonhejok ol sb'ok'e spat heb', ch'okxo mach ol aj t'a yo'ol. Manh ol yawej yawb'en heb', ch'okxopax mach ol loan sat. Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal heb' icha sk'inal te te'. Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wu'uj chi', najtil ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' smunlajel.

Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', manh nab'anhejok ol munlaj heb', manh ol cham yuninal heb' wanto sk'ib'i. Yujto a in chonhab' chi', a heb' anima wak'nakkan in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a in Jehová in tik, a heb' ay yinhtilal heb'. Icha chi' ol aj pax heb' yuninal heb'.
Ayik manto in yawtej heb', toxo ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ayik manto lajwi yalan heb', toxo ix wab' tas syal heb'.

Ha nok' okes yet' nok' kalnel, junnhej ol wa nok'. Ha nok' choj, a anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux nok' ichok nok' wakax. Haxo nok' chan, a lum pokok ol slo nok'. Ha t'a in tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, malaj junok tas ol yal yixtani. Ha in wal swala', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha satcha'anh in despacho yaji, haxo sat lu'um tik sb'akhnub' wok yaji. Ha exxo tik, ¿b'ajtil ol he b'ok'e junok in pat b'aj wach' tzin aji?

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in wal in b'onak juntzanh tastak ix wak' b'inaj tik, icha chi' ajnak spitzwicha'anh smasanil. Ha heb' te emnakil yaji, a in ol in tanhwej heb', haton heb' skus yuj smul, heb' ay yelk'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ay ex tzex tzalaj he k'ulan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak t'a wichanh. Yuj chi' ayik tze milancham nok' wakax silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a junok anima tze milchamok. Ayik tze milancham nok' kalnel silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a sjaj nok' tz'i' tze ch'umeli. Ayik tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en ofrendail t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a schik'il nok' chitam tze tob'emi. Ayik tze nhusan incienso t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato ha t'a komon Dios tzeyal wach' lolonel.

Yuj chi' toxo ix in na' tas ya'elal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Ha tas b'aj te k'un he xiwi, a chi' ol wak'kot t'ayex, yujto ix ex wawtej, palta malaj mach ix tak'wi t'ayin. Ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i, ix he k'ulan chukal. Ix he k'ulan juntzanh tas max schalaj in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Ha ex tze cha eyab'i, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ay juntzanh heb' eyetchonhab' schichon sk'ol t'ayex, tzex spechanb'eyek' heb', yujto tzeyal he b'a t'ayin, syalan heb' icha tik: Sch'oxokab' stzikikial Jehová chi', skil jab'ok he tzalaji, xchi heb'. Palta a heb' chi', te k'ixwelal ol ajkan heb', xchi Jehová.
Ab'ek jun nhilili sk'an skot t'a chonhab' chi', sk'anh skotpax t'a templo. Haton Jehová sk'anh skoti, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a smojal.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha chonhab' Sion, lajan wal icha junok ix ix mantalaj sya'il yune' skoti, tz'alji yune' ix chi'.

¿Tom ay mach ix ab'ani, mato ay mach ix ilan jun chi'? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'uhal tz'och nacional? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'uhal sb'o'i? Palta a Sion tik, kennhej ol yab' sya'il ol ochxok nacional.
¿Tom ol yal in yamanoch wa'an jun wan yalji, yujto a in swak' aljok? Ma'ay. Manh ol yalpaxlaj in tenanek' spitzwixi jun chonhab' tik. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', icha chi' ol ajok.
Ha ex tze xajanej Jerusalén, tzalajanhek yet'ok. Ha ex ok'nak ex yuj ayik yab'annak sya'il, mol tzalajanhek yet'ok.
Yujto a Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', syak'an yim, icha chi' ol aj yak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol, masanto ol ex tzalaj yuj, yujto niwan wach'ilal ol scha Jerusalén chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ol yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nación t'ay. Icha sjawi junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj sjawi. Icha junok nene' unin nib'ab'il ol ex utajok, ichato ol ex chunok, ol ex cheljok, ichato ol ex chenchenan t'a sat xub'.
Icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', icha chi' ol aj ex in montani. Icha chi' ol aj eyik'an sniwanil he k'ol t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ayik ol eyilan juntzanh tik, ol ex te tzalajok. Ol eyik'xi eyipok, icha tz'aj syaxb'ixi anh ank'ultak. Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová t'a skal heb' schekab', haxo yowal sk'ol ol yak' t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Yujto a Jehová ol jawok t'a kal k'ak', a scarruaje lajan icha chakxuxum ik'. Ol jawok yak'och yowal sk'ol t'a heb' ajk'ol icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'.
Ha yet' k'ak' yet' yespada Jehová, ol sch'olb'itej masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tzijtum heb' ol cham yuj.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios t'a skaltak te' awb'en te', stzalaj heb' sk'ulan icha sk'ulej mach skuchb'an heb', schi'an nok' chitam heb', nok' ch'o'ow yet' juntzanhxo nok' nok' yajb'entak, junnhej ol satel heb' smasanil.
Yuj tastak sna heb' yet' tastak sk'ulej heb', ol in molb'ej masanil anima t'a junjun ti'al, t'a junjun chonhab', ol in ch'oxan in poder yil heb'.

Ol in ch'oxan in poder t'a heb' olto kanok, ol in chekanb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Haton t'a Tarsis, t'a Fut, t'a Lud b'aj kajan heb' jelan sjulwaj t'a jul-lab'. Ol in chekanpaxb'at heb' t'a Tubal, t'a Javán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat t'a stitak ha' mar b'aj manh ab'chajnakok in b'inaji yet' b'aj manh ilb'ilok in poder. Ol b'at yalel yab'ixal sniwanil welk'och heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to t'a masanil chonhab', ol ik'jokkot masanil heb' eyetchonhab' ayek' t'a skal heb'. Ay heb' ol ik'jokkot t'a yib'anh nok' chej, t'a yol carruaje, t'a yib'anh b'akhlab', t'a yib'anh nok' mula yet' t'a yib'anh nok' camello. Icha junok silab' ol aj sjawi heb' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin t'a Jerusalén tik. Icha tz'aj yik'ankot junok ofrenda heb' in chonhab' t'a in templo t'a yol junok yet'tal te wach', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajkot heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ixto kani, hata' ol in sik'el heb' ol och sacerdoteal yet' levitail, xchi Jehová.
Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha ak' satcha'anh yet' ak' yol yib'anhk'inal ol in b'o'o, ol ajnhejek' t'a junelnhej. Icha chi' ol aj eyajnhejek'i, ol ex b'inaj yet' eyinhtilal t'a junelnhej.
Junjun sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'a junjun semana yet' juntak el tz'alji k'e'en uj, ol jawok masanil heb' anima, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayin.

Ayik tz'elta heb' in chonhab', ol yilan sniwanil heb' chamnak heb', haton heb' pit yutejnak sb'a t'ayin. Aynhejoch nok' ha'ay schianb'at sniwanil heb' chi', haxo k'ak' wan snhusantz'a heb', malaj b'ak'inh stupi. Yajb'entak yilji heb' t'a sat masanil anima tz'ilani, xchi Jehová.

Ha in Jeremías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hilcías, yinhtilal in heb' sacerdote kajan t'a chonhab' Anatot t'a yol smakb'en lum Benjamín. Haton t'a jun tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli.
Ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin ayik 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá.

Ix lolonnhej t'ayin ayik ayoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Judá. Ix lolonnhej pax t'ayin masanto ayik yo'il ujal yoch yuxluchil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, yuninal pax winhaj Josías chi'. Hata' ix ik'jib'at heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén icha preso t'a Babilonia.
Ayik ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ach Jeremías, yiktax manto ach wak' pitzwok t'a a nun, sik'b'ilachxoel wu'uj. Ayik manto ach alji, sik'b'ilachxoel wu'uj yik tzach och in chekab'ok t'a juntzanh chonhab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ach Wajalil, unin hinto. Maxto nachaj tas swutej in loloni, xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin: Manh ala' to unin ach. Anhej to ol ach b'at b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati, ol halan tas ol in chek ala'.
Malaj mach b'aj tzach xiwi. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ayinnhejoch het'ok yik tzach in kolani, xchi t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot sk'ab', ix yak'anoch t'a in ti', ix yalan t'ayin:

Haton wal tiknaik swak'och in lolonel t'a a ti'. Tzach in chekb'at t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik tzalan yab' heb' to ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel heb', ol lajwokem heb'. Ay chonhab' chi' ol satel t'a junelnhej, ay pax ol b'ochajxik'eok, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani: ¿Tas tzil chi' ach Jeremías? xchi. Ha jun te' k'ab' almendro swila', xin chi.
Yel tzala'. Ol wilnhej to a tas swal tik t'ayach ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin t'a schaelal: ¿Tas tzil chi'? xchi t'ayin. Swil jun lum chen wan xeji, wan stob'kot t'a stojolal norte, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha t'a norte chi', hata' ol kot ya'elal ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima kajan t'a tik.

Ha in Jehová in tik swal t'ayach to ol laj wawtejkot jantak soldado skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a norte. Ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén tik yet' t'a spatiktak juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en Judá. Ol jawok sreyal heb', ol sb'oanem sdespacho heb' t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik.

Haton jun ya'elal tik ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh heb' anima ix och smul t'ayin. Ix in yaktejkan heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix sb'o heb', hata' ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix snhusanpaxtz'a incienso heb' t'ay.
Ha tiknaik ak' ip, tek'b'ej a b'a, b'at halan masanil tas ol in chek ala'. Manh ach xiw t'a heb' etanimail chi'. Tato ol ach xiwok, ol ach wak' ib'xokk'e t'a yichanh heb'.

Ha tiknaik tzach wak'och icha junok chonhab' te tek'an, icha wal junok oy nab'a hierro, ma icha muro nab'a bronce. Yuj chi' ol yal a tek'b'an a b'a t'a yichanh chonhab' Judá, t'a yichanh heb' rey, heb' yajal, heb' sacerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.
Ol yak' owal heb' chi' het'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach telwok yuj heb', yujto ayinnhejoch het'ok ach in kolani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ixik, b'at halan yab' heb' aj Jerusalén to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Tzin nawalkoti ayik ex wak'anoch in chonhab'ok. Ix in he k'anab'ajej wal, ix in he xajanej wal, icha junok ix kob'es toto snupnaji xajanan winh yetb'eyum. Ix ex ochwal tzak'an wuj t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a lum malaj b'aj tz'awchaj tas t'ay.
Ayik chi' wiknhej heyaj a ex israel ex tik, icha wal b'ab'el sat awb'en. Ha in Jehová in swala' to yalnhej mach heb' ex ixtani, ix och smul heb', ix wak'kot ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'ayin.
E masanil ex yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, haton winhaj Israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.

Syalan t'ayex icha tik: ¿Tas in paltail ix yil heb' he mam eyicham? ¿Tas yuj ix in spatikejkanel heb', haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yal sb'a heb'? Yuj chi' manhxalaj jab'ok ix ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Majxo in snakot heb', wach'chom a in ix wik'elta heb' t'a Egipto, ix wik'an b'ey heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um, lum takinh sat, lum pak'kiltak, lum malaj mach kajan t'ay, lum malaj mach tzek' t'a sat.

Ha in ix wak'och heb' t'a lum te yax sat tik, b'aj te ay tas wach' syab'lej heb'. Palta a exxo yinhtilal ex heb' tik, ex kajan ex t'a sat in lu'um tik, ix eyixtejb'at lu'um yuj he chukal, yuj chi' maxtzak scha in k'ol jun in lu'um tik.

Ha heb' sacerdote maxtzak in snakot heb'. Ha heb' tzex k'ayb'ani, maxtzak in yojtakejel heb'. Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, haxo heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a sb'i Baal syalel heb'. Haxo t'a komon Dios syal sb'a heb', haton juntzanh malaj jab'ok tas wach' syik' heb' t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' owal heyet'ok yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal.

Ixikek t'a chonhab' Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, tzeyilan wal. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a chonhab' Cedar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'at yilan wal heb' tato ayxo b'aj tzuji icha wal jun tik.

¿Tom ay junok chonhab' skomon aktankan sdiosal, wach'chom a sdiosal heb' chi' manh Diosok? Ha exxo ex in chonhab' ex tik, ix in eyaktejkani. Wach'chom a in ix ex wak' wal b'inajok, palta haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, hata' tzeyal he b'a.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Ex kajan ex t'a satcha'anh, satokab' he k'o'ol, cheklajokab' xiwelal t'a he sat yuj tas wan yuji tik.

Ha in chonhab' tik, cha makan smul ix och t'ayin: Ha in tik lajan in icha sjaj ha ha' sk'euli, palta ix in spatikejeli. Ix sb'oanpax sdiosal lajan icha yet'tal ha ha' jateltakxo, maxtzak yal-laj skan wa'an ha' t'a yo'ol, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik, manh chekab'ok eyajkaneli, palta ¿tas yuj tzex ixtaj icha tz'utaj heb' chekab'?
¿Tas yuj ix och heb' anima ajk'olal t'ayex? Icha yel yaw nok' choj icha chi' yel yaw heb' t'ayex. Ix kan tzinan he lu'um, ix tz'ab'at he chonhab'. Manhxa mach syal skajnaj t'ay.
Ha heb' soldado aj Menfis yet' heb' aj Tafnes yik Egipto, ix smak'poj he jolom heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik ix eyik'kot t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix in he patikejel a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, yakb'an ix ex in kuchb'ej b'eyok.

Haxo tiknaik ¿tas tzeyak' yala', yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Egipto ay t'a sti' ha' Nilo? ¿Tas pax tzeyak' yala' yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Asiria ay t'a sti' ha' Éufrates?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala': Ha wal he mul chi' ol ik'ankot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh. Ha he pitalil ol ak'anb'at t'a eyib'anh. Nachajokab'el eyu'uj to te chuk ix he k'ulej yujto ix in he patikejeli, a in Jehová he Diosal in. Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a eyib'anh yujto malaj welk'och t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Atax t'a peka' ix ex och ijan he pitan he b'a t'ayin. Maj yal he k'ol ix in he k'anab'ajej. Ix eyalani: Malaj ko gana tzach kak' serwil, xe chi. Haxonhej ajmulal ix he k'ulej t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.
Icha wal tz'aj yawchaj te' uwa te wach', icha chi' ix aj ex wawani, lajan ex icha yinhatil te' uwa te wach'. ¿Tas yuj lajanxonhej tzex ajkan icha te' kaltakte'al uwa?

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Wach'chom tze komon b'ikejel he b'a yet' k'e'en yal ta'anh, mato niwan xapon tzeyak'ek' t'ayex, palta a he mul chi', chekel yajek' t'a in sat. Malaj b'ak'inh syal he sakb'ikani.

Tze komon halan icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko juel ko b'a kalan ko b'a t'a komon Dios, xe chi. Naekkoti, tas ix eyutej he b'a t'a lum ch'olkixtak. Tonhej tzex komon ek' jechechok icha junok nok' nun camello sayanek' nok' smam.

Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' kaltakte'al nun b'uru k'ajan sb'eyek' b'aj malaj anima, suk'lan nok' tzek' nok' ayik wan stajni nok'. Malaj mach syal syaman wanaj nok'. Ayik stajni nok' chi', sekojtak tz'aj schax nok' yuj nok' mam b'uru chi'.

Ex israel, aktejek he b'eyek' he sayanek' he komon diosal. Nab'anhej slajwi eyok yet' stakji he ti' he b'eyek'i. Palta a ex tik tzeyala': Ma'ay, ayoch ko pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ol kalnhej ko b'a t'ay, xe chi.
Icha wal sk'ixwi junok elk'um ayik syamchajelta, icha wal chi' ol aj he k'ixwi a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, heb' eyajal, heb' sacerdote yet' pax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok.

Tzeyal t'a junok te te' icha tik: Mamin, xe chi t'a te'. Tzeyalanpax t'a junok k'e'en k'e'en: Nunin, xe chi. Haxo pax t'ayin jun, a yich he patik tze meltzitejkoti. Maxtzak ex kot k'elan t'ayin. Haxo wal yik tzeyilani to ay tas tzex ik'ani: Kotanh, kolwajanh, xe chi t'ayin.

Ex aj Judá, icha wal sb'isul he chonhab', icha chi' sb'isul he diosal. ¿B'ajtil ay juntzanh he komon diosal ix he b'o chi'? Kotokab' heb', ol kilani tato ol yal ex skolan heb' ayik ol jawok ya'elal t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tas in mul t'ayex yuj chi' tzeyalub'tanhej to max ex in kolo'? Ina he masanil tze pitej he b'a t'ayin.
Nab'anhej swak'och eyaelal, maxtzak yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al. Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' choj te ow, tze milcham heb' in chekab' swak'b'at t'a he kal.

¿Tas animail heyaj a ex yinhtilal ex kan Israel? Maklejek eyab' tas swala'. ¿Tom malaj jab'ok tas swak' t'ayex? ¿Tom icha takinh lu'um waj t'ayex, mato icha junok lum lum te ay smay? Ex in chonhab', ¿tas wal yuj tzeyal t'ayin icha tik: Munil kik ko b'a, malaj tzach och ku'uj? xe chi.
¿Tom ol sat sk'ol junok ix kob'es t'a stonh, ma t'a spichul ayik sb'at ix t'a nupnajel? Palta a exxo pax in chonhab' ex tik, junjun k'u tzin b'atnhej satk'olal eyu'uj.
Lajan ex icha heb' ix ajmul ix yojtak b'e b'aj sb'ati, ayik sayanek' heb' winh winak heb' ix. Sat k'ayb'um heyaj t'a chukal.
Te chik'tak he pichul yuj schik'il heb' meb'a' yet' heb' malaj smul. Tze milcham heb', wach'chom malaj b'aj tz'och heb' elk'al t'ayex.

Wach'chom tze k'ulej icha chi', palta tzeyalan icha tik: Ha onh tik, te wach' onh, malaj ko mul, manhxalaj yowal sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Palta a in Jehová in tik ol wak'kot ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, yujto tzeyala' to malaj he mul.

¿Tas yuj tze pech he b'a yik tze k'exan heb' tze nib'ej skolwaj heyet'ok? Icha wal ajnak yel he k'ixwelal yuj heb' aj Asiria, yujto maj ex skol heb', icha pax chi' ol aj yel he k'ixwelal yuj heb' aj Egipto.
Toxonhej nhojan ex em yuj k'ixwelal ayik ol ex meltzajkot t'a Egipto chi', yujto toxo ix in patikejel heb' tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol chi'. Malaj tas ol eyak' yal yet' heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, tato ay junok ix ix spuk sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo winh ix, tato spukxi sb'a ix yet' winh schab'il chi', a winh yetb'eyum ix chi', maxtzak yal yik'lanxi sb'a winh yet' ix. Tato syik'lajxi sb'a heb' jun, a lum lum tik sjuwiel lum t'a yol in sat. Palta a in Jehová in tik swala' to lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix tzijtum swinak, haxo tiknaik, tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxikot t'ayin.

K'eanhek k'elan t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxalaj ste'al, scham eyilan lum jolomtak tzalan chi'. ¿Tok ayto lum tzalan chi' b'aj maj he k'ulej ajmulal? Tzex em k'ojan t'a titak b'e tze maklan yek' heb' tzex mulan chi' yet'ok, icha tz'aj smaklan heb' árabe yek' heb' tzek' b'aj malaj anima. Yuj eyajmulal chi' ix eyixtejb'at lum lum tik.
Yuj wal he mul chi' maxtzak yak' nhab' t'a stiempoal. Icha heb' ix ajmul ix maxtzak k'ixwi jab'ok, icha wal chi' eyaji.
Ina hato eyalan tik t'ayin: Mamin, wach' ak'an ket'ok yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto.
¿Tom aynhejkot owal t'ayonh? ¿Tom aynhejkot owal chi' t'a junelnhej? xe chi. Yakb'an wan eyalan icha chi', wannhej pax he k'ulan jantak tas malaj swach'il stechaj he k'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey Josías, ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: ¿Ix am wal il tas ix sk'ulej heb' etchonhab' israel? Icha wal heb' ix ajmul ix ix yutej sb'a heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' sk'ulej ajmulal t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Ha in tik, a tzin na'ani to ayik toxo ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi', ol meltzajpaxkot heb' t'ayin, palta maj meltzajxikot heb'. Ha chonhab' Judá te pit, ix yil tas sk'ulej chonhab' Israel ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok.
Ix yilanpax heb' to ix in puk in b'a yet' heb' israel yuj yajmulal, palta a heb' aj Judá chi' maj xiw jab'ok heb', ix empax heb' ajmulal.
Yujto malaj yelk'och ajmulal t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yixtejb'at lum lum tik heb' yuj smul chi', yuj pax to ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios nab'a k'e'en, nab'a te'.
Wach'chom ix yil heb' tas ix aj heb' israel chi', manh yujok chi' ix meltzajxikot heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, palta tonhej ix stz'ak meltzajkot sb'a heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel te pit heb', palta kennhej wal smul heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Judá. Ha heb' aj Judá chi' maj yak' elk'och tas ix yal heb'.

Ach Jeremías, ixik k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzalanb'at jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal ay t'a norte chi'. Ha wal Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex israel te pit, meltzajanhekxikot t'ayin. Manh owalok ol wutej ex in cha'ani, manh masanilok tiempo aykot wowal t'ayex, yujto tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex.

Anhej to tzeyojtakejel he chukal, to te pit ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik. Ha in swala' to ix och he mul he k'ulan ajmulal yet' juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il. Maj he k'anab'ajej jab'ok in cheknab'il, xchi Jehová t'ayex, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex in chonhab' te pit, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yujto eyetb'eyum waji. Junjun ex ol ex wik'kot t'a junjun chonhab'. Chatakwanh ol aj ex wik'ankot t'a junjun makan inhtilal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anxikankot t'a Sion.
Ol wak'och heb' eyilumal icha wal in gana, haxo heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh t'a jelanil yet' t'a sjichanil.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ayik toxo ix k'ib'xi he b'isul t'a he chonhab' tik, manhxa b'aj ol eyak' b'inaj te' skaxail in trato. Manhxa b'aj ol he nakot te', manhxo pax olto jawok te' t'a he pensar. Manhxo ol he b'o junokxo sk'exul te'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a Jerusalén ol alchaj yuj to in despacho yaj a in Jehová in tik. Masanil chonhab' ol smolb'ej sb'a t'a tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Manhxo ol yak' sb'a heb' skuchb'ajb'at yuj schuk pensaril.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', junxonhej ol aj chonhab' Judá yet' chonhab' Israel. Junxonhej ol aj he meltzajkot t'a jun nación t'a stojolal norte, haxo he jawikan kajan t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham.

Ex israel, ix in na' to tzex in chaoch wuninalok, swak'an jun lum te nib'ab'il tik t'ayex. Anhej wal jun lum tik te wach' yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ix in na' to ol in eyal he mamok t'a junelnhej, manhxo ol in eyaktejkan walani.
Palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to icha junok ix ix te chuk t'a winh yetb'eyum, icha chi' ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.

Tz'ab'chaj yoch jaj t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxa ste'al, haton heb' israel tz'el yaw yok'i sk'anan kolwal heb'. Ix elkan heb' t'a sb'e'al tojolal. Ix in b'at satk'olal yuj heb', a in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik.

Ex anima te pit, kotanhekxi t'ayin, ol wik'anel jun pitalil ayoch t'a he pensar chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' israel chi' icha tik: Ina kajek' tik, skak'och ko b'a t'a yol a k'ab', yujto a ach tik Jehová ko Diosal ach.
Nab'anhej onh xit'ek' t'a tzalkixtak, onh awaj cha'anh kak'an k'inh t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Anhej wal t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal tz'ilchaj ko kolnab'il.

Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto, onh och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel k'ixwub'tak chi', yuj chi' ix ak' satel tastak ix aj t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Ix champax yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb'.

Kik'ek em ko b'a yuj k'ixwelal, yujto a onh tik yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ix te och wal ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto masanto tiknaik, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syal t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Ex israel, tato t'a wal yel tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxi t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh he diosal yajb'entak chi'.
Hak'ek he ti' t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an elk'och tas tzeyala'. Ichato chi' b'i'an, ol in yik'ancha'anh masanil nación, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb', xchi.

Syalanxi Jehová t'ayex, ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén: Ix pitb'iel he pensar icha lum lum malaj mach smunlaj t'a sat, anhej te' k'ix sk'ib' t'ay. Komonok k'un tzeyutej jab'ok he pensar yik tz'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén, k'anab'ajejek in trato ix in b'o heyet'ok. Ch'oxekel in trato t'a he b'eyb'al, haton in trato chab'il eyu'uj. Ojtakejek eli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Tato ma'ay, a yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi' skot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh icha te' k'ak' manhxa mach syal smak'an tupok.

Alek juntzanh tik t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Hak'ek ok' k'e'en trompeta t'a masanil chonhab', xe chi. Te cha'anh tzex awaji tzeyalan icha tik: Ko molb'ejek ko b'a t'a yol juntzanh chonhab' wach' yaj smuroal, xe chi.
Ik'ekcha'anh he bandera sch'oxani to sb'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a Sion. Sayek ek' b'aj tze kol he b'a, manh ex och wa'an. Yujto ha t'a norte ol wik'kot jun niwan ya'elal ol satanel smasanil.

Icha yelta nok' choj b'aj ay, icha chi' ol aj skot heb' ol ul satanel juntzanh chonhab' tik. Toxo ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' yik tzul satanel he chonhab' tik heb', ol smak'anem lanhnaj heb', manhxa mach ol kan t'ay.
Yuj chi' ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i, ok'anhek, elokab' eyaw yuj ya'elal, yujto a wal yowal in k'ol a in Jehová in tik manto el-laj t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winh rey yet' heb' yajal, ol el yip heb' yuj xiwelal. Ha heb' sacerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, toxonhej ol satkan sk'ol heb', xchi.
Ix walan Jeremías in tik: Ay Mamin ¿tas yuj ix a k'exanh ti'ej heb' aj Jerusalén tik? Ix ak' a ti' ak'an junk'olal t'a heb', haxo tiknaik, a k'e'en kuchilub' ijanoch t'a sjaj heb' u'uj, xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol wal t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Ay jun takinh ik' skot t'a lum tzalkixtak ay t'a takinh lu'um. Sjawi xumnaj t'a stojolal in chonhab', manh ichok ik' tz'ik'anel smatz'il ixim trigo.
Ha jun ik' swak'kot chi', te ow t'a yichanh junxo ik' chi'. Ha jun ik' sb'inaj tik, haton ya'elal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ilek wal skot heb' soldado ajk'o'ol, icha wal skot junok asun skot heb'. Ha wal scarruaje heb' lajan sb'ey icha chakxuxum ik'. Haxo nok' schej heb' ek'b'al sb'ey nok' t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Ob'iltak onh wal, ol onh satelok, xe chama.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ik'ekel masanil chukal ay t'a he pensar yik wach' ol ex kolchajok. ¿B'ak'inhto wal ol eyaktej he na'an chukal?
Hato t'a Dan yet' t'a lum tzalkixtak yik Efraín, hata' skot yab'ixal owal.
Alek t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a Jerusalén to ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ay, hata' skot heb' ajk'o'ol. Tz'el yaw heb' skot yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá.
Ol oymaj heb' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, icha heb' stanhwan junok munlajel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ujok, yujto ix ste pitej sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yuj he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh. Ha yuj he chukal, te chuk tz'aj eyelk'ochi, syab' wal sya'il he pixan yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ay..., ste kus in k'o'ol, tz'och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan. Stinhtinhan in pixan yuj tas sjawi chi'. Maxtzak in em numan. Toxo ix wab' yok' k'e'en trompeta yet' yel yaw heb' soldado yik tz'och owal.
Tzoltzon sja ab'ix yik juntzanh ya'elal sjawi. Masanil chonhab' tik toxo ix laj juwib'ati. Elanhchamel ix lajwiem ko campamento, ix ixtaxb'at b'aj kajan onh.
¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol wil sbandera heb' soldado yet' wab'an spukhaj k'e'en trompeta? xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' in chonhab', te malaj spensar heb', max in yojtakejel heb'. Lajan heb' icha heb' unin malaj jab'ok spensar, manh jab'ok snachajel yuj heb'. Te jelan heb' t'a chukal. Manh yojtakok heb' sk'ulan wach'il, xchi.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix ch'oxji wil sat lu'um tik, tz'inanxonhej ix ajkani. Ix wilpaxk'e satcha'anh, manhxalaj sakil k'inal t'ay.
Ix laj wil lum niwak witz, ix ib'xik'e lu'um yet' pax lum tzalkixtak, ix laj tzikub'tanhaj lu'um.
Ix wilani manhxalaj anima, haxo masanil nok' sjenhwi toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.
Ix wilanpaxi, a lum lum b'aj ay awb'en, toxo ix kan tzinan lu'um. Masanil chonhab' toxo ix juwiemi. Yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová icha chi' ix aj masanil juntzanh chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil lum lum ol juwokb'atok, palta manh ol in satel lum t'a junelnhej.

Kuseltak ol ajkan lum lum tik, haxo satcha'anh ol k'ik'b'okkanok. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto icha chi' ix aj in na'ani, ix walan paxi. Manh ol in k'exlaj tas ix in na' chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj tas ix wal chi', xchi Jehová.

Ayik syab'an heb' anima yel yaw heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' heb' yet'nak sjul-lab', sb'at heb' elelal, b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', sk'ekan lotzlon heb' t'a sattak k'e'en tenam. Yuj chi' ix laj kan tzinan schonhab' heb'. Manhxalaj mach skajnajkan t'ay.

Ha Jerusalén wan slajwiemi, lajan icha junok ix ix nab'axonhej syak'och sk'apak púrpura, syak'anoch k'e'en oro ix wach' yilji, k'ik' syutej stitak sat ix yak'an uk'ok. Manhxa yelk'och b'aj sb'o sb'a ix chi', yujto a heb' winh winak nib'ab'il yuj ix, yajb'ilxoel ix yuj heb' winh. Toxonhej sna heb' winh tas ol aj smilan ix heb' winh. Icha chi' wan sk'ulan Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional.

Ha heb' aj Sion tz'el yaw chi'. Swab' wal yel yaw heb' icha yel yaw junok ix ix b'ab'elto tz'alji yune'. Sk'akwi heb', syak'anel li'an sk'ab' heb', syalan heb': Ay, ob'iltak onh. Ol onh miljokcham yuj heb' milum anima, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ek'anh t'a scalleal Jerusalén tik, tzilan masanil anima, tzilan t'a mercado tato ay junok anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, wach'nhej syutej sb'a. Wach'chom junok pitanh tz'ilchaj u'uj, ol wak' niwank'olal Jerusalén tik.
Ay heb' stz'akan slok in b'i ayik syak'an sti' heb', palta t'a es slok in b'i chi' heb', xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, a heb' tza nib'ej, haton heb' yelnhej syala'. Yuj chi' ix ak'och sya'elal heb' a chonhab' tik, palta malaj yelk'och t'a heb'. Ix ak' lajwokem heb', palta maj nachajpaxel yuj heb'. Te pit spensar heb', icha stzatzil junok k'e'en k'e'en. Malaj snib'ej heb' syaktejkan schuk b'eyb'al.
Ix in na' icha tik: Tekan a heb' meb'a' malaj wal jab'ok spensar, a heb' icha chi' sk'ulani, yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'.

Ol b'at in lolon yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, xin chi. Ha walani to yojtak heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'. Palta masanil juntzanh heb' chi', ix spitejpax sb'a heb' t'a Dios. Maj yal sk'ol heb' ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi'.

Yuj wal chi' ol elta nok' choj t'a kaltak yax lu'um, ol miljokcham heb' yuj nok'. Ha nok' okes ay t'a tzinan lu'um ol tzilchitanb'at heb'. Haxo nok' leopardo, ol laj k'och nok' t'a stitak schonhab' heb'. Tato tz'elta heb', chok' tz'ajkan heb' yuj nok', yujto te niwan smul heb' ix ochi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok spitalil heb'.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj ex wak'an niwank'olal? Ha heb' eyuninal, ix in yaktejkan heb', syak'an sti' heb' t'a sb'i juntzanh komon Dios to manh diosok. Jantak wa'el ix wak' t'a heb', palta maj in sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', molannhejek' heb' b'aj ay heb' ix ajmul ix.
Icha nok' mam chej nhepepi yuj b'ak'ech, toxonhej tz'el yaw jinhinhi yek'i, icha chi' heb', komonxonhej stzuntzejb'at heb' ix ix heb' ay t'a slak'anil, heb' ix ayxo yetb'eyum.
¿Tom manh ol wak'och sya'elal heb' yuj juntzanh sb'eyb'al chi'? ¿Tom manh ol wak' spak t'a junok chonhab' t'a smojal icha tas sk'ulej?
Ochokab' heb' ajk'ol satanel te' uwa, palta manh masanilok te' ol lajwokelok. Sjekokab'el te' sk'ab' heb', yujto manhxo wikok te'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ajok, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá in trato ix in b'o yet'ok, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, manh yelok tas syal heb' t'a spatik Jehová. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ha Dios malaj tas sna t'a kib'anh. Manh ol kab'laj sya'il yuj owal, ma yuj wejel.

Ha heb' schekab' Dios malaj yelk'och tas syal heb', manhok slolonel Dios syal heb', xchi heb'. Palta a wal Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' ix halan juntzanh tik t'ayin: Yujto syal heb' icha chi', yuj chi' a wal tik ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha in lolonel ol elta t'a a ti', lajan wal ol wutej icha te' k'ak'. Haxo heb' anima tik, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' k'atzitz. Haxo jun k'ak' chi' ol satanel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yinhtilal Israel, a jun chonhab' te najat ay, te tek'an, aytaxon t'a peka', ol wik'kot t'ayex, haton jun chonhab' to manh eyojtakok sti', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', te jelan heb' yak'an owal, a syamk'ab' heb' yik owal yet'nak chamel.

Ol slajel sat eyawb'en heb' yet' he wa'el. Ol smilcham eyuninal heb' yet' eyisil. Ol schianb'at nok' he kalnel heb' yet' nok' he wakax, ol sloanpaxb'at sat te' uwa heb' yet' sat te' higo awab'il eyu'uj. Ha heb' soldado heb' ol mak'anem lanhnaj he chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal ayoch yipok he k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.
Ha wal Jehová ix halan t'ayin: Wach'chom tzijtum ya'elal ol ja t'a jun pekti' chi', palta manh ol ex in satel-laj t'a junelnhej.

Tato ay mach ol k'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj syak'kot juntzanh tik Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh? tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Icha chi' ex yutej yujto ix he patikejkaneli, haxo juntzanh ch'ok diosal ix eyak' serwil t'a yol he makb'en tik. Yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ch'ok animail t'a junokxo makb'en manh eyikok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Alek t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Jacob kajan t'a smakb'en Judá:
Ex anima malaj he pensar, ab'ek juntzanh tik: Ay yol he sat, palta max yal-laj heyilani. Ay he chikin, palta max eyab'laj.

Ha ex tik, malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in tik ix in b'okanem k'e'en arena t'a stitak ha' mar t'a junelnhej. Wach'chom sk'e wa'an ha' sk'anh yem ponhnaj ha', palta max ek'laj ha' t'a k'e'en arena aykanem chi' wu'uj. Tato icha chi' in poder tzeyila', ¿tom manh smojok he xiw t'ayin?
Ha ex tik te pit ex, ix in he patikejkaneli.
Max he na jab'ok eyal icha tik: Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, yujto a tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a stiempoal, syak'anpax elul sat kawb'en t'a stiempoal, manh xe chiok.
Palta yuj he mul tz'och wa'an juntzanh tik, yuj chi' max yal eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol yet' juntzanh in wach'k'olal tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ha t'a in chonhab' tik, ay wal heb' anima te chuk, say modo heb' tas tz'aj yixtan heb' anima heb', icha heb' tz'ak'anem sya'alil nok' much.
Sb'ut' spat heb' yet' masanil tastak sutel heb' t'a heb' anima, icha tz'aj yak'jioch nok' much t'a yol ste', sb'ut'ji yuj nok', yuj chi' niwan tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuj sb'eyumal syelk'ej chi'.
Naynay yaj heb' yuj b'ak'ech. Manhxa yalnab'il schukal heb'. Max sb'olaj yaj heb' t'a stojolal tas tz'utaj heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' meb'a'.
¿Tom manh ol wak'kot ya'elal t'a eyib'anh yuj juntzanh tik? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak' spak t'ayex in chonhab' ex tik icha wal t'a smojal.
Xiwub'tak, satk'olaltak yuj tas tzuji t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, anhej es syal heb'. Haxo heb' sacerdote syak' yajalil heb' icha snib'ej. Haxo in chonhab' tik, wach' syab'i. Palta, ¿tas wal ol aj heb' ayik ol ja slajwub'?

Ex yinhtilal Benjamín, sayek b'aj tze kol he b'a. Elanhek t'a Jerusalén. Puek k'e'en trompeta t'a Tecoa, ak'ekk'e te' tab' ch'oxnab'ilal t'a Bet-haquerem, yujto t'a norte skot jun niwan ya'elal, niwan tas ol lajwokel yuj.
Toxo wal ol in satel heb' anima ay t'a Sion, heb' te nib'ab'il.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' soldado ol jawok heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol sb'o'an scampamento heb' t'a spatiktak. Ha b'aj ol kan junjun heb', ol satnhejel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' eyajk'ol chi', syal heb' icha tik: Kak'ek lista ko b'a kak'an owal yet'ok. Kotanhek, kak'ek owal yet' t'a chimk'uhalil. Palta anhej to wan yem k'u, wanxo yoch wewen,
yuj chi' t'ak'walil ol onh ochek kak' owal yet'ok. Ol ko mak'anem lanhnaj yet'tal heb' soldado stanhwan chonhab', xchi heb'.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te', tze b'oank'e he tek'nub' yik tzex och eyak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto haxonhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ha t'a Jerusalén chi' spak'cha'anh chukal, icha wal sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'. Anhej ixtoj anima yet' chukal sb'inaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ol janhej ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi'.
B'o'ek he b'eyb'al ex aj Jerusalén, yik wach' max wik'el in pensar t'ayex. Tato ma'ay, ol wak'kan tzinan he lu'um tik, manhxalaj mach ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik manhxa junok heb' ol kanok, icha tz'aj smolchaj sat te' uwa manhxa b'aj skan junok pitanh sat, icha chi' ol aj heb'. Yuj chi' yakb'an manto uji jun chi', kolkanel jantak heb' syal yelkani, icha wal tz'aj yek' heb' swach' molan te' sat uwa t'a sk'ab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi: ¿Mamin, mach ol ab'anok tato swal jun ab'ix tik? Icha wal to makan schikin heb', max yab'laj heb'. Tonhej sb'uchwaj heb', max schalaj sk'ol a lolonel heb'.

Mamin, skot pax yowal in k'ol het'ok t'a jun chonhab' tik. Maxtzak techaj wuj in yamanoch wa'an, xin chi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Hak'em yowal in k'ol chi' t'a yib'anh heb' unin tzek' t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a yib'anh heb' winh kelemtak umanek'i. Ol yamchaj heb' winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' te icham animaxo.
Masanil spat heb', smunlajel heb', heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', ch'okxo mach ol ik'ankanok. Yujto a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wik'k'e in k'ab' wak'an sya'elal heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, anhej tas syutej heb' yak'an ganar t'a spatik chukal sna'a. Hanheja' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sacerdote, haxonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak ya'elal syab' in chonhab', syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max k'ixwi jab'ok heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sk'ixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun k'ixwelal chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an sya'elal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' schonhab' icha tik: Ayik ex och tek'tek' b'aj skulusej sb'a b'e, ix walan t'ayex: Scham wal eyilan b'aj tzex b'ati. Tze k'anb'ej eyab'i tas b'eal yik'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton t'a b'e wach' chi' tzex b'ati, hata' ol eyik' eyip, xin chi t'ayex. Palta ix eyalani: Ma'ay, malaj ko gana tzonh b'at ta', xe chi.

Icha spukhaj k'e'en trompeta yik syak'an ab'ix to wan sjawi owal t'a skal heb' anima, icha chi' ix wutej in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ex skacha', ix in chekan yal heb' icha tik: Aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al tik, yik manh ol ja ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, xin chi. Palta ix eyalan icha tik: Malaj ko gana skaktejkani, xe chi.
Yuj chi' swalan icha tik: Ab'ek ex ch'ok chonhab'il, ojtakejekel tas ol ujok t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ab'ek he masanil ex kajan ex t'a sat lu'um tik: Ol wik'kot junok ya'elal te chuk t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, yuj chukal sna heb' sk'ulej, yujto maj scha yab' in lolonel heb', ix spatikejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'.

Ex in chonhab', ¿tasto yuj tzeyik'kot incienso yik chonhab' Sabá t'ayin yet' te te' suk'uk'i sjab' skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat? Maxtzak schalaj in k'ol juntzanh he silab' tze nhustz'aok, ma juntzanhxo he silab' tzeyak'a', xchi Jehová.

Yuj juntzanh tik ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ol wak'em junok tas b'aj ol slok sb'a eyok t'a yichanh heb' eyajk'o'ol. Eb' mamab'il, heb' uninab'il, heb' kajan t'a slak'anil heb' yet' heb' yamigo heb', lajannhej ol aj scham heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Hato t'a snajatil lum lum ay t'a stojolal norte, hata' ay jun chonhab' te ay yip wan yak'an lista sb'a skoti.

Yet'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' slanza. Te chuk heb', malaj yok'elk'olal heb'. Icha wal sk'anh sk'e wa'an ha' mar, icha wal chi' yel yaw heb' skoti, ayk'e heb' t'a yib'anh chej. Listaxo yaj heb' skot yak' owal heyet'ok a ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' anima t'a Jerusalén tik, ol yal heb' icha tik: Toxo ix kab' jun ab'ix chi', ix el kip yuj xiwelal. Te ya skab'i, icha wal yab'an sya'il junok ix ix ayik tz'alji yune'.
Manhxo ex b'at munlajel, manhxo ex b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e, yujto te ay xiwk'olal. Yalxonhej b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'o'ol yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, xcham heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab', ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i yik tze ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh. Ochanhek wal t'a kusk'olal, ok'anhek wal sik'lab'il, icha wal yik scham junok k'otanh eyuninal, yujto a jun mach ol ex satanelok, wan sja tzak'najok, xchi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tzach wak'ochi yik tzak'an prowal in chonhab' tik. Tza ch'olb'itej wal heb' sik'lab'il, tzilan wal tas yaj sb'eyb'al heb'.
Te pit heb' smasanil, alum pekal heb'. Ix pitb'iel spixan heb' icha stzatzil k'e'en bronce, ma k'e'en hierro.

Ayik slawaj te' k'ak' yet' junok lawlab', schakb'i te', tz'ulaxel k'e'en plomo t'a skal k'e'en plata. Palta haxo in chonhab' tik, wach'chom ix wak'lej in b'oan sb'eyb'al heb', palta malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok swach'il sb'eyb'al heb', max satel chukal t'a skal heb'.
Yuj chi' ol aljok yuj heb' to lajan heb' icha schukal k'e'en plata sjulchajeli, yujto a in Jehová in tik, ix in spatikejel heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik:

Ochanh tek'tek' t'a spuertail in templo a in Jehová in tik, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' anima: Masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá, mach ex tzex och t'a jun puerta tik yik tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel yik Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal: Tato ol he b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a sat lum tik.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a heb' tz'esani, heb' tz'alan icha tik: Kojtak wal to malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, yujto ayek' skajnub' Jehová t'a tik, haton wal stemplo tik, skomon chiej heb'.
Tato tze b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, tato wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayex junjun ex,

tato max eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ayek' t'a he kal, tato max he milcham heb' anima malaj smul, tato max ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh tz'ik'an he juwieli,
tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex wak'kan kajan t'a jun lum tik, haton lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham t'a junelnhej.
Palta a ex tik, tzeyak'och juntzanh esal lolonel malaj yelk'och t'a he k'o'ol.
Tzex elk'ani, tzex mak'wicham anima, tze k'ulej ajmulal, tze lok in b'i t'a es, tze nhusan incienso t'a Baal, tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios to malaj eyalan heyik t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tzex ja pax t'a wichanh t'a in templo tik, tzeyalani: Malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, xe chi. Anhej yik tzex elb'ati tze b'eyb'alanxi juntzanh tas yajb'entak t'a yol in sat.
¿Tom tze na' to a in templo tik lajan yet' k'e'en nhak'e'en b'aj sk'ub'ej sb'a heb' elk'um? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to swilnhej masanil juntzanh tze k'ulej tik.
Ixikek b'aj ek'nak chonhab' Silo b'aj ek'nak in kajnub', haton jun chi' in sik'nakel t'a sb'ab'elal b'aj in ch'oxnak in b'a. Hata' ol heyila' tas wutejnak in satanel yuj smul heb' he mam eyicham.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal tik, tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkani, palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'woklaj t'ayin.
Yuj chi' icha wal wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo chi', icha chi' ol wutejkan in templo tik, haton jun wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex tik, haton jun tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol tiknaik.
Ol ex wik'kanel t'a wichanh, icha wal ix aj wik'anel heb' eyetchonhab' t'a wichanh t'a yalanhtaxo, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok t'ayach.
¿Tom max il tastak sk'ulej heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak calle t'a Jerusalén?

Ha heb' yuninal heb' sayankot te' k'atzitz, haxo heb' mamab'il tz'ak'anoch te' k'ak', haxo heb' ix nunab'il sb'o'an ixim k'oxox pan yik syak'an heb' silab'il t'a sdiosalil, jun skuchan ix yajalil satcha'anh. Stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' ayik syak'an wino heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to manhok innhej tzin yixtej heb', palta munil syixtej pax sb'a heb' yak'an k'ixwelal sb'a.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun lugar tik: Haton t'a yib'anh heb' anima, t'a nok' nok' yet' te te' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil awb'en. Lajan wal wowal chi' icha junok te' k'ak' tz'eli, maxtzak yal-laj stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan t'a schonhab' icha tik: Hak'ek he gana eyak'an he silab', nok' snhusjitz'aok, tze chi'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi'.
Palta ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yuj nok' silab' snhusji yet' ofrenda.

Ha tas in b'ab'laj alejnak t'a heb' to tzin sk'anab'ajej heb'. Tato icha chi', a in ton tzin och sDiosalok heb', haxo heb' tz'ochkan in chonhab'ok. Walannak to sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal tas ix wala', yik wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb'. Ha tas sk'ulejnak heb' to yak'nak pitb'okel spensar heb', sk'anab'ajannak schukal spensar heb'. Oktom swach' b'oejnak sb'eyb'al heb', palta to swach' juejnakel sb'a heb'.
Yiktax yelnakkot heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, tzin cheknhejb'at heb' in chekab' yala'.
Palta a ex tik, max he k'anab'ajej, max he cha eyab' tas swala'. Te pit tzeyutej he b'a. Yelxo wal te chuk tzeyutej he b'a t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Ha hachxo tik ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh tik, wach'chom manh ol schalaj yab' heb' t'ayach. Alnhej, wach'chom manh ol tak'wok heb'.
Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex wal tik junelnhej te pit ex, malaj he gana tzex kachji yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Manhxa mach yel syal t'a he kal, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, joxekel xil he jolom yuj kusk'olal, tzeyumaneli. Ixikek t'a lum tzalkixtak kuseltak yilji, tze b'itan b'it yik kusk'olal, yujto toxo ix ex waktejkan yuj yowal in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh. Ha juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yajb'entak ix yak' wal och heb' t'a yol in templo. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel in templo chi' yuj heb'.
Ha t'a sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar heb' yik Tofet b'aj snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil. Manhok in ix in chek sk'ulej heb', maj ek'paxlaj jab'ok t'a in pensar.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ay jun pekti' to a jun ch'olan chi', manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, palta ol skuchkan icha tik: Lum Sch'olanil yik heb' mak'b'ilchamok. Yujto manhxa b'aj syal smukji heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ha t'a lum Tofet chi' ol b'at juljokkan heb'.
Ha sniwanil heb' anima ayek' tiknaik t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te'. Manhxa mach ol xib'tan nok' t'a heb'.

Ol wak' satel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Judá. Haxo t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén, manhxa b'it yik k'inh yet' yik tzalajk'olal. Manhxa pax b'it yik nupnajel ol ochok. Ichaxonhej tzinan lu'um ol ajkan jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol joychajk'eta sb'akil heb' ak'annak reyal t'a Judá b'aj mukan, sb'akil heb' ak'annak yajalil, sb'akil heb' sacerdote, sb'akil heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' sb'akil pax juntzanhxo heb' ek'nak kajan t'a Jerusalén.

Ol laj b'atkan lean sb'akil heb' chi' t'a yok k'u, t'a yok k'e'en uj yet' t'a yok k'e'en k'anal. Ayik pitzanto heb', xajan juntzanh chi' yuj heb', yak'nak serwil heb', yalnak sb'a heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' malaj mach ol molank'e sb'akil heb' chi' yik smukchaji. Ol kannhej ta' icha tz'ajkan stza' nok' nok'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala' to a jantak heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a skal juntzanh anima te chuk tik, ol snib'ej cham sb'a heb' t'a yichanh to pitzan b'aj ol in saklemkanb'at heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías icha tik tzutej halan t'a jun in chonhab' tik: Tato ay junok mach stelwi, tokwal maxtzak k'e wa'an. Tato ay junok mach satb'at t'a junok b'e, tokwal maxtzak sayxi sb'e chi'.

Palta a exxo tik ex israel, ¿tas yuj tzeyik'el he b'a t'ayin? Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿tas yuj maxtzak ex meltzajxi t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och he pensar, haxo t'ayin malaj he gana he meltzajxi?

Ix in maklej wal wab'i, palta malaj mach slolon t'a stojolal. Malaj wal junok mach sna sb'a t'a schukal syalani: ¿Tas wal ix in k'ulej? manh xchiok. Sb'atkan heb' smasanil t'a yol b'e, icha sb'at lemnaj nok' chej t'a owal.

Ha nok' cigüeña tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha'anh, yojtak nok' b'ak'inh ol meltzaj nok'. Yet' nok' kuwajte', nok' sanhkapech yet' nok' grulla, yojtak nok' b'ak'inh ol b'at nok' t'a junokxo lugar. Ha exxo pax tik ex in chonhab', manh eyojtakok jab'ok in k'ayb'ub'al.
¿Tas yuj tzeyala' to ay he pensar, eyojtak in k'ayb'ub'al eyalani? Palta haxo heb' slaj tz'ib'anelta in k'ayb'ub'al, slaj sk'ex heb' tas syala'.
Ha juntzanh heb' jelan yalan chi', ol k'ixwokkanel heb', ol somchajk'e sk'ol heb', ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix spatikejel in lolonel heb', yuj chi' ¿b'ajtil ol yik' sjelanil heb'?

Yuj wal chi' ol wak'kanoch heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok winakil, haxo slu'um heb' ch'ok mach ol ikankanok. Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, haxonhej yak'an ganar heb' t'a spatik chukal, a chi' sna heb'. Icha pax chi' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sacerdote, haxonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak ya'elal syab' in chonhab'. Syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max k'ixwi heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sk'ixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun k'ixwelal chi'. Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an sya'elal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el heb' in chonhab' t'a tik, yujto icha wal junok snunal te' uwa, ma junok ste'al te' higo malaj sat, tonhej sk'ajb'anel xi'il ayik wan stakjieli, icha chi' yaj heb'. Yuj chi' a tas ix wak' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ol wik'xiek' t'a heb', xchi.

Ol yal heb' aj Judá icha tik: ¿Tas yuj tzonh kan t'a tik? Ko molb'ejek ko b'a, konh b'atekkan t'a chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal. Hata' ol ko kol ko b'a, wach'chom t'a skal owal ol onh chamok. Ha Jehová ko Diosal tzonh sataneli, yujto ix och ko mul t'ay, ichato ix yak' kuk' ha ha' ayb'at veneno t'a skal.
Ix ko na' to wach' ol onh elk'ochok, palta malaj tas wach' ix ak'ji t'ayonh. Ha ko na'ani to tzalajk'olal ol onh ajok, palta anhej xiwk'olal ix jawi t'ayonh.

Wan sjawi heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh. Sjornaj snhi' nok' schej heb' t'a Dan, skab'ul hato t'a tik. Ayik tz'ok' nok', tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik. Sjawi heb' satel ko chonhab' tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' masanil onh kajan onh t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'kot chamel t'a he kal icha wal schiwaj nok' chan te ow schiwaji. Manhxalaj mach syal yak'an nanamax nok', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha in kusk'olal tik manhxalaj yanhal, slajwi wal el in pixan yuj swab'i.

Tz'ab'chaj wal yel yaw heb' wetchonhab' t'a smasanil yol ko makb'en. Syalan heb', ¿tom manhxo ayokek' Jehová t'a Sion? ¿Tom manhxo ayokek' ko reyal sik'b'il och yuj Jehová ta'? xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol ayik ix ex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios, juntzanh yechel malaj yelk'ochi, ch'ok b'aj kotnak? xchi.
Syalan heb' anima icha tik: Toxo ix ek'b'at stiempoal ko kolji, icha yek'b'at stiempoal jochoj trigo, ma icha yek'b'at stiempoal smolchaj sat awb'en, xchi heb'.
Swab' wal sya'il yuj sya'elal heb' wetchonhab'. Toxo ix k'echa'anh kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'ayin.
Yakb'an ay yanhal t'a Galaad, ay pax heb' syal yanhtan ta', ¿tas yuj max anhtaj in chonhab' tik?
Komonok lajan in sat tik icha sjaj ha ha' tz'el yok, yik k'uhal t'ak'wal tzin ok' yuj jantak heb' wetchonhab' ix chami.
Komonok ay junok b'aj syal waj t'a tzinan lu'um, yik wach' najat tzin b'atkan t'a in chonhab' tik. Yujto ix spatikejel Dios heb', ixtum anima heb'.

Te jelan yesan heb'. Sk'e wal cha'anh heb' yet' es chi', icha wal junok mach sk'echa'anh ste julanel sjul-lab'. Manhxa jab'ok tas yel tz'alji. Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Masnhej ste chukb'iel heb'. Maxtzak yal sk'ol heb' tzin yaloch sDiosalok.
Ach Jeremías, manhxo ak'och heb' amigo yet' heb' a k'ab' ok yipok a k'o'ol, yujto chuklaj tas wan sna'an heb' t'a a patik. Ha tas sna masanil heb' amigo chi', syik'lajkot heb' t'a yib'anh junjun.
Syak'laj musansatil sb'a heb'. Manhxa mach slolon t'a yel. Toxo ix te k'ay heb' yesani. Maxtzak yal sk'exan spensar heb'.
Ha wal tas ay t'a skal heb', anhej ak'oj musansatil, ixtoj anima, yuj chi' maxtzak yal sk'ol heb' tzin yal sDiosalok.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala': ¿Tasto wal junokxo syal in k'ulan yet' in chonhab' tik? Anhej to ol wak'och heb' t'a sya'elal, icha tz'aj yak'jioch k'e'en plata t'a kal k'ak', yik tz'el schukal k'e'en.

Ha tas tz'elta t'a sti' heb' lajan icha jul-lab' jay ye scham anima yuj. Haxonhej es tzek' yal heb'. Wach' sk'umlan sb'a heb' yet' heb' yamigo yalani, palta haxo t'a spensar heb' wan sna'ani tas ol yutej heb' yak'an chukal t'a heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tom manh smojok wak'anoch sya'elal heb' yuj tas sk'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manh smojok wak'an spak t'a in chonhab' tik?

Ix walanxi a in Jeremías in tik: Tzin te ok' wal yuj lum tzalkixtak, tzin kus wal yuj lum takinhtak sat b'aj swa nok' nok', yujto toxo ix te takji sat lu'um. Manhxa mach tzek' ta'. Manhxa junok nok' wakax tz'ab'chaj yok'i. Ha nok' kaltakte'al nok' yet' nok' much toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.

Ix wab' yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha jun chonhab' Jerusalén tik, icha junok b'ulanh k'e'en b'aj kajan nok' niwak okes, icha chi' ol wutejkani. Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol kan tzinan. Manhxa junok anima ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Malaj junok onh snachajel ku'uj tas yuj a jun ko chonhab' tik tzinan lu'um ix ajkani. Al t'ayonh tas yuj icha chi' ix ajkani, xin chi t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Icha tik ix aji yujto ix spatikejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej heb', maj sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ix yak'an wal pitb'okel spensar heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, icha ix aj sk'ayb'ajkan heb' yuj smam yicham.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swala': Ol wak' yab' sya'il heb' t'a junjun k'u, ol k'e wal chi'an sat heb' yab'an sya'il icha sk'a'il junok tas k'a' swa heb', ma syuk' heb'.

Ol in saklemankanb'at heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' manh yojtakok yet' pax heb' smam yicham heb' manh yojtakok heb'. Ol in chekb'at heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', masanto ol satel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, b'at chekek ik'chajkot heb' ix ix aytaxonoch t'a yib'anh yok'i.
Yalokab' heb' aj Jerusalén: Kotokab' heb' ix t'a elanhchamel, kusokab' heb' ix ku'uj. B'ut'jokab'el yol ko sat yuj ya'al, elokab' b'ulnaj xil ko sat yuj jantak yal ko sat kok'i, xchiokab' heb'.

Ha t'a chonhab' Sion, tz'ab'chaj wal yoch ok'el yuj kusk'olal. Syalan heb' icha tik: Te ob'iltak onh, wan ko sateli, skab' wal sya'il yuj k'ixwelal. Ha tiknaik, yowalil skaktejkan ko chonhab' tik, yujto toxo ix laj em lanhnaj ko pat, xchi heb' tz'ok' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ex ix, maklejek eyab' slolonel Jehová, ak'ek wal och he chikin t'a tas syala'. k'ayb'ejek heb' eyune' yet' heb' ix wach' eyak'an yet'ok yik tz'ok' heb' yuj skusk'olalil chamel.
Ha chamel toxo ix och t'a yoltak ko pat, toxo ix k'och t'a yoltak ko palacio. Slaj cham heb' unin t'a yoltak calle, schampax heb' kelemtak t'a yoltak chonhab'.

Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Toxonhej saktzipinak ol ajkan sniwanil heb' anima, icha tz'ajkan tzipan stza' nok' nok' t'a ak'liktak. Icha wal tz'ajkan ixim trigo manojail t'a spatik heb' sjochani tato malaj mach smolank'e wa'an ixim, icha chi' ol ajkan heb', xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' jelan, mokab' yak'och sjelanil heb' chi' yipok sk'o'ol, heb' ay yip, mokab' yak'och yip heb' chi' yipok sk'o'ol, hanhejtona' heb' b'eyum, mokab' yak'och sb'eyumal heb' chi' yipok sk'o'ol.

Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay mach ay tas syak'och yipok sk'o'ol, a in okab' tzin yak'och yipok sk'o'ol, tzin yojtakaneli to a in Jehová in. Swak'elk'och swach'il in k'o'ol, tzin ch'olb'itan tas yaj anima t'a stojolal. Haton juntzanh tik snib'ej in k'o'ol sb'eyb'alej heb' anima, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Wan sja stiempoal wak'an sya'elal heb' aj Egipto, heb' aj Judá, heb' aj Edom, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Moab yet' heb' kajan t'a tzinan lu'um, haton heb' sjoxel xil spak'ul sti'. Masanil juntzanh anima chi' ak'b'il circuncidar heb', palta max sk'anab'ajej jun trato sch'oxan jun yechel chi' heb', hanhejtona' pax heb' israel max sk'anab'ajej heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix wal icha tik: E masanil ex wetchonhab' israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.
Ha tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo nación, manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh tas sch'ox sb'a t'a satcha'anh, icha syutej sb'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.
Ha sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación chi', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Sb'at suykot junok te yib' te' heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo junok winh nhikum te' snhikan te' yet' syamk'ab'.
Slajwi chi' syak'anoch k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro winh yelwanub'ok. Smak'anb'at slawuxal te' winh yet' k'e'en martillo yik stzatzb'i te', yik max el k'otnaj te'.

Ha juntzanh yechel chi', lajan icha xib'tanub'al nok' much t'a skal junok awb'en. Max yal-laj sloloni. Yowalil skuchji b'eyek'ok, yujto max yal-laj sb'eyi. Manh ex xiw t'a juntzanh chi', yujto malaj chukal, ma wach'il syak' t'a heb' anima, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok, yujto te niwan elk'ochi, te b'inajnak ach, syal uj smasanil.

Ach sReyal masanil nación, ¿tom ay junok mach manh smojok xiw t'ayach? Smoj wal te niwan elk'och t'a masanil anima. Ha t'a skal heb' jelan yet' t'a skal heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok.
Masanil heb' anima chi' malaj spensar heb', malaj sjelanil heb', max yal sk'ayb'aj jab'ok heb' yuj juntzanh yechel b'ob'il t'a te te' chi'.

Ha juntzanh yechel komon Dios chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' tenum k'e'en, nab'a plata, haton k'e'en ik'b'ilkot t'a Tarsis yet' k'e'en oro ik'b'ilkot t'a Ufaz. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak yilji yet' k'apak chakchak k'apak ayoch spichulok. Masanil juntzanh chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' anima jelan spensar sb'o'an tastak.

Haxo Jehová, haton Dios pitzan, Dios t'a wal yel, Rey t'a junelnhej. Ayik skot yowal, tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik yuj. Maxtzak yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a yichanh yowal sk'ol Jehová chi'.
Ex wetisraelal, alek t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il icha tik: Ha juntzanh komon Dios, manhok b'oannak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, ol satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manhxa junok ol kanok, xe chi.
Ha Jehová b'oannak lum lum tik yet' spoder, a yet' sjelanil sb'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hanheja' yet' sjelanil chi' sb'onak pax satcha'anh.

Ayik tz'awaj Jehová chi', tz'ib'xik'e ha ha' t'a satcha'anh, sk'e wa'an asun t'a cha'anh yuj masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. Tz'ek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a skal niwak yaxnhab' yuj, sjakanelta ik' b'aj molan yuj.

Masanil heb' anima tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'o'ol, malaj spensar heb', malaj tas yojtak heb'. Masanil heb' tenum k'e'en, tz'ak'ji k'ixwelal heb' yuj juntzanh yechel sb'o chi'. Ha juntzanh yechel sb'o heb' chi', malaj yelk'ochi, malaj spixan.
Ha juntzanh yechel chi', malaj jab'ok yopisio, smoj wal stzetzaji. Ayik ol jawok ya'elal yuj Jehová, ol satelok.
Te ch'ok yel ko Diosal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ha b'oannak masanil tasi, ix onh sik'anpaxel a onh israel onh tik yik tzonh ochkan yikok. Ha sb'i, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ex aj Jerusalén, oyb'ilxok'e ko chonhab' yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, molb'ejek masanil he k'a'el.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik ol in molkot ya'elal t'a he patik masanto ol yal eyamchaji. Masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ex in pechb'at t'a najat, icha tz'aj sjuljib'at junok k'e'en k'e'en yet' ch'anh mejme'ech, xchi.
Ix walan a in Jeremías in tik: Ob'iltak in, wan wab'an sya'il. Ha wechen tik malaj yanhal. Ha jun ya'elal tik wik yaji yuj chi' ol wak' techajok.
Toxo ix em lanhnaj ko pat, icha mantiado st'inhchaj sch'anhal. Toxo ix cham heb' kuninal, ix onh yaktejkan heb', yuj chi' manhxa mach skolwaj ket'ok yik slich'ank'e jab'ok kenhul.
Ha heb' yilumal ko chonhab', malaj spensar heb'. Max sk'an sjelanil heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' onh saklemb'at icha nok' kalnel.

Ab'ek wal sjawi jun ab'ix tik. Ay jun chonhab' skot t'a stojolal norte nhilili sk'anh skoti. Ha jun chi' ol ak'ankanoch juntzanh ko chonhab' tik tzinan lumal. Haxonhej nok' niwak okes ol kajnajkan t'ay.
Mamin Jehová, wojtak sik'lab'il to a onh anima onh tik manh kojtakok tas ol aj kelk'ochi. Max nachaj kuj tastak sjawi t'a kichanh.
Ak' ko ya'elal icha wal t'a stojolal, palta manhokab' yet' yowal a k'o'ol yik max onh a sateli.

Hak'em yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, juntzanh chonhab' to manh ach ojtannakok, juntzanh chonhab' max yal sb'a t'ayach, yujto ix satel ko chonhab' heb' a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Junelnhej ix onh satel heb'. Ix laj yak'kan tzinan ko chonhab' tik heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:
Ab' wal tas syal in trato, tzalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' to a in Jehová sDiosal in heb', a in swala' to skatab'aj mach max k'anab'ajan tas syal in trato tik.

Haton in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham, ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha jun nación chi', lajan yaj t'a heb' icha junok horno b'aj stz'a k'e'en hierro. Walannak t'a heb': k'anab'ajejinek, b'o'ek masanil tas swala'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ha exxo pax tik, tato ol in he k'anab'ajej, ol wak'nhej elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, yik swak'an jun he lu'um, haton lum te yax sat b'aj ayex ek' tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Ujokab' Mamin Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén. Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Maklejek eyab' jun trato tik, tze b'eyb'alan tas syala'.
Ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, cham wal walnak t'a heb' to scha yab' heb' tas swala'. Atax t'a jun pekti' chi' masanto tiknaik ayinnhejoch walani.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej to wach' pitb'inakel spensar heb'. Yak'annakb'at sb'a heb' t'a skal chukal. Maj yal sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej tas swala'. Yuj chi' wak'nakb'at ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yajkan t'a in trato chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik syik'anel sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Ix sk'ulejxi chukal heb' icha sb'eyb'alejnak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton heb' manh k'anab'ajannakok tas walnak, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios yak'nakoch spensar heb', yochnak heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ha pax tiknaik manhok chonhab' Israel, manhok pax chonhab' Judá sk'anab'ajan in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wak'kot ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'ay. Olto awaj heb' t'ayin sk'anan in kolwal, palta manhxo ol in tak'wok t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' b'i'an a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, ol b'at snhus incienso heb' yik sk'anan kolwal t'a juntzanh sdiosal chi'. Yujto a heb' aj Judá tik, tzijtum wal sdiosal heb', lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb'. Hanheja' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, te tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb', icha wal scalleal chonhab', haton ta' snhus incienso heb' t'a Baal, jun komon Dios yajb'entak. Palta manh ol yal-laj skolji heb' t'a sya'elal chi' yuj juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.
Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok, wach'chom ol sk'an in kolwal heb' t'a skal sya'elal.

Ix yalan Jehová to swal t'a heb' wetchonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab' xajanab'il wu'uj, malaj eyalan heyik he jawi t'a in kajnub', yujto manh jantakok tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej. Ha xepu'al yet' schib'ejal nok' he silab', manh ol yal ex skolanel t'a jun ya'elal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Manhxo eyak'och k'inh t'a in kajnub' tik.

Yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan ex icha junok te' olivo k'ayum xi'il, te ay sat. Palta haxo tiknaik, ol ex in sateli, icha tz'aj slajwiem junok te te' sjekchaj sk'ab' yuj junok owal ik' nhab', stz'ab'at te' yuj sk'ak'al lheb'lon.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in ix ex wak' pitzwok ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, icha yawchaj junok te te'. Palta toxo ix wala' to ol ex in satel yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej, icha junok te te' stok'jik'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol, yujto ix he nhus incienso t'a Baal, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ay heb' ajk'ol t'ayin wan sna'an in smilani. Ix a jak in pensar yik snachajel wu'uj.

Junk'olal wajek'i, icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok, palta manh wojtakok tas wan sna'an heb' t'a in patik. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ko mak'ekchamok, yik wach' manhxa mach ol na'ankotok, icha wal tz'aj xikjiel junok te te' syak' sat, xchi heb'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, Juez ach t'a stojolal. Ojtak tas ayek' t'a ko pensar. Ak' wil tas ol aj ak'an spak t'a juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wab'enejoch t'a yol a k'ab' tas sna heb' t'a in patik, xin chi.
Ha heb' aj Anatot, ix sna heb' tas tz'aj in chami. Ix yalan heb' to tzin smilcham heb' tato hanheja' walanel slolonel Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix halan yuj heb' aj Anatot chi' icha tik: Ayik ol in b'oan yaj yet' heb', a heb' kelemtak ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, haxo yuninal heb' yet' yisil, ol cham heb' yuj wejel.
Manhxa junok heb' winak ol kanok, yujto ol ja sk'uhal ol in ch'olb'itan tas sk'ulej heb'. Ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová, wach'chom wojtak to te tojol a pensar, palta in gana tzin telaj in b'a het'ok. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'anb'ej juntzanh tik t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk sb'eyb'al? ¿Tas yuj junk'olal yaj heb' anhej chukal sna'a?

Ha ach a b'onak heb', wach'nhej sk'ib' heb', icha junok te te' wach' sb'at sch'anhal yib', wach' sk'ib'i, syak'an sat, icha chi' yaj heb'. Anhej yet' sti' heb' syal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo spensar heb' najat yajeli.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak in. Tzila' jantak yajoch in pensar t'ayach. Ik'b'at juntzanh anima chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Tza sik'kanel heb', yik wach' ol cham heb' t'a jun k'uhal ayik ol miljokcham anima.

¿B'ak'inh ol och wa'an stakji yib'anhk'inal tik yet' stakjiel anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok' nok'? Hanheja' nok' much wan scham nok' yuj schukal heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik. Sna heb' to max il tastak sk'ulej heb', xin chi t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Tato maj ach tzak'wan a b'ey yet' heb' sb'ey t'a yok, ¿tas wal ol aj a lajb'an a b'ey yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej? Tato manh junk'olalok ajek' b'aj sekan, ¿tas ol aj a na'ani tato tzach ek' t'a skaltak swayumtakil stitak ha' Jordán?

Ijan spax ip, palta manto ojtakok to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, haton heb' ayto uj a b'a yet'ok. Tz'awaj heb' skot heb' t'a a patik icha heb' pechum nok'. Wach'chom wach'nhej syutej lolon sb'a heb' t'ayach, manh ak'och heb' yipok a k'o'ol, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol waktejkan in chonhab' tik, ol in patikejel jun chonhab' to wik yaji. Ol wak'och in chonhab' xajanab'il tik wuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol.
Ha heb' in chonhab' wiktaxon yaj tik, icha junok nok' choj t'a kaltak te' tz'el yaw skoti, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin yajkanel heb'.
Ha in chonhab' tik, lajan wal icha junok nok' ch'akb'a ch'ok yilji, stzok'jicham nok' yuj juntzanhxo nok' yetch'akb'ail. Kotokab' masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ul satel in chonhab' tik.

Tzijtum heb' yilumal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol satanel in chonhab' tik, ichato wan satanel te' uwa heb' awab'il wu'uj. Ol stek'em lat'an in munlajel heb'. Ha lum lum nib'ab'il wu'uj, takinh lum ol ajkan lum yuj heb'.
Kuseltakxonhej ol ajkan in chonhab' tik yuj heb', ichato ol ok' lum t'ayin. Masanil in chonhab' tik, kuseltakxonhej ol ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol na'an jab'ok yuj.

Masanil t'a tzalkixtak t'a tzinan lu'um, ol jawok heb' winh winak sateli, yujto a wespada a in Jehová in tik, a ol satanel masanil b'aj slajwik'och smakb'en in chonhab' tik. Manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal ol ajok.

Ix yawej ixim trigo heb', haxo te' k'i'ix ix k'ib' sk'exulok. Nab'anhej ix munlaj heb'. Ix lajwiel yawb'en heb', k'ixwelalxo smolank'e jab'jab' sat yawb'en heb' chi', yuj wal yowal in k'ol t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Icha tik swal a in Jehová in tik yuj juntzanh nación te chuk t'a slak'anil Israel tik, to ix yik'ek' lum lum heb' ix wak' smakb'enej Israel in chonhab': Ol wik'el heb' t'a slu'um junjun, haxo heb' aj Judá ol wik'el heb' t'a skal heb'.
Ayik toxo ix wik'el juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol ok'xok in k'ol t'a heb', ol wik'an meltzaj heb' t'a slu'um yet' t'a schonhab' junjun.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix k'ayb'an in chonhab' yak'an sti' t'a sb'i Baal. Haxo ol ajok, tato ol sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al in chonhab' tik heb', ol slokan in b'i heb' t'a tas syala', tato icha chi' ol yal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' in chonhab' tik.
Tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swal jun, a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol in satel heb' icha stok'jik'eta junok te te' yet' sch'anhal yib', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at man junok tzek'ul nab'a lino, tzak'anoch t'a a nanhal ayik manto juk'chajok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in manan jun tzek'ul chi' icha ix yal Jehová, ix wak'anoch t'a in nanhal.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin:
Ik'b'at jun a tzek'ul ix a man chi', jun ayoch t'a a nanhal chi', tzach b'at t'a Perat. Hata' tza k'ub'ejel t'a sjatelal junok k'e'en tenam, xchi Jehová.
Ix in b'at b'i'an, ix in k'ub'anel jun tzek'ul chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixik t'a Perat, b'at ik'xikot jun tzek'ul in cheknak b'at a k'ub'ejel ta', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in b'at b'i'an, ix in joyan b'aj aykan chi' wu'uj, ix wik'ankoti, palta k'axo, manhxalaj yopisio.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli:
Icha tik ol aj in satanel yik'ojchanhb'ail Judá yet' Jerusalén.

Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, te chuk ex, malaj he gana tze k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, anhej tas tze nib'ej a tze k'ulej. Tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzeyak'an serwil. Lajan ex icha jun tzek'ul manhxalaj yopisio tik.

Icha junok mach stzek'och junok tzek'ul t'a snanhal, icha chi' ix in k'ulej eyet' ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, yik junnhej tzex aj wet'ok, in chonhab' eyaji, yik tzeyak'an ojtakajeli to b'inajnak in, niwan welk'ochi. Palta maj in he k'anab'ajej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' etchonhab' tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alani: Junjun yet'tal wino, smoj sb'ut'ji yuj wino, xa chi. Ol yalan heb' t'ayach: Toxon kojtak to junjun yet'tal wino smoj sb'ut'ji yuj, xcham heb'.

Ol halan t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' sat he k'ol he masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik yuj yowal in k'o'ol, icha wal tz'aj sat sk'ol mach niwan wino syuk'ej. Ha heb' ol satel sk'ol chi', haton heb' rey yinhtilal winhaj David, heb' sacerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik.

Ol wak' he mak'lajcham he b'a icha tz'aj spojb'at lum yet'tal wino ayik stenlan sb'a lu'um. Lajan ol yutej sb'a heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ol ex in sateli, manhxo ol ok'laj in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ex aj Judá, a Jehová wan slolon t'ayex. Emnakil tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklan eyab' tas syala'.

Alekk'eta he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yakb'an manta tas skot t'a eyib'anh, icha sk'ulej heb' sb'eyek' t'a sat pak'an t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Tze na' to ol ja wach'ilal t'ayex palta te niwan ya'elal ol kot t'a eyib'anh yuj Jehová, ichato ol k'ik'b'ok k 'inal ol heyila'.
Tato max he cha eyab'i, elk'altak ol in ok' yuj eyik'ojchanhb'ail chi'. Ol elta yal in sat, yujto ol ex ik'chajkanb'at t'a najat, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin: Al t'a winh a reyal yet' t'a ix snun winh: Emanhekkot t'a xilail he reyal, tzex em k'ojan t'a sat lu'um, yujto ol ik'chajel he corona manh jantakok swach'il yilji ayk'e t'a he jolom.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a Neguev ol makchaj yuj heb' soldado, ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak, manhxa mach ol yal yochi. Masanil heb' aj Judá, ol ik'chajkanb'at heb' t'a najat.
Ixikek k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzeyilan skot heb' ajk'o'ol. ¿Tas yaj in chonhab' wak'nakoch t'a yol he k'ab' he tanhwani, haton heb' ayoch he b'inajb'ilok?
¿Tas ol eyala' ayik ol wak'anoch juntzanh anima eyajalilok, haton heb' eyak'nakoch yipok he k'o'ol? Ol ja ya'elal t'a eyib'anh icha sjawi ya'elal t'a yib'anh junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, tato tze k'anb'ej tas yuj sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, nachajokab' el eyu'uj to yuj jantak he mul, yuj chi' b'eran ex eli tzex ek'i, tzex te ixtajpaxi.
Ha junok k'ik'al anima, tokwal syal sk'exmaj yilji. Ha spintotakil nok' leopardo, tokwal syal sk'exmaji. Ichexta' te k'aynak ex t'a chukal, maxtzak yal sk'exmaj he b'eyb'al.
Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejb'ati, icha tz'aj saklemkanb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik' skot t'a takinh lu'um.
Haton wal tik aykanoch t'a eyib'anh wu'uj, icha wal smojal. Yujto ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj, haxonhej juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol.
Ol ex wak'el b'eran, ol ex wak'an k'ixwelal.

Ix wil jantak eyajmulal, haton juntzanh k'ixwelaltak tze k'ulej. Yajb'entak tas tze k'ulej t'a lum jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il. Ex aj Jerusalén, ob'iltak ex, ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal chi'? xchi Jehová.
Yuj wal jun niwan tiempo manhxalaj nhab' syak'a', yuj chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha heb' aj Judá tz'ok' wal heb' yuj kusk'olal, manhxa yip schonhab' heb', toxonhej teltumb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Sk'e wal yaw heb' aj Jerusalén yuj sya'elal.
Ha heb' b'eyum, schekb'at heb' schekab' heb' ik'oj ha'. Sb'at heb' say ha' t'a yoltak jul, palta manhxalaj ha', malaj yol sch'ub' heb' smeltzaj heb'. Toxonhej smak sat heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Sk'e tamaljok lum lum sjat yuj stak'inhal. Yuj chi' a heb' munlajwum, stak wal sk'ol heb', smak sat heb' yuj k'ixwelal.
Icha chi' nok' k'ultakil chej, syaktejkan yune' nok' toto tz'alji, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok'.

Yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru, ha t'a tzalkixtak b'aj malaj ste'al skot tek'tek' nok'. Suk'lan ik' nok' icha nok' okes. Sk'unb'i wal yol sat nok' yilani, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak wach' sk'uxan nok', xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom te niwan ko mul t'a a sat, palta kolwajanh t'ayonh yik wach' max ach alchaj chukal. Tzijtum el sko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, tz'ochpax ko mul.

Ha achnhej ayach och yipok ko k'o'ol, a achnhej pax ko Kolumal aji ayik ayonh och t'a sya'elal. ¿Tas yuj icha ch'ok chonhab'il tzutej a b'a t'a ko chonhab' tik, icha junok paxyalwum junnhej ak'wal tzek' t'ayonh?
¿Tas yuj lajan ach icha junok soldado satk'olal yaji syamji, maxtzak yal skolwaji? Palta Mamin, tik pax ayachek' t'a ko kal. Masanil chonhab' ojtannak to a chonhab' onh. Manh onh aktejkani, xin chi.

Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová yuj heb' chonhab' israel: Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, te ay stzalajk'olal heb' sb'eyek'i. Sb'at heb' t'a jun, sb'at heb' t'a junxo. Yuj chi' manh jab'ok tzin tzalaj yet' heb'. Ha tiknaik ol in nakot schukal heb', ol in ch'olb'itan tastak sk'ulej heb', xchi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj swach'ilok juntzanh anima t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Wach'chom tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, palta manh ol in tak'woklaj t'a heb'. Wach'chom tzijtum silab' snhus heb' yet' jantak sat awb'en syik'kot heb' ofrendail, palta manh ol in tzalaj yet' heb'. Ol in satel heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi t'ayin.

Ix in tak'wi t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: Palta Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a heb' syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok, syal heb' t'a heb' anima tik to malaj owal ol ochok. Malaj wejel ol jawok. Syal heb' to ol ak'nhej junk'olal b'aj kajan onh tik, xin chi.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalanel heb' chekab' chi' t'a in b'i, wan yesan heb' syal chi', yujto manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Malaj junok cheknab'il ix wak' t'a heb', maj in lolonpax t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' to a in ix wak' yil heb' yalani, palta manh yeloklaj, malaj yelk'ochi. Munil t'a yol yik heb' snacha'anh juntzanh syal chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swal t'a juntzanh chekab' stek'b'ej sb'a yalanel t'a in b'i to malaj owal, malaj wejel ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik, manhok in tzin chek yal heb', yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' yuj wejel chi'.

Yet' pax heb' anima b'aj syal heb' chi', ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' wejel. Ol cham heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yalyuninal. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb' t'a yoltak scalleal chonhab' Jerusalén. Malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel smul heb' ix yak'ochi.
Yuj chi' al juntzanh tik t'a heb' anima: k'uhal dak'walxo yel yal in sat wok' yuj ya'elal ayxo smay ix jawi t'a yib'anh heb' wetchonhab', yuj ya'elal tz'ak'an echnaj heb'.

Ayik tzin ek' t'a kal munlajel swilani, ay sniwanil anima teltumb'a yajkan yuj owal. Haxo yik tzin ochxita t'a yol chonhab' tik, swilani to wan scham anima yuj wejel. Haxo heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' heb' sacerdote, toxo ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il manh yojtakok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom junelnhej ix ik'el heb' aj Judá tik t'a a k'o'ol? ¿Tom toxo ix a patikejel chonhab' Sion? ¿Tas yuj ix onh ak' echnajok to maxtzak yal kanhtaji? Sko nib'ej junk'olal kaji, palta malaj jab'ok tas wach' sjawi t'ayonh. Sko na' to wach'nhej ol onh b'ey t'a kichanh, palta anhej tas ay smay ix ja t'a kib'anh.
Mamin Jehová, skojtakejel ko chukal yet' pax spitalil heb' ko mam kicham. Ix och wal ko mul t'ayach.
Yuj wal yik'jicha'anh a b'i, manhxo onh a patikejeli. Manh a patikejel jun chonhab' tik b'aj ay a despacho to niwan yelk'ochi. Nakot a trato ix ak' ket'ok. ¿Tokwal manh ol ak'elk'ochi?

Malaj junok komon Dios, sdiosal ch'ok chonhab'il ol yal yak'ankot nhab'. Ha satcha'anh max yal-laj yak'ankot yaxnhab' t'a yol yiko'. Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, yuj chi' tzach kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, yujto a achnhej tzak'kot juntzanh tik, xin chi t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach'chom a winhaj Moisés, ma winhaj Samuel tzul tewok t'ayin yuj heb', manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a in chonhab' tik. Al t'a heb' to tz'el heb' t'a wichanh, sb'at heb'.

Tato ay heb' sk'anb'an t'ayach, b'ajtil tzonh b'ati, tato xchi heb', al juntzanh swal tik t'a heb': Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj ilya, ha' ilya chi' ol milanok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham t'a owal, ha t'a owal chi' ol chamok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj wejel, a wejel chi' ol milanok. Ha pax mach ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'joknhejb'atok, xa chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'kot chanh makan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' anima tik: Ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, ol nherjok b'eyek' sniwanil heb' yuj nok' tz'i', ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ostok, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol wach' lajanel heb'.
