Ol jawok jun ya'elal chi' yuj wal juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Manasés yuninal winhaj Ezequías t'a Jerusalén, ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Judá. Masanil chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol te xiw heb' yilanoch juntzanh ya'elal ol jawok t'a yib'anh in chonhab' tik.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol kus sk'ol eyu'uj? ¿Machto wal ol och ilk'olal eyu'uj?
Ha in Jehová in swala', a ex tik ix in he patikejeli, ex te juwieli. Toxo ix in te tzaktzaj ex wak'an niwank'olal, yuj chi' toxo ix wik'chanh in k'ab' wak'an eyaelal yik tzex in sataneli.

Ol ex wik'elta t'a yoltak he chonhab' t'a yol he makb'en tik, ol ex in saklemejb'at icha tz'aj saklem smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik'. Ol wak'an satjokel in chonhab' tik. Manhxa junok eyuninal ol wak'kani, yujto max yal he k'ol tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al.

Wu'ujnhej tzijtum ol ajkan heb' ix ix ol cham yetb'eyum, icha wal yarenail sti' ha' mar maxtzak b'ischaji. T'a chimk'uhalil ol jawok jun ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' ix nunab'il ayb'at yune' t'a owal, aynhej heb' nank'olal ol jawok kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' ix nunab'il manh jantakok yune', tz'el yip heb' ix yuj k'ixwelal, maxtzak yal yik'an yik' heb' ix, emnakilxonhej tz'ajkan heb' ix. Ha k'uhalil smeltzajkanoch t'ak'walil t'a heb' ix. Tato ayto heb' ol kan t'a yol schonhab' chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' miljokcham heb' yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Nunin, ob'iltak in. ¿Tas wal yuj ix in ak' aljok? Anhej wal owal yet' telajb'ail swak' yet' masanil anima. Malaj junok mach b'aj ix wak' tumin majanil, malaj pax mach b'aj ix in majnej k'e'en, palta masanil heb' tzin katab'ani.

Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och b'aj tzin skatab'ej heb' chi' tato chuk ix wutej ach wak'an serwil, tato maj in k'an a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ayik ayoch heb' t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a sya'elal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, ¿tok ay mach syal smak'an kanhchaj k'e'en bronce yet' k'e'en hierro? Icha chi' yaj heb' ajk'ol ol kot t'a stojolal norte, manh ol techaj eyak'an owal yet' heb'.
Yuj wal jantak he chukal ex aj Israel, yuj chi' a wal he b'eyumal yet' masanil tas ay t'a sat he lum tik, ol wak' t'a heb' eyajk'o'ol chi'. Nab'anhej ol yik'b'at heb', manh ol stupkanlaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi' t'a jun lum lum manh eyojtakok, yujto a yowal in k'o'ol lajan icha te' k'ak', ol ex satel yuj, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak smasanil, na in koti, kolin. Paktzitej t'a heb' wajk'o'ol. Mokab' ak' niwank'olal heb', paktzitej t'a heb' yakb'an manto in smilcham heb'. Ilnab' wal, u'uj tzin sb'uch heb'.
Ayik tzalan a lolonel t'ayin tzin chanhej wab'i, anhej ayoch in tzalajk'olalok, yujto ik in Mamin Jehová in Diosal, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil.
Manh junnhejok tzin ek' yet' heb' stzalaj sk'ulan chukal. Yuj wopisio ak'nak, in ch'okoj tzin ek'i, yujto swab' sya'il yowal a k'ol het'ok.
¿Tas wal yuj malaj b'ak'inh tz'och wa'an in ya'elal icha junok echen malaj yanhal? ¿Tom ol in ixtej icha ha' eluma' stupemi?

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato tzach meltzajkot t'ayin, ol ach in chaxi, icha chi' b'i'an ol yal in ak'an serwil. Tato max a komon alej komon lolonel, anhej tas niwan yelk'och tzala', a ach ol ach lolon wu'uj. Ha heb' anima ol meltzajkot heb' ul yab'an a loloni, manhok ach ol a cha ab' slolonel heb'.

Lajan wal ol ach wutejkan t'a heb' etchonhab' tik icha junok muro nab'a bronce. Ol yak' owal heb' het'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach yak' ganar heb', yujto ayin och het'ok, ol ach in kolo'.
Ol ach in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk, ol ach in kolnhej t'a heb' milumcham anima, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Manh ak'och etb'eyum, manh ol aj uninal t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in Jehová in tik ol wal t'ayach tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' unin ol aljok t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' mamab'il nunab'il.

Ol cham heb' yuj juntzanh ilya te ow, malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' heb' t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj nok' nok'. Ha owal yet' wejel ol ik'an scham heb'. Haxo sniwanil heb' chi', ol laj chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach och t'a yol junok pat b'aj ayek' heb' anima iloj ak'wal yuj chamnak. Manh ach ok' yet' heb', manh ak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', yujto a in Jehová in swala' to ix wik'el junk'olal t'a heb', maxtzak in xajanej heb', maxtzak ok' in k'ol t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol cham heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin. Manhxalaj mach ol mukan heb', malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb'. Malaj mach ol yak' echnaj sniwanil, ma sjoxanel xil sjolom yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal yuj heb'.
Manhxalaj mach ol b'oan wa'el yuj chamel chi', yik tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', wach'chom a heb' mamab'il nunab'il schami.
Hanhejtona' manh ach och k'ojan t'a yol junok pat a wa'i yet' uk'an ha' b'aj ay junok k'inh.

Yujto a in Jehová in Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' lajwok k'inh yik tzalajk'olal, icha k'inh yik nupnajel t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ha t'a yol he tiempoal tik ol ujok jun tik, ol eyil wal.

Ayik ol halan jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etchonhab' tik, ol sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj ol yak'kot jun niwan ya'elal chi' Jehová t'a kib'anh? ¿Tas chukal ix ko k'ulej? ¿Tas ko mul ix och t'a Jehová ko Diosal? xcham heb'.

Tza pakan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' he mam eyicham ix in yaktejkan heb', ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a spatik komon Dios, ix och heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ix in spatikanel heb', maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al heb' ix wak'a'.
Ha exxo pax tik, ek'al te chuk tze k'ulej t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'. Junjun ex tze k'ulej chukal skot t'a he pensar, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala'.

Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a jun lum tik, ol ex wak'ankanb'at t'a junokxo chonhab' manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakok pax heb' he mam eyicham. Hata' k'uhal t'ak'wal ol eyak' serwil juntzanh komon Dios. Manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in swak' in ti': Ha tiknaik, ayik slokan in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: T'a sb'i Jehová Dios ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.

Palta ol jawok jun pekti', ol yalan heb' anima icha tik: T'a sb'i Jehová, haton ix ik'anelta heb' israel t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix saklemkanb'at heb', xcham heb'. Yujto a in ol wik' meltzaj heb' etisraelal t'a schonhab', haton lum lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.

Palta ayik manto ol ujok jun chi', ol wik'kot heb' yajk'ol heb' israel yik tzul yamji heb' yuj heb', icha tz'aj syaman nok' chay heb' yamum chay yet' schimpa, ma icha heb' pechum nok' sb'at tzak'an t'a spatik nok' nok' t'a tzalkixtak, tzek' sayan nok' heb' t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en yet' t'a yoltak sjatelal k'e'en.
Yujto swil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ub'anel sb'a t'a yol in sat, ma sk'ub'anel schukal t'a wichanh.

Ol wak' spak t'a heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej chi', yujto ix yixtejb'at in lum heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh pitzanok, yajb'entak icha sniwanil junok chamnak. Ix sk'ulej heb' tas to max scha in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, wilumal ach, in tanhwumal aji. Ha ach wal tzin a kolo' ayik ay in och t'a sya'elal. Ol kot juntzanh chonhab' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ol ul yalan heb' t'ayach: Ha heb' ko mam kicham, anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj wach' yochi, malaj yopisio, anhej ta' yak'nakem sb'a heb'.
¿Tom syal sb'o'an sdiosal heb' anima? Tato a heb' sb'o'ani, manh diosok syal chi', xcham heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Yuj chi' t'a junelnhej ol wak' yojtakejel in poder heb'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in Jehová in a innhej Dios in, xchi.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, maxtzak el he chukal t'a he pensar. Max satlaj he chukal chi' t'a schikintak eyaltar. Skan yechel icha letra tz'ochkan t'a junok k'e'en k'e'en yuj k'e'en cincel ma yuj k'e'en diamante.
Ha heb' eyuninal snakot juntzanh altar heb', sna'anpaxkot juntzanh te te' yechel komon Dios heb', te' ay t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak cha'anh yajk'ei,
yet' t'a jolomtak witz t'a stitakel chonhab'. Yuj he chukal tzeyak'och t'a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'aj cha'anh t'a masanil he makb'en tik, ol wak' elk'ajb'at he b'eyumal yet' tastak ay t'ayex.

Yowalil ol ex ik'jokel t'a sat lum he lum tik, haton lum ix wak' he makb'enej. Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex t'a jun lu'um manh eyojtakok, yujto toxo ix kot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Ha yowal in k'ol chi', lajan icha junok k'ak' malaj b'ak'inh stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak heb' tzin ik'anel t'a sk'o'ol, haxo anima syak'och heb' yipok sk'ol yik skolwaj yet' heb' sna'ani.
Lajan wal heb' icha te' k'i'ix t'a tzinan lu'um, malaj b'ak'inh syil wach'il. Sk'ib'k'e te' t'a kaltak k'e'en yet' t'a lum lum ay atz'am atz'am t'ay yet' b'aj max yal skajnaj anima.
Palta te wach' yik heb' anima tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol.

Lajan wal heb' icha te te' awab'il t'a stitak ha ha', sb'at wal sch'anhal yib' b'aj sb'ey ha ha' chi'. Malaj sna te' wach'chom te ay k'ak', k'ayumnhej xil te'. T'a stiempoal malaj nhab', malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an te', malaj b'ak'inh syaktej yak'an sat te'. Icha chi' yaj heb'.
¿Tok ay junok tas yelxo wal ak'um musansatil, icha spensar heb' anima? Malaj sb'onab'il jun spensar heb' chi'. ¿Mach wal syal yojtakaneli?
Ha in wal Jehová in tzin ch'olb'itej tastak ay t'a junjun pensar. Wojtak wal tastak tzek' t'a spixan junjun anima. Ha in swak' spak t'a junjun t'a smojal icha sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' tz'och b'eyumal yuj ixtoj anima, lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' much smanhelta nholob' manh yikok. Ayik te tek'anto heb' ol ek'xok sb'eyumal heb' chi', haxo ol aj scheklaji to malaj spensar heb'.
Ha skajnub' Dios b'ob'ilkan yiktax yichb'anel, lajan wal icha junok palacio te wach' yilji, cha'anh b'ob'ilkank'ei.

Mamin Jehová, a ach ayachoch yipok ko k'ol a onh israel onh tik. Masanil heb' tzach aktankani, ol k'ixwokkanel heb'. Masanil heb' tz'el t'a a tz'ey, ol satkanel heb' icha tz'aj satel junok b'i tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a kal pokok. Ol satkanel heb' yujto tzach yaktejkan heb', yujto a ach tik lajan ach icha junok sjaj ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, ak' b'oxok in k'o'ol yik tzin b'oxikani. Kol in, yik wach' tzin kolchajkani, yujto anhej t'ayach swal wach' lolonel.
Syal heb' anima t'ayin icha tik: ¿B'ak'inh ol elk'och slolonel Jehová alnak t'ayonh? Elokab'k'och tas syal chi' tiknaik, xchi heb'.

Mamin, malaj b'aj ix in tewi t'ayach yik tzin k'anankot junok tas tz'ik'an satel heb' anima. Max in nib'ej pax sjawi junok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha ach tik ojtak tas ix in k'ana', yujto t'a ichanh ix wala'.
Manh in ak'och t'a xiwk'olal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a ayik ay in och t'a sya'elal.
K'ixwokab'kanel heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, mokab' in k'ixwokel a in tik. Xiwokab' heb' chi', mokab' in xiw a in tik. Ak'kot ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', satel heb' t'a junelnhej.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at ochanh linhan t'a spuertail chonhab' b'aj tz'eli tz'och heb' sreyal Judá. Hata' tzalel in lolonel. Ichanhej chi' tza k'ulej t'a juntzanh spuertail Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Ex rey yet' jantak ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik yet' he masanil ex aj Judá, machtak ex tzex och t'a juntzanh puerta tik, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová:
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he kuch eyikatz t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, manh eyik'ochta t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik, yik max ja ya'elal t'a eyib'anh yuj.
Manh eyik'paxelta junok eyikatz t'a yol he pat t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi'. Malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'u chi'. Niwanokab' yelk'och t'ayex icha ajnak walan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.
Palta manh schanakok yab' heb' tas walnak chi'. Spitejnak sb'a heb', manh sk'anab'ajejnakok skachnab'il heb' wak'nak.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': k'anab'ajejek tas swala', manh eyik'kot eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Niwanokab' yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swal tik, aynhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj David ol ochnhej reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail yet' carruaje nherb'il yuj nok' chej, ajun heb' eyajalil ex aj Judá ex tik yet' pax heb' aj Jerusalén tik. Ha jun chonhab' tik malaj b'ak'inh ol kan tzinan.

Ol laj kot heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, haton juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén tik, t'a yol yik Benjamín, t'a ak'lik, t'a tzalkixtak yet' pax t'a yol yik Neguev. Ol yik'kot nok' nok' heb' silab'il yik snhusjitz'a t'a templo. Ol yik'paxkot juntzanhxo nok' silab' heb', ixim trigo, incienso yet' ofrenda yik syak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.

Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il tik jun, tato manh niwanok yelk'och jun k'uhal chi' t'ayex, tato ol eyik'ochta eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a jun k'u chi', ol wak' nhusjoktz'a masanil palacio t'a Jerusalén tik. Manhxa mach ol yal smak'an tup jun k'ak' chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, emanh t'a spat jun winh tz'akum lu'um. Hata' ol wal jun lolonel t'ayach, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in em b'i'an, wan stz'akwi winh t'a jun tz'aklab' tzek' sururok.
Ayik wan stz'akan jun lum chen winh, haxo ix aji ix ixtaxb'at lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Yuj chi' hanheja' yet' lum slumal chi' ix sb'o junxo lu'um winh icha snib'ej.
T'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in wal Jehová in swal t'ayex israel ex tik: ¿Tom max yal ex wutan icha syutej lum lum winh tz'akum tik stz'akani? Ha ex tik, lajan heyaj t'a yol in k'ab' icha yaj lum lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh tz'akum tik.
K'inalok a in tik tzin na' in juanb'ati, ma in satanel junok chonhab', ma junok makb'en,
palta tato a jun chonhab' chi' sna sb'a sk'o'ol, syik'anel sb'a t'a skal chukal, hanhejtona' in tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak'b'at jun ya'elal chi' t'a yib'anh.
K'inalok tzin na' in b'oank'e junok chonhab' yet' wak'an k'ib'ok,
palta tato anhej chukal sk'ulej, max sk'anab'ajej pax tas swala', tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak' in wach'k'olal nab'il wuj wak'an t'ay.

Al t'a heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to a in swal juntzanh lolonel tik: Wan in na'an tas ol ex wutej, tas ol aj wak'anoch eyaelal, yuj chi' aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al, k'ulejek wach'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ol yalan heb' t'ayach icha tik: Manh ixtej a b'a onh a kachani. Ha onh tik ol ko k'ulejnhej chukal, icha tas skot t'a ko pensar ko k'ulani, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: k'anb'ejek ek' t'a junjun nación, tato ay b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'ulaj icha tas sk'ulej heb' etisraelal tik. Ha heb' tik yelxo wal te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'.
¿Tok ay junok tiempoal manh ayokem k'e'en sakb'akom t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Líbano? ¿Ay am b'aj stup ha ha' te si'ik skot t'a jolomtak witz chi'?

Palta a ex in chonhab' ex tik, manh junnhejok b'aj ayexkani, kotak skal tze k'exan he pensar. Tzin eyaktankani, haxo t'a tas manh diosok tze nhus incienso. Ex satb'at t'a jun b'e aytaxon t'a peka'. Haxo t'a b'e yik chukal b'aj tzex b'ati.
Yuj he chukal chi' ol kan tzinan he chonhab' tik. Ol te b'uchjoknhej. Masanil heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol laj syum sat heb' ex stzetzani, yujto satub'tak ol aj yilji.

Icha tz'aj saklemb'at tastak yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ol aj ex wak'an saklemb'at yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol. Ol in b'at mikan t'ayex ayik ol ja sk'uhal sjawi he ya'elal chi'. Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ko naek tas skutej winhaj Jeremías tik yuj tas syal winh t'a kib'anh. Tokwal ol lajwokel heb' sacerdote tzonh k'ayb'ani, ma heb' aj pensar tz'ak'an ko razón, ma heb' schekab' Dios tz'alan slolonel Dios chi' t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko naekk'e esal lolonel t'a spatik winh, yik smiljicham winh. Manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an wal tas syal heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin.

¿Tom yet' chukal tz'aj spaktzitaj wach'k'olal? Ha heb' chi' toxo ix sna heb' tas ol yutej heb' in smilanchamok. Nakoti to ix in k'och t'a ichanh in tewi t'ayach yuj swach'ilok heb', yik max ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'.

Haxo tiknaik jun, ak' cham yuninal heb' yuj wejel yet' yuj owal. Kanokab' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' junixtakil, manhxaokab' junok yune' heb' ix skani. Miljokab'cham heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo heb' winh yune' heb' ix kelemtakxo, chamokab' heb' t'a owal.
Ak'kot junok nhilanh soldado elk'um t'a skal heb'. Ab'chajokab' yel yaw heb' yuj sya'elal, yujto ichato sjoy olan heb' b'aj ol in mukchajok, say modo heb' tas tz'aj in telwi t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak masanil tastak smol alej heb' t'a wib'anh yik tzin smilancham heb' yalani. Manh ak' niwank'olal heb', mokab' b'at smul heb' chi' satk'olal u'uj. Satokab'el heb' t'a ichanh, ak'och sya'elal heb' yuj yowal a k'o'ol.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: B'at man junok lum ch'ub', tzik'anb'at heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' het'ok yet' heb' sacerdote ichamtak winakxo.
Tzach el t'a puerta b'aj tz'el heb' sb'at ak'ojkan k'alem t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, hata' ol al juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach t'a heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ex sreyal Judá yet' ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, ab'ek wal slolonel Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Ab'ek, ol wak'b'at jun niwan ya'elal t'a yib'anh he chonhab' tik. Masanil mach ol ab'anok, ol sat sk'ol heb' yab'ani.

Yujto tzin eyaktejkani, tzeyak'anoch jun lugar tik yikok komon Dios. Tze nhusan incienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios manh eyojtakok yet' heb' he mam eyicham. Manhxa yalnab'il jantak heb' unin malaj smul tze milchamok.
Ix he b'ok'e juntzanh altar b'aj tze nhustz'a heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a Baal. Tze k'ulan wal tas manhok in swak' he k'ulej, max ek' t'a in pensar juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in tik swala': Ay wal jun k'uhal to a jun ch'olan tik, manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, palta sch'olanil b'aj smiljicham anima ol sb'iejkani.

Yuj jantak anima ol cham t'a jun ch'olan tik, ol wak' ixtaxel tas nab'il eyuj ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén. Ol ex wak' ak'jok ganar yuj heb' eyajk'ol snib'ej tzex milanchamok. Haxo he niwanil ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ochkan he chonhab' tik tzinan lumal, xiwub'tak ol ajkanok. Ha heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol xiw heb', ol sat sk'ol heb' yilani, ol b'uchwaj heb' yuj tas ol ajkan chi'.
Ol wak' he chilajb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil yuj wejel, ol wak'an he chilajb'at he b'a, ayik ol oymaj heb' ajk'ol t'a spatik he chonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ayik slajwi halan juntzanh tik, tza mak'anpoj jun lum ch'ub' chi' t'a yichanh heb' anima ajun et' chi',

tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in satel jun chonhab' tik, icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum ch'ub' maxtzak yal sb'o junelxo. Ha t'a lum Tofet tik ol he mukem heb' he chamnak, yujto manhxa b'aj ol yal he mukan heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', icha chi' ol wutej jun chonhab' tik yet' heb' kajan t'ay, lajan ol aj icha ol aj Tofet tik.

Te yajb'entak ol ajkan masanil pat t'a Jerusalén tik yet' spalacio heb' sreyal Judá. Hanhejtona' yajb'entak ol ajkan spanhanil yib'anhtak pat b'aj snhusji incienso t'a k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh yet' b'aj tze sekem wino ofrendail t'a komon Dios. Icha Tofet chi' ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ayik ix lajwi in k'ulan juntzanh tik, a in Jeremías in tik, in paxta t'a Tofet chi', b'aj ix walkanel slolonel Jehová. In och linhan t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios, ix walan t'a masanil heb' anima icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'b'at ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun he chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a he lak'anil. Ol jawok masanil juntzanh ya'elal toxo ix wal tik t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix he pitej he b'a, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala', xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ay jun winh skuchan Pasur yuninal winhaj Imer, sat sacerdote yaj winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix wal a in Jeremías in tik,
ix in schekan mak'jok winh, ix in schekan ak'jokpaxoch winh t'a te' cepo t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal smakb'en Benjamín.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, a winh ix halani to tzin ik'chajel t'a yol te' cepo chi'. Yuj chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ix k'exan a b'i. Magor-misabib ol a b'iejkani, syalelk'ochi xiwk'olalnhej yaji.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'och xiwk'olal t'a ib'anh yet' masanil heb' wach' ak'an yet'ok. K'elan ach wal ochi ol miljokcham heb' a wach'k'o'ol yuj yespada heb' ajk'o'ol. Ha exxo aj Judá ex tik ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia. Ay ex ol ex yik'b'at winh t'a Babilonia chi', ayex pax ol ex smilcham winh.
Masanil he b'eyumal yet' masanil tastak ay stojol ay t'ayex yet' sb'eyumal heb' sreyal Judá ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi', ol yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha hachxo tik ach Pasur, ol ach ik'chajb'at chekab'ok t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan et' t'a a pat. Hata' ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchajkan ta' yet' heb' a wach'k'o'ol chi', haton heb' b'aj ix esejkanel in ti'ok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, tonhej ix in a montej. Ix in k'anab'ajan tas ix ala'. Yelxo te tek'an ach, yuj chi' ix in ak' ganar. Masanil tiempo tzin tzetzaji, masanil anima tzin b'uchan u'uj.

Ayik swalan t'a heb' juntak el icha tik: Ol jawok ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex lajwokelok, xin chinhej t'a heb'. Yuj chi' aynhejoch heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin, tzin sb'uchan pax heb', yujto swalel a lolonel.

Tato swala' to maxtzak ach wak' b'inajok, maxtzak walpaxel a lolonel, haxo tz'aji, icha te' k'ak' tz'aj a lolonel chi' t'ayin. Stz'ab'at in b'akil yuj swab'i. Tzin nib'ej tzin och wa'an walanel a lolonel tik, palta maxtzak yal-laj.

Swab' wal sajson heb' in sb'uchani: Syalan heb' icha tik: Ina winh xiwk'olalnhej yaj tik, xchi heb'. Syalanpax heb': Koyek, b'at kik'ekcha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh winh, xchi heb'. Hanhejtona' heb' in wach'k'o'ol, snib'ej heb' b'aj tzin lektaji. Syalan heb' wu'uj icha tik: Ko sayek modo tas tz'aj kak'an ganar kak'anek ek' ko pak t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ayachnhej ek' wet'ok, icha junok soldado malaj mach tz'ak'an ganar. Ha heb' tzin pechani ol ak'jok ganar heb', a inxo jun manh ol in yak' ganar heb'. Ol k'ixwokkanel heb', manh ol satlaj sk'ol heb' t'a sk'ixwelal chi'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, a ach tza ch'olb'itej heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, tzilan tastak sna heb' anima. Ch'ox wil tas ol utej ak'an sya'elal juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wak'och in b'a ab'enal t'a yol a k'ab'.
B'itejek Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay. Ha skolanel heb' tz'ab'an sya'il t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
Te chuk jun k'u b'aj aljinak in. Mokab' alchaj wach'il t'a jun k'u b'aj aljinak in t'a in nun.
Ob'iltak jun winak xit' alannak t'a winh in mam to ix alji jun yuninal winh yik stzalaj winh.
Satokab'el jun winak chi', icha juntzanh chonhab' ix satjiel yuj Dios t'a junelnhej. Yab'okab' winh yel aw yuj ya'elal t'a k'inhib'alil yet' aw yik ak'oj owal t'a chimk'uhalil.
¿Tas yuj maj in mak'jicham yuj jun winak chi' ayik manto in alji? Tato icha chi', kannhejnak in am t'a ix in nun chi', ichato t'a ix mukchajnak in kani.
¿Tas wal yuj aljinak in? ¿Tom yuj wilan sya'elal, yik tzin cham t'a k'ixwelal? xin chi.

Ha winhaj rey Sedequías ix chekankot winhaj Pasur yuninal winhaj Malquías yet' winhaj sacerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías, yik sjawi heb' winh in yil a in Jeremías in tik, yik syalan heb' winh t'ayin icha tik:

Tzonh tewi t'ayach to tza k'an t'a Jehová ku'uj, yujto a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, wan yak'an owal winh ket'ok. k'an t'a Jehová chi' to sch'ox spoder, icha sk'ulejnak t'a pekataxo, yik syik'anel winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin. Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' icha tik: Alek t'a winhaj Sedequías chi'

to a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alani: Ol wak' meltzaj heb' a soldado t'a spatik, haton heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' winh sreyal Babilonia. Haxo heb' soldado winh chi' haton heb' oyanxo och t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' tik, ol in molb'ejoch heb' t'a yol jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in ol wak' owal heyet'ok yet' in poder yet' pax yowal in k'ol te ay smay.
Ol wak'cham masanil heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham heb' yet' nok' nok' yuj jun niwan yab'il.

Ol lajwok chi', a hachxo tik ach Sedequías, ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' heb' a chekab', heb' a soldado yet' heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, haton heb' olto kan yuj jun niwan yab'il, owal yet' wejel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', manh ol ok' sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'a heb', ol miljokcham heb' yuj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a juntzanh anima tik to a in swal icha tik: Swak' he sik'lej, ¿tom a he k 'inal, mato a he chamel?

Ha mach ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' yuj ilya. Haxo pax heb' ol el yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik jun, manh ol chamlaj heb', tewelxonhej ol kolchaj heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', toxo ix in na' wak'ankot ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, manhxo'ok wach'il ol wak'koti. Ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, haxo winh ol nhusantz'aok.

Alpax t'a heb' sreyal Judá yinhtilal winhaj David icha tik: Scham wal eyab'an tas swal a in Jehová in tik: Wach'okab' tzeyutej he b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima t'a junjun k'u. Tze kol heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' ixtum anima. Tato chuk tzeyutej he b'oan yaj jun, ol kot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, icha te' k'ak' te ow sk'e nhilnhon yok manhxa mach syal stupani.

Ex aj Jerusalén, te cha'anh eyajk'e t'a yib'anh lum ak'lik, icha yajk'e junok niwan tenam t'a lum ak'lik chi'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to aykot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Tzeyal icha tik: ¿Mach ol yal yak'an owal ket'ok? ¿Mach ol yal sk'eul b'aj sko kol ko b'a tik? xe chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och eyaelal icha wal smojal yuj tastak tze k'ulej. Ol wak'och sk'ak'al he palacio. Haxo tastak ay t'a spatiktak he chonhab', ol lajwokel stz'ab'ati, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Sedequías chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Ixik t'a spalacio winh sreyal Judá, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik
t'a winh, haton winh yinhtilal winhaj David. Tzalan pax t'a yichanh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet' winh yet' pax t'a heb' anima ay ta' to smaklej yab' in lolonel tik heb'.

Ha tojolal yet' wach'ilal a tze b'eyb'alej. Manh eyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ma heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Manh he milcham heb' anima malaj smul.

Tato t'a wal yel ol he b'eyb'alej juntzanh swal tik, ol ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj David reyal t'a tik. Ayoch heb' t'a yol carruaje yet' t'a yib'anh chej ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail palacio tik, ajun masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' heb' yet' pax heb' anima.
Palta tato manh ol he cha eyab' juntzanh ix wal a in Jehová in tik jun, a jun palacio tik ol satelok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik. Ha spalacio winh sreyal Judá, ha t'a yol in sat lajan wal icha swach'il yilji lum Galaad, icha pax lum jolom witz Líbano. Palta swak' in ti' swalani to ol meltzajkanoch icha tzinan lu'umal. Manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ol wik'kot heb' anima ay syamk'ab' yik owal t'a jun palacio tik yik satanel heb'. Ol smak'anelta te' k'ute' heb', haton te' manh jantakok swach'il ayoch spatzab'ilok, ol snhusankantz'a te' heb'.
Ol kot heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', ol ek' heb' t'a stz'ey jun chonhab' tik, ol laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix yutej jun niwan chonhab' tik Jehová? xcham heb'.

Ol tak'wok juntzanhxo heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej Jehová sDiosal heb', yujto ix yaktejkan strato heb' sb'onak yet'ok, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Manh ex ok' yuj schamel winhaj Josías, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Josías chi'. Yujto ix ik'jib'at winh t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'ak'inh ol meltzaj winh, manhxo ol yil-laj schonhab' winh b'aj aljinak. Ha yuj winhaj Salum chi', winh ix och sreyalok Judá ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', a Jehová tz'alan yuj winh icha tik. Ix ik'jiel winh t'a jun chonhab' tik, manhxo ol meltzajlaj winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ix ik'jib'at winh chi', hata' ol cham winh. Manhxo ol ul yilxi schonhab' winh tik.
Ob'iltak ach, yuj wal a chukal tza b'oank'e a palacio yet' a niwak pat. Tzak' munlaj heb' anima, palta max a tuplaj sk'u heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ol in b'ok'e junok in niwan palacio, haxo t'a yib'anh ol in b'ok'e juntzanhxo lewan tz'aj yo'ol. Ol jakwokkan swentenail, haxo te' k'ute' ol wak'och yichtakok, haxo yelaw, chakchak ol ajok, xa chi.

¿Am a na'ani to yujnhejto ayachek' t'a yoltak pat nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, yuj chi' rey ach to niwan elk'ochi? Ha winh a mam ix yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh, yujto tojol ix yutej sb'a winh, wach'nhej tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh.
Ix skol heb' meb'a' winh yet' heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar. Yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och winh. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a sb'eyb'al winh chi' sch'oxani to yojtak in winh.
Palta a ach tik, anhej b'eyumal tza nib'ej t'a spatik chukal. Tza chekan miljokcham heb' anima malaj smul, tzixtan heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová.

Syal Jehová yuj winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías sreyal Judá icha tik: Malaj heb' ol ok' yuj schamel winh. Malaj heb' ol halan icha tik: Ay, ach wetanimail. Ob'iltak onh. Toxo ix cham winh ko reyal, icha ko mam yaj winh, manh xchiok heb'.
Icha tz'aj junok nok' chamnak b'uru, icha chi' ol utaj winh, ol nherchajkanel winh t'a tiel chonhab' Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, k'eanhek t'a jolom witz Líbano tzex awaj ta'. Te cha'anh tzex awaj t'a jolomtak witz yik Basán yet' t'a tzalkixtak yik Abarim, yujto masanil heb' ayoch heyet'ok toxo ix satel heb'.
Ha in tik, ix wal t'ayex yik wach' eyajek' t'a he chonhab', palta maj yal he k'ol ix eyab'i. Ichanhej chi' ix eyutej he b'a yiktax wanto eyoch chonhab'il, toxon max he cha eyab' tas swala'.

Ol ik'jokb'at heb' eyajalil yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, icha yik'jib'at junok tas yuj owal ik', haxo heb' ayoch heyet'ok ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex k'ixwokkanok. Manhxa ol ajkan eyelk'och yuj jantak he chukal.

Ha tiknaik, te tzalajk'olal eyajek' t'a he pat nab'a k'ute' kotnak ste'al t'a Líbano. Palta ayik ol jawok ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, ol el eyaw eyab'an sya'il, icha yab'an sya'il junok ix ix tz'alji yune', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá: Wach'chom aylaj tzach och wuj icha junok kolk'ab' ayoch t'a swach' k'ab' heb' niwak winak, palta swak' in ti' to ol ach in julkaneli.
Ol ach wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol b'aj tzach te xiwi, heb' snib'an ach smilanchamok, haton winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ol ach wak' ik'jokb'at yet' ix a nun t'a lum lum b'aj manhok ta' ex alji, hata' ol ex cham he chawanhil.
Manhxo ol ex meltzaj t'a tik, wach'chom olto he nib'ej meltzajxi he b'a, xchi Jehová.
¿Tom lajan winhaj Jeconías tik yet' junok lum chen pojeltak manhxa yopisio, ma icha junok yamk'ab' manhxa mach snib'ani? ¿Tas yuj sjuljikanb'at winh yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a jun lum lum manh yojtakok?
Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, scham wal eyab'an tas syal Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Tz'ib'chajokab'kan b'aj ay sb'i heb' yinhtilal heb' rey to a jun winak tik, lajan tz'ajkan icha junok winak malaj yuninal, icha junok winak manh wach'ok ix aj yelk'ochi. Yujto manhxa junok yinhtilal winh ol och reyal t'a spalaciokan winhaj David, syak'anxi reyal t'a Judá tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ob'iltak ex, lajan ex icha junok tanhwum kalnel smilancham nok' skalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok' yuj. Icha chi' tzeyutej heb' in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'a heb' yilumal schonhab' tz'ak'an yajalil t'ay: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ix he saklemkanb'at heb' in chonhab', ix he xib'tankanb'at heb', maj he tanhwej heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wak'och eyaelal yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Haxo heb' ix in saklemkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il, a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wik' meltzaj heb'. Ol wak'anxi kajnaj heb' t'a schonhab', ol wak'anxi k'ib' sb'isul heb'.
Ol wak'anoch yilumal heb', yik maxtzak xiw heb', manhxa junok heb' ol satok, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ay jun k'u ol jawok, ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj rey David reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ha jun rey chi' te tojol spensar. Yet' sjelanil ol yak' reyal, tojol ol yutej sch'olb'itan masanil chonhab'.
Ha t'a stiempoal ol yak' reyal chi', ol kolchajkanel heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' aj Israel, manhxalaj tas ol sna heb'. Haton jun b'i tik ol ak'jok sb'iok: Ha Jehová sb'oanel tas tzonh aj t'a stojolal.

Ha tiknaik, slok in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'. Palta swak'kan in ti' tiknaik to ay jun k'u ol jawok ol yal heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ix onh ik'anelta t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix onh saklemkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Ichato chi' ol kajnajxi heb' israel chi' t'a slu'um, xchi Jehová.

Icha tik ix wal t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios: Ha Jehová ix halan jun lolonel niwan yelk'och t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan sik'lab'il, ix ib'xik'e in niwanil. Icha sketkonek' heb' uk'um anh toxo wal stelwi, icha chi' ix in aji.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, anhej wal ajmulal sk'ulej heb', syak' wal yip heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ha heb' niwak yelk'ochi, anhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'. Yuj chi' toxo ix katab'aj lum lum tik yuj Jehová, toxo ix takjiel lu'um, toxo ix tz'ab'at anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' nok'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok tik yet' heb' sacerdote, malaj welk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Swil wal sk'ulan chukal heb' t'a yol in templo.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to yuj chi' te k'ik' k'inal ol ajkan sb'e heb', te nhereri ol aj paxok. Ichato ol ekchajb'at heb', ol telwok heb'. Haxo yik ol in ch'olb'itan heb', ol wak'ankot ya'elal te ya t'a yib'anh heb'.
Wilnak wal heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Samaria, te chuk tas sk'ulejnak heb'. Yalnakel slolonel Baal heb', icha chi' aj skuchb'annak satb'at in chonhab' Israel heb'.

Ix wilpax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'. Anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', ixtum anima pax heb', syiptzitan heb' sk'ulan chukal heb'. Malaj junok mach syaktejkan sk'ulan chukal. Ha wal tz'aj wilani, a juntzanh anima tik yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, lajan wal heb' yet' heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, swal juntzanh lolonel tik yuj juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi': Yujto yuj heb' sk'echa'anh chukal t'a masanil smakb'en heb' tik, yuj chi' ol wak' tas k'a' swa heb' yet' yuk'ej heb', to scham anima yuj.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ex aj Israel, manh eyak'och tas syal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yipok he k'o'ol, yujto a tas syal heb' chi' esnhej, t'a yol yik heb' snaelta, manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.

Ha t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och in lolonel, hata' syal heb' icha tik: Wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, xchi heb'. Ha t'a heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sk'ulan tas snaelta t'a yol yiko', syal heb' icha tik: Malaj junok ya'elal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in, a in swala' to a heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', malaj junelok xit'ek' heb' b'aj tz'och molchajel, ayik tzin lolon yet' heb' in chekab'. Malaj junelok syab' heb' in loloni.
Te chuk heb', yuj chi' ol wak'och sya'elal heb' yet' yowal in k'o'ol. Ha yowal in k'ol chi' lajan wal icha junok owal ik' nhab' sja xumnajok.
Manh ol wanaj yowal in k'ol chi', masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il wu'uj. Hato b'ak'inh, ol nachajel juntzanh tik eyu'uj.
Manhok in tzin chek juntzanh chekab' chi', malaj tas swal t'a heb'. Tonhej skomon b'at lemnaj heb' yalel slolonel chi' t'a in b'i.
Komonok syojtakejel heb' tas nab'il wu'uj, a am in lolonel syal heb' t'a in chonhab'. Tato icha chi', toxom ix yaktejkan schuk b'eyb'alil in chonhab' tik, manhxa am chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Wach'chom t'a lak'an, ma t'a te najat, a in tik Dios innhej t'a smasanil b'aj.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Malaj junok b'aj wach' he k'ub'anel he b'a t'ayin. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil satcha'anh yet' t'a masanil sat lu'um?
Swab' wal tas syal juntzanh chekab' esalwum chi', stek'b'ej wal sb'a heb' yalani to a in lolonel syal heb', a in tzin lolon t'a heb' t'a swayich yalani.
¿B'ak'inh ol yaktej juntzanh syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yalan esal lolonel chi'? ¿B'ak'inh ol yaktej heb' yalan juntzanh lolonel tonhej snak'e t'a yol yik chi'?

Ha heb' chi' sna heb' tas tz'aj in b'atkan satk'olal yuj in chonhab' yuj swayich heb' syal-laj t'ay junjun, icha wal sk'ulejnak heb' he mam eyicham, ayik in b'atnak satk'olal yuj heb', haxonhej komon Dios Baal b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Tato ay junok chekab' chi' ay tas swayichej, yalokab'i to wayich. Palta tato a in lolonel scha jun, yalokab' t'a sjichanil. ¿Tom lajan yopisio ixim sat trigo yet' yok? Icha chi' in lolonel, manh lajanok yet' wayich. Ha in lolonel lajan wal icha te' k'ak', ma icha k'e'en almágana chok' tz'aj k'e'en niwak k'e'en yuj.
Yuj chi', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' tonhej syal-laj yab' slolonel junjun, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syal heb'.
Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' te wach' syutej sloloni, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syalel heb'.

Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' stz'ak yal swayich. Ha yuj juntzanh niwak esal lolonel syal heb' chi', satkanb'at heb' in chonhab'. Manhok in tzin chekb'at heb', manhok in swak' in cheknab'il t'a heb', yuj chi' malaj tas wach' yik'an heb' in chonhab' tik t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, tato ay junok anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, ma junok syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, ma junok sacerdote sk'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas syal srazón Jehová? tato xchi heb'. Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Lajan ex icha wal junok ikatz t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ol ex aktajem yuj, xa chi.
Tato a junok chekab', ma junok sacerdote, ma junok komon anima tz'alan icha tik: Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', a in ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' yet' heb' kajan yet'ok.
Tato ay junok mach sk'anb'an t'a junok yamigo, ma t'a junok sk'ab' yok yuj tas swala', syal yalan icha tik: ¿Tas ix yutej Jehová spakani? ma ¿tas ix yal Jehová? xchiokab'i.

Palta max yal yalan icha tik: Ha srazón Jehová tzin k'anb'ej. Tato syal icha chi', a jun lolonel chi' ol meltzajkanoch ikatzil t'ay. Yujto ix yixtejb'at heb' anima tik tas swal a in he Diosal pitzan in tik, Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Icha tik tz'aj he k'anb'an t'a jun in chekab': ¿Tas spak ix yal Jehová, ma tas ix yala'? xe chi.
Ach Jeremías, tato tzato yal heb': Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Yujto a ex tik tzeyalnhej juntzanh lolonel b'aj ix ex in kacha' to maxtzak eyala',
yuj chi' ol ex b'at satk'olal wu'uj yet' pax jun chonhab' ix wak' t'ayex yet' t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Najat ol ex in yumkaneli.
Masanil tiempo ol ex wak'kan k'ixwelal, manhxalaj jab'ok yelk'och ol ex ajkanok. Manhxo ol b'at satk'olal eyuj tas ol ex utaj chi', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, yuninal winhaj Joacim, ix ik'jib'at winh preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ix ik'chajpaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh, heb' b'o'um pat yet' heb' tenum k'e'en. Ixlajwi chi' icha t'a wayichal ix aj sch'oxan chab' mo'och sat te' higo Jehová t'ayin, ayek' t'a yichanh templo.
Ha t'a yol junok mo'och chi', ayem te' sat higo te wach', k'inhxo, haton te' b'ab'el sat, haxo t'a yol junxo te' mo'och chi', ayem te' higo te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani.

Haxo ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'ayin: ¿Jeremías, tas tzil chi'? xchi. Ix in tak'wi, ix walani: Ay chab' mo'och te' sat higo swila'. Ay te' manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay pax te' te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani, xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala': Icha wal sat te' higo wach' chi', icha chi' yaj chonhab' Judá t'a yol in sat, haton heb' ix wak' ik'jokb'at t'a smakb'en heb' caldeo. Te wach' ol wutok in b'a t'a heb'.
Ol in tanhwejnhej heb', ol wik'anxi meltzaj heb' t'a jun schonhab' tik. Ha tik ol wik'cha'anh heb', manhxo ol in satel-laj heb'. Icha wal to ol wawejem heb', manhxo ol in tok'k'eta heb'.
Ol wak' wal spensar heb', yik syojtakejel heb' to a in ton Jehová Dios in. Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'. Yujto t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ol meltzajkot t'ayin.

Haxo winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá, heb' yajal yaj yet' winh yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, haton heb' ixto kan kajan t'a tik yet' pax heb' ix k'och kajan t'a Egipto, lajan wal heb' t'a yol in sat icha sat te' higo te chukxolaj chi', haton te' maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol wak'b'at junok niwan ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol te xiw juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional yuj. Manhxalaj ol ajkan yelk'och heb'. Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanh nación b'aj ol in saklemejb'at heb' chi', ol te b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj heb', ol jawok katab' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a yib'anh heb'. Manhxa junok heb' ol kan t'a sat lum lum ix wak' t'a heb' yet' t'a smam yicham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, haton yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik yuj tas ol aj chonhab' Judá.
Ix walan jun lolonel tik t'a masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik:

Ayik 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá tik, ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, yuj chi' 23 ab'ilxo slolonnhej t'ayin. Tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex, palta manh jab'ok tze cha eyab'i.
Wach'chom tzijtum el ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayex, palta maj he chanhej eyab' tas ix chekji yal heb', maj he k'anab'ajej.
Ix yal wal heb' t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al, yik wach' tzex kajnajnhej t'a lum lum yak'nak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Manh ex b'at t'a spatik komon Dios, manh ex och ejmelal t'ay. Manh he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh Dios to a ex tze b'o tik, yik wach' max yak'kot junok ya'elal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb' schekab' chi'.

Haxo tiknaik, syal Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik max yal he k'ol tze cha eyab' tas swala'. Tze tzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'o'ol, yujto tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh he diosal tze b'o'o. Yuj chi' hanheja' ex tzeyik'kot ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' syalanxi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' tas swala',

yuj chi' ol wawtejkot masanil juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il skot t'a norte yet' pax winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ol wak'lab'ej winh yik sjawi winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' chi' yak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil yet' heb' anima kajan t'ay. Ol wak' satel heb' smasanil. Junelnhej ol wak' lajwokel heb'. Ha heb' ol ilanok, ol xiwk'e heb', ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb'.
Ha wal ol wutejkan heb' chi', manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj yoch b'it yik k'inh yuj tzalajk'olal, ma b'it yik nupnajel. Manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj sk'anh k'e'en cha', manhxa b'aj ol ilchaj yok candil.
Masanil jun chonhab' tik ol kan tzinan, ol em lanhnajok. Ha jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil tik, 70 ab'il ol kan t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swak' in ti', ayik ol lajwok 70 ab'il chi', ol in ch'olb'itan smul winh sreyal Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a smakb'en winh, haton heb' caldeo. Ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Masanil juntzanh ya'elal ix wala', ol wak'em t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', haton tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a jun u'um tik, haton tas ix in chek yalkan winhaj Jeremías yuj masanil juntzanh chonhab'.
Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' niwak chonhab' yet' heb' niwak yajal. Icha chi' ol aj scha'an spak heb', icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayin icha wayichal, ix yalan t'ayin: Ina jun kopa tik, b'ut'an yuj wino, sch'oxel yowal in k'o'ol. Ik'b'ati, tzak'an yuk' masanil nación b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati.
Ayik ol yuk'an heb', ol xej heb', ol kistalax heb' yuj. Icha chi' ol aj heb' yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a skal, xchi Jehová.
Ix in cha'an jun kopa chi' t'a Jehová, ix wak'an yuk' masanil chonhab' chi' tas ayem t'a yo'ol, haton juntzanh b'aj ix in scheka'.

Ix wak' yuk' heb' aj Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ix yuk' heb' yet' sreyal yet' yajalil, yik slajwiel heb' yuj. Ha heb' ol ilan heb', ol xiw heb', ol b'uchjok heb', ol katab'aj heb' yuj heb', icha wan kilan tiknaik.
Ix wak'anpax yuk' winh sreyal Egipto, heb' yajal, heb' niwak winak yet' masanil heb' anima kajan ta',

yet' pax heb' anima tonhej tzek' ta'. Ix wak'anpax yuk' masanil heb' rey ay t'a chonhab' Uz yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo: Haton t'a Ascalón, t'a Gaza, t'a Ecrón yet' heb' anima ixto kan t'a Asdod.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' sreyal Edom, Moab yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal Amón.
Yet' t'a heb' sreyal Tiro yet' Sidón yet' masanil heb' sreyal junjun nación ay t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' aj Dedán, t'a heb' aj Tema, t'a heb' aj Buz yet' t'a masanil heb' anima spiljoxejel yib'tak schikin.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' rey t'a Arabia yet' t'a masanil makanhil anima kajan t'a takinh lu'um.
Ix wak'pax yuk' heb' rey t'a Zimri, t'a Elam yet' t'a Media,
yet' t'a heb' rey t'a norte, haton heb' lak'nik ma heb' najtik skal. Syalelk'ochi, masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal ix uk'ani. Slajwub'alxo ol yuk' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ala' to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, a in ix wala': Uk'ejek he masanil ex yajal ex tik masanto sk'e t'a he jolom, ol ex xejok, ol ex telwok. Manhxo ol ex k'e wa'an. Icha chi' ol ex aj yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a he kal, xchi Jehová.
Tato malaj snib'ej heb' scha'an jun kopa chi' t'ayach, max yuk' pax heb', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tz'alani: Yowalil ol eyuk'ej.

Tik wal tzin chael yich wak'anb'at ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' wik yaji. ¿Tzam he na' to manh ol k'och ya'elal chi' t'a eyib'anh? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to a jun chi' manh ol ek'b'at sk'och t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol wak'b'at owal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb': Ha Jehová icha sk'anh k'u, icha chi' ol aj yawajemta t'a satcha'anh, haton t'a skajnub' to yiknhej yaji. Icha wal yel yaw heb' tek'umel yal uwa, icha chi' ol aj yel yaw skot yowal t'a masanil anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.

Olto ab'chaj sk'anh b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, yujto ay tas ol yal Jehová t'a yib'anh masanil nación. Ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima yuj, ol yak'ankanoch chamel t'a yib'anh masanil heb' chuk, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, t'a stzolal ol aj syamchaj junjun nación yuj jun ya'elal ol jawok, icha sjawi junok owal ik' nhab'. Wan smolb'an sb'a jun niwan ya'elal chi' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' ol cham yuj Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', teltumb'a ol ajkan heb' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol molb'an sniwanil heb' yik smukji. Toxonhej ol kan b'ulan sniwanil heb' t'a sat lu'um icha stza' nok' nok'.

Elokab' eyaw yuj ya'elal ex yilumal chonhab'. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a sat lu'um, yujto toxo ix ja sk'uhal he miljichamok. Ol ex saklemkanb'atok. Ol ex ak'jok ganar, ol ex miljokcham icha nok' ch'ak kalnel te b'ak'ech.
Ha heb' yilumal chonhab', manh ol yal sb'at heb' elelal. Ha heb' stanhwumal chonhab' chi' manh ol kolchajkanel heb'.
Ab'ek wal sk'akwi heb' yilumal chonhab' chi'. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj ya'elal, yujto toxo ix satel schonhab' heb' yuj Jehová, icha stakjiel anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' kalnel.
Ix satjiel schonhab' heb' chi' yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Ix elta juknaj Jehová t'a yet'tal icha junok nok' choj. Yet' wal yowal sk'o'ol ix yak'ankot jun owal te ay smay t'a skal juntzanh anima chi', chok' ix ajem lanhnaj schonhab' heb'.
Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ajanh tek'tek' t'a yamak'il in templo, tzalan masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayach t'a heb' aj Judá tzul och ejmelal t'a in templo tik. Malaj junok lolonel to max ala'.
Talaj scha yab' heb' t'ayach, syaktankan schuk b'eyb'al heb', tato icha chi', manhxo ol wak'b'at ya'elal nab'il wuj wak'anb'at t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Tzal t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' in k'ayb'ub'al swala', max he k'anab'ajej paxi,
max he cha eyab' he kachji yuj heb' in chekab', wach'chom tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb', palta maj he k'anab'ajej heb',

yuj chi', icha wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo, icha chi' ol wutej jun templo tik. Ol wak'b'at katab' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' masanil heb' anima, ix yab' wal heb' walan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'a templo.
Ayik ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wala', ix in syaman heb'. Ix yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ol ach chamok.

¿Tas wal yuj tza tek'b'ej a b'a halan t'a sb'i Jehová to a jun stemplo tik lajan ol ajkan icha ajnak skajnub' t'a Silo? Tzalani to ol satel jun chonhab' tik, manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xa chi, xchi heb'. Masanil anima ix ja nhilnaj t'a yamak'il templo chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' yajal t'a Judá tas wan yuji chi', ix kot heb' t'a spalacio winh rey, ix jawi heb' t'a templo b'aj ay jun ak' puerta, hata' ix jawi k'ojan heb'.

Ix yalan heb' sacerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a heb' yajal yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik smoj scham winh, yujto ix yal winh to ay ya'elal ol ja t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha ex tik tzeyab'nhej tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Ix walan t'a heb' yajal chi' yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ix chekan wal tas ix eyab' t'a spatik jun templo tik yet' t'a spatik ko chonhab' tik.
B'o'ek he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, k'anab'ajejek Jehová ko Diosal yik wach' manh ol yak'kot juntzanh ya'elal toxo ix alchaj chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in tik, ayin wal ek' t'a yol he k'ab', syalnhej he k'ulan tas tze nib'ej t'ayin.

Palta, ojtakejek wal el sik'lab'il: Tato a ex yet' heb' anima tik tzin he milchamok, ol och he mul yujto tze milcham junok mach malaj smul. Yujto wal yel, a Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' yajal yet' heb' anima chi' t'a heb' sacerdote yet' t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi': Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto ha t'a sb'i Jehová ko Diosal ix lolon winh t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix k'e wa'an, ix yalan heb' t'a heb' anima molanek' chi':

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, a winhaj Miqueas aj Moreset ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha Sion tik ol kan yikok munlajel. Ha pax Jerusalén ol emkan lanhnajok, haxo jun tzalan b'aj ay templo tik, wayumtak ol ajok, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta tokwal ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' pax yuj heb' anima. Anhej to ix xiw winh, ix tewi winh t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot ya'elal Jehová toxo ix yal chi'. Tato sko milcham winhaj Jeremías tik, ol kik'kot ya'elal t'a kib'anh, xchi heb'.

(Yet' pax winh schekab' Dios skuchan Urías yuninal winhaj Semaías, aj Quiriat-jearim, a winh ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en, icha ix aj walan Jeremías in tik.

Ha winhaj rey Joacim yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' heb' niwak yopisio, ix yab' heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix snib'ej winh rey chi' smilcham winh. Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Urías chi' tas yaji, ix xiwb'at winh, ix b'at winh elelal t'a Egipto.
Ix chekjib'at winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh winak yuj winhaj rey Joacim t'a Egipto chi'.

Haton heb' winh ix b'at ik'ankot winhaj Urías chi', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh to smiljicham winh, syumjib'at sniwanil winh b'aj sb'atkan sniwanil heb' komon anima. Icha chi' ix aji.)
Palta a in Jeremías in tik, maj in ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima yik tzin smilancham heb', yujto a winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán ix yak'och sb'a wet'ok.
Ayik toto ochnak winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: B'o junok te' yugo yet' juntzanhok nok' tz'u'um, tzak'ank'e t'a yib'anh a jaj.

Slajwi chi', tzak'anb'at junok cheknab'il t'a heb' sreyal Edom, t'a heb' yik Moab, t'a heb' yik Amón, t'a heb' yik Tiro yet' t'a heb' yik Sidón. Ha t'a heb' chekab' sjawi ul yil winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén, hata' tzak'b'ati.
Tzal t'a heb' to syal heb' t'a heb' sreyal, to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel tik, a in swala':
Yet' wal in poder te niwan, in b'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. In b'onak heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' syal wak'an t'a yalnhej mach b'aj in gana swak'a'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik swak'kanoch juntzanh nación tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh in chekab' aj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Swak'paxkanoch nok' kaltakte'al nok' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Masanil nación ol kan t'a yol sk'ab' winh, t'a yol sk'ab' yuninal winh yet' t'a yol sk'ab' yixchikin winh, masanto ol ja sk'uhal yak'ji ganar Babilonia chi'. Ichato chi' ol kan Babilonia chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo nación yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo rey niwak yelk'och yet' yopisio.

Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay junok nación max yak'och sb'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh, haton owal, wejel yet' ilya, masanto ol satel heb' yuj winh.

Yuj chi', manh he cha eyab' tas syal heb' tz'alan t'ayex to max eyak'och he b'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha heb' tz'alan juntzanh chi', haton heb' tik: Eb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' sna'anel tas syal wayich yalani yet' heb' schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal yet' heb' skomon halan tastak toto ol ujok.
Masanil juntzanh tas syal heb' chi', esnhej, yujto ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional. Ha in ol ex in pechb'ati, hata' ol ex chamok.
Haxo pax juntzanh nación syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'nhejkan heb' t'a slu'um, ol munlaj heb' ta', xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix walanxi juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá icha tik: Ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' schonhab' winh, yik wach' max ex chami.

¿Tas yuj tza b'ekcham a b'a yet' a chonhab' yuj owal, wejel yet' pax yuj ilya? Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to a juntzanh chi' ol ik'an masanil nación manh ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.
Manh a cha ab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' tz'alani to max ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yujto nab'a es tas syal heb' chi'.

Ha Jehová ix halani to manhok schekan yal juntzanh chi' heb', nab'a es tas syal heb'. Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi' jun, ol ach ik'jokel t'a tik yet' heb' esalwum chekab' tz'alan chi' t'ayach, ol ach cham yet' heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan pax t'a heb' sacerdote yet' t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Manh he cha eyab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi'. Syalan heb' t'ayex to toxo ol ak'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' t'ayex, esal lolonel.
Yuj chi' manh he cha eyab'i. Hak'ek wal och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a tik. ¿Tas yuj ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik?

Tato yel in chekab' heb', tato yet'nak in lolonel heb', tewokab' heb' t'ayin a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, yik max wach' ik'jib'at juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik in templo t'a Babilonia yet' tastak kannak t'a spalacio heb' tz'ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayik ix ik'jib'at winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil t'a Jerusalén yet' winh. Ayik ix ik'jib'at heb' chi' maj ik'jib'atlaj juntzanh niwak oy, jun niwan pila nab'a bronce yet' sb'akhnub'al yet' juntzanhxo syamk'ab'il templo yet' tas ix kan t'a spalacio heb' sreyal Judá yet' Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.
Ha in swala' to masanil tas ix kan chi' ol ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, hata' ol kannhej, masanto ayik ol ex wik'anxi meltzaj t'a he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yo'il ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', a winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Azur, aj Gabaón, jun winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, ix lolon winh t'ayin Jeremías in tik t'a templo. T'a yichanh heb' sacerdote yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan winh:
--Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol in mak' kanhchaj jun te' syugo winh sreyal Babilonia, haton spoder winh ayem t'a eyib'anh.
Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wak' ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' meltzaj winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yet' masanil heb' anima ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi'. Ol in kanhchitej syugo winh rey chi' ayem t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Hananías chi'.
Ix in tak'wi t'a winh t'a yichanh heb' sacerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima ayek' t'a templo chi'. Ix walan icha tik:

--Ichokab' chi'. Komonok icha chi' sk'ulej Jehová. Komonok syak'elk'och juntzanh lolonel tzal chi', syak'an ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil anima.
Palta ab' wal juntzanh tas ol wal tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' anima tik:
Ha heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', ayik manto onh alji het'ok, yalnak heb' to ol ja owal, ya'elal yet' ilya t'a yib'anh juntzanh nación ay spoder.
Palta tato ay junok chekab' tz'alani to ol ja wach'il t'a juntzanh nación, hato yik ol elk'ochok, ichato chi' ol cheklajelok to a Jehová ix chekan yala', xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun te' yugo chi' winhaj Hananías ayoch t'a in jaj, ix skanhchitan te' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Syal Jehová icha tik: Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wik'el spoder winhaj Nabucodonosor ayoch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nación tik, xchi Jehová chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in b'atxi.
Ayik ix ek'b'at jun pekti' ayik toxo ix smak' kanhchaj te' yugo winhaj Hananías ix yik'el t'a in jaj chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winhaj Hananías to a in Jehová in swala': Ha ach ix a kanhchitej te' yugo nab'a te', a inxo ol wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro sk'exulok te te' chi'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swal icha tik: Ix wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro t'a yib'anh juntzanh nación walnak, yik skan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Hanhejtona' nok' kaltakte'al nok', ix wak'kanoch nok' t'a yalanh smandar jun winh rey chi', xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a winhaj Hananías chi' icha tik: --Hananías, ab' wal tas ol wala'. Manhok Jehová ix chekan ala'. Palta a tas tzal syak'och heb' anima yipok sk'o'ol chi' manh yeloklaj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ol ach in satel t'a sat lum tik. Yuj a lolonel ix al chi', ix wach' pitb'iel juntzanh anima tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a jun ab'il tik ol ach chamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a yukil uj t'a jun ab'il chi', ix cham winhaj Hananías chi'.

Ha in Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, ix wak'b'at jun in carta t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', t'a heb' sacerdote, t'a heb' schekab' Dios yet' t'a masanil anima aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ix wak'b'at jun carta tik, ayik toxo ix ik'jib'at winhaj rey Jeconías t'a Babilonia chi' yet' ix reina, haton ix snun winh. Ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' smunlaj t'a palacio, heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' jelan sb'o'an tastak yet' pax heb' tenum k'e'en.

Ix ik'jib'at jun carta tik yuj winhaj Elasa yuninal winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Haton heb' winh tik ix chekjib'at yuj winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha jun carta chi', icha tik syala':
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia yuj ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan t'ayex icha tik:
B'o'ek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat.
Hak'ekoch eyetb'eyum, aljokab' eyuninal. Ochokab' pax yetb'eyum heb' eyuninal chi', aljokab' pax yuninal heb', k'ib'okab' he b'isul, mokab' emta he b'isul chi'.
Munlajanhek yuj swach'ilok jun chonhab' b'aj ix ex wak'b'at chi'. k'anek in kolwal t'a yib'anh, tato wach' tz'aj jun chonhab' chi', wach' pax ol ex aj yet'ok.

Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal juntzanh tik: Manh eyak' he b'a musansatil yuj juntzanh heb' syesejoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' naumel lolonel yalani. Manh he cha eyab' swayich heb' syala'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' t'a in b'i, nab'a es. Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.
Swalanxi: Ayik ol tz'akwok 70 ab'il yak'an yajalil Babilonia chi', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, ol wak'anpaxelk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' to ol ex wik'xi meltzaj t'a tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', wojtak tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Ha tas nab'il chi' wu'uj, manh yujok eyab'an sya'elal, palta yuj he wach'ilok yik wach' ay tas tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol t'a b'ak'inh.
Ol lajwok chi', ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, ol ex lesalwok t'ayin, ol wab'an he lesal chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol ex jawok t'ayin, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex, yujto ol eyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ol in ch'oxnhej in b'a t'ayex. Ol in k'ex tas eyaji. Ol ex wik'kot t'a masanil nación yet' t'a masanil b'aj ix ex in saklemejkanb'ati. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol ex wik'anpax meltzaj b'aj ayex ek' kajan ayik ix ex ik'jib'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex tik tzeyala': Ayxo heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik, xe chi.

Palta syal Jehová icha tik t'a yib'anh winh rey ayoch t'a sdespachokan winhaj rey David yet' t'a heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, haton juntzanh heb' ayto eyuj he b'a yet'ok, heb' maj ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi':
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a skal heb'. Lajan ol wutejkan heb' icha juntzanh te' higo k'a'eltakxo, te chuklaj, maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol in pechb'eyek' heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Ol wak'an yajjok heb' yuj masanil nación. Ol ja katab' t'a yib'anh heb', ol xiw heb' anima yuj heb' ayik ol yilanoch heb'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj juntzanh nación b'aj ol in saklemejkanb'ati.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to tzijtum el ix alji t'a heb' yuj heb' in chekab', palta maj scha yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' in chekab' chi'. Hanhejtona' ex pax tik maj he chapax eyab'i.
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ix ex wak' ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ab'ek wal in lolonel swala'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in paxi, swal yuj winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Colaías yet' yuj winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Maasías, haton heb' winh tz'alan juntzanh esal lolonel t'a in b'i: Ol wak'och heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ol chekan miljokcham heb' winh t'a eyichanh.

Yuj chi', ex aj Judá, ex ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia, tato ayex ol he nib'ej he katab'ej junok mach, ol eyal icha tik: Ach yutejokab' Jehová icha utajnak winhaj Sedequías yet' winhaj Acab, haton heb' winh scheknak winhaj Nabucodonosor nhusjoktz'aok, xe chama.

Icha chi' ol aj sja t'a yib'anh heb' winh, yujto te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' winh t'a yol he chonhab'. Tz'em heb' winh ajmulal yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yetwinakil. Syalan juntzanh esal lolonel heb' winh t'a in b'i, manhok in tzin chek yal heb' winh. Ha in Jehová in swala', wojtak tas yaji, xchi Jehová, xin chib'at t'a jun in carta chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Semaías aj Nehelam ayek' t'a Babilonia chi'. T'a yol yik winh ix yak'kot jun carta t'a masanil heb' anima kajantokan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote. Ha t'a jun carta chi' ix yalkot winh t'a winhaj Sofonías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios ix ach ak'anoch sacerdoteal sk'exulok winhaj Joiada, yik wach' kuchb'um tzach aj t'a stemplo. Tato ay mach sk'och t'ayach aykot t'a sjolom tz'och ijan slolon icha heb' schekab' Dios. Ha jun chi' elanhchamel tzak'och t'a yol te' cepo, tza tzek'an yet' k'e'en cadena. ¿Tas yuj maj a kach winhaj Jeremías aj Anatot? Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh slolon t'a ichanh, icha schekab' Dios syutej sb'a winh, yujto ix yak'kot jun carta winh t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik. Syalan winh icha tik: Najtilto ol ex kajnaj ta'. B'o'ek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat, xchi jun scarta winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi scarta winhaj Semaías chi'. Ix yawtan jun carta chi' winhaj sacerdote Sofonías wab' a in Jeremías in tik. Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ix lolon t'ayin. Ix yalan icha tik: Alb'at t'a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia to a in swal icha tik: Ha winhaj Semaías aj Nehelam, winh ix halani to a in ix in chek yal winh to toxo ol meltzaj winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Palta manhok in ix in chek yal jun esal lolonel winh ix eyak'och yipok he k'ol chi'. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' sya'elal winhaj Semaías chi' yet' pax heb' yinhtilal. Manhxalaj junok yinhtilal winh chi' ol aj t'a skal heb' in chonhab', yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol t'a in wach'k'olal ol wak' t'ayex, yujto ix ex skuchb'ej winh yik tze pitej he b'a t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Haton slolonel Jehová tik ix yal t'ayin Jeremías in tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik, swal icha tik: Tz'ib'ejkan masanil tas ix wal t'ayach,

yujto ol k'och sk'uhal, ol wak' meltzaj heb' in chonhab' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham, xchi Jehová.
Haton tas ix yal Jehová tik t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ix yalan icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yel aw yuj xiwk'olal, manhxalaj tzalajk'olal.

k'anb'ejek wal eyab'i, tokwal ay junok winh winak tz'aj yune'. ¿Tas yuj swila', a heb' winh winak te tek'an, toxonhej wetz'wetz'och heb' winh t'a sk'ol icha heb' ix ix aykot sya'il unewel t'ay? ¿Tas yuj sakxonhej yilji sat heb' winh smasanil?

Ay jun k'uhal to manhxa yalnab'il ya'elal ol ujok, malaj junokxo k'u lajan yet' jun k'u ol jawok chi'. Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' ol och wal ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Jacob, palta ol kolchajel heb' t'a skal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wik'el te' yugo ayoch t'a sjaj heb' in chonhab', haton b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'wumal. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol och heb' chekab'wumal t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik ol in yak' serwil, ol yak'anpax serwil winh yinhtil winhaj David heb', haton winh ol wak'och sreyalok heb'.

Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok, yujto ol ex in kolel yet' heb' eyuninal t'a jun nación najat b'aj ix ex ik'jib'ati. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ex kajnajxi t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol he na'a, manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.

Ex yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok. Ayinnhejoch heyet'ok, ol in satel masanil juntzanh nación b'aj ix ex in saklemejb'ati. Palta a ex tik manh ol ex in satel-laj, anhej to ol wak'och eyaelal icha t'a smojal. Manh ol ek'b'atlaj in ch'olb'itan tas eyaji.
Ha b'aj ix ex lajwi chi', max yal yanhtaji, a eyaelal manhxalaj sb'onab'il.
Malaj mach tz'alan eyaelal, malaj mach tz'anhtan eyechen chi'. Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi'.

Masanil heb' tzex xajanani, toxo ix ex b'at satk'olal yuj heb'. ¿Tok tzato sna heb' tas tzex aji? Ha in ix ex wak' echnajok, icha ajk'ol wajoch t'ayex. Te niwan eyaelal ix wak'ochi, yujto manh jantakok he chukal, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
¿Tas yuj tz'el wal eyaw yuj eyechen chi'? Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi', yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok he mul, yuj chi' icha chi' tzex wutej.

Palta masanil heb' snib'ej ex sataneli, ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ik'jokkanb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ha heb' ix ik'anb'at tastak ay t'ayex, ol ik'jokpaxb'at yik heb'. Ha heb' ix elk'anb'at he k'a'el, ol elk'ajpaxb'at yik heb'.

Wach'chom a heb' eyajk'o'ol chi' syal heb' t'a he patiktak icha tik: Ha Sion toxo ix aktajkani, manhxalaj mach tz'ok' sk'ol yuj, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' b'oxok he k'o'ol, ol wanhtej eyechen chi'.

Yujto ol k'och sk'uhal, ol ex wik'xi meltzaj a ex yinhtilal ex Jacob tik b'aj ik'b'il ex b'ati. Ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex. Ha he chonhab' ol b'oxokk'e b'aj jub'ilem t'a sb'ab'elal yet' pax he palacio ol b'oxok t'a yet'tal.
Hata' ol k'e he jaj he b'itan yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, ol ex tzewaj t'a tzalajk'olal. Ol wak' k'ib' he b'isul, manh jaywanhoknhej ol ex ajok. Manh ol ex patikajelok, a in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'ochi.
Ha ex israel ex tik, icha heyaj t'a peka', icha chi' ol ex ajxok. Tek'an ol ex ajxok t'a wichanh. Ol wak'och sya'elal heb' ix ex ixtani.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a he kal ol elta jun mach ol och eyajalilok, a ol ex kuchb'anok. Ha jun eyajalil chi' ol wak' jawok t'a in tz'ey. Yujto malaj junok mach skomon tek'b'ej sb'a sjawi t'a in tz'ey.
Ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok, xchi Jehová.
Ha yowal sk'ol Jehová ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' chuk, icha wal junok owal ik' nhab' sjawi xumnajok.
Ha yowal sk'ol chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il yuj. Masanil juntzanh tik ol nachajel eyu'uj t'a slajwub' k'uhal.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun pekti' ol jawok chi', a in ol in och sDiosalok junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel, haxo heb' ol och in chonhab'ok.
Ha heb' israel ix elkan t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix scha in wach'k'olal heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ayik wan sayanek' heb' b'aj syik' yip.
Ha t'a pekataxo in ch'oxnak in b'a t'ayex walannak icha tik: Ex israel xajan ex wuj t'a masanil k 'inal, yuj chi' tz'ok'nhej in k'o'ol t'ayex.
Ol ex wik'xik'echa'anh. Eyet'nak he pandereta ol ex k'ex cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ol eyawejxi te' eyuwa t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Samaria. Ha mach ol yawej yuwa chi', ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' sat.

Yujto ol jawok jun k'uhal to a heb' stanhwumal chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol smakb'en Efraín, cha'anh ol el yaw heb' icha tik: Kotanhek, koyek t'a Sion t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal yuj jun chonhab'il heb' yinhtilal Jacob, haton jun te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil nación. Ab'chajokab' he b'itani, tzeyalan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, kol onh a chonhab' onh tik, a onh ayonh to kan tik, xe chi.

Ol wik' meltzaj heb' t'a jun nación ay t'a norte. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', hata' ol jawok heb' max yal-laj yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' ix yab'ix yet' heb' ix hato wal yalji yune'. Te niwan ol aj sb'isul heb' smeltzajxi.

Haxonhej lesal yet' ok'el ol yak' heb' ayik ol meltzajxok heb'. Ha inxo ol wik'b'at heb' t'a ha ha' tz'el yok yet' t'a yol jun b'e te ak'lik, manhxa b'aj ol telwok heb'. Yujto mamab'il waj t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Haxo chonhab' Efraín, ichato in b'ab'el unin yaji, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Ex junjun nación, ab'ek wal in loloni. Alekel t'a juntzanh chonhab' lak'an yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a sk'axepal ha' mar te najat ay, tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová ix ak'an saklem heb' israel, hanhejtona' pax ol molb'anxikot heb'. Ol tanhwajxok heb' yuj icha tz'aj stanhwaj nok' kalnel yuj stanhwumal, xe chi.
Yujto ol in kolkanel heb' yinhtilal Jacob, ol in kolankan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación te ay yip.

Ol ja heb', ol sb'itan b'it heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a tzalan Sion, haxo yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas wach' ol wak' t'ay, haton ixim trigo, wino, aceite, nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Lajan ol aj heb' icha te' awb'en te' aynhejoch yalil, manhxo ol el-laj yip heb' junelxo.

Ol k'e cheneljok heb' ix kob'estak yuj tzalajk'olal. Ol tzalaj pax heb' winh kelemtak yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch skusk'olal heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yelxo niwan stzalajk'olal heb' ol wak' t'a yichanh ya'elal ix yil heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote a wal wa'el te wach' ol wak' swa heb', haxo heb' in chonhab' ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' masanil tas ol wak' t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yoch aw t'a chonhab' Ramá, ay mach sik'sik'an wal yok' yuj ya'elal. Ha ix Raquel tz'ok' wal ix yuj heb' yune'. Manhxa snib'ej ix sniwanaj sk'o'ol, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix ix kani.

Ach Raquel, manhxo ach ok'ok, mokxob' el yal a sat yujto a in Jehová in swala', a tas ix a k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' une' chi', ol a cha spak. Ha heb' une' chi', ol elta heb' t'a schonhab' heb' ajk'o'ol, ol jaxkan kajan heb' t'a tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to syal ak'anoch yipok a k'ol tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'inh. Ha heb' une', ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab' tik.

Ix wab' wal sk'akwi heb' aj Efraín yuj kusk'olal, syalan heb' icha tik: Ix onh a k'ayb'ej icha tz'aj sk'ayb'aj junok nok' kelem wakax manh yojtakok smunlaji, palta ix kileli. Ik'onh meltzaj het'ok, b'ekan ko k'ol ko meltzaji, yujto a ach tik Jehová, ko Diosal ach.

Ix kik'el ko b'a t'ayach, palta ix ko na ko b'a tiknaik. Ayik ix nachajel ko chukal ku'uj, toxonhej ix onh em nhojan yuj k'ixwelal. Emnakilxonhej skutej ko b'a yuj jantak ko mul ix och t'a yiktax ko kelem uninal, xchi heb' aj Efraín chi' t'ayin.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a heb' aj Efraín tik, ichato wuninal yaj heb', xajan heb' wu'uj. Wach'chom swak' sya'elal heb', palta max waktej in na'an heb', ya swab' yuj heb', yujto tz'ok' wal in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ex aj Israel, sik'lab'il tzeyilkan jun b'e b'aj tzex b'ati, yujto hanheja' t'a jun b'e chi' ol ex meltzajxok yik tzex jax t'a he chonhab' ol eyaktejkan tik. Meltzajanhek ex chonhab' Israel. Meltzajanhek t'a juntzanh he chonhab'.

¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he b'eyek' icha junok ix ix te pit? Ha in Jehová in ol wak' ujok junok tas to manta b'aj tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik: Ha junok ix ix ol tzuntzanb'at junok winh winak, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ayik ol wik'anxikot heb' israel tik t'a slu'um b'aj kajantaxoni, ol laj yal heb' anima kajan t'a yol yik Judá icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun tzalan sik'b'ilel yuj, b'aj sb'eyb'alaj tojolal, xcham heb'.
Ol laj kajnajxok heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' heb' munlajwum tz'awan tastak, yet' pax heb' tanhwum kalnel ol kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha in ol wak'xi yip heb' k'unb'inak. Ha heb' tz'el yip yuj wejel, ol wak' b'ut'jok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi wilan juntzanh tik ix el in wayanh, ix in ek' k'elelok, te wach' jun ix ch'oxji wil tik.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol k'och sk'uhal, ol wak'anxi k'ib' sb'isul heb' anima yet' nok' nok' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha wal ix aj wak'an wip in tok'aneli, in juanemi, wak'an ik'jokemi, in sataneli yet' wak'an ixtajok, hanhejtona' icha chi' ol aj wak'anxi wip wak'anxiem yich, yik tzin b'oanxik'ei.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' manhxo ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il ix slo te' uwa heb' te paj, haxo heb' uninab'il, jululixonhej sb'at spajil te' t'a yichtak ye heb', manh xchiok heb'.
Yujto junjun mach ol cham yuj smul. Ha mach ol loan te' paj uwa chi', munil a ol ab'an spajil te', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol jawok sk'uhal, ol in b'oan junokxo in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Israel yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a jun trato chi', manh lajanok yet' jun in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ichato ochnak in ketzketz t'a sk'ab' heb' ayik wik'annakelta heb' chi', palta maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' in b'o yet'ok, wach'chom ichato wetb'eyum wutejnak heb'.

Haton in trato tik ol in b'o heyet'ok a ex yinhtilal ex israel tik t'a jun pekti' chi': Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och juntzanh in cheknab'il t'a he pixan, ichato ol in tz'ib'ejkanoch t'a he pensar, ol in och he Diosalok, a exxo ol ex och in chonhab'ok.

Manhxo yowalilok ay junok ex ol eyal t'a heb' eyetchonhab' icha tik: Ojtakejel Jehová, manhxo xe chiok. Yujto a in Jehová in swala' to he masanil ol in eyojtakejeli, wach'chom heb' unin, ma heb' icham anima. Ol wak' niwank'olal schukal heb', manhxa b'ak'inh ol in nakot smul heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix ak'ankanoch k'u yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a k'uhalil, k'e'en uj yet' k'e'en k'anal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'ak'walil. A' tz'ak'ank'e ponhnaj ha' mar ayik sk'anh ha'. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik:
Yakb'an manto satel juntzanh tz'ak'an sakil k'inal chi', a ex israel ex tik manh ol ex satel-laj t'a nacional t'a wichanh.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Icha satcha'anh malaj b'ak'inh syal yechtaji, mato icha sjulal yich lum lum malaj b'ak'inh tz'ojtakajeli, icha chi' waj eyet' in chonhab' israel ex tik, malaj b'ak'inh ol ex in patikejel yuj tas tze k'ulej, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Ol ja sk'uhal to ol b'ochajxik'e in chonhab', schael yich t'a torre Hananel, masanto ol k'och t'a jun puerta ay t'a jun schikin.
Tojolnhej ol b'at t'a smojonal, masanto t'a lum tzalan yik Gareb, skumlajb'at t'a stojolal Goa.

Masanil lum sch'olanil b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, b'aj sb'at yumchajkanel k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh yet' t'a yib'anh sti' ha ha' skuch Cedrón, masanto t'a junxo schikin b'aj ay puerta yik nok' chej, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, wik ol ajkanok. Masanil juntzanh chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol juchajemok, manhxa b'ak'inh ol satelok, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ayoch slajunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik 18 ab'ilxo pax yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ha t'a yik chi' wan yak'an owal heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Jerusalén, a inxo Jeremías in tik, ayin och preso t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalacio heb' sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj rey Sedequías chi' ix in chekan yamjok, yujto ix wal icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alani: Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Haxo winhaj rey Sedequías, manhxo ol yal-laj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' caldeo. Ol yamchaj winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Yowalil ol k'och winh t'a yichanh jun winh rey chi'. Ol lolon winh yet' winh, ol yil wal och winh.

Ha winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol schek ik'jokb'at winhaj Sedequías chi' winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Hata' ol kannhej winh masanto ol cham winh. Wach'chom ol eyak' owal yet' heb' caldeo chi', palta manh ol yal-laj eyu'uj, xchi Jehová, xin chi. Yuj chi' ayin och t'a preso chi'.
Hata' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
