Ilnab'i, a winhaj Hanamel yuninal winhaj Salum winh a k'ab' ok, ol jawok winh t'ayach, ol ul yalan winh icha tik: Man jun in lum ay t'a Anatot. Smoj ton wal a ach tza mana', yujto ayto kuj ko b'a, xcham winh, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Icha ix aj yalan chi' t'ayin, icha chi' ix aji. Ix jawi winh in k'ab' wok chi' t'ayin ayik ayinek' t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalacio winh rey chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Man jun in lu'um ay t'a Anatot, t'a yol smakb'en Benjamín. Ha ach ay halan ik a manani, skan lum t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te ayto kuj ko b'a, xchi winh t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wu'uj to slolonel Jehová jun chi'.
Ix in manan lum t'a winhaj Hanamel chi', ix wak'an 17 k'e'en plata stojolok lu'um.
Ix in tz'ib'ankan jun trato chi', ix in makankan yet' in sello t'a yichanh heb' testigo.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wik'ankot jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato b'aj ayoch sello chi', haxo scopiail maj och selloal yik wach' syal yilji.

Ixlajwi chi', a wal t'a yichanh winh in k'ab' wok aj Hanamel chi' yet' t'a yichanh pax heb' testigo yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' wetchonhab' k'ojanem ta' ix wak'an in firma b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato chi', ix wak'ankan schab'il t'a winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías, yixchikin winhaj Maaseías.
T'a yichanh heb' ix wal t'a winhaj Baruc chi' icha tik:

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a ix halani to skan juntzanh b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato tik, haton jun ayoch selloal yet' jun malaj selloal, tza sik'kan t'a yol junok lum chen yik wach' najtil ol ek'ok.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha b'ak'inh, ol laj smanxi spat heb' anima, slum heb' yet' te' uwa awab'ilxo t'a jun nación tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ixlajwi wak'ankan jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chaj jun trato yik jun lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Baruc chi', ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik:
Mamin Jehová yet' wal a poder a b'onak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Malaj tas ajaltak sb'o u'uj.

Ha ach tik, tza xajanej jantak makanhil anima tz'ek'i. Palta tzak'paxoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam yicham. Ach Dios te niwan elk'ochi, masanil syal u'uj. Ha a b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Te niwan elk'och t'a tas tza na' yet' t'a tas tza k'ulej. Ha ach tik, tzil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb' anima, tza pakan t'a junjun heb' icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej chi'.

Ha ach a b'onak juntzanh tas niwak satub'tak t'a Egipto yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwan yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona' tiknaik jantak tas tza ch'ox pax t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik yet' t'a skal masanil anima, yuj chi' tzach b'inaj wal.
Yet' wal jantak a poder chi' ik'nakelta a chonhab' Israel tik t'a Egipto, a ch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwak yelk'ochi. Yuj chi' xiwnak wal masanil anima.
Slajwi chi' ak'annak jun lum te yax sat tik t'ayonh israel onh tik, icha ajnak ak'annakkan a ti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Palta ayik skajnajnak heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, yikannak lum heb', maj scha yab' a cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sk'ulej heb' tas tza chek sk'ulej. Yuj chi' ix ak'kot masanil juntzanh ya'elal tik t'a kib'anh.

Ha tiknaik, a heb' caldeo toxo ix sb'ok'e juntzanh stek'nub' heb' yik syak'an owal heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Yuj owal, wejel yet' ilya, ol yak' ganar ko chonhab' tik heb' ak'um owal chi'. Mamin, wan yelk'och tas alnakkani.
Palta Mamin Jehová, wach'chom ol ak'jok ganar jun ko chonhab' tik yuj heb' caldeo chi', palta a ach ix ala': Man jun lum chi', tza tupan t'a yichanh heb' testigo, xa chi, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in, sDiosal in smasanil anima. ¿Tok ay tas ajaltak sb'o wu'uj?
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, a in ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal heb' caldeo t'a Babilonia.

Ha heb' caldeo wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ochta heb' t'a yo'ol, ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb'. Ol tz'ab'at masanil juntzanh pat b'aj ix laj yak'och smul heb' anima t'ayin, haton t'a spanhanil yib'anh juntzanh pat chi' b'aj ix snhus incienso heb' t'a Baal. Ix yak'an wino heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'.

Atax yik ix el yich chonhab' Israel yet' Judá, ix sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tas max scha in k'ol heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to max yaktej heb' stzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj juntzanh yechel komon Dios sb'ok'e heb'.

Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, yiktax ix el yich skajnaj heb' t'ay, masanto tiknaik, malaj jab'ok wach'il sk'ulej heb', anhej yowal in k'ol stzuntzejkot heb', yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' schonhab' tik.

Ha heb' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' yuj jantak chukal sk'ulej, lajan heb' yet' sreyal, heb' yajal, heb' sacerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' pax masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá tik.
Max kot k'elan heb' t'ayin, palta to a yich spatik heb' syak'koti. Wach'chom max waktej in k'ayb'an heb', palta manh wal jab'ok scha yab' heb', malaj yelk'och t'a heb' b'aj tzin kacha'.
Ix yixtejb'at in templo heb' to wiknhej yaji, ix yak'anoch juntzanh yechel yajb'entak heb' t'a yo'ol.

Hanhejtona' ix sb'opaxk'e altar yik Baal heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, hata' snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios Moloc. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yoch smul heb' aj Judá sk'ulan tas manhok in swala', max ek' jab'ok t'a in pensar juntzanh tas sb'eyb'alej heb' chi'.
Syal heb' anima icha tik: Ha ko chonhab' tik, ol ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová he Diosal in swala':
Ol in molb'ejxi heb' b'aj ol in saklemejb'at t'a junjun nación yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol lajwok chi', ol in wik'anxikot heb'. Ha t'a tik ol aj heb', manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'.
Junxonhej ol wutej spensar heb', lajanxonhej ol yutej heb' in yak'an serwil t'a masanil tiempo, yik tz'och swach'ilok heb' yet' yinhtilal.

Ol in b'o junok in trato yet' heb' t'a junelnhej, manh ol waktejkan wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Ol wak' sk'ulej heb' to aynhej ol aj welk'och t'a sat heb', yik manhxa b'ak'inh ol yik'kanel sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yet' wal in tzalajk'olal ol wak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. T'a wal yel ol wak' kajnaj heb' t'a jun lu'um tik t'a smasanil in k'o'ol.
Icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at jun niwan ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, icha chi' ol aj wak'anpaxb'at wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, icha ix aj wak'an in ti'.
Ha heb' anima tik syal heb' to ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik. Manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' ol kan t'ay. Ol ak'jok ganar yuj heb' caldeo, xchi heb'. Palta ol meltzajxok heb' anima sman lum lum tik.

Ol sman slu'um heb', ol sb'o'an yumal heb' yet' sello yet' pax sfirma heb' testigo. Icha chi' ol ujok t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, t'a tzalkixtak, t'a ak'liktak yet' t'a yol smakb'en Neguev. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xicha'anh in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik ayinto och t'a preso t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palacio, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani:
Ha in Jehová in in b'onakem yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Wach' wutejnakkan lu'um t'a yet'tal, a in swal t'ayach icha tik:
Awajanh t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach tas niwak yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yalji to manh ojtakok.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ay wal jun in lolonel swalkan t'a yib'anh spat heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh spalacio heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ha juntzanh pat chi' wan sjuchajemi yik sk'anchaj sk'enal t'a juntzanh olan t'a smuroal chonhab', yik wach' max och heb' caldeo yak' owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yol juntzanh pat chi', toxonhej ol b'ut'jokel yuj sniwanil heb' anima ol miljokcham yuj heb' caldeo yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol in b'at mikan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto te niwan smul heb' ix och t'ayin.
Palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'anxi sk'inal heb', ol wak'an kajnaj heb' t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel b'aj ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol laj in b'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' icha t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ol wik'el schukal heb' ix yak'och t'ayin. Ol wak'an niwank'olal smul heb' yet' spitalil t'ayin.

Ol te tzalajb'ok in k'ol yuj Jerusalén tik. Ha wal yik ol yab'an masanil nación yuj tas niwan yelk'och ol in k'ulej t'a in chonhab' tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin, ol in yak'an b'inaj heb'. Palta ol sat wal sk'ol heb', ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik ol yilan heb' jantak wach'il yet' junk'olal ol wak' t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ha ex tik tzeyala' to a jun lum tik kuseltak yajkani, manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' tz'ilchaj t'ay. Wach'chom icha chi' yajkani, ha t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén, t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a Judá tzinan yajkani, b'aj manhxa junok anima, ma junok nok' nok' ayek' t'ay, hata' ol ab'chajxok yoch b'it yik k'inh, b'it yik tzalajk'olal, sb'it heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ix kob'estak ayik snupnaj heb'. Ol ik'chajkot ofrenda yik ak'oj yuj diosal t'a in templo, ol ab'chaj yalji icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, yujto te wach', xajan onh yuj t'a masanil k 'inal, xcham heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xicha'anh jun chonhab' tik icha t'a sb'ab'elal, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a jun lum kannak tzinan tik, manhxa anima, manhxa nok' nok' ay t'ay, palta ha t'a spatik yichanh juntzanh chonhab' tik, manh jantakok ol ajxok anh ank'ultak b'aj ol tanhwajxok nok' kalnel yuj heb' stanhwumal.

Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak, t'a lum ak'liktak, t'a lum Neguev, t'a lum yik Benjamín, t'a juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol iljokxi heb' tanhwum kalnel, ol ab'chaj sb'isan nok' skalnel heb' chi'.
Ol k'och sk'uhal, ol elk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ayik ol jawok jun tiempo chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj David reyal. Ha ol ik'ancha'anh tojolal yet' wach'ilal t'a jun nación tik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a heb' aj Judá ol kolchajkanel heb', haxo heb' aj Jerusalén, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'. Ha jun b'i tik ol ak'jok t'a heb': “A Jehová tzonh ak'anoch wach'il”, xchama.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj b'ak'inh ol satel yinhtilal winhaj David, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel.

Hanhejtona' malaj b'ak'inh ol satpaxel heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví, ol snhusnhej silab' heb' t'ayin. T'a junjun k'u ol snhusan ixim trigo heb' silab'il yet' juntzanhxo silab' ol yak' heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in tik swala' to ay jun in trato wak'nakkani to ay k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil t'a stiempoal. Max yal-laj sk'exmaj jun in trato chi'.

Hanhejtona' max yal-laj satel in trato wak'nak yet' winh in chekab' aj David to tz'ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winh reyal t'a sdespacho. Manh ol satelpax in trato in b'onak yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví yik tzin yak'an serwil heb' t'a sacerdoteal.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winh in chekab' aj David chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví tzin ak'an serwil, ol wak' k'ib' sb'isul heb' icha k'e'en k'anal, ma icha k'e'en yarenail sti' ha' mar malaj mach syal sb'isani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

¿Tom max nachajel u'uj tas syal heb' anima, syal heb' to ix in patikejel cha makan inhtilal sik'b'ilel wu'uj, haton Israel yet' Judá? Yuj chi' manhxa yelk'och heb' in chonhab' chi' t'a heb', manhxo naciónoklaj yaj t'a yol sat heb'.
Ha in Jehová in in b'onak jun in trato yet' k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil. Swalani chajtil tz'aj sb'ey satcha'anh yet' sat lum tik, max k'exmajlaj.

Hanhejtona' malaj pax b'ak'inh ol k'exmaj in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Jacob yet' pax heb' yik winh in chekab' aj David. Yowalil ol in sik'elta junok yinhtilal winh, ol yak'an reyal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Abraham, Isaac yet' Jacob. Ol wik'xicha'anh heb', yujto te ay wok'elk'olal t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Ayik wan yak'an owal winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil, yet'nak masanil heb' soldado winh yet' masanil juntzanh nación aykan t'a yalanh smandar winh, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swal t'ayach, b'at al t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, ol yak'och sk'ak'al winh.

Ha ach tik manhxo ol yal-laj el lemnajok, ol ach yamchaj yuj heb', ol ach yak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol il-laj och a sat yet' winh, ol ach lolon yet' winh, ol ach yik'anb'at winh t'a Babilonia chi'.
Yuj chi' ach Sedequías, ab' wal tas ol wal a in Jehová in tik: Manh ol ach miljokcham t'a k'e'en espada.

Junk'olal ol aj a chami. Ha in Jehová in swak' in ti' to icha yutejnak heb' anima snhusan incienso ayik smukchajnak heb' a mam icham, haton heb' ochnak reyal ayik manto ach och a ach tik, icha chi' ol aj snhuschaj incienso chi' ayik ol ach mukchajok. Ol ok' heb' u'uj, ol yalan heb' icha tik: Ay, ix cham winh ko reyal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix walan masanil juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén,

yakb'an a heb' soldado yik Babilonia ayxo och heb' yak'an owal t'a chonhab' Jerusalén tik, t'a Laquis yet' t'a Azeca. Ha t'a yol yik Judá haxonhej juntzanh chonhab' chi' wach' yajoch smuroal manto ak'ji ganar yuj heb' soldado yik Babilonia chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ayik toxo ix yak' jun strato winhaj Sedequías yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, yik tz'ak'jiel heb' ayoch chekab'ok t'a libre.

Icha tik ix aj jun trato chi': Masanil heb' israel ayoch chekab'ok t'a heb' yetchonhab', tz'ak'jiel heb' t'a libre, wach'chom winak, wach'chom ix, yik manhxa junok yetchonhab' heb' tz'ochkan schekab'ok.

Masanil heb' yajal yet' masanil heb' anima, ix scha sk'ol jun trato chi' heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yak'anel heb' schekab'wum heb' chi' t'a libre. Manhxa junok heb' tz'ak'ji pural yak'an serwil junokxo yetchonhab'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'exanxi spensar heb' ix aktanel heb' schekab' chi', yuj chi' ix yak'xi pural heb' yochxi heb' schekab'ok.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, wak'nakkan jun in trato yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto, b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'ok. Walnak t'a heb' t'a yiktax chi'

to t'a junjun yuktakil ab'il syak'el heb' schekab' heb' t'a libre, haton heb' eyetisraelal schonhnakoch sb'a t'a heb', yak'annak serwil heb' wakeok ab'il. Palta a heb' he mam eyicham chi', maj scha yab' heb' tas walnak, maj sk'anab'ajej heb'.

Icha pax chi' ix eyutej he b'a a ex tik. Palta ix he k'ex he b'eyb'al, yujto wan he k'ulan tas scha in k'o'ol, yujto ix eyak'el heb' eyetchonhab' ayoch he chekab'ok t'a libre. Ix eyak'an he ti' t'a jun trato ix he b'o t'a wichanh, haton t'a yol in templo wiknhej yaji.
Ixlajwi chi', ix he k'exanxi he b'eyb'al, ix in he patikejkaneli. Ix eyak'anxi pural heb' he chekab' chi' ex yak'anxi serwil, wach'chom toxo ix eyak'el heb' t'a libre.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala': Maj he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', maj eyak'el heb' eyetchonhab' t'a libre. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a eyib'anh. Ol xiw masanil nación ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol ex wutej.

Ha heb' yajal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' tz'ak'an serwil t'a palacio, heb' sacerdote yet' masanil heb' anima kajan ta', ix sb'o jun strato heb' t'a wichanh. Chapoj ix yutej jun nok' kelem wakax heb', ix lajwi chi' ix b'eyek' heb' t'a skal nok'. Palta elanhchamel ix spatikejel jun trato b'aj ix yak' sti' heb' chi'. Icha ix yutej nok' wakax chi' heb', icha chi' ol wutej heb'.
Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajk'o'ol, ol miljokcham heb' yuj heb'. Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' ol chianb'at sniwanil heb'.

Ol wak'och winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, heb' snib'ejtaxon smilancham heb'. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' yuj heb' winh soldado aj Babilonia, wach'chom toxo ix aktajkan heb' yuj heb'.

Palta a in Jehová in swala': Ol wik'xikot heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol yak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ol ak'jok ganar yuj heb', ol snhusankantz'a heb'. Haxo juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol wak'kan tzinan, manhxa junok anima ol kan kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ayoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik b'aj ayek' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab, tzach lolon yet' heb'. Tzik'anb'at heb' t'a junok cuarto t'a in templo, tzak'an wino yuk' heb', xchi t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix b'at in sayek' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal junxo winhaj Jeremías, yixchikin winhaj Habasinías. Ix wik'b'at winh yet' heb' yuk'tak yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' yet' masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab kajan ta'.

Ix wik'b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová, t'a jun cuarto yik heb' yuninal winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Igdalías, haton winh ay yelk'och Dios t'ay. Ha jun cuarto chi', junnhej yaj yet' yik heb' yajal yaj t'a templo chi'. Ha t'a yib'anh scuarto winhaj Maasías yuninal winhaj Salum hata' ay, haton winh yajalil heb' stanhwumal templo.
Ix wak'an juntzanh xalu yet' waso b'ut'an yet' wino t'a heb', ix walan t'a heb': Uk'ek jab'ok wino tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ha onh tik, max kuk'laj wino tik, yujto a winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab, haton winh ko mam kicham a onh tik, a winh ak'annakkan yowalil to max kuk' wino. Hanhejtona' heb' kinhtilal max yal-laj yuk'an heb'.

Yak'annak pax yowalil winh to max ko b'o ko pat, max kawej kawb'en, max kawej pax ko uwa. Yalannak pax winh t'ayonh to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado tzonh aji, ichanhej chi' ol aj kek' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum b'aj ek'elb'anhej kek' tik.
Ha onh tik, wan ko k'anab'ajan tas yalnakkan winh ko mam kicham aj Jonadab chi'. Yuj chi' malaj b'aj skuk' wino tik, ma heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal max yuk'laj heb'.
Malaj ko pat sko b'o'o, malaj te' uwa skawej, malaj ko lum b'aj syal kawan kawb'en.
Anhej t'a yoltak mantiado tzonh aji, wan ko k'anab'ajan tas yalnakkan winh ko mam kicham chi'.

Palta haxo yik ix jawi winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a jun nación tik, ix onh el elelal. Ix ko na'ani to wach' tzonh jakan t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto onh el t'a heb' soldado caldeo yet' t'a heb' soldado aj Siria. Yuj chi' ayonhek' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, swal t'ayach, ixik b'at al t'a masanil heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén to sk'ayb'ej wal jun k'ayb'ub'al tik heb', yik sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il heb'.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab chi', sk'anab'ajej wal heb' tas yalnakkan smam yicham heb' chi'. Max yuk' wino heb' masanto tiknaik. Hanheja' sk'anab'ajan heb', max yuk'laj heb'. Ichin pax ta', tzijtum el ix wak' in cheknab'il t'ayex, palta max in he k'anab'ajej.

Tzijtum heb' in chekab' ix in chekb'at t'ayex yik syal heb' to tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al yet' he chuk pensaril. Tzin chek yal heb' to max eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ma eyoch ejmelal t'ay, yik wach' tzex kajnajnhej t'a lum lum wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex. Palta junelnhej max he cha eyab'i, max in he k'anab'ajej.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab chi', sk'anab'ajej heb' tas yalnak smam yicham chi', a exxo tik, junelnhej max in he k'anab'ajej.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at juntzanh ya'elal alb'ilxo wuj t'a eyib'anh he masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik. Yujto ix ex in kacha', palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix in awaj t'ayex, palta maj ex tak'wok t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix walanxi t'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Recab chi': Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alani: Yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas yalnakkan winh he mam eyicham chi',
yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, a in swala': Malaj b'ak'inh ol satel yinhtilal winhaj Jonadab chi' in yak'an serwil, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim, yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ix yalan icha tik:

Ik'kot junok b'aj tzach tz'ib'ani. Tza tz'ib'an masanil tas ix wal t'a yib'anh Israel yet' t'a yib'anh Judá yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nación, yiktax ix in cha'anel yich walan t'ayach t'a stiempoal winhaj Josías masanto tiknaik.
Talaj ayik ol yab'an heb' aj Judá, yuj juntzanh ya'elal tzin na' t'a yib'anh heb' tik, ol yaktankan schukal b'eyb'al heb', yik icha chi' ol aj wak'an niwank'olal smul heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix wawtankot winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías. Ix walan t'a winh masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin, ix stz'ib'ankan winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ilnab' wal tas waji, tzin kachjioch wa'an in b'at t'a stemplo Jehová.

Yuj chi', ayik ol jawok sk'uhal tzek'ojk'olal junelxo, tzach b'at t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Hata' ol awtej tas ix in chek a tz'ib'ej tik, yik wach' a masanil heb' aj Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a yol yik Judá ol jawok t'a tik, ol yab' slolonel Jehová heb'.

Talaj syalxi sb'a heb' anima tik t'a Jehová chi', syaktankan schukal b'eyb'al heb'. Yujto nab'ilxo yuj Jehová to te niwan yowal sk'o'ol ol yak'kot t'a yib'anh juntzanh anima tik, xin chi t'a winhaj Baruc chi'.
Ix sk'ulan winhaj Baruc chi' masanil tas ix wal chi' t'ay. Ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová, ix yawtan slolonel Jehová chi' winh, haton tas ix stz'ib'ej winh chi'.

Ha t'a sb'alunhil uj t'a yo'il ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix sna winhaj Joacim chi' to a heb' anima kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix kot t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yowalil tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Haxo winhaj Baruc ix awtan tas ix in chek stz'ib'ej, yik syab' masanil anima. Ha t'a jun amak' cha'anh yajk'e t'a stemplo Jehová t'a stz'ey jun ak' puerta b'aj ay scuarto winhaj Gemarías winh tz'ib'um, winh yuninal winhaj Safán, hata' ix yawtej winh.
Ha winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Gemarías, yixchikin winhaj Safán, ix yab' winh masanil slolonel Jehová ix yawtej winhaj Baruc chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a spalacio winh rey, t'a scuarto winh tz'ib'um, b'aj molanek' heb' winh niwak yopisio: Haton winhaj Elisama tz'ib'um, winhaj Delaía yuninal winhaj Semaías, winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor, winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Safán, winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Ananías yet' masanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' masanil tas ix yab' yuj tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj winhaj Baruc chi', ayik ix yawtan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima.

Haxo heb' winh niwak yopisio chi' ix chekanb'at winhaj Jehudí yuninal winhaj Netanías, yixchikin winhaj Selemías yinhtilal winhaj Cusi, yik b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Baruc chi', yik syik'kot tas tz'ib'ab'il chi' yuj winh, haton jun ix yawtej winh t'a yichanh heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'il chi' winhaj Baruc chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Emanh k'ojan, tzawtan kab'i tas ix a tz'ib'ej chi', xchi heb' winh. Ix yawtan winh.

Ha wal yik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix xiw heb' winh, ix och k'eljab' heb' winh t'ay junjun, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik t'a winh: --Yowalil ol kal juntzanh tik t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Al t'ayonh, ¿tas ix utej a tz'ib'an juntzanh tik? ¿Am winhaj Jeremías ix halan t'ayach? xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Haton winhaj Jeremías ix halan t'ayin, ix in tz'ib'ankan yet' tinta, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --B'at k'ub'ejel a b'a yet' winhaj Jeremías chi', malajokab' mach tz'ojtakaneli b'aj tzex k'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix yak'ankan tas tz'ib'ab'il heb' winh ay yopisio chi' t'a scuarto winhaj Elisama winh tz'ib'um, ix b'at yalan masanil juntzanh chi' heb' winh t'a winh rey t'a yamak'il spalacio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix chekjib'at winhaj Jehudí yuj winh rey chi' yik b'at yik'ankot winh tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj winhaj Baruc chi', jun ix kan t'a scuarto winhaj Elisama. Ayik ix jawi winh yet'ok, ix yawtan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ay yopisio chi', oyanek' heb' smaklan yab'i.
Yujto sb'alunhil uj yoch jun ab'il chi', yuj chi' ayek' winh rey t'a scuarto b'aj tz'aj t'a stiempoal si'ik. Haxo t'a yichanh winh ayoch jun yet'tal tzak'ak', chak xeinak yaj te' t'a yo'ol.

Ayik ix lajwi yawtan winhaj Jehudí oxe', ma chanhe' makan tz'ib'ab'il chi', ix skotak polanb'at winh rey juntzanh toxo ix awtaj chi' yet' jun pol-lab' sk'an heb' tz'ib'um. Ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol k'ak' chi'. Icha chi' ix aj snhusantz'a masanil tas tz'ib'ab'il chi' winh.
Wach'chom ix yab' winh rey yet' heb' ayek' chi' yet' winh tas ix yal jun tz'ib'ab'il chi', palta maj xiw jab'ok heb', maj sch'oxel skusk'olal heb' yuj.
Ha winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Gemarías ix tewi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi' yik max snhustz'a winh, palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh.

Tonhej ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Jerameel yinhtilal heb' rey, t'a winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Azriel yet' t'a winhaj Selemías yuninal winhaj Abdeel, yik tzin ik'jikot a in Jeremías in tik yet' winh in tz'ib'um aj Baruc chi'. Palta a Jehová onh k'ub'aneli.
Ayik toxo ix snhustz'a tas tz'ib'ab'il winh rey chi', haton juntzanh lolonel ix in chek stz'ib'ej winhaj Baruc, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'kot junokxo b'aj ol a tz'ib'ejxi juntzanh lolonel ix ak' tz'ib'chaj t'a sb'ab'elal chi', haton ix snhustz'a winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá.

Tzalan pax juntzanh lolonel tik t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha ach tik, ix a nhustz'a tas tz'ib'ab'il, ix a tuman pax winhaj Jeremías, yujto ix stz'ib'ej winh to ol jawok winh sreyal Babilonia ul satel jun nación tik, manhxa junok anima, ma junok nok' nok' ol kanok.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swal t'ayach ach Joacim sreyal Judá, malaj junok inhtilal ol kannhej t'a sdespacho winhaj David. Ha a niwanil ol kan telan t'a yok k'u yet' t'a skal sikal t'ak'walil.

Ha ach tik yet' inhtilal yet' pax heb' ayoch yajalil het'ok, ol wak'och ya'elal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul. Ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a Judá juntzanh ya'elal toxo ix walkan tik, haton juntzanh maj he cha eyab'i, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wik'anxikot junxo b'aj stz'ib'chaj tastak, ix wak'an t'a winhaj Baruc winh in tz'ib'um, ix stz'ib'an winh tastak ix wala', haton tastak tz'ib'ab'il t'a juntzanh ix snhustz'a winhaj rey Joacim chi'. Ayto pax stz'akub' tas walnak chi' ix tz'ib'aji.
Ix ak'jioch winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ix ochkan sk'exulok winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim.

Hanhejtona' winhaj Sedequías chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' pax masanil heb' yetchonhab' winh, maj sk'anab'ajej slolonel Jehová heb' ix schek wal a in Jeremías in tik, a in schekab' in Dios.

Ha winhaj rey Sedequías chi' ix chekankot winhaj Jucal yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj sacerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías, yik tzul in yilan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'ayin icha tik: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal ku'uj, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik chi' manto in ak'jioch t'a preso, yuj chi' libre to in b'eyek' t'a skal heb' anima.

Ha heb' soldado aj Babilonia oyanoch heb' t'a spatik Jerusalén tik, palta t'a jun pekti' chi', ix yab' heb' to wan skot heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto t'a schonhab', yuj chi' ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix schekan wal t'a heb' winh ix chekjikot chi' t'ayin icha tik:
Alek t'a winh sreyal Judá, winh ix ex chekankot ul he k'anb'ej t'ayin, a heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto ix kot kolwal heyet'ok eyalani, palta ol meltzaj heb' t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', ol kotxok heb' aj Babilonia chi' yik tzul yak'an owal heb' yet' Jerusalén tik, ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' tik yuj heb', ol yak'ankanoch sk'ak'al heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Manh eyak' musansatil he b'a, tzeyalani to toxo ix el heb' soldado aj Babilonia t'a he kal, yujto manh ichaok ta' yaji.

Wach'chom ol eyak' ganar heb' soldado wan yak'an owal eyet' chi', yuj chi' haxonhej heb' lajwinak ol kan t'a scampamento heb', palta ol k'ex wa'an heb', ol yak'anoch k'ak' heb' t'a jun he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayik ix el heb' soldado Babilonia t'a Jerusalén, yujto ix yab' heb' to wanxo sjawi heb' soldado winh sreyal Egipto,
wanxo welta a in Jeremías in tik t'a yol chonhab' chi', yik tzin b'atkan t'a yol yik Benjamín, yik sb'at in cha'an in makb'en t'a heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok walani.

Ayik in k'och t'a spuertail b'aj sb'at b'e t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', hata' ay jun winh skuchan Irías yuninal winhaj Selemías, yixchikin winhaj Hananías, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha jun winh chi' in yamanoch wa'an, yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ha ach tik, wanxo och yet' heb' aj Babilonia, xchi winh.
In tak'wi t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, malaj in tzin och yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi', xin chi t'a winh. Palta maj scha yab' winh, anhej to in yik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal.
Kot yowal heb' winh yajal chi' t'ayin, in schekan mak'jok heb' winh, b'at in yak'anoch heb' winh t'a preso t'a spat winhaj Jonatán, winh tz'ib'um. Ha spat winh chi' och presoal yuj heb'.
Yuj chi', in kannhej t'a preso t'a jun cuarto b'ob'il t'a yol lu'um. Niwan tiempo in kan ta'.

Haxo winhaj rey Sedequías in ak'an ik'jokkot t'a spalacio. Ayik in k'och t'a yichanh winh rey chi', sk'anb'an winh t'ayin t'a elk'altak icha tik: --¿Ay am junok slolonel Jehová tzal t'ayin? xchi winh. In tak'wi t'a winh icha tik: --Ay toni. Icha wal tik yalani: Ha ach tik mamin rey, ol ach ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, xin chi.
Hanhejtona' in k'anb'ej t'a winhaj Sedequías chi' icha tik: ¿Tas in mul ix och t'ayach mamin rey yet' t'a heb' ayoch yajalil het'ok yet' pax t'a heb' anima, yuj chi' ix in a chek ak'jokoch t'a preso?
¿Tas ix aj yelk'och slolonel juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' ix halani to manh ol jawok winh sreyal Babilonia yak' owal yet' jun chonhab' tik?
Haxo tiknaik jun mamin rey, a tas ol in k'an t'ayach, komonok tzak' t'ayin: Manhxo in a cha ik'jokb'at t'a spat winhaj Jonatán, winh tz'ib'um, haxo talaj tz'aji tzin cham ta'.

Yuj chi', yalan winhaj rey Sedequías chi' to tzin kan t'a jun yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palacio chi', haxo t'a junjun k'u tz'ak'ji junjun pan t'ayin, smanji t'a heb' b'o'um pan. Ichanhej chi' aji, yakb'an ayto ixim pan chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Icha chi' aj in kannhej t'a amak' chi'.

Ha winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Matán, winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Pasur, winhaj Jucal yuninal winhaj Selemías yet' winhaj Pasur yuninal winhaj Malquías, a heb' winh tik, ix yab' heb' winh tas ix wal t'a yichanh heb' anima ayik ix walani:

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha mach ol kan t'a yol chonhab' tik, ol cham yuj owal, yuj wejel, ma yuj ilya. Haxo mach ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia, a heb' chi' ol kolchaj heb', manh ol chamlaj heb'.
Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' soldado winh sreyal Babilonia. Ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' tik yuj heb', xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh yajal chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Chek miljokcham jun winak tik, yujto schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' soldado aytoek' t'a yol chonhab' tik yuj tas syal winh, syak'an somchaj spensar heb' anima winh. Ha jun winak tik, manhok swach'il heb' ketchonhab' tik say winh, palta a ko ya'elal say winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj rey Sedequías chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ichokab'ta', syalnhej he k'ulan tas he gana t'a winh, malaj jab'ok tas syal walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix in syaman heb' winh, ix in yak'anem heb' winh yet' jun lasu t'a yol jun yet'tal b'aj smolb'ej sb'a ha ha'. Ha jun chi', yik winhaj Malquías yuninal winh rey chi'. Ha t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palacio, hata' ay. Ha t'a yol jun chi' manhxalaj ha ha' chi', haxonhej lum sok'om ay. Yuj chi' ayik ix in emk'och chi', ix in b'atkan t'a skal lum sok'om chi'.

Ayik k'ojan em winh rey chi' t'a spuertail b'aj sb'at b'e t'a yol yik Benjamín, ix yab'an winhaj Ebed-melec to toxo ix in ak'jiem t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' chi'. Ha jun winh winak chi' aj Etiopía winh, ay yopisio winh t'a spalacio winh rey chi'.
Ix elta winh t'a yol palacio chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik:

--Mamin rey, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej juntzanh winak tik t'a winhaj Jeremías schekab' Dios. Ix yak'em winh heb' winh t'a yol jun yet'tal ha' jul yich. Hata' ol cham winh yuj wejel, yujto manhxalaj tas swaji t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Ebed-melec chi' icha tik: --Ik'b'at junok 30 heb' winh winak tik, b'at eyik'ank'eta winhaj Jeremías chi' t'a jun jul chi', yakb'an manto cham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Ebed-melec chi' yet' heb' winh t'a jun cuarto ay t'a yalanh b'aj sik'chaj tastak yik palacio, ix b'at yik'ankot juntzanh k'atak k'apak heb' winh. Ix yak'anem k'apak heb' winh yet' jun lasu t'ayin.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ak'och juntzanh k'apak chi' t'a yalanh a k'ab' yik wach' max ach lajwi yuj ch'anh lasu tik, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix wutej.
Ix yak'anem ch'anh lasu chi' heb' winh, ix in yik'ank'eta heb' winh. Haxo t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palacio ix in yaktejkan heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Sedequías chi' to tzin ik'jib'at a in Jeremías in tik t'a yichanh winh, masanto t'a yoxil spuertail templo. Hata' ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: --Ay jun tas tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, in gana to tz'akan ol aj a pakan t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ix walan icha tik: --Tato tzin pak t'ayach mamin rey, tzam in a chek miljokchamok, tato swak' junok razón t'ayach, tom ol a cha ab'i, xin chi.

Palta k'ub'eltak ix yak' sti' winh t'ayin icha tik: --T'a yichanh Jehová tz'ak'an ko k 'inal swak' in ti' t'ayach to manh ol ach in chek miljokchamok, manh ol ach wak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' snib'ej ach smilanchamok, xchi winh.

Ix walanxi t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Tato tzak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh sreyal Babilonia, ol ach kolchaj yet' masanil heb' kajan et' t'a a pat, haxo jun chonhab' tik manh ol nhusjoktz'aok.
Tato manh ol ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' jun, ol yak' ganar jun chonhab' tik heb', ol snhusantz'a heb'. Ha hachxo tik manh ol yal-laj a kolan a b'a, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a heb' ketchonhab' toxo ix och yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi', talaj tzin ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ob'iltak am tzin yutej heb', xchi winh.
Ix in tak'wixi, ix walan icha tik: --Ma'ay mamin rey, manh ol ach ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. k'anab'ajej wal slolonel Jehová swal tik t'ayach, yik wach' ol ach elk'ochok, manh ol ach chamok.
Yujto toxo ix sch'ox Jehová t'ayin mamin rey tas ol ujok tato manh ol ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' ix ix ol kan t'a a palacio, yowalil ol ik'jokelta heb' ix, ol ak'chajoch heb' ix t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal soldado yik winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' ix t'ayach icha tik: Ha heb' amigo, tonhej ix ach yak' musansatil heb', yuj chi' ix ach ak'ji ganar. Ix ach aktajkan yuj heb' t'a kal sok'om, ix el heb' t'ayach, xcham heb' ix.

--Mamin rey, masanil heb' ix etb'eyum yet' heb' uninal, ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi'. Ha hachxo jun, manhxo ol yal el t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Palta to ol ach ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' tik heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winh t'ayin icha tik: --Tato tza nib'ej max ach chami, malaj junok mach b'aj tzal jun tik.

Tato syojtakejel juntzanhxo heb' yajal to ix ach lolon wet'ok, ol jawok heb', ol sk'anb'an heb' tas ix al t'ayin yet' tas ix wal t'ayach. Ol yal heb' t'ayach to manh ol ach smilcham heb' tato tz'akan ol al t'a heb'.
Palta ol al t'a heb' to tonhej tzach tewi t'ayin yik maxtzak ach b'at preso t'a spat winhaj Jonatán yik max ach cham ta', xchi winh rey chi' t'ayin.

Ichaton chi' ix aji. Masanil heb' winh yajal chi' ix b'at in hilani, ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'ayin. Icha wal ix aj yalan winh rey chi' t'ayin, icha chi' ix wutej walan t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' winh sk'anb'an t'ayin, yujto malaj junok mach ix ab'an tas ix wal yet' winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix in kannhej t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palacio masanto ix ak'ji ganar Jerusalén.
Ayik slajunhil uj yik sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix jawi winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, ix yoymitan Jerusalén heb'.
Ayik sb'alunhil k'uhal yoch schanhil uj yik 11 ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías chi' reyal, hata' ix smak'el amnaj smuroal chonhab' chi' heb' soldado chi'.

Hata' ix och masanil heb' yajal soldado yik winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha t'a jun puerta ay t'a snanhal chonhab' chi', hata' ix ajek' heb'. Ha heb' winh niwak yajal chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Nergal-sarezer, winhaj Samgar-nebo, winhaj Sarsequim yet' pax junxo winh skuchan Nergal-sarezer.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj rey Sedequías yet' heb' soldado tas wan yuji, ix b'at heb' elelal t'ak'walil. Ha t'a skal te' yawb'en te' heb' rey, hata' ix el heb', ix elk'och heb' t'a jun puerta ay t'a skal chab' muro. Icha chi' ix aj sk'och heb' t'a yol b'e sk'och t'a spanhanil sti' ha' Jordán.

Palta ix och heb' soldado yik Babilonia chi' t'a spatik heb', ix yamchaj winhaj Sedequías chi' yuj heb' t'a spanhanil Jericó. Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor t'a chonhab' Ribla t'a yol smakb'en Hamat. Hata' ix yal winh tas ol utaj winhaj Sedequías chi'. Ix schekan winh miljokcham heb' yuninal winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a yichanh yet' masanil heb' niwak winak yaj t'a Judá.
Ix schekanpax winh ik'jik'eta yol sat winhaj Sedequías chi', stzek'chaj pax winh t'a k'e'en cadena yik tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a Babilonia.
Haxo heb' soldado Babilonia chi' ix ak'anoch sk'ak'al spalacio winh yet' masanil pat ay t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix smak'anem lanhnaj smuroal jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Haxo winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ix yik'b'at masanil heb' aj Judá winh t'a Babilonia chi', haton heb' ixto kan t'a yol chonhab' chi' yet' heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' heb' aj Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' anima.
Haxonhej juntzanh heb' meb'a' ix yaktejkan winh t'a yol yik Judá chi', haton heb' malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay. Ix ak'chaj lum lum b'aj awab'il te' uwa t'a heb' yet' juntzanhxo te' awb'en te'.
Ha winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix yal winh t'a winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey chi' yuj tas tzin aj a in Jeremías in tik, ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ik'b'at winh tik, tza tanhwan winh, manh ixtej winh, masanil tas sk'an winh, tzak' t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' a winhaj Nabuzaradán yet' winhaj Nabusazbán yet' pax winhaj Nergal-sarezer yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh sreyal Babilonia chi',

ix in schek ik'jielta heb' winh t'a yamak'il b'aj ayin och preso chi'. Ix in yak'ankanoch heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchikin winhaj Safán, yik tzin yak'an meltzaj winh t'a in pat. Icha chi' ix aj in kan kajan t'a skal heb' wetchonhab'.
Ayik ayintoek' t'a yamak'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palacio chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:

Ixik t'a winhaj Ebed-melec aj Etiopía, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'elk'och tas walnakkan t'a spatik jun chonhab' tik. Ol jawok ya'elal, manhok wach'ilal. Ayik ol elk'och juntzanh chi' ol il wal yet' a sat.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ach in tanhwej yik wach' manh ol ach och t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima b'aj tzach xiw chi'.
Ha in wal swala' to ol ach in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yuj chi' manh ol ach miljokchamok, yujto ayoch a pensar t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.

Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin ayik toxo ix in aktajel t'a Ramá yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán yajal t'a heb' stanhwumal winh sreyal Babilonia. Ix yil winh to tzek'an in t'a k'e'en cadena, ay in och t'a skal heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' aj Judá, heb' wan yik'jib'at t'a Babilonia.
Ix in yik'anelta winh, ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová a Diosal ix halani to ol yak'kot jun niwan ya'elal tik t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi'. Ix yak'kot juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej tas ix yala'.

Ha tiknaik, ol wik'el k'e'en cadena tik t'ayach. Tato a gana tzach b'at wet' t'a Babilonia, syala', a in ol ach in ya ilej. Tato malaj a gana tzach b'at jun, kananh t'a tik. B'ekan yaj masanil lum lum tik t'ayach, syal a sik'lan b'aj snib'ej a k'ol tzach kani, xchi winh t'ayin.

Ayik manto in tak'woklaj t'a winh, ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Wach' tzach meltzaj b'aj ayek' winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchikin winhaj Safán, haton winh chi' ix yak'och winh sreyal Babilonia gobernadoral t'a Judá, tzach kajnaj yet' winh t'a skal heb' etchonhab'. Syal pax a b'at b'aj a gana, xchi winh t'ayin. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an jun silab' yet' jab'ok wa'el winh t'ayin, ix yalan kil ko b'a winh t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix aj in b'atkan t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a chonhab' Mizpa. Ix in kajnaj yet' winh t'a skal heb' anima ixto kan yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ay heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado aj Judá sk'ub'ejnakkanel sb'a t'a kaltak te' t'a heb' soldado aj Babilonia. Ix yab'an heb' winh to a winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam ix ak'jioch gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha winh ix och yajalilok heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' meb'a', haton heb' maj ik'jokb'atlaj t'a Babilonia chi'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yil winh t'a Mizpa chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Jonatán, haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Carea, winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Tanhumet yet' jaywanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efai aj Netofa, winhaj Jezanías yuninal jun winh aj Maacat, ajun heb' winh soldado heb' winh yet'ok.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Gedalías t'a heb' winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Manh ex xiw eyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi'. Kajnajanhek t'a tik. Hak'ekoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi' yik malaj tas ol ex ik'anok.

Ha in tik ol in kan t'a Mizpa tik, yik wach' a in ol ex wak' cheklaj t'a yichanh heb' aj Babilonia chi', ayik ol jawok heb' t'a tik. Ha ex tik, molb'ejek sat te' uwa yet' sat te' awb'en te' yet' aceite. Icha chi' ol ex kannhej t'a juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix eyik' chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Hanhejtona' jantak heb' aj Judá ayb'at t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a Edom yet' t'a juntzanhxo nación, ix yab'an heb' to ayto anima ix kan yuj winh sreyal Babilonia t'a Judá. Ix yab'anpax heb' to a winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, yixchikin winhaj Safán ix ak'jioch gobernadoral.

Masanil heb' sakleminak yajkanb'at chi', ix meltzajxi heb' t'a Judá. Ix jawi heb' sch'ox sb'a t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a Mizpa chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'an sat te' uwa heb' yet' juntzanhxo sat te' awb'en te'.
Ha winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal soldado ix kan t'a kaltak te' chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a winhaj Gedalías t'a Mizpa chi',

ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿Ix am ab'i to a winhaj Baalis sreyal Amón ix chekankot winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yik tzach smilanchamok? xchi heb' winh. Palta a winhaj Gedalías chi', maj schalaj winh t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' t'a k'ub'eltak ix yal winhaj Johanán t'a winhaj Gedalías chi': --Cha in b'ati yik b'at in milcham winhaj Ismael chi'. Malaj junok mach ol ojtakanelok mach ix milancham winh. ¿Tas yuj ol ach ko cha smilcham winh? Tato ol ach cham yuj winh, ol saklemkanb'at masanil heb' ayxoek' tik het'ok, axom somchajb'at heb' toxo ix kan t'a Judá tik junelxo, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Gedalías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a na' icha chi'. Ha tas tz'alchaj t'a spatik winhaj Ismael chi', manh yeloklaj, xchi winh.

Ha t'a yukil uj ix b'at winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yet' lajunhwanh soldado t'a Mizpa yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi', junnhej ix wa heb' winh yet' winh. (Ha winhaj Ismael chi', yixchikin pax winh winhaj Elisama, yinhtilal heb' winh rey, niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Judá t'a yalanhtaxo.)

Yakb'an wan swa heb' winh, ix k'e wa'an winhaj Ismael yet' heb' winh lajunhwanh ajun yet' chi', ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh t'a k'e'en espada, haton winh ix ak'jioch gobernadoral t'a Judá yuj winh sreyal Babilonia.
Ix smilanpaxcham masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' soldado aj Babilonia ayek' yet' winhaj Gedalías winhaj Ismael chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Gedalías chi', manta mach tz'ojtakanel tas ix uji chi',

ix k'och 80 heb' winh winak spetoj t'a Siquem, t'a Silo yet' t'a Samaria. Toxo ix sjoxel xil sti' heb' winh, tzilchimtak spichul heb' winh ayochi, haxo sniwanil heb' winh echentak yaji, munil a heb' winh icha chi' ix yutej sb'a. Yet'nak ixim trigo heb' winh yet' incienso yik syak' heb' winh silab'il t'a Jehová t'a templo.

Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix elta winhaj Ismael chi' ul scha heb' winh, wan stz'akan ok' sb'a winh, haxo yik ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Kotanhek, ul ilek winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, xchi winh.

Palta anhej yik ix k'och heb' winh winak chi' t'a snanhal chonhab' chi', ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh. Ix yumjikanb'at sniwanil heb' winh t'a yol jun niwan jul yet'tal ha'.

Palta ay lajunhwanh heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh wan smiljicham chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Ismael chi': --Manh onh a milchamok, a onh tik ay ixim ko trigo, ixim cebada, ko aceite, ay pax nok' ko yal chab'. Ha juntzanh chi' k'ub'anel kuj t'a spatiktakel ko chonhab', xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo miljokcham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael yet' heb' ajun yet' winh.

(Ha jun jul b'aj ix ak'jiem sniwanil heb' winh ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi', haton jun scheknak winhaj rey Asa joychajok, yik skolannak sb'a winh t'a winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel. Ha jun jul chi' te lewan, palta ix b'ut'ji yuj sniwanil heb' anima ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi'.)

Ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yisil winh rey winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a Mizpa chi', haton heb' ix ak'ji stanhwej winhaj Gedalías yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán. Ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, yik sb'atkan heb' t'a yol smakb'en Amón presoal.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' heb' yajalil soldado ayek' yet'ok, yuj jantak chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Ismael chi',
ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yak' owal yet' winhaj Ismael chi'. Ha b'aj ay jun niwan yet'tal ha' t'a Gabaón, hata' ix ilchaj winh yuj heb' winh.
Haxo heb' wan yik'jib'at icha presoal yuj winhaj Ismael chi', ayik ix yilan winhaj Johanán chi' heb' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winh, ix te tzalaj heb'.
Ix meltzaj heb' smasanil, ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Johanán chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Ismael chi' yet' wajxakwanhxo heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix el lemnaj heb' winh, ix b'atkan heb' winh t'a yol yik Amón.

Ha winhaj Johanán yet' heb' soldado chi' ix ik'anxikanek' heb' anima, ix koljipax heb' yuj heb' winh, haton heb' kajan t'a Mizpa ix yik'b'at winhaj Ismael chi' ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Gedalías winh. Ha juntzanh heb' anima chi', ay heb' winh soldado, ay heb' ix ix, ay heb' unin, ay pax heb' niwak yopisio. Haton heb' ix ik'jixikanek' t'a winhaj Ismael t'a Gabaón

yik sb'at heb' elelal t'a Egipto yujto xiwnak heb' t'a heb' aj Babilonia, yujto ix miljicham winhaj Gedalías, winh ix sik'jioch gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia yuj winhaj Ismael. Ix b'atnhej heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Gerut-kimam, t'a slak'anil Belén. Hata' ix och wa'an heb', yujto wan sb'at heb' t'a Egipto chi' yalani.

Masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' pax winhaj Jezanías yuninal winhaj Osaías yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' ay yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, ix jawi heb' t'ayin Jeremías schekab' in Dios tik.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ol ko k'an t'ayach tiknaik, manh a tenek' t'ayonh: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal kuj jaywanh onh ix onh kan ik. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzijtum ko b'eyi, palta haxo tiknaik haxonhej jaywanh onh ayonhek' tik onh kani.
Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal ku'uj yik wach' ol sch'ox t'ayonh tas b'eal ol k'ik'a' yet' tas wach' ol ko k'ulej, xchi heb'.

Ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ix walan icha tik: --Wach' yaji. Ol in lesalwok t'a Jehová ko Diosal eyu'uj, icha ix aj he k'anan chi' t'ayin. Jantaknhej tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin a ol walxi t'ayex. Malaj jab'ok tas ol in k'ub'ejeli, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wixi heb' t'ayin icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová chi' testigo tz'ajkan t'ayonh, tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej tas ol yal chi' t'ayach.

Tato ol scha ko k'ol tas ol aj spakan Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayach, mato manh ol scha ko k'o'ol, palta ol ko k'anab'ajejnhej tas ol yal chi'. Skal t'ayach to tza k'an t'ay ku'uj yik wach' ol onh elk'ochok, xchi heb'.
Sb'alunhilxo k'uhal chi', ichato chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix wawtejkot winhaj Johanán yet' heb' winh yajal soldado yet' masanil heb' anima, heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi.
Ix walan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, b'aj ix in tewi yuj tas ix eyal t'ayin, a tz'alan icha tik:

Tato tzex kajnajkan t'a jun lum tik, ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a eyib'anh, manhxo ol ex in sateli. Ol wak' k'ib' he b'isul, manhxo ol ex wak' ik'jokb'atok. Yujto ya ix wab' yuj jun niwan ya'elal ix wak'b'at t'a eyib'anh tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Manhxo ex xiw t'a winh sreyal Babilonia, haton winh b'aj tzex te xiwi. Ha tiknaik manhxo ex xiwok, yujto ayinnhejek' heyet'ok, ol ex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ay wal wok'elk'olal t'ayex. Hanhejtona' ol wak' ok' pax sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'ayex, ol ex yak'anxi meltzaj winh t'a he chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Palta tato max he k'anab'ajej tas syal Jehová ko Dios chi', tato tzeyal icha tik: Malaj ko gana ko kan t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol onh b'at t'a Egipto. Hata' ol onh kajnajok, b'aj manhxo ol kil owal, manhxo ol kab' yok' k'e'en trompeta, manhxo ol onh cham yuj wejel, tato xe chi,
yuj chi' ab'ek a ex ayex to kan t'a Judá tik, tas wal syal Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Tato tzex ek' wal t'a yib'anh he b'at t'a Egipto chi' yik tzex kajnaj ta' he na'ani,
a owal yet' wejel b'aj tzex xiw chi', ol k'och t'ayex ta'. Hata' ol ex chamok.

Masanil heb' sb'at t'a Egipto yik skajnaj ta', ol cham heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Malaj junok mach manh ol chamok, manhxalaj mach ol yal skolan sb'a t'a ya'elal ol wak'b'at ta', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Icha ix aj sja yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, icha wal chi' ol aj sja pax yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh a ex tik, tato ol ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ayik ol ex yilan heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo nación to icha sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' katab'il, icha chi' ol ex ajok, ol xiw heb', ol ex b'uchjok yuj heb'. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyilxi jun he lum tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex aj Judá ex ixto ex kan tik, a Jehová wan yalan t'ayex yik max ex b'at t'a Egipto chi'. Ojtakejekeli to a in wan walan t'ayex tiknaik,

te niwan he pitalil wan eyak'anochi, yujto ix he chek in k'anb'ej t'a Jehová ko Diosal, ix eyalan t'ayin icha tik: Lesalwanh t'a Jehová ko Diosal ku'uj. Ol ak'an kojtakejel masanil tas ol yala', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi.
Toxo ix wak' eyojtakejel tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal chi', palta max yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej.
Yuj chi', ojtakejekeli to ol ex cham yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya t'a jun chonhab' b'aj he gana tzex b'atkan chi', xin chi t'a heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wal t'a heb' anima chi',

haxo winhaj Jezanías yuninal winhaj Osaías, winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh winak te ak'umtak, ix yalan heb' winh t'ayin: Manh yelok juntzanh lolonel tzal chi'. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal maj yal-laj t'ayach to max onh b'at t'a Egipto yik tzonh kajnaj ta'.

Ha winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías, a winh tz'alan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a ko patik yik tzonh yak'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia chi', yik tzonh smilancham heb', ma onh yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', xchi heb' winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yoch spitalil winhaj Johanán yet' heb' winh yajal soldado yet' pax masanil heb' anima. Maj kanlaj heb' t'a Judá icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' aj Judá ix saklemb'at t'a junjun nación, haton heb' toxo ix smolb'ejxi sb'a t'a Judá chi' yik skajnajxi heb' ta', a winhaj Johanán chi' yet' heb' winh yajal soldado ix ik'anb'at heb' t'a Egipto.

Ix yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh winak heb' winh, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' ix yisil winh rey yet' masanil heb' ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Gedalías yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán. Ix in yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh yet' winhaj Baruc.
Manh jab'ok ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal Jehová. Ix onh b'at ko masanil t'a Egipto chi'. Hato t'a jun chonhab' skuch Tafnes ix onh k'och kajan.
Ha t'a chonhab' Tafnes chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ik'b'at jaye'ok niwak k'e'en, tza mukan t'a skal lum b'ak'ech lum t'a sti' yamak'il spalacio heb' winh sreyal Egipto ay t'a jun chonhab' tik. T'a yichanh heb' etchonhab' chi' tza mukem k'e'en.

Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alani: Ol wik'kot winhaj Nabucodonosor in chekab', winh sreyal Babilonia, ol wak' yak'em sk'ojnub' winh, ol sb'oank'e smantiado winh yenhulok t'a yib'anh juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en ix a mukem tik.

Ol jawok winh, ol satanel Egipto tik winh. Ha mach yik yaj scham yuj ilya, a ilya chi' ol ik'an schami. Ha mach yik yaj yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'joknhejb'atok. Ha mach yik yaj smiljicham t'a owal, t'a owal chi' ol chamok.

Ol snhusantz'a juntzanh stemplo sdiosal heb' aj Egipto tik winh, ol yik'anb'at juntzanh skomon diosal heb' chi' winh. Icha junok tanhwum kalnel pilan syik'el nok' sip t'a spichul, icha chi' ol yutej Egipto tik winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', pilan ol yik'b'at sb'eyumal winh, junk'olal ol meltzaj winh.
Ol juchajpaxem juntzanh obelisko t'a Bet-semes t'a Egipto, haxo stemplo sdiosal heb' ol nhusjoktz'aok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Haton juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, yik swal t'a heb' aj Judá, haton heb' ix k'och kajan t'a yol smakb'en Egipto, haton t'a Migdol, t'a Tafnes, t'a Menfis yet' t'a Patros.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tik, ix eyil masanil ya'elal ix wak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ha tiknaik a juntzanh chonhab' chi' satnakeli. Manhxa junok mach kajan t'ay,

yujnhej wal chukal sk'ulej heb'. Ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb', yujto ix och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ix snhusanpax incienso heb' t'a juntzanh chi'. Ha t'a juntzanh Dios chi', malaj yalan yik heb' yet' ex a ex tik yet' pax heb' he mam eyicham.
Tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb' in chekab', yik sb'at yalan heb' t'ayex to max he b'eyb'alej juntzanh chi', yujto max schalaj in k'o'ol.
Palta maj he k'anab'ajej, maj he chapax eyab' tas ix wala'. Maj eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal, ix ex te k'e wal cha'anh he nhusan incienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal in k'o'ol, icha te' k'ak' ix aj sk'och kopnaj t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén. Icha chi' ajnak yem lanhnajok masanto tiknaik.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swala': ¿Tas yuj tzeyik'kot jun niwan ya'elal chi' t'a eyib'anh? ¿Tas yuj ol ex cham he masanil ex aj Judá? Ol cham heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' pax heb' wanto yalji, syalelk'ochi to manhxa ex ol ex kanok.

¿Tas yuj tzin he tzuntzej yuj tas tze k'ulej, tze nhusan incienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a Egipto b'aj ix ex jawi kajan tik? Yuj wal juntzanh chi' ol ex satelok. Ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanhxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yilan heb' to icha tas sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' katab'il, icha chi' ol ex ajok.

¿Tom toxo ix b'at satk'olal eyu'uj jantak chukal sk'ulejnak heb' he mam eyicham, heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' pax juntzanh chukal he k'ulejnak yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén?
Hanhejtona' tiknaik, max he k'ex he b'eyb'al, max ex xiwpax jab'ok. Max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'ayex yet' t'a heb' he mam eyicham.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swala': Toxo ix in na' to ol wak'b'at jun ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex wak'an satel he masanil ex aj Judá.

Ha ex ix ex kanlej kajan t'a Judá, palta ix ex ek' t'a yib'anh he jawi t'a Egipto tik. Ol ex satel t'a junelnhej, schakot t'a heb' nene' unin masanto t'a heb' icham anima, ol cham heb' yuj owal yuj pax wejel. Ol ja in katab' t'a eyib'anh, ob'iltak ol ex wutokkanok. Ha heb' ol ex ilanok ol te xiw heb'.
Ol wak' eyaelal mach ex ix ex jawi kajan t'a Egipto tik yet' owal, wejel yet' pax ilya icha ajnak wak'an sya'elal heb' aj Jerusalén.

Malaj junok ex aj Judá ex tik, a ex ix ex ja kajan t'a Egipto tik olto ex kanok, manhxa junok mach ol yal yeli. Wach'chom ol he nib'ejxik'och he b'a t'a Judá yik tzex kajnajxi t'ay, palta haxonhej jaywanhok ex ol ex el elelal, ol ex k'och he kol he b'a ta', xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' masanil heb' winh ojtannak to a heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh snhus incienso heb' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios yet' masanil heb' ix ix ayek' ta', te tzijtum heb' molanek'i yet' pax masanil heb' aj Judá kajan t'a Egipto yet' t'a Patros, ix tak'wi heb' t'ayin icha tik:
--Ha onh tik, manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj slolonel Jehová ix al chi' t'ayonh.

Anhej tas sko na' anhej ol ko b'eyb'alej. Ol ko nhusnhej incienso, ol kak'nhej pax wino silab'il t'a ix yajalil satcha'anh, icha wan ko k'ulan tiknaik, icha sk'ulejnak pax heb' ko mam kicham yet' heb' ko reyal yet' heb' yajalil t'a yoltak juntzanh chonhab' t'a Judá yet' t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén. Yujto ha t'a peka' chi', ay ko wa'el, tzalajk'olalnhej ek'nak onh, malaj ya'elal jawinak t'a kib'anh.
Hato ix kaktan ko nhusan incienso yet' kak'an wino silab'il t'a ix yajalil satcha'anh, manhxalaj tas ay t'ayonh, tzonh cham yuj wejel yet' yuj owal, xchi heb'.

Ix yalan heb' ix ix icha tik: --Ha onh tik ix ko b'o ixim wa'il icha yechel ix yajalil satcha'anh, ix ko nhusan incienso, ix kak'anpax wino silab'il t'ay. Masanil tas ix ko k'ulej chi', t'a yichanh heb' winh ketb'eyum ix ko k'ulej, xchi heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh winak yet' t'a heb' ix ix halan juntzanh chi' t'ayin, ix walan icha tik:

--¿Am he na'an a ex tik to manh yojtakok Jehová, ma ix b'at satk'olal yuj b'aj ix he nhus incienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi' t'a yoltak chonhab' yet' t'a yoltak scalleal Jerusalén icha yutejnak sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, heb' ko reyal, heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal yet' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yik Judá?

Palta majxo techaj juntzanh he b'eyb'al te chuk chi' yuj Jehová chi', maj scha sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' a ko chonhab' toxo ix pojchajem tiknaik, manhxa mach kajan t'ay. Toxo ix ja skatab' Jehová t'a yib'anh, ste xiw anima yilani.

Ha jun ya'elal ayoch t'a kib'anh tik, ix jawi yujto hanheja' he nhusan incienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Hanheja' eyak'anoch he mul t'a Jehová, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al, slolonel yet' pax scheknab'il, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ix walanxi t'a heb' ix ix yet' t'a masanil anima chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal jun slolonel Jehová tik ex wetchonhab', ex kajan ex t'a yol yik Egipto tik tiknaik.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tik yet' heb' ix eyetb'eyum, ix eyak' he ti' t'a ix yajal satcha'anh he nhusan incienso, eyak'anpax wino silab'il t'a ix, wan he k'anab'ajan he k'ulan b'aj ix eyak' he ti' chi'. Wach'toni, k'anab'ajejek he k'ulan b'aj ix eyak' he ti' chi'.

Palta he masanil ex aj Judá kajan ex t'a Egipto tik, ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová in tik t'ayex: Ha in wal swak' in ti' to manhxa junok ex aj Judá ex tik olto in eyak' b'inaj t'a Egipto tik ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a junok tas.
Yujto wan wilani to ol wak'b'at ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, manhok wach'il ol wak'b'ati. Masanil ex aj Judá kajan ex t'a Egipto tik, ol ex satel yuj owal, yuj pax wejel.

Jaywanh exxonhej ol ex kolchaj t'a skal owal, ol ex el t'a Egipto tik, ol ex meltzaj t'a Judá. Ichato chi' he masanil ex aj Judá ix ex jawi t'a Egipto tik, ol heyila' mach ol elk'och slolonel, am wiko', mato a heyik ol elk'ochok.
Ha in Jehová in swak' jun ch'oxnab'il tik, ol wak' ya'elal nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ex in satel t'a jun nación tik, icha ix aj wak'an in ti'.

Ol wak'och winhaj Hofra sreyal Egipto t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol snib'an smilan winh, icha ix aj wak'anoch winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, haton winh yajk'ol winh snib'an smilanchamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Ha t'a yik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ayik toxo ix tz'ib'chaj yuj winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías tas ix wal Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, hata' ix wal t'a winhaj Baruc chi':

Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ach Baruc, wan halan icha tik: Ob'iltak in. Anhej ya'elal yet' ilk'olal syak' Jehová t'ayin. Wanxo in k'unb'i wok'i, maxtzak yal wik'an wip swab'i, xa chi.
Ina a in Jehová in, tzin satel tas ix in b'o'o, wan in tok'ank'eta tas ix wawej t'a masanil jun nación tik.

¿Tom smoj tza k'an tas tz'aj a k'echa'anh? Manhxo a k'ana', yujto ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh masanil anima. Palta a in Jehová in swala', yalnhej b'aj ol ach k'ochok, manh ol ach in cha miljokchamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik yuj juntzanh nación.

Ix yal yuj Egipto, yuj winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto yet' pax heb' soldado winh, haton winh ix ak'ji ganar t'a Carquemis t'a slak'anil ha' Éufrates yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Haton yik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, haton ta' ix uji jun chi'.
Tz'awaj heb' yajalil heb' soldado, syalan heb' icha tik: B'o'ek he maklab' jul-lab'. Ixikek owal.
Hak'ekoch stz'um nok' he chej, tzex k'e t'a yib'anh nok'. Hak'ekk'e he k'e'en xumpil tze tzolan he b'a. nhikekk'e ye snhi' he lanza. Hak'ekoch smakul snhi' he k'o'ol, xchi heb'.
Palta, ¿tas jun wan yuji tik? Ha swilani to a heb' soldado winhaj Necao wan smeltzaj heb' t'a spatik yuj xiwelal, sakleminak sb'atkan heb' elelal. Maxtzak meltzajb'at k'elan heb' t'a spatik.

Ha heb' jelan sb'eyi maxtzak yal-laj yel lemnaj heb'. Yet' pax heb' te tek'an, maxtzak yal-laj skolan sb'a heb'. Ha t'a stojolal norte t'a sti' ha' Éufrates, hata' tz'ak'ji ganar heb', schampaxkan heb'.
¿Mach jun nación syik'cha'anh sb'a chi' icha ha' Nilo, ma icha junok ha ha' tz'el t'a smelemal?

Haton Egipto wan yik'ancha'anh sb'a, icha tz'aj sk'e ha' Nilo, ma icha junok ha ha' tz'el t'a smelemal. Ix yalan heb' aj Egipto chi' icha tik: Ol onh k'ib'cha'anh, ol ko mak sat lum lum tik, ol laj ko satel chonhab' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'ay, xchi heb'.
Pilek eyip yet' nok' he chej. Ik'ekb'at he carruaje. B'atokab' heb' soldado aj Etiopía yet' heb' aj Libia, yet'nakokab' smaklab' jul-lab' heb'. B'atokab' pax heb' soldado aj Lidia te jelan sjulwaji.

Haton jun sk'uhal yowal in k'ol a in Jehová Yajal in t'a smasanil, jun k'uhal yik ol in pakan in b'a t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj k'e'en espada ol cham heb' smasanil, masanto ol pimb'ok k'e'en yuj chik', yujto tzijtum heb' soldado ol wak' miljokcham t'a norte, t'a slak'anil ha' Éufrates. Icha nok' silab' ol aj scham heb'.
Ex aj Egipto, ixikek t'a Galaad he say yanhal tas tzex ik'an chi'. Wach'chom te niwan yanhal chi' tze k'ana', palta malaj ol ochok, yujto manhxalaj yanhal tas tzex ik'an chi'.
Yojtakxo masanil nación to wan yel he k'ixwelal. Masanil b'aj tz'ab'chaj yel eyaw. Toxonhej stenlaj sb'a heb' soldado, junnhej b'aj stelwikan heb' t'a sat lu'um, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik yuj tas ol aj sja winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a Egipto tik:
Alel t'a yol smakb'en Egipto, haton t'a Migdol, t'a Menfis yet' t'a Tafnes icha tik: Hak'ek lista he b'a. Makwajanhek, yujto wan scham heb' anima t'a he lak'anil yuj k'e'en espada.
¿Tas yuj toxonhej teltumb'a heb' soldado? ¿Tas yuj maj yal stek'b'an sb'a heb'? Icha chi' ix aji yujto a in Jehová in ix wak' ak'jok ganar heb'.

Ha heb' soldado slok sb'a yok heb', stelwi heb', syal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: Onh elek t'a tik, paxokonhek t'a ko chonhab', t'a ko nación b'aj ix onh alji. Onh elek lemnajok yakb'an manto onh miljokcham t'a owal tik.
Ha winh sreyal Egipto tik tonhej ste lolon winh, palta malaj wach' yoch winh, xchi heb'.

Ha in Rey in, a in b'i haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a in swak' in ti': Icha lum witzal Tabor ek'al scha'anhil t'a juntzanhxo lum witz, ma icha lum witzal Carmelo te cha'anh yajk'e t'a yib'anh ha' mar, icha chi' yip jun ajk'ol wan sjawi t'ayex.
Yuj chi', a ex kajan ex t'a Egipto tik, ak'ek lista he b'a yujto ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a ch'ok nacional. Ha chonhab' Menfis ol kan tzinan, ol-laj juchajkanemok, manhxalaj mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ha Egipto tik lajan icha junok kob'es wakax wach' yilji, palta t'a stojolal norte wan skot jun ajk'ol icha nok' kach ol ul satanelok.

Ha juntzanh soldado majnab'ilkoti, te b'ak'ech heb', icha nok' kelem wakax b'ak'ech, palta ipan heb' ol b'at elelal. Manhxo ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb', yujto sjawi sk'uhal yak'ji ganar heb', sjawi yorail yak'ji sya'elal heb'.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ayik ol jawok heb' soldado ul yak' owal t'a Egipto tik, ol el lemnaj heb' aj Egipto tik icha sb'at junok nok' chan ayik xiw nok'. Icha sb'at heb' winh winak yet' sch'akab' ch'akoj te', icha chi' ol aj sjawi heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a heb'.

Ha in Jehová in swala', wach'chom malaj mach schaxoch t'a heb' icha te te' k'ayum, palta ol ch'akjokel heb' icha tz'aj sch'akjiel te' niwak ch'akte'. Yujto ek'to sb'isul heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a nok' k'ulub', manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb'.
Ha heb' aj Egipto tik ol ak'jok k'ixwelal heb', ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación ol kot t'a stojolal norte, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, sDiosal Israel a tz'alan icha tik: Ol in satel Amón, haton sdiosal heb' aj Tebas. Ol wak'pax sya'elal heb' aj Egipto, sdiosal heb' yet' sreyal heb'. Ol wak' sya'elal winh sreyal Egipto chi' yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch winh yipok sk'o'ol.

Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol ol milanchamok, haton winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a b'ak'inh, ol kajnajxok anima t'a Egipto tik, ichataxon yaji, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Israel yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok, yujto ol ex in kolel yet' heb' eyuninal t'a jun nación najat b'aj ix ex ik'jib'ati. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ex kajnajxok t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol he na'a, manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.

Ex yinhtilal Jacob in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok. Ayinnhejoch heyet'ok, ol in satel masanil juntzanh nación b'aj ix ex in saklemejb'ati. Palta a ex tik manh ol ex in satel-laj, manh ol ex kanpaxlaj t'a ichnhejta', anhej to ol wak'och eyaelal icha t'a smojal, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik yuj heb' filisteo, ayik manto k'och winh sreyal Egipto yak' owal t'a chonhab' Gaza:

Ix yalan Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha t'a stojolal norte ol kot wal nhililok heb' soldado, icha wal yel ponholjok ha' eluma' tz'el t'a stitak smelemal. Pilan ol satel jun nación chi' heb' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' juntzanhxo chonhab'. Masanil heb' kajan t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo chi', ol el yaw heb' yab'an sya'il.
Ha wal yik ol yab'an heb' sk'anh yem yok nok' chej yet' sk'anh skot carruaje, a heb' winh mamab'il yet' heb' ix nunab'il ol te el yip heb', ol yaktejkan yal yuninal heb'.

Toxo ix k'och sk'uhal satel heb' filisteo yet' heb' skolwaj yet' heb', haton heb' aj Tiro yet' heb' aj Sidón, xchi Jehová. Ha Jehová ol satanel heb' filisteo chi', haton masanil heb' kotnak t'a Creta t'a snanhal ha' mar.

Masanil heb' aj Gaza ol sjoxel xil sjolom heb' yuj kusk'olal. Haxo heb' ay t'a Ascalón manhxo ol yal-laj slolon heb' yuj satkank'e sk'o'ol. Ha exxo kajan ex t'a yak'likal sti' ha' mar, ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktej eyak'an echnaj he niwanil yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal?
Ay, a yespada Jehová. ¿B'ak'inh wal ol och wa'an? Komonok tz'ak'jixiem t'a yol yatut yik tz'och wa'an, manhxa tas sk'ulej.
Palta ¿tas wal ol aj yoch wa'an? Ha Jehová ix halani to icha chi' tzuji. Hanheja' ix halani to tz'och owal t'a chonhab' Ascalón yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a stitak ha' mar.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton sDiosal Israel, ha' ix halan icha tik yuj chonhab' Moab: Ob'iltak chonhab' Nebo, yujto ix juchajemi. Hanhejtona' chonhab' Quiriataim, toxo ix ak'ji ganar, k'ixwelal ix ajkani. Toxo ix juchajem lanhnaj smuroal t'a sat lu'um.

Toxo ix satel sb'inajnakil Moab. Ha t'a chonhab' Hesbón, hata' sna heb' ajk'ol syalan heb' tas ol yutok heb' satanel Moab t'a junelnhej. Hanhejtona' chonhab' Madmena, ol satelok, manh ol och wa'an owal sataneli.
Ha heb' aj Horonaim ol el yaw heb': Tzonh chami, tzonh lajwieli, xcham heb'.
Ha Moab toxo ix sateli, tz'ab'chaj yel yaw heb' skotak unin heb' kajan t'ay.
Tz'ok' heb', tz'el yal sat heb', sk'e heb' t'a lum switzal Luhit. Haxo heb' tz'em t'a Horonaim, tz'ab'chaj yel yaw heb' yuj sya'il tas tzuji chi'.
Ha mach tzato yal yeli, elokab' lemnajok, skolokab' sb'a. Lajanokab' syutej sb'a icha nok' kaltakte'al b'uru t'a tzinan lu'um.

Ha heb' aj Moab, a smunlajel heb' yet' sb'eyumal ayoch yipok sk'o'ol, palta ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional. Ha jun sdiosal heb' skuchan Quemos ol ik'jokb'atok yet' heb' ayoch sacerdoteal t'ay yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ha jun owal chi', ol laj k'och t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Moab, manhxa junok mach ol elkanok. Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a ch'olkixtak yet' t'a panhkiltak ol juwokkanb'at smasanil.
Ichato ol och sk'axil heb' aj Moab yik sb'at heb' elelal. Masanil chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en, ol satelok. Manhxa mach ol kan kajan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
(katab'ajokab' mach max k'ulan t'a smasanil sk'ol tas snib'ej Jehová. katab'ajokab' mach max yak'lab'ej yespada smilwaji.)

Ha heb' aj Moab junk'olalnhej yaj heb', malaj b'aj tz'ik'jib'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional. Icha wino tonhej tanhanemi, max k'exchaj yet'tal, yuj chi' max k'exwi sjab', max satel swach'il yuk'ji, icha chi' yaj heb'.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol ja sk'uhal, ol in chekanb'at juntzanh soldado, ol yik'anb'at heb' aj Moab heb' t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional, icha tz'aj sk'exji wino t'a yol yet'tal. Ol mak'chajem lanhnaj schonhab' heb', icha tz'aj smak'jipoj yet'tal wino manhxa tas ayem t'a yo'ol. Kuseltakxonhej ol ajkan schonhab' heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' aj Moab chi' ol k'ixwok heb' yuj jun sdiosal skuch Quemos, icha ajnak sk'ixwi sk'ol heb' israel yuj sdiosal t'a Betel, haton jun yak'nakoch heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Manhxaokab' yal heb' aj Moab icha tik: Ha onh tik te jelan onh, niwan kelk'ochi, ak'um onh owal, manhxo'okab' xchi heb'.
Toxo ix k'och jun rey ol satanel juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Moab chi', ol cham heb' kelemtak te tek'an kajan t'ay. Ha in ton Rey in swal jun tik, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil in b'i.
Toxo ix k'och sk'uhal sjawi ya'elal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Moab, ix ja sk'uhal sateli.
Jantak ex kajan ex t'a slak'anil Moab yet' ex eyojtak jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi, ok'anhek yuj, tzeyalan icha tik: Ha sniwanil yelk'och Moab yet' swach'il yilji toxo ix sateli, xe chiokab'i.
Aktejekkan sniwanil eyelk'och ex aj Dibón, emnakil tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a mach wan satanel Moab, wan sk'och t'ayex, wanxo spojanem smuroal he chonhab'.
Ex aj Aroer, ochanhek linhan t'a titak b'e, tzeyilani. k'anb'ejek t'a heb' aj Dibón ixto yal yeli tas ix uji.
Ha Moab k'ixwelal ix ajkani, yujto ix ak'ji sya'elal. Ok'anhek yuj sya'elal chi'. Alekel t'a stitak ha' Arnón to a Moab toxo ix sateli, xchi Jehová.

Toxo ix jawi ya'elal alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum ak'liktak: Haton Holón, Jahaza, Mefaat, Dibón, Nebo, Bet-diblataim, Quiriataim, Bet-gamul, Bet-meón, Queriot, Bosra yet' t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Moab, haton juntzanh ay t'a slak'anil yet' juntzanh najat ay.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha yipalil Moab toxo ix lajwi. Ha sniwanil yelk'ochi toxo ix sateli.
Hak'ek somchaj spensar heb' aj Moab, yujto ix spitej sb'a heb' t'ayin. B'uchjokab' heb' yuj heb' anima, icha tz'aj sb'uchji junok uk'um anh tzek' b'alb'on t'a skal xej.
Naekkot ex aj Moab ayik he b'uchwajnak t'a heb' aj Israel, icha tz'aj sb'uchji junok elk'um, icha chi' eyutejnak he b'uchwaj t'a heb'.
Ex aj Moab, aktejekkan he chonhab', ixikek, kajnajanhek t'a sattak k'e'en tenam icha nok' kuwajte' sb'o so' t'a yoltak sjatelal k'e'en.
Kojtak jantak wal syik'cha'anh sb'a heb' aj Moab. Te ak'umtak heb', anhej heb' niwan yelk'och sna'ani. Te niwak winak syutej sb'a heb'.
Ha in Jehová in, wojtak to syik' wal cha'anh sb'a heb', palta malaj syak' yal heb' yujto malaj yalan jun b'aj syik'cha'anh sb'a heb' chi'.
Yuj chi' tzin ok'i, skus in k'ol yuj heb' aj Moab, yuj pax heb' aj Quir-hares.

Ol in ok' wal yuj chonhab' Sibma, ek'to ol aj wok' yuj t'a yichanh ayik ix och ok'el yuj Jazer. Yujto ix k'ib'b'at icha te' uwa, ix ek'k'och t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ix k'och pax t'a ha' nhajab' yik Jazer chi'. Haxo tiknaik ix k'och sk'uhal sjawi heb' ol satanelok, icha tz'aj sk'och sk'uhal smolji sat te' uwa yet' sat juntzanhxo te' awb'en te'.

Manhxa aw yik tzalajk'olal ol ab'chaj t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' b'aj te yax sat t'a Moab. Manhxalaj wino b'aj smolb'aji, yujto manhxa mach stek'anel yal sat te' uwa chi', manhxa b'it yik tzalajk'olal.

Ha heb' anima t'a Hesbón, tz'el yaw heb' yuj ya'elal. Chekelto yel yaw heb' chi' t'a Eleale, t'a Jahaza. Sk'och yaw heb' chi' t'a Zoar masanto t'a Horonaim yet' t'a Eglat-selisiya. Yujto toxo ix laj tup sjaj ha ha' t'a Nimrim.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol satel heb' aj Moab tz'och ejmelal, snhusan silab' yet' incienso heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a jolomtak witz.
Icha yok' flauta spuji yuj kusk'olal, icha chi' tz'aj wok' yuj heb' aj Moab chi', yuj pax heb' aj Quir-hares, yujto a sb'eyumal heb' ix smolb'ej, toxo ix lajwieli.
Yuj ya'elal yet' kusk'olal, masanil heb' toxo ix sjoxel xil sjolom, toxo ix sjoxpaxel xil sti' heb'. Masanil heb' toxo ix spol lajwok sk'ab', haxonhej pichul ya swa yik kusk'olal ayoch yuj heb'.

Masanil spanhanil yib'anhtak pat t'a Moab yet' t'a yoltak calle, haxonhej ok'el yuj kusk'olal tz'ab'chaji, yujto a in Jehová in ix in mak' wekchaj Moab icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum chen malaj wach' yochi.
Ha Moab chok' ix ajkani. Ok'anhek yuj, yujto k'ixwelal ix ajkani, toxo ix juchajb'ati. Masanil anima t'a juntzanh nación t'a slak'anil sb'uchwaj heb' t'ay, xiwpax heb' yilani, xchi Jehová.
Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha jun ajk'ol t'a Moab, ol k'och juknaj icha junok nok' ch'akb'a jenhaneli sk'ochi.
Ol och juntzanh chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', a heb' soldado yik Moab ol ib'xokk'e heb' icha junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Ha Moab chi', manhxo nacionok ol ajkanok, yujto ix yik'cha'anh sb'a t'a wichanh, ix och smul t'ayin a in Jehová in tik.
Yuj chi' swal icha tik: Ha heb' kajan t'a Moab, lajan ol aj heb' icha nok' nok' spechji yuj heb' pechum nok'. Ay smay sb'at sutnaj heb' t'a junok olan, ma skan heb' t'a junok ya'al.

Ha heb' ol el lemnaj t'a heb' pechjinak chi', ol b'at sutnaj heb' t'a junok olan. Ha heb' ol k'exta t'a jun olan chi', haxo t'a junok ya'al ol kan heb'. Yujto a in ol wak'b'at ya'elal nab'il wu'uj t'a yib'anh Moab chi'.

Ay heb' ol el lemnajok, manhxalaj yip heb', ol b'at heb' say b'aj ol skol sb'a t'a Hesbón. Palta ha t'a Hesbón chi', haton schonhab'kan winhaj rey Sehón, wan stz'ab'ati, ol b'eynhejb'at te' k'ak' chi'. Ol tz'ab'at masanil jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Moab yet' jun chonhab' Hesbón chi', haton jun syik'cha'anh sb'a.
Ex aj Moab ob'iltak ex. Ex schonhab' ex jun Dios skuch Quemos, toxo ix ex sateli. Ha heb' eyuninal yet' heb' ix eyisil, ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Ay jun k'uhal ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Moab chi' b'ajtak ik'b'ilb'ati, xchi Jehová. Haton juntzanh ya'elal tik ix yalkan Jehová t'a yib'anh Moab.

Ha tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Amón ayik yalannakkan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj yinhtilal Israel syal smakb'enan lum lum tik? ¿Tas yuj a juntzanh anima tz'och ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Milcom skajnaj t'a lum slu'um heb' yinhtilal Gad? ¿Tas yuj a heb' amonita skajnaj t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' chi'?

Palta a in Jehová in swala', ol k'och sk'uhal, ol ab'chaj yel aw yik owal t'a chonhab' Rabá, sniwan chonhab' heb' amonita. Junnhej b'ulanh ol ajkan smak'jiem lanhnajok, ol tz'ab'at masanil yaldeail. Ha in Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol aj yik'anxiek' slum heb' aj Israel t'a heb' tok'jinak ek'i.

Ok'anhek yuj kusk'olal ex aj Hesbón, yujto a chonhab' Hai toxo ix sateli. Ex ix aj Rabá, ochanhek t'a kusk'olal. Hak'ekoch pichul ya swa yuj kusk'olal, tzex ok'i. Xikek lajwok he niwanil, ek'anhek jinhinhok t'a yol he chonhab' yuj he kusk'olal, yujto a he diosal skuch Milcom ol ik'jokb'atok yet' heb' ayoch sacerdoteal t'ay yet' pax heb' anima niwak yopisio.
Ex anima pit, ¿tas yuj tzeyik'cha'anh he b'a yuj lum he ch'olkixtak yax sat? Anhej he b'eyumal molb'il, ha' ayoch yipok he k'o'ol, yuj chi' tzeyala': ¿Mach wal ol yal yak'an owal ket'ok? xe chinaji.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at xiwk'olal t'a eyib'anh, masanil chonhab' ayek' t'a he lak'anil ol k'och yak' owal t'ayex. Junjun ex, ol ex pechchajelok, manhxalaj mach ol yal ex smolb'anxi.
Palta ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Amón chi' b'ajtak ol ik'jokb'atok, xchi Jehová.
Ha tas ix yal Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'a yib'anh Edom: ¿Tom manhxa jelanil t'a chonhab' Temán? ¿Tom maxtzak yal yak'wi razón heb' jelan? ¿Tom ix satel masanil sjelanil heb' chi'?
Ex aj Dedán, elanhek lemnajok, ixikek he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en. Yujto ol in satel schonhab' winhaj Esaú tik. Toxo ix k'och sk'uhal wak'anoch sya'elal.
Ayik smolchaj sat te' uwa, ay b'aj skan junjunxo xuk'yatil te'. Ayik sk'och heb' elk'um t'ak'walil, anhej tas yowalil tz'och yuj heb' syelk'ejb'ati.

Palta ha t'a schonhab' winhaj Esaú tik, manhxalaj jab'ok tas olto wak'kani. Wojtak smasanil, malaj b'aj ol yal he k'ub'anel he b'a. Masanil heb' eyuninal, heb' he k'ab' eyok yet' heb' kajan t'a he lak'anil, ol satel heb'. Manhxa mach olto kanok.
Kanokab' heb' eyuninal mheb'ail, ol in tanhwej heb'. Yet' heb' ix junixtak, syal in yak'anoch heb' ix yipok sk'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' manh smojok yab'an sya'il, a tiknaik yowalil ol yab' sya'il heb' yuj yowal in k'o'ol, ichato ol yuk' wino heb' te ow. Ok exxom a ex tik, ¿tom manh ol eyab' sya'il he na'ani? Yowalil ol eyab' sya'il yuj yowal in k'o'ol.

Yujto a in Jehová in swak' in ti': Ha chonhab' Bosra ol kan tzinan, a heb' anima ol ilanok ol te xiw heb', ol b'uchjok yuj heb', ol yak' b'inaj heb' ayik ol skatab'an junok mach heb'. Haxo juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Edom chi', ol satpaxel t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.

Ix jawi jun ab'ix t'ayin yuj Jehová icha tik: Wan schekjikot jun chekab' ul yalel t'a skaltak nación icha tik: Molb'ejek he b'a, tzex b'at t'a Edom, ak'ek lista he b'a yik tzex b'at eyak' owal yet'ok, xchi jun chekab' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ex aj Edom, emnakil ol ex wutejkan t'a skal masanil nación. Manhxalaj ol aj eyelk'och t'a yol sat masanil anima.

Munil a ex ix eyak' musansatil he b'a yuj eyak'umtakil. Ha he na'ani to masanil mach xiw t'ayex. Ichato t'a sjatelaltak k'e'en tenam, ma t'a jolomtak witz kajan ex. Palta a in Jehová in swala', wach'chom te cha'anh b'aj tzex kajnaj icha nok' ch'akb'a te cha'anh b'aj sb'o so', palta yowalil ol ex wik'emta ta'.
