Haxo stzikikial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ix k'e wa'an, ix el t'a yib'anh juntzanh yechel querubín, b'aj aytaxonek'i, ix kan t'a spuertail templo chi'. Ha Jehová chi' ix awtan jun winh ayoch pichul lino chi' yuj, haton jun winh et'jinak yamk'ab' yik tz'ib' t'a snanhal.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ek'anh t'a masanil yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik, tzak'anoch yechel t'a snanhal sat masanil anima tz'ok' yuj chukal yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' anima t'a chonhab' tik, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wab'an yalanxi t'a heb' winh et'jinak syamk'ab' yik owal chi': Ixikek t'a spatiktak winh chi', tzex ek' t'a kal chonhab' tik smasanil, mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb' anima, tze milcham

masanil heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh kelemtak, heb' ix kob'estak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, masanto manhxalaj junok heb' skani. Palta manh he milcham junok heb' ayoch yechel t'a snanhal chi'. Tze chael yich t'a in templo tik, xchi Jehová. Ix scha'anel yich heb' winh smilancham heb' winh ichamtak winak ayek' t'a yamak'il templo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixtejekel templo tik, tzeyak'an b'ut'jok yamak'il yuj sniwanil heb' scham chi', slajwi chi' tzex b'ati, xchi. Ix wilan sb'at lemnaj heb' winh b'i'an, ix och ijan heb' winh smilancham heb' anima t'a masanil yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik wan smilancham heb' anima chi' heb' winh, a inxonhej in kan t'a yichanh Jehová, ix in em nhojan t'a sat lu'um, ix te kus in k'o'ol, yuj chi' ix el waw: Mamin Jehová Wajalil, ¿tom ol a satel masanil heb' aytokan t'a Israel yuj yowal a k'ol t'a Jerusalén tik? xin chi.

Ix tak'wi t'ayin icha tik: Ha wal smul heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá tik, yelxo wal te niwan. Yelxo wal b'ut'jinakel yol juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj sniwanil heb' anima smiljichamok. Manhxa jab'ok tojolal sk'ulej heb'. Ha sna'an heb' to toxo ix waktejkan jun nación tik, maxtzak wil tas sk'ulej heb' sna'ani.
Ha tiknaik maxtzak ok' in k'ol t'a heb', ol wak'xonhejoch sya'elal heb' yuj masanil tas tz'el sk'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix jax jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi', yet'nak pax yamk'ab' yik tz'ib' t'a snanhal, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Wajalil, toxo ix in k'anab'ajej tas ix a chek in k'ulej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wilan t'a yib'anh jun b'akhanb'at t'a yib'anh heb' querubín, hata' ix sch'ox sb'a jun tas icha junok trono, lajan wal yilji icha k'e'en zafiro.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi' icha tik: Ochanh t'a skal juntzanh xokanxokan ay t'a yalanh juntzanh querubín chi', tzik'anelta jun jopok tzak'ak' ayoch sk'ak'al, haton juntzanh ay t'a snanhal juntzanh querubín chi', tza tzipanb'at t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh. Haxo ix wilani, ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' querubín chi' ayek' heb' t'a jun spak'ul templo chi' t'a stojolal sur. Ix em jun yasunal stzikikial Jehová, ix b'ut'jiel yamak'il templo chi' yuj.

Toxo ix k'e wan stzikikial Jehová t'a yib'anh juntzanh yechel querubín b'aj aytaxonek'i, ix kan t'a spuertail templo chi'. Ix b'ut'jiel templo yuj jun asun chi', haxo yamak'il templo chi', toxonhej skopopi yilji yuj stzikikial Jehová chi'.
Tzato ab'chajnhej sk'anh sk'axil heb' querubín chi' t'a jun niwan amak' t'a stiel templo chi'. Lajan wal icha sjaj Dios Syal yuj Smasanil ayik sloloni.

Ayik ix yalan Jehová t'a jun winh winak ayoch lino spichulok chi' to syik'elta k'ak' t'a skal juntzanh xokanxokan t'a snanhal heb' querubín chi', ix och winh b'i'an, ix och linhan winh t'a stz'ey junok juntzanh xokanxokan chi'.

Ha t'a yalanh sk'axil heb' querubín chi', hata' ayelta sk'ab' heb' icha k'ab' anima. Ha junok heb' querubín chi' ix yak'b'at sk'ab' t'a skal k'ak' ayelta t'a snanhal heb' chi', ix yik'anelta jab'ok k'ak' chi', ix yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh ayoch lino spichulok chi'. Ix scha'anek' winh, ix yik'anelta winh.
Ix wilan pax chanhe' xokanxokan toxonhej skopopi yilji icha k'e'en topacio, junnhej yaj yet' heb' querubín chi'.
Ha juntzanh chi' lajannhej, ha t'a junjun ay junokxo xokanxokan sk'axpaj ek' t'a snanhal yo'ol.
Ayik sb'at heb' querubín chi', a b'aj k'elanb'at heb' sb'ati, sb'atnhej heb', max sutmaj sniwanil heb' b'aj sb'at chi', palta to syal sb'atnhej heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh b'aj k'elanb'ati.
Masanil sniwanil heb', yich spatik heb', sk'ab' heb' yet' sk'axil heb', aynhej yol sat, icha juntzanh xokanxokan chi'.
Ix wab'an yalchaj sb'i juntzanh xokanxokan chi': Xokanxokan surankani.

Ha heb' querubín chi', chanhe' sat junjun heb'. Ha sb'ab'el sat heb' lajan yilji icha sat junok querubín, haxo schab'il, lajan yilji icha sat anima, haxo yoxil, lajan yilji icha sat nok' choj, haxo schanhil, lajan yilji icha sat nok' niwak ch'akb'a.
Ha heb' querubín chi', hanhejtona' heb' ix wil t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Ix k'e wa'an heb'.
Ayik sb'at heb', sb'atpax juntzanh xokanxokan chi' yet' heb'. Ayik syik'ank'e sk'axil heb' ayik sk'e jenhnaj heb' t'a sat lu'um, sk'epax wa'an juntzanh xokanxokan chi' yet' heb'.
Ayik tz'och wa'an heb', tz'ochpax wa'an juntzanh xokanxokan chi'. Ayik sk'e wa'an heb', sk'epax wa'an juntzanh chi' yet' heb', yujto ha t'a juntzanh xokanxokan chi' ayoch spixan heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e wa'an stzikikial Jehová t'a spuertail templo chi', haxo t'a yib'anh heb' querubín chi' ix k'ochkani.

K'elan in wal ochi ix yik'ank'e sk'axil heb', ix k'e wa'an heb' t'a sat lum tik yet' juntzanh xokanxokan chi', haxo t'a spuertail yamak'il stemplo Jehová t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u ix wanaj heb'. Ha stzikikial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ayek' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haton juntzanh heb' querubín tik wilnak t'a yalan strono Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ayik ayinek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel wu'uj to querubín heb'.
Ha junjun heb' chi', chanhe' sat heb', chanhe' pax sk'axil junjun heb'. Haxo t'a yalanh sk'axil heb' chi', ayelta sk'ab' heb' icha yilji k'ab' anima.
Ha sat heb', lajannhej yilji icha yilji heb' wilnak t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar chi'. Ayik sb'eyb'at heb', tojolnhej sb'at heb' b'aj k'elanb'at t'a yichanh.

Ha Yespíritu Dios chi' ix in ik'anb'at b'aj ay spuertail stemplo Jehová chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ha t'a jun puerta chi', ayek' 25 heb' winh winak, haxo t'a skal heb' winh chi', ayek' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal winhaj Azur yet' winhaj Pelatías yuninal winhaj Benaías, haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' anima.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, haton wal juntzanh winak tik aynhejek' t'a spensar sk'ulan chukal, skuchb'an heb' anima heb' t'a chukal chi'.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Manh toxo'ok ol satel ko chonhab' tik, ko b'oekk'e ko pat. Ha ko chonhab' tik lajan icha junok k'e'en chen, a onhxo tik lajan onh icha nok' chib'ej tz'em t'a yol chen chi', xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ach anima alel in lolonel yuj tas ol ja t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ja pax Yespíritu Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik: Al t'a heb' anima chi' to a in swal icha tik: Ex israel, wojtak wal sik'lab'il tas tze na'a.
Te tzijtumxo anima ix he milcham t'a jun chonhab' tik, b'ut'an yoltak calle yuj chamnak chi'.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swal t'ayex: Ha Jerusalén tik, lajan wal icha junok k'e'en chen. Haxo nok' chib'ej chi', haton heb' anima tze milcham t'a yoltak calle chi'. Palta a exxo tik, ol ex wik'el t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Wojtak to tzex xiw t'a owal, yuj chi' a in Jehová in ol wak'kot owal chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex wik'el t'a yol chonhab' tik, ol ex wak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ol ex miljokcham t'a k'e'en espada. Ha in ol wak'och eyaelal t'a yichanhb'at smojonal Israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha jun chonhab' tik, manh lajanok ol aj icha junok k'e'en chen t'ayex, a exxo pax tik, manh lajanok ol ex aj icha nok' chib'ej. Ha t'a yichanhb'at smojonal Israel tik, hata' ol wak'och eyaelal.

Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Yujto a ex tik manh jab'ok ix he b'eyb'alej in cheknab'il, maj he k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al, palta a sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación ay t'a he lak'anil tik ix he b'eyb'alej, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Yakb'an wan walan juntzanh tik, ix wilani ix cham winhaj Pelatías yuninal winhaj Benaías. Ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lu'um, ix wak'anel waw, ix walani: Ay Mamin Jehová, ¿tom ol a satel jaywanhxo anima ixto kan t'a Israel tik? xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal aykan t'a Jerusalén tik, syal heb' eyu'uj a ex ayto eyuj he b'a ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia icha tik: Ha heb' chi', te najat ix ik'jikanel heb' t'a tz'ey Jehová, yuj chi' a lum lum tik, toxo ix ak'jikan lum ko makb'enok xchi heb' eyu'uj.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil: Ix wik'el heb' t'a slu'um, ix in saklemanb'at heb' t'a juntzanh ch'ok nacional. Palta yakb'an ayek' heb' junok tiempoal ta', ayinek' yet' heb', ichato ayek' jun b'aj kajan in ek' t'a skal heb'.
Ha in ol ex in molb'ejxi t'a juntzanh nación b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'ati, ol ex wik'anxi meltzajok. Ol wak'anxi lum he lu'um he makb'enok.
Ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab', ol satanel masanil juntzanh yechel yajb'entak heb'.
Ol wik'el jun pensar ayoch t'a heb' icha k'e'en k'e'en, haxo jun ak' pensar te wach' ol wak'och t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj yajek' heb' icha wal yalan in k'ayb'ub'al, ol sb'eyb'alan pax in cheknab'il heb', in chonhab' ol ajxok heb', a inxo ol in ochxok sDiosalok heb'.
Haxo pax heb' to olto b'eyb'alan juntzanh b'eyb'al yajb'entak chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' yuj, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix wilan sk'e wa'an heb' querubín, ix b'at jenhenhok heb', ix b'atpax juntzanh xokanxokan yet' heb'. Ha stzikikial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik ayem t'a yib'anh heb'.
Junnhej ix k'e wa'an yet' heb', ix el t'a chonhab' Jerusalén chi'. Haxo t'a sjolom jun lum witz t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a chonhab' chi' hata' ix wanaji.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wilani a Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'anxikot t'a Babilonia tik, haton b'aj ayek' juntzanh heb' wetchonhab' ik'b'ilkot t'a tik. Haton juntzanh tik ix sch'ox Yespíritu Dios wila''. Ixlajwi chi', manhxalaj tas ix wila''.
Masanil juntzanh tas ix sch'ox Jehová chi' t'ayin, ix wal t'a heb' ik'b'ilkot chi' t'a Babilonia tik.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a juntzanh anima b'aj kajan ach ek' t'a skal tik, te pit heb'. Nab'anhej ay yol sat heb', palta max yil-laj heb'. Nab'anhej ay schikin heb', palta max yab' heb' tas swala', yujto a jun chonhab' tik junelnhej te pit.

Yuj chi' molb'ej a k'a'el, ichato wan ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. T'a k'uhalil, yichanh wal heb' tzach elta t'a yol a pat, ch'okxo b'aj tzach b'atkani, tekan ol nachajel yuj heb' icha chi, wach'chom te pit heb'.

T'a k'uhalil, wal t'a yichanh heb' smasanil, tzik'anelta a k'a'el chi', ichato tzach ik'jib'ati. Hanheja' t'a yemk'uhalil, tzach elta pax t'a yichanh heb', ichato tzach ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ol junok olan t'a sat a pat, tzach el ta' yet' masanil a k'a'el t'a yichanh heb' smasanil.

Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, tza jolomjenhjab'an masanil a k'a'el chi', wal t'a yichanh heb' smasanil tzach eli. Tza musej a sat yik wach' max yal ilan b'aj tzach b'ati. In gana to a ach tzach och ch'oxnab'ilal t'a heb' etisraelal tik, xchi t'ayin.

Ix wak'an lista masanil in k'a'el icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin. T'a k'uhalil ix in elta yet' in k'a'el chi', icha wal heb' wan yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Haxo t'a yemk'uhalil ix in b'oan jun olan t'a sat in pat, haxo yik wan sk'ik'b'i, ix in jolomjenhjab'an masanil in k'a'el chi'. Yichanh wal heb' ix in elta.
Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal tik yelxo te pit heb', ¿tok wal maj sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach yuj tas wan a k'ulan chi'?

Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Ha jun tzin chek k'ulaj tik, ch'oxnab'il yaji, icha wal tik ol aj winh sreyal Jerusalén yet' masanil anima kajan ta', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Tzalan paxi to ch'oxnab'il aj t'a heb'. Yujto yowalil icha chi' ol aj heb' aj Jerusalén chi', icha wal wan utan a b'a chi', yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.

Ha winh sreyal heb', yowalil ol sjolomjenhjab'ejb'at sk'a'el winh ayik wan sk'ik'b'i, ol el winh t'a jun olan b'ob'il yuj heb' t'a smuroal Jerusalén chi'. Ol smusan sat winh, yik wach' manh ol yil winh b'aj sb'ati.

Ha in ol wak'b'at jun icha ch'anh ya'al t'a yib'anh winh rey chi', ol kan winh t'a yol ch'anh, ol ik'jokkot winh t'a Babilonia, t'a slum heb' caldeo tik, palta manh ol yil-laj jun chonhab' tik winh. Ha t'a tik ol cham winh.
Ol saklemkanb'at heb' soldado stanhwan winh yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' soldado. Ha in ol wak' pechjok heb' yet' k'e'en espada.
Ayik toxo ix in saklemejb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación chi', ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.

Palta a in ol wak' kolchajkanel jaywanhokxo heb' t'a skal owal, t'a skal wejel yet' t'a skal ilya, yik wach' ha t'a juntzanhxo nación b'aj ol b'atkan heb' chi', ol yal heb' yuj jantak tas yajb'entak sk'ulejnak. Ol yojtakejpaxel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, luklonanhk'e yuj xiwelal yet' ilk'olal ayik tzach wa'i yet' ayik tzuk'an ha'.

Al t'a masanil heb' etchonhab' chi' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová Kajalil t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a smakb'en Israel chi': T'a skal ilk'olal ol wa heb', t'a skal somk'olal ol yuk'ej ha' heb', yujto a jun nación chi' ol lajwokemok. Ol kan wal tzinan yuj masanil ixtoj anima sk'ulej heb' kajan t'ay.
Masanil chonhab' b'ajtak kajan anima ol laj emkan lanhnajok, ol kan pax tzinan lum smakb'en heb' chi'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ¿tas syalelk'och jun slolonel heb' israel syal icha tik? Tonhej b'elb'on yek' tiempo, max elk'ochlaj tas syal heb' schekab' Dios, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb': Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil: Ha yuj tas ol in k'ulej, manhxo ol eyal-laj jun lolonel chi', yujto toxo ol k'och stiempoal yelk'och juntzanh tas in ch'oxnak yil heb' in chekab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Yujto manhxa mach ol stz'ak yala' to ay tas te wach' ix yil t'a swayich, ma sna'ancha'anh junok esal lolonel t'a he kal.
Yujto a in Jehová in ol in lolonok. Yalnhej tas ol wal chi' elanhchamel ol elk'ochok. Ha ex anima ex te pit ex tik, ol eyil wal to a in ol in lolonok, ol wak'anelk'och tas swal chi', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal chi', syal heb' to a juntzanh ix in ch'ox ila' yet' juntzanh lolonel ix ala' to olto heb' yelk'ochi,
yuj chi' al t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swala' to a tas swala' manh ol ek' tiempo yelk'ochi, yowalil ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, al juntzanh in lolonel tik t'a juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a heb' etisraelal, haton heb' skomon lolon t'a yol yiko'. Al t'a heb' to smaklej yab' in lolonel heb', a in Jehová he Yajal in tik swal icha tik:

Ex israel, ob'iltak wal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', malaj spensar heb', anhej spensar heb' t'a yol yik syala', tokwal ay tas sch'oxji yil heb'. Lajan wal heb' icha nok' wa'ax kajan b'aj emnak lanhnaj junok chonhab'.

Icha wal muro max nipchaj spojelal ayik sjawi sk'uhal owal, icha chi' yaj heb' yinhtilal Israel, manh jab'ok sb'o sb'eyb'al heb' yuj heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yik max wak' sya'elal heb' ayik ol in jawok in ch'olb'itan heb' a in Jehová in tik.

Ha tas tz'ak'ji yil heb' yalani, manh yeloklaj. Ha lolonel ayokto syalankanel heb', es juntzanh chi'. Syal heb' to a in lolonel syalel heb', palta manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Wach'chom es juntzanh syal heb' chi', palta syak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol to ol elk'och yalan heb'.

Yuj chi' swal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik tzeyaloch he b'a in chekab'ok. Tokwal manh esok tas tzeyala' ayik tzeyalani to ay tas ix ch'oxji heyila', tze na'anel lolonel, ayik tzeyalani: Icha tik yalan Jehová xe chi, palta malaj tas swal t'ayex.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Yujto a ex tik tzeyala' to ay tas tzin ch'ox heyila', palta manh yeloklaj, yuj chi' ay in och ajk'olal t'ayex.

Ol wik' wal cha'anh in k'ab' wak'anoch sya'elal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', yujto anhej tas manh yelok syal heb'. Malaj yalan yik heb' sk'och b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' yetisraelal, max tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' t'a slistail heb' yetchonhab' chi', manhxo ol meltzajpax heb' t'a slu'um. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Yajal in.

Ha juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', tonhej syak' heb' in chonhab' heb' musansatil, syalan heb' icha tik: Ha tiknaik manhxo he na' to ay tas ol ja t'a kib'anh, xchi heb', palta manh yeloklaj syal heb'. Lajan heb' icha junok mach stzikanoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a junok yichtak pat chuklaj yaj sb'o'i.
Al t'a heb' stzikanoch k'e'en ta'anh chi' to ol telwok jun yich pat chi' ayik ol wak'ankot niwak yaxnhab' ay yik'al, ay pax sakb'atil,

ol em lanhnaj jun yich pat chi'. Ichato chi' b'i'an ol sk'anb'an heb' anima: ¿Tas yopisio juntzanh k'e'en ta'anh ix eyak'och chi'? xcham heb'. Ha jun yich pat chi', a Jerusalén yet' schukal, a sch'oxo'.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha wal yuj yowal in k'o'ol ichato ol wak'b'at niwak yaxnhab' ay yik'al, ay pax sakb'atil. Yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol ol wak'anem lanhnaj jun yichtak pat chi'.

Ol wak'em lanhnaj chonhab' Jerusalén chi', ol em lanhnaj t'a sat lu'um, masanto ol cheklaj yich aykanemi. Ayik ol em lanhnaj jun chonhab' chi', ha t'a skal spojelal chi' ol ex chamok. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ol wak'walb'at yowal in k'ol t'a jun yichtak pat chi' yet' t'a heb' ix ak'anoch k'e'en ta'anh t'ay, ol yalan heb' anima icha tik: Manhxa jab'ok jun yichtak pat chi' ix kani, manhxa pax heb' ix ak'anoch sta'anhil ix kani, xcham heb'.

Ha heb' stz'ak yaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', haton heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yetisraelal tas tz'ak'ji yil heb' yalani. Syalan heb' to malaj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Jerusalén, haton heb' tik yet' tas syal heb' chi' sch'ox heb' ix ak'anoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a yichtak pat. Palta a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to manh ichok syal heb' chi' swala', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ach anima, al t'a juntzanh heb' ix etisraelal syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, palta anhej t'a yol yik heb' skomon loloni.

Icha tik tz'aj halan t'a heb' ix: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil: Ob'iltak ex tze pixoch juntzanh k'apak t'a sk'ab' heb' anima, tze pixanpaxoch k'apak t'a sjolom heb', hato syal jantakxo yab'ilal heb'. Tze nib'ej tz'och tzak'an heb' eyu'uj. Yik wach' yek' tiempo eyu'uj, tzeyalani to syal he mak'anek' schamel heb', ma syal pax eyak'ancham heb'.

Ha ex tik, anhej yuj jun jopok ixim cebada, ma yuj jab'ok ti pan tzin he patikanel t'a yichanh heb' in chonhab'. Tzeyak'cham heb' anima manh smojok schami, haxo heb' anima manhxo smojok pitzan, a heb' chi' max eyak'chamok. Icha chi' tz'aj eyixtan heb' in chonhab' scha yab' eyes chi'.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Ayinoch ajk'olal t'ayex yuj juntzanh k'apak tze pixoch t'a heb' anima chi' yik tzeyak'an heb' musansatil icha tz'aj smakchaj nok' much. Ol in nhik'el juntzanh k'apak chi' t'a sk'ab' heb' anima chi'. Icha chi' ol aj yelkan heb' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Ol in kolel in chonhab' t'a yol he k'ab' b'aj tzeyak' musansatil heb' yet' juntzanh k'apak tzeyak'och t'a sat heb' chi'. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol montaj heb' eyuj junelxo. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ha yuj eyes chi' tzeyak' chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' wach' spensar, haton heb' malaj in gana swak' kus sk'o'ol, ix he kuchb'an heb' te chuk sk'ulej, yuj chi' max sna sb'a heb' t'a schukal chi' yik skolchaj heb'.

Yuj chi' manhxalaj b'aj ol eyala' to ay tas tz'ak'ji heyila', ma olto he tz'ak he na'el tas ol ujok. Ha in ol in kolel in chonhab' t'a yol he k'ab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb' ix, xchi t'ayin.
Ay heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel ix jawi t'ayin yik tzin k'anb'ej t'a Jehová yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a juntzanh anima tik toxo ix yak'och spensar heb' t'a komon Dios, syak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi'. ¿Tom olto in tak'wok t'a heb' ayik ol sk'anb'an junok tas heb' t'ayin?

Al t'a heb' to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Yalnhej mach ex israelal ex tik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a komon Dios, tzeyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi', slajwi chi' tzex jawi he k'anb'ej junok tas t'a heb' in chekab', a in ol wak' spak t'ayex icha wal smojal, yujto tzijtum he diosal chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj wik'an meltzaj spensar heb' israel t'ayin, haton heb' ix yik'el sb'a t'ayin, haxo t'a komon Dios ix och heb' ejmelal.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Yajal: Meltzajanhekkot t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh komon Dios yet' juntzanh he b'eyb'al yajb'entak tze k'ulej chi', xa chi t'a heb'.

Tato ay junok heb' ma junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a skal heb' tzin patikaneli, haxo t'a komon Dios tz'och ejmelal, syak'anoch sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' chukal yuj juntzanh chi', slajwi chi' sjawi t'a junok in chekab' yik sk'anb'an t'ayin yuj, a in wal ol wak' spak t'ay.
Ol in och ajk'olal t'ay, ol in satel t'a skal in chonhab' yik tz'och ch'oxnab'il, yik sb'inaj yuj heb' anima. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Palta tato ay junok in chekab' smontaj yuj junok anima, syalan junok tas t'a yol yiko', a in Jehová in ol in wach' ak'ej montajok. Ol in och ajk'olal t'a jun in chekab' chi', ol in satel t'a skal heb' in chonhab' Israel.
Yowalil ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh jun anima ix montan jun in chekab' chi' yet' pax t'a yib'anh jun in chekab' ix pakan t'a yol yik chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' in chonhab' Israel manhxo ol in spatikejel heb', manhxo ol b'at heb' t'a spatik chukal. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to in chonhab' heb', a inxo sDiosal in heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, k'inalok ay junok chonhab' tzek' t'a yib'anh yoch smul t'ayin, swak'anoch sya'elal, swik'anek' swa'el, yuj chi' scham heb' anima yet' nok' nok' yuj wejel.

K'inalok ha t'a skal heb' chi' kajan winhaj Noé, winhaj Daniel yet' winhaj Job, a in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to anhej am oxwanh heb' winh chi' skolchaji, yujto tojol sb'eyb'al heb' winh, malaj junokxo mach skolchaj yet' heb' winh.
K'inalok swak'b'at nok' chium nok' t'a jun chonhab' chi' yik smiljicham masanil yuninal heb' kajan ta' yuj nok', skan tzinan. Manhxa mach sb'eyek' ta' yuj xiwk'olal t'a nok'.

K'inalok ha t'a jun chonhab' chi' kajan heb' winh oxwanh chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchaji. Malaj junok mach syal skolanel heb' winh, wach'chom yuninal heb' winh mato yisil heb' winh, max yal-laj skolchaj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to skan tzinan jun chonhab' chi'.
K'inalok swak'b'at owal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yik scham heb' anima yet' nok' nok',
k'inalok hata' kajan heb' winh oxwanh chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchajeli. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to maxtzak am yal skolchaj heb' yuninal heb' winh yet' yisil heb' winh yuj.
K'inalok swak'b'at ilya t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol swak'anb'at chamel t'a yib'anh heb' anima yet' t'a yib'anh nok' nok'.

K'inalok hata' kajan winhaj Noé, winhaj Daniel yet' winhaj Job chi', anhej am heb' winh skolchaji. Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala', wach'chom tojol sb'eyb'al heb' winh, palta max yal-laj skolan heb' yuninal heb' winh, ma yisil heb' winh.

Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Te ayxo smay ol ujok, ayik ol wak'anb'at chanhe' ya'elal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi': Haton owal, wejel, nok' chium nok' yet' ilya, scham anima yet' nok' nok' yuj juntzanh chi'.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' ol kolchajkanel yet' yuninal yet' yisil. Ha heb' chi' ol ik'jokkot heb' t'a tik, ol eyilanoch sb'eyb'al heb' yet' jantak chukal sk'ulej heb'. Icha chi' ol aj eyaktan he kus yuj ya'elal swak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to malaj tas manh smojok swak'b'at t'a yib'anh Jerusalén chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ¿tom ek'b'al yelk'och ste'al te' uwa t'a yichanh junok te te'?
Ha ste'al te' uwa chi' malaj yopisio te', max yal-laj yoch te' lokteal, max yalpaxlaj sb'o junok tas t'a te'.
Tato tz'och te' k'atzitzal, stz'ab'at te', a stzak'ak'il te' chi', malaj tz'ochi.
Ayik manto tz'a te' chi', malaj tz'och te', ¿tom hato wal yik stz'ab'at te', ichato chi' tz'och yopisio te'?
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swala': Icha yaj te' uwa tz'ik'jielta t'a skal te te' yik snhusjitz'a te', icha chi' ol aj wak'anoch sya'elal heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ha in wal ay in och ajk'olal t'a heb'. Wach'chom ol el lemnaj heb' t'a jun ya'elal chi', palta a ya'elal chi' ol satanel heb'. Ayik ol in och ajk'olal t'a heb', ol nachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kan tzinan jun chonhab' chi', yujto maj in sk'anab'ajej heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al yab' heb' aj Jerusalén tastak te yajb'entak sk'ulej heb'.
Al t'a heb' to a in Jehová Yajal in, a in swala' to icha tik yaj yab'ixal Jerusalén chi': Ha Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix ix ha t'a Canaán aljinak. Amorreo smam ix, haxo snun ix, hetea.
Ayik yaljinak ix, maj poljiel-laj smuxuk ix, maj b'ikchajel-laj jab'ok ix, maj ek' jab'ok yal atz'am t'a ix, maj pichchaj jab'ok ix yet' k'apak.
Manhxa mach ix ok' sk'ol sb'o'an juntzanh chi' t'a ix. Ayik ix alji ix chi', ix kan telan ix yuj heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix yajji ix yuj heb'.
Haxo yik ix in ek' t'a stz'ey ix, ix wilani to mi'ikmi'ik ix yuj schik'il, ix in na'ani to smoj sk'ib' ix.
Ix wak'an k'ib' ix icha junok te' kaltakte'al te' spak'k'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix k'ib'k'e ix, ix kob'esax ix, ix elta yim ix, ix k'ib'pax xil sjolom ix. Palta junelnhej te b'eranel ix.

Ix in ek'xi junelxo t'a slak'anil ix chi', ix wilani to smojxo yoch yetb'eyum ix. Yuj chi' ix wak'b'at jun k'apak t'a yib'anh ix. Icha wal chi' ix aj in pichan ix, yujto b'erannhejel ix. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix wak' in trato yet' ix yik tz'ochkan ix t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ix in b'ikel schik'il ix, ix in sakb'itej ix, ix wak'anoch perfume t'a ix.
Ix wak'anoch jun pichul te wach' yilji stz'ib'ul t'a ix. Ix wak'anoch xanhab' tz'u'um te wach' t'a ix yet' pax jun tzek'ul nab'a lino yet' pax jun spichul ix te wach' yaj sjalchaji.
Te wach' ix aj wak'anoch yelwanub' t'a ix. Ix wak'och k'e'en brazalete t'a sjaj sk'ab' ix yet' pax jun tonh t'a sjaj ix.
Ix wak'anpaxoch jun k'e'en icha kolk'ab' t'a snhi' ix yet' yuchikin ix yet' pax jun corona te wach' yilji t'a sjolom ix.

Pichichi ix ajkan ix yet' k'e'en oro yet' pax k'e'en plata. Ha spichul ix chi', haton k'apak lino te wach', haton juntzanh k'apak te wach' yaj sjalchaji yet' k'apak te wach' yilji stz'ib'ul. Ix wak'an ixim pan te wach' t'a ix yik swa ix yet' yal chab' yet' pax yaceiteal sat te' olivo. Te wach'xonhej ix aj yilji ix, yuj chi' ix och ix reinail.
Te b'inajnak ix aj ix t'a kaltak nación yuj swach'il yilji chi'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to tz'akaki ix aj in b'oanel ix yet' yelwanub'.
Yujto te b'inajnak ix aj ix, ix yak'anoch spensar ix t'a swach'il yilji chi', haxo t'a ajmulal ix b'atkan ix, ix yak'an sb'a ix t'a yalnhej mach tzek' ta'.
Ha yet' spichul ix ix sb'ok'e smantiado b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios t'a tzalkixtak, hata' ix em ix ajmulal. Ha juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej ix chi', manh smojok ix sk'ulej ix.
Ix yik'anel masanil k'e'en k'e'en ix te wach' yilji, k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata wak'nak t'a ix. Ha yet' k'e'en ix sb'ok'e yechel winak ix yik tz'och ix ajmulal yet'ok.
Ha spichul ix te wach' yilji chi' yet' aceite yet' incienso ix wak' t'a ix, ix yak' ix t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.

Ha ixim pan b'ob'il t'a ixim harina te wach', aceite yet' nok' yal chab' ix wak' swaelok ix, ix yak' ix silab'il te wach' sjab' t'a juntzanh yechel, haton juntzanh te wach' sjab'. Haton wal juntzanh chi' sk'ulej ix t'a wichanh a in Jehová in tik.

Hanhejtona' a heb' wuninal yet' heb' wisil ix wil sat yet' ix, ix snhustz'a ix silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', icha wa'el ix aj heb' unin chi' t'a juntzanh yechel chi'. Manh tonhejok ix em ix t'a ajmulal chi',
palta ix yik'b'at heb' wuninal ix, ix nhusantz'a heb' ix silab'il t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.

T'a skal juntzanh smul ix te yajb'entak sk'ulej chi', majxo snakot ix tas ix aj skotoch t'a uninal, majxo snakot ix tato b'eranel ix ayik aytoek' ix t'a skal schik'il. Ha jun ix ix chi', haton Jerusalén sch'oxo'.
Ha in wal Jehová Yajal in swala': Ob'iltak chonhab' Jerusalén chi' yuj juntzanh chukal sk'ulej.
Yalnhej b'aj tzalkixtak, hata' ix sb'ok'e b'aj tz'em ajmulal.
Ha b'aj slajwikank'och junjun calle ix sb'ok'e juntzanh b'aj tz'em ajmulal chi'. Ha swach'il yilji, yajb'entak ix ajkani. Ix yak'b'at sb'a t'a yalxonhej mach tzek' ta'.
Ix yak'anb'at sb'a t'a jun chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil, haton Egipto te pek' t'a ajmulal. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol yuj sk'echa'anh t'a ajmulal chi'.

Yuj chi' ay in och ajk'olal t'ay, ix wak'anoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh. Ix wik'anemta swa'el, ix wak'anpaxoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, haton heb' filisteo. Ha heb' chi' ix sat sk'ol heb' yilan sb'eyb'al Jerusalén te k'ixweltak sk'ulej chi'.
Palta ix yak'paxb'at sb'a t'a Asiria. Palta max k'och sk'o'ol.
Ix yak'anpaxb'at sb'a t'a Babilonia, haton schonhab' heb' chonhwajum, palta manh yujok chi' ix k'och sk'o'ol.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Ha Jerusalén te pek' t'a ajmulal chi', lajan wal ix yutej sb'a icha junok ix ajmul ix maxtzak k'ixwi yuj tas syutej sb'a.

Ix sb'ok'e juntzanh b'aj tz'em ajmulal t'a b'ajtak slajwik'och calle yet' b'ajtak smolb'ej sb'a anima, ix yak'anb'at sb'a t'a ajmulal chi'. Palta nab'anhej syak'b'at sb'a, manh lajanok syutej sb'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix sk'an stojol.
Icha juntzanh ix te chuk syutej sb'a t'a yetb'eyum, syak'b'at sb'a t'a junokxo ch'ok winakil, icha chi' ix yutej sb'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha heb' ix ajmul ix stupchaj heb' ix, haxo pax Jerusalén chi', ha' ix ak'an silab' t'a heb' b'aj syaltej sb'a chi'. Ha ix tupan heb' yik yalnhej b'aj skot heb' sk'ulan ajmulal chi' yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ch'ok yel Jerusalén chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ix ajmul ix. Malaj mach sayanek'i yik smulan yet'ok, max tupchajpaxi, palta to a stupan heb' sk'ulan ajmulal chi' yet'ok, yuj chi' ch'ok yel t'a yichanh heb' ix ajmul ix chi'.
Yuj chi', ab'ek wal tas swal yuj ix ajmul ix chi':

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Malaj sk'ixwelal, ix skichanel b'eran sb'a yik sk'ulan ajmulal yet' heb' xajanej sb'a yet'ok, ix em kuman t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak. Ix stob'anem schik'il heb' yune' yik syak'an silab'il.

Yuj chi' ol in molb'ej masanil juntzanh heb' xajanab'il chi' yuj, haton heb' ix yak' snib'ej yet'ok, juntzanh heb' xajan yuj yet' juntzanh heb' ix schakeli. Ol in molb'ejoch hoyan heb' t'a spatik, wal t'a yichanh heb' ol in kichel b'eran yik wach' ol yil heb' to b'eraneli.
Ol wak' sya'elal t'a smojal, icha tz'utaj junok ix ajmul ix yet' pax junok ix mak'umcham anima. Yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol yet' in chichonk'olal ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.

Ol wak'och Jerusalén chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación chi' yik ol satel juntzanh tzalkixtak heb' b'aj ix em ajmulal yet' b'aj ix och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'. Ol yik'el spichul heb' yet' juntzanh yelwanub' ayoch t'ay, toxonhej ol kan b'eran.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok anima ol k'e wa'an t'a spatik Jerusalén chi', ol sjulk'enancham heb', ol smilancham heb' yet' k'e'en espada.
Ol yak'och sk'ak'al chonhab' chi' heb', t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh. Icha chi' ol aj wak'an lajwok yajmulal chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol stup heb' b'aj ay snib'ej chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj sikb'i yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh, manhxo ol chichon in k'ol t'ay. Manhxo ol kot yowal in k'ol t'ay.

Ix b'at satk'olal yuj chajtil yaji ayik uninto, yuj chi' ix stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'o'ol yuj sb'eyb'al te yajb'entak chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh yuj sb'eyb'al chi'.
Masanil heb' anima ol halan jun lolonel tik t'a spatik Jerusalén chi'. Ol yalan heb': Icha wal ix nunab'il, icha pax chi' ix uneab'il, xcham heb'.

Ha Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix yune' junok ix ix schakanel winh yetb'eyum yet' heb' yune'. Icha pax chi' heb' ix snulej, schakpaxel heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix yet' heb' yune' heb' ix, yujto a ix snun heb' ix chi', hitita ton ix, haxo smam heb' ix, amorreo winh.
Ha t'a stojolal norte, hata' ay ix snulej ix b'ab'el ix, haton Samaria yet' yaldeail. Haxo t'a stojolal sur, hata' ay ix snulej ix tzak'an, haton Sodoma yet' yaldeail.

Manhoknhej sb'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix sb'eyb'alej Jerusalén chi', manhoknhej pax juntzanh tas yajb'entak ix sk'ulej juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix sk'ulej, palta ek'b'al tas te yajb'entak ix sk'ulej, yujto manh k'okb'ilok juntzanh chi' ix yab'i.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha Sodoma yet' yaldeail, manh sk'ulejnakok tas te chuk icha wal tas sk'ulej Jerusalén chi' yet' yaldeail.

Haton wal juntzanh smul Sodoma chi' yet' masanil yaldeail: Yik'nak wal cha'anh sb'a, manhxo jantakok tas yab'lejnak, wach'nhej yaji, palta maj kolwajlaj t'a heb' meb'a', maj kolwajpax t'a heb' ay stzapan majan.
Ha sna'ani to anhej te niwan yelk'ochi, ochnakpax ijan sb'eyb'alan juntzanh tas tzin yaja', yuj chi' in satnakeli, icha wal tz'aj eyilanoch tiknaik.

Haxo pax Samaria yet' yaldeail, ix sk'ulej chukal, palta max tzak'wan t'a tas te chuk sk'ulej Jerusalén chi'. Manh jantakok tas yelxo wal te yajb'entak sk'ulej Jerusalén chi'. Ha juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a slak'anil, wach'takto wal tas sk'ulej.

Ha tiknaik, a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yak' techaj k'ixwelal, yujto a schukalil yelxo te chuk t'a yichanh yik Sodoma yet' t'a yichanh yik Samaria. Ha chab' chonhab' chi', ayik sko lajb'an schukal yet' yik Jerusalén, wach'takto wal.
Ha Sodoma yet' yaldeail wach' ol ajxok wu'uj. Ha Samaria yet' yaldeail wach' ol aj paxok. Icha pax chi' Jerusalén wach' ol ajxok wu'uj.
Palta a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yak' techaj emnakilal yet' k'ixwelal yuj tas te chuk ix sk'ulej. Ha Sodoma yet' Samaria ol sniwanej sb'a sk'o'ol ayik ol yilani to ix wak' sya'elal Jerusalén chi'.
Ayik ol wak'an ajxok Sodoma yet' yaldeail, Samaria yet' yaldeail icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo, ol wak'pax ajxok Jerusalén yet' yaldeail icha t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ayik ix yik'ancha'anh sb'a Jerusalén, haton yik manto ilchajelta schukalil, ix b'uchwaj t'a Sodoma. Palta a tiknaik, a Edom, Filistea yet' masanil nación, ol b'uchwaj t'a Jerusalén chi'. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol patikanelok.
Ha tiknaik, a in Jehová in swala' to a Jerusalén chi' yowalil ol yab' sya'il yuj sb'eyb'al te yajb'entak.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol wak' spak icha wal smojalil t'a Jerusalén chi', yujto maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ulan icha ix aj yak'an strato wet'ok.
Palta a in tik, ol in nakot in trato wak'nak yet'ok ayik uninto, ol in b'oanxi in trato chi' yet'ok, malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwok.

Ha Jerusalén chi', ol snakot schuk b'eyb'al, ol k'ixwokpaxi ayik ol wak'anoch chawanh snulej chi' t'a yol smakb'en, haton Samaria yet' Sodoma. Ichato nunab'il ol ajkan t'a chab' chonhab' chi'. Wach'chom malaj yalan yik chab' chonhab' chi' t'a in trato in b'onak yet' Jerusalén chi',
palta yuj in trato ol in b'oxi yet' Jerusalén chi' icha chi' ol ajok. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel yuj Jerusalén to a inton Jehová sDiosal in.

Ol wak' niwank'olal masanil tas ix sk'ulej Jerusalén chi', palta yowalil ol snakot juntzanh sb'eyb'al chi', ol k'ixwok yuj, yuj chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol yik'cha'anh sb'a, a in Jehová in swala', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' etisraelal t'a ch'oxnab'ilal.

Icha tik tz'aj halani: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil: Ay wal jun nok' niwan ch'akb'a ix k'och t'a Líbano, a sk'axil nok' te niwak, te najatto sk'och jenhan, tz'ib'ib'i yilji xi'il nok'. Ha t'a sk'ab' jun te' k'ute' ix k'och nok'.
Ix yik'anel schon te' nok', ix b'at nok'. Haxo t'a jun chonhab' t'a smakb'en heb' chonhwajum ix k'och nok' yet' te'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'ank'e jun yinhatil te' nok', haxo b'aj ay slumal ix yawejem te' nok', b'aj sb'o munlajel t'a stitak ha ha' icha tz'aj yawchaj te' b'akmam.

Haxo yik ix wolan te', te niwakil ix aj te', te tzijtum ix aj xi'il te', pejannhej ix aj ste'el te'. Ix st'inhb'ejb'at sb'a sk'ab'tak te' b'aj ayek' nok' niwan ch'akb'a chi', ix b'eynhejb'at sch'anhal yib' te' t'a yol lu'um. Manh jantakok swol te' yet' sk'ab'tak ix k'ib'i.

Palta ay junxo nok' niwan ch'akb'a, te niwak sk'axi'il, manhxo jantakok xi'il. Ix b'at jun te te' chi', ix b'eynhejb'at sch'anhal yib' te' yet' sk'ab'tak t'a stojolal junxo nok' niwan ch'akb'a chi', yik wach' niwan ha ha' syak' nok' t'a te'.

Palta toton te wach' lum b'aj awab'ilem te' chi'. Te aynhej ha ha' chi', yuj chi' syal sb'eynhejb'at sk'ab'tak te', syak'anpax sat te' t'a stiempoal, yik te wach' tz'aj yilji te', xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha jun te' chi', manh ol te k'ib'laj te'. Ha nok' niwan ch'akb'a t'a sb'ab'elal, a nok' ol tok'ank'eta sch'anhal yib' te', icha wal chi' ol aj sk'a'el b'ulnaj sat te' yet' xi'il. Ol takjok pax juntzanh swol te' toto ix k'euli. Manh yowalilok yet' niwak ip, ma yet' tzijtumok anima ol tok'ank'eta te' t'a yol lu'um yik stakji.

Wach'chom ol k'exchaj b'aj tz'awchaj te', palta manhxo ol k'eulaj swol te'. Ayik ol ek' ik' skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a te', ol takjok te'. Ol takjok te' b'aj awab'il chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

k'anb'ej t'a juntzanh anima te pit tik, tato snachajel jun ab'ix tik yuj heb'. Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha nok' b'ab'el niwan ch'akb'a chi', haton winh sreyal Babilonia sch'oxo'. Ha winh ix k'och t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at yik'ankot heb' yajal yet' winh sreyal Judá winh preso t'a Babilonia tik.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo jun winh yinhtilal heb' rey ix yak'och winh reyal t'a Judá. Ha winh sreyal Babilonia chi' ix ak'an pural winh yak'an sti' to k'anab'ajum ol yutej sb'a winh t'a winh. Ix yik'ankot heb' niwak winak yaj t'a Jerusalén chi' winh preso
yik manhxalaj tz'aj yelk'och smakb'en Judá chi', yik maxtzak yal yik'ank'e wa'an sb'a, wach'nhej yajek'i yakb'an sk'anab'ajej jun sti' ix yak' chi'.

Palta a winh rey chi' te pit ix yutej sb'a winh t'a winh sreyal Babilonia tik. Ix yak'b'at schekab' winh t'a winh sreyal Egipto yik sk'anankot nok' chej winh yet' jantakok soldado. ¿Tzam he na' to ol yal skolanel sb'a winh yet' jun spensar chi'? ¿Tom ol yal skolanel sb'a junok mach max k'anab'ajan junok strato?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti': Ha t'a Babilonia tik ol cham winh sreyal Judá chi', yujto malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yak' sti' winh, maj sk'anab'ajej strato winh ix sb'o yet' winh rey ix ak'an yopisio.

Ha winh sreyal Egipto chi', wach'chom te tzijtum soldado winh te tek'an, palta manh ol yal-laj skolwaj winh t'a owal ayik ol sb'oank'e stek'nub' heb' soldado aj Babilonia yet' muro t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén yik smilancham anima.
Maj sk'anab'ajej b'aj ix yak' sti' winh sreyal Judá chi', maj elk'och tas syal strato winh ix sb'o chi', yuj chi' manh ol yal-laj skolan sb'a winh.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti': Maj sk'anab'ajej winh rey b'aj ix yak' sti' t'a wichanh, haton jun trato ix yak' winh b'aj ix in yak' b'inajok, yuj chi' ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh winh.

Ichato ol wak'b'at junok ch'anh ya'al t'a yib'anh winh, ol kan winh t'a yol ch'anh, ol wak' ik'jokkot winh t'a Babilonia tik. Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh winh, yujto te pit ix yutej sb'a winh t'ayin.
Ha heb' soldado winh te jelan, ol cham heb' t'a owal, haxo heb' olto kanok, ol saklemkanb'at heb'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová in ix wal jun tik.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha in ol wik'el schon te' k'ute' chi'. Ha junok yuninal schon te' ol wik'eli, ol wawanem t'a junok jolom witz te cha'anh yajk'e t'a Israel. Ol k'ib'k'e sk'ab'tak te', niwan k'ute' ol aj te', te wach' pax ol aj te'. Ha t'a yich te' chi', ol kajnaj masanil makanhil nok' nok', haxo t'a sk'ab'tak te' ol sb'o so' masanil makanhil nok' much.

Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil te te' to a in ton Jehová in syal in ch'akanel te' niwak te' syik'cha'anh sb'a, syal wak'an k'ib' te' kotak ste'el. Ha in swak' takjok te te' te ya'ax, swak'an pax yaxb'ok te' takinh. Ha in Jehová in swala', ol wak'paxelk'ochok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
¿Tas yuj hanheja' eyalub'tanhan jun lolonel t'a spatik chonhab' Israel: Ha heb' mamab'il slo pajal uwa heb', haxo heb' uninab'il jululixonhej sb'at spajil chi' t'a yichtak ye heb'?
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a jun lolonel chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyalub'tanhej a ex aj Israel ex tik.
Yujto wik yaj masanil anima, heb' mamab'il yet' pax heb' uninab'il. Ha mach tz'och smul, ha' schami.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak tojol spensar, wach'nhej tas sk'ulej winh.

Max och winh yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max yak'och juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal winh chi' yipok sk'o'ol. Max mulan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail, max yil-laj sb'a winh yet' ix yetb'eyum ayik ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta to syak' meltzaj tas aykan t'a winh yuj junok anima ay sb'ok t'ay. Max elk'anwi winh. Syak' swa'el heb' ay swejel winh, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Max yak' k'e'en tumin winh t'a majanil yik sk'ananel niwan yune' k'e'en winh. Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta wach' tz'aj sb'o'an yaj junok lolonel winh t'a yib'anh chawanhok ay owal t'a skal.
Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha junok winh winak icha chi', wal yel tojol ton sb'eyb'al winh, ol najatb'ok sk'inal winh, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winh winak chi' te elk'um, mato mak'umcham anima tz'aji. Sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tastak
maj sb'eyb'alej smam, palta to syak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz, tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, smulan pax yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail,

syixtan heb' anima ilb'ajk'ol yuj smheb'ail, tz'elk'anwi, max yak' meltzaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay, anhej juntzanh komon Dios chi' syak'och yipok sk'o'ol, sk'ulan tas te yajb'entak t'a wichanh.

Ha stumin syak' majanil te niwan yune' sk'ana'. Ha junok anima icha chi' sb'eyb'al, ol tzapanb'ok sk'inal. Yujto ix sk'ulej juntzanh tastak tzin yaj chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj schami. Ha schamel chi', ha t'a yib'anh skani.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winak chuk sb'eyb'al chi', syila' tastak juntzanh chuk sk'ulej smam chi', palta manhok juntzanh chi' sk'ulej.
Max yak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios. Max yak'och son t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal. Max mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail, max elk'anwi, max kanlaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay. Syak' swa'el heb' malaj swa'el, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Malaj junok mach syixtej yujto a stumin syak' majanil manh niwanok yune' sk'ana'. Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha jun anima icha chi', manh ol cham yuj smul smam chi', palta to ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Haxo smam chi' ol cham yuj smul chi', yujto ixtum anima, elk'um, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej t'a yol schonhab'.

Tato ayex ol he k'anb'ej icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max kotkan t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam? tato xe chi. Tato a yuninal chi' anhej tas wach' yet' tojolal sk'ulej, sk'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.

Ha mach tz'och smul, a ol chamok. Manhok heb' uninab'il ol tupanel smul smam, manhok pax heb' mamab'il chi' ol tupanel smul heb' yuninal chi'. Ha mach wach' sb'eyb'al, wach' spak ol scha'a, haxo pax mach chuk sb'eyb'al, a chukal ol scha spakok schukal chi'.
Tato ay junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al tz'aktankan schukal chi', sb'eyb'alan masanil in cheknab'il, sb'eyb'alanpax tojolal, wal yel a jun anima chi' manh ol pet chamok.
Ha in tik, manhxo ol in nakot juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal yujto a tojolal sk'ulej.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj in gana scham heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, palta in gana to sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb' yik snajatb'i sk'inal heb'.

Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, palta syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo juntzanh tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' chuk, a chi' sk'ulej, ¿tom ol wak' najatb'ok sk'inal jun anima chi' tze na'a? Manhxo ol in nakot tastak wach' ix sk'ulej chi'. Ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ex tik tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej, yuj chi' ab'ek ex aj Israel: ¿Yel am wal to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manhok ex tze k'ulej tas manh tojolok chi' jun?
Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo chukal sk'ulej, ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta tato a junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan schukal chi', haxo wach'il yet' tojolal sk'ulej, ol kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yujto ix nachajel yuj ix yaktankan schukal sk'ulej chi', wal yel manh ol chamlaj, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Ha exxo aj Israel ex tik, hanhejtona' tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej. ¿Tom manhok ex manh tojolok tas tze k'ulej chi' jun?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol ex in ch'olb'itej junjun ex icha tas tze k'ulej. Yuj chi' naek he b'a, aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al chi' t'a junelnhej. Tato ma'ay, yuj he chuk b'eyb'alil chi' ol ex satelok.
Ex israel, ¿tom tze nib'ej cham he b'a yuj chi' max he k'ex he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al? Palta aktejekkan masanil chukal tze k'ulej chi' yik manh ol ex chamok.
Ha in Jehová in swala', malaj in gana to ay mach schami. Aktejekkan chukal chi' yik ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, xchi Jehová.
Ach anima, b'itej jun b'it yik kusk'olal yuj heb' sreyal Israel, tzalan icha tik:
Ay jun nok' nun choj te b'inajnak, kajan nok' t'a skal juntzanh nok' mam choj. Ha t'a skal nok' chi' ix sk'ib'tzitej yune' nok'.
Ay jun yune' nok' ix yil k'ib'ok. Ix sk'ayb'ank'e syaman schib'ej, haxo heb' anima ix chijib'at yuj.
Ix yab' spekal juntzanh nación tas sk'ulej nok' yune' chi'. Ix yamji nok' yuj heb' t'a jun ya'al, ix yak'anoch jun gancho heb' t'a nok', ix snheranb'at nok' heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayik ix yilan jun nok' nun choj chi' to maj elk'och tas ayoch yipok sk'ol nok', ix yilan k'ib' junxo yune' nok'.
Haxo ix kelemax nok' yune' chi', junnhej ix ek' nok' yet' nok' mam choj chi'. Ix sk'ayb'an sb'a nok' syaman schib'ej, haxo heb' anima ix chijib'at yuj nok'.
Manhxo jantakok anima smil nok' t'a yoltak cuartel. Tzijtum niwak chonhab' syixtejb'at nok'. Tz'ib'xik'e yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik tz'el yaw nok'.
Yuj chi' ix och juntzanh nación ay t'a slak'anil chi' ajk'olal t'a nok'. Ix sb'oanem ya'al heb' t'a nok', ix yamchaj nok' yuj heb'.

Yet' k'e'en gancho ix yak'anoch nok' heb' t'a yol jaula, ix yik'anb'at heb' t'a winh sreyal Babilonia. Ix makchajkan nok' ta' yik manhxa mach tz'ab'an yel yaw nok' t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Israel. (Ha jun nok' nun choj chi', a ix snun heb' sreyal Judá sch'oxo'.)
Ha he nun chi' ex rey, lajan pax icha junok ib' te' uwa awab'il t'a stitak junok ha ha', te niwan ix aji, manhxo jantakok sat ix yak'a', tzijtum swol ix k'ib'i yujto aynhejoch yalil.

Ay juntzanh sk'ab' te', k'enal te' ix aji, a ix och sk'okochok heb' rey. Te cha'anh ix aj ste'el te' sk'ib'i, ix ek'b'at te' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo te' niwak te'. Ch'ok ix aj yel te' t'a skal juntzanhxo te te' yujto te cha'anh ste'el te', te tzijtum pax sk'ab'tak te'.

Palta ix tok'jik'eta te' uwa chi' yuj yowal sk'ol Dios. Yuj ik' ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u ix takjiel te' yet' sat. Ix jekjiel sk'ab'tak te', ix takji. Ix nhusjipaxtz'a jun sk'ab' te' k'enal te' ix aj chi'.
Haxo tiknaik, ha t'a tzinan lu'um awab'il te' nunal uwa chi'.

Ha t'a jun te' sk'ab' chi' ix elta k'ak', yuj jun k'ak' chi' ix tz'ab'at juntzanhxo sk'ab' te', ix tz'apaxb'at sat te'. Manhxalaj sk'ab' te' k'enal te' tzato yal yoch sk'okochok heb' rey, xchi jun b'it chi', xchi Jehová. (Haton jun b'it tik yik kusk'olal, yuj chi' ol b'itajok.)

Ayik lajunhe' k'uhal yoch yo'il uj, ayik yukil ab'ilxo ayonh ek' t'a Babilonia tik, ay tas ix snib'ej juntzanh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel sk'anb'ej t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ix em k'ojan heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, al t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajal: ¿Tom tzex jawi t'ayin ul he k'anb'an eyab'i? Wal yel a in wal swak' in ti' to manh ol in tak'wok t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ach anima al t'a heb' tas sya'elal heb' ol wak'a'. Scham wal ak'an yojtakejel heb' tas te yajb'entak sk'ulejnak heb' smam yicham heb'.

Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Ayik in sik'anel heb' he mam eyicham chi', wak'annak in ti' t'a heb', in ch'oxannak in b'a t'a heb' t'a Egipto. Hata' wak'nak in ti' t'a heb', walannak: Ha in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' wak' in ti' wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi', yik swik'anb'at heb' t'a jun lu'um to a in wal ix in saya', haton t'a jun lum lum te yax sat, yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh masanil lum lum.
Wal t'a heb' icha tik: Junjun ex tzeyaktejkan juntzanh he diosal te yajb'entak, manh eyixtejel he b'a yuj sdiosal heb' aj Egipto tik, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, xin chi t'a heb'.

Palta spitej sb'a heb' t'ayin. Maj yal sk'ol heb' scha yab' tas wala'. Maj satel-laj sdiosal heb' yajb'entak chi', maj yaktejpaxkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' aj Egipto chi' heb'. Yuj chi' in na wak' sya'elal heb' yet' masanil yowal in k'ol t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi'.

Palta maj in k'ulejlaj icha in na chi' yik manh chukok syal juntzanh nación b'aj kajan ek' heb' chi' t'a in patik, yuj chi' in ch'ox sniwanil welk'och t'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' ch'ok nacional chi', ayik wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi'.
Wik'anelta heb' t'a nación chi', wik'ankanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Hata' wak' in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il yojtakejel heb', tato sb'eyb'alej heb' wach'nhej tzek' heb'.
Wak'an jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip wik yaj t'a heb' yik sk'anab'ajej heb', yik tz'ochkan sch'oxnab'ilok in trato wak'kan yet' heb', yik sna'anpaxkot heb' to a in Jehová in tik in sik'kanel heb'.

Palta spitej sb'a heb' t'ayin t'a tzinan lu'um chi', maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatikejel in cheknab'il heb', haton juntzanh wak' t'a heb' yik wach'nhej tzek' heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej pax sk'uhal ik'oj ip wal t'a heb'. Yuj chi' in na in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'ol t'a tzinan lum chi'.
Palta yik max in yal juntzanh nación ilan wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' chukal, yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb'.
Hanhejtona' t'a tzinan lum chi' wak' in ti' to manh ol wak'och heb' t'a jun lum wak' in ti' wak'an t'a heb', haton jun lum te yax sat, te wach' t'a yichanh masanil lum lum,

yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatikejel in cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', haton jun k'u wik yaji. Anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ayoch spensar heb',
palta ok' in k'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb' t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Hata' wal t'a heb' yuninal heb' to max sk'ulej heb' icha sb'eyb'al smam heb' chi', max yixtejpaxel sb'a heb' yuj juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak chi'.
Walani to a in Jehová in sDiosal in heb' to sk'anab'ajej wal in cheknab'il heb' yet' in k'ayb'ub'al.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip wik yaj t'a yol sat heb'. Ha jun chi' ch'oxnab'il yaj t'a jun trato in b'o yet' heb' yik syojtakejel heb' to a in ton Jehová sDiosal in heb'.

Palta hanheja' spitejpax sb'a heb' yuninal heb' chi' t'ayin. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj in k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sb'eyb'alej pax in cheknab'il heb', haton yuj juntzanh chi' wach'nhej tzek' heb' sk'anab'ajani. Hanhejtona' yixtejel sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', haton jun k'u wik yaji. Yuj chi' in na' in satel heb' yet' yowal in k'ol t'a tzinan lum chi'.
Palta yik max in yal juntzanh nación ilan wik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' chukal, yuj chi' maj in satel-laj heb'.
Palta yakb'an aytoek' heb' t'a tzinan lum chi', wak'an in ti' to ol in saklemejb'at heb' t'a skaltak nación t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik,

yujto maj sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al heb', spatikejpaxel in cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', haton jun wik yaji. Anhej t'a juntzanh Dios yajb'entak b'aj yak'och spensar heb', haton sdiosal heb' smam yicham heb'.
Yuj chi' wak'an juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il manh wach'ok t'a heb', juntzanh max yal wach' tzek' heb' anima yuj.

Wak'an yixtejel sb'a heb' yuj silab' to a sb'ab'el yuninal heb' snhustz'a silab'il. Ha juntzanh chi' wak' sk'ulej heb' yik wach' manhxo animaok tz'aj heb' yik syojtakejel heb' to a in ton Jehová in sDiosal in heb'.

Yuj chi' ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha heb' he mam eyicham stzuntzejnak wal kot yowal in k'ol heb', in spatikannakel heb' ayik sb'oannak juntzanhxo tik heb':

Ayik toxo ix wik'och heb' t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb', yilanoch juntzanh tzalkixtak heb' yet' juntzanh te te' te k'ayum xi'il, hata' snhus silab' heb', ofrenda heb', incienso heb' sumumi sjab', stob'anpaxem wino heb' ofrendail t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj juntzanh chi' stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'.
In k'anb'an t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yaj juntzanh cha'anh b'aj tzex b'at chi'? xin chi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' Chaanh Yajk'ei, icha chi' sb'iejnakkani, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Al t'a heb' etisraelal to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha ex tik tze jub'at he b'a icha ajnak sjuanb'at sb'a heb' he mam eyicham chi'. Tze tek'b'ej wal he b'a eyoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios te yajb'entak chi'.

Slajwi he juanel he b'a yuj b'aj tze nhustz'a heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', tzex jawi pax he k'anb'ej t'ayin tas snib'ej he k'o'ol. Wal yel, a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to manh ol in tak'wok t'ayex.
Ha ex tik ix he na eyoch ejmelal t'a te te' yet' t'a k'e'en k'e'en, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo nación. Palta malaj b'ak'inh ol in cha he k'ulej juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to a in ol wak' yajalil t'a eyib'anh yet' in poder yet' pax yowal in k'o'ol.
Ol ex wik'anelta t'a juntzanh nación, ol ex in molb'an b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'at wu'uj, ol in ch'ox wal in poder yet' yowal in k'ol t'ayex,

ol ex in molb'an t'a jun tzinan lu'um t'a skal juntzanh nación. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in wal ol ex in ch'olb'itej, ol wak'anoch ya'elal t'a eyib'anh, icha ajnak wak'anoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' he mam eyicham t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Egipto.
Icha syutej winh tanhwum kalnel sik'lan nok' skalnel ayik sb'isan nok' winh, icha chi' ol ex wutej. Ol ex in sik'elta mach ex ol ex och t'a in trato ol in b'o heyet'ok.

Ha heb' te pit tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, ol wik'elta heb' b'aj sakleminak heyaj tiknaik, ol in satel heb' t'a he kal, manh ol ochlaj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' eyetisraelal. Icha wal chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.

Ex aj Israel, a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Yujto te pit tzeyutej he b'a t'ayin, yuj chi' ixikek, ochanhek ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak chi'. Palta ol k'och sk'uhal haxo t'ayin ol eyal he b'a. Manhxo ol eyixtejel sniwanil welk'ochi, yujto manhxo ol eyak' juntzanh eyofrenda t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi'.

Ha t'a jun tzalan wik yaji, haton jun witz te cha'anh t'a smakb'en Israel, hata' ol ex och ejmelal t'ayin he masanil ex israel. Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to hata' ol ex in cha yet' smasanil in k'o'ol. Hata' ol in k'an t'ayex to ol eyak' eyofrenda t'ayin yet' pax b'ab'el sat eyawb'en yet' masanil tas wiktaxon yaji.

Ayik toxo ix ex wik'elta t'a skaltak juntzanh nación yet' b'ajtak sakleminak eyajkanb'at chi' tiknaik, t'a tzalajk'olal ol ex in cha icha incienso sumumi sjab'. Ol in ch'ox wal sniwanil welk'och t'ayex t'a yichanh masanil nación.
Ayik ol ex wik'anxib'at t'a lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, haton lum Israel, hata' ol nachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in.
Hata' ol he nakot juntzanh he b'eyb'al malaj swach'il yet' jantak chukal tze k'ulej tiknaik. Ayik ol he na'ankot juntzanh he chukal chi' ol ex te k'ixwok.

Ex israel, ayik ol heyilani to max wak' eyaelal icha wal smojal yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej chi', palta to tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex yuj sniwanil welk'ochi, hata' ol eyojtakejeli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb' etisraelal chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, b'atanh k'elan t'a stojolal sur, tzalanb'at juntzanh lolonel tik t'a lum niwak yax lum ay t'a smakb'en sur chi'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ol wak'och jun k'ak' yik ol tz'ab'at masanil lum yax lu'um, haton te te' ya'ax xi'il yet' te' takinh. Masanil tas ay t'a sat lum lum chi' ol tz'ab'atok, schab'at t'a sur masanto sk'och t'a norte. Malaj mach ol yal smak'an tup jun k'ak' chi'.
Masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol ojtakanelok to a in ix wak'och jun k'ak' chi', yujto a jun k'ak' chi', manh ol tuplaj, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in tak'wi icha tik: Ay Mamin Jehová, a heb' anima syal heb' to anhej t'a k'exanh lolonelal tzin loloni, xin chi t'a Jehová chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, b'atanh k'elan t'a stojolal Jerusalén, tzalanb'at juntzanh lolonel tik t'a yib'anh juntzanh stemplo heb' komon Dios. Alkanel in lolonel tik t'a chonhab' Israel.
Tzalani: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ol in och ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol wik'k'eta wespada ol in milancham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yet' heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Ol wik'k'eta wespada, junlajan ol aj in milancham masanil anima. Ol cham heb' wach' yet' heb' chuk, ol schael yich scham heb' t'a sur masanto ol k'och t'a norte.
Masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol ojtakanelok to a in ix wik'k'eta wespada, manh ol wak'xiem t'a yol yatut, xchi Jehová.
Ach anima, sik'sik'ananh wal ok'i, yab'okab' wal sya'il a pixan, tzach ok' t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab'.

Tato sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach tas yuj tzach ok'i, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha yuj yab'ixal jun tas toxo ol ujok tzin ok'i. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manhxo animaok ol ajkan heb', toxonhej ol emkan nhojan heb'. Manhxalaj mach olto yal stek'b'an sb'a. Masanil heb' ol luklonk'e yok yuj xiwelal, xa chi t'a heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to wan sjawi stiempoal, yowalil ol elk'ochok, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, lolonanh t'a in b'i, tzalani to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ileknab' wal k'e'en espada wan sjawi. Ha k'e'en espada te jayxo yaj ye k'e'en. Toxonhej kopopi yilji k'e'en.
Jayxo yaj k'e'en yik xikjicham anima. nhikb'ilel k'e'en yik tz'el kopnaj sk'ak'al k'e'en. Manhxalaj tzalajk'olal yujto a winh he reyal max xiwlaj winh t'a ya'elal yet' t'a skachnab'il.
Kopopi ix aj k'e'en espada chi' snhikjieli yik sk'anchaji. Toxo ix ak'jioch ye k'e'en yik tz'ak'jioch k'e'en t'a yol sk'ab' jun mach ol xikancham anima yet' k'e'en, xa chi.

Ach anima, elokab' aw, yujto ol xikjokcham heb' aj Israel yet' masanil heb' yajal t'a skal heb'. Ha heb' yajal chi', junnhej ol aj scham heb' yet' heb' komon anima. Yuj chi' tanhub'tanhej snhi' a k'ol yuj kuselal.
Wal yel ol ujok jun ya'elal chi'. ¿Tas ol ex ajkan a ex tik ayik manhxalaj ol aj yelk'och winh he reyal t'a k'e'en espada chi'? Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhxalaj ol aj yelk'och winh he reyal chi'.

Ach anima, tz'it a k'ab' tzalan t'a heb' etchonhab' chi' icha tik: T'ab'jokab'nhejoch k'e'en espada t'a anima. Xikjokab'cham anima t'a k'e'en. Masanil anima scham yuj xiwelal, yujto yalnhej b'aj smilji anima yuj k'e'en.

Yuj k'e'en espada chi' ste sat sk'ol heb' anima yuj xiwelal. Ha t'a masanil chonhab' ayxoek' k'e'en wu'uj yik xikjicham anima. Toxonhej kopopi yilji k'e'en, te jay yajk'e ye k'e'en yik xikjicham anima.
Xikekcham anima t'a k'e'en espada t'a he wach' yet' t'a he k'exanh. Yalnhej b'aj chamokab' anima yuj sjayil ye k'e'en.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol in tz'it pax in k'ab', masanto ol sikb'ok yowal in k'ol t'a in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, b'o yechel chab'ok b'e b'aj ol b'at winh sreyal Babilonia yet' k'e'en espada. Ha chab' b'e chi' junnhej chonhab' b'aj ol elok, haxo b'aj spoj sb'a, ol a b'o'och chab'ok yechel ol ch'oxanok tas chonhab'il b'aj ol k'och junjun.

Tzak'och yechel junok b'e b'aj ol b'at winh rey chi' yet' k'e'en espada t'a chonhab' Rabá, t'a yol yik Amón. Tza b'oan yechel junokxo b'e chi' sk'och t'a Jerusalén, haton jun chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal t'a yol yik Judá.

Ha winh sreyal Babilonia chi', ol och wa'an winh b'aj spoj sb'a chab' b'e chi', ol sk'anb'an winh mach junok b'e chi' syik'a'. Ol skalej sjul-lab' winh, ol sk'anb'ej pax winh t'a sdiosal, ol sayan yil seyub' junok nok' nok' winh.

Ha t'a swach' k'ab' winh, hata' ol elul sjul-lab' sch'oxan t'a stojolal Jerusalén, syalelk'ochi to tz'och owal t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ol miljokcham anima ta'. Ol el aw yik owal. Ol b'ochaj mak'lab' poj puerta. Ol b'ochajk'e tek'nub' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ol oymaj heb' soldado t'a spatiktak smasanil.

Palta haxo heb' anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ol sna heb' to a jun lolonel tz'alchaj tik to manh ol ujok yuj juntzanh trato toxo ix yak' heb'. Palta a winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' ol ak'an snakot jantak schukal heb', yuj chi' ol ik'jokkot heb' t'a Babilonia tik yuj winh.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha wal he chukal yet' he pital, te chekel yaji. Masanil he mul yet' jantak chukal tze k'ulej, te jakan yaji, yuj chi' ol ex yamchajok.
Ha ach wal tik ach sreyal Israel, te chuk ach, yajb'il ach eli, lak'anxo sjawi stiempoal a cha'an slajwub' ya'elal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol ik'chajel sk'ox winh sat sacerdote, ol ik'chajpaxel scorona winh rey. Masanil ol k'exchajok. Ha heb' emnakil, ol ik'jokcha'anh heb', haxo heb' niwak yelk'ochi, emnakil ol ajkan heb'.
Ol satel smasanil. Ha in ol in satel yopisio heb' sreyal Israel. Manhxo ol yik' yip ichataxon yaji, masanto ol jawok jun mach ay yalan yik t'ay, ha t'a jun chi' ol wak' opisio chi'.

Ach anima, al t'a in b'i icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Yajal t'a heb' amonita, haton heb' sb'uchwaj t'a in chonhab': Ilek wal k'e'en espada wan sjawi, wach'xo yaj k'e'en yik smiljicham anima, toxonhej kopopi yilji k'e'en, toxonhej tz'el kopnaj sk'ak'al k'e'en icha lheb'lon yik satel anima.
Ha tas syil heb' naumel lolonel yet' juntzanh lolonel tz'alchaj t'a he patik, manh yelok. Ol och k'e'en espada t'a sjaj heb' chuk. Toxo ix jawi sk'uhal yak'ji slajwub' sya'elal heb'.
¿Am he na'ani to ol wak'xiem k'e'en espada chi' t'a yol yatut? Ma'ay, palta to ol ex in ch'olb'itej b'aj aljinak ex, haton b'aj kajan ex.
Icha wal junok k'ak' tz'eli, icha wal chi' ol aj wak'anb'at yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh. Ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima chuk spensar, haton heb' te jelan smilwaji.
Ol ex satelok, ol ex tz'ab'atok, ol tob'kanb'at he chik'il t'a masanil yol he chonhab'. Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhxa mach ol ex na'ankotok, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al jantak ya'elal ol och t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' smilancham anima. Ha yuj jantak tas yajb'entak ix sk'ulej,

al t'ay icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ex aj Jerusalén, ex tze milcham heb' kajan t'a he kal, tze b'oank'e juntzanh yechel sjuanb'at he pensar, yuj chi' a ex tzeyik'kot ya'elal t'a eyib'anh.

Yuj jantak anima ix he milchamok, ol jawok t'a eyib'anh tiknaik. Yuj juntzanh yechel ix he b'ok'ei ix ixtaxel he pensar, yuj chi' toxo ix jawi slajwub' k'uhal t'a eyib'anh. Yuj chi' a in swak' sk'ulej masanil nación tzex b'ajani, tzex sb'uchanpaxi.
Tz'el wal eyaw eyak'an chukal t'a heb' eyetanimail, yuj chi' masanil nación ol b'uchwaj t'ayex, heb' ay t'a he lak'anil yet' heb' ay t'a najat.
Ha jantak heb' yajal kajan t'a he kal chi', smilcham anima heb', yujto ay yopisio heb'.
Manhxa yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat. Tzeyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Tze tok'anek' tastak ay t'a heb' manhxa smam yet' pax t'a heb' ix ix chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum.
Manhxa yelk'och in kajnub' t'a he sat yet' sk'uhal ik'oj ip wik yaji.
Ha t'a he kal ay mach sna'ank'e lolonel t'a spatik yetanimail yik smiljichamok. Tzex b'atpax t'a k'inh tz'och t'a jolomtak witz yik tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios. Te k'ixwelal tas tze k'ulej ta'.
Ayex tzex mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum he mam, ayex tzex mulan yet' heb' ix ix ayik ayoch heb' ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Ayex tzex mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum heb' eyetanimail, ayex pax tzex mulan yet' heb' ix eyalib', ayex pax tzex mulan yet' heb' ix eyanab' yisil he mam.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ay heb' eyajalil scha'an tumin yik syak'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul. Tzeyixtej heb' eyetanimail, yujto a k'e'en he tumin tzeyak' smajnej heb', niwan yune' k'e'en tze k'aneli. Komonnhej tzeyak'och t'a yib'anh heb' eyetanimail yik tzex och b'eyumal, a inxo tik tzin b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj.
Te aykot wowal yuj b'aj tzeyixtej heb' anima chi', yuj pax b'aj tze milcham heb'.
¿Tzam he nalaj to ol yal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a wichanh ayik ol wak'an eyaelal? Ha tas toxo ix wal a in Jehová in tik, yowalil ol wak'elk'ochi.
Ol ex in saklemejb'at t'a skaltak nación yet' t'a skaltak masanil chonhab', icha wal chi' ol aj wik'anel he chukal chi'.
K'ixwelal ol eyutejkan he b'a t'a yichanh masanil nación. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in Jehová he Diosal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, a heb' etisraelal manhxalaj tz'och heb' wu'uj. Lajan wal heb' icha smikal k'e'en plata tz'eli ayik snhusji k'e'en t'a horno, syalelk'ochi haton k'e'en cobre, k'e'en estaño, k'e'en hierro yet' k'e'en plomo.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha ex tik, lajan ex icha smikal k'e'en plata chi', malaj yopisio, yuj chi' ol ex in molb'ej t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén chi'.

Icha tz'aj k'e'en plata, k'e'en cobre, k'e'en hierro, k'e'en plomo yet' k'e'en estaño, junxonhej tz'aj yak'chajb'at k'e'en t'a yol junok horno, tz'ulaxb'at k'e'en t'a skal k'ak' chi', icha wal chi' ol ex wutej yet' yowal in k'o'ol. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol wak'anoch ya'elal t'a eyib'anh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Icha wal chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a in ton Jehová in ix wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal icha tik: Ha he chonhab', manh wach'ok yaj t'a wichanh, yuj wal yowal in k'o'ol malaj jab'ok nhab' syak'a'.

Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok ayek' t'a he kal, junlajan tz'aj smilwicham anima heb'. Lajan wal heb' icha nok' choj tz'el yaw, skotak tzilchitanb'at schib'ej. Syelk'anb'at sb'eyumal yet' tastak wach' ay t'a heb' anima chi' heb'. Tzijtum heb' ix ix scham yetb'eyum t'a he kal yuj heb'.

Ha heb' sacerdote, a in k'ayb'ub'al yet' juntzanh tas wik yaji ix yixtejb'at heb'. Ha tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, malaj sk'exanhil t'a sat heb'. Max k'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj heb' yik syojtakejel heb' tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok. Hanhejtona' max sk'anab'ajej in k'uhal ik'oj ip heb'. Yuj chi' chekel to malaj welk'och t'a sat heb'.
Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab' chi', smilcham anima heb', yujto snib'ej wal heb' tz'och b'eyumal, lajan wal heb' icha nok' okes skotak tzilchitejb'at schib'ej.

Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a tas manh wach'ok sk'ub'ejel heb', icha tz'aj yoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a junok k'a pat. Syalan heb' to ay tas swak' yil heb', syalanel esal lolonel heb'. Syal heb' to a in swak' juntzanh lolonel chi' yal heb', palta wal yel malaj tas tzin chek yalel heb'.

Ha heb' anima sk'e wal cha'anh heb' yixtan yetanimail yet' elk'al. Ha wal heb' meb'a' malaj tas ay t'ay, a heb' syixtej heb'. Yelxo wal manh tojolok tas sk'ulej heb' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il kajan t'a skal heb'.
Ha in tik, ix in sayek' t'a skal he chonhab' chi', talaj ay junok mach wach'takto wal spensar, stewi t'ayin yuj schonhab' yik wach' max in sateli, palta malaj junok mach ix ilchaj wu'uj.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swak'b'at ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb', ol in satel heb' yet' in k'ak'alk'olal. Icha chi' ol aj sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, ay jun ab'ix ol wal ab'i: Ha t'a junel, ay chawanh heb' ix ix snulej sb'a, junnhej snun heb' ix.
Yiktax kob'es unin heb' ix, ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' ix ajmulal t'a Egipto. Hata' ix b'anji yim heb' ix, yuj chi' manhxo kob'estakok ix ajkan heb' ix.

Ha ix b'ab'el, Ahola sb'i ix, haton Samaria sch'oxkot ix. Haxo ix schab'il chi', Aholiba sb'i ix, haton Jerusalén sch'oxkot ix. Ha in ix wak'och heb' ix wetb'eyumok, ix aj wuninal yet' wisil yet' heb' ix.
Te chuk ix yutej sb'a ix Ahola chi', ix mulan ix t'a yol in k'ab' yet' heb' aj Asiria b'aj te ay snib'ej ix, haton heb' soldado
ayoch k'apak ya'ax pichul yuj. Masanil heb' yajal, heb' capitán, heb' kelemtak te wach' yilji, masanil heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix mulan yet' ix.
Ha yet' heb' te wach' yilji t'a skal heb' aj Asiria chi' ix mulan ix Ahola chi'. Ix yak'anpaxb'at spensar ix t'a sdiosal heb', ix och ix ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'.

Atax yik ayek' ix t'a Egipto chi' ix ochkan ix ajmulal, maxtzak yaktejlaj ix. Yixtax skob'esal ix tzijtum mach ix mulan yet' ix, ix laj b'anji yim ix yuj heb'. Manhxo kob'esoklaj ix ajkan ix, palta to ix ochkan ix ajmul ixal.
Yuj chi' ix wak'och ix t'a yol sk'ab' heb' b'aj ay snib'ej chi', haton heb' aj Asiria, heb' ix snib'ejb'at ix.

Haxo ix aji, ix el b'eran ix yuj heb', ix ik'jiek' heb' yune' ix yuj heb', ix xikjicham ix yuj heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yak'anoch ya'elal heb' t'a yib'anh ix. Ha tas ix utaj ix chi', te niwan ix aj sb'inaj t'a skal heb' ix ix.
Haxo pax ix Aholiba, snulej ix chi', ix yil wal juntzanh chi' ix, palta ix ek' ix t'a yib'anh yak'anoch sb'a ajmulal t'a yichanh ix Ahola chi'.
Ix yak'anpaxoch sb'a ix t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Asiria chi', haton t'a masanil heb' yajal, heb' soldado te wach' yilji spichul ayochi, heb' kelemtak te wach' yilji ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej.
Ix wilani to ix yixtejpaxb'at sb'a ix yet' heb' chi', lajan ix yutej sb'a ix icha wal ix yutej sb'a ix snulej chi'.
Palta yelxo wal ix ek' ix t'a yib'anh sk'ulan ajmulal chi'. Ix yilan juntzanh yechel ix tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a sattak pat, haton yechel heb' caldeo chakchak yilji spichul,
ayoch stzek'ul snanhal heb', aypaxoch k'apak stzek'ul sjolom heb' tzijtum yelaw, icha wal to yajalil soldado heb', aj Caldea heb'.
Ayik ix yilanoch juntzanh yechel heb' aj Babilonia chi' ix, ix ste nib'ejoch ix, yuj chi' ix yak'b'at schekab' ix t'a Babilonia chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi heb' aj Babilonia chi', ix ul mulan heb' yet' ix. Tzijtum tas ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' ix, masanto ix yajjik'e heb' yuj ix.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'anoch sb'a ix ajmulal t'a yichanh chonhab'. Ix sch'oxanel b'eran sniwanil ix, masanto ix in yajel ix, icha ix in k'ulej yet' ix snulej ix.
Palta yelk'olal ix och ix ajmulal chi'. Ix sna'ankot skob'esal ix t'a peka', ayik smulannak ix t'a Egipto,
yiktax yak'annakoch sb'a ix t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ste nib'ej wal sb'a ix yet'ok, haton juntzanh winak lajan syutej sb'a icha nok' b'uru ma nok' chej t'a junok nok' nun chej.
Ha ach wal tik ach Aholiba, tza nakot ajmulal a k'ulejnak ayik kob'es achto, ayik sb'anannak im heb' aj Egipto, tza nib'ej tza k'ulejxi icha chi'.
Yuj chi' a in Dios Yajal in swal icha tik: Ha juntzanh heb' ix a nib'ej chi', haton heb' yajb'ilxo u'uj tiknaik, a in ol wak'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayach, yalxonhej b'aj ol kot heb',

haton heb' aj Babilonia yet' heb' aj Caldea, heb' aj Pecod, heb' aj Soa yet' heb' aj Coa yet' masanil heb' aj Asiria. Masanil juntzanh kelemtak te wach' yilji, heb' yajal yet' heb' niwak yopisio yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej.

Ol kot heb' chi' t'ayach yet' jantak carruaje yet' heb' soldado. Toxonhej ol oymaj heb' t'a a patik, yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal yet' sk'en xumpil, yet'nak pax smaklab' jul-lab' heb'. Ha in ol wak' yopisio heb' yik syak'an a ya'elal, icha yalan sley heb'.

Yet' wal in k'ak'alk'olal ol wak'b'at yowal in k'ol t'a ib'anh. Ha heb' chi' ol ach ixtan sik'lab'il. Ol spolel a nhi' heb' yet' a chikin. Ha heb' ol kanok, ol xikjokcham heb' t'a k'e'en espada. Ol ik'jokek' heb' une', heb' winak unin yet' heb' ix. Haxo t'a slajwub'al, ol nhuschajtz'a heb' olto kanok.
Ol yik'el a pichul heb' yet' pax masanil k'e'en k'e'en ayoch elwanub'ok.
Icha wal chi' ol aj slajwikank'och ajmulal a k'ulejnak t'a Egipto chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol a nib'ejxib'at juntzanh chi'. Manhxo pax ol a nakot Egipto chi'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik swal a in Jehová Yajal in tik: Ha in ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación tza chakeli, haton juntzanh yajb'il u'uj.
Ol yak' wal chukal heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' chi' ol ikankan tas ix ik' t'a a munlajel, toxonhej ol ach elkan b'eran yuj heb'. Ol cheklaj juntzanh schukal a niwanil b'aj ix a k'ulej ajmulal chi'.
Icha chi' ol aj sjawi t'a ib'anh, yujto ix ach tzalaj a k'ulan ajmulal yet' juntzanh nación chi', a na ix ach och pax ejmelal t'a juntzanh sdiosal heb'.

Yujto icha sb'eyb'al ix a nulej chi' ix a b'eyb'alej, yuj chi' a ya'elal ix wak'och t'a yib'anh ix, a ol wak'paxoch t'a ib'anh a ach tik, icha wal to lajan tas ayem t'a yol junok niwan waso swak' eyuk'ej.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha tas ix yuk' ix a nulej chi', ha' ol uk'paxi. Ha jun waso te niwan yo'ol, a ol uk'lab'ej. Masanil nación ol ach b'uchanok, ol ach stzetzan pax yuj jun niwan waso tzuk'lab'ej chi'.
Ol oyb'ok a sat yuj tas ay t'a yol waso chi', ol ach kuspaxk'e yuj. Ol ach xiw wal k'e'i yujto chuk tas ol yik'kot t'a ib'anh. Haton jun waso chi' ix yuk'lab'ej ix a nulej ix Samaria.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol uk'lab'ej jun waso chi', manhxa tas ol kan t'a yo'ol. Ol lajwok chi' ol a mak'anpojok, haxo yet' spojelal chi' ol a jotz' lajwok im.
Yujto ix in b'atkan satk'olal u'uj, ix ach el mikan t'ayin, yuj chi' yowalil ol ab' wal sya'il yuj ajmulal chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, alel jantak ya'elal ol jawok t'a yib'anh ix Ahola yet' t'a yib'anh ix Aholiba chi'. Wach' tzutej alanoch t'a sat heb' ix jantak tas yajb'entak ix sk'ulej heb' ix.

Ha heb' ix chi', ix mulan heb' ix t'a yol in k'ab', chik'tak sk'ab' heb' ix yuj b'aj smilcham yune'. Ix in yaktejkan heb' ix, haxo t'a komon Dios ix och heb' ix ejmelal. Ix snhusantz'a yune' heb' ix silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', haton juntzanh wuninal ix wil sat yet' heb' ix.
Hanhejtona' ix sk'ulej pax juntzanh tik heb' ix: Ha in templo yet' sk'uhal ik'oj ip wik yaji, junnhej k'uhal ix aj yixtanb'at heb' ix.

Haton t'a jun k'uhal ayik ix snhusantz'a wuninal heb' ix silab'il yik syik'ancha'anh sdiosal heb' ix chi'. Ix jawi pax heb' ix ul yixtejb'at in templo, haton wal juntzanh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej heb' ix t'a yol in pat.

Ix yak'b'at schekab' heb' ix yik tz'awtaj heb' winh winak kajan t'a najat. Haxo ix Aholiba ix sb'ik sb'a ix, ix yak'an uk' sat ix, ix yak'anpaxoch k'e'en k'e'en ix t'ay yelwanub'ok, yik schaji sjawi heb' winh chi' yuj ix.
Ix em k'ojan ix t'a jun ch'at manhxo jantak swach'il yilji, wach'xo pax yajem wa'el t'a sat mexa. Ix yak'anpaxem incienso ix yet' aceite to wik yaj t'a sat mexa chi'.

Toxonhej snhilnhilan juntzanh komon anima yik syak'anoch k'inh heb' yet' ix, haton juntzanh uk'um anh skot t'a tzinan lu'um, ix yak'anoch yelwanub' heb' t'a ix, ix yak'och k'e'en brazalete heb' t'a sk'ab' ix, ix yak'anpaxk'e corona heb' manhxo jantak swach'il t'a sjolom ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in na'an t'a yib'anh heb' ix manhxalaj swach'il yuj yajmulal chi': Sk'ulejokab' ajmulal chi' heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix yujto ichanhej chi' sk'ulej heb' ix.
Ix jawi heb' winh, ix way heb' winh yet' heb' ix chukal ix chi', haton ix Ahola yet' ix Aholiba, icha wal tz'aj sway heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ajmul ix.
Palta a heb' winh winak wach' sb'eyb'al, a heb' winh ol ak'anoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' ix, icha wal smojalil yajmulal heb' ix, yuj pax b'aj smilcham anima heb' ix.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala': Smolokab' sb'a masanil nación t'a spatik heb' ix chi' yik tz'ak'jioch heb' ix t'a niwan xiwk'olal, yik tz'elk'ajpaxb'at tastak ay t'a heb' ix.
Masanil nación chi' ol julk'enancham heb' ix, ol xikjokpaxcham heb' ix t'a k'e'en espada. Ol mak'jokcham swinak unin heb' ix yet' yix unin heb' ix, ol nhusjokpaxtz'a spat heb' ix.
Icha chi' ol aj wak'an satel jun b'eyb'al chi' t'a smakb'en Israel. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel yuj masanil heb' ix ix to max yal-laj sb'eyb'alan ajmulal heb' ix.

Ha chawanh heb' ix chi', ol wak' sya'elal heb' ix yuj yajmulal, yuj pax smul heb' ix b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel yuj heb' ix to a in ton Dios Yajal in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal yik slajunhil uj, ayik sb'alunhilxo ab'il kik'jikot t'a Babilonia tik, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ach anima, tz'ib'ejkani tas k'uhal yet' jantak yoch uj tiknaik, yujto ha t'a jun k'uhal tik ix och winh sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a Jerusalén.

Alkanel jun ab'ix tik t'a ch'oxnab'ilal t'a jun chonhab' te pit chi'. Tzalan icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ak'jokab'k'e junok k'e'en chen t'a yib'anh k'ak', ak'jokab'paxem ha ha' t'a yo'ol.
Ak'jokab'em nok' chib'ej t'a yo'ol, haton nok' nib'ab'il, k'olkixtak tz'aj nok'. Aokab' nok' xub' yet' nok' sb'ak'chil yich spatik tz'emi yet' pax nok' sb'akil te wach'.
Ik'jokab'b'at junok nok' kalnel te wach', niwanokab' k'atzitz tz'ak'chajoch t'a yalanh jun chen chi' yik wach' xej sik'lab'il, masanto stajib'at nok' b'ak chi'.

Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ob'iltak jun chonhab' milumcham anima. Lajan icha junok chen k'ustakxo. Ha sk'ustakil chi' maxtzak el-laj. T'a junjunal tz'aj ik'ank'eta nok' chib'ej chi', manh a sik'lejlaj nok'.

B'ut'jinakxoel jun chonhab' chi' yuj schik'il heb' anima smiljicham t'ay. Manhok t'a sat lum tz'em chik' chi' yik smukchaj yuj lum pokok, palta to t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en malaj tas ay t'a yib'anh, hata' stob'emi.
Ol kannhej schik'il heb' anima chi' t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en chi' wu'uj yik chekelnhej yaji, yuj chi' ol kot yowal in k'o'ol, ol wak'an spak icha t'a smojal.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ob'iltak wal jun chonhab' te milumcham anima chi'. Ichato ol wak'och jun niwan k'ak' t'a yalanh.
Kotokab' niwanok te' k'atzitz, ochokab' sk'ak'al te'. Icha chi' tz'aj staji nok' chib'ej chi', masanto ol yal stupxej masanil ya'al, yik stz'ab'at nok' b'ak ayem t'a yol chen chi'.
Kanokab' jun k'e'en chen malaj tas ayem t'a yo'ol t'a yib'anh k'ak' chi', masanto schakb'iel stz'ai. Icha chi' ol aj sakb'i yel smiktakil, masanto tz'el sk'ustakil chi'.
Nab'anhej ix in k'unb'i wik'anel sk'ustakil jun chen chi', palta maj el-laj, wach'chom t'a te' k'ak', palta max el-laj.

Ha jun sk'ustakil chi' sch'oxanel yajmulal chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix wak' wip in b'ikanel schukal chi', palta manh jab'ok ix eli. Ha tiknaik, manhxa tas syal yik'aneli, masanto ol lajwok wak'anb'at yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh, ichato chi' ol sakb'okkanelok.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Toxo ix jawi stiempoal wak'anoch sya'elal, manhxo ol in yamoch wa'an in b'a. Manhxalaj wok'elk'olal, manh ol in na in b'a. Ha in swala' to ol wak' wal och sya'elal icha wal smojalil yuj sb'eyb'al, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ach anima, a ix etb'eyum te xajanab'il u'uj, elanhchamel ol cham ix, a in ol wik'ek' sk'inal ix chi'. Palta manh ol a ch'oxel-laj a kusk'olal yuj ix, manh ol ach ok'paxlaj.

T'a elk'altak ol ab' sya'il, palta manh ol a ch'oxel-laj a kusk'olal chi' icha sk'ulej juntzanhxo anima. Aynhejk'e smusil a jolom, aynhejoch a xanhab' ol ach ek'ok. Manh ol a musej a sat yuj a ch'oxanel a kusk'olal, manh ol a wa wa'el swaji ayik ay chamel, xchi t'ayin.
Ha t'a k'inhib'alil ix in lolon yet' heb' anima, haxo t'a yemk'uhalil ix cham ix wetb'eyum. Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil ix in k'ulan icha ix yal Jehová t'ayin.
Haxo masanil heb' anima t'a chonhab' tik ix halan t'ayin: Al t'ayonh tas syalelk'och juntzanh tas tza k'ulej chi', xchi heb' t'ayin.
Ix walan t'a heb' to a Jehová ix lolon t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
