Ha scorredoral k'elk'umb'a yaj yet' jun b'ab'el amak'. Ayoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak t'a junjun spak'ul. Ha t'a jun puerta chi' ay wajxake' b'akhkiltak sk'ek'och t'ay.
Ay jun cuarto junnhej yaj yet' jun corredor chi' t'a junjun puerta. Hata' sb'ikchaj nok' nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il.

Ha t'a corredor t'a sti' puerta chi', ay chanhe' mexa k'e'en latz'b'ilk'ei, chab'chab' t'a junjun pak'anh. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh mexa chi', hata' smiljicham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il, nok' silab' yik tz'ak'ji tup mul yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji stojolok mul.
Ha t'a spatikel corredor t'a puerta t'a stojolal norte chi', ay chab' k'e'en k'e'en icha mexa t'a junjun pak'anh,
syalelk'ochi, ay chanhe' juntzanh k'e'en chi' t'a yo'ol yet' chanhe' t'a spatikel jun corredor chi'. Ay wajxake' mexa chi' t'a smasanil, haton t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi' smiljicham nok' silab'.

Ha chanhe' mexa b'aj smiljicham nok' nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il, a k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il ayoch t'ay. 75 centímetro sat schanhil pak'anh, 50 centímetro scha'anhil ste'el junjun. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi', hata' tz'ak'jik'e yamk'ab' sk'anchaji ayik smiljicham nok' silab' chi'.

Ha t'a yol jun corredor chi', ay juntzanh k'e'en gancho lokjab'k'e t'a junjun pak'anh, 25 centímetro ste'el junjun k'e'en. Masanil nok' chib'ej tz'ak'ji silab'il, tz'ak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh juntzanh k'e'en mexa chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch winh t'a schab'il amak'. Hata' ay chab' cuarto k'elanelta t'a stojolal b'ab'el amak'. Ay jun t'a slak'anil puerta t'a norte, k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur. Haxo pax junxo, ha t'a slak'anil puerta t'a stojolal sur ay, k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun cuarto k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur chi', a heb' winh sacerdote smunlaj t'a templo ay yiko'.

Haxo jun cuarto k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, yik heb' winh sacerdote smunlaj t'a altar b'aj snhusji nok' silab'. Masanil heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, anhej heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Leví syal yak'an serwil t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan jun schab'il amak' winh. Lajannhej yechel schanhil pak'anh, 50 metro yaji. Haxo altar b'aj snhusji silab', ha t'a yichanh templo ayek'i.

Ix in yik'b'at jun winh winak chi' t'a scorredoral templo, ix yechtan spatiktak jun corredor chi' winh, nanhal yoxil metro spimal. Haxo spuertail, uke' metro sat. Ha sattak ay t'a sti' puerta chi', nanhal schab'il metro ayelta t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ha jun corredor chi', lajunhe' metro slewanil, wake' metro yo'ol. B'achkiltak sk'e'i. Ay chab' k'e'en niwak oy t'a sti' spuertail, junjun t'a junjun pak'anh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch jun winh winak chi' t'a yol jun b'ab'el cuarto yik templo, ix yechtan stitak spuertail chi' winh, oxe' metro spimal junjun.

Haxo spuertail, oye' metro sat. Haxo sattak ay t'a sti' puerta chi', nanhal yoxil metro ayelta t'a junjun pak'anh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yechtan pax jun b'ab'el cuarto chi' winh, 20 metro ste'el, 10 metro slewanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yechtan junxo cuarto winh t'a yichochi. Ix yechtan sattak sti' spuertail winh, jun metro spimal. Haxo puerta chi', oxe' metro sat, haxo sattak t'a junjun pak'anh sti' puerta chi', nanhal schanhil metro ayelta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan jun cuarto chi' winh, 10 metro sat schanhil pak'anh. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun cuarto tik, Yiknhej Dios Yaji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan spimal spatiktak jun templo chi' winh, oxe' metro spimal. Ha t'a spatiktak templo chi', ay juntzanh cuarto, chab' metro yaj yich junjun, junnhej yaj yet' templo chi'.

Ha juntzanh cuarto chi', ayk'e jun t'a yib'anh junxo, oxe' piso yaji, haxo t'a junjun piso, ay 30 cuarto. Haxo t'a sattak templo chi' lotzanoch junjun piso. Ha t'a yib'anh juntzanh chi', hata' tz'och spatzab'il junjun cuarto, yuj chi' max ochlaj t'a yo'ol.

Ha juntzanh cuarto ay t'a schab'il piso ayoch t'a spatiktak templo chi', lewan yol t'a yichanh juntzanh ay t'a b'ab'el piso. Haxo juntzanhxo t'a yoxil piso, niwan yol t'a yichanh juntzanh t'a schab'il piso chi'. Ay jun k'o'och b'e sk'e t'a b'ab'el piso, sk'e t'a schab'il, masanto sk'ek'och t'a yoxil piso.

Ix wilani to a templo b'ob'ilk'e t'a yib'anh jun yich, oxe' metro scha'anhil yajk'e jun yich chi'. Hanheja' jun chi' ayoch yichok juntzanh cuarto ay t'a spatiktak templo chi'. Haxo jun yich chi' nanhal yoxil metro b'echanel t'a spatikel juntzanh cuarto chi'. Ay junxo amak' ayoch t'a spatiktak yich templo chi' yet' t'a skal juntzanh scuarto heb' sacerdote, 10 metro sat. Ay spuertail juntzanh cuarto t'a spatiktak templo chi', tz'elul t'a amak' ay t'a spatiktak chi'. Ay jun puerta t'a stojolal norte, ay pax junxo t'a stojolal sur.
Ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a stojolal jun amak' t'a spatiktak templo chi', ay jun niwan cuarto 35 metro sat, 45 metro sk'atul yo'ol. Ha yichtak, nanhal yoxil metro spimal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan sk'atul templo chi' winh. Ha sk'atul chi' 50 metro. Haxo jun amak' t'a spatik templo chi' masanto t'a jun cuarto t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' pax spimal yichtak, 50 metro t'a smasanil.
Ha t'a sat jun templo chi' yet' yamak'il sti' ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 50 metro pax jun chi' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtan sk'atul jun niwan cuarto winh, jun ay t'a spatik templo k'elankot t'a amak' yet' yichtak, 50 metro smasanil. Ha chab' cuarto t'a yol templo yet' scorredoral k'elanb'at t'a amak',

ayoch te' chemte' t'a spatiktak. Ay swentenail yoxil, kotak swentenail chi'. Sb'atnhej te' chemte' t'a ti' puerta masanto t'a yo'ol, aynhejoch te' t'a sat yichtak smasanil. Sb'atnhej te' t'a spisoal, sk'ek'och te' t'a swentenail chi'. Ha juntzanh swentenail chi' ay smakul t'a spatikeli, xayayi yajochi.
Aypaxoch te' chemte' t'a yichtak t'a yol b'ab'el cuarto t'a yib'anh puerta tz'och t'a yol schab'il cuarto.

Majnakel sattak te' chemte' chi' yuj yechel heb' querubín yet' pax yechel te' palma. Jun yechel te' palma chi', jun yechel querubín chi', ichanhej chi' yajoch smasanil. Chab'chab' sat junjun querubín chi'.

Ha jun sat, lajan yilji icha sat anima, k'elanoch t'a yechel te' palma chi'. Haxo junxo, lajan icha yilji sat nok' choj, k'elanpaxoch t'a junxo yechel te' palma chi'. Ichanhej chi' yajoch t'a yol templo chi'.
Sb'atnhej juntzanh yechel t'a piso masanto t'a jolom puerta.
Ha yoyal spuertail jun b'ab'el cuarto chi', lajan yaj te' schab'il, chanh tzalanh yaj te'. Ha t'a yichanh jun cuarto yiknhej Jehová yaji, ay jun tas lajan wal yilji

icha junok altar nab'a te', jun metro schanhil pak'anh, nanhal schab'il metro yajk'e scha'anhil. Ha schikintak, pax yich yet' spatiktak, nab'a te'. Ix yalan jun winh chi' t'ayin: Haton jun mexa tik ayoch t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
Ha spuertail b'ab'el cuarto yet' spuertail jun cuarto yiknhej Dios yaji, chab' jenhan yaji.
Haxo junjun jenhan chi', chab'chab' makan yaji, ayoch swisagreal t'a snanhal.

Ha t'a sattak spuertail jun b'ab'el cuarto chi', ayoch yechel querubín yet' yechel te' palma. Lajan yilji yet' juntzanh ayoch t'a sattak yichtak chi'. Ha t'a yichanhelta spuertail scorredoral ayk'e spatil nab'a te'.

Ha t'a junjun pak'anh scorredoral chi', ay swentenail kotak sat. Aypaxoch yechel te' palma t'a sattak yichtak chi'. Ha swentenail juntzanh kotak cuarto oyanoch t'a spatik templo chi', ayoch smakul t'a spatik, xayayi yajochi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a amak' t'a spatiktak templo t'a stojolal norte. Ix in yik'anoch winh t'a yol chab' pat t'a spatikel amak' chi' yet' t'a stojolal norte t'a jun niwan cuarto t'a spatik templo chi'.
Ha chab' pat t'a stojolal norte chi', 50 metro sk'atul, 25 metro sat.

Ha jun pat skan t'a sti' jun amak' ay t'a spatiktak templo chi', 10 metro sat. Haxo junxo pat, ha t'a stojolal b'aj latz'b'ilem k'e'en k'e'en t'a b'ab'el amak' skani. Oxe' piso yaj junjun pat chi'. Junjun piso sk'e'i, yunenhej yo'ol t'a yichanh jun ay t'a yalanh.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh pat chi', ay jun calle, oye' metro sat, 50 metro ste'el, tz'ochnhejk'och t'a yolochi. Ha spuertail juntzanh cuarto chi', ha t'a stojolal norte ayochi.
Ha juntzanh cuarto t'a yoxil piso, yunenhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo t'a schab'il piso ay t'a yalanh, yujto ay scorredoral, yuj chi' yunexonhej yo'ol.

Oxe' piso yaj juntzanh pat chi', palta malaj yoyal icha yoyal juntzanh cuarto ay t'a spatiktak jun b'ab'el amak', yuj chi' a jun piso t'a yib'anh, yunenhej yol t'a yichanh jun ay t'a snanhal, haxo jun snanhal chi' yunenhej t'a yichanh jun ay t'a yalanh.
Ha jun pat ayoch t'a sti' jun b'ab'el amak' chi', tzek' t'a yichanh junxo pat, 25 metro sk'atul, junnhej sb'at k'atan yet' smuroal stitak b'ab'el amak'.
Yujto a jun pat ay t'a stz'ey b'ab'el amak' chi', 25 metronhej sk'atul, haxo pax junxo pat ay t'a spatik templo chi', 50 metro sk'atul.
Ha juntzanh cuarto t'a b'ab'el piso, ay spuertail yik tzonh el t'a b'ab'el amak', t'a jun pak'anh ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u,
b'aj tz'elul jun muro t'a sti' amak' chi'. Haxo t'a stojolal sur, t'a sti' jun amak' t'a spatiktak templo yet' jun niwan cuarto, hata' ay pax chab'xo pat.
Lajannhej yaj yechel yet' sb'onab'il, icha chab' pat t'a stojolal norte. Lajannhej yaj b'aj tzonh ochi yet' b'aj tzonh eli yet' jun scalleal t'a skal chab' pat chi'.
Ha tzonh och t'a juntzanh cuarto t'a stojolal sur, ay jun puerta b'aj schael yich jun scalleal chi' b'aj tz'elul jun smuroal yich, haton jun muro chi' smakan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Ix yalan jun winh chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun pat t'a stojolal norte yet' jun ay t'a stojolal sur, haton juntzanh ay t'a stitak amak' t'a spatiktak templo, anhej heb' winh sacerdote ay yiko'. Hata' schi nok' silab' heb' winh to anhej Jehová ay yiko', yujto a heb' winh tz'ak'an serwil Jehová. Hata' syak'paxoch heb' winh juntzanh tas to yik Jehová yaji, haton ixim trigo tz'ak'ji ofrendail, ixim tz'ak'ji yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji yuj stojolok mul. Ha juntzanh cuarto b'aj tz'ak'ji juntzanh ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.

Tato tz'och heb' winh sacerdote t'a yol templo chi', max yal-laj yel heb' winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak' ayik manto sk'exel spichul heb' winh syak'ochi ayik tz'och heb' winh munlajel t'a yol templo chi'. Yujto a spichul heb' winh chi', niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' max yal-laj yel heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima yet'ok. Yowalil ch'ok spichul heb' winh syak'ochi ayik tz'el heb' winh, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ayik ix lajwi yechtan yol templo chi' winh, ix in yik'anelta winh t'a jun puerta ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ixlajwi chi' ix och ijan winh yechtan lum spatiktakel templo chi'.
Ha jun te' aj yet'nak winh, a te' ix yak'lab'ej winh yechtani. Ha jun pak'anh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 250 metro yok.
Ix yechtan pax junxo pak'anh winh t'a stojolal norte. Ha jun chi' hanheja' 250 metro yok.
Haxo pax jun pak'anhxo t'a stojolal sur, hanheja' 250 metro yok.
Haxo jun slajwub' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, hanheja' 250 metro yok.

Ix yechtejnhej winh schanhil pak'anh. Ha smuroal ayoch t'a spatiktak slumal templo chi', 250 metro junjun pak'anh. Ha jun muro chi' smakankan jun lugar yik Dios yaj chi', haxo spatikel muro chi', komon yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anxib'at winh t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ix wilan stzikikial Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u chi'. Te cha'anh sk'anhi, icha sk'anh yem ha' niwak pajaw. Kopopi ix aj yilji sat lu'um yuj.
Ha tas ix wil chi', lajan wal icha jun ix wila'' ayik ix jawi Jehová ul yak'an satel Jerusalén, lajan pax icha jun ix wil t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lum yuj.
Ha stzikikial Jehová chi', ix och t'a yol templo t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Yuj chi' ix wab'i to a Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'ank'e wa'an, ix in yik'anoch t'a jun schab'il amak', ix wilani, b'ut'jinakel yol templo chi' yuj stzikikial Jehová chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'ani, hato t'a yol templo chi' ay jun mach ix lolonelta t'ayin. Haxo jun winh winak chi' linhanoch winh t'a in tz'ey.

Ix yalan icha tik: Ach anima, haton jun lugar tik b'aj ay in despacho, b'aj ol wak' reyal. Ha tik ol in kajnaj t'a junelnhej t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik. Ha ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, manhxo ol in he patikejel-laj yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a komon Dios yet' he mukan heb' he reyal t'a slak'anil in templo tik, icha he k'ulejnak t'a pekataxo.

Ha pekatax chi' sb'onakk'e spalacio heb' t'a stz'ey in templo. Junnhej muro aykan t'a skal spuertail in templo yet' spuertail spalacio heb' chi'. Ix in alji chukal yuj schukal sb'eyb'al heb' yajb'entak t'a yol in sat. Yuj chi' ix kot wowal t'a heb', ix in satanel heb'.
Haxo tiknaik yaktejokab' heb' yoch ejmelal t'a skomon diosal, syaktanpax heb' smukan heb' sreyal t'a in tz'ey, yik ol in kajnaj t'a skal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik ach anima, al t'a heb' etisraelal chajtil yaj templo ix ila', yik wach' scham yilan heb', yik sk'ixwi heb' yuj schukal.

Tato ol k'ixwok heb' yuj tas sk'ulej chi', tzalan t'a heb' chajtil yaj in templo yet' tastak ay t'a yo'ol, chajtil yaj spuertail. Syalelk'ochi, chajtil yaj templo chi' smasanil, tas yaj pax juntzanh scheknab'ilal yowalil sk'anab'ajaji. Tz'ib'ej yechel masanil juntzanh chi', yik wach' ol nachajel yuj heb' sik'lab'il yik ol sb'o heb' icha yaj chi'. Tza tz'ib'anpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il yik sk'anab'ajej heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik cheknab'il yuj in templo: Masanil lum tzalan t'a spatiktak templo chi', junelnhej to wik yaj lu'um, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ha juntzanh echlab' ix k'anchaj t'a templo, ha' ix k'anchaj pax t'a yechel jun altar t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Haton yechel jun altar chi': Ha cimientoal yich, nanhal metro ayem t'a yol lum, nanhal pax metro yajel t'a spatik yichanh. Haxo t'a sti' jun ayel chi' ay jab'xo tzalank'e t'a stitak, 25 centímetro yajk'ei.

Ha jantak yajk'e jun b'ab'el b'akhanh skot t'a yich, jun metro yajk'ei, nanhal metro yajel t'a spatik b'aj sb'at junxo b'akhanh. Haxo jun schab'il b'akhanh chi', chab' metro yajk'ei, nanhal metro yajel t'a spatik b'aj sb'at junxo b'akhanh. Haxo jun yoxil b'akhanh chi' hanheja' chab' metro yajk'ei,
haton ta' snhusjitz'a silab'. Ha jun chi', chab' metro yajk'e scha'anhil. Ay schikintak t'a junjun yesquinail, cha'anh yajk'e t'a yib'anh b'aj stz'a silab' chi'.
Ha jun chi' wake' metro junjun pak'anh.
Haxo schab'il b'akhanh, uke' metro junjun pak'anh. Haxo t'a stitak, ay jab'xo tzalank'ei, 25 centímetro yajk'ei. Haxo sk'o'ochal sk'ek'och t'a altar chi', ha t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u skani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun winh winak chi' t'ayin: Ach anima, a Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ayik b'ob'ilxo jun altar chi', yowalil sk'anab'ajaj juntzanh cheknab'il tik: Snhusjitz'a junok nok' nok' silab'il t'a yib'anh, stzikchajoch schik'il nok' t'ay.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a heb' sacerdote levita yinhtilal Sadoc, haton heb' tz'och t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil, syak'an junok nok' kelem wakax heb' silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul.

Slajwi chi', syik'ank'e jab'ok schik'il nok' heb', stzikanoch heb' t'a schikintak altar chi' schanhil yet' t'a schikintak yik schab'il b'akhanh yich yet' t'a spatiktak yich altar chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikan jun altar chi' yik tz'ochkan wikok.
Slajwi chi' syik'anel nok' wakax chi' heb', nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il chi', snhusantz'a nok' heb' t'a spatikel templo t'a jun lugar chekel yaji.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, snhusantz'a junok nok' chiwa heb', junok nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan jun altar chi' heb' sacerdote chi', icha syutej heb' yet' nok' wakax.
Ayik slajwi juntzanh chi', syik'ankot junok nok' kelem wakax heb' yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' schawanhil.
Icha chi' tz'aj yik'ankot nok' heb' t'ayin. Syak'anoch yatz'amil nok' heb', snhusantz'a nok' heb' yuj in yik'ancha'anh.

Uke' k'uhal snhustz'a nok' silab' chi' heb', syak'anpax junok nok' chiwa heb' silab'il, junok nok' kelem wakax yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel yuj yak'ji tup mul. Malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' yoxwanhil.
Ichanhej chi' sk'ulej heb' t'a uke' k'uhal chi', yuj sakb'itan jun altar chi' heb' yik tz'ochkan wikok.

Haxo slajwi yukil k'uhal chi', haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal yet' sb'eynhejb'ati, syak'nhej nok' silab' chi' heb', nok' stz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ichato chi' a in Jehová in swala' to tzex in cha t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix in yik'xib'at winh t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix wilani, makan jun puerta chi'.
Hata' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha jun puerta tik, ol kannhej makan, malaj b'ak'inh ol jakchajok. Malaj mach ol yal yoch t'ay, yujto ha t'a jun tik ix in och a in sDiosal in Israel tik.

Anhej winh yajalil chonhab' syal sk'och wa'el ta' yik schi'an nok' silab' winh t'a wichanh. Ha t'a corredor tz'och winh, tz'ochk'och winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak', hanheja' hata' stz'elxita winh, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anb'at jun winh winak chi' t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte t'a yichanh templo. Ix wilani ix b'ut'jiel yol templo chi' yuj stzikikial Jehová. Ayik ix wilan jun chi' ix in em lachnaj t'a sat lu'um.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, scham wal hilani, schampax ab'an sleyal jun templo tik. Scham wal hilani mach heb' syal yoch t'a yol templo tik, mach pax heb' max yal yochi.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal chi' to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ex in chonhab' Israel, te pit ex, aktejek he b'eyb'alan tas yajb'entak.

Ha ex tik ix eyixtejb'at in templo. Komonxonhej ix he chaoch heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yo'ol, haton juntzanh anima malaj yechel in trato t'a spensar yet' t'a sniwanil. Ix eyixtejb'at eyak'an silab' t'ayin, haton xepu'al nok' silab' yet' schik'il nok', palta max he k'anab'ajej in trato, haxo tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej.
Maj he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yuj tas wik yaji, palta to ix eyaktejkan eyopisio chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Manhxa b'ak'inh ol och junok anima ch'ok chonhab'il t'a in templo, haton heb' kajan t'a he kal, heb' manh ayokoch yechel in trato t'a spensar yet' t'a sniwanil.
Ha heb' levita ix in aktankani ayik in yaktankan masanil heb' yetisraelal heb', yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ol scha spak heb' yuj schukal chi'.

Syal smunlaj heb' yik stanhwej spuertail in templo yet' t'a junokxo munlajel t'a in templo chi'. Syal smilancham nok' silab' heb', haton nok' snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin yet' juntzanhxo nok' silab' syak' heb' chonhab'. Yowalil b'ekan sk'ol heb' yak'an serwil heb' yetchonhab' chi'.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo yak'nak serwil heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Icha chi' ix aj skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'a chukal. Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swak' in ti' to ol scha spak heb' yuj smul chi'.

Max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil t'a sacerdoteal, max yalpaxlaj syaman juntzanh tas niwak yelk'och heb', haton juntzanh wik yaji. Yowalil ol jawok k'ixwelal t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schukalil sk'ulejnak chi'.
Ha tiknaik, ol wak'och heb' stanhwumalok in templo, masanil komon munlajel ol wak' sb'o heb' ta'.

Palta a heb' sacerdote levita, yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, a heb' chi' ix in yak'nhej serwil heb', wach'chom a heb' yetisraelal heb' ix in yaktejkan heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to anhej heb' chi' syal sk'och t'a wichanh yik tzin yak'an serwil. Syal yoch heb' t'a wichanh yik syak' xepu'al nok' nok' yet' schik'il nok' silab'il t'ayin.
Anhej heb' syal yoch t'a yol in templo yik tzin yak'an serwil heb' t'a tastak ay t'a yol templo chi'. Anhej heb' syal yilan in munlajel ta'.
Ayik tz'och heb' t'a spuertail schab'il amak', yowalil a pichul lino syak'och heb'. Ayik ayoch heb' t'a yopisio ta', ma t'a yol templo, max yal-laj a pichul lana syak'och heb'.
Yowalil ayk'e sk'ox heb' nab'a lino. Yowalil lino pax yol swex heb' ayochi. Mokab' stzek' snanhal heb' t'a junok tas tz'ik'an yel yalil.

Ayik manto elta heb' t'a b'ab'el amak', b'aj ayek' heb' yetchonhab' heb', yowalil syik'kanel spichul heb' sk'an t'a yopisio t'a yol templo chi', skan t'a yol juntzanh cuarto t'a yo'ol chi'. Haxo junxo spichul heb' syak'ochi yik wach' max ochkan smay jun pichul chi' t'a heb' ayek' chi'.
Max sjoxel-laj t'ab'an sjolom heb'. Scha k'ib' xil sjolom heb' chi', anhej snhitak sjoxel heb'.
Malaj junok heb' sacerdote chi' tz'uk'an wino ayik tz'och t'a schab'il amak'.

Max yal yik'an heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum heb', ma heb' ix aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum, palta anhej junok ix yetisraelal heb' kob'esto syik'a', ma junok ix yetb'eyum junok yetsacerdoteal heb' chamnakxo.
Ha heb' sacerdote chi', yowalil sk'ayb'ej heb' in chonhab' heb' yik syojtakejel heb' tas sik'b'ilel wu'uj yet' tas manh sik'b'ilokel wu'uj, tas wach' yet' tas manh wach'ok, icha yalan ley.
Hanheja', tato ay b'aj tz'och owal, a heb' sb'o'ani icha yalan ley. Yowalil sk'anab'ajej sleyal juntzanh in k'inh heb', sk'anab'ajej pax jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', haton jun k'u wik yaji.

Malaj b'ak'inh syam junok sniwanil chamnak heb' yik max yixtejb'at sb'a heb', icha yalan ley. Anhej tato a smam snun heb', ma junok yuninal heb', ma yisil heb', ma junok yuk'tak heb', ma junok yanab' heb' kob'esto schami, syal syaman heb'.
Slajwi chi' yowalil sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley, uke' k'uhal maxtzak ochlaj heb' munlajel t'a yol in templo chi'.
Ayik tz'ochxi heb' t'a yol in templo chi' yik smunlajxi heb', a in Jehová in swala', yowalil syak' junok nok' silab' heb' yuj stupil smul.
Malaj junok smakb'en heb' sacerdote syik' t'a he chonhab', ichato a in ayin och smakb'enok heb'.

Ha swa'el heb' sacerdote chi', haton tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj heb' eyetchonhab' yet' nok' silab' tz'ak'ji t'ayin yuj yak'ji tup mul yet' nok' tz'ak'ji stojolok mul yet' masanil silab' syak' heb' yetisraelal heb' t'ayin. Ha juntzanh chi', yiknhej heb' sacerdote chi' yaji.

Ha heb' sacerdote chi', a b'ab'el sat awb'en te wach', yowalil scha heb' yet' masanil tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin. Ayik sb'o'an ixim pan heb' in chonhab', a ixim b'ab'el sb'o'i, a ixim syak' heb' t'a heb' sacerdote chi' yik wach' swak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote chi', max yal-laj schi'an junok nok' much heb', ma junokxo nok' nok' skomon chami, mato milb'ilcham yuj nok' chium nok'.

Ayik tz'och suerte yik spukchajek' lum lum t'a junjun inhtilal, yowalil ch'ok tz'ik'chajkanel jab'ok lu'um wik tz'ajkan a in Jehová in tik, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el lu'um, oye' kilómetro sat lu'um. Masanil jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', hata' tz'ik'jikanel junok makan lum b'aj skan templo, 250 metro tz'aj lum t'a schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a spatiktak lum chi' skan pax jab'ok lum kolan tz'ajkani, 25 metro sat.
Ha jun makan lum chi' yik heb' sacerdote smunlaj t'a templo tz'aj lu'um, haton heb' tz'och t'a wichanh in yak'an serwil. Hata' syal sb'oank'e spat heb' t'a spatiktak in templo chi'.

Hanheja' tz'ik'chajkanel junxo makan lum lum, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el, oye' kilómetro sat. Ha jun lum chi', yik heb' levita tz'ajkan lu'um, haton heb' smunlaj t'a templo yik wach' ay b'aj sb'ok'e spat heb' b'aj skajnaji.

Haxo t'a skostil lum wik yaji, yowalil skan junxo makan lu'um. Ha jun lum chi' yik chonhab' tz'ajkan lu'um. 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj ste'el lu'um, nanhal yoxil kilómetro tz'aj sat lu'um, yik chonhab' Israel tz'ajkan lu'um.

Hanhejtona', ay chab' makan lum lum, yik winh yajal tz'ajkan lu'um. Ay jun makan lum skan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haxo junxo makan lu'um, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u skan lu'um, syalelk'ochi haton t'a stz'ey lum wik yaji yet' t'a stz'ey lum yik heb' chonhab'. Lajan tz'aj ste'el lu'um yet' lum yik junjun inhtilal.
Ha jun makan lu'um chi' yik winh yajal Israel tz'ajkan lu'um. Yuj chi', a lum yik heb' in chonhab', manhxo ol yik'ek' lum heb' winh yajal heb' chi', palta ol kan lum t'a junjun makan inhtilal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ex yajal Israel, manhxo eyixtej heb' in chonhab', wach'nhejokab' tzeyutej he b'a, tojolnhej tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan junok tasi. Aktejek he tok'anek' lum slum heb' in chonhab'.
Ha echlab' te tz'akan tze k'ana'.

Ha eyechlab' tze k'an t'a sat eyawb'en, lajanokab' yo'ol yet' eyechlab' tze k'an t'a tas ha' yaji. Ha niwan echlab', haton homer, 220 litro yo'ol, a tz'ak'an yechel masanil echlab'. Ha jun homer chi', lajunhe' bato ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol, lajunhe' pax efa sat awb'en tz'em t'ay.
Hanheja' pax tas tz'echtaj yalil: Ha 20 gera, lajan yalil yet' jun ciclo, haxo pax 60 ciclo lajan yalil yet' jun mina.
Haton juntzanh ofrenda tik yowalil syak' heb' etisraelal: Ha ixim he trigo yet' ixim he cebada 60 makan tzeyutej ixim. Jun makan ixim tzeyak'a'.
Icha pax chi' tzeyutej eyaceite, 100 makan tzeyutej. Jun makan tzeyak'paxi.

Haxo pax nok' kalnel swa b'aj yax anh ank'ultak t'a yol yik Israel, jun nok' tzeyik'el t'a skal 200 ok nok'. Ha in Jehová in swala', masanil juntzanh tik ol k'anchaj t'a ofrendail yet' t'a silab' stz'ai yet' t'a silab' yik junk'olal yet' silab' yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' in chonhab' Israel.
Yowalil masanil in chonhab' Israel tz'ak'an juntzanh ofrenda chi' t'a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'ak'an nok' nok' stz'a silab'il yet' ixim trigo ofrendail yet' wino tz'ak'ji ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj, t'a k'uhal ik'oj ip yet' t'a juntzanh niwak k'inh wik yaji. Yowalil syak' pax silab' winh yik stup mul, ixim trigo ofrendail, silab' stz'ai, silab' yik junk'olal yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup schukalil heb' yinhtilal Israel.
Ha in Dios Yajal in swala': Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, yowalil tzeyak' junok nok' kelem wakax malaj spaltail yik sakb'ikan in templo.

Ha winh sat sacerdote tz'ik'ank'e jab'ok schik'il nok' wakax chi', haton nok' ix ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, sukanoch schik'il nok' winh t'a smarcoal spuertail in templo, t'a spatiktak schikintak schanhil yet' t'a yoxmakanhil yich altar cha'anh ayk'ei yet' t'a smarcoal spuertail chab'il amak'.
Hanheja' icha chi' tz'aj pax t'a yukil k'uhal, yuj yalnhej mach tz'och smul to manh sk'anok sk'o'ol, mato manh yojtakok tato wan yoch smul. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ikanel in templo chi'.
Ayik 14 yoch b'ab'el uj, tze cha'anel yich k'inh yik tze na'ankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto. Uke' k'uhal tze wa ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', a winh yajal, yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem wakax winh silab'il yuj smul, yuj pax yik masanil heb' chonhab'.

Ha t'a junjun k'u t'a uke' k'uhal k'inh chi', yowalil syak' ukwanh nok' kelemtak wakax winh yajal chi' yet' ukwanhok nok' ch'ak kalnel, haton nok' malaj jab'ok spaltail. Snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin. Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a junjun k'u silab'il yuj yak'chaj tup mul.
Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', tz'ak'jipax 40 libraok ixim trigo yet' nanhal schanhil litro'ok aceite.

Anhejpaxa' t'a uke' k'uhal k'inh yik chinama, haton jun k'inh schael yich t'a 15 yoch yukil uj, a winh yajal chi' yowalil syak'nhej silab' winh. Lajan sb'isul nok' silab' chi' syak' winh t'a junjun k'u, icha nok' syak' winh t'a k'inh yik tze na'ankot tas ajnak eyelta t'a Egipto, haton nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupchaj mul, nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yet' ixim trigo yet' aceite ofrendail.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ha jun spuertail schab'il amak' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ha t'a wake' k'uhal munlajel, yowalil makannhej, anhej t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip sjakwi yet' t'a sk'uhal yik tz'alji k'e'en uj.

Ha winh yajal chi' tz'och winh t'a jun puerta t'a b'ab'el amak', tz'och winh t'a jun corredor t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarcoal jun puerta chi', yakb'an wan snhusantz'a nok' silab' heb' sacerdote yet' nok' silab' yik junk'olal syak' winh. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh ejmelal t'ayin b'aj ayek' chi', ichato chi' tz'el winh t'a corredor chi', palta skannhej jakan jun puerta chi', masanto wanxo sk'ik'b'i smakchaji.
Haxo t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' t'a yik tz'alji k'e'en uj, yowalil tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin, t'a yichanh jun puerta chi'.
Ha nok' silab' yowalil syak' winh yajal chi' t'ayin yik snhusjitz'a t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, wakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel, malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok' yukwanhil.

Yowalil syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi'. Haxo yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', hato ha' jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' 40 libraok ixim harina, syak' pax nanhal schanhil litro aceite winh.
Haxo t'a sk'uhal ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj, yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem wakax winh, wakwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel. Masanil juntzanh nok' chi', malajokab' spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' nok' kelem wakax chi' syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh. Icha pax chi' tz'aj yak'an jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' winh. Haxo pax yet' nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yak'ani. Haxo yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' nanhal schanhil litro aceite winh.
Ayik tz'och winh yajal t'a spuertail schab'il amak' chi', tz'och winh t'a corredor chi', hanheja' ta' tz'elxi winh.

Ayik tzul och heb' chonhab' ejmelal t'ayin t'a junjun k'inh, yowalil a tik sk'ulej heb': Ha mach tz'och t'a b'ab'el amak' t'a spuertail, t'a stojolal norte, ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur tz'elxi. Haxo mach tz'och t'a puerta t'a stojolal sur chi', ha t'a puerta t'a stojolal norte chi' tz'elxi. Malaj junok mach smeltzajxiel t'a puerta b'aj ix ochi, palta to tz'el t'a junxo puerta k'elankot b'aj ix och chi'.
Ha winh yajal chi', yowalil tz'och winh yet' heb' chonhab', tz'el pax winh yet' heb'.

Ha t'a niwak k'inh yet' sk'uhal molanil, syak' 40 libraok ixim harina winh yajal chi' yet' junjun nok' kelemtak wakax. Icha pax chi' ixim syak' winh yet' junjun nok' ch'ak kalnel. Haxo pax yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel, yalnhej jantak tz'el t'a skol winh yak'ani. Ha yet' junjun 40 libraok ixim harina chi', syak' pax nanhalok schanhil litro aceite winh.

Ayik tz'el t'a sk'ol winh yajal chi' yak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, junok nok' snhusjitz'aok, ma junok nok' yik junk'olal, yowalil sjakchaj puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, syak'an silab' winh chi', icha syak' winh t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip. Slajwi chi' tz'elxita winh t'a puerta chi', ichato chi' smakchajxikani.

Junjun k'inhib'alil t'a junjun k'u syak' silab' winh yajal chi' t'ayin. Yowalil syak' junok nok' kelem kalnel winh, yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'ayin, jun ab'il sk'inal nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Ha yet' jun nok' kelem kalnel chi', syak' pax 14 libraok ixim harina winh yet' junok litro aceite sekchajem t'a yib'anh ixim. Ha jun tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej winh t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum smakb'en t'a junok yuninal, a jun lum chi' tz'ochkan smakb'enok yuninal chi'.

Palta tato a winh yajal chi' siej jab'ok lum t'a junok schekab' yik smakb'enej, masanto sjawi ab'il yik tz'el tas t'a libre, ichato chi' syik'anxi lum winh yajal chi'. Haxo skan lum smakb'enok heb' yuninal winh.

Ha winh yajal chi', malaj yalan yik winh stok'anek' smakb'en junokxo anima. Ha lum slu'um winh, a lum syak' winh smakb'enok heb' yuninal. Icha chi', malaj heb' malaj smakb'en skan t'a skal in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anb'at jun winh winak chi' t'a yoloch sti' jun puerta, t'a chab' pat yik heb' sacerdote skan t'a stojolal norte. Ix sch'oxan winh t'ayin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a spatik chab' pat chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Haton t'a tik yowalil ol stz'anh nok' silab' heb' sacerdote tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, ma yuj stojolok mul. Ha t'a tik ol b'ochaj pax ixim harina tz'ak'ji ofrendail. Icha chi', max ik'chajel juntzanh tastak chi' t'a b'ab'el amak', yik wach' max ochkan stzikikial juntzanh tas yik Dios yaj t'a heb' anima, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a jun b'ab'el amak', ix in yik'anek' winh t'a schanhil pak'anh.
Ix wilan t'a junjun schikintak amak' chi', ay juntzanhxo yunetak amak'. Lajan yechel schanhil. 20 metro ste'el, 15 metro sat.
Ha t'a spatiktak juntzanh yunetak amak' chi', ayk'e jun muro nab'a k'e'en, haxo t'a yichtak jun muro chi', ayk'e b'aj tz'och k'ak'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Haton t'a juntzanh kusinu tik stz'anh nok' silab' heb' smunlaj t'a templo tik, haton silab' syak' heb' chonhab', xchi winh t'ayin.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch winh t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haxo ix wilani, ay jun ha ha' sk'eul t'a yalanh sti' puerta chi'. Ha jun ha ha' chi' sb'atkan ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a ko wach' ayik tzonh elta t'a templo chi', tzek' ha' t'a stojolal sur t'a jun altar.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a spatik b'ab'el amak' chi', t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte. Ix b'at woyan in b'a t'a spatik amak' chi' yuj winh, masanto t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix wilani, ay jun ha' yune' ha' sk'eul t'a stojolal sur t'a jun puerta chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', ix b'at winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, yet'nak jun ch'anh ch'anh winh yik echlab'. Ix yechtan 500 metro winh, ix in yik'anek' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', ha t'a sjaj wok ix k'eul ha'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Haxo t'a sjolom in penek ix k'eul ha'. Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Haxo t'a in nanhal ix k'ek'och ha'.
Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh. Ha ha' chi' te niwan ix aj ha', manhxalaj mach syal sk'axpaj t'a yol ha'. Te jul ix aj yich ha', syal kek'i, palta toxonhej sko mak'a'.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ach anima, scham wal a na'an tas ix il tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anxikot winh t'a stitak ha ha' chi'.
Haxo ix wilani, manhxo jantakok te te' ay t'a stitak ha' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'ayin: Ha jun ha' tik, sb'at ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'atnhej ha' t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán, sb'atkan ha' t'a yol ha' mar Muerto. Ayik ol k'och ha' t'a yol ha' chi', ol chib'okk'e ha' mar chi' yuj ha'.

Yalxonhej b'aj ol k'och jun ha' tik, wach' ol kajnaj masanil makanhil nok' nok' t'a yol ha', manhxo jantakok nok' chay ol k'ib'ok. Yujto a jun ha' tik, ol chib'okk'e ha ha' k'achi' yuj ha', ol te k'ib' tastak ay sk'inal t'a yol ha'.

Tzijtum heb' yamum chay ol aj t'a sti' ha'. Ha t'a En-gadi masanto t'a En-eglaim ol yak' takjok schimpa heb' yamum chay chi'. Manhxo jantakok makanhil nok' chay ol k'ib' t'a ha', icha smakanhil schayil ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Haxo pax stitak ha' sok'omtak, ma b'aj ay ha' kotak nhajab', manh ol chib'oklaj ha', hata' ay ha ha' k'achi', hata' ol yik'k'eta yatz'am anima.

Ha t'a stitak ha ha' chi', ol k'ib'k'e masanil makanhil te te' sloji sat. Ha te te' chi', malaj b'ak'inh sk'ajb'anem xi'il te'. Manh ol yaktejpax yak'an sat te'. Junjun uj syak'nhej sat te', yujto ha ha' tz'elta t'a templo ayoch yalok te'. Ha sat te' chi', ol lochajok, haxo xil te' ol och remeyoal, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'ayin icha tik: Haton stz'akanhil lum lum ol scha' lajchawe' makan heb' yinhtilal Israel smakb'enok. (Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj José cha makan smakb'en heb' ol yik'a'.
Ha in ix wak' in ti' wak'an jun lum tik t'a heb' he mam yicham. Lajannhej tz'aj he pukanek' lum t'a he kal he lajchawe' inhtilal. Haton jun lum tik ol wak' he makb'enok.)
Haton stz'akanhil lum tik t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal norte: Schael t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, sk'och t'a chonhab' Hetlón yet' t'a chonhab' Zedad,
Hamat, Berota yet' Sibraim, haton ay t'a skal stz'akanhil Damasco yet' Hamat masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-hatikón, haton stz'akanh sb'a yet' Haurán.
Yuj chi', a stz'akanhil lu'um schael t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-enán. Haxo t'a norte skan lum yik chonhab' Damasco yet' lum yik Hamat.

Haxo stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton tik: Tz'ek' t'a stitak lum yik chonhab' Haurán yet' yik Damasco. Sb'atnhej t'a stitak ha' Jordán, haton ha' chi' tz'akanh yaj t'a skal chonhab' Galaad yet' Israel, masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Tamar t'a stojolal sur t'a yik ha' mar Muerto.
Haxo pax stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal sur, haton tik: Schael t'a chonhab' Tamar, tzek' t'a sjajtak ha' Meriba-cades yet' t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto, masanto sk'och t'a ha' Mediterráneo.

Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ha ha' mar Mediterráneo ayoch stz'akanhilok lu'um. Schael t'a stz'akanhil yik Egipto tzek'nhej t'a sti' ha' mar chi' masanto sk'och b'aj tzonh och t'a chonhab' Hamat.
Haton jun lum tik yowalil spukchajek' t'a he kal junjun makan ex yinhtilal Israel ex tik.
Ha lum ol eyik' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, haton heb' ayxo yuninal. Ayik ol he pukanek' lu'um t'a he kal, lajan lum yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi' ol yik' heyet'ok.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol scha' smakb'en heb' yalnhej b'aj kajan t'a skal junjun inhtilal chi'.

Ha stz'akanhil Israel t'a norte, schael t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, tzek' t'a Hetlón yet' b'aj tz'och b'e t'a Hamat yet' t'a Hazar-enán, tzek' t'a stojolal sur t'a lum yik Damasco yet' Hamat chi'. Junjun makan yinhtilal Israel scha junok makan lum lum smakb'enok, sb'at stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Icha tik ol aj scha'an lum smakb'en heb' chi' t'a stzolal, schael yich t'a norte skotnhej t'a sur: Dan, Aser, Neftalí, Manasés, Efraín, Rubén yet' Judá.

Ha t'a stz'ey lum smakb'en Judá, hata' ay jun lum sik'b'ileli: 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo sat lu'um. Haxo ste'el lu'um, lajan yet' ste'el lum smakb'en junjun inhtilal, skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', hata' ay in templo.
Ha t'a jun lum lum wik yaj chi', ay jun makan lu'um, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax sat lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal lum chi', hata' ay in templo.

Ha jun lum chi', yik lum heb' sacerdote ayoch in yak'an serwil, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Sadoc, heb' maj tzak'laj t'a spatik heb' yetisraelal ayik in yaktankan heb', icha ix yutej sb'a heb' yetlevitail heb'.

Ha t'a sti' lum yik heb' sacerdote chi', hata' ay lum yik heb' levita. Ha lum chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax sat lu'um. Ha lum wik yaj chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el lu'um, 10 kilómetro sat lu'um.

Ha jun makan lum chi' anhej lum te wach' t'a yol nación chi'. Malaj junok makan lum chi' syal schonhchajeli. Max yal-laj sk'exchaj lu'um, max yalpaxlaj yak'chaj lum t'a junokxo anima, yujto wik yaj lu'um.

Ay junxo makan lu'um t'a skostil lum wik yaj chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo ste'el lu'um, nanhal yoxil kilómetro sat lu'um, komon yaj lu'um. Ha t'a snanhal yol lum chi', hata' ay niwan chonhab'. Haxo jantakto lum kolan skani, syal skajnaj anima, syal pax swa nok' nok' ta'. Ha jun chonhab' chi', 2 mil 250 metro schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ay jab'xo lum lum oyanek'i, 125 metro sat lu'um. Ha nok' nok' swa t'a jab'xo lum lum chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'an t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun chonhab' chi', ay jun makan lum lum, oye' kilómetro ste'el lu'um. Hanheja' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ay pax junxo makan lu'um, oye' kilómetro pax ste'el lu'um. Ha t'a juntzanh lum chi' smunlaj anima ay t'a chonhab' chi', haxo sat yawb'en heb' smolo', a syab'lej heb'.
Yalnhej mach anima t'a yik junjun makan yinhtilal Israel smunlaj t'a yol chonhab' chi', syal smunlaj heb' t'a chab' makan lum chi'.
Masanil lum wik yaji yet' lum yik jun niwan chonhab' ay t'a snanhal jun lum sik'b'ilkanel chi', 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo lum t'a schanhil pak'anh.

Ha winh yajal chonhab' chi', a winh tz'ikan lum aykan t'a snanhal lum smakb'en Judá yet' lum smakb'en Benjamín, syalelk'ochi, haton lum ay t'a stz'eytak lum wik yaji yet' t'a stz'ey lum yik chonhab'. Ay jun makan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, 12 kilómetro yet' nanhalxo sat lu'um, sb'atnhej lum t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u chi'. Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ay junxo makan lu'um, masanto t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo sk'och lu'um. Ha t'a skal chab' makan lum chi', hata' ay lum wik yaji, haton lum b'aj ay in templo yet' lum yik heb' sacerdote yet' pax lum yik heb' levita. Hata' ay pax lum b'aj ay niwan chonhab'.

Ha lum smakb'en juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal Israel, sb'atnhej t'a sur. Junjun inhtilal ol scha junjun makan slu'um, schael t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto sk'och t'a tz'akanh t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Icha tik ol aj scha'an smakb'en heb' chi' t'a stzolal: Benjamín, Simeón, Isacar, Zabulón yet' Gad.
Ha t'a stojolal sur ay lum smakb'en Gad, a stz'akanhil lu'um, schael t'a Tamar, tzek' t'a sjaj ha ha' yik Meriba-cades, t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto, masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Haton jun lum chi' ol scha juntzanh yinhtilal Israel smakb'enok. Icha chi' ol aj he pukanek' lu'um.

Ha jun chonhab' t'a snanhal lu'um chi', ayoch muro t'a spatiktak. Ha muro chi', 2 mil 250 metro yaj junjun pak'anh, lajan yaj schanhil pak'anh. Ha t'a junjun pak'anh ay oxe' puerta. Ha t'a junjun puerta chi' ayoch sb'i junjun yinhtilal Israel, icha tik yaj stzolal: Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal norte, ayoch sb'i yik Rubén, yik Judá yet' yik Leví. Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ayoch sb'i yik José, yik Benjamín yet' yik Dan. Ha t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal sur, ayoch sb'i yik Simeón, yik Isacar yet' yik Zabulón. Haxo pax t'a oxe' puerta t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ayoch sb'i yik Gad, yik Aser yet' yik Neftalí.
Ha jun muro chi' 9 kilómetro yajoch t'a spatiktak niwan chonhab' chi'. Ha sb'i jun chonhab' chi' ayik ol b'eynhejb'atok: Ha Jehová ayek' t'a tik, ol sb'iej, xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim reyal t'a Judá, ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, yik syak'an owal heb' t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix och hoyan heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'.

Ha Dios Kajalil ix ak'anoch winhaj rey Joacim chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima aj Judá yet' jantak yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Dios. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', ix yik'kot winh, ix jawi t'a Babilonia tik, ix schekan winh ak'chajoch t'a spatil sdiosal b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a sdiosal winh chi'.

Ayik ix jawi heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Aspenaz, haton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yilumal sdespacho winh rey chi' to sik'chajel jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' winh rey aj Judá chi' yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' niwak yopisio ix ik'chajkot chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi', yowalil te wach' yilji heb' winh, malaj jab'ok spaltail sniwanil heb' winh, jelan heb' winh, ay spensar heb' winh, snachajel tas yuj heb' winh, heb' winh smoj wal yak'an serwil t'a palacio. Yowalil sk'ayb'ej sti' heb' caldeo heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj heb'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to a swa'el winh yet' swino winh syab'lej heb' winh kelemtak chi', sk'ayb'ajpax oxeok ab'il heb' winh. Slajwi chi', tz'och heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak ix sik'chajel yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi', hata' ayoch winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Haton heb' winh tik ix kot t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ix k'exchaj sb'i heb' winh yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Ha winhaj Daniel chi', Beltsasar ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Ananías, Sadrac ix sb'iej winh, haxo pax winhaj Misael, Mesac ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Azarías jun, Abed-nego ix sb'iej winh.

Ha winhaj Daniel chi', ix sna winh to manh ol swalaj juntzanh tas ay yowalil yuj sley Dios, yuj chi' ix tewi winh t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to max ak'ji pural winh swa'an swa'el winh rey yet' tas syuk'ej winh.
Ix och Dios yet' winhaj Daniel chi', yuj chi' te wach' winh t'a yol sat winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Wach'chom icha chi',

palta ix yal winhaj Aspenaz chi' icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a winh wajalil, yujto a winh ix halani tas ol he wa''a yet' tas ol eyuk'ej. K'inalok haxo ol yilan winh to b'aktak ex t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak tik, ol am in schek miljokcham winh rey chi' eyu'uj, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Aspenaz chi', ix yak'och jun yilumal winhaj Daniel chi' winh yet' heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Daniel chi' t'a winh yilumal chi' icha tik:
--Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' prowal t'a lajunheok k'uhal. Anhej komon wa'el tzak' t'ayonh, mokab' ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a, anhej pax ha ha' tzak' kuk'ej.

Ayik stz'akwi lajunhe' k'uhal chi', tzonh a lajb'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak swa'an swa'el winh rey chi'. Ichato chi' syalxo ak'an t'ayonh tas ol ko wa chi', hato syal chajtil kiljiochi, xchi winh.
Ix scha'an sk'ol winh tas ix sk'an heb' winh chi'. Lajunhe' k'uhal ix ak'ji prowal heb' winh.
Haxo yik ix tz'akwi lajunhe' k'uhal chi', ix iljiochi to te wach' yilji heb' winh, te tek'an heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh ix wa'an swa'el winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi', majxo ak'jilaj wa'el yet' wino yik winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj winh yilumal heb' winh chi', haxonhej komon wa'el ix yak' winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi' schanhwanhil, ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' winh yuj Dios yik snachajel jantak sk'ayb'ub'al heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ay pax sjelanil winh sna'anel tas syalelk'och juntzanh wayich yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji yila'.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal icha yalnakkan winh rey, ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh kelemtak ix k'ay chi' yuj winhaj Aspenaz, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' heb' winh, palta ha t'a skal heb' winh kelemtak chi' smasanil, malaj junok heb' winh syal slajb'an sb'a yet' heb' winh chanhwanh chi', haton winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Yuj chi' ix ak'jikanoch heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Juntakel sk'anb'ej razón winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj juntzanh jelanil yet' tastak ajaltak snachajeli, ix nachajel yuj heb' winh, lajunhel wal ek'to sjelanil spensar heb' winh chanhwanh chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ajchum yet' heb' naumel lolonel ay t'a yol masanil smakb'en winh.
Haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix kannhej winh t'a yopisio chi', masanto t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal, ay jun tas ix ak'ji swayichej winh. Ix te och winh ilk'olal yuj jun swayich chi', yuj chi' majxo ochlaj swayanh winh.

Haxo masanil heb' winh syal yuj yalani, heb' winh ajb'a'al, heb' winh jelan yet' heb' winh schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal, ix chekji awtajkot heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', yik tzul yal heb' winh tas syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'. Haxo yik ix jawi heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ix in wayichej, te ilk'olal waj yuj. Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh t'a ti' arameo icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab'nhej opisio tik t'a junelnhej. Al t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik tas ix a wayichej chi', ol kalan t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Toxo ix in na'a, tato manh ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, chok' ol ex aj he xikjichamok, haxo he pat, ol pojchajkanemok.

Palta tato ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, niwan silab' ol wak' spakok t'ayex, te niwan pax ol aj eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi', alek t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh jelan chi' t'a schaelal icha tik: --Mamin rey, al a wayich chi' t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik yik ol kal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Wojtakxo to tonhej tze say modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a, yuj chi' tzeyik'ek' tiempo, yujto eyojtak to a tas ix wal t'a he patik manh ol ek'laj.

Tato manh ol eyala' tas ix in wayichej chi', a tas nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ujok, yujto ix he mol alej tas tzeyutej he pakan t'ayin t'a esal, yakb'an wan he tanhwan in k'exan tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Alek tas ix in wayichej chi', yik snachajel wu'uj to ol yal eyalani tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wixi heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj junok anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik syal snachajel yuj tas tza k'anb'ej tik. Hanhejtona', malaj junok rey wach'chom te b'inajnak sk'anb'an icha jun tik t'a heb' winh jelan.
Yujto a jun tik, te ajaltak snachajeli. Malaj junok mach syal yalani, anhej am heb' Dios snachaj yuj, palta a heb' chi', manhok t'a ko kal ay heb' a onh anima onh tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il. Ix yalan winh to xikjicham heb' winh jelan chi' t'a masanil yol yik Babilonia.
Ayik ix elta jun ley chi', ix saychajek' winhaj Daniel yet' heb' winh oxwanh yetb'eyum winh, yik schampax heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Arioc, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey. Ix ak'jioch yopisio winh yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan chi'. Wan smolb'aj heb' winh yuj winh, haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix lolon yet' winh t'a jelanil yet' t'a emnakilal.
Ix sk'anb'an yab' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj elanhchamel ix yak'elta jun ley te ow tik winh rey chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc tas yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Daniel yik stewi winh t'a winh rey yik tz'ak'ji jab'okxo stiempo winh, yik syalan winh tas syalelk'och jun wayich chi'. Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj Daniel chi' t'a spat. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum, haton winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías, chajtil yaj jun lolonel chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to sk'an skolwal sDiosal satchanh heb' winh yik snachajel jun lolonel satub'tak chi' yuj heb' winh, yik max miljicham heb' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh jelan t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' Dios swayichej winhaj Daniel tas jun swayich winh rey chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach ko Diosal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ik yaj masanil jelanil yet' poder.
Ha ach ojtak jantak tiempo syak' yajalil junjun mach, yujto a ach tzak'och heb' t'a yopisio. Hanheja' a ach syal ik'anxiel heb'. U'uj ay spensar heb' ay spensar. U'uj ay sjelanil heb' jelan.
Ha ach tzak' ojtakajel tas satub'tak yet' tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Ojtak masanil tastak ay t'a kal k'ik' k'inal, yujto aj sakil k'inal ach.

Ach ko Diosal, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam kicham, skak' yuj diosal t'ayach. Skalanpax wach' lolonel, yujto ix ak' in jelanil yet' in tek'anil. Ha tiknaik, ix ak' wojtakejeli tas ix ko k'an t'ayach. Ix ak' kojtakejeli tas yaj swayich winh rey, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi winhaj Daniel chi', ix b'at winh t'a winhaj Arioc, haton winh ix ak'ji yopisio yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a milcham heb' winh jelan chi'. Ik' in b'at t'a yichanh winh rey. Ol wala' tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ik'chajb'at winh yuj winhaj Arioc chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Judá, ix ilchaj jun winh winak wu'uj. Ha winh ol alanok tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Daniel chi', skuchanpax Beltsasar, icha tik: --¿Ol am yal halani tas ix in wayichej chi', tas pax syalelk'ochi? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a jun tas satub'tak tza nib'ej tzojtakejel chi', wach'chom a heb' winh jelan, heb' winh schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal yet' heb' winh ajb'a'al, malaj junok heb' winh snachajel yuj.
Palta ay jun Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, ha' syal yak'an kojtakejel tas satub'tak. Ha ix ak'an ojtakejeli tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'inh. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas ix a wayichej chi'.
Ach Mamin rey, ayik jichan ach ek' t'a sat ch'at, wan a na'ani tastak ol ujok t'a b'ak'inh, haxo Dios, haton tz'ak'an ojtakajel tas satub'tak, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach.
Hanheja' pax ix ch'oxan jun tik t'ayin, manh yujok to te jelan in t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, ma'ay, palta yuj wak'an ojtakejeli tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', yik ol nachajel u'uj tas tza na'a.
Mamin rey, a tas ix il t'a a wayich chi' to ay jun yechel anima te niwan, linhanek' t'a ichanh. We'ei yilji, te ay smay yilji.
Ha sjolom, nab'a oro. Haxo snhi' sk'o'ol yet' sk'ab', nab'a plata. Haxo sk'o'ol yet' yib'tak xub', nab'a bronce.
Haxo xub' yet' spenek, nab'a hierro, haxo samil yok yet' yiximal yok, a k'e'en hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a kal k'ak'.

Mamin rey, yakb'an wan ilan jun chi', ay jun k'e'en k'e'en munil ix kot t'a sat witz, malaj mach ix ekankot k'e'en. Ha wal t'a yok jun yechel chi' b'aj kalan yaj k'e'en hierro yet' lum lum, hata' ix och tanhnaj k'e'en.

nhej wal chi' ix pojb'at k'e'en hierro yet' lum lum chi', k'e'en bronce, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro chi', pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'ati. Icha wal smatz'il ixim trigo b'aj stek'chaj t'a waresma tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', manhxa jab'ok skani, icha chi' ix ajkanb'at jun yechel chi'. Haxo k'e'en k'e'en ix mak'anpoj jun yechel chi', ix k'ib'cha'anh k'e'en. Icha lum niwak witz ix aj k'e'en, ix makchajel yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj k'e'en.
Mamin rey, haton jun tik ix a wayichej. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha ach tik, sat aj t'a masanil heb' rey, yujto ha Dios aj satcha'anh, ha' ix ach ak'anoch reyal. Ix yak'anpax a jelanil yet' a b'inajnakil yet' sniwanil elk'ochi.

Ix ach yak'och yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil lum lum b'aj kajan heb' anima, nok' nok' yet' nok' much. Ha Dios chi' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yol a k'ab', yuj chi' a ach ton tzach sch'ox sjolom jun yechel to nab'a oro ix il chi'.

Ayik ol lajwokek' opisio tik, ol k'e wa'an junxo nación, palta manh lajanoklaj yet' jun ik tik. Slajwi chi', ol k'e wa'an junxo yoxil, haton jun sch'ox k'e'en bronce chi'. Haton jun chi' ol ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol k'e wa'an junxo schanhil te ay yip, icha k'e'en hierro. Ha k'e'en hierro chi' smak'an poj masanil tastak, pokok tz'aj yuj k'e'en. Icha chi' ol aj junxo ol k'e wa'an chi', ol satjokel juntzanhxo nación yuj.

Ix ilanpax yok yet' yiximal yok jun yechel chi', kalan yaj k'e'en hierro chi' yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a skal k'ak'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a jun nación chi' cha makan yaji: Jun makan ay jab'ok yip icha k'e'en hierro, icha ix aj ilan k'e'en hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum chi'.
Ha yiximal yok kalan yaj yet' k'e'en hierro yet' lum lum chi', a jun chi', syalelk'ochi to a jun nación chi' ay jab'ok yip, haxo nanhalxo malaj wal yip.

Icha wal ix aj ilan k'e'en hierro kalan yet' lum lum chi', icha chi' ol yutej sb'a heb' yajal t'a juntzanh nación chi'. Ol laj yik'laj sb'a yal yuninal heb' yik junnhej ol yutok sb'a heb' yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj tas sna heb' chi', icha k'e'en hierro max skalej sb'a yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a stiempoal juntzanh heb' yajal chi', hata' ol k'e wa'an junxo nación yuj Dios aj satcha'anh, manhxa b'ak'inh ol satelok, manhxo ol kan t'a yalanh junokxo. Ol satjokel juntzanhxo nación chi' yuj, ol kannhej t'a junelnhej.

Haton chi' syalelk'och k'e'en k'e'en ix il skot t'a sat witz to malaj junok mach ix ekankoti. Haton yuj k'e'en pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'at k'e'en hierro, k'e'en bronce, lum lum, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro. Mamin rey, ha Dios te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'inh chi'. Ha jun a wayich chi' te yel, icha wal tz'aj walan tik, icha chi' ol aj yelk'ochi, xchi winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh winhaj Daniel chi', ichato chi' ix schekan winh ak'chaj silab' yet' incienso t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Wal yel a he Diosal a ex tik, anhej yelxo niwan t'a yichanh juntzanhxo Dios. Haton wal yajalil heb' rey, a sch'oxanpax tas satub'tak yaji. Tik wal a achnhej ix nachajel jun lolonel tik u'uj, xchi winh.

Haxo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a jun opisio te niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ak'chajpax silab' te wach' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix ak'chajoch winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'. Ix ochpax winh yajalil t'a masanil heb' winh jelan t'a smakb'en chi'.

Ix sk'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'. Ix scha'an sk'ol winh rey chi', ix och heb' winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi', haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ha t'a sdespacho winh rey chi' ayoch winh t'a yopisio.
Ix schek winhaj rey Nabucodonosor b'ochaj jun yechel ayoch oro t'ay, 30 metro ste'el, haxo sat, oxe' metro. Ix yalan winh to tz'ak'jiem t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Dura t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.

Ayik toxo ix b'oel jun yechel chi', ix yawtankot heb' winh ayoch yajalil winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en, haton heb' winh yajalil soldado, heb' winh gobernador, heb' winh ak'um razón t'a yoltak chonhab', heb' winh molum tumin, heb' winh juez yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a juntzanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' t'a yichanh jun yechel chi', yik tz'och sk'inh yuj heb' winh.
Ha jun mach ayoch t'a yib'anh sloloni, te cha'anh ix aj yalani: Ab'ek he masanil ex anima ix ex kot t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al.

Ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, haton flauta, tanhb'il, arpa, salterio, zamponia yet' masanil juntzanhxo son, ol ex em kumnaj he masanil t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel ix schek b'ojok winhaj rey Nabucodonosor tik.
Masanil mach manh ol em kumnaj ejmelal t'a jun yechel tik, elanhchamel ol yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al, xchi.
Yuj chi', masanil anima ayek' molan chi', ayik ix yab'an heb' sk'e nhilnaj son chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ha t'a yik chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Caldea ix ul ak'an queja heb' winh aj Judá t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ach ix ala' to ayik sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, tz'em kumnaj masanil anima ejmelal t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel tik,
haxo mach max k'anab'ajani, syumchajb'at t'a yol horno sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al, xa chi.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Judá, haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego, heb' winh ix ak'och yopisio t'a yol smakb'en Babilonia tik, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix ala'. Max och heb' winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh a diosal, max empax kuman heb' winh t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ochajk'e tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom yel a ex tik Sadrac, Mesac yet' Abed-nego maj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh in diosal yet' t'a yechel in diosal ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik?

Ha tiknaik jun, tato b'ekan he k'o'ol, ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj son chi' junelxo, ol ex och ejmelal t'a yichanh jun yechel ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik, malaj tas ol ex ik'anok. Tato max he k'anab'ajej eyem kuman ejmelal jun, a wal t'a jun rato chi', ol ex yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al. Tato icha chi' ol ex utajok, ¿machto junok Dios ol yal ex skolanel t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj tas wach' kalan yuj jun tik.
Ha ko Diosal b'aj tzonh och ejmelal a onh tik, syal onh skolanel t'a skal k'ak' t'a horno chi'. A' ol onh kolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Wach'chom manh ol onh koljok yuj jun, palta mamin rey skak' ojtakejeli to manh ol onh em kuman t'a juntzanh a diosal chi' yet' t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ojok tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh slolonel heb' winh kelemtak winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix chakb'i wal sat winh skot yowal. Ix schekan ekchajk'e sk'ak'al jun horno chi' winh, masanto jantak stechaj schakb'i sik'lab'il.
Ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh soldado winh te ay yip, yik stzek'chaj heb' winh oxwanh chi', syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.
Ha heb' winh oxwanh chi' ayto och spichul heb' winh sk'an t'a yopisio b'aj ayochi, ix tzek'chaj heb' winh yik syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.

Snib'ej winh rey chi' to elanhchamel syumjiem heb' winh t'a yol horno chi', yuj chi' ayik ix yumjiem heb' winh yuj heb' winh soldado chi', ix k'eul kopnaj te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto te ow sk'ak'al.
Haxo pax heb' winh oxwanh chi', tzek'b'il heb' winh ix emk'och heb' winh t'a yol horno chi'.

T'a elanhchamel ix k'e juknaj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix xiwk'e winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yajal ayek' ta': --¿Tom manh oxwanhoknhej heb' winh kelemtak tzek'b'il ix yumjikanem t'a skal k'ak' chi'? xchi winh. --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

--Palta chanhwanh heb' winh swila', tijanel heb' winh, sb'eyek' heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' chi', malaj wal jab'ok tas tz'ik'an heb' winh. Haxo jun schanhil chi', lajan wal yilji icha junok Dios, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil sti' horno chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Sadrac, Mesac yet' ach Abed-nego, schekab' ex Dios Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, elanhekkoti, tzex kot t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix elta heb' winh yoxwanhil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och umnaj masanil heb' winh yajal t'a yol jun nación chi' yet' heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yil heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi', malaj wal jab'ok sniwanil heb' winh ix tz'a yuj k'ak' chi'. Ix chamwal yilan heb' winh to malaj jab'ok xil sjolom heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj pax jab'ok spichul heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj wal jab'ok sjab' te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego to a ix chekankot yángel yik skoljiel heb' schekab' syak' wal och sk'o'ol t'ay. Maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il a in rey in tik heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ol heb' winh scham t'a yichanhpax yem kuman t'a yalnhej tas diosal to manh sDiosalok heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik a in swala' to yalnhej mach anima sb'uchwaj t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego tik, chok' tz'aj heb' schami. Haxo spat heb' sjuchajem smasanil, wach'chom tas chonhab'il, tas nacional, ma tas ti'al syala', yujto malaj junokxo Dios syal skolwaj icha sDiosal heb' winh tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi' winh rey t'a niwak opisio t'a smakb'en Babilonia chi'.

Ix yak'anb'at jun ab'ix winh rey t'a yol masanil smakb'en icha tik: Ha in rey Nabucodonosor in tik, swak' stzatzil he k'o'ol he masanil ex chonhab', ma ex nación yalxonhej tas ti'al tzeyala', a ex masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
In gana tzeyojtakejel he masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej Dios Niwan Yelk'och t'ayin.
Te satub'takxonhej tas sk'ulej, manh jantakok spoder, Yajal ton t'a masanil tiempo, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.
Ha in Nabucodonosor in tik, tzalajk'olal wajek' t'a in palacio.
Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal, ay jun tas ix in wayichej. Ha yuj tas ix wil chi' yet' tas ix in na'a, ix in te xiwi.
Yuj chi' ix in chek awtajkot masanil heb' jelan t'a Babilonia tik, yik syalan heb' tas syalelk'och in wayich chi'.
Ix jawi heb' smasanil: Haton heb' ajb'a'al, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a heb', palta maj yal-laj heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Stzak'anilxo ix jawi winhaj Daniel, skuchan pax Beltsasar, icha sb'i in diosal, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ach Beltsasar, yajal aj t'a skal heb' jelan spensar, wojtak to ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, ojtakpax masanil tas satub'tak. Scham wal ab'ani tas ix wil t'a in wayich, ol halan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Haton wal in wayich ix wil tik ayik jichan in ek' in wayi: Ha t'a snanhal lum lum tik ix wil jun te te' te cha'anh ste'el.
Ix k'ib'cha'anh te', te niwan ix aj spatik te'. Ha schon te', ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, chekel te' masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum.

Te wach' yilji xil te', manh jantakok sat te', k'okb'il wal syab' sat te' chi' sloan masanil anima. Haxo masanil nok' nok', tz'och nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yenhul yich te'. Haxo t'a sk'ab'tak te' sb'o so' nok' much, haxo masanil tas pitzan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, k'okb'il swatzitaj heb' yuj sat te'.
Haxo ix aj jun, ix wilan jun ángel t'a in wayich chi', to stanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, wan yemta t'a satcha'anh.

Te cha'anh ix el yaw, ix yalan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te' chi', xikekel sk'ab' te', tzeyik'anel xil te', tze saklemanb'at sat te' chi' smasanil. Saklemokab'kanb'at masanil nok' nok' ayoch t'a yalanh yenhul te' yet' masanil nok' much ayoch t'a sk'ab'tak te'.

Haxonhej yib' te' tzeyaktejkani, tze tzek'ankan te' yib' chi' yet' k'e'en cadena to hierro yet' bronce. Skan jun chi' t'a skal anh ank'ultak chi', haxo yal ak'wal ol em t'a yib'anh, haxo anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux icha nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ixtaxel spensar. Lajanxo ol aj spensar icha spensar nok' nok'. Ha jun makan ya'elal chi', uke' ab'il ol yak'a'.

Ha onh ángel onh sko tanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a onh skala' to ol jawok jun ya'elal tik t'a yib'anh, yik wach' syojtakejel heb' anima smasanil to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ay yopisio t'a yib'anhtak nación. Ha tz'ak'an opisio t'a mach snib'ej syak'ochi, syalpax yak'anoch junok mach emnakil yajalilok junok nación, xchi jun ángel chi'.

Haton in wayich ix wil tik. Ha tiknaik ach Beltsasar, al t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, yujto malaj wal junokxo heb' ay tas syal yuj t'a yol in makb'en tik snachajel yuj. Palta a ach tik ol yal snachajel u'uj, yujto ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, xin chi.

Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', haton winh skuchpax Beltsasar, ken am manh junok hora ix kan numan winh. Ix somchajk'e spensar winh, palta ix walan t'a winh: Beltsasar, manh ak' pensar yuj jun in wayich chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ay mamin rey, komonok wal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ol em tas syalelk'och jun a wayich tik.
Mamin rey, a jun te te' te cha'anh ste'el ix il chi', haton jun te' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, te' ix cheklaj t'a najat,

te' wach' yilji xi'il, te' tzijtum sat, te' k'okb'ilnhej syab' sat sloan masanil tas pitzan, te' b'aj tz'och masanil nok' nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yalanh yenhul sk'ab', te' b'aj sb'o so' nok' much t'a skaltak sk'ab',
a ach ton tik mamin rey. To ix ach k'enhejcha'anh yuj sniwanil elk'och chi'. Ix k'ek'och a b'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh. Yajal ach t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ix ilanpax yemta jun ángel stanhwumal yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Ch'akek telwok te niwan te' chi', yik slajwiem te'. Haxonhej yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' tzeyak'kani. Stzek'chajkan yib' te' yet' k'e'en cadena to hierro yet' bronce, skan t'a kaltak ank'ultak. Emokab' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh ta', ol kajnaj yet' nok' nok' ukeok ab'il.
Ha syalelk'och jun tik mamin rey, a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'alan jun tik t'a ib'anh.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima tik. Ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok', haxo anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux icha nok' wakax. Ol em yal ak'wal t'a ib'anh. Mamin rey, icha chi' ol ach ajek' ukeok ab'il, masanto ol nachajel u'uj to a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' anima. Ha tz'ak'anpaxoch heb' yajal icha snib'ej mach syak'ochi.
Ha jun lolonel ix alchaji to skan yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' chi', syalelk'ochi to ol ach k'ochxok t'a opisio chi' ayik toxo ix nachajel u'uj to ha Dios yajal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, cha ab' masanil juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach. Yuj chi' tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, manhxo ak'och a mul. Komonok wal tzaktejkan a k'ulan chukal, tzach kolwaj t'a heb' tz'ixtaji. Tato icha chi', tekan ol ach kan t'a junk'olal yet' a k'echa'anh t'a masanil tasi, xchi winhaj Daniel chi' t'ayin, xchi winh rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix elk'ochi.
Yab'ilal yalchaj juntzanh chi' t'a winh rey chi', ayik wan sb'eyek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh spalacio t'a Babilonia,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Ina wal yilji niwan chonhab' Babilonia tik. Ha in yet' wal in poder ix in b'ok'ei yik scheklajeli to niwan welk'ochi, xchi winh.

Wanto wal yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' winh, ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Scham ab'an juntzanh lolonel tik ach rey Nabucodonosor, a opisio chi', toxo ix ik'chajek' t'ayach.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima, ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok'. Ha anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux ichok nok' nok' t'a ukeok ab'il, masanto ol yal snachajel u'uj to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil anima yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' tz'ak'anoch t'a yajalil mach snib'ej syak'ochi, xchi jun lolonel chi'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix elk'och tas alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix pechchajkanel winh t'a skal heb' anima. Ha anh ank'ultak ix sk'ux winh icha nok' wakax, haxo yal ak'wal ix em t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh. Ix k'ib' xi'il winh icha nok' ch'akb'a, hanheja' icha yech nok' ix aj k'e'en yech winh.

Ix yalanpaxb'at winh rey chi' icha tik: Ayik ix lajwi stiempoal ya'elal ayoch t'a wib'anh a in Nabucodonosor in tik, ix in k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh, ix b'o in pensar t'a in lokoal. Ix walan wach' lolonel t'a Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ix wik'ancha'anh sb'i Jun aynhejek' t'a junelnhej: Yujto Yajal ton t'a junelnhej, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.

Ha t'a yichanh, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal yuj heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej t'a skal heb' ayek' t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a skal heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Malaj mach syal syamanoch wa'an sk'ab' syalan t'ay, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tza k'ulej? manh xchiok.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix meltzaj in pensar ix wab'i yet' wik'anxi wopisio niwan yelk'ochi yet' in poder. Haxo heb' in chekab' yet' heb' niwak yopisio t'a in despacho, ix jawi heb' ul in sayek'i. Ix in ochxi yajalil t'a in nación, ix yik'anxi yip wopisio. Te niwan ix ajxi t'a yichanh icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha tiknaik, a in wal swik'cha'anh Jun sReyal satcha'anh. Swalanpax wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej, wach'nhej, tojolnhej t'a smasanil. Syalpax yik'anemta heb' syaloch sb'a to niwan yelk'ochi, xchib'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ha winhaj Belsasar sreyal Babilonia, ix yawtej mil heb' niwak yopisio winh t'a yol snación t'a jun niwan wa'el. Ha t'a jun wa'el chi', ix yuk' anh heb', ix yuk'an anh winh yet' heb'.

Wanxo sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajkot kopa yet' uk'ab' nab'a oro, haton juntzanh yik'nakkot winhaj Nabucodonosor smam icham winh t'a templo t'a Jerusalén. Ha t'a yol juntzanh kopa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' ix b'at ik'chajkot chi', hata' ix yuk' anh winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax masanil heb' ayoch yet' winh t'a wa'el chi'.
Masanil heb' ix cham yuj anh, ix yik'ancha'anh sdiosal heb' nab'a oro, plata, bronce, hierro, te te' yet' k'e'en k'e'en.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix cheklaj jun k'ab' anima b'aj sakk'inal yuj candil, ix och ijan stz'ib'anoch t'a sat pat chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun k'ab' stz'ib'an chi' winh rey,
sak ix aj sat winh yuj xiwelal. Ix luklonk'e yok winh, ix el wal yip winh.

Elanhchamel ix el yaw winh, ix yawtankot heb' naumel lolonel winh, heb' schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha mach syal yilan juntzanh tz'ib'ab'iloch chi', syalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, tz'ak'chajoch junok pichul púrpura t'ay, tz'ak'chajoch junok cadena oro t'a sjaj, tz'och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' jelan ayoch yopisio yak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix och heb' t'a yol jun cuarto, palta malaj wal junok heb' ix nachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix te xiw winhaj rey Belsasar chi', sak ix aj yilji sat winh. Haxo masanil heb' winh winak ayek' yet' winh ta', ix somchajpax sk'o'ol heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an ix reina, snun winh rey chi' yel yaw winh yet' pax heb' awtab'il, ix och ix t'a yol scuartoal b'aj ayoch k'inh chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej. Mokab' ak' pensar, mokab' ach sakb'ielpax yuj xiwelal,

yujto ha t'a yol a makb'en tik, ay jun winh syal snachajel yuj, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ha t'a yol stiempoal winh a mam icham, a jun winh winak chi', ix sch'ox wal winh to ay spensar winh te wach', ay spensar winh sik'lab'il icha yik heb' Dios. Yuj chi', a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor a mam icham, a winh ix ak'anoch jun winh chi' yajalilok heb' ay spensar, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal yet' heb' ajchum.

Daniel sb'i jun winh chi', haxo winh a mam icham chi' ix ak'an skuch winh Beltsasar. Te ay sjelanil winh yet' tas yojtak, yik snachajel wayich yuj winh, syal snachajpaxel yuj winh tas syalelk'och junok lolonel to ajaltak snachajeli yet' sb'o'an yaj junok tas to niwan yaji. Awtejkot winh an. Ha winh ol ak'an ojtakejel tas syalelk'och juntzanh tz'ib' t'a sat pat tik, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix awtaj winhaj Daniel chi', ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Daniel, aj Judá ik'b'ilkot preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor winh in mam icham?
Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, tob' ay a pensar, jelan ach.

Yuj chi' ix ach wawtej. Ix wawtej masanil heb' winh jelan yet' heb' naumel lolonel, yik syawtej juntzanh lolonel heb' tz'ib'ab'iloch tik yet' yalan heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, palta malaj wal junok heb' snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.

Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' syal ak'an cheklajel lolonel ajaltak snachajeli. Yuj chi' ta syal awtan juntzanh lolonel tik, tzalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, ol ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'ayach, ol ak'chajpaxoch junok cadena oro t'a a jaj, ol ach och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Kanokab' a silab' chi' t'ayach mamin rey. Syal ak'an jun opisio chi' t'a junokxo, palta ol wawtej jun tz'ib' tik, ol walan t'ayach tas wal syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a sat pat tik.
Mamin rey, ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ak'an yopisio winhaj Nabucodonosor a mam icham yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi, sb'inajnakil yet' stzikikial.

Yuj opisio ix ak'chaj chi' t'a winh, ix xiw masanil anima t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al, yujto niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a yol sat heb'. Ha mach snib'ej winh schami, schamnhej, haxo mach malaj snib'ej winh schami, max miljichamok. Ay pax mach ix ik'jiel t'a yopisio yuj winh, ay pax mach ix ak'jioch t'a yopisio, hato ha' tas snib'ej sk'o'ol winh.
Palta a wal yik ix yik'ancha'anh sb'a winh, ix ixtaxel sb'eyb'al winh. Ix ik'chajel winh t'a yopisio t'a reyal chi' yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Ix pechchajel winh t'a skal heb' yetanimail, ix ochkan spensar winh icha spensar nok' nok'. Junnhej ix aj winh yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ix sk'ux anh ank'ultak winh icha nok' wakax. Ix empax yal ak'wal t'a sniwanil winh, masanto ix yal snachajel yuj winh chajtil wal yaj Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajal to snib'ej syak'ochi.
Ha hachxo pax tik, mamin rey Belsasar, yixchikin ach winh, wach'chom ojtak tas ix uji chi', palta manh wal jab'ok tzik'em a b'a.

Palta yelxo ix ik'cha'anh a b'a t'a yichanh Jun Yajalil satcha'anh. Ix ak'an ik'chajkot juntzanh kopa t'a a mexa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' yik stemplo Jun Yajal satcha'anh chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix uk' wino yet' masanil heb' awtab'il u'uj. Ix eyik'cha'anh juntzanh Dios to max yal yilani, max yal yab'ani, malaj pax jab'ok tas yojtak. Manhok pax t'a Dios ix al wach' lolonel, ina a pax t'a yol sk'ab' ay a k 'inal, a pax sna'an tas tza k'ulej.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot Dios jun k'ab' ix tz'ib'an juntzanh lolonel tik,
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPARSIN.
Ha juntzanh tik icha tik syalelk'ochi: MENE: Toxo ix sb'is Dios jaye' k'u ayachto och t'a opisio, toxo ix sch'ox slajwub'.
TEKEL: Toxo ix ach echtaj t'a yol echlab', manh tz'akanok alil.
PERES: Ha a makb'en, wan spojchajb'ati, ix ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' Medo yet' heb' Persa, xchi winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Belsasar chi' ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix ak'chajoch jun cadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil anima to ha t'a jun rato chi', ix ochkan winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol smakb'en.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix miljicham winhaj Belsasar sreyal heb' caldeo chi'.
Haxo winhaj Darío aj Media ix yak'och sb'a yajalil sk'exulok winh. 62 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Darío chi'.
Ix yak'anoch 120 heb' winh gobernador winhaj Darío chi', yik syil junjun makan chonhab' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en.

Ix yak'anoch oxwanhxo sat yajal winh t'a heb' winh gobernador chi', yik syilan heb' winh yet' stanhwan masanil tastak, yik wach' tz'akan tz'aj yak'chaj k'e'en tumin syak' heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. T'a skal heb' winh sat yaj chi' ayoch winhaj Daniel chi'.
Ix cheklajel winhaj Daniel chi' t'a skal heb' winh yetyajalil chi', yujto wach'nhej syutej sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sna winh rey chi' to tz'och winh sat yajalil t'a yol smakb'en chi'.

Haxo juntzanh heb' winh yetyajalil winh chi', ix say modo heb' winh tas tz'aj yemta winh t'a yopisio chi'. Palta te k'anab'ajum winh, max elk'an winh t'a tas sk'ulej, ayoch spensar winh t'a yopisio chi'. Yuj chi' malaj junok tas syal yalank'e heb' winh t'a spatik winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh sna'ani, ix yalan heb' winh: Malaj wal junok tas syal kalank'e t'a spatik winh, anhej yuj sk'anab'ajan sDiosal winh, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh yajal chi', yik b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Darío chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey Darío, ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej.

Ix ko mol lajtiej ko b'a ko masanil a onh yajal onh tik t'a yol a makb'en tik. Ix ko na'ani to tzak'elta junok ley yik tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil anima t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik to malaj junok mach sk'anan skolwal sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo yetanimail t'a junok ujal, palta anhej t'ayach syal sb'a mamin rey. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun ley chi', tojolnhej syumjikanem b'aj makb'il nok' choj.
Yuj chi', mamin rey, ak' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', tzak'anoch a sello t'ay yik wach' malaj mach syal sk'exani. A' ko ley a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'ati, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Darío chi' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yopisio.

Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Daniel to toxo ix alchajel jun ley chi', ix k'enhej winh t'a yol spat t'a cha'anh, ix sjakanxi swentena winh k'elanb'at t'a stojolal Jerusalén. Ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Dios, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Oxel slesalwi winh t'a junjun k'u, ichataxon sk'ulej winh.
Haxo juntzanh heb' winh chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to wan slesalwi winh yet' stewi winh t'a Dios.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh yuj jun ley toxo ix alchajel chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Toton ix a chek alchajel jun ley tz'alan icha tik: Yalnhej mach syal sb'a t'a sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo ch'ok animail t'a junok ujal, tato manhok t'a winh rey syal tas snib'ej, yowalil syumchajem b'aj makb'il nok' choj, xchi. ¿Manh am yelok icha chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ichaton chi' ix aji. Ha jun ley chi' yowalil sk'anab'ajaji, a ko leyal a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'at tas syala', xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Daniel, winh ik'chajnakkot t'a Judá, max sk'anab'ajejlaj winh. Mamin rey, manh jab'ok xiw winh t'ayach, malaj pax jab'ok yelk'och jun ley chi' t'a winh. Toxo ix kila' to oxel slesalwi winh t'a sDiosal t'a junjun k'u, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey chi' icha chi', ix och winh t'a kusk'olal. Masanil jun k'uhal chi', ix sayek' winh tas tz'aj skolchajel winhaj Daniel chi'.
