--Ixikek t'a stemplo Dios. Tzex och t'a yol yamak'il. Tzex aj linhan ta', tzeyalanel wach' ab'ix yik k 'inal t'a junelnhej, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' toxo wan sakb'i ayik ix ochk'och heb' winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios chi', ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh ta'. Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi' yet' heb' winh yetb'eyum ix awtankot heb' winh sat yajal, haton jantaknhej heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' israel. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh polenkía heb', yik sb'at heb' winh yik'elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a preso.
Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a te' preso chi', manhxalaj mach ayek'i. Ixlajwi yilan heb' winh to manhxalaj mach, ix b'at yalan heb' winh icha tik:
--Ix kila', wach' yajoch sk'ab' te' preso chi'. Haxo heb' stanhwumal te' chi', linhanek' heb' t'a sti' te'. Palta haxo ix ko jakan te', ix kilani manhxalaj mach ayek' t'a yol te', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi', heb' yetb'eyum yet' pax winh yajal heb' winh stanhwumal stemplo Dios, ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix te sat sk'o'ol heb' winh. Maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas wal yaji.

Junanto rato chi' ix k'och junxo winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha heb' winh ix eyak'och t'a preso, ayxo ek' heb' winh t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios tiknaik. Wan sk'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', haxo winh yajal heb' stanhwan templo chi' yet' heb' winh polenkía, ix b'at heb' winh yik'kot heb' winh. Palta ak'ank'olal ix yutej heb' winh yik'ankot heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', yujto ix xiw heb' winh sjulk'enaj yuj heb' anima.
Ix b'at ak'ji heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Haxo winh sat sacerdote chi' ix halan t'a heb' winh.

--Ina ix cham wal kalan t'ayex to maxtzak he k'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jesús. ¿Tom max he k'anab'ajej? Ha tiknaik, ix te pukaxb'at he k'ayb'ub'al t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto he gana tze ch'oxelta to a onh ix ko milcham Jesús chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Pedro yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús, ix yalan heb' winh: --Yowalil a tas syal Dios, a sko k'anab'ajej. Haxo juntzanh scheknab'il anima, tato max scha sb'a yet' yik Dios, max ko k'anab'ajejlaj.

Ha ex tik ix eyak' miljokcham Jesús, ayik ix t'unhb'ajk'e t'a te' kulus. Palta a jun Dios b'aj yak'nak em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, hanheja' ko Diosal a onh tik. A' ix ak'an pitzwokxi Jesús chi' t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ha ix ak'an yopisio, ix yik'anb'at t'a swach'k'ab'. Ix yak'anoch Kajalok yet' ko Kolumalok, yik wach' sko na ko b'a a onh israel onh tik, yik slajwikan ko mul yuj.

Ha onh tik, skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh skal tik t'ayex. Hanhejtona' Yespíritu Dios syak' pax testigoal sb'a ket'ok. Ha Dios tz'ak'an Yespíritu tik t'a jantaknhej mach sk'anab'ajan tas syala', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh yajal chi', ix te kot yowal heb' winh. Ix snib'ej heb' winh smilcham heb' winh t'a elanhchamel.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh yajal chi' ay jun winh fariseo skuch Gamaliel ayek'i. Te k'ayb'um winh t'a sley Dios. B'inajnak winh t'a wach'il yuj heb' anima. Ix k'e linhan winh. Ix schekan winh ik'jokkanelta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' junok rato.
Ixlajwi yelkankot heb' winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ex wetisraelal, naek wal sik'lab'il tas tzeyutej he b'oan yaj juntzanh heb' winh tik.

Ko naekkot jun winh skuch Teudas ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Yak'nakoch sb'a winh yajalil t'a skal heb' anima. Yalannakel winh to te ay yopisio winh. Ay am junok chanhe' ciento winak ochnak yet' winh. Palta miljicham winh. Haxo jantak heb' ochnak yet' winh chi', saklemnakkanb'at heb'. Satnakpaxkanem jun yik heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun winh skuch Judas aj Galilea, yak'nakoch sb'a winh yak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal ayik ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' anima. Tzijtum anima ochnak yet' winh. Hanheja' ix miljipaxcham junxo winh chi'. Haxo jantaknhej heb' ochnak yet' winh, saklemnakpaxkanb'at heb'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, kaktejek kixtan heb' winh schekab' Jesús tik, yil heb' winh. Ha jun yik heb' winh tik, tato anhej heb' anima ay yiko', munil ol satxikanemok.
Palta tato ha Dios ay yiko', manh ol yal-laj kak'an lajwok. Ay smay to wan kak'an owal yet' Dios chi', xchi winh.

Ix sna'an heb' winh yajal chi' to te yel syal winh. Yuj chi' ix awtajxioch heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh to smak'ji heb' winh. Ix yalanpax heb' winh t'a heb' winh to maxtzak yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix aktajel heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Te wach' ix yab' heb' winh, yujto yujnhej Jesús ix yab' sya'il heb' winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Masanil k'u ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh to Cristo toni, syalelk'ochi Jun Sik'b'ilel yuj Dios. Ix laj ek' yalel heb' winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios yet' t'a kaltak pat.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb' creyente. Palta a heb' creyente aj Grecia, ix kot yowal heb' t'a heb' creyente aj Israel, yujto ayik tz'ak'ji wa heb' meb'a' t'a junjun k'u, manh tz'akanok tz'ak'ji swa'el heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum aj Grecia chi'.
Yuj chi' ix awtajkot heb' creyente smasanil yuj heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh smojok skaktejkan kalanel slolonel Dios tik yik haxonhej wa'el tik skila'.

Yuj chi', ex wuk'tak, tze say ukwanhok winak t'a ko kal tik, tzeyak'anoch yopisio heb' sb'o'an jun munlajel tik. Ha heb' tze say chi', haton heb' te wach' sb'eyb'al, heb' snachaj wal el yik Dios yuj, heb' te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet'ok.
Ha onhxo tik, hanheja' ol onh lesalwok, ol kalanpaxel slolonel Dios, xchi heb' lajchawanh chi'.

Ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil yuj jun lolonel chi'. Haxo heb' winh ix sik'jiel chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Esteban, te ay wal och spensar winh t'a Dios, te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, winhaj Felipe, winhaj Prócoro, winhaj Nicanor, winhaj Timón, winhaj Parmenas yet' winhaj Nicolás aj Antioquía. Ha winhaj Nicolás tik, ochnak winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ixlajwi sik'jielta heb' winh chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh schekab' Jesús. Haxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' ix lesalwi yuj heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxek' sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sjolom heb' winh.
Haxo slolonel Dios ix te pukaxb'at t'a skal heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb' creyente t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo winhaj Esteban chi', niwan swach'k'olal Dios ix scha winh. Ix och wal Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' tzijtum milagro ix sch'oxel winh t'a skal heb' anima.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' israel smolb'ej sb'a t'a jun spatil culto skuch Yik heb' Ak'b'ilxokanel t'a Libre. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' aj chonhab' Cirene, heb' aj Alejandría, heb' aj Cilicia yet' heb' aj Asia. Ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi'. Ix stelan sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Palta maj yak'laj ganar winh heb', yujto a Espíritu Santo ix ak'an sjelanil winh.

Haxo heb' chi', tonhej ix sman jaywanh stestigo heb'. Ix ak'ji sk'o'ol heb' yuj heb', yik syal heb' icha tik: --Ix kab' sb'uchwaj winhaj Esteban tik t'a spatik winh ko mam kicham aj Moisés yet' t'a Dios, xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix yutej heb' stzuntzan cha'anh heb' chonhab', heb' ichamtak winak yet' heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Yuj chi' ix kot juknaj heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi', ix syaman winh heb', xit' yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix manji juntzanhxo heb' tz'ak'anoch es t'a yib'anh winhaj Esteban chi' yuj heb'. Ix stz'akan yal heb' icha tik t'a heb' winh yajal chi': --Ha winhaj Esteban tik, max yaktejkan winh sb'uchwaj t'a jun templo yiknhej Dios yaj tik. Sb'uchwaj pax winh t'a ley Moisés.
Ix kab' yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jesús aj Nazaret ol pojanem stemplo Dios tik. Ol k'exchaj juntzanh ko b'eyb'al ak'b'ilkan t'ayonh yuj Moisés chi', xchi winh, xchi heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yajal chi' yet' heb' k'ojanem ta' smasanil, ix och k'elan heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi', ix yilanoch sat winh heb', lajan yilji icha sat junok ángel.
Haxo winh sat sacerdote ix k'anb'an t'a winhaj Esteban chi': --¿Yel am juntzanh ix yal heb' tik? xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Esteban chi' icha tik: --Ex wetchonhab' yet' ex ichamtak winak, ab'ek nab'i. Ha Dios, te niwan yelk'ochi. Sch'oxnak sb'a t'a winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham ayik ayek' winh t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, ayik manto k'och kajan winh t'a chonhab' Harán.
Yalannak Dios chi' icha tik t'a winh: Aktejkan lum a lu'um tik yet' jantak heb' a k'ab' ok. Ixik t'a junxo lugar ol in ch'ox t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Slajwi chi', yaktannakkan slugar heb' caldeo winh b'aj ayek' chi'. Haxo t'a chonhab' Harán k'ochnakkan kajan winh. Haxo yik schamnak winh smam winh, yik'jinakkot winh yuj Dios t'a jun lugar b'aj ay onh ek' tik.

Palta malaj jab'ok lu'um yak'nak Dios chi' yikok winh t'a tik. Malaj jab'ok ak'jinak t'a winh, palta yak'nakkan sti' Dios chi' t'a winh, ayik yalannakkan icha tik: Ol wak' jun a lu'um. Haxo yik ol ach chamok, ol kan jun a lu'um chi' yikok heb' inhtilal, xchi Dios chi' t'a winh. Ayik mantalaj junok yuninal winh, hata' yalnakkan jun chi' Dios.

Yalannakpaxkan Dios chi' icha tik t'a winh: Ha heb' inhtilal ol k'och kajan heb' t'a yol yik junxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol ak'jok och heb' schekab'ok heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Chanhe' ciento ab'il ol yab' sya'il heb' yuj heb'.
Palta a in ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol elta heb' inhtilal chi' t'a jun lugar chi', ol in yak'an serwil heb' t'a jun lugar tik, xchinak Dios chi'.

Hanhejtona', yak'nakxikan sti' Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Yalannakkan t'a winh to tz'och jun yechel t'a sniwanil winh yet' t'a jantaknhej heb' yinhtilal winh, yik wach' scheklajeli to ay strato Dios yet' heb'. Ha jun yechel chi', haton jun skuch circuncisión. Yuj chi', ayik yalji jun yuninal winhaj Abraham skuch Isaac, yukub'ixial yalji, yak'ji circuncidar yuj winhaj Abraham chi'. Hanhejtona' yalji pax jun yuninal winhaj Isaac chi' skuch Jacob, ak'jipax circuncidar yuj winhaj Isaac chi'. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi', lajchawanh heb' yuninal winh aljinak. Laj ak'ji circuncidar heb' smasanil. Ha heb' lajchawanh chi', haton heb' ko mam kicham a onh israel onh tik.

Ha t'a skal heb' ko mam kicham chi', ay jun winh yuk'tak heb' skuchan José. Ha junel meltzajoch heb' yuk'tak winhaj José chi' ajk'olal t'ay. Yuj chi' schonhb'at winh heb' t'a Egipto, palta haxo Dios och yet' winh.

Ha Dios chi' kolanelta winh t'a skal juntzanh sya'elal. Yak'an sjelanil t'a winh. Och yet' winh, yik wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh winh sreyal heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' yak'och yopisio winhaj José chi' winh yoch yajalil t'a Egipto chi'. Hanhejtona', yak'och winhaj José chi' winh yilumalok spat.

Palta ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ja jun niwan wejel t'a yib'anh masanil heb' aj Egipto chi' yet' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Canaán. Te ya' ek' heb' yuj jun wejel chi'. Icha pax chi' heb' ko mam kicham ay t'a Canaán chi', manhxa b'aj wach' skot tas syab'lej heb'.
Haxo yab'an winhaj Jacob chi' to ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' schekb'at heb' yuninal winh chi' ta', haton heb' ko mam kicham. Sb'ab'elalto heb' b'at t'a jun chi'.
Haxo schekjixib'at heb' t'a schaelal, hato ta' yal winhaj José chi' t'a heb' to yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' heb'. Icha chi' aj yojtakanel winhaj Faraón chi' mach heb' yetchonhab' winhaj José chi'.
Haxo winhaj José chi' chekan ik'jib'at winhaj Jacob t'ay, haton winh smam winh. Schekan ik'jib'at heb' yuk'tak yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' smasanil, 75 sb'isul heb'.
Icha chi' aj sk'och winhaj Jacob chi' t'a Egipto chi'. Hata' cham winh. Junjunal champax heb' ko mam kicham chi' ta'.

Ichato chi' yik'jixikot sniwanil winh chi' yuj heb' junelxo t'a chonhab' Siquem. Haxo ta' ak'jinakoch sniwanil heb' chi' t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en. Ha jun k'e'en chi', atax winhaj Abraham manannakkanel k'e'en t'a heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor aj chonhab' Siquem chi'.

Haxo yik wanxo sk'och stiempoal yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi', ayik yak'annakkan sti' t'a winh, k'ib'cha'anh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal winh t'a Egipto chi'. Te tzijtum aj sb'isul heb' ta'.
k'ojank'olalto och junxo winh sreyal heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ha jun winh chi', manhxo yojtakok yab'ixal winhaj José chi' winh.

Ha jun winh rey chi', yixtejnak wal heb' ko mam kicham chi' winh. Yak'nak wal chukal winh t'a heb'. Yalannak winh t'a heb' to yowalil syumel jantaknhej heb' swinak unin heb' tzato alji, yik munil syak'cham sb'a heb' b'aj sb'at yumjikanel chi'.
Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' alji winhaj Moisés. Te wach' aj winh t'a yichanh Dios. Oxenhej ujal k'ib'tzitaj winh yuj smam snun t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi', yaktajkan winh yuj ix snun icha syal jun ley chi'. Haxo jun ix yisil winh rey chi' ilanelta winh. Yik'anb'at winh ix t'a spat. Sk'ib'tzitan winh ix icha wal junok yune'.
Haxo winhaj Moisés chi' sk'ayb'ej winh jantaknhej tas yojtak heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' te jelan aj slolon winh. Jelan pax aj winh sk'ulan masanil tastak.
Ayik 40 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh, sja t'a spensar winh b'at yilan heb' yetchonhab', haton heb' ketisraelal.

Haxo sk'och winh, yilan winh to ay jun winh aj Egipto chi' wan yak'an chukal t'a jun winh yetchonhab' winh. Yuj chi' och winh yet' winh. Haxo winh ak'anek' spak winh yetchonhab' chi' ayik smak'ancham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.
Sna'an winhaj Moisés chi' to snachajel yuj heb' yetchonhab' winh chi' to ha Dios wan yak'lab'an winh yik skolankanel heb'. Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u sk'och winh t'a chawanhxo heb' yetchonhab'. Yilan winh to wan stzuntzan sb'a heb'. Ha snib'ej winhaj Moisés chi' to tz'och heb' t'a junk'olal, yuj chi' yal winh t'a heb': Ex wetchonhab', ¿tas yuj tzeyak' owal? Ina eyetchonhab' he b'a, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Palta haxo winh wan yak'an owal chi' ik'anel winhaj Moisés chi'. Yalan winh t'a winh: ¿Mach ix ach ak'anoch juezal, yik tzonh ak'an mandar?
¿Tom a gana tzin a mak'paxchamok icha utej jun winh aj Egipto ewi? xchi winh.
Slajwinhej yab'an jun chi' winhaj Moisés chi', sb'atkan winh elelal. Sk'ochkan kajan winh t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Madián. Haxo ta' alji chawanh yuninal winh.
Ayxom 40 ab'ilok sk'och winh ta', sb'at winh t'a tzalan Sinaí, b'aj malaj anima. Haxo ta' sch'ox sb'a jun ángel t'a winh. Ayek' t'a skal jun k'ak' b'aj wan stz'a jun te' k'i'ix.
Haxo yik yilanb'at jun chi' winh, tonhej te sat sk'o'ol winh. Yuj chi' b'at winh yilb'ati, haxo Dios Kajal halan t'a winh:

Ha in ton tik, jun Dios b'aj yak'nak em sb'a heb' a mam icham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi t'a winh. Haxo winhaj Moisés chi', te ib'xik'e winh yuj xiwelal. Majxo ochlaj k'elan winh t'ay.
Yalan Dios Kajal chi' t'a winh: Kichel a xanhab', yujto ha t'a jun lugar b'aj ayach ek' tik, a inton ayinek' t'ay.

Ha heb' in chonhab' ayek' t'a Egipto, swila' to wan yab'an sya'il heb' ta'. Swab'anpaxi to sk'akwi heb' yab'an sya'il. Yuj chi' in jawi wik'elta heb' t'a skal sya'elal chi'. Yuj chi', ixik. Ol ach in chekb'at t'a Egipto chi', xchi Dios chi' t'a winh.

T'a peka' maj chajoklaj winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Malaj ochnak winh t'a heb'. Yalannak heb' t'a winh: ¿Mach ach ak'anoch juezal, yuj chi' tzonh ak' mandar? xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ha Dios ak'an yopisio winh yak'an mandar heb'. Yak'jipax yopisio winh yik syik'elta heb' t'a skal ya'elal chi'. Ha jun ángel sch'ox sb'a t'a winh t'a skal te' k'i'ix chi', a och yet' winh.
Haton winhaj Moisés chi' ik'annakelta heb' ketchonhab' t'a Egipto chi'. 40 ab'il sch'oxnak juntzanh milagro winh t'a Egipto chi' yet' t'a ha' Chakchak Mar yet' pax t'a tzinan lu'um.
Haton winh alannak icha tik t'a heb' ketisraelal chi': Ha Dios ol sik'anelta jun schekab' t'a skal heb' ketchonhab' icha ix yutej in sik'anelta a in tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ek'nak winh yet' heb' ko mam kicham t'a jun takinh lu'um. Aypaxek' jun ángel yet' heb', haton jun lolonnak yet' winh t'a tzalan Sinaí. Ha t'a winhaj Moisés chi', hata' yalnakkan juntzanh lolonel Dios tz'ak'an ko k 'inal. Haxo winh alannakkan t'ayonh.
Palta a heb' ko mam kicham chi', maj yal sk'o'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej tas yal winh chi'. Yuj chi' spatikejel winh heb'. Snib'ej heb' meltzaj t'a Egipto.
Yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: B'o juntzanhok ko diosal yik tzonh skuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés chi', jun winh ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', sb'o'an jun k'e'en heb' icha kelem wakax. Ha jun chi' yak'och heb' sdiosalok. Smilanpax juntzanh nok' nok' heb' silab'ok t'ay. Yak'anoch sk'inhal jun sdiosal heb' sb'o chi'.

Yuj chi', yik'el sb'a Dios t'a skal heb'. Aktajkan heb' sch'okoj yik wach' syak'em sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh k'anal ay t'a satcha'anh. Stz'ib'ejnakkan jun schekab' Dios icha tik: Ex israel, ayik yek'nak 40 ab'il heb' he mam eyicham t'a tzinan lu'um, manhok t'ayin snhusnak silab' heb' yet' yofrenda.

Malaj jab'ok tas eyak'nak t'ayin. Palta a jun he diosal skuch Moloc, b'akhb'il yet'tal eyu'uj yet' jun yechel k'anal skuch Renfán, a juntzanh chi' eyalnak och he diosalok. Ha t'a juntzanh yechel he b'onak chi', hata' eyalnak he b'a. Yuj chi' ol ex wik'kanel t'a jun he lu'um tik, haxo ex wak'ankanb'at t'a yichanhb'at Babilonia, xchikan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Palta ayik yek'nak heb' ko mam kicham chi' t'a tzinan lu'um chi', yet'nak jun yet'tal sley Dios heb'. Haton jun yet'tal chi' b'onakkan yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ajnak yalan Dios chi' t'a winh, ayik sch'oxannak jun yechel t'a winh.

Ha jun yet'tal chi', k'ojank'olal kannak t'a juntzanhxo heb' ko mam kicham. Haxo winhaj Josué ik'annakkot jun chi' yet' heb'. Ayik yikannak jun slu'um heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tik heb', haton heb' pechb'ilel yuj Dios. Ha jun yet'tal sley Dios chi', yet'nak heb', masanto ochnak winhaj David sreyalok heb'.
Ha winhaj David chi', te niwan swach'k'olal Dios schanak winh. Yuj chi', snib'ej winh sb'onak jun stemplo Dios, haton jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a winhaj Jacob, haton pax ko Diosal.
Palta hato wal winhaj Salomón b'oannak stemplo Dios chi',
wach'chom ha Dios yelxo wal te niwan yelk'ochi, max aj t'a junok templo b'ob'il yuj heb' anima. Yalnakkan jun schekab' t'a peka' icha tik:
Ha satcha'anh, haton in despacho. Haxo yol yib'anhk'inal, icha sk'anh wok yaji. Yuj chi', ¿tasto wal ol eyutok he b'oan junok in templo? Malaj junok lugar b'aj syal wik'an wip.
Yujto a in ix in b'o masanil juntzanh tik, xchi Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Palta a ex tik, te pit ex. Lajan wal he pensar yet' heb' manh ojtannakok Dios. Max eyak'och he chikin t'a slolonel. Tonhej tze makoch wa'an Yespíritu Dios. Yuj chi', lajan ex yet' heb' ko mam kicham chi'.

Ina heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', laj yab'nak sya'il heb' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Haton heb' schekab' Dios chi' alannakkani to ol jawok winh tojol spensar, palta milb'ilcham heb' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Haxo ix jawi jun tojol spensar chi', a exxo ix eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix eyak'an miljokchamok.
Wach'chom ak'b'ilkan juntzanh scheknab'il Dios t'ayex yuj heb' ángel, palta max he k'anab'ajej, xchi winhaj Esteban chi' t'a heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix te och pitz'an t'a spixan heb', ix kot yowal heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi'. Ix sk'ux wal ye heb' skot yowal.

Palta haxo winhaj Esteban chi', te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' ix k'e k'elan winh t'a satcha'anh, ix yilank'e stzikikial Dios winh. Ix yilan winh to linhanek' Jesús t'a swach'k'ab' Dios chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Inai, a swilani to jakan spuertail satcha'anh. Swilani to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch animail, linhanek' t'a swach' k'ab' Dios chi' tiknaik, xchi winh.
Haxo heb' ayek' ta', ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yawaji. Ix smakan schikin heb'. Ix kot nhilnaj heb' t'a winh, ix jachjiel winh t'a stiel chonhab' yuj heb'.

Ha heb' ix ak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winhaj Esteban chi', ix skichel spatik sk'apak junjun heb', ix yak'ankanb'at heb' t'a jun winh skuch Saulo, yik wach' a winh tz'ilankani. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' sjulancham winhaj Esteban chi' yet' k'e'en k'e'en.
Ayik wan sjulk'enan cham winh chi' heb', ix lesalwi winh t'a Dios. --Mamin Jesús, cha in pixan, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix em kuman winh. Te cha'anh ix yutej sjaj winh slesalwi t'a Dios: --Mamin, manh ak'kanoch jun smul heb' tik t'a yib'anh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix cham winh.

Te lokan winhaj Saulo yet' heb' ix milancham winhaj Esteban chi'. Haton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix och ijan heb' anima yak'anoch sya'elal heb' creyente t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yab'an wal sya'il heb' sik'lab'il. Yuj chi' ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' t'a yol yik Judea yet' Samaria. Haxonhej heb' schekab' Jesús ix kan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix lajwinhej scham winhaj Esteban chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh ayoch spensar t'a Dios ix ik'anb'at sniwanil winh chi', ix b'at smukanem winh heb'. Ix te ok' heb' winh yuj winh.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix yak' wal chukal winh t'a heb' creyente. Yalnhej b'aj ayek' heb', ix laj och winh t'a yol spat heb'. Ix laj yik'elta heb' winh winak winh yet' heb' ix ix, ix b'at yak'anoch heb' winh t'a preso.
Haxo heb' creyente ix el t'a Jerusalén, ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Masanil b'ajtak ix laj k'och heb' ix laj yalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb'.
Ay jun winh skuch Felipe ix k'och t'a jun chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix yalkanel yab'ixal Cristo winh t'a skal heb'.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix smaklej wal yab' heb' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix yilanpax juntzanh milagro heb' ix sb'o winh.

Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzijtum heb' anima ayoch heb' enemigo t'ay, haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix laj ik'anel heb' t'a heb'. Ix laj el yaw heb' yel t'a heb'. Tzijtum heb' sikb'inakeli yet' heb' max yal sb'eyi, ix laj b'oxikan heb' yuj winh.
Yuj juntzanh chi' ix te tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' anima smasanil t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Palta ay jun winh winak skuch Simón ta'. Ste ak'ej wal musansatil heb' anima winh, yujto te niwan yelk'och winh yalani, ay tas syal yuj winh yalani.
Masanil heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwan yelk'ochi, jun lajan syak'och spensar heb' t'a winh, syalan heb': --Ha winhaj Simón, haton jun Dios skuchan Niwan Spoder, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Syak' wal och spensar heb' t'a winh, yujto pekatax syamnakoch winh yak'an musansatil heb', syalan winh to tzuji yuj.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix alanel t'a skal heb' tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix yalanel yab'ixal Jesucristo winh t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ay heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix scha'an sbautismo heb'.

Icha pax chi' winhaj Simón chi', ix yak'och slolonel Dios winh t'a sk'o'ol. Ix scha'an pax sbautismo winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', junxonhej ix ek' winh yet' winhaj Felipe chi'. Ay juntzanh milagro ix sch'ox winhaj Felipe chi', te niwan yelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix te sat sk'o'ol winhaj Simón chi' yilani.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús ayek' t'a Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an heb' to ay heb' aj Samaria ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'o'ol, ix schekb'at winhaj Pedro heb' yet' winhaj Juan yil heb'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix lesalwi heb' winh yuj heb' creyente aj Samaria chi', yik wach' tz'ak'ji Espíritu Santo t'a heb',
yujto manta junok heb' scha'ani. Anhejanto t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús b'aj ix ak'ji bautizar heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix ak'anek' sk'ab' t'a sjolom heb'. Ichato chi' ix scha'ankan Espíritu Santo chi' heb'.
Ix yilan winhaj Simón chi' to ayik ix yak'anek' sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sjolom heb' creyente chi', ix schakan Espíritu Santo heb', yuj chi' ix yaltej tumin winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek wopisio heyet'ok yik wach' yalnhej mach ol wak'ek' in k'ab' t'a sjolom, ol schakan Espíritu Santo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro t'a winh: --Ach satokab'el yet' k'e'en a tumin chi', yujto a jun tas syak' Dios t'a nab'anhej ix a nib'ej a man yet' jab' a tumin tik.
Malaj halan ik ket'ok. Malaj och t'a jun kopisio tik, yujto manh tojolok a pensar t'a yichanh Dios.
Yuj chi' na a b'a yuj jun a chukal tik. k'an t'a Dios, tope ol ach yak' niwank'olal yuj tas wan a na'an tik.
Yujto swila' to anhej chichonk'olal tza na'a, yujto anhej chukal wan ak'an serwil, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi winh: --Tze k'an wal t'a Dios Kajal wu'uj, yik manh ol jawok jun ya'elal tzeyal tik t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi', ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ix yalanpaxel slolonel Dios Kajal heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', yakb'an wan smeltzajxib'at heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, tzijtum juntzanh yunetak chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria chi' b'aj ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.

Ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix halan icha tik t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ak' lista a b'a. Ixik t'a sur, t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén, sk'och t'a chonhab' Gaza, xchi. Ha jun b'e chi', haton jun tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um.

Yuj chi', ix yak' lista sb'a winh, ix b'at winh. Haxo t'a yol b'e chi', ix yil-laj sb'a winh yet' jun winh aj Etiopía. Ha jun winh chi' ay yopisio winh yuj ix Candace, ix yajal yaj t'a Etiopía chi'. Sik'um tumin yaj winh t'a ix. Ix xit'ek' winh yak'em sb'a t'a Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Wan spax winh t'a Etiopía chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol jun scarruaje. Wan yilan Slolonel Dios winh tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías, haton winh schekab' Dios.
Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ixik, nitzb'at a b'a t'a stz'ey jun carruaje chi', xchi.

Haxo ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey, ix yab'an winh to wan yawtan Slolonel Dios winh, haton jun tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --¿Tzam nachajel u'uj tas wan awtan chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Tato malaj mach tzin k'ayb'ani, ¿tas ol aj snachajel wu'uj? ¿Max am yal a k'eta t'a yol carruaje tik yik tzach em k'ojan wet'ok? xchi winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi'

Ha Slolonel Dios wan yawtan winh chi', haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj ol b'at chamok, icha chi' ol aj yik'jib'at jun Schekab' Dios Kajal schami. Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'innhej xchi sjoxchaji, icha pax chi' ol ajok.
Te k'ixwelal ol yutej heb'. Toxonton manh ol sb'o yaj jab'ok heb' t'ay. Malaj junok mach ol alanok tato ay yinhtilal ol kanok, yujto ol miljokchamok, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Al t'ayin, ¿mach ay yab'ixal jun yalnakkan winh schekab' Dios chi'? ¿Tom a yab'ixal winh yalnakkani, ma to ch'ok junokxo mach yalnakkan yab'ixal winh? xchi winh aj Etiopía chi'.
Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix halan t'a winh tas syalelk'och Slolonel Dios chi'. Ix syamanoch winh yalan yab'ixal Jesucristo t'a winh.
Ayik wan sb'at heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ha ha'. Ix yalan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a winh: Ina jun ha ha' tik, ¿max am yal in ak'ankan bautizar tiknaik? xchi winh.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan winh to syamjioch wa'an jun scarruaje winh chi'. Ix em heb' winh schawanhil t'a yol jun ha ha' chi'. Haxo ta' ix ak'jikan bautizar winh.

Ayik ix lajwi sk'exta heb' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ik'anb'at winhaj Felipe chi'. Yuj chi' majxo iljilaj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi', majxo yil-laj winh b'aj ix k'och winh. Palta te tzalajk'olal ix b'atxikan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yol b'e chi'.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi', ha t'a chonhab' Azoto ix k'och winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'atxi winh. Ix laj ek' yalankanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il winh t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', masanto ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea.
Haxo winhaj Saulo, max yaktej winh yalani to ol smilcham heb' tz'ak'anoch Jesús Kajal t'a sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ix k'och winh t'a winh sat sacerdote.

Ix sk'anan juntzanh ch'anh carta winh, yik syik'anb'at ch'anh winh t'a yoltak spatil culto ay t'a chonhab' Damasco. Ha juntzanh carta chi' tz'ak'an sderecho winh yik syaman jantaknhej heb' syak'och spensar t'a Jesús, wach'chom winak ma ix, yik syik'kot heb' winh preso t'a Jerusalén.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh, palta haxo yik wan sk'och winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', ix emul kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel. Ix yalan icha tik: --Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'a winh.
--Mamin, ¿mach ach? xchi winh. --Ha in ton tik Jesús in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej.
--K'e'anh wa'an, ixik t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' ol alchaj t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Saulo chi', ix wanaj heb' winh, ix sat sk'ol heb' winh yuj xiwelal. Ix yab' heb' winh to ay mach sloloni, palta malaj mach ix yil heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e wa'an winhaj Saulo chi' t'a sat lu'um. Haxo yik ix elta k'elan winh, majxo yal-laj yilan jab'ok winh. Yuj chi' a heb' winh yetb'eyum winh ix yaman sk'ab', ix sketzanb'at winh heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Haxo ix k'och winh ta', oxe' k'uhal majxo yal-laj yilan winh. Majxo walaj winh. Majxo yuk'paxlaj ha' winh.
Ha t'a Damasco chi' ay jun winh creyente skuchan Ananías, haxo Jesús Kajal ix halan t'a winh icha t'a wayichal icha tik: --Ach Ananías, xchi. --Tik ay in Mamin, xchi winh.
--Ixik t'a jun calle skuch Tojol. Ayik tzach k'och t'a spat winhaj Judas, tza k'anb'an t'a winh yuj winhaj Saulo aj Tarso. Ol hilani to wan slesalwi winh.
Ay jun tas ix in ch'ox t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to a ach ol ach k'ochok, ol ak'anek' a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh, yik wach' ol jakwokxikan sat winh, xchi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh.
Palta haxo ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzijtum mach ix halan t'ayin yuj winhaj Saulo chi'. Ha t'a Jerusalén manh jantakok chukal ix yak' winh t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.
Xal tiknaik ix ja winh t'a tik, yik syamji jantaknhej heb' syal sb'a t'ayach yuj winh, yujto ak'b'il yopisio winh yuj heb' winh sat sacerdote, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, yujto a winhaj Saulo chi', ix in sik'el winh, yik wach' ol yalel in lolonel winh t'a skal heb' manh israelok, t'a yichanh heb' rey yet' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha in ol in ch'ox t'a winh, jantak sya'elal yowalil ol yab' winh wu'uj, xchi Jesús Kajal chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Ananías chi' t'a jun pat chi'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix och winh t'a yo'ol. Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wuk'tak Saulo, a Kajal Jesús, jun ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayach t'a yol b'e b'aj ach jawi chi', ha' in chekankot t'ayach, yik wach' ol jakwokxi a sat, haxo yochkan Espíritu Santo t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
Junanto rato chi' ix elta tziknaj juntzanh icha stumin nok' chay ayoch t'a yol sat winh, ichato chi' ix b'oxikan yilan winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh, ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wa winh, ix yik'anxi yip winh. Ix aj jaye' k'uhal winh yet' heb' creyente t'a Damasco chi'.
Ha winhaj Saulo chi', ix syamoch winh yalel slolonel Dios t'a yoltak spatil culto. Ix yalan winh to a Jesús, Yuninal ton Dios.

Jantaknhej heb' ix ab'an yalan winh, ix te sat sk'o'ol heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Haton jun winh tik ix ak'anoch sya'elal heb' syal sb'a t'a Jesús t'a Jerusalén. Ha ko na'ani to sja winh ul syam heb' creyente t'a tik, yik syik'b'at heb' winh t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote, xchi heb'.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix ste ak'ej yip winh yalaneli, yik wach' scheklajeli to a Jesús t'a wal yel Cristo toni, haton jun tanhwab'il yuj heb'. Haxo heb' israel aj Damasco chi', maj nachajel jab'ok yuj heb' tas syutej heb' spakan t'a winh.
Ayik niwanxo tiempo ix ek'i, ix slajtian sb'a heb' israel t'a spatik winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'.
Palta ix yab' spekal winh to k'uhal t'ak'wal stanhwan heb' t'a juntzanh b'e sb'at t'a stiel chonhab', yik hata' smilcham winh heb' sna'ani.
Yuj chi', a heb' creyente ix ak'anem winh t'a yol jun xu'uk, haxo t'a swentenail smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix yak'em t'unhunhok winh heb' t'ak'walil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajel winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och winhaj Saulo chi' t'a Jerusalén, ix snib'ej winh smolb'ej sb'a yet' heb' creyente ta', palta tonhej ix xiwk'e heb' smasanil t'a winh. Maj schalaj yab' heb' tato yel creyentexo winh.

Palta a jun winh skuch Bernabé ix ik'anb'at winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha winhaj Saulo tik, ix yil Kajal Jesús winh t'a yol b'e. Ix lolonpax Kajal Jesús chi' yet' winh. Yuj chi' malaj mach b'aj ix xiw winh yalanel yab'ixal Jesús t'a chonhab' Damasco chi', xchi winhaj Bernabé chi'.
Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj Saulo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Junnhej ix ek' winh yet' heb' creyente ta'.
Ix ste tek'b'an sb'a winh yalanel yab'ixal Kajal Jesús. Ix stelan sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal tz'alan sti' heb' griego. Palta a heb' chi', ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik smilancham winh heb'.
Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb' creyente, ix yik'anb'at winhaj Saulo chi' heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ixlajwi sk'och heb' yet' winh ta', ix schekankanb'at winh heb' t'a chonhab' Tarso.

Ichato chi', ix och wa'an spechji b'eyek' heb' creyente t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judea, t'a yol yik Galilea yet' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix laj stek'b'itan sb'a heb'. Te na'annhej Kajal Jesús yuj heb'. Ix och Yespíritu Dios yet' heb', yuj chi' ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb'.
Ha junel, ayik ix ek' winhaj Pedro yil heb' yetcreyenteal, ix k'och winh t'a heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Lida.
Hata' ix ilchaj jun winh skuch Eneas yuj winh. Swajxakilxo ab'il stelwikan winh, yujto sikb'inakel winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --Ach Eneas, swal t'ayach, a Jesucristo tz'ak'an b'oxok a k'o'ol. Yuj chi' k'e'anh wa'an, pak a waynub' tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'e wan winh.
Haxo heb' anima smasanil aj Lida chi' yet' heb' aj Sarón, ix yil heb' to ix b'oxikan winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb', ix yak'anoch spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús.
Ha t'a chonhab' Jope, ay jun ix creyente skuchan Tabita. Haxo t'a ti' griego Dorcas sb'i ix. Te wach' ix, skolwaj ix t'a heb' meb'a'.
Haxo t'a jun tiempo chi', ix yamchaj ix yuj jun yab'il, ix cham ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'ikchajel sniwanil ix, ix ik'jik'e t'a yol jun cuarto t'a cha'anh.

Ha jun chonhab' Jope chi', ha t'a slak'anil chonhab' Lida ay, haton b'aj ayek' winhaj Pedro chi'. Haxo ix yab'an heb' creyente to hata' ayek' winh, ix schekanb'at chawanh winak heb' t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Kotanh, konh ket'ok t'a Jope wal tiknaik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb' winh. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix ik'jik'e winh t'a jun cuarto b'aj ay sniwanil ix Dorcas chi'. Hata' molanek' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Wan yok' heb' ix yuj ix. Ay juntzanh spichul heb' ix yet' juntzanh skamix sb'onak ix Dorcas chi' ayik pitzanto ix. Ix sch'oxan juntzanh chi' heb' ix t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.

Haxo winh ix chekanxiemta heb' smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh. Ix och k'elan winh t'a ix Dorcas chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ach Tabita, swal t'ayach, k'e'anh wa'an, xchi winh t'a ix. Haxo ix elta k'elan ix. Ix yilanoch winhaj Pedro chi' ix, ix k'e k'ojan ix.
Ha winh ix yaman sk'ab' ix. Ix sketzank'e wa'an ix winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtanxik'e heb' ix ix chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' creyente. Ix sch'oxanelta ix winh t'a heb' to ix pitzwixi ix.
Haxo heb' aj Jope chi', ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'o'ol.
Ha winhaj Pedro chi', ixto ek' jayexo k'uhal winh t'a Jope chi', haxo t'a spat jun winh skuchan Simón smunlaj yet' nok' tz'um ix aj winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ay jun winh skuch Cornelio, yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado skuchan aj Italia.
Syak' wal och spensar winh t'a Dios. Te ay xiwk'olal winh t'ay yet' jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh yet'ok. Tzijtum tas syak'pax winh t'a heb' israel te meb'a'. Slesalwi wal winh t'a Dios.
Haxo junel t'a tz'eymajk'uhalxo, ix yilan winh icha t'a wayich, ay jun yángel Dios ayoch t'a yol jun cuarto b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'a winh: --Cornelio, xchi.

Ix och k'elan winh t'ay. Ix te xiw winh yuj. --Mamin, ¿tas tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh: --Ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix yilanpax juntzanh a silab' ix ak' t'a heb' meb'a'. Maj satlaj sk'o'ol t'a juntzanh chi'.
Ha , chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak t'a chonhab' Jope, yik b'at yik'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, haton winh skuchpax Pedro.
Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'u'um. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi spax jun ángel chi', ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi' yet' pax jun winh soldado yak'umaltaxon serwil winh yaji. Ha jun winh soldado chi', anhej t'a Dios ayoch spensar winh.
Jantaknhej tas ix yal jun ángel chi', ix laj yal winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u t'a chimk'uhalil, ayik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a slak'anil Jope chi', haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix k'e winh lesal t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix och swejel winh. Ix sk'anan wa sb'a winh. Palta haxo yik wan to sb'oji tas ol yab'lej winh chi', icha t'a wayichal
ix aj yilan winh sjakwi satcha'anh. Haxo ix yilan winh ichato ay jun k'apak yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat b'aj ayek' winh chi'.
Haxo t'a yol jun k'apak chi', hata' ayoch junjun makan nok' nok'. Ay nok' chanhe' yok. Ay pax nok' chan yet' nok' much.
Ixlajwi yemul jun chi', ix yab'an winhaj Pedro chi', ix och jun lolonel, ix yalan icha tik: --Pedro, mak'cham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix yalan winh: --Ach Wajalil, max yal-laj, yujto manta jun elok tzin chi junok komon tasi, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan junelxo: --Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a hachxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix alchaj icha chi'. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Wanto sna'an winhaj Pedro tas yaj jun chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio t'a sti' jun pat chi'. Toxo ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh yab'i b'aj ay spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Yuj chi' ix awajoch heb' winh, ix sk'anb'an heb' winh: --¿Ay am ek' winhaj Simón t'a tik, winh skuchpax Pedro? xchi heb' winh.
Hanheja' wanto sna'an winhaj Pedro yuj juntzanh ix yil chi', ix yalan Yespíritu Dios t'a winh: --Ay oxwanh heb' winh winak tzach k'anb'ani.
Yuj chi' emanh. Ixik yet' heb' winh, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'ati, yujto a in ix in chekkot heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix emta winh b'aj ayek' heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ina in tzin he k'anb'ej tik. ¿Tas he chekab'il t'ayin yuj chi' tzex jawi? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Ay jun winh yajal soldado skuch Cornelio. Te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, syak'paxem sb'a winh t'a Dios. Te wach' winh t'a yichanh heb' etisraelal smasanil. Haxo jun yángel Dios ix halan t'a winh to schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzach yik'b'at heb' t'a spat winh, yik wach' smaklej yab' winh tas ol ala', xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jioch heb' winh t'a yol pat chi' yuj winh. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb' winh. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh. Ix b'at jaywanh heb' creyente aj Jope chi' yuk'lewok winh.
Hato t'a schab'jial ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Haxo winhaj Cornelio ix tanhwan sk'och heb' ta'. Toxo ix yawtejkot heb' sk'ab' yok winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yamigo winh.
Ayik wan sk'och winhaj Pedro chi', ix elta winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a sti' spat. Ix scha'an winh sk'och winh. Ix em kuman winh yak'em sb'a t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Palta a winhaj Pedro chi' ix ketzank'e wa'an winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh linhan, yujto ketanimail ko b'a, xchi winh.
Wan slolon heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a yol pat. Ix yilan winhaj Pedro chi' to tzijtumxo heb' molanek'i.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb': --Ex wetanimail, eyojtak to a onh israel onh tik, ay yowalil ko k'umlan ko b'a yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma koch t'a yol spat. Palta ha Dios ix ak'an wojtakejeli to max yal walani to ay yowalil tzin k'umej junok mach.
Yuj chi' malaj tas ix wala' ayik ix b'at in eyik'ankoti. Xal tiknaik, alek t'ayin, tas yuj ix b'at in eyik'koti, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yab' am icha hora tik oxji, wan in lesalwi t'a yol in pat tik, ichataxon tzin k'ulej t'a junjun tz'eymajk'uhalil. Ay jun sch'ox sb'a t'ayin, kopopi kilan spichul.
Yalan t'ayin: Cornelio, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix sna'anpaxkot juntzanh a silab' tzak' t'a heb' meb'a'.

Haxo tiknaik, chekb'at jaywanhok winak t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'ankot winhaj Simón heb', skuch pax Pedro. Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'u'um. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi.

Slajwi chi', in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ach sayek'i. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach ix a k'anab'ajej a koti. Ha tiknaik, ayonh ek' ko masanil t'a yichanh Dios Kajal. Yuj chi' sko snib'ej skab'i jantaknhej tas alb'ilkan t'ayach yuj, yik tzalan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik wojtak to t'a wal yel, jun lajannhej yelk'och masanil anima t'a yichanh Dios.
Ha heb' xiw t'a Dios, wach'chom manh israelok heb', ste tzalaj yet' heb' tato wach' sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ha Dios ak'jinakkan slolonel t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Yalannakkan t'ayonh to ay junk'olal yuj Jesucristo, haton Kajal ko masanil.
Ha exxo tik, ina eyojtak tas ix sk'ulej Dios t'a ko lugar. Ha t'a Galilea elnak yich, ayik slajwinak yalankanel slolonel Dios winhaj Juan, a slajwinak yak'an bautizar heb' anima winh.

Eyojtak to ha Dios yak'nak Yespíritu t'a Jesús aj Nazaret, yak'annakpax spoder t'ay. Eyojtak paxi to a Jesús ix kolwaj t'a heb' anima. Jantaknhej heb' ixtab'il yuj winh diablo, ix laj yak' b'oxok sk'o'ol heb'. Icha chi' yutejnak sb'a yujto ha Dios ayoch yet'ok.

Ha onh tik skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh tastak ix sk'ulej chi'. Jantaknhej tas ix ek' sk'ulej t'a yol yik Judea yet' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, ix kila'. Ixlajwi chi', ix kulusajk'e yuj heb' wetisraelal. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' smilanchamok.
Palta haxo t'a schab'jial ix pitzwixi yuj Dios. Yuj spoder Dios chi' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayonh.

Palta maj sch'oxlaj sb'a t'a masanil heb' anima. Anhej t'ayonh ix sch'ox sb'a, yujto atax t'a peka' sik'b'ilonhxokanel yuj yik tzonh och stestigook. Onh wa pax yet'ok ayik toxo ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak chi'.
Ix yalankan t'ayonh to yowalil tzek' kalel yab'ixal t'a heb' anima, to ha Dios ak'jinak yopisio sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' anima smasanil, wach'chom heb' pitzanto ma heb' chamnakxo.

Atax t'a peka', ayokto yalannakkanel yab'ixal Jesús heb' schekab' Dios. Yalnakkan junjun heb' to a jantaknhej heb' ol ak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a sk'o'ol, ol ak'jokkan lajwok smul heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Haxo yik wan yalan winhaj Pedro chi', ix ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a masanil heb' wan yab'an chi'.
Haxo heb' creyente aj Israel ajun yet' winhaj Pedro chi', ix te sat sk'o'ol heb', yujto ix yak'pax Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' manh israelok.
Yujto ix yab' heb' to ch'okch'ok ti'al syal heb' b'aj ix ochkan kajan Espíritu Santo chi'. Ix yab'anpax heb' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi':
--Max yal sko kachoch wa'an heb' tik, yik max ak'ji bautizar heb'. Ina to ix ak'ji Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' icha ix aj yak'ji t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pedro chi' to tz'ak'ji bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Jesucristo. Ixlajwi yak'ji bautizar heb' chi', ix sk'anan pawor heb' t'a winh, yik wach' tz'aj jaye'ok k'uhal winh yet' heb'.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús yet' heb' creyente ay t'a yol yik Judea, ix yab' heb' to ay heb' manh israelok ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'o'ol.
Yuj chi' ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Pedro t'a Jerusalén, ix yalan heb' creyente israel to manh wach'ok ix yutej sb'a winh.
Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ix ach xit'ek' a k'umej heb' manh israelok, ach wa pax yet' heb'? xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' tastak ix uji chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Ayinek' t'a chonhab' Jope. Haxo t'a jun k'u, wan in lesalwi, icha wayich ix aj wilan yemul jun niwan k'apak ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul b'aj ay in ek' chi'.
Ix in och k'elan t'ay yik swila' tas ayoch t'a yo'ol. Haxo ix wilani, ay juntzanh nok' kaltakte'al nok' chanhe' yok. Ay nok' ay smay. Ay nok' chan yet' juntzanh nok' much.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'an yoch jun lolonel, ix yalani: Pedro, milcham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix in tak'wi t'ay: Ma'ay, ach Wajal, yujto manta junelok tzin chi junok komon tas, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xin chi t'ay.
Yuj chi', ix yalanemta junelxo t'ayin t'a satcha'anh: Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a hachxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix yal juntzanh chi' icha chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Junanto rato chi' ix k'och oxwanh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj ayinek' chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ix chekjikot heb' winh, yik sb'at in sayan heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope.

Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'at yet' heb' winh, xchi. Ix b'at pax wakwanhxo heb' winh kuk'tak tik wet'ok. Haxo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh och t'a yol spat jun winh.

Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to ix yil jun ángel winh, linhanek' t'a yol spat winh chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: Chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'okab'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, skuchan pax Pedro.
Ha winh ol halan t'ayach tas ol aj a kolchaji yet' jantaknhej heb' ayek' t'a yol a pat, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.
Haxo yik ix in och ijan walan t'a heb', t'a jun rato chi' ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb', icha ix aj yoch t'ayonh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yuj chi' ix in na'ankot tas alb'ilkan yuj Kajal Jesús, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Yel toni, a winhaj Juan ix ak'an bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta a ex tik, ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi.

Ha Dios ix ak'an Yespíritu t'a heb' icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayonh ayik ix kak'anoch Kajal Jesucristo t'a ko k'o'ol. Yuj chi', ¿tom a in tik, syal in kachanoch wa'an tas sk'ulej Dios? xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.

Haxo heb' creyente t'a Jerusalén chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', manhxalaj tas ix yal heb'. Haxonhej wach' lolonel ix yal heb' t'a Dios. Ix yalan heb': --Hanhejtona' pax heb' manh israelok, ha Dios ix ak'an sna sb'a heb' yik wach' scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej ket'ok, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix miljicham winhaj Esteban, ix ak'jipax och sya'elal heb' creyente smasanil. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' elelal. Ay heb' ix k'och masanto t'a chonhab' Fenicia, t'a Chipre yet' t'a Antioquía. Ix laj yalanel wach' ab'ix heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal ayek' ta'. Palta malaj tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Palta ay jaywanh heb' creyente aj Chipre yet' heb' aj Cirene ix k'och t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'. Hata' ix yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Haxo Jesús Kajal ix och yet' heb' creyente chi', yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al. Ix yak'anoch Kajal Jesús heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo heb' creyente aj Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb', ix schekb'at winhaj Bernabé heb' t'a Antioquía chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ix yak' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh yuj heb'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh to tek'an syutej sb'a heb', syak'anpax och spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús t'a masanil tiempo.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Bernabé chi' yalan t'a heb', yujto te wach' spensar winh. Te ayoch Espíritu Santo yet' winh. Syak' wal och Dios winh t'a sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' tzijtum wal heb' aj chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'o'ol yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Tarso, ix b'at sayanek' winhaj Saulo winh ta'. Haxo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yik'ankot winh winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'.
Haxo ta' ix ek' jun ab'il heb' winh t'a skal heb' creyente chi'. Tzijtum mach ix sk'ayb'ej heb' winh. Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', hata' ix ak'ji skuch heb' creyente cristiano t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Dios ix b'at alanel slolonel. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix jawi heb' winh t'a Antioquía chi'.

Ay jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh skuch Agabo. Ix k'e wa'an winh t'a skal heb' creyente. Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an yal winh icha tik: --Ay jun niwan wejel ol jawok t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi winh. (Ha jun wejel ix yal winh chi', ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Claudio yajalil, hata' ix yak'a').
Yuj tas ix yal winhaj Agabo chi', haxo heb' creyente aj Antioquía chi', ix el t'a sk'o'ol heb' to skolwaj heb' t'a heb' creyente aj Judea, hato syala' jantak stzak'wan heb' yak'ani.
Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'. Ix yak'anb'at yofrenda heb' t'a heb' winh anciano aj Judea chi'. Haxo winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo ix ik'anb'at jun ofrenda chi'.
Ha t'a yik jun pekti' chi', a winhaj rey Herodes, ix och ijan winh yak'an chukal t'a heb' creyente.
Ix schekan winh tzepchajel sjolom winhaj Jacobo, haton winh yuk'tak winhaj Juan.
Ayik ix yilan winh to wach' ix yab' heb' israel yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix schek winh yamjokpax winhaj Pedro. Ha t'a jun sk'inh heb' israel, yik swa'an ixim pan heb' malaj yich, hata' ix yamji winh.

Haxo ix yamchaj winh chi', ix ak'jioch winh t'a preso. Ix ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' waklajunhwanh heb' soldado, yik stanhwaj winh yuj heb'. Chanhtakwanh heb' ix tanhwan winh t'a juntak el. Ix sna'an winhaj Herodes chi' to ayik ol lajwok k'inh yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto chi', ol sch'oxanelta winhaj Pedro chi' winh t'a yichanh heb' anima, ichato chi' ol sch'olb'itan winh rey chi' tas yaj winh.
Yuj chi' te ay wal och yilumal winhaj Pedro t'a yol te' preso chi'. Haxo heb' creyente, t'a smasanil sk'o'ol heb' ix lesalwi t'a Dios yuj winh. Maj ochlaj wa'an heb' slesalwi.

Haxo t'a jun ak'wal, k'ik'anokxo tz'elta winhaj Pedro chi' t'a yichanh heb' anima yuj winhaj Herodes chi', waynak winh t'a snanhal chawanh heb' soldado. Tzek'b'il winh t'a chab' k'e'en cadena. Haxo t'a sti' te' preso chi' ayek' chawanhxo heb' winh stanhwej.

Palta t'a jun rato chi' ix k'och jun yángel Dios Kajal. Te sak k 'inal ix aj t'a yol te' preso chi' yuj. Ix yekub'tanhan skostil winhaj Pedro chi' jun ángel chi', yik tz'el swayanh winh, ix yalan t'a winh: --K'e'anh wa'an wal tiknaik, xchi. Haxo k'e'en cadena ayoch chi' t'a sk'ab' winhaj Pedro chi', munil ix el k'e'en, ix em lanhnaj k'e'en.
Ix yalanpax jun ángel chi' t'a winh: --Tzatzb'itej a tzek'ul, tzak'anoch a xanhab', xchi. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Ak'och jun spatik a pichul. Tzach och tzak'an wu'uj, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj. Ix elta winh t'a jun cuarto b'aj ayek' chi'. Wan swayichan winh sna'ani. Manh yojtakok winh tato yel to wan yelta winh.

Ix ek' heb' t'a scha makanhil b'aj ayek' heb' soldado wan stanhwan te' preso chi', ichato chi' ix k'och heb' b'aj ay k'e'en smakul preso chi' b'aj sjakwiel t'a yol calle. Ha jun k'e'en chi' munil ix jakwi k'e'en sch'okoj. Ix el heb' b'i'an. Haxo ix b'at heb' t'a jun calle chi', ix aktajkan winhaj Pedro chi' yuj jun ángel chi'.

Haxo ix yilan winh to yel. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik, swila' to yel ix schekkot jun yángel Dios Kajal tzul in skolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Herodes. In kolchajelta t'a yalanh jantaknhej tas snib'ej heb' wetisraelal syak'och t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Wanto sna'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix k'och winh t'a spat ix María, snun winhaj Juan, haton winh skuchpax Marcos. Tzijtum heb' molanek' t'a jun pat chi', wan slesalwi heb' yuj winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'onhub'tanhej spuertail yamak'il jun pat chi' winh. Haxo jun ix kob'es skuch Rode, a ix ix ul tak'wokelta t'a winh.

Palta haxo ix yab'an ix to a winhaj Pedro, maj sjaklaj te' puerta chi' ix. Tonhej ix te tzalaj ix. Ix ochxi lemnaj ix. Ix yalan ix t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta' to a winhaj Pedro ayek' t'a sti' puerta chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a ix: --Tekan tonhej tzach komon loloni, xchi heb'. Palta ix yalxi ix to yel a winhaj Pedro chi' ayek'i. Haxo ix yalanxi heb': --Tekan manhoklaj winhaj Pedro chi'. Tekan a junok ángel ayoch stanhwumalok winh, tekan a ix jawi, xchi heb' t'a ix.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', hanheja' sk'onk'onhan och winh. Haxo ix sjakan heb', ix yilan heb' to yel a winhaj Pedro chi' ayek'i. Ix te sat sk'o'ol heb'.

Palta ix yak'an yechel winh yet' sk'ab' t'a heb' yik numan tz'aj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' tas ix aj yik'jielta winh yuj Dios Kajal t'a preso chi'. Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Tzeyal juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Jacobo yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' creyente, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winh t'a skal heb'. Ix b'at winh t'a junxo lugar.
Haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix k'e somnaj heb' soldado yalani, yujto maj nachajel yuj heb' tas ix yutej sb'a winhaj Pedro chi'.

Haxo winhaj Herodes chi' ix ak'an órden yik saychaj winh, palta majxo ilchajlaj winh yuj heb'. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' soldado chi' tas ix aj yel winhaj Pedro chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an órden winh scham heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Herodes t'a yol yik Judea b'aj ayek' chi'. Ix k'och kajan winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea.

Ha junel, ix te kot yowal winhaj rey Herodes chi' t'a heb' anima aj Tiro yet' Sidón. Yuj chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' tas syutej heb' b'at yalan sb'a t'a winh. Ix yak'an sk'ol jun winh skuchan Blasto heb'. Haton winh sat yaj yak'an serwil winh rey chi'. Yuj chi', haxo winh ix k'anan niwank'olal heb' t'a winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a heb', yujto ha t'a schonhab' winh rey chi', hata' tz'ak'jikot jantaknhej tas swa heb'.

Haxo winh rey chi' ix halani tas k'uhal sk'och heb' t'a yichanh winh. Haxo t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak'och juntzanh spichul winh te wach', icha yik heb' rey smasanil. Ixlajwi chi', ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub'. Ix och ijan winh slolonelta t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ixlajwi yab'an heb', ix laj yalank'e heb': --Ha jun slolon tik, manh animaok, haton Dios, xchi heb'.
Yujto maj yik'cha'anh sb'i Dios winh, yuj chi' t'a jun rato chi' ix ak'jioch sya'elal winh yuj jun yángel Dios, ix och nok' ha'ay t'a yol sk'o'ol winh, ix cham winh.
Palta haxo slolonel Dios Kajal ix pukaxnhejel t'a skal heb' anima. Ix laj alchajel t'a junjun lugar.

Haxo winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo, ayik ix lajwi scheknab'il heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Juan heb' winh, haton winh skuch pax Marcos. Ix k'ochxi heb' winh t'a Antioquía chi'.

Ha t'a skal heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh syak' Dios yalanel slolonel. Ay pax ek' juntzanh heb' winh sk'ayb'umal heb' creyente. Ayek' winhaj Bernabé, winhaj Simón skuchanpax Niger, winhaj Lucio aj chonhab' Cirene yet' winhaj Saulo. Ayek' pax winhaj Manaén, haton winh junnhej k'ib'nak yet' winhaj Herodes, winh ak'jinak yajalil t'a Galilea.

Ha junel wan yalan sb'a heb' t'a Dios Kajal. Ay pax och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'a heb': --Tze sik'elta winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo, yik ol munlaj heb' winh b'aj ol wak'och yopisio, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix lesalwi heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh heb'.

Ix chekjib'at winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo yuj Yespíritu Dios. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Seleucia. Haxo ta' ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barco, ix b'at heb' winh t'a jun lugar skuch Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Salamina, ix ek' yalankanel slolonel Dios heb' winh t'a yoltak spatil culto. Haxo winhaj Juan Marcos, ajun pax winh yet' heb' winh, yik skolwaj winh yet' heb' winh.

Ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'a Chipre chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Pafos. Hata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' jun winh israel skuch Barjesús. Ha jun winh chi', syaloch sb'a winh ajb'a'alil. Syal pax winh to ha Dios tz'ak'an yalel slolonel.

Ha jun winh chi', junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Sergio Paulo, winh yajal t'a Chipre chi'. Te jelan spensar winhaj Sergio chi'. Ix yawtejkot winhaj Bernabé winh yet' winhaj Saulo, yujto snib'ej winh syab' slolonel Dios t'a heb' winh.
Palta haxo winh syaloch sb'a ajb'a'alil chi', haton winh skuchan pax Elimas, ix yak'elta yowal winh t'a heb' winh, yujto snib'ej winh max yak'och slolonel Dios winhaj Sergio chi' t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', haton winh skuchpax Pablo, te ayoch Espíritu Santo t'a winh. Ix och k'elan winh t'a winh syaloch sb'a ajb'a'alil chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, tzak' musansatil heb' anima. Te chuk a pensar. Yuninal ach winh diablo. Ajk'ol ach t'a masanil tas wach'. Ha slolonel Kajal Jesús te yel. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj max aktejkan ixtani?

Ha tiknaik, ol yak'kot ya'elal Kajal Jesús t'a ib'anh. Ol yak' ixtax yol a sat, yuj chi' manhxo ol yal-laj ilan yok k'u junok tiempoal, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh. T'a jun rato chi', ix ixtax yol sat winh. Majxo yal yilan jab'ok winh. Yuj chi', ix machmonek' winh, ix snib'ej winh to ay junok mach sketzan b'eyek'ok.
Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winh yajal t'a Chipre chi', ix yak'och Dios winh t'a sk'o'ol. Ix te sat pax sk'o'ol winh yab'an juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Kajal Jesús.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barco. Ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Pafos, ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Perge t'a yol yik Panfilia. Palta haxo winhaj Juan Marcos, ix aktajkan heb' winh yuj winh, ix meltzajkan winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén.
Ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a Perge chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía t'a yol yik Pisidia. Haxo t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil culto, ix em k'ojjab' heb' winh ta'.

Hata' ix awtaj ch'anh ley Moisés yet' juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Ixlajwi chi', a heb' skuchb'an heb' t'a culto ix halan t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi': --Ex ketanimail, tato ay junok tas he gana tzeyak' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima, syal eyalan tiknaik, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yik'an cha'anh sk'ab' winh yik numan tz'aj heb'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetisraelal yet' ex manh ex israelok ay he xiwk'olal t'a Dios, ab'ek:

Ha ko Diosal a onh aj Israel onh tik, a sik'jinakkanel heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik yek'nak heb' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto, A' ak'jinakkan och heb' niwak chonhab'il. Slajwi chi', yik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' yet' sniwan poder.
Yak'nak techaj Dios chi' sb'eyb'al heb' 40 ab'il t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Hanhejtona', A' ak'jinak satel uke' nación ay t'a yol yik Canaán. Haxo slu'um heb' b'aj satnakel chi', ak'jinakkan yikok heb' ko mam kicham.
450 ab'il yak'nak heb' icha chi'. Slajwinak chi', haxo Dios ak'annak yopisio juntzanh heb' juez yak'an mandar heb', masanto yochnak winhaj Samuel schekab'ok Dios.

Haxo t'a jun pekti' chi', sk'annak junok sreyal heb' t'a Dios, yik a skuchb'an heb', haxo winhaj Saúl ak'jioch sreyalok heb' yuj Dios. Ha winhaj Saúl chi', a winhaj Cis ay yuninal winh, winh yinhtilal Benjamín. 40 ab'il ochnak winh sreyalok heb'.

Haxo Dios ik'jinakel winh t'a yopisio chi'. Haxo winhaj David yak'xikanoch sk'exulok winh. Yalannak Dios icha tik yuj winh: Ina yajek' winhaj David winh yuninal winhaj Isaí, haton jun winh tik tzin tzalaj yet'ok. Ha winh ol b'oan masanil tas in gana, xchi.
Haxo Jesús, a winhaj David chi' ay yinhtilalkani. Ha Dios ak'jinakkan yopisio yoch ko Kolumalok a onh israel onh tik, icha ix aj yak'ankan sti'.
Ayik manto yamchajoch smunlajel chi', a winhaj Juan ix alanel t'a heb' ketisraelal to yowalil sna sb'a heb', syak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb'.

Haxo yik wanxo slajwi yopisio winhaj Juan chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha he na'ani to he Kolumal in, palta ma'ay. Ay jun tzak'an sja wu'uj, a jun chi' te niwan yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona' in, manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tijel xanhab', xchi winh.
Ex wetanimail, ex yinhtilal Abraham wet'ok yet' ex ay he xiwk'olal t'a Dios, a jun ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik, heyik wet'ok.

Palta a heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yajal, max nachajel-laj yuj heb' tato a Jesús chi' Yuninal Dios, wach'chom t'a junjun k'uhal ik'oj ip, ix yab'an heb' yawtaj tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios, palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb'. Yuj chi', ayik ix yak'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh Jesús chi', ix yak'elk'och juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi' heb'.
Malaj jab'ok smul ix ilchaj yuj heb', manh smojok smilancham heb'. Palta xit' sk'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh t'a winhaj Pilato, haton winh yajal.

Ix laj yak'elk'och heb' t'ay icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ay heb' ochnak tzak'an yet' Jesús ix ik'anemta sniwanil t'a spenek te' kulus. Ix b'at smukanoch heb' t'a yol jun k'e'en k'e'en.
Haxo Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ixlajwi chi', tzijtumto k'uhal ix ek' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Haton heb' kot yet' t'a Galilea sk'och heb' t'a Jerusalén yet'ok ayik manto chami. Ha heb' chi', wan yalanel yab'ixal heb' t'a skal heb' anima tiknaik.
Ichonh pax ta' a onh tik wan kalan pax el jun wach' ab'ix tik t'ayex, to ha Dios yak'nakkan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Haxo t'ayonh ix yak'elk'och sti' chi'. Ayik ix pitzwixi Jesús, ix elk'och jun yalnakkan chi'. Icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Salmo 2, b'aj syal icha tik: Ha t'a jun k'u tik, ix wak' cheklajok to Wuninal ach, xchikan Dios t'a Slolonel chi'.

Yalnakkan Dios to ol yik'k'e wa'an Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak, yik malaj b'ak'inh ol k'a sniwanil. Yalnakpaxkan icha tik t'a Slolonel Dios chi': Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ix wutej wak'ankan in ti' t'a winhaj David, xchi.
Yuj chi', ayokto yalannakkan yab'ixal Cristo winhaj David chi' t'a junxo Salmo b'aj syal icha tik: Mamin, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in ton tik sik'b'il in el u'uj, xchi.
Ha winhaj David chi' ak'jinak serwil heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi', icha snib'ej Dios. Slajwi chi' scham winh, smukchajnak winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham. Haxo sniwanil winh chi' k'anakb'ati.
Palta haxo jun ix yak' pitzwokxi Dios t'a skal heb' chamnak, maj k'alaj sniwanil.
Yuj chi' in gana tzeyojtakejeli to anhej Jesús syal yak'an lajwok ko mul. Yuj chi' wan kalan jun ab'ix tik t'ayex.
Ha ley Moisés max yal-laj yak'an lajwok ko mul. Palta a mach tz'ak'anoch Jesucristo t'a sk'o'ol, slajwikan smul smasanil yuj.
Yuj chi' naek wal he b'a. Tato ma'ay, a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, yujto yalnakkan heb' icha tik:

Ex b'uchumtak, ileknab'i. Satokab' he k'o'ol heyilani, haxo he satel chi'. Yujto a in Dios in ol in b'o junok tas t'a he tiempoal tik, wach'chom ay mach ol halan t'ayex, palta manh ol he cha eyab'i, xchi Dios chi', xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' yet' winhaj Bernabé, ayik wan yelta heb' winh t'a yol spatil culto chi', ay heb' manh israelok ix k'anan t'a heb' winh, yik sk'och heb' winh sk'ayb'ej heb' t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al chi' t'a junxo sk'uhal ik'oj ip.

Haxo yik ix lajwi jun culto chi', a heb' israel, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ay pax heb' ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel chi' ix b'at pax yet' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a heb' to tek'an syutej sb'a heb' yak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol to xajan heb' yuj Dios.
Haxo t'a junxo sk'uhal ik'oj ip, kenxonhej maj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a jun chonhab' chi' smaklej yab' slolonel Dios.
Palta haxo ix yilan heb' israel to tzijtum anima ix smol sb'a, ix chichonoch sk'o'ol heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix laj yalan heb' to es juntzanh syal winh chi'. Tonhej ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ex ketisraelal, yowalil a t'ayex sko b'ab'laj alejel slolonel Dios. Palta ina malaj he gana tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol. Tekan a he na'ani to manh he mojok he cha'an he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a tiknaik, ha t'a heb' manh israelok ol onh b'at kaleli.

Yujto icha tik yalnakkan Kajal Jesús t'ayonh: Ix wak' opisio a ch'oxan in sakil k'inal t'a heb' manh israelok, yik wach' ay heb' ol kolchajel t'a junjun lugar masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo heb' manh israelok ix te tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' yab'an juntzanh chi'. Ix och ijan heb' yalani to te wach' slolonel Kajal Jesús. Haxo heb' sik'b'ilxoel yuj Dios yik scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Icha chi' ix aj spukaxb'at slolonel Kajal Jesús chi' t'a jun lugar chi' smasanil.

Palta haxo heb' israel ix ak'an sk'o'ol heb' yajal t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ay pax juntzanh heb' ix ix ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel chi', chekel yaj heb' ix t'a sat heb' anima, ix ak'jipax sk'o'ol heb' ix. Ix och ijan heb' yak'an chukal t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ix pechjiel heb' winh t'a jun lugar chi' yuj heb'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', ix stzikkanel spokokal yok heb' winh, yik sch'oxanel heb' winh to manhxa yalan yik heb' winh t'a heb' anima chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Iconio.
Haxo heb' creyente aj Antioquía chi', ix te tzalaj heb'. Te ay wal och Espíritu Santo t'a heb'.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé t'a chonhab' Iconio chi', yaman ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil sculto heb' yetisraelal. Te wach' ix yutej heb' winh yalanel slolonel Dios ta'. Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' israel ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol yet' pax heb' manh israelok.
Palta ay heb' israel maj ak'anochlaj t'a sk'o'ol, ix yak'an sk'o'ol juntzanh heb' manh israelok heb', yik schichonoch sk'o'ol heb' t'a heb' creyente chi'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', niwan tiempo ix aj heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Maj xiwlaj heb' winh yalanel yab'ixal swach'k'olal Kajal Jesús, haxo Kajal chi' ix ch'oxani to yel syal heb' winh, yujto ix yak' spoder t'a heb' winh sch'oxan juntzanh milagro.
Palta haxo heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi', cha poj ix aj heb'. Nanhal heb' ix kan yet' heb' israel chi'. Haxo nanhalxo heb', a yet' heb' schekab' Jesús chi' ix och heb'.

Haxo heb' israel chi' yet' juntzanh heb' manh israelok, ix laj slajtiej sb'a heb' yet' heb' skuchb'umal jun chonhab' chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol yak' chukal heb' t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi', ol sjulancham heb' winh heb' sna'ani.

Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun ix alchaj chi' heb' winh t'a spatik, ix b'at heb' winh elelal. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Listra yet' t'a Derbe t'a yol yik Licaonia. Ix ek' heb' winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Hata' ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.
Ha t'a chonhab' Listra ay jun winh atax yaljinak max yal sb'eyi. Malaj b'aj sb'ey jab'ok winh. Haxo junel k'ojanem winh,
wan yab'an winh tas syal winhaj Pablo. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to syak'och winh t'a sk'o'ol to syal sb'oxi winh yuj Dios.
Yuj chi' te cha'anh ix yal winh t'a winh: --K'e'anh wa'an, tojol tzach ajk'e linhan, xchi winh. T'a jun rato chi', ix k'e linhan winh. Ix och ijan winh sb'eyek'i.

Ayik ix yilan heb' anima tas jun ix sk'ulej winhaj Pablo chi', ix och ijan heb' yalan cha'anh t'a sti' heb' aj Licaonia chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha heb' ko diosal ix yak'och sb'a heb' animail, ix emul heb' t'a ko kal, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Bernabé, Júpiter ix sb'iej winh yuj heb'. Haxo winhaj Pablo, Mercurio ix yak' heb' sb'iok winh, yujto a winh ix lolon t'a skal heb'.

Ay jun winh sacerdoteal Júpiter chi', yajal yaj winh t'a stemplo Júpiter t'a stiel chonhab'. Ix b'at yik'kot juntzanh nok' toro winh yet' juntzanh xumakil te te'. Haxo yet' heb' anima chi' smasanil ijan ix yak' jun silab' nhusb'il winh t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi'.

Palta haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', ix snhik'chitej spichul heb' winh sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima, te cha'anh ix yal heb' winh t'a skal heb' icha tik:

--Ex ketanimail, ¿tas yuj icha tik tzeyutej he b'a? Ha onh tik, anima onh icha ex tik. Yuj chi' tzul kal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan juntzanh he b'eyb'al tik, yujto nab'anhej tzeyixtej he b'a. K'exek he b'eyb'al, ak'ek och he pensar t'a jun Dios to t'a wal yel pitzan. A' b'ojinak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik. Sb'oannak pax ha' mar yet' masanil tastak.
T'a peka', tonhej ix yil Dios tas ix sk'ulej heb' anima, ix yak'an snib'ej heb'.
Palta ix yak' ko pensar yik skojtakej eli tas yaji ayik syak'ankot nhab' t'a kib'anh. Syak'an masanil tas skawej. A' tz'ak'an masanil tas sko wa''a. Syak'anpax ko tzalajk'olal, xchi heb' winh.

Palta ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', puralxonhej ix och wa'an heb' anima chi' skachji yuj heb' winh. Yujto snib'ej heb' syak' nok' wakax chi' silab'il t'a heb' winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' israel aj Antioquía yik Pisidia ix k'och yet' jaywanhxo heb' aj Iconio. Ix yak'an sk'o'ol heb' anima chi' heb'. Yuj chi', ix laj sjuloch k'e'en k'e'en heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo ix sna'an heb' to toxo ix cham winh, ix snheranb'at winh heb', ix syumankanel winh heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.
Palta ix k'och hoyan heb' creyente t'a stz'ey winh, ix k'ex wa'an winh. Ix ochxi winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'atxi winh yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe.

Hata' ix ek' yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb' winh. Tzijtum anima ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'o'ol. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix ek'xi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra, t'a Iconio yet' t'a Antioquía yik Pisidia chi'.

Ix laj ek' heb' winh yiptzitej heb' creyente t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ek' ak'jikan stek'anil spensar heb' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalankan heb' winh icha tik t'a heb': --Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a eyak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a he k'o'ol, yujto ayik manto onh k'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yowalil niwan ya'elal ol ja t'a kib'anh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a junjun iglesia, ix yak'och yopisio heb' tz'och ancianoal heb' winh. Ix yak'an lesal heb' winh t'a Dios, ix och pax heb' winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikanoch heb' creyente ab'enal t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús, haton jun ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a yol yik Pisidia. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Panfilia.
Ix yalanel slolonel Dios heb' winh t'a chonhab' Perge. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Atalia.

Haxo ta' ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barco. Ix jax heb' winh t'a Antioquía yik Siria. Haton t'a jun chonhab' chi' sk'annak swach'k'olal Dios heb' creyente t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', yik ix b'at yalankanel slolonel Dios heb' winh. Xal tiknaik ix yik' sb'a jun smunlajel heb' winh chi'.

Ayik ix k'ochxi heb' winh, ix laj yawtejkot heb' creyente heb' winh ayek' ta'. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb' winh. Ix laj yalanpax heb' winh to a Kajal Jesús ix cha'an yak'och heb' manh israelok t'a sk'o'ol.
Najtil ix aj heb' winh yet' heb' creyente chi' ta'.

Ha t'a yik jun pekti' chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh ix kot t'a yol yik Judea, ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía. Ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a heb' creyente icha tik: --Tato maj he cha jun yechel circuncisión t'a he niwanil, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés, manh ol ex kolchajlaj, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé, ix stelaj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh, palta maj b'olaj yaj yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' creyente to sb'at heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a Jerusalén. Sb'atpax juntzanhxo heb' creyente yet' heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' sk'anb'ej razón t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' t'a heb' winh anciano t'a jun iglesia chi'.

Ixlajwi schekjib'at heb' winh yuj heb' creyente chi', ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol yik Fenicia yet' t'a Samaria. Hata' ix ek' heb' winh yalel t'a heb' creyente to ay heb' manh israelok ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al, ix yak'anoch spensar heb' t'a Dios. Ha ix yab'an jun chi' heb' creyente, ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ix chaji sk'och heb' winh yuj heb' creyente smasanil, heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh anciano. Ix laj yalan heb' winh jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb' winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' winh fariseo ak'annakoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol. Ix k'e wan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ha heb' manh israelok tz'ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol, yowalil tz'ak'ji circuncidar heb'. Yowalil skal t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej ley Moisés heb', xchi heb' winh.
Haxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' winh anciano yik sna'an heb' winh tas tz'aj jun chi'.

Haxo ix lajwi ste telan sb'a heb' winh, ix k'e linhan winhaj Pedro, ix yalan winh: --Ex wuk'tak, eyojtaktaxoni, ayxo stiempoal in sik'jikanel yuj Dios yik swalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb' manh israelok, yik wach' syak'och Cristo heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Yujto yojtak Dios tas ay t'a spensar junjun anima, yuj chi' ix yak' Yespíritu t'a heb' manh israelok chi', icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayonh, yik scheklaji to wach' heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha t'a yichanh Dios lajannhej heb' ket'ok, yujto ha' ix tojolb'itan sb'eyb'al heb' ayik ix yak'anoch Cristo heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Ha tiknaik, ¿tas yuj malaj he gana tze cha tas wan sk'ulan Dios? Ha ley Moisés, lajan yet' junok ikatz te al max k'e ko kuchani. Maj techaj sk'anab'ajan heb' ko mam kicham. Hanhejtona', max techaj pax ko k'anab'ajan a onh tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj he gana tzeyak'och jun chi' t'a yib'anh heb' creyente manh israelok?
Manh he k'ulej jun chi', yujto kojtak to yujnhej swach'k'olal Kajal Jesús tzonh kolchaji. Hanhejtona', icha pax chi' heb' manh israelok chi', xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Ha ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix em numnaj heb' smasanil. Ixlajwi chi', ix smaklan yab' heb' tas syal winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Pablo. Ix yalan heb' winh to tzijtum milagro ix sb'o Dios, ayik ix ek' heb' winh t'a skal heb' manh israelok.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Jacobo icha tik: --Ex wuk'tak, ab'ek tas ol wal t'ayex.
Ix yal winhaj Simón Pedro t'ayonh tas ix aj yel yich sch'oxan swach'il Dios t'a heb' manh israelok. Ix sik'jielta jaywanh heb' yik wach' tz'och heb' yikok.
Ha jun ix uji tik, lajan icha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', haton b'aj syal icha tik:

Ha t'a yik junxo tiempoal ol in jaxok. Ol ul wak'ankanpaxoch jun yinhtil winhaj rey David sk'exulok t'a yopisio. Yujto icha junok pat ix em lanhnajok, icha chi' ajnakkan yopisio winh chi'. Palta ol in b'ok'e junelxo,
yik wach' a heb' manh israelok ol yak'och spensar heb' t'ayin, a in Yajal in, haton jantak heb' wik sik'b'iltaxonel wu'uj t'a junjun nación.
Icha chi' yutejnak Dios Kajal yalani. Ha ak'jinak kojtakejel juntzanh tik yiktax t'a peka', xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Yuj chi' tzin na a in tik, max yal kak'anoch junok ikatz ajaltak t'a yib'anh heb' manh israelok wan yak'anoch spensar t'a Dios.

Anhejokab' ko carta skak'b'at t'a heb', skalanb'ati to maxtzak schilaj heb' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'a komon Dios. Maxtzak sk'ulej ajmulal heb'. Maxtzak schi schik'il nok' nok' heb'. Maxtzak schi nok' nok' heb' sut'jichamok yujto ayto schik'il nok'.
Swal icha chi', yujto atax t'a peka' ay heb' tz'awtan ley Moisés t'a yoltak spatil culto. Hanhejtona' tiknaik, hanheja' yalanel heb' t'a junjun sk'uhal ik'oj ip, xchi winhaj Jacobo chi' t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', a heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh anciano ix smol alej heb' winh yet' heb' creyente smasanil. Ix sna'an heb' to ol sik'el jaywanhok heb' creyente heb', yik sb'at heb' t'a chonhab' Antioquía yuk'lewok winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé. Ixlajwi chi', ix sik'chajel winhaj Judas, skuchan pax Barsabás yet' winhaj Silas yuj heb'. Ha chawanh heb' winh chi', chekel yaj heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' creyente.

Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yak' jun carta chi'. Haxo t'a yol ch'anh carta chi', icha tik tas ix yal heb': Ha onh schekab' onh Jesús, heb' anciano yet' heb' creyente smasanil, tik skak'b'at stzatzil he k'o'ol a ex manh ex israelok t'a chonhab' Antioquía, t'a yol yik Siria yet' t'a Cilicia.

Ix kab'i to ay juntzanh heb' munil ix b'at t'a ko kal, ix k'och heb' t'ayex. Palta manhok onh ix ko chekb'at heb'. Ix kab'i to tzex ixtax yuj tas syal heb' t'ayex ta', to ijan somchajel he pensar yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' ix ko mol alej, ix ko sik'anel jaywanh heb' winh t'a ko kal tik, yik sb'at heb' winh t'ayex ta'. Junnhej ol b'at heb' winh yet' winh kuk'tak aj Bernabé yet' winh kuk'tak aj Pablo. Ha heb' winh tik, xajanab'il heb' winh ku'uj.
Toxo ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' ya'elal yuj Kajal Jesucristo. Ay b'aj ijan ix miljicham heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Judas yet' winhaj Silas tik, haton heb' winh sko chekb'at t'ayex. Ol b'at yal heb' winh t'ayex t'a wal sjichanil, tas ix ko k'ulej t'a tik.
Sko na'a, to manh niwanok ko cheknab'il skalb'at t'ayex. Icha chi' sna pax Yespíritu Dios ket'ok. Yuj chi', a juntzanh cheknab'il skalb'at tik t'ayex, anhej wal yowalil tze k'anab'ajej ta':

Manh he chi nok' chib'ej tz'ak'jioch silab'ok t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Manh he chi schik'il nok' nok'. Manh he chi nok' nok' tonhej sut'jichamok. Manh he k'ulej ajmulal. Tato tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh tik, wach' ol eyutok he b'a. Anhej jay b'elanh tik skalb'at t'ayex.
Ha heb' winh ix chekjib'at chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix smolb'ej heb' creyente chi' heb' winh smasanil. Ix yak'an entregar ch'anh carta chi' heb' winh.
Ayik ix yawtan ch'anh heb' creyente chi', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ak'ji sniwanil sk'o'ol heb' yuj ch'anh.

Haxo winhaj Judas yet' winhaj Silas chi', haton heb' winh yalumalel slolonel Dios, ix yak' sniwanil sk'o'ol heb' creyente heb' winh. Tzijtum tas ix yal heb' winh t'a skal heb', ix yak'ankan stek'anil heb' creyente chi' heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yek' jaye' k'uhal heb' winh ta', ix stak'lankan sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' creyente chi'. Junk'olal ix meltzaj heb' winh b'aj aykan heb' winh chekankot heb' winh chi'.

Hanhejtona', winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé, ix kan heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ix sk'ayb'ej heb' creyente heb' winh. Tzijtum pax heb' ix k'ayb'an heb' yet' heb' winh ta'. Ix yalanel slolonel Kajal Jesús heb' winh.

Haxo ix ek'b'at jayexo semana, ix yalan winhaj Pablo t'a winhaj Bernabé chi': --Konh, b'at kil heb' creyente t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ek'nak onh kalel slolonel Kajal Jesús. B'at kilxi heb', tato hanheja' tek'an heb', xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Bernabé chi', snib'ej winh syik'b'at winhaj Juan Marcos.
Palta ix sna winhaj Pablo chi' to manh smojok sb'at winh yet' heb' winh, yujto aktajkan heb' winh yuj winh junel t'a yol yik Panfilia. Maj yak' lajwok yopisio winh smunlaj yet' heb' winh.

Ix stelaj sb'a heb' winh yuj winh. Palta maj scha sb'a yalan heb' winh. Yuj chi' ch'okch'ok b'aj ix b'atkan heb' winh. Ha winhaj Bernabé chi' ix och winh t'a yol barco. Ix b'atkan winh t'a yol yik Chipre. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Marcos chi' winh yet'ok.

Haxo winhaj Pablo ix sik'anelta winhaj Silas t'a skal heb' creyente, yik sb'at winh yet'ok. Haxo heb' creyente chi', ix sk'an swach'k'olal Dios heb' t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh.
Ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol yik Siria yet' t'a Cilicia. Ix ek' heb' winh yak' stek'anil heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia.

Ix k'och winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe. Ix b'atxi heb' winh ta', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra. Hata' ix yil-lajel sb'a heb' winh yet' jun winh creyente skuch Timoteo. Ha jun winh chi', a jun ix creyente israel ay yune' winh, haxo winh smam winh, griego winh.
Ha heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Listra yet' t'a Iconio ix laj yal heb' smasanil to te' wach' sb'eyb'al winhaj Timoteo chi'.

Ix sna'an winhaj Pablo chi' to ol yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji circuncidar winh yuj winh, yik max kot yowal heb' israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj ol ek' heb' winh chi', yujto yojtak heb' to griego winh smam winh.

Haxo t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ix laj ek' heb' winh, ix yalanel heb' winh juntzanh cheknab'il alb'il yuj heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh anciano ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' creyente to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il chi'.
Haxo heb' creyente t'a junjun chonhab' chi', ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak och heb' t'a sk'o'ol chi'. Sk'ib' pax sb'isul heb' t'a junjun k'u.
