Snib'ej heb' winh sb'at yalel slolonel Dios t'a yol yik Asia, palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj cha'anb'atlaj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol yik Frigia yet' t'a Galacia ix b'at heb' winh.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a sti' smojonal yol yik Misia, ix sna'an heb' winh to ha t'a yol yik Bitinia sb'at heb' winh. Palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj cha'anb'atlaj heb' winh ta'.
Yuj chi' ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'a sti' yol yik Misia chi'. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Troas, haton jun ay t'a sti' ha' mar.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal, icha t'a wayich ix aj yilan jun winh aj Macedonia winhaj Pablo chi', linhanek' winh ix yil winh. Ix tewioch winh t'a winh: “Kotanh t'a Macedonia. Kolwajanh t'ayonh,” xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yilan jun chi' winhaj Pablo chi', ix kak'an lista ko b'a yik tzonh b'at t'a Macedonia chi'. Yujto ix kojtakejeli to ha Dios ix ak'an kopisio kalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ichato chi', ix onh och t'a yol jun barco t'a chonhab' Troas chi'. Te t'inhannhej ix onh b'ati, ix onh k'och t'a yol yik Samotracia. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch Neápolis.

Ixlajwi chi', ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Filipos. Ha jun chonhab' chi', haxo t'a yol yik Roma ay. Anhej te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Macedonia chi'. Hata' ix onh ek' jaye' k'uhal.

Haxo t'a jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix onh b'at t'a sti' jun ha' niwan ha' t'a stiel chonhab'. Hata' xit'taxon ek' anima lesal. Haxo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh em k'ojan. Ix kalanel wach' ab'ix t'a juntzanh heb' ix ix toxonton smolb'ej sb'a ta'.

Hata' ay jun ix skuch Lidia, aj chonhab' Tiatira ix. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak te caro stojol schonh ix. Syak' wal och Dios ix t'a sk'o'ol. Ayik wan yab'an jun ab'ix chi' ix, haxo Kajal Jesús ix jakan spensar ix. Yuj chi' ix yak' wal och spensar ix t'a tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ix ak'ji bautizar ix yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj yet' ix t'a yol spat. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix t'ayonh: --Tato tzeyila' to yel swak'och Kajal Jesús t'a in k'o'ol, ol ex b'at wet' t'a in pat. Wach' tzex aj ta', xchi ix t'ayonh. Ix tewioch ix t'ayonh, yuj chi' ix onh aj ta'.

Haxo junel, ayik wan ko b'at b'aj slesalwi heb' anima, ix k'och jun ix kob'es ix t'ayonh. Ayoch jun enemigo t'a ix. Yuj chi' naumel lolonel ix. Junelnhej ayoch ix chekab'ok t'a juntzanh winak. Ha juntzanh winak chi', syak' wal ganar tumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix, yujto syal ix tastak toto ol ujok.

Ix och tzak'an ix ku'uj yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix syamanoch ix yawaji, syalan ix: --Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, schekab' ton wal Dios yaj heb' winh, haton jun Dios yelxo niwan yelk'ochi. Wan yalan heb' winh t'ayex tas tz'aj he kolchaji, xchi ix.

Tzijtum el ix ek' ix ket'ok. Anhej wal jun chi' syal ix t'a juntak el. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', majxo techaj yuj winh yab'ani. Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a ix. Ix yalan winh t'a jun enemigo chi': --Swal t'ayach t'a sb'i Jesucristo, elanh t'a ix, xchi winh t'ay. T'a jun rato chi' ix el t'a ix.

Palta haxo ix yilan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' to ix el jun enemigo chi' t'a ix, to maxtzak yal-laj yak'an ganar stumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal.
Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh juez. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' icha tik: --Ha heb' winh israel tik, tonhej tzul yak' somchajel ko chonhab' tik heb' winh.
Wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al ay yowalil yuj ley. Max yal ko k'ulan juntzanh chi' a onh tik yujto aj Roma onh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix te kot yowal heb' t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Haxo heb' winh juez ix chekan ik'jokel spichul heb' winh schawanhil. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan mak'jok heb' winh heb' winh t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.

Manh jantakok ix aj heb' winh yik'ani. Ixlajwi chi', ix yumjioch heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yalan heb' winh juez chi' t'a winh stanhwumal preso chi': --Tza tanhwej wal heb' winh sik'lab'il, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix b'at winh yak'kanoch heb' winh t'a jun cuarto t'a slajwub'xo k'ochi. Ix yak'anoch yok heb' winh t'a slot'il jun te' cepo.

Haxo t'ak'walil, ix lesalwi winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'. Ix sb'itan juntzanh b'it heb' winh t'a Dios. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix yab' heb' sb'itan heb' winh. Haxo t'a chimilak'wal

ix ek' jun niwan kixkab', te ow ix yutej sb'a. Ix laj ib'xik'e yich preso chi'. Haxo t'a jun rato chi', munil ix laj jakwi spuertail jun preso chi' smasanil. Haxo k'e'en cadena ayoch t'a heb' preso chi', ix laj elta chokoljok k'e'en.

Haxo ix el swayanh winh tanhwum preso chi', ix yilan winh to jakanxo jantaknhej spuertail preso chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'k'eta k'e'en yespada winh t'a yol yatut yik smilancham sb'a winh sna'ani. Ha sna'an winh to ix b'at heb' elelal smasanil.
Palta haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix awajelta t'a winh: --Manh a milcham a b'a, ayonh ek' ko masanil, xchielta winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'ankot sk'ak' winh. Ix och winh b'aj ay heb' chi'. Ix te ib'xik'e winh yuj xiwelal. Ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' winh chawanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ex mamin, ¿tas yowalil tzin k'ulej yik tzin kolchaji? xchi winh.
--Ak'och Kajal Jesucristo t'a a k'o'ol, yik wach' ol ach kolchaj yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj et' t'a yol a pat, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan slolonel Kajal Jesús heb' winh t'a winh yet' t'a jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh.

Hanheja' t'a jun rato chi' ix b'ikjiel schik'il heb' winh b'aj ix lajwi smak'ji chi' yuj winh tanhwum preso chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh yet' heb' junnhej yaj yet' winh t'a yol spat chi'.
Ichato chi' ix ak'jioch heb' winh yuj winh t'a yol spat. Ix ak'ji wa heb' winh yuj winh. Ix te tzalaj winh yet' heb' kajanek' yet' chi' yujto ix yak'och Dios heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, ix chekjib'at juntzanh heb' winh polenkía yuj heb' winh juez. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh tanhwum preso chi' to tz'el winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a libre.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ix in cha jun órden yuj heb' winh juez chi', tob' tzex wak'el t'a libre. Yuj chi' ixikek. Paxanhek t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' winh polenkía chi': --Ha onh tik, aj Roma onh. Maj sk'anb'ej yab' heb' winh tato ay ko mul. Palta ina ix onh smak' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Haxo tiknaik, ¿tom snib'ej heb' winh t'a elk'altak tzonh yak'el t'a libre? Manh ol onh el-laj. Kotokab' heb' winh juez chi'. Ha wal lak'an heb' winh ol onh ik'anelok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a heb' winh juez chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh to aj Roma heb' winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' winh.

Haxo wal lak'an heb' winh ix b'at k'anan niwank'olal sb'a t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jielta heb' winh yuj heb' winh t'a preso chi'. --Sko k'an pawor t'ayex, komonok tzex el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi heb' winh juez chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi yelta heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a spat ix Lidia. Ix sk'umlan sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' creyente. Ix ak'jikan yip sk'o'ol heb' yuj heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh.
Ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a chonhab' Anfípolis yet' t'a chonhab' Apolonia. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tesalónica b'aj ay jun spatil culto.
Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och winh yet' heb' ta' ichataxon smodo winh. Oxe' k'uhal ik'oj ip ix yak' winh yak'lab'an Slolonel Dios yalan t'a heb' israel

chajtil to a Cristo yowalil ix yab' sya'il, ix miljichamok. Yowalil pax ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak. Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha Jesús wan walan yab'ixal tik t'ayex, haton Cristo, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ay jaywanh heb' israel ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ix och heb' yetb'eyumok winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'. Tzijtum heb' griego ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel ix ak'anpaxoch t'a sk'o'ol. Tzijtum pax heb' ix ix ojtakab'il yuj heb' anima ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.

Palta haxo heb' israel maj ak'anochlaj t'a sk'o'ol, ayik ix yilan heb', ix te kot yowal heb'. Ix smolb'an juntzanh heb' chuk spensar heb'. Ha heb' chi', anhej chukal tzek' sayek' heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi yak'ji sk'o'ol heb' yuj heb', ix ek' smolb'an heb' anima heb' smasanil. Ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' ste kot yowal. Ix yak'an yip heb' yekanoch sb'a t'a yol spat jun winh skuch Jasón, yujto a sna'an heb' to hata' ayek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi', yujto snib'ej heb' syik'elta heb' winh yik syak'anoch heb' winh heb' t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'.

Palta malaj heb' winh ayek' t'a yol pat chi'. Yuj chi', ix syam winhaj Jasón heb' yet' jaywanhxo heb' creyente. Ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb' winh t'a heb' winh yajal. Haxo ta' ix yal cha'anh heb': --Ha winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas, tzek' heb' winh yak' somchajel heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Haxo tiknaik ix ja heb' winh t'ayonh.

Ha winhaj Jasón tik ix cha'anoch heb' winh t'a yol spat. Ha heb' winh tik toxon max sk'anab'ajej sley winh kajal t'a Roma heb' winh, yujto syal heb' winh to ay junxo rey skuchan Jesús, xchi heb' t'a heb' winh yajal chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh yajal yet' heb' chonhab' chi', ix k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal.
Haxo k'e'en tumin ix sk'an heb' yajal chi' t'a winhaj Jasón yet' t'a heb' ajun yet' winh chi'. Ichato chi', ix aktajel heb'.
Haxo yik ix k'ik'b'i, ix chekjib'at winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' yuj heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Berea. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh ta', ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil culto.

Ha heb' israel aj Berea chi' más wach' spensar heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Tesalónica chi', yujto ix smaklej wal yab' slolonel Dios heb'. Haxo t'a junjun k'u, sk'ayb'an heb' tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios yik syil heb' tato yel syal winhaj Pablo chi'.
Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' israel yet' heb' griego ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol. Ha t'a skal heb' chi' ay heb' ix ix ojtakab'il yuj heb' anima yet' pax heb' winh winak.

Palta haxo heb' israel aj Tesalónica, ayik ix yab'an heb' to wan yalanel slolonel Dios winhaj Pablo t'a Berea chi', ix b'at heb' ta'. Ayik ix k'och heb', ix yak'k'e somnaj heb' chonhab' chi' heb' skot yowal.
Palta elanhchamel ix chekjib'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sti' ha' mar yuj heb' creyente. Haxo winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo ix kan heb' winh t'a chonhab' Berea chi'.

Ha heb' creyente ix b'at yet' winhaj Pablo chi', ix b'atnhej heb' yet' winh masanto t'a chonhab' Atenas. Ayik ix k'och heb' ta' ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Tzeyal t'a winhaj Silas yet' t'a winhaj Timoteo to skot heb' winh t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb'.

Ayik wan stanhwan winhaj Pablo sk'och winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo chi' t'a chonhab' Atenas, ix yilan winh, manh jantakok juntzanh tas syaloch heb' anima sdiosalok. Yuj chi' ix te kus winh yilani.

Ichato chi' ix och winh t'a yol spatil culto. Ix stelan sb'a winh yet' heb' israel yet' heb' ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb'. Haxo t'a junjun k'u ix laj yalub'tanhej pax winh yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a mercado.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak te jelan sk'ayb'an sjelanil heb' skuch epicúreo yet' juntzanh heb' skuch estoico. Ix och ijan heb' winh slolon yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo nanhalxo heb' winh ix alub'tanhan icha tik: --Ha jun winh te jelan slolon tik, ¿tastaxlaj ol yal winh t'ayonh? xchi heb' winh. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh ix halan icha tik: --Ha ko na'ani to tzul yal yab'ixal juntzanhxo ch'ok diosal winh, xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' winh yujto ix yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalanpax winh to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak.

Haxo heb' winh jelan chi' ix ik'anb'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a jun yune' tzalan skuch Areópago, haton jun b'aj smolb'ejtaxon sb'a heb' winh yik syak'an slajti' heb' winh. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh ta' ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --Ha jun ak' k'ayb'ub'al tzalel tik, ¿tzam yal kab'an smasanil?
Yujto manta b'aj skab' juntzanh tik, yuj chi' ko gana skojtakejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' yujto masanil heb' anima t'a Atenas chi' yet' pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' ta', ch'ok smodo heb'. Tato ay junok ak' k'ayb'ub'al tz'alji, snib'ej heb' syab' smasanil, syalan paxel heb' junelxo. Anhej ta' syak'och spensar heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', ix k'e linhan winh t'a skal heb' t'a Areópago chi', ix yalan winh: --Ex yajal t'a Atenas tik, ix wila'' to te ay wal och he pensar t'a juntzanh he diosal.

Yujto ayik ix in b'eyek' t'a yol he chonhab' tik, ix in ek' wil b'ajtak slaj eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh he diosal chi'. Ix wilan pax jun sb'akhnub' silab' b'ajtil tz'ib'ab'ilkan och eyuj icha tik: Ha t'a tik skak'em ko b'a t'a jun Dios manh ojtakab'ilok, xchi. Ha jun Dios chi', niwanok tzeyak'em he b'a t'ay, palta manh eyojtakok. Haton jun Dios chi' tzul wal yab'ixal t'ayex.

Ha jun Dios swal tik, a b'ojinak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Haton yajal yaj t'a satcha'anh, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha jun Dios chi', max kajnaj t'a junok pat b'ob'il yuj heb' anima.
Manh yowalilok ay tas tz'ak'ji t'ay yuj heb' anima. Yujto haton tz'ak'an ko k 'inal ko masanil. Ha tz'ak'an kik' kik', a tz'ak'anpax masanil tas ay t'ayonh.

Haton b'ojinak jun winh b'ab'el winak ochnak smam yichamok junjun nación, yik aynhej anima t'a masanil sat lu'um tik. Ha tz'alani jantak tiempoal tzek' junjun nación. Ha tz'alanpaxi b'ajtil sk'och k'aman smakb'en junjun.

Icha chi' syutej yik wach' tz'ilchaj yuj heb' anima. Wach'chom tonhej tzek' machmon heb' sayek'i yik tope wal tz'ilchaj yuj heb'. Palta swal t'ayex, manh najatok ayek' Dios chi'. Lak'an ayek' t'a ko tz'ey junjun onh.

Yel, yujnhej Dios chi' pitzan onh. Yuj ay ko k 'inal. Yuj ay onh ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ay juntzanh heb' eyetchonhab' jelan sloloni. Syalan heb' icha tik: Yuninal onh Dios ko masanil, xchi heb'.

Yel ton syal heb', yuninal onh Dios. Yuj chi' manhxo smojok sko na'a to Dios juntzanh yechel b'ob'il tik yet' k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' juntzanhxo k'e'en k'e'en. Ha juntzanh yechel tik yujnhej sjelanil heb' anima sb'o'i.
Ha t'a peka' manh yojtakok heb' anima chajtil yaj Dios. Yuj chi' niwan yutejnak sk'o'ol t'a heb'. Palta a tz'alan tiknaik to yowalil sna sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yujto yalnakkani to ay jun k'uhal ol sch'olb'itej tas yaj heb' anima smasanil. Tojol ol yutok sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb', icha tas tz'el sk'ulan junjun heb'. Haxo jun sik'b'ilkanel yuj, haton jun chi' ol ch'olb'itan tas yaj heb'. Ix sch'ox Dios t'a heb' anima smasanil to te yel jun tik ayik ix ik'jik'e wa'an jun sik'b'ilkanel yuj chi' t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Palta ayik ix yab'an heb' to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, ay heb' ix laj b'uchwaj t'a winh. Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix halani: --Olto ko k'anb'ejxi kab' juntzanh tik t'ayach, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' heb', ix el winh t'a skal heb'.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol. Ix och heb' yetb'eyumok winhaj Pablo chi'. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', hata' ayek' winhaj Dionisio, winh yetyajalil sb'a yet' heb' smolb'ej sb'a t'a Areópago chi'. Ay pax jun ix ix skuchan Dámaris yet' juntzanhxo heb'.
Ixlajwi slolon winhaj Pablo t'a Areópago chi', ix helxi winh t'a chonhab' Atenas chi', haxo t'a chonhab' Corinto ix k'och winh.

Hata' ay jun winh israel skuch Aquila. Ha t'a yol yik Ponto aljinak winh. Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, Priscila sb'i ix. Ek'nak winh t'a yol yik Italia yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', palta a winh yajal skuchan Claudio, a winh pechjinakel jantak heb' israel ayek' t'a chonhab' Roma t'a yol yik Italia chi'. Yuj chi' ix helxi heb' ta', ix k'ochkan heb' t'a Corinto chi'. Haxo winhaj Pablo ix k'och t'a spat heb'.
Hata' ix kan winh yet' heb' yujto lajan smunlajel winh yet' heb' schawanhil. Ha juntzanh mantiado sb'o heb', yuj chi' junnhej ix munlaj winh yet' heb' ta'.
Haxo t'a junjun sk'uhal ik'oj ip, sb'at winhaj Pablo chi' yalel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal heb', syak'an winh yojtakejel heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok yik syak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Haxo winhaj Silas yet' winhaj Timoteo, ix kotxi heb' winh t'a yol yik Macedonia. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a Corinto chi', a winhaj Pablo, haxonhej slolonel Dios ix yalel winh. Ix ste ak'an wal winh yojtakejel heb' israel to a Jesús haton Cristo, jun tanhwab'iltaxon sja yuj heb'.

Palta tonhej ix kot yowal heb' t'a winh. Ix laj te b'uchwaj heb'. Yuj chi' ix stzikub'tanhej spichul winh yil heb', yik sch'oxanel winh to manhxalaj yalan yik winh t'a heb'. Ix yalankan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha ex tik, munil tzeyik'kot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh t'a junelnhej. Ha in xo tik manhxa walan wik t'ayex. Ha tiknaik ol in b'at walel t'a heb' manh israelok, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta winh b'aj tz'och culto chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat jun winh skuch Ticio Justo. Ha jun winh chi' syak' wal och Dios winh t'a sk'o'ol. Ha spat winh ha t'a stz'ey spatil culto chi' ay.

Ay jun winh skuch Crispo kuchb'um yaj t'a culto. Ix yak'och Kajal Jesús winh t'a sk'o'ol yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj yet' winh t'a yol spat. Tzijtum heb' aj Corinto chi' ayik ix yab'an slolonel Dios heb', ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, ix ak'jipax bautizar heb'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal, icha wayich ix yutej Kajal Jesús yalan t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Manh ach xiwok. Manh ach och wa'an alanel in lolonel,
yujto ay in ek' het'ok. Malaj junok mach ol yal skot juknaj t'ayach, yujto tzijtum mach sik'b'iltaxonel wu'uj t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' nanhal schab'il ab'il ix aj winh t'a Corinto chi'. Ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima winh t'a slolonel Dios ta'.
Ayik ayoch winhaj Galión yajalil t'a yol yik Acaya, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' israel t'a spatik winhaj Pablo chi', ix syaman winh heb', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a yichanh winh yajal.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh yajal chi': --Ha jun winh tik tzek' ak'an sk'o'ol heb' anima, yik wach' niwanok syal sb'a heb' t'a Dios, palta manh ichaok yaj ley, xchi heb'.

Wanxo wal yalan yik winhaj Pablo chi', palta ix yalan winhaj Galión chi' t'a heb' israel chi': --Manh ex awajochta t'ayin. K'inalok ay junok chukal sk'ulej winh tik, mato ay junok smul winh te chuk t'a yichanh ley, tato icha chi' tzam in cha wab' tas tzeyala'.

Palta ina tonhej he gana tzeyak' owal yuj juntzanh lolonel syal winh, yuj juntzanh mach tz'ak'an b'inaj winh yet' pax yuj he ley. Yuj chi' ixikek, b'at b'o'ek yaj jun tik he ch'okoj. Xal in tik, max yal in k'ol tzin b'o juntzanh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix spechanelta heb' winh t'a yol sdespacho chi'.

Haxo winhaj Sóstenes ix syam heb', haton jun winh skuchb'an heb' t'a culto. Ix smak'an winh heb' t'a sti' sdespacho winh yajal chi'. Palta tonhej ix och k'elan winh yajal chi', malaj jab'ok tas ix yal winh t'a heb'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', niwanto tiempo ix ek' winh t'a Corinto chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalankan kil ko b'a winh t'a heb' creyente chi'. Ix b'at ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila yet' winh. Ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cencrea. Haxo ta' ix och heb' t'a yol jun barco wan sb'at t'a Siria. Ayik manto och heb' t'a yol barco chi', ix joxchajkanel winhaj Pablo chi' ta'. Ha jun chi' yechel yaji to ay jun sti' winh ix yak' t'a Dios.
Haxo ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Éfeso b'aj ix kan ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila chi', ix b'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a spatil culto. Haxo ta' ix lolon winh yet' heb' yetisraelal.
Ix sk'an wal heb' t'a winh to skan jaye'ok k'uhal winh yet' heb', palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh.
Haxo yik wan yalankan kil ko b'a winh t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Tato ol el t'a sk'ol Dios, ol in ek' t'ayex junelxo, xchikan winh t'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi winh t'a yol te' barco.
Ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ixlajwi chi', ix helxi winh ta'. Ix k'e winh t'a Jerusalén b'at sk'umej heb' creyente. Ixlajwi yek' winh ta', ix em winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía.

Hata' ix ek' jun pekti' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi winh. Ix ek' winh t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Galacia yet' t'a yol yik Frigia. Ix laj ek' yak'kan stek'anil heb' creyente winh b'aj ix laj ek'i.

Haxo t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh israel skuchan Apolos. Aj chonhab' Alejandría winh, ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Éfeso. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalaneli, yujto yojtak wal slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

k'ayb'ab'il winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jesús. Ix yal wal el wach' ab'ix winh t'a smasanil sk'o'ol. Te wach' ix yutej winh yalanel yab'ixal Jesús chi', wach'chom anhejanto juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Juan, winh ak'annak bautizar yojtak winh.

Haxo junel, ix b'at yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a yol spatil culto. Te tek'an ix yutej sb'a winh yalaneli. Haxo yik ix yab'an ix Priscila yet' winhaj Aquila, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' yet'ok. Ix swach' k'ayb'an winh heb' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios.

Ixlajwi chi', ix el t'a sk'o'ol winhaj Apolos chi' sb'at t'a yol yik Acaya. Yuj chi', haxo heb' creyente ix kolwaj yet' winh. Ix stz'ib'an jun carta heb', yik syik'b'at winh t'a heb' creyente, yik wach' schaji winh yuj heb' sk'ochi. Ayik ix k'och winh ta', a heb' yak'nakoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol yuj swach'k'olal Dios, ix te kuchb'aj heb' yuj winh.

Ix yak' wal yip winh sch'oxaneli to yelk'olal satnak sk'o'ol heb' israel. Ha slolonel Dios tz'ib'ab'ilkani, ha' ix yak'lab'ej winh yalan t'a heb' anima yik wach' snachajel yuj heb' to a Jesús haton Cristo, jun tanhwab'iltaxon sja yuj heb'.

Ayik ayek' winhaj Apolos t'a Corinto, ix ek' winhaj Pablo t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a tzalkixtak. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Éfeso. Hata' ix yil-lajel sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' creyente.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Ix am he cha Yespíritu Dios ayik ix eyak'anoch Cristo t'a he k'o'ol? xchi winh t'a heb'. --Ma'ay, manta b'aj ix kab'i tato ay Yespíritu Dios chi', xchi heb'.
--Palta ayik ix ex ak'ji bautizar, ¿tas yaj jun bautismo ix he cha chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'. --Haton jun bautismo yik winhaj Juan ix ko cha'a, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalxi winh t'a heb': --Ha sbautismo winhaj Juan chi', ha' sch'oxaneli to sna sb'a heb' anima t'a smul. Palta yalnak winh t'a heb' to ay jun tzak'anto sja yuj winh. Yowalil ha t'a jun chi' syak'och spensar heb'. Ha jun ix yal winh chi', a Jesús, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix ak'ji bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sjolom junjun heb'. Ichato chi' ix ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a heb'. Ix lolon heb' t'a juntzanh ch'okch'ok ti'al, ix yalanel juntzanh lolonel ix ak'ji yal heb' yuj Dios.
Ha heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol chi', ay am lajchawanhok heb'.

Oxe' ujal xit' yalel slolonel Dios winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol spatil culto t'a chonhab' Éfeso chi'. Malaj junok mach b'aj ix xiw winh yalanel t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta'. Ix yak'lej winh yak'an nachajel yuj heb' sik'lab'il tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' te pit t'a skal heb' chi'. Junelnhej malaj snib'ej heb' syak'och t'a sk'o'ol. Ix laj ek' heb' yal t'a heb' anima to chuk jun k'ayb'ub'al yik heb' creyente chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'el sb'a winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb' creyente chi' winh t'a jun escuela yik jun winh skuch Tirano. Haxo ta' ix yalel slolonel Dios winh t'a skal heb' t'a junjun k'u.
Chab' ab'il ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi'. Yuj chi', ix laj yab' yab'ixal Kajal Jesús masanil heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok ay t'a yol yik Asia chi'.
Haxo Dios ix och yet' winhaj Pablo chi', yik sb'o'an juntzanh milagro winh te satub'tak.

Ay heb' ix ik'ankot spayu' yet' spichul, ix sukanek' heb' t'a sniwanil winh, slajwi chi' haxo t'a sniwanil heb' pena'ay sb'at sukek' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikan sk'o'ol heb'. Ay pax heb' winh enemigo ix el t'a heb' anima chi' yuj winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' israel skomon b'eyek'i. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel heb' enemigo t'a heb' anima. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel heb' t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús. Yuj chi' ix skomon alej heb' t'a heb' enemigo chi': --Ha t'a sb'i Jesús, skal t'ayex, elanhek. Ha Jesús chi', haton jun tzek' yalel yab'ixal winhaj Pablo, xchi heb'.
Sk'ulej pax jun tik ukwanh heb' yuninal jun winh israel skuch Esceva winh sat sacerdote. Ix yak'lej heb' yik'anel jun enemigo.
Haxo ix tak'wi jun enemigo chi' t'a heb': --Wojtak Jesús chi'. Toxo ix wab'paxi mach jun winh tzeyal Pabloal chi'. Palta a exxo tik, ¿mach ex? xchi.

Haxo winh b'aj ayoch jun enemigo chi', ix kot juknaj winh t'a heb'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' smasanil yuj winh. Te ya' ix ek' heb' yuj winh. Tzijtum b'aj ix lajwi heb'. Ix kichjiel sk'apak heb' yuj winh, yuj chi' b'eranel heb' ix elta lemnaj heb' t'a jun pat chi'.
Haxo heb' aj Éfeso chi' smasanil, heb' israel yet' heb' manh israelok, ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix te xiw heb' smasanil. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Kajal Jesús.
Hanhejtona', tzijtum heb' ayoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol ix laj k'ochi. Ix yalank'eta jantaknhej juntzanh chukal ix laj sk'ulej heb'.

Te tzijtum heb' yak'nakoch sb'a ajb'a'alil ix och creyenteal. Ix yik'kot juntzanh yumal b'aj sk'ayb'ej jun ajb'a'alil chi' heb'. Ix snhusantz'a juntzanh chi' heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Ayik ix sb'isan stojol juntzanh ch'anh u'um chi' heb', ix elk'och am t'a junok 50,000 dracma.
Ix te pukaxel slolonel Dios, tzijtum pax heb' anima ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol. Icha chi' ix aj scheklajeli to te niwan spoder slolonel chi'.

Ixlajwi juntzanh chi', ix sna'an winhaj Pablo chi' to tzek' winh t'a yol yik Macedonia yet' t'a yol yik Acaya, haxo sk'och winh chi' t'a Jerusalén. Ix yalan winh: --Ol lajwok chi', yowalil ol in k'och t'a Roma, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek b'ab'laj chawanh heb' schekab' winh t'a Macedonia chi', haton winhaj Timoteo yet' winhaj Erasto. Palta haxo winhaj Pablo chi', najtiltakto ix kan winh t'a yol yik Asia chi'.
Haxo t'a jun pekti' chi', ix te k'e nhilnaj heb' anima skot yowal yuj sk'ayb'ub'al Kajal Jesús.

Ay jun winh b'o'um plata skuch Demetrio. Ha juntzanh yechel stemplo jun sdiosal heb' skuchan Diana sb'o winh. Ix jun sdiosal heb' chi'. Ha heb' sb'o'an juntzanh yechel chi', niwan tumin syak' ganar heb' t'a spatik.

Ha winh ix molb'an jantaknhej heb' sb'o'an juntzanh yechel chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' lajan yopisio yet' winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetmunlajwumal, eyojtak jantak ko tumin skak' ganar t'a jun kopisio tik.

Palta ina tzeyila', tzeyab'anpaxi, tas wan sk'ulan winhaj Pablo. Syalan winh to a juntzanh Dios b'ob'il yuj anima, manh diosok. Tzijtum anima ix yak' sk'o'ol winh. Manhoknhej t'a chonhab' Éfeso tik, palta kenxonhej maj ak'jok sk'o'ol masanil heb' ay t'a yol yik Asia tik yuj winh.

Te ay smay jun tik. Tekan manhxo ol b'atlaj ko chonh yuj. Haxo pax ko diosal Diana, tekan manhxalaj ol elk'och stemplo t'a yichanh heb' anima. Ha jun ko diosal tik, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil t'a Asia tik yet' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal. Palta haxo tiknaik ay smay, tekan ol lajwokel yopisio t'a yichanh heb', xchi winh.
Haxo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix te kot yowal heb', ix awaj cha'anh heb': --Te niwan yelk'och ix ko diosal Diana a onh aj Éfeso onh tik, xchi heb'.

Haxo heb' chonhab' chi' smasanil, ix te k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal. Ix syaman winhaj Gayo heb' yet' winhaj Aristarco. Ha chawanh heb' winh chi', aj Macedonia heb' winh, ajun heb' winh ix k'och yet' winhaj Pablo t'a Éfeso chi'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a jun lugar b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima.
Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', snib'ej winh sb'at yal t'a heb' anima chi', palta maj chajib'atlaj winh yuj heb' creyente.
Ay pax jaywanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Asia chi' wach' yak'an yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix schekan aljok heb' winh t'a winh to max b'at sch'ox sb'a winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Haxo heb' anima ix smolb'ej sb'a chi', ch'okch'ok ix laj yalk'e junjun heb', yujto tonhej ix laj k'e somnaj heb' yalani. Ek'to nanhal heb' manh ojtannakok tas yuj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.

Palta ay jun winh skuch Alejandro, a winh ix ik'jib'at t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ix alchaj t'a winh tas yuj molanek' heb' anima chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh t'a heb', yik wach' numan tz'aj heb', yujto snib'ej winh skol sb'a yet' heb' yetisraelal.

Palta ayik ix yilan heb' anima chi' to israel winh, yuj chi' ix te wach' k'e yaw heb' smasanil. Ay am chab'ok hora ix awajk'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Te niwan yelk'och ix ko diosal Diana a onh aj Éfeso onh tik, xchi heb'.

Haxo winh secretarioal chonhab' chi', k'ojank'olal ix smontej heb' winh yik wach' numan tz'aj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetchonhab', masanil anima ojtannak to a onh aj Éfeso onh tik ay kopisio ko tanhwan jun stemplo ko diosal Diana niwan yelk'ochi yet' jun yechel ix kotnak t'a satcha'anh.
Malaj junok mach syal yalani to es juntzanh swal tik. Yuj chi' numan tzex aji. Naek wal sik'lab'il, yik wach' malaj junok tas tze komon k'ulej.
Yujto a heb' ix eyik'kot tik, malaj junok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a spatik ko diosal. Max b'uchwaj pax heb' t'a ix.

Ha winhaj Demetrio yet' heb' yetb'eyum, tato snib'ej heb' syak'och t'a yib'anh junok mach, syal sb'at heb' t'a juzgado, b'at yalan heb' t'a winh juez. Syal b'at yalan sb'a heb' t'a heb' winh yajal chi'.
Tato ay junokxo tas he gana, syal tze k'umlaj he b'a yet' heb' winh yajal chi', tze b'oan yaj ta'.

Yujto te ay smay jun tas sko k'ulej tik, syal sna'an heb' winh yajal to a yet' heb' winh wan kak'an owal. Tato sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayonh: ¿Tas yuj ix ex k'e b'ulnaj eyak'an owal? tato xchi heb' winh, max yal-laj ko kolan ko b'a kalan junok tas t'a heb' winh, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh secretario chi', ix schekan pax heb' anima chi' winh smasanil t'a spat.

Ayik toxo ix lajwi jun owal chi', ix smolb'an heb' creyente winhaj Pablo. Ix ak'jikan stek'anil heb' yuj winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankan kil ko b'a winh t'a heb', ix b'atxi winh t'a yol yik Macedonia.
Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix laj ek' winh yil heb' creyente t'a junjun chonhab'. Ix ek' yak'an stek'anil heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a yol yik Grecia.

Hata' ix ek' oxe' ujal winh. Ixlajwi chi', ayik toxo wan yoch winh t'a yol te' barco yik sb'at winh t'a Siria, ix yab'an winh to ay tas sna heb' israel t'a spatik winh. Yuj chi', ix sna'an winh: Más wach' tzin meltzajxiek' t'a Macedonia, xchi winh.

Haxo ix b'at winh, ay juntzanhxo heb' creyente ix b'at yet' winh. Ix b'at winhaj Sópater yuninal winhaj Pirro aj Berea yet' winh, winhaj Aristarco, winhaj Segundo aj Tesalónica, winhaj Gayo aj Derbe yet' pax winhaj Timoteo. Ay pax chawanh heb' winh aj Asia ix b'at yet' winh, haton winhaj Tíquico yet' winhaj Trófimo.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Filipos b'aj ayin ek'i, ix yaktejkan winhaj Pablo chi' heb' winh wet' ta'. Ix b'ab'laj b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Troas. Haxo ta' ix onh stanhwej heb' winh.

Ha onhxo tik, ha t'a chonhab' Filipos chi' ix ko tanhwej kil jun k'inh b'aj swaji ixim pan malaj yich. Ixlajwi yek' jun k'inh chi', ix onh b'at t'a yol barco. Oye' k'uhal ix onh b'ey t'a sat ha ha'. Ichato chi' ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Troas chi'. Haxo ta' ix kil-laj ko b'a yet' heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ku'uj chi'. Uke' k'uhal ix onh ek' ta'.

Haxo t'a domingo ix ko molb'ej ko b'a yet' heb' creyente smasanil yik sko wa'an ixim pan yik Santa Cena. Haxo winhaj Pablo ix k'ayb'an heb' ketcreyenteal. Yujto k'ik'anokxonhej sb'at winh, yuj chi' tzijtum tas ix yalkan winh t'a heb', masanto ix och chimilak'wal.
Ha t'a jun cuarto cha'anh yajk'ei, hata' molan onh ek'i. Tzijtum candil ayoch sk'ak'al.

Ay jun winh kelem skuchan Eutico k'ojanem t'a sti' wentena. Toxonhej sneknekan winh swayi, yujto junip ix yak' winhaj Pablo chi' sloloni. Yuj chi' ix te kot swayanh winh, ix elta pichnaj winh t'a sti' jun wentena chi'. Hato t'a yoxil piso ix elta sutnaj winh. Haxo ix emul heb' creyente chi', ix schelan cha'anh winh heb', palta chamnakxo winh.
Haxo ix emul winhaj Pablo chi', ix em lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' creyente chi': --Manh ex och ilk'olal. Ix pitzwixi winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ex winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol cuarto chi' junelxo. Ix spukanb'at ixim pan yik Santa Cena winh t'a ko kal. Ix ko wa'ani. Tzijtumto tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi', masanto ayik wan sakb'i. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh.
Haxo winh kelem ix pitzwixi chi', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a spat. Ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix pitzwixi winh.
Ha onh tik, ix onh b'ab'laj och t'a yol jun barco, ix onh b'at t'a chonhab' Asón. Hata' ix ko tanhwej sk'och winhaj Pablo chi' icha ix kutej kalan yet' winh, yujto t'a yok winh ix b'ati.
Haxo ix k'och winh t'ayonh, ix och winh t'a yol barco ket'ok. Ixlajwi chi, ix onh b'at yet' winh t'a chonhab' Mitilene.

Ix onh helxi ta', haxo t'a yichanhkot chonhab' Quío ix onh wanaj jun k'uhal. Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch Samos ay t'a sti' ha' mar chi'. Ha t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'atxi, haxo t'a chonhab' Mileto ix onh k'ochi.

Icha chi' ix aj ko b'ati, yujto maj yal sk'ol winhaj Pablo chi' ix onh ek' t'a chonhab' Éfeso, yujto snib'ej winh elanhchamel tzonh ek' t'a Asia chi', yik talaj k'okb'ilto tzonh k'och kil jun k'inh Pentecostés t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Mileto, ix yak'anb'at schekab' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' winh anciano aj Éfeso, yik b'at ik'jokkot heb' winh.
Haxo ix ja heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, eyojtaktaxon in b'eyb'al yiktax ix in ulek' sb'ab'elal t'a Asia tik.
Masanil tiempo ix wak' serwil Kajal Jesús t'a emnakilal. Ay b'aj te ok'nak in yuj spital heb' anima. Tzijtum el ix in ak'ji prowal yuj juntzanh chukal ix yak'och heb' wetisraelal t'a wib'anh.
Palta eyojtak, maj in och wa'an walan masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al wach' t'ayex, yik tze tek'b'ej he b'a. Ix walel slolonel Dios t'ayex t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' yet' pax t'a yol he pat.
Ix walanpaxel t'a heb' israel yet' t'a heb' manh israelok, to yowalil sna sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Dios, syak'anoch Kajal Jesucristo heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo tiknaik, wan in b'at t'a Jerusalén, yujto a Yespíritu Dios tzin ik'anb'ati. Manh wojtakok tas ol jawok t'a wib'anh ta'.
Palta wojtak to tzijtum ya'elal ol ak'jokoch t'a wib'anh. Ol in och t'a preso, yujto icha chi' syal Yespíritu Dios t'ayin t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj in ek'i.

Palta a juntzanh chi', malaj tas tzin na yuj. Wach'chom ol in smilcham heb', palta b'alaj malaj yelk'och jun chi' t'ayin. Anhej jun tzin na'a to swak'kan lajwok jun in munlajel ayoch tik t'a wib'anh t'a tzalajk'olal, yik slajwi wopisio yak'nak Kajal Jesús t'ayin, yik swalanel wach' ab'ix to niwan swach'k'olal Dios t'a heb' anima.
Ek'nak in wal t'ayex chajtil tz'aj he yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Haxo tiknaik wojtak to manhxa b'ak'inh ol kil ko b'a t'a tik.
Yuj chi', ha t'a jun k'u tik, manhxalaj walan wik t'ayex,
yujto ix walkanel masanil juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Dios t'ayex, malaj jab'ok ix in k'ub'ejeli.
Yuj chi', tzeyil wal he b'a. Tzeyilanpax heb' creyente smasanil, yujto ak'b'il eyopisio yuj Yespíritu Dios eyilan heb' manb'ilxo yuj schik'il Kajal Jesús ayik ix cham ku'uj.
Yujto wojtak, ayik toxo ix in pax t'a he kal, ay juntzanh heb' ol ja t'ayex, ol yak'lan heb' ex yixtani, icha syutej nok' okes yik'anelta nok' kalnel.
T'a he kal paxi, ay juntzanhxo heb' ol k'e wa'an. Ol yesan heb', ol yak'an sk'o'ol heb' creyente heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' heb'.
Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a. Naekkoti to ayik ix ex in k'ayb'an junjunex t'a oxe' ab'il tik, t'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ix ex in k'ayb'ej, ay pax b'aj ix in ok' eyu'uj.

Xal tiknaik, ex wuk'tak, tzex wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yik ha' ol ex tanhwan yet' slolonel. Yuj slolonel chi' syak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh, yuj pax to ay spoder yak'an ko tek'anil. Yuj chi' ol yak' jun tas altab'il yuj t'ayex, yujto ay eyalan heyik yet' juntzanh heb' sik'b'ilxoel yuj.
Ha in tik, malaj b'aj ix wiloch in k'o'ol t'a stumin, ma t'a spichul junok mach.
Ina eyojtak, munil ix in munlaj wal yet' in k'ab' yuj tas ay ix och wu'uj yet' yuj tas ay ix och yuj heb' ajun wet'ok.

Masanil tiempo ix in ch'ox t'ayex to yowalil icha chi' skutej ko b'oan ko munlajel, yik syal ko kolwaj t'a heb' ay tas ay tz'och yuj. Yowalil sko nakot slolonel Kajal Jesús, ayik ix yalankan icha tik: Ha heb' tz'ak'an junok tas, ek'alxo wal wach' yik heb' t'a yichanh heb' scha'ani, xchi Kajal Jesús chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh anciano chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo chi', ix em kuman winh. Ix lesalwi winh yet' heb' smasanil.
Ixlajwi slesalwi heb', ix och ijan heb' yok' smasanil. Junjunal ix och lak'naj heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi', ix stz'ub'ankanelta sti' winh heb'.
Ix te kus heb' yujto ix yal winh t'a heb' to manhxa b'ak'inh ol yil-lajxi sb'a heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'ankan winh heb' t'a yol barco chi'.

Ix kaktejkan heb' creyente chi', ix onh och t'a yol barco. T'inhannhej ix onh b'ati, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Cos. Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Rodas. Ixlajwi chi' ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Pátara.
Hata' ayek' jun barco wan sb'at t'a yol yik Fenicia. Ix onh och t'a yo'ol, ix onh b'atxi.

Ayik wanxo ko b'eyi, ix kilankanb'at jun lu'um skuch Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Ha t'a ko k'exanh ix kani. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Tiro t'a yol yik Siria, yujto hata' ix kan yikatz te' barco chi'.

Haxo ix onh elta t'a yol te', ay heb' creyente ix ilchajel ku'uj. Ix onh aj yet' heb' uke' k'uhal ta'. Ha heb' chi' ix halan icha tik t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ok wal max ach b'at t'a Jerusalén, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb', yujto a Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an yojtakejel heb' tas ol ja t'a yib'anh winh ta'.

Haxo yik ix ek'b'at uke' k'uhal chi', ix onh b'atxi. Haxo heb' winh kuk'tak chi' smasanil yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' winh, ix xit'ek' heb' onh yak'kanel t'a stiel chonhab' chi'. Haxo ta' ix onh em kuman t'a sti' ha' mar, ix onh lesalwi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kalankan kil ko b'a t'a heb'. Ix onh ochxikan t'a yol barco chi'. Ix laj paxixkan heb' t'a spat.
Ayik ix onh helxi t'a chonhab' Tiro chi', ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Tolemaida. Hata' ix kaktejkan te' barco chi'. Ix onh lolon yet' heb' creyente ta'. Jun k'uhal ix onh ek' yet' heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ha t'a spat winhaj Felipe, winh tz'alanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il, hata' ix onh wanaji. Ha jun winh chi', haton winh sik'b'iloch diáconoal t'a Jerusalén yet' wakwanhxo heb' winh.
Ay chanhwanh yisil winhaj Felipe chi', mantalaj yetb'eyum heb' ix. Syalel slolonel Dios heb' ix.
Ayik ix onh ek' jaye' k'uhal ta', ix k'och jun winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios skuchan Agabo t'ayonh, ha t'a yol yik Judea kot winh.

Ix xit'ek' winh onh sk'umej. Ayik wan ko lolon yet' winh, ix yik'anel stzek'ul winhaj Pablo chi' winh. Ix tzek'an k'otan sb'a winh yet'ok. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha Yespíritu Dios tz'alani to icha ix wutej in tzek'an in b'a tik, icha chi' ol aj stzek'chaj winh ay yik jun tzek'ul tik yuj heb' israel t'a Jerusalén. Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' manh israelok, xchi winh.
Ha onhxo tik yet' heb' aj Cesarea chi', ayik ix kab'an tas ix yal winh chi', ix onh tewioch t'a winhaj Pablo chi', yujto ko gana max b'atlaj winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Palta ix yal winh t'ayonh: --¿Tas yuj tzex ok'i? ¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och in kusk'olal? Malaj yelk'ochi tato tzin stzek' heb'. Wach'chom tzin smilcham heb' t'a Jerusalén chi' yujnhej walanel yab'ixal Kajal Jesús, ol in b'eknhej in b'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi winh.
Junelnhej maj kak'laj ganar winh ko kachanoch wa'an. Yuj chi' ix kaktej ko tewi t'a winh. Tonhej ix kal icha tik: --Ha tas snib'ej Kajal Jesús, ujokab'i, xko chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix kak'an lista ko b'a, ix onh b'at t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ay pax jaywanh heb' creyente aj Cesarea chi' ix b'at ket'ok, ix onh yik'anb'at heb' t'a spat jun winh b'ab'el creyente aj Chipre skuch Mnasón, yujto ha t'a spat winh chi' ix onh kani.
Ayik ix onh k'och t'a Jerusalén chi', tzalajk'olal ix onh scha heb' creyente ta'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh b'at yet' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a spat winhaj Jacobo. Ayek' pax heb' winh anciano ta' smasanil.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej sk'ol heb' winh winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix laj yal winh t'a heb' yuj jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet'ok t'a skal heb' manh israelok.

Haxo ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix yal wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Te wach' wuk'tak, palta ojtak, tzijtum heb' ketisraelal ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol. Haxo slaj yalan heb' smasanil to yowalil sko k'anab'ajej ley Moisés.

Ix yab' spekal heb' to tzach ek' a k'ayb'ej heb' israel ay t'a skal masanil heb' manh israelok. Tob' ix al t'a heb' israel chi' to maxtzak sk'anab'ajej ley Moisés heb'. Tob' ix al t'a heb' to maxtzak yak' circuncidar heb' yuninal heb', maxtzak sk'anab'ajej ko b'eyb'al heb' a onh israel onh tik.
¿Tas ol kutok? Ha tiknaik ol yab' heb' to ix ach jawi.
Yuj chi', wach' icha tik tzutej a b'a. Ay chanhwanh heb' winh t'a ko kal tik, yak'nakxo sti' heb' winh t'a Dios. Wanxo sk'och stiempoal b'aj yak'nakkan sti' heb' winh chi'.

Ik'b'at heb' winh het'ok. Tza b'oankan a b'a yet' heb' winh icha syal ley Moisés. Tzak' stumin heb' winh yik smanan juntzanh nok' nok' heb' winh silab'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'an joxchajel sb'a heb' winh schanhwanhil. Tato icha chi' ol utok a b'a, ol yil heb' anima smasanil to a jun a pekal ix yab' heb' chi', to es. Haxo ol yilan heb' to tza k'anab'ajej pax tas syal ley Moisés.

Haxo heb' manh israelok ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'o'ol, tz'ib'ab'ilxob'at ko carta t'a heb' to manh yowalilok sk'anab'ajej juntzanh tik heb'. Anhej juntzanh cheknab'il tik ix kalb'at t'a heb': To max schi nok' chib'ej heb' tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max schi schik'il junok nok' nok' heb'. Max schi nok' nok' heb' sut'jichamok. Max em heb' t'a ajmulal. Icha chi' ix kutej kalanb'at t'a heb', xchi heb' anciano chi' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix ik'anb'at heb' winh chi' schanhwanhil. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix sb'o sb'a winh yet' heb' winh icha syal ley Moisés. Ixlajwi chi' ix och winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios yik syalan winh t'a winh sacerdote tas k'uhal ol lajwokk'och stiempoal sb'o'an sb'a heb' winh, yik syak'an silab' heb' winh t'a Dios.

Haxo yik wanxo slajwi uke' k'uhal chi', ay jaywanh heb' israel aj Asia, ayik ix yilan heb' to ayek' winhaj Pablo t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios, ix yak'ank'e somnaj heb' anima heb' smasanil skot yowal. Ix syaman winhaj Pablo chi' heb'.

Te cha'anh ix yal heb': --Ex ketisraelal, ochanhek ket'ok. Haton winh tik tzek' k'ayb'an heb' anima t'a junjun lugar t'a chukal. Syalan chukal winh t'a ko patik a onh israel onh tik. Syalanpax winh t'a spatik ley Moisés yet' t'a spatik stemplo Dios tik. Haxo tiknaik ix skomon ik'ejochta jaywanh heb' griego winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios tik. Ha jun templo tik, yiknhej Dios yaji, palta ix te juwi yuj winh t'a yichanh Dios, xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix aj yalan heb', yujto ix yil heb' to junnhej ix ek' winhaj Trófimo yet' winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha winh chi', griego winh, aj Éfeso winh. Ha sna'an heb' to a winhaj Pablo chi' ix ik'anoch winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios yet'ok.
Haxo heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix te kot yowal heb'. Ix smolb'an sb'a heb'. Ix b'at sjachanelta winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios chi'. Ix smakan puerta heb' t'a winh.
Toxo wal smilcham winh heb', palta ayik ix yab'an winh coronel to ix k'e somnaj heb' aj chonhab' chi' skot yowal,

ix yik'b'at heb' soldado winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil. Te yelk'olal ix b'at heb' b'aj wan smolb'an sb'a heb' anima chi'. Haxo ix yilanb'at heb' anima chi' to wan sk'och winh coronel chi' yet' heb' soldado smasanil, ix yaktan heb' smak'an winhaj Pablo chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winh, ix syaman winhaj Pablo chi' winh. Ix schekan winh ak'jok och chab' cadena t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: --¿Mach jun winh tik? ¿Tas smul winh? xchi winh.

Palta haxo heb' anima chi', tonhej ix k'e somnaj heb' yalani. Ch'okch'ok ix yal junjun heb'. Maj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' yujto tonhej ix k'e somnaj heb' yawajk'ei. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ik'jokb'at winhaj Pablo chi' t'a cuartel.
Haxo ix k'och heb' t'a sb'akhkiltakil sti' cuartel chi', ix b'akhjik'e winhaj Pablo chi' yuj heb' soldado chi', yujto snib'ej heb' anima chi' smilcham winh.
Masanil heb' tzak'anoch yuj winh ix laj awaj cha'anh heb': --Chamokab' winh t'a elanhchamel, xchi heb'.

Ayik wan yik'anoch winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a yol cuartel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh coronel chi': --¿Ma max yal in lolon jab'ok het'ok? xchi winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: --¿Tom syal halan ti' griego?

Walok to aj Egipto ach. Ha walani to a ach tik ik'nakcha'anh jun owal t'a spatik winh yajal t'a peka'. Ha jun winh chi', yik'nakb'at chanhe' mil heb' mak'umcham anima winh t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalxi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh: --Ma'ay. Ha in tik, israel in. Ha t'a chonhab' Tarso t'a yol yik Cilicia, jun chonhab' te niwan yelk'ochi, hata' aljinak in. Tzin k'an t'ayach, cha in lolon t'a skal heb' anima tik, xchi winh.

--Lolonanh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix elta linhan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a sb'akhkiltakil sti' cuartel chi'. Ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh yik wach' tz'em numan heb' anima chi'. Haxo ix em numan heb', ix yalan winh t'a heb' t'a ti' hebreo icha tik:
--Ex wetchonhab' yet' ex ichamtak winak, ab'ek in lolonel swal tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yab'an heb' to ix lolon winh t'a ti' hebreo, te numan ix aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb':

--Ha in tik, israel in heyet'ok. Ha t'a chonhab' Tarso t'a yol yik Cilicia, hata' aljinak in, palta ha t'a Jerusalén tik k'ib'nak in. Haxo winhaj Gamaliel k'ayb'annak in. Ix in sk'ayb'ej wal winh sik'lab'il t'a sley heb' ko mam kicham. Swak'anpax wal serwil Dios t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, icha tzeyutej he b'a he masanil tiknaik.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wixtejnak wal heb' ayoch t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al b'aj ay in och tiknaik. Ay b'aj in yamnakkot heb'. Wach'chom winak, ma ix, laj wak'nakoch heb' t'a preso. Ay b'aj wak'nakoch chamel t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh yajal smasanil syal yalan heb' winh to yel swala', yujto yak'nak juntzanh carta heb' winh t'ayin yik swik'anb'at t'a heb' ketisraelal t'a chonhab' Damasco. B'at in t'a chonhab' chi' yujto in gana tzin sayek' heb' creyente ta'. In gana sb'at in tzek'kot heb', tzul wak'an heb' t'a Jerusalén tik yik tz'ak'jioch sya'elal heb'.

Palta haxo yik wan in b'eyi, ayik wanxo in k'och t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', tekan chimk'uhalil hama, ay jun sakil k'inal te ow yok kot kopnaj t'a satcha'anh, yemul t'a wib'anh, in kan t'a skal,
in telwi t'a sat lu'um yuj. Haxo wab'ani, yawaj jun t'ayin, yalan icha tik: Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'ayin.
¿Mach ach Mamin? xin chi t'ay. Ha in ton Jesús aj Nazaret in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej, xchi t'ayin.
Haxo heb' ajun wet' chi', yil jun sakil k'inal chi' heb', te xiw heb'. Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas jun alji chi' t'ayin.
Slajwi chi' walan t'ay: Mamin, ¿tas a gana tzin k'ulej? xin chi t'ay. K'e'anh wa'an. Ixik t'a chonhab' Damasco. Hata' ol aljok t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Kajal Jesús chi' t'ayin.
Yujto majxo yal-laj wilan jab'ok yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', yuj chi' a heb' ajun wet'ok chi' ketzan in b'at t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Haxo ta' ay jun winh skuch Ananías, sk'anab'ajej wal ley Moisés winh sik'lab'il. Te wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb' israel smasanil t'a chonhab' Damasco chi'.
k'och winh t'ayin, yalan winh: Wuk'tak Saulo, jakwokab' a sat, xchi winh. T'a jun rato chi', jakwixi in sat. Wilan winh.

Yalanxi winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha ko Diosal, haton jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, ha' ix ach sik'aneli yik wach' ol ojtakejel tas snib'ej t'ayach. Yujto snib'ej to tzil Jesús, haton jun tojol spensar, ix ab'an pax tas ix yal t'ayach.
Xal tiknaik ol alel yab'ixal Jesús t'a skal anima smasanil. Ol ala' tas ix ila' yet' tas ix ab'i.
Haxo tiknaik manh a tanhwej. Ak' ak'jok bautizar a b'a. Al a b'a t'a Jesucristo yik wach' ol ak'jokkan lajwok a mul, xchi winh.
Haxo yik in jax t'a Jerusalén tik, in lesalwi t'a stemplo Dios tik. Ayik in lesalwi chi', ichato wayichan in.
Wilan Kajal Jesús, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Elanhchamel tzach el t'a Jerusalén tik, yujto toxon manh ol scha yab' jun wab'ixal heb' ol ala', xchi.
Yuj chi', wal t'ay: Mamin, toxon yojtak heb' to ix in ek' in say heb' ix yak'och sk'ol t'ayach t'a junjun spatil culto. Ix laj in yam heb', ix wak'anoch heb' t'a preso, ix in mak'an pax heb'.
Haxo winhaj Esteban, winh aljinakel ab'ixal, ayik smilannak cham winh heb', lokan in ta'. Ha in wilnakkan spichul heb' ayik sjulannakcham winh heb', xin chi t'ay.
Palta yalanxi t'ayin: Ixik, yujto najat tzach in chekb'ati, haton t'a skal heb' manh israelok. Icha chi' aj yalan Kajal Jesús chi', xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.

Ix smaklej yab' heb' anima chi' tas wan yalan winhaj Pablo chi', masanto t'a juntzanh ix yal winh chi', ix och ijan heb' ste awajk'ei, ix yalan heb': --Chamokab' winh. Manhxo smojok pitzan winh, xchi heb'.
Ix te k'e somnaj heb' skot yowal. Ix laj stzikub'tanhan spichul heb'. Ix stzipank'e lum pokok heb' t'a cha'anh yik sch'oxanel heb' to te yowal heb' t'a winh.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winh coronel chi', ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jioch winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol cuartel chi'. Ix yalan winh to smak'ji winh yik wach' syal winh tas yuj sk'e yaw heb' anima chi' skot yowal yuj winh.

Haxo yik toxo ix tzek'ji winh chi' yik smak'ji winh, ix yalan winh t'a jun winh capitán ayek' ta' --¿Tom ay sleyal tzin he komon mak'ej? Ina aj Roma in. Hanhejtona', malaj jab'ok in mul ix cheklaji, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh capitán jun ix yal winh chi', ix b'at winh yal t'a winh coronel chi' icha tik: --Te ay smay jun wan a k'ulan tik. Ab'i to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', xchi winh t'a winh.
T'a jun rato chi' ix b'at winh coronel chi' sk'anb'ej t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tom yel aj Roma ach? xchi winh t'a winh. --I', aj Roma in, xchi winh t'a winh.
--Ichin pax ta'. Anhejto te niwan tumin ix wak'a', ix in manoch in b'a aj Romail, xchi winh. --Palta a in tik, atax yik ix in alji toxonton aj Roma in, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', a heb' soldado ijan ix mak'an winh chi', ix yaktejxiel winh heb'. Ayik ix yab'an winh coronel chi' to aj Roma winhaj Pablo chi', ix te xiw winh, yujto ix yak' tzek'chaj winh yet' k'e'en cadena.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, snib'ej winh coronel chi' syab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi' yuj heb' israel. Yuj chi' ix schek winh ik'jokel k'e'en cadena chi' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' masanil heb' winh sat yajal. Ix yik'anelta winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'a yol cuartel chi', ix ak'ji entregar winh yuj winh t'a heb' winh.

Haxo ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb' winh sat yajal chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a heb' winh: --Ex wetchonhab', tojolnhej yaj in pensar t'a yichanh Dios, masanto t'a jun k'u tik, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Ananías, winh sat sacerdote, ix halan t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey winhaj Pablo chi' to stz'itb'at sti' winh heb'.

Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi': --Ha Dios ol ach mak'anpaxok. Ha ach tik, chab' sat ach. k'ojan ach em in a ch'olb'itan icha syal ley Moisés. Palta ina tzin a chek mak'jok, palta manh sleyalok tza k'ulej icha chi', xchi winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal juntzanh heb' ayek' ta': --¿Tom tzach b'uchwaj t'a winh sat sacerdote yaj tik yuj Dios? xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Pablo chi': --Ex wetchonhab', manh wojtakok tato a winh tik sat sacerdote yaj winh. Yujto syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Manh eyal chukal lolonel t'a spatik winh yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', xchikani, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yilan winh to saduceo nanhal heb' sat yajal chi', haxo nanhalxo heb', fariseo heb', yuj chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh t'a heb': --Ex wetchonhab', a in tik fariseo in, yuninal in pax fariseo. Haxo tiknaik, wan in he ch'olb'itani yujto swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi yalan jun chi' winh, haxo heb' fariseo chi' ix och ijan heb' stelan sb'a yet' heb' saduceo. Ix spojan sb'a jun smolanil heb' chi'.
Yujto a heb' saduceo syal heb' to manh ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak. Syalan heb' to malaj heb' ángel, malaj pax juntzanh espíritu. Haxo heb' fariseo syal heb' to ay juntzanh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix k'e nhilnaj heb' masanil yalani. Ay juntzanh heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yetb'eyum sb'a yet' heb' fariseo, ix k'e wa'an heb', ix yalan heb': --Malaj jab'ok chukal sk'ulej winhaj Pablo tik. Talaj icha chi' ay junok espíritu, ma junok ángel ix halan t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ste ak'an owal heb' sik'lab'il. Haxo winh coronel chi' ix te xiw winh. Ha sna'an winh to wan stok'an jekchaj winhaj Pablo chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot heb' soldado winh, haxo heb' ix ik'anelta winhaj Pablo chi' t'a skal heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anxib'at winh heb' t'a cuartel.

Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix ul sch'ox sb'a Kajal Jesús t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: --Pablo, manh ach och ilk'olal, yujto icha ix utej alanel wab'ixal t'a Jerusalén tik, icha pax chi' ol utok alanel t'a chonhab' Roma, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, ay jaywanh heb' israel ix smolb'ej sb'a. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' to ol smilcham winhaj Pablo chi' heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh ol onh waok, manh ol kuk'pax ha' masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej icha skal tik jun, yak'okab' ko ya'elal Dios, xchi heb'.
Másto 40 heb' ix halan icha chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yak'an mandar heb' israel. Ix yalan heb': --Ix kak' ko ti' to maxto onh wa'i masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix ko k'ankot ko ya'elal t'a Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha tas ix kal chi'.

Haxo tiknaik, a ex tik yet' juntzanhxo heb' sat yajal tze k'an t'a winh coronel chi' to syik'kot winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'ayex k'ik'an. Tze tz'akan eyal t'a winh to ayto wal tas he gana tzeyab' t'a winh. Ha onhxo tik, lista ol kutok ko b'a ko mak'ancham winh b'aj ol jawok chi', xchi heb' israel chi'.
Palta ay jun winh yune' ix yanab' winhaj Pablo chi' ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a cuartel chi'. Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yawtankot jun winh capitán winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ik'b'at winh kelem tik t'a winh coronel yujto ay tas snib'ej winh b'at yal t'a winh, xchi winh.

Haxo winh capitán chi' ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winh coronel chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yalan winh capitán chi' t'a winh: --Ha winhaj Pablo, winh ayoch t'a preso ix in awtanb'ati. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzul wak' jun winh kelem tik t'ayach. Tob' ay tas snib'ej winh syal t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo winh coronel chi' ix ketzanel winh, ix snitzanel sb'a heb' winh schawanhil. --¿Tas a gana tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh kelem chi': --Ay heb' israel ix halani, tob' ol sk'an heb' t'ayach yik tzik'b'at winhaj Pablo t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal k'ik'an. Ol stz'akan yal heb' t'ayach to ayto wal tas snib'ej heb' syab' t'a winh.

Palta manh a cha ab'i. Yujto más am 40 heb' ol sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol b'e, yik ol smak'cham winh heb'. Yujto ix yak' sti' heb' to manh ol wa heb', malaj pax tas ol yuk' heb' masanto ol smak'cham winh heb'. Ix sk'anankot sya'elal heb' t'a Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha ix yal heb' chi'. Ha tiknaik listaxo yaj heb'. Wan stanhwan heb' yab'i tato ol ak'b'at winh, xchi winh.
Haxo winh coronel chi' ix chekan pax winh kelem chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Malaj junok mach b'aj tzala' tato ix ul al jun tik t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh capitán winh coronel chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Tzeyak' lista chab'ok ciento soldado ol b'at t'a yok, 70 ok heb' ol b'at t'a yib'anh chej yet' chab'ok ciento heb' syik' slanza, yik sb'at heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea t'a k'e ak'walil tik.
Tzeyak'an lista jaywanhok schejal winhaj Pablo. Yujto yowalil ol eyik'b'at winh t'a winhaj Félix, winh yajal. Te lista tzeyutej he b'a yik malaj ol ik'an winh t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winh.
Ix yak'anb'at jun scarta winh t'a winhaj Félix chi'. Ha jun carta chi' icha tik syala':
Ha in Claudio Lisias in, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun in carta tik t'ayach, ach wajalil Félix. Swak'b'at stzatzil a k'o'ol ta'.
Tik swak'b'at jun winh skuch Pablo t'ayach. Ha heb' israel ix yaman winh. Ijan ix mak'jicham winh yuj heb', palta ix in kol winh yet' heb' soldado yujto ix wab'i to aj Roma winh.
In gana ix wab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winh yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' ix wik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.
Haxo ix wab'ani to yujnhej sley heb' ix och smul winh t'a heb'. Palta manh smojok smak'jicham winh, hanhejtona' manh smojok yoch winh t'a preso.

Palta ix wab'i to ay heb' israel ix slajtiej sb'a, ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'. Yuj chi' swak'b'at winh t'ayach. Ix walan t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh chi' to syal sb'at heb' t'ayach, b'at yalan heb' tas wal spensar heb' t'a spatik winh. Anhej tik swalb'at t'ayach, xchi winh t'a scarta chi'.
Haxo heb' soldado chi' ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'ak'walil. Ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Antípatris.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, a heb' soldado ix kot t'a yok chi' ix meltzajxikan heb' b'aj ay scuartel chi'. Haxo heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix b'at heb' yet' winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea chi', ix yak'an ch'anh carta chi' heb' t'a winh yajal chi'. Ix yak'ankan winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yilan ch'anh carta chi' winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi' tas chonhab'il b'aj kotnak winh. Haxo ix yab'an winh to aj Cilicia winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Jawokab' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh chi'. Ichato chi' ol wab'ani tas ol ala', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to stanhwaj winh t'a yol spat winhaj Herodes b'aj syak' yajalil.

Yoilxo k'uhal sk'och winhaj Pablo t'a Cesarea chi', ix k'och winhaj Ananías, winh sat sacerdote. Ajun pax jaywanh heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' jun winh licenciado skuch Tértulo. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Félix chi' yik syak'anb'at heb' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik ix ik'jikot winh, ix och ijan winhaj Tértulo chi' yak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj Félix chi': --Ach kajal Félix, yuj wal Dios t'ayach, u'uj junk'olal kaji. Te wach' yaj jantaknhej tas t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te jelan ach.
Te wach' ach. Ha t'a junjun lugar chekel yaji to wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach.
Palta yik max kik'ek' niwanok tiempo t'ayach, ¿ma max ak' pawor ab'an jay b'elanh lolonel ko gana skal tik t'ayach?

Ha winhaj Pablo tik, skab' wal sya'il yuj winh. Ijan max techaj ku'uj. Slaj ek' winh stzuntzej cha'anh owal t'a skal heb' ketisraelal t'a junjun lugar. Yajal yaj winh t'a junxo makan k'ayb'ub'al, haton heb' syak'och spensar t'a jun winh aj Nazaret.

Ix yak'lej winh yik'anoch heb' manh israelok t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios yik tz'ixtaxel t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' ix ko yam winh. Ko gana ix ko ch'olb'itej yaj winh, icha syal ch'anh ley aykan t'a yol ko k'ab',
palta haxo winhaj Lisias, winh coronel ix yekoch sb'a t'a ko kal. Ix b'at winh yik'elta winh t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo tik to yowalil skot heb' t'ayach. Ha ach tik, syal a k'anb'an ab' t'a winhaj Pablo tik. Ichato chi' ol ilanelta to yel, manh nab'anhejok skik'kot t'a yib'anh winh, xchi winhaj Tértulo chi'.
Haxo heb' winh israel ajun yet' winh, ix yal pax heb' winh: --Te yel syal winhaj Tértulo tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yechel winh yajal chi' yik slolon winhaj Pablo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal yik winh icha tik: --Mamin Félix, a ach tik, wojtak to niwanxo tiempo ayach och juezal t'a ko nación tik. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaji swalan tas waj t'ayach.
Syal ojtakaneli to yel juntzanh ol wal tik t'ayach. Manto k'ochlaj slajchawil k'uhal in k'och t'a Jerusalén, yik swal in b'a t'a Dios.

Malaj junok anima tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok. Malaj pax junok lugar b'aj tzek' wak'k'e somnaj heb' anima. Manhok t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios, manhok t'a yol spatil culto, manhok pax t'a junokxo lugar t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj jab'ok in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tik t'a wib'anh, malaj jab'ok tas sch'ox heb' tato yel juntzanh tas syak'och heb' tik t'a wib'anh.

Yel toni, ha Dios, haton sDiosal heb' in mam wicham, a t'ay swak' em in b'a, icha syal ko k'ayb'ub'al, haton jun makanhxo k'ayb'ub'al tik syal heb'. Palta a in tik, swak'och t'a in k'ol jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés yet' jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios.
Swak' wal och Dios yipok in k'o'ol to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak smasanil, jantaknhej heb' tojol spensar yet' pax heb' manh tojolok. Icha pax chi' sna heb' tik wet'ok.
Yuj chi' swil wal in b'a, yik max och in mul t'a Dios, yik max och pax in mul t'a heb' wetanimail.
Ay xom sjayilok ab'il manhxo in ayok ek' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Yuj chi' in k'ochxi, yik swak' jab'ok in kolwal t'a heb' meb'a' t'a skal heb' wetchonhab' tik, yik swak'an pax jab'ok in silab' t'a Dios.

Ayinek' t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios, yik swak'an in silab' chi'. Toxo ix in b'o in b'a ichataxon ko ley. Jaywannhej anima ayoch wet'ok, malaj mach nhilanochi. Malaj jab'ok owal ix in saya'. Palta hata' ix in syam juntzanh heb' israel aj Asia.
Tato ay wal in mul ix yil heb', kotokab' heb' t'a ichanh tik, ul yalokab' heb' tas in mul chi'. Oktom a wal heb' ix jawi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh ayek' tik, yalokab' heb', tato ay in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel ayik ix in sch'olb'itan heb'. Anhej tato mul jun tik:
Ayik ay in ek' t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi', te cha'anh ix wal icha tik: Wan in ch'olb'itaji yujto swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xin chi, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Félix chi' yojtak winh sik'lab'il tas yaj sk'ayb'ub'al heb' creyente. Yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Kotokab' winhaj Lisias, winh coronel chi'. Ol ul yalan winh t'ayin tas wal yaj jun eyowal tik. Ichnhejokab' ta' skan b'ela, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh capitán to hanheja' stanhwaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Palta libre wal tz'aj winh. Syal slolon winh yet' heb' swach'k'o'ol, syal pax yak'an heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.

Ayxom jaye'ok k'uhal chi', ix jax winhaj Félix t'a Cesarea chi' junelxo. Ajun ix yetb'eyum winh skuch Drusila yet'ok, israel ix. Haxo winh ix awtankot winhaj Pablo chi' yik sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a winh tas skutej kak'anoch Jesucristo t'a ko k'o'ol.

Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh to yowalil wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al, sko kachanoch wa'an ko b'a yik max ko k'ulej chukal. Ix yalanpax winh to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima smasanil. Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te xiw winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --k'okb'ilxo chi' tzala'. Tato ay b'aj ol och in kolanil, ol ach wawtejxikoti, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Félix chi', snib'ej winh to ix yak' jab'ok tumin winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh t'a elk'altak, yik tz'aktajel winh yuj winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum el ix awtajkot winh yuj winh yik slolon winh yet' winh.

Chab' ab'il ix yak' winh icha chi' yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Porcio Festo ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo yik ix el winhaj Félix chi' t'a yopisio chi', ix kannhej winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol preso chi' yuj winh yik wach' stzalaj heb' israel yet' winh.
Haxo winhaj Festo chi', ix k'och winh t'a Cesarea, yik tz'och winh yajalil. Yoxil k'uhal scha'an yopisio winh chi', ix k'e winh t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' t'a winh yik sk'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ix och ijan heb' sk'anan t'a winhaj Festo chi', yik wach' tz'ik'jikot winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yal heb' icha chi' yujto snib'ej heb' smilcham winh t'a yoltak b'e.
Palta ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Preso yaj winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Cesarea tiknaik. Yikto jaye' k'uhal tik ol in b'atxok ta'.
Yuj chi' syal sb'at heb' eyajalil t'a Cesarea chi' wet'ok. Tato ay smul winhaj Pablo chi', syal b'at yalan heb' ta', xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix am ek' wajxakeok, ma lajunheok k'uhal winhaj Festo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxxi winh t'a Cesarea chi'. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi' winh.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, a heb' israel ix kot t'a Jerusalén ix k'och hoyan heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Tzijtum tas ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh winh, palta malaj jab'ok tas sch'oxani tato yel syal heb'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Toxon malaj jab'ok in mul ochnak t'a sley heb' wetisraelal. Malaj in mul ochnak t'a stemplo Dios. Malaj pax in mul ochnak t'a winh kajal t'a Roma, xchi winh.

Palta yujto snib'ej winhaj Festo chi' to wach' skan winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tzam yal a k'ol tzach b'at t'a Jerusalén yik wach' hata' ol ach in ch'olb'itej? xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh: --Ha t'a yichanh winh kajal t'a Roma tzin k'anb'at in b'a. Anhej ta' syal in ch'olb'itaji. Ina ojtak, malaj in mul ix och t'a heb' israel tik.

Tato ay junok in mul smoj in cham yuj jun, in chamokab'i. Palta tato malaj in mul scheklaj yuj heb' israel tik, malaj junok mach syal in yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Tik tzin k'anb'at in b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Hato winh ol in ch'olb'itanok, xchi winh.

Haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix lolon winh yet' heb' tz'ak'an spensaril. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ha ach tik ix a k'anb'at a b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Yuj chi' hata' ol ach wak'b'ati, xchi winh.
Ayxom sjayilok k'uhal, ichato chi' ix ja winhaj rey Agripa yet' ix Berenice t'a Cesarea chi', yik tzul sk'uman winhaj Festo chi' heb', yujto toto ix och winh t'a yopisio.

Ix ek' jaye' k'uhal heb' ta'. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Festo chi' t'a winh rey chi' tas yaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ayik ix el winhaj Félix t'a yopisio ay jun winh skuch Pablo ix kan t'a preso yuj winh.

Ayik ix in xit'ek' t'a Jerusalén, a heb' sat sacerdote yet' heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio ix k'och heb' t'ayin, ix yak'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'. Snib'ej heb' ix wak'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.

Yuj chi' ix wal icha tik t'a heb': Ha yaj ley t'ayonh aj Roma onh tik, max yal skomon ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima. Yowalil syil-lajoch sat yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh chi' t'a yichanh winh juez yik syak'lej yik'anel t'a yib'anh, xin chi t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'.
Yuj chi' haxo ix ja heb' t'a tik maj wik'ek' tiempo. Ha t'a junxo k'u ix in och t'a in despacho b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ix in chekan ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ha in na'ani to ay wal smul winh. Palta haxo heb' ix ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh chi', malaj wal smul winh ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh icha ix wutej in na'ani.
Anhej ix yal heb' to ay smul winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb'. Ix yalan heb' yuj jun winh chamnakxo skuch Jesús. Haxo yujto syal winhaj Pablo chi' to pitzan winh, yuj chi' syak'och heb' t'a yib'anh winh.

Ha in xo tik max nachaj wu'uj tas swutej in b'oan yaj t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix in k'anb'ej icha tik t'a winhaj Pablo chi': ¿Tzam yal a k'o'ol tzach b'at t'a Jerusalén yik wach' hata' tzach in ch'olb'itej? xin chi t'a winh.

Palta haxo ix yalan winh t'ayin: Tik tzin k'anb'at in b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Hato winh ol in ch'olb'itanok, xchi winh t'ayin. Yuj chi' a inxo ix wala' to skan winh t'a preso, masanto ol wak'b'at winh t'a winh kajal chi', xchi winhaj Festo chi'.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj rey Agripa chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Festo chi': --Ha inxo tik, in gana swab' tas syal winhaj Pablo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Festo chi' t'a winh: --Tato icha chi', k'ik'anto tzab' tas syal winh, xchi winh t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix k'och winhaj rey Agripa yet' ix Berenice chi'. Yelxo wal te wach' yilji heb' yet' spichul, ix och heb' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ix och pax heb' yajal soldado yet' heb' ichamtak winak t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix chekan ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach Rey Agripa yet' he masanil ix he molb'ej he b'a tik ket'ok, ina winhaj Pablo tik. Masanil heb' israel ix halan t'ayin to ay smul winh. Ix yal heb' t'ayin t'a Jerusalén, ix yalanpax heb' t'ayin t'a Cesarea tik to manhxo smojok pitzan winh.

Palta tzin na a in tik to malaj junok smul winh, yik smoj scham winh yuj. Toxo ix sk'anb'at sb'a winh t'a winh kajal Augusto, yik wach' a winh ol ch'olb'itan winh. Yuj chi' tzin na'a to ol wak'b'at winh.

Palta malaj tas wach' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'a winh kajal chi' yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix wik'kot winh t'a ichanh ach rey Agripa yet' t'a eyichanh he masanil. Ha tiknaik, k'anb'ejek eyab' t'a winh, ta icha chi' ay junok smul winh tz'ilchaj eyu'uj, yik a jun chi' ol in tz'ib'ejb'at t'a winh kajalil chi'.
¿Tom ol yal wak'anb'at junok presowum tato max in tz'ib'ejb'at smul tz'och t'a yib'anh? xchi winhaj Festo chi'.
Haxo winhaj rey Agripa chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Syal halan tiknaik tas aji, xchi winh. Ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winhaj Pablo chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik:
--Ach rey Agripa, tzin te tzalaji yujto tzin a cha lolon t'a ichanh, yujto in gana swik'el jantaknhej tas ix yak'och heb' wetisraelal t'a wib'anh.
Te wach' swal t'ayach, yujto ojtaktaxon ko ley a onh israel onh tik. Ojtak pax tas tz'ik'an ko telan ko b'a. Yuj chi' tzin k'an t'ayach to niwan tzutej a k'ol t'ayin yik tzab'an tas ol wal t'ayach.
Ha heb' wetisraelal smasanil, yojtaktaxon heb' tas wutejnak in b'eyb'al t'a in chonhab' yet' t'a Jerusalén yiktax ix in kotoch uninal.
Tato ay snib'ej heb' syala', syal yalan heb' to ayxo tiempo fariseo in. Ha heb' fariseo chi' yelxo wal sk'anab'ajej juntzanh b'eyb'al yik ko k'ayb'ub'al heb'.
Haxo tiknaik, syak'och heb' t'a wib'anh yujnhej to swak'och yipok in k'ol tas yalnakkan Dios ayik yak'annakkan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ha heb' ketisraelal slajchawil makan, wan stanhwan heb' yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios chi'. Yuj chi' k'uhal t'ak'wal yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a Dios. Ach rey Agripa, yujnhej to tzin tanhwej yelk'och jun chi', yuj chi' syak'och heb' wetisraelal chi' t'a wib'anh tiknaik.
Ha exxo tik, ¿tas yuj max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to ha Dios tz'ak'an pitzwokxi heb' chamnak?
Ha in pensar t'a yalanhtaxo, to swak' chukal t'a heb' yik Jesús aj Nazaret. Ha in na'ani to te wach' swutej in b'a.
Icha chi' wutejnak in b'a t'a Jerusalén. Ochnak wopisio yuj heb' winh sat sacerdote, yuj chi' tzijtum heb' creyente wak'nakoch t'a preso. Ayik smak'jicham heb', tzin tak'wib'at t'a spatik heb'.

Tzijtum el wak'nakoch sya'elal heb' yik maxtzak yak'och Jesús heb' t'a sk'o'ol in na'ani. Icha chi' ek' wutejnak in b'a t'a yoltak spatil culto. Te niwan chichonnak in k'ol t'a heb'. Xit'nak in pax ek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' te najat, xit' wak'annakoch sya'elal heb'.
Yuj wal in chichonk'olal chi', a junel b'at in t'a chonhab' Damasco. Yujto ay wopisio yuj heb' winh sat sacerdote, yuj chi' schek in b'at heb' winh.

Palta ach rey swal t'ayach, tas aj in. Ayik wan in b'ey t'a chimk'uhalil, wilan skot kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh. Ek'alto yok t'a yok k'u. Emul kopnaj t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ajun wet'ok.

Telwi onh t'a sat lu'um yuj jun sakil k'inal chi' ko masanil. Wab'an yawaj jun, yalan t'a ti' hebreo icha tik: Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? Palta munil tzixtej a b'a icha junok nok' wakax stek'waj och t'a junok te te' stekjioch t'ay, xchi t'ayin.
Walan t'ay: Mamin, ¿mach ach? xin chi. Yuj chi', yalan Kajal Jesús t'ayin: Ha in ton tik, Jesús in. Ha in ton tzin ixtej.
Palta k'e'anh wa'an. Tzul in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach yik ol ach och in chekab'ok, ol alanel yab'ixal tas ix il tik yet' jantaknhej tas toto ol in ch'ox ila'.
Ha tiknaik, tzach in chekb'at t'a heb' manh israelok. Ol ach in kolelta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' etisraelal.

Tzach in chekb'at t'a heb' yik wach' ol jawok spensar heb', yik syaktejkan jun sb'eyb'al heb' yik k'ik' k'inal, haxo yoch heb' t'a jun sakil k'inal yik Dios. Ol elkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh diablo, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' Dios ol ochkan heb'. Ol in yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol yik wach' ol ak'jokkan lajwok smul heb'. Ichato chi' ol och heb' yetb'eyumok heb' ayxo och yikok Dios, yujnhej in yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'o'ol, xchi Jesús t'ayin.
Yuj wal chi', ach rey Agripa, in k'anab'ajej tas ul yalkan Jesús chi' t'ayin, ayik skot t'a satcha'anh ul sch'oxan sb'a.

Yuj chi' ha t'a Damasco chi' in b'ab'laj alejel slolonel Dios. Slajwi chi' ek' walanel t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil yol yik Judea, swalanpax t'a heb' manh israelok to sna sb'a heb', syak'anpaxoch spensar heb' t'a Dios. Swalan pax t'a heb' to yowalil wach' syutej sb'eyb'al heb', yik wach' scheklaji to yel sna sb'a heb'.
Yujto ix walel juntzanh chi', yuj chi' ix in syam heb' israel t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix yak'lan heb' in smilanchamok.

Palta ha Dios ix kolwaj wet'ok. Yuj chi' te tek'an ix wutej in b'a. Hanhejtona' pax tiknaik, tek'an swutej in b'a walanel slolonel Dios t'a masanil anima. Swal t'a heb' niwan yelk'ochi, swal pax t'a heb' malaj yelk'ochi. Ha heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yet' winhaj Moisés, ayokto stz'ib'annakkan heb' tastak ol jawok. Anhej juntzanh chi' tzek' waleli.

Swalaneli to a Cristo yowalil ix yab' sya'il, ix chami. Ixlajwi chi', haxo ix b'ab'laj pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak yik syalanel yab'ixal kolnab'il t'a heb' ketchonhab' yet' t'a heb' anima smasanil, xchi winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik wan yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo chi', haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix k'e juknaj winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Pablo, tekan to ay tas tz'ixtan yol a jolom. Manh jantakok tas a k'ayb'ejnak, yuj chi' ha' ix k'e t'a a jolom, xchi winh t'a winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Pablo chi': --Ach wajalil Festo, malaj tas tz'ixtan yol in jolom. Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex, te yel, te niwan yelk'ochi.

Haxo winhaj rey Agripa tik, yojtaktaxon juntzanh tik winh sik'lab'il. Yuj chi', tek'an wal swutej in b'a walan juntzanh tik t'a yichanh winh. Ha juntzanh swal tik, manh k'ub'eltakok yaji, yojtaknhej heb' anima smasanil. Yuj chi' wojtak to yojtak pax winh rey tik.
Ha hachxo tik ach rey Agripa, ¿tzam ak'och t'a a k'o'ol tas yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'? Wojtak to tzak'och t'a a k'o'ol, xchi winhaj Pablo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tom yujnhej jab' tzal tik tzin och cristianoal tza na'a? xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi': --Wach'chom yujnhej jab' ix wal tik t'ayach, mato yujto tzijtumto tas ol eyab'i, komonok tz'el t'a sk'o'ol Dios to icha ix in aj tik icha pax chi' tzach aj yet' jantak heb' ix ab'an tas ix wal tik, palta max ex tzek'chajlaj t'a k'e'en cadena icha waj tik, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix k'e linhan winh rey chi' yet' ix Berenice. Hanhejtona' ix k'epax linhan winhaj Festo yet' jantaknhej heb' ayek' chi' ta'.

Ix sb'esanel sb'a heb', yik smol alej heb' tas ol aj jun chi'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto malaj jab'ok smul winh, hanhejtona' manh smojok ayoch winh t'a preso tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Agripa t'a winhaj Festo chi': --Syal kak'anel winh t'a libre tiknaik, ichokta' maj sk'anb'at sb'a winh t'a winh kajal t'a Roma chi', xchi winh.

Ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh yajal to sb'at winhaj Pablo t'a Roma t'a yol yik Italia. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji entregar winh yet' jaywanhxo heb' yetpresowumal t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh capitán skuchan Julio. Ha jun winh chi', yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' jun makan heb' soldado winhaj Augusto.

Ix onh och t'a yol jun barco yik chonhab' Adramitio. Ha te' barco chi', t'inhan yek' te' t'a junjun lugar t'a stitak Asia. Ayik ix onh b'at t'a yol te', ix b'at pax winhaj Aristarco ket'ok, haton winh aj Tesalónica t'a yol yik Macedonia.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Sidón. Ha winhaj Julio chi', te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi', yuj chi' ix ak'ji spermiso winh yuj winh b'at sk'uman heb' swach'k'o'ol, yik syak' heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.
Ix onh helxi t'a Sidón chi', ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Ha t'a ko k'exanh ix kan Chipre chi' yujto manh tojolok sb'ey ik'.
Ix onh ek' t'a stitak Cilicia yet' t'a stitak Panfilia. Ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Mira, haton jun ay t'a yol yik Licia.
Haxo winh capitán chi' ix sayanek' junxo te' barco ta'. Ix ilchaj jun te' barco yik Alejandría yuj winh wan sb'at t'a Italia. Yuj chi' t'a yol te' ix onh yak'xioch winh.

Ayik ix onh b'atxi te tzijtum k'uhal ix onh b'eyi, yujto k'ojank'olal sb'ey te' barco chi'. Pural ix onh k'och t'a yichanhkot chonhab' Gnido. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Salmón, ix onh ek' pax t'a Creta, haton jun ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, yujto a jun ik' chi' hanheja' manh tojolok sb'eyi.
Pural ix onh ek' t'a sti' Creta chi' masanto ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch “B'aj Wach' Tz'och wa'an Te' Barco” ay t'a slak'anil chonhab' Lasea.
Te ayxo smay sb'eyek' te' barco chi' t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi', yujto toxo ix te ek' tiempo, wanxo sja nhab'il k 'inal.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pablo t'a heb' icha tik: --Ex wetanimail, swila' to te ay smay ko b'at tiknaik. Ol lajwokel te' barco tik yet' yikatz smasanil. Hanhejtona' ay pax smay ol onh chamok, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Palta a winh capitán chi', maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi'. Anhej tas ix yal winh tz'ik'an b'ey te' barco yet' winh aj barco chi' ix scha yab' winh.

Ha t'a jun lugar chi', malaj b'aj syal skan wa'an te' barco chi' yik tzek' nhab'il k 'inal chi'. Yuj chi' kenxonhej manh masanilok heb' ix na'ani to wach' tzonh b'atnhej, ta icha chi' kolan tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Fenice t'a yol yik Creta chi'. Hata' snib'ej heb' ix ko tanhwej ek' nhab'il k 'inal chi', yujto manh owok sk'och ik' ta'.
Ix sna heb' to wach' tzonh b'ati, yujto ay jun ik' k'ojank'olal wan skot t'a sur. Yuj chi' ix onh b'ati. Ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil stitak Creta chi'.
Palta junanto rato chi' ix pitzwicha'anh junxo niwan ik' tzek' t'a jun lu'um chi'.
Ix och chulan ik' t'a te' barco chi', majxo yal-laj sb'at te' b'aj sja ik' chi'. Yuj chi' ix kaktej kik'anb'at te' b'aj sja ik' chi', munilxonhej ix b'at te' b'aj sb'at ik' chi'.

Ix onh ek' t'a stz'ey jun yune' lugar skuch Clauda ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Hata' manhxo owoklaj ik' icha ix aj sja t'a sb'ab'elal chi'. Aytaxon jun te' ko yune' barco tok'b'il yuj te' niwan chi'. Pural ix k'eta te' ko tok'an t'a yib'anh te' niwan chi'.

Ixlajwi sk'ek'och te' t'a yib'anh te' niwan chi', haxo heb' aj barco chi', ix sk'an juntzanh niwak lasu heb', yik stzek'an tzatzb'ok te' niwan chi' heb'. Yujto ix xiw heb' spok'anem sb'a te' t'a yib'anh jun yarenail jun skuchan Sirte, ay t'a sjayil sti' ha', yuj chi' ix stijemta juntzanh icha mantiado heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh te' barco chi', haton juntzanh smak'ji yuj ik'. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh kan ichnhej ta'. Munilxonhej ix onh yik'b'at te' yet' ik' chi'.
Hanhejtona' t'a junxo k'u, te ow jun ik' chi'. Yuj chi', ix och ijan heb' syumankanel yikatz te' t'a yol ha'.
Haxo t'a yoxil k'uhal, ix onh kolwaj yet' heb' aj barco chi'. Ay pax juntzanh syamk'ab'il te' barco chi' ix ko yumkanel yet' heb'.
Niwan tiempo majxo kil-laj k'u yet' k'e'en k'anal. Haxo yuj jun ik' te ow ix k'och chi' t'ayonh, majxo ko nalaj tato tzato onh kolchaji.

Niwan tiempo majxo onh walaj. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e linhan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a ko kal. Ix yalan winh: --Ex wetanimail, oktom wal ix he cha eyab' tas ix wala'. Oktom maj onh kotlaj t'a Creta chi'. Tato icha chi', maj am ja jun tik t'a kib'anh, malaj am pax jab'ok tas ix sateli.
Haxo tiknaik swal t'ayex, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto malaj junok onh ol onh chamok. Wach'chom ol lajwokel te' barco tik.
Yujto a k'ik'i t'ak'wal ix ul sch'ox sb'a jun yángel Dios t'ayin. Haton jun Dios b'aj swak' em in b'a, yujto ha' ay in yiko'.
